title: I&P-GN - SONG-MT-DSMS-Customer Lifecycle Campaign-GEN AI-Senior Manager
description:
**Job Summary:**
The I&P Global Network Song practice works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions, providing transformation services driven by key offerings like Living Marketing, Connected Commerce and Next-Generation Customer Care. This is a leadership role for a CVM practitioner who has operated across both Consumer and Enterprise sides of the business. You will own the Next Best Action and Customer Value Management agenda end-to-end — setting the strategy, shaping the decisioning and agentic AI architecture, leading a multi-track delivery team, and carrying the senior client relationship. You will be the single accountable leader stitching together Prepaid Consumer growth and Enterprise Postpaid retention into one coherent lifecycle engagement programme.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* NBA-CVM Strategy & Transformation Leadership:
* Define and own the multi-year NBA-CVM transformation roadmap spanning Consumer (Prepaid and Consumer Postpaid) and Enterprise Postpaid portfolios.
* Set the value agenda against hard telco levers — ARPU uplift, churn and involuntary disconnection reduction, recharge frequency and top-up value, data attach, cross-sell and upsell, and revenue per enterprise account.
* Build the CVM operating model — governance forums, decision rights, campaign-to-cash measurement, and the operating rhythm between marketing, sales, product, data and IT.
* Shaping the Agentic AI vision:
* Drive the adoption of AI and Generative AI capabilities within lifecycle marketing, including customer segmentation, content generation, audience intelligence, next best action recommendations, campaign orchestration and performance optimization.
* Identify and scale high-value AI use cases that improve personalization, campaign effectiveness, marketing productivity and customer experience outcomes across the lifecycle journey.
* Build business cases for AI-enabled marketing transformation, demonstrating impact through campaign cycle-time reduction, improved customer engagement, operational efficiency and personalization at scale.
* Consumer & Enterprise Portfolio Ownership:
* Translate two very different commercial logics into one lifecycle framework — high-volume, high-frequency, price-elastic Prepaid Consumer engagement alongside relationship-led, contract-bound Enterprise Postpaid account management.
* Ensure Consumer and Enterprise tracks share a common customer data foundation, decisioning engine, offer library and measurement language while respecting the differences in buying cycle, decision unit and channel mix.
* Decisioning & Offer Framework:
* Own the target-state real-time decisioning architecture — Next Best Action / Next Best Offer strategy design, engagement policies, arbitration and prioritisation logic, adaptive and predictive model deployment, and inbound versus outbound channel orchestration.
* Govern the offer and proposition library, eligibility and suppression frameworks, contact policy, and offer economics across segments.
* Client & Stakeholder Leadership:
* Act as the trusted advisor to CMO, CDO, Chief Commercial Officer, Head of CVM and Enterprise Business Head level stakeholders.
* Manage a complex stakeholder ecosystem across client business, technology and analytics teams, Accenture account leadership, delivery centres and platform partners.
* Own escalation management and course correction across concurrent client engagements.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building:
* Lead and develop a team of Managers and Consultants across campaign strategy, decisioning, journey orchestration and analytics tracks.
* Build telco CVM and GenAI capability within the practice — assets, accelerators, reusable NBA playbooks, points of view and credentials.
* Commercial & Delivery Governance:
* Own delivery quality, project financials, resource planning, staffing pyramid and utilisation across engagements.
* Manage risk and contingency planning across multi-country, multi-vendor programme environments.
* Business Development:
* Create business cases, shape solutions, respond to RFPs and develop proposals that bring the best of Accenture's telco CVM, martech and AI capabilities to clients.
* Identify and convert expansion opportunities within existing telco accounts.

title: Organic User Acquisition Ninja (30 Day Sprint)
description:
We are hiring a hands-on growth marketer who can get working fashion designers and apparel founders into The F\* Word and through their first real workflow. You will recruit the people who can reach them, launch the experiments yourself, and show us how many users actually did something in the app.

**No old economy folks please. If your default playbook is Meta ads, Google PPC, SEO retainers, or a content calendar, please skip this one.**
Same goes if your best case study ends at impressions, followers, or waitlist signups. Bring proof that you acquired users and got them to use the product.

You Own

* **Turn our free tools into acquisition channels.**
  Use the AI Fashion Suite and its Scanner, Designer, and Portfolio tools to give people a useful first experience and a clear reason to open the main app.
* **Build the Trend to Design loop.**
  Recruit working designers, apparel creators, and niche community operators. Seed a trend brief, get participants to create designs, and give them something worth sharing that brings the next designer in.
* **Convert Design to Tech Pack.**
  Get users with a design they want to make into the tech pack workflow. Find where they drop off and work with our team to fix the handoff.
* **Track the whole path.**
  Show us who arrived, who signed up, who completed a design or tech pack, and who returned or brought someone else in. Separate traffic seeded by partners from users acquired through participant sharing.

We want

You have personally built a repeatable acquisition channel for an app, creative tool, or self-serve software product. You know how to recruit partners, test hooks and offers, use AI and automation to move faster, and trace a campaign through to in-app behavior. You can explain what you shipped, what it cost, and why it worked. You can also name an experiment you killed and tell us what the numbers showed.

Fashion experience helps. Proven acquisition is required.

The first 30 days

Plan on
**one to two days a week**
. Recruit the first partners, launch one tracked acquisition experiment, and show us where users converted or dropped off. We’ll use that evidence to decide what to run next and whether to extend the engagement.

The Application

Send one campaign you personally ran. Tell us
**whom you targeted, how you reached them, what you did yourself, and how many people signed up and completed a meaningful action in the app**
. Anonymized numbers are fine.

Then give us
**one idea you’d test in the first two weeks**
using the AI Fashion Suite. Name the audience, how you’d reach them, and the first action you’d get them to take.

Resumes are an old economy practice and we don't take those seriously, your answer will drive our decisions.

****About The Role****
We are actively seeking a highly enthusiastic and deeply empathetic Product Accessibility Engineer to become an integral part of our dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute significantly to our core mission: ensuring all our applications are universally accessible to every individual, irrespective of their abilities or challenges.
  
  
As a Product Accessibility Engineer, you will be immersed in the complete product development lifecycle, from the initial conceptual design phases through to meticulous testing and final deployment. This hands-on experience will provide invaluable insights and practical skills within the rapidly expanding and critically important field of digital accessibility. You will collaborate closely with various teams, including product managers, designers, and engineers, to identify potential accessibility barriers, propose innovative solutions, and implement best practices that adhere to global accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG).
  
  
Exceptional opportunity for students who possess a keen interest and foundational knowledge in front-end development, human factors engineering, or interaction design. You will have the chance to apply your academic learning and emerging professional skills in a truly meaningful way, directly impacting the lives of diverse users and contributing to a more inclusive digital landscape. Beyond technical skills, we are looking for individuals who demonstrate a strong sense of empathy, a proactive problem-solving approach, and a commitment to fostering an inclusive user experience.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Design Phase: Collaborate with our design teams to review mockups and prototypes, ensuring they meet accessibility standards. You’ll check for proper color contrast, clear descriptions, and logical heading structures.
* Development Phase: Work with our development teams to ensure code is written with accessibility in mind, focusing on proper use of HTML, JavaScript, and CSS.
* Testing Phase: Assist in testing applications for accessibility. You'll use a combination of automated tools, manual checks, and testing with assistive technologies like screen readers to identify and report issues.
* AI Development (Bonus): If you have experience in AI, you may have the opportunity to contribute to projects involving AI-powered accessibility features.

****Skills We're Looking For****

* Front-End Development: A solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Empathy: A genuine desire to understand and advocate for the needs of users with disabilities.
* Design Skills: An eye for good design and an understanding of user experience principles.
* Bonus Skills: Experience or interest in AI development is a plus.

****Qualifications****

* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, Front-End Development, Human Factors Engineering, or Interaction Design.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
* A passion for creating inclusive and accessible technology.

**Modern Tooling Acumen:**
Direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. Must be able to effectively guide AI tools to achieve desired outcomes.
  
  
Graduates need direct experience using and critically reviewing code and artifacts generated by large language model (LLM) coding assistants and agentic tools. This is a newer requirement; candidates who have actively experimented with and used tools like Gemini, Cursor, or other agent-based frameworks will be stronger candidates.
  
  
Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

**Human-AI Interaction (HAI) & UX Expert**
, you are the architect of the user experience. You study the "friction" between human intent and machine response, refining the personality, empathy, and logic of the AI. Your goal is to move AI from being a "tool" to becoming a "partner" by optimizing how it handles multi-turn conversations and builds user trust. At TELUS, you ensure technology adapts to the human, not the other way around.

* **Conversational UX Auditing:**

* **Persona & Tone Synthesis:**

title: Assistant Manager - Media
description:
**The Opportunity**

As Plum scales, every media investment must do more than deliver impressions: it should strengthen consumer preference and contribute to measurable business growth. We are looking for an Assistant Manager– Media (Digital) to lead full-funnel digital media strategy, investment planning and effectiveness across priority brands and categories. This is a commercially grounded role combining brand-building judgment, analytical rigour, creative understanding and strong agency leadership.

**What You'll Own**

1
**. Full-Funnel Media Strategy & Planning**

* Translate brand and category priorities into integrated digital media plans across awareness, consideration, conversion and retention.
* Own channel and budget recommendations across YouTube, Meta, OTT/CTV, search, programmatic and relevant emerging platforms.
* Balance long-term brand building with near-term demand creation, ensuring a coherent consumer journey.

**2. Media Investment & Business Impact**

* Own media budgets, phasing, forecasts and investment efficiency across focus categories.
* Evaluate incremental impact on awareness, branded search, traffic, consideration, conversion and sales; distinguish correlation from causation.
* Recommend where to scale, reduce or reallocate spending using business outcomes, not only CTR, CPC or ROAS.

**3. Experimentation, Measurement & Analytics**

* Design structured tests across audiences, channels, creative, frequency and media mix.
* Develop reporting frameworks and dashboards to connect media signals with commercial outcomes.
* Work with Analytics, Growth and E-commerce teams to assess incrementality, attribution limitations and learning agendas.

**4. Agency & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Brief, challenge and manage media and performance partners against clear deliverables and outcomes.
* Lead regular performance reviews and ensure timely optimization and financial discipline.
* Collaborate with Brand, Category, D2C, E-commerce, Finance and Creative teams to turn insights into decisions.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2-4 years in digital media planning, integrated media, growth or performance marketing, preferably in consumer/D2C environments.
* Demonstrated ownership of sizable media plans, budgets and agency relationships.
* Strong knowledge of Meta, Google/YouTube, OTT/CTV and performance media; comfortable interpreting brand and business metrics.
* Advanced Excel/Sheets and analytical skills; ability to structure ambiguous questions and test hypotheses.
* Sound consumer and creative judgment, strong communication and stakeholder influencing skills.
* Comfortable with speed, ambiguity and high accountability; beauty experience is helpful but not essential.

**You'll Thrive Here If You...**

* Think of media spending as a business decision, not simply a channel plan.
* Question standard agency recommendations and build your own point of view.
* Can move between creative discussion and rigorous numerical analysis.
* Enjoy experimentation and are willing to change course when evidence demands it.

description:
PharmaACE is a growing Global Healthcare Consulting Firm, headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. Our expert teams of Business Analysts, based across the US, Canada, Europe, and India, provide Analytics and Business Solutions using our worldwide delivery models for a wide range of clients. Our clients include established, multinational BioPharma leaders and innovators, as well as entrepreneurial firms on the cutting edge of science. We have deep expertise in Forecasting, Business Analytics, Competitive Intelligence, Sales Analytics, and the Analytics Centre of Excellence Model. Our wealth of therapeutic area experience cuts across Oncology, Immuno- science, CNS, CV-Met, and Rare Diseases. We support our clients' needs in Primary Care, Specialty Care, and Hospital business units, and we have managed portfolios in the Biologics space, Branded Pharmaceuticals, Generics, APIs, Diagnostics, and Packaging & Delivery Systems.

**Brief Introduction:**

PharmaACE’s Primary Market Research (PMR) team works with leading pharmaceutical clients based in the US. We conduct diverse types of primary market research targeting healthcare and pharma professionals (physicians/ nurses/ pharmacists/ patients). The actionable insights on market performance and future strategy development are an aid to the pharmaceutical commercial teams in developing as well as validate near term and long-term brand strategies.

**Designation name and Description:**

* Senior Consultant – Primary Market Research
* Individual contributor plus strong project and people management skills
* Able to comprehend and manage client expectations effectively
* Flexible to work on quick turnaround projects Responsibilities:
* Required to design and execute high quality primary research for leading global pharmaceutical clients.
* Should be able to take decisive actions with regards to project plan implementation
* Looking for people with strong data analysis skills and the ability to generate actionable insights that help the client’s business strategy process.

**Responsibilities:**

* Required to design and execute high quality primary research for leading global pharmaceutical clients.
* Should be able to take decisive actions with regards to project plan implementation
* Looking for people with strong data analysis skills and the ability to generate actionable insights that help the client’s business strategy process.

**Market Research Design and Execution:**

* Develop and implement primary market research strategies to address client-specific business objectives.
* Design qualitative and quantitative research studies, including surveys and in-depth interviews.
* Identify and engage key stakeholders, including healthcare professionals, patients, and industry experts.
* Execute and improvise on the market research setup as per client requirements.

**Data Analysis and Insight Generation**
:

* Analyze primary data to uncover trends, behaviors, and actionable insights.
* Translate research findings into strategic recommendations for clients.
* Utilize statistical tools and software for data analysis as needed.
* Analyze primary data to obtain relevant discussion points.

**Client Management:**

* Support a leading global pharmaceutical client and internal stakeholders in an offshore setting.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by understanding their business challenges and providing tailored research solutions.
* Communicate research findings and recommendations through clear and compelling presentations and reports.
* Build and maintain long-term client relationships.

**Project Management:**

* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery within budget and scope. Coordinate with internal teams and external partners (vendors) to ensure project success.
* Monitor project performance and proactively address any challenges or risks.
* Train and develop reporting team members to independently run projects.
* Mentor the team members to meet expectations and develop existing skills.

**Industry Expertise and Innovation:**

* Stay abreast of market trends, therapeutic areas, and regulatory developments in the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors.
* Innovate research approaches and tools to enhance the quality and efficiency of deliverables. Contribute to thought leadership initiatives, including whitepapers, webinars, and conferences.

**Qualification and skills:**

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant job experience
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Excellent analytical, communication, reporting, and presentation skills
* Fluency in English is a must.
* MBA Marketing with Graduation degree in Life Sciences or Pharmaceutics / MBA Pharma / M Pharma
* Understanding and experience of working in US pharmaceutical market scenario is a must
* A decent background knowledge around multiple therapy areas (specifically oncology) is an advantage
* Experience of developing and programming survey questionnaires or discussion guides is desirable
* Able to create impactful PowerPoint presentations based on survey data.
* Adherence to client specific data privacy and compliance policies

title: Solution Owner - SKF.com & Digital Experience Platforms
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Solution Owner - SKF.com & Digital Experience Platforms
**Reports To:**
Head of Digital Commercial Solutions
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
**Location:**
Pune

**Purpose of the role**

Digital experience is becoming increasingly important in how customers discover, engage with, and do business with SKF. As part of SKF's digital transformation journey, we are evolving the capabilities that enable customers, partners, investors, job seekers, and employees to interact with SKF in more seamless, consistent, and personalized ways.

We are looking for a Solution Owner to drive the evolution of key digital experience capabilities, including content management & content lifecycle management, digital asset management, and translation management. These capabilities are fundamental to SKF's ambition of delivering compelling, scalable, and globally consistent digital experiences across channels and markets.

As a Solution Owner, you will be responsible for translating business needs and customer insights into prioritized initiatives that create measurable value. Working closely with stakeholders across business and technology, you will ensure that SKF's digital platforms and capabilities continue to support a modern, efficient, and customer centric digital ecosystem.

In addition to continuously improving today's capabilities, you will help shape SKF's future digital landscape. This includes exploring and enabling new opportunities in AI, automation, content operations, personalization, and customer experience optimization, ensuring SKF is well positioned to adapt to rapidly changing customer expectations and technological advancements.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Shape and drive the vision, strategy, and evolution of SKF's digital experience capabilities, including content management & content lifecycle management, digital asset management, and translation management.
* Own and prioritize the SKF.com product backlog, ensuring investments are aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and SKF's digital transformation roadmap.
* Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to identify opportunities that strengthen SKF's brand, improve customer engagement, and create seamless end-to-end digital journeys.
* Lead the evolution of digital capabilities that enable global content creation, management, localization, and delivery at scale.
* Drive strategic transformation initiatives that modernize how SKF creates, manages, delivers, and optimizes digital experiences across markets, channels, and touchpoints.
* Explore and enable emerging technologies, including AI, automation, and data driven personalization, to improve efficiency, content effectiveness, and customer experiences.
* Define roadmaps and investment priorities that balance innovation, operational excellence, scalability, security, and long term business value.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects, UX specialists, web developers, content teams, and external partners to turn strategy into impactful digital solutions.
* Champion a customer centric and data driven approach to decision making, ensuring digital experiences are informed by insights, user behavior, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure digital platforms and capabilities remain secure, resilient, adaptable, and ready to support future business growth and changing customer expectations.
* Build strong partnerships with technology vendors and implementation partners to accelerate innovation and maximize the value of SKF's digital investments.
* Promote modern product management, Agile, and DevSecOps practices that enable continuous improvement, faster delivery, and sustainable digital transformation.

****Main Requirements****

* Solid understanding of modern web and digital experience platforms including headless CMS or DXP platforms, modern frontend frameworks, analytics, technical SEO/GEO and web performance.
* Proven experience in a solution owner, product owner, digital product manager, application owner, or similar role, driving digital products and business capabilities in a complex environment.
* Experience leading digital experience platforms, global enterprise websites, content ecosystems, or customer facing digital solutions.
* Strong product management experience, including roadmap definition, backlog prioritization, value realization, and agile delivery.
* Experience working at the intersection of business and technology, translating strategic objectives into scalable digital capabilities.
* Knowledge of content management, content lifecycle management, digital asset management, translation management, digital experience delivery, or related disciplines.
* Understanding of modern digital ecosystems, including cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data driven decision making, and emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence and automation.
* Experience driving digital transformation initiatives and managing change across organizations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build alignment across business, IT, and external partners.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage audiences ranging from operational teams to senior leadership.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

The AI Engagement, Community and Training Senior Change Manager will translate engagement, communications, community and learning strategies into coordinated plans, milestones and deliverables. You will handle cross-functional delivery across AI communications campaigns, the AI Champion community, the AI Community of Practice, AI learning coordination, trusted guidance and continued development of the AI Hub. Translate engagement, community and training strategies into integrated plans, milestones, dependencies and deliverables. Establish practical delivery rhythms, maintain momentum and ensure work is completed to agreed quality and outcomes.

Coordinate Communications, Training, Workplace and Resilience, AI Governance, Digital Security and other teams to execute shared priorities. Clarify roles and hand-offs, manage dependencies and avoid duplication of specialist responsibilities.

Coordinate AI communication campaigns, content development, approvals and associated execution activity. Maintain coherent plans and ensure messages and materials are clear, consistent, timely and connected to adoption objectives.

Track progress, dependencies, risks, issues, actions and outcomes across the engagement portfolio. Produce clear status reporting and decision support, and ensure commitments are owned and followed through.

See opportunities to simplify plans, content processes, community operations and delivery controls. Capture learning and improve repeatability, quality and pace across the pillar.

title: Operations Innovations Senior Analyst
description:
**Locations**
: Gurgaon | London
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology-enabled, global organization.
  
  
Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology & AI deployments to end-to-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
  
  
We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward-thinking design.
  
  
**Key Activities And Responsibilities Include**

* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication & engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.
* Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.
* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation

What You'll Bring
  
  

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus

Who You'll Work With
  
  
The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You’re Good At**

* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* Structuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* Culture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements
* Learning and adapting – you are an eager and consistent learner, are naturally curious, open to feedback and interested in continuous improvement

*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.*

The analyst will work with senior analysts and with clients, including OEMs, carriers, component suppliers, and investors, to make sure our device research holds up both quantitatively and qualitatively.

**The Work**

As an Analyst on the
**Recon Analytics Device Intelligence Group**
, your responsibilities will include:

* Creating and managing global and country-level market trackers and industry reports across device categories such as smartphones, tablets, wearables and PC/laptops.
* Networking with local OEMs, industry executives and build awareness about our products and services
* Supporting other market research activities and business initiatives
* Preparing reports and contributing to internal and external presentations
* Collaborating with global team members across time zones
* Writing blogs and research notes under the guidance of senior team members
* Participating in weekly and daily meetings and collaborating through tools such as MS Teams, Outlook, Asana, and others

**Who This Is For**

* You learn fast and stay curious. You think in systems and catch what others miss. You have 2+ years in an analytical role. You're an expert with MS Powerpoint and Excel.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Competitive pay based on industry standards.
* Competitive leave policy with PTO days and local national holidays.
* Flexible work hours

**Where This Goes**

You start by building and maintaining trackers and research notes. You grow into authoring reports and owning client relationships. Analysts who perform here become known in the industry because clients and reporters start asking for them by name.

**How to Apply**

* Apply to this job post if you qualify
* Create a short PowerPoint deck on India's smartphone market with OEM market share, price forecasts, best-selling models and send it to hanish.bhatia@reconanalytics.com

description:

About the Role

We're looking for a performance-driven
**Media Buyer**
with hands-on experience in scaling Indian D2C and e-commerce brands.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of paid advertising, consumer behaviour, and e-commerce business economics. You'll be responsible for planning, executing, managing, and scaling paid campaigns across Meta and Google Ads, with a clear focus on driving profitable revenue, improving customer acquisition costs, and maximizing ROAS.

This role requires someone who understands more than just campaign management. We need a person who can analyse numbers, identify growth opportunities, make strategic decisions, and take complete ownership of campaign performance.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Media Buying & Campaign Management**

* Plan, build, launch, and manage performance marketing campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
* Manage multiple D2C brand accounts across different product categories and business models.
* Develop campaign structures, audience strategies, budget allocations, and scaling plans based on individual brand objectives.
* Manage daily campaign budgets and ensure efficient utilization of advertising spends.
* Execute retargeting, prospecting, lookalike, broad targeting, and audience segmentation strategies.

**2. Performance Optimisation & Scaling**

* Continuously monitor and optimise campaigns to improve ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, CPM, CPC, and overall conversion rates.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective actions through audience, placement, creative, and budget optimisation.
* Develop and execute scaling strategies while maintaining profitability and stable acquisition costs.
* Conduct regular A/B testing across creatives, audiences, ad copies, campaign structures, and landing pages.
* Track customer acquisition costs, conversion funnels, and overall advertising efficiency.

**3. Creative Strategy & Collaboration**

* Work closely with the creative team to develop performance-focused ad concepts and creative directions.
* Identify winning creatives and provide actionable feedback for iterations and new creative production.
* Understand different creative formats, hooks, angles, USPs, and consumer psychology that drive conversions.
* Analyse creative performance and identify fatigue, declining engagement, and opportunities for improvement.

**4. Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Maintain daily tracking of campaign performance and advertising spends.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights.
* Analyse campaign data to identify trends, bottlenecks, and growth opportunities.
* Track overall brand performance against agreed KPIs and business objectives.
* Communicate campaign performance, challenges, and scaling opportunities to internal teams and clients.

**5. Account Ownership & Strategy**

* Take ownership of assigned brand accounts and their advertising performance.
* Understand individual brand margins, AOV, contribution margins, product economics, and profitability targets before planning campaigns.
* Develop brand-specific media plans aligned with business goals and growth targets.
* Stay updated with the latest advertising trends, platform updates, and performance marketing strategies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in media buying or performance marketing.
* Prior experience working with Indian D2C, Shopify, or e-commerce brands is mandatory.
* Strong practical expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Proven experience in managing and scaling monthly advertising budgets of at least ₹10–20 lakhs.
* Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC, CPA, AOV, CPM, CPC, CTR, CVR, and contribution margins.
* Experience with campaign scaling, creative testing, audience research, and retargeting.
* Good understanding of Shopify analytics, Meta Pixel, Conversion API, Google Analytics 4, and tracking fundamentals.
* Ability to independently manage multiple brand accounts and advertising campaigns.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

What We're Looking For

* Someone who understands the difference between generating sales and generating profitable sales.
* A hands-on media buyer who can independently manage accounts without constant supervision.
* Someone who takes ownership of campaign performance and doesn't just follow instructions.
* A data-driven thinker who can translate campaign numbers into actionable strategies.

B-148, B Block, 2nd Floor,

title: Senior Manager, Strategy, India
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****About The Role:****
The Strategy group is focused on unlocking client business growth by developing audience, category, market and media insights. Key responsibilities include using audience and media tools to identify insights, translating them into media strategy and go-to-market recommendations, and working closely with planning and activation teams to develop responses to campaign and business briefs.
  
  
This will be a dedicated strategy role for one of WPP Media’s top global clients: Google. The role will independently lead strategy for an assigned business, while also contributing to larger brand, cross-business and portfolio-level strategic projects in partnership with the wider strategy team.
  
  
Reporting of the role:
  
  
This role reports to the Director/Sr. Director (Google)
  
  
****3 Best Things About The Job:****

* You would be working in one of the most exciting agencies and with a team of energetic and diverse individuals
* Opportunity to work across a wide spectrum of strategic assignments including audience strategy, integrated media planning, annual planning, category analysis and emerging media opportunities.
* Opportunity to work across traditional, digital and emerging media for one of the world's leading technology brands

Measures of success:
  
  
****In Three Months:****

* Demonstrate hands-on ability to use tools such as TGI, WPP internal platforms and GWI to analyse audiences, media behaviour, affinities and consumption patterns and translate the findings into actionable strategic implications.
* You would meet the key client on your independent brand and have a 1:1 rapport when it comes to strategic requirements
* Understand how a strategy moves from audience and business insight into planning to buying to partnership to activation and so on, and proactively identify where strategic inputs can improve the final media recommendation

****In Six Months:****

* Independently manage defined strategic assignments and develop strategic responses to client requirements and briefs, with senior strategy guidance where required.
* Contribute meaningfully to Brand AOPs, quarterly planning and campaign strategy by bringing together audience data, category dynamics, competitive activity and media behaviour
* Demonstrate the ability to create integrated channel recommendations across digital and offline media rather than independently planning channels in silos.
* Develop point-of-view documents and strategic narratives on relevant audience, category, platform and media trends
* Partner with various teams to ensure the strategic recommendation is reflected consistently in channel architecture, media roles and campaign execution.

****In Twelve Months:****

* Be visible as key POC of your team within the agency as well as with clients
* Drive annual, half-yearly and quarterly planning ensuring above benchmark scores for strategy on client feedback
* Drive award-winning strategy work through innovative approaches, new emerging platform test and learns, use of AI on business problems, etc
* Build reusable strategic frameworks and learnings that can improve planning across multiple campaigns and businesses rather than approaching every brief from scratch
* Contribute original thinking to broader Google strategy projects, including new audience opportunities, emerging platforms, evolving media behaviour and category shifts

****Skills And Experience****

* Hands on expertise in tools like TGI, GWI, Comscore. The candidate should be able to independently work with the tools, extract relevant data, identify meaningful patterns and translate the output into strategic audience and media recommendations
* Strong understanding of audience segmentation, media consumption analysis, affinity analysis, reach/penetration analysis and the ability to use these to build differentiated audience strategies
* Proven contribution to Brand AOPs, quarterly business reviews with senior client stakeholders; working on pitches will be a bonus
* Ability to work with multiple data sources and reconcile different signals into one clear strategic recommendation rather than presenting data points in isolation
* Ability to articulate the role of media platforms differently based on tasks – eg: launch brands vs challenger brands vs brands looking at premium audiences vs small town India
* Strong depth of understanding on media platforms and tactics – TV vs. CTV vs. Sharechat vs Instagram
* Strong communication, presentation and strategic storytelling skills; comfortable developing clear, insight-led presentations and presenting recommendations to internal teams and client stakeholders
* Ability to simplify complex research, media and audience information into a sharp strategic narrative with a clear ‘so what’ and recommended action
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to convert an ambiguous business or marketing challenge into a structured media strategy problem.

**Mandatories**

* 4-6 years relevant experience in a media agency with atleast one exposure on tech/smartphone category
* Hands-on working knowledge of TGI and GWI is mandatory. Candidate should have personally used these tools for audience/media analysis rather than only consumed outputs prepared by research or planning teams
* Ability to clearly articulate the role of both online and offline media channels and how they can work together within an integrated media strategy.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
You own the brand on social media from strategy to the last comment. That covers:

* **Brand direction:**
  Set the long-term vision. Keep the positioning sharp and different from everyone else in the feed. Measured by brand awareness, consideration and brand health scores, tracked quarterly.
* **How the brand shows up on social media, end to end:**
  Every post, profile and reply should look, sound and feel like us.
* Calendar and series
  **.**
  Plan the monthly social calendar for our Instagram pages and run it. Strategise, write and create episodic series.
* **Growth:**
  Drive healthy growth in engagement and followers. Organic growth, virality and content loops are your playbook. Paid boosting backs them up. Measured by engagement rate and follower growth, tracked against industry benchmarks.
* **The words:**
  You own banner and web copy, and you write it yourself. Every line should sound like the brand, read well to a consumer and give them a reason to act.
* **Creators and agencies:**
  Run influencer campaigns from brief to results. Manage agencies so their work stays on brand, on time and within budget.
* **Performance:**
  You know why a post worked and why it did not, and you know how to read the data to prove it.
* **Competition:**
  Track competitors on positioning, launches and communication. Turn what you find into action. Measured by a monthly competition report and the share of brand decisions backed by insight.
* **Trends:**
  Stay close to the consumer. Build on the trends that fit the brand and skip the ones that do not.
* **Budgets:**
  You know how to get more done with smaller budgets. You stretch each spend across organic growth, content loops, creators and targeted boosting, and you can show what each one returned.

What we are looking for:

You have 5 to 7 years in D2C, beauty, personal care or FMCG, and a track record of growing brands on social media, especially Instagram and LinkedIn.

You also bring:

* Paid social experience
* A working knowledge of the Instagram algorithm and how to build for the feed
* Strong creative judgement and an eye for design
* An AI native way of working: you know when AI makes the work easier and when it costs you quality
* An ambitious vision for the brand, and the willingness to be hands-on with execution
* Clear briefing skills and easy working across design, video, performance and growth teams
* Fluency in Instagram formats: reels, carousels and stories
* Comfort shooting reels yourself and appearing in them on camera
* Community management instincts, from comments and DMs to DM automation flows
* A test-and-learn habit: you try hooks, formats and creatives, and act on the results
* Working knowledge of Canva, Manychat (or any other DM automation tool), Meta Ads Manager, Meta Business Suite, Instagram, Instagram Edits and Instagram Analytics, and LinkedIn

title: Exhibition Marketing Manager
description:
Job Description: B2B Exhibition Marketing Manager

**Company:**
Vertex Next

**Position:**
B2B Exhibition Marketing Manager

**Industry:**
International B2B Exhibitions, Trade Shows & Conferences

**Experience:**
Minimum 2 Years in B2B Exhibition Marketing

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

About the Role

Vertex Next is seeking a proactive, creative and results-driven
**B2B Exhibition Marketing Manager**
to manage marketing campaigns for our international portfolio of trade shows, exhibitions and conferences.

We are looking for someone who understands that successful exhibition marketing is not simply about generating registrations, but about
**attracting the right industry professionals, decision-makers and buyers who deliver genuine business value to exhibitors and sponsors.**

The candidate must be equally comfortable developing marketing content, managing digital campaigns, creating designs in Canva, engaging directly with exhibitors and conducting targeted visitor acquisition activities.

Key Responsibilities1. Exhibition Marketing & Campaign Management

* Plan and execute end-to-end marketing campaigns for B2B exhibitions and conferences.
* Develop and maintain detailed marketing calendars with clear deadlines and deliverables.
* Drive visitor registrations, delegate acquisition, exhibitor enquiries and event awareness.
* Identify relevant industries, companies, job titles and decision-makers for each exhibition.
* Develop segmented campaigns for different visitor and exhibitor categories.
* Monitor campaign performance and continuously improve results.

2. Exhibitor Engagement & Visitor Profiling

* **Conduct regular calls with exhibitors, sponsors and clients**
  to understand their business objectives and target customer profiles.
* Identify the industries, companies, job titles and decision-makers exhibitors wish to meet.
* Translate exhibitor requirements into focused visitor acquisition campaigns.
* Work closely with the sales team to identify and attract relevant buyers.
* Conduct direct outreach through telephone calls, LinkedIn, email and other channels to encourage participation from targeted visitor groups.
* Coordinate buyer invitations and targeted networking opportunities.
* Ensure visitor acquisition focuses on
  **quality and commercial relevance, not just registration numbers.**

3. Content Marketing & Creative Development

* Develop compelling, industry-specific content for exhibition marketing campaigns.
* Create professional marketing creatives using
  **Canva**
  , including social media posts, email banners, speaker announcements and event promotions.
* Prepare email campaigns, newsletters, brochures, promotional messages and website content.
* Promote conference agendas, industry themes, keynote speakers and participating companies.
* Understand industry trends and convert technical subjects into engaging marketing messages.
* Coordinate with graphic and web designers for more advanced creative requirements.
* Maintain consistent branding, accuracy and professional communication standards.

4. Digital Marketing & Social Media

* Manage email marketing campaigns, audience segmentation and promotional databases.
* Plan and execute LinkedIn and other relevant social media campaigns.
* Support paid advertising campaigns across LinkedIn, Google and other appropriate platforms.
* Coordinate website updates, landing pages and registration campaigns.
* Monitor engagement, registrations, lead generation and campaign conversions.
* Create and modify basic HTML marketing emails where required.

5. Sales, Exhibitor & Partner Marketing

* Support the exhibition sales team with targeted exhibitor and sponsorship lead-generation campaigns.
* Develop exhibitor promotional materials and marketing toolkits.
* Coordinate agreed marketing deliverables for exhibitors and sponsors.
* Work with industry associations, media partners and supporting organisations to expand event reach.
* Develop campaigns highlighting the commercial benefits of exhibiting, sponsoring and attending.

6. Marketing Operations & Coordination

* Maintain strict control over campaign schedules, marketing deliverables and deadlines.
* Coordinate with sales, conference production, graphic design, web development and operations teams.
* Ensure all marketing campaigns and collaterals are accurate, professionally presented and delivered on time.
* Manage multiple exhibition marketing campaigns simultaneously.
* Maintain CRM records, marketing databases and campaign tracking spreadsheets.
* Provide weekly performance updates and progress reports.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **Minimum 2 years of direct experience in B2B exhibition or trade show marketing is mandatory.**
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to independently produce professional marketing content.
* Hands-on proficiency in
  **Canva**
  for creating marketing creatives and promotional materials.
* Experience with email marketing platforms, CRM systems and database segmentation.
* Strong understanding of visitor acquisition, buyer profiling and B2B lead generation.
* Confident conducting professional telephone calls with exhibitors, clients and prospective visitors.
* Experience managing LinkedIn and other social media channels.
* Good working knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets and marketing reporting.
* Familiarity with HTML email creation and website content management would be an advantage.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to meet strict deadlines.
* Ability to independently manage campaigns while coordinating with internal teams.
* Flexibility to work across international time zones when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on:

1. **Qualified Visitor Acquisition:**
   Delivering relevant visitors aligned with exhibitor requirements.
2. **Registration Targets:**
   Achieving agreed exhibition visitor and conference delegate registration targets.
3. **Exhibitor Engagement:**
   Conducting client calls, understanding buyer requirements and executing targeted campaigns.
4. **Marketing Campaign Performance:**
   Email engagement, lead generation, conversions and campaign effectiveness.
5. **Content & Creative Quality:**
   Producing accurate, engaging and professionally designed marketing materials.
6. **Timely Execution:**
   Completing marketing activities and campaign deliverables according to the approved calendar.
7. **Database & CRM Management:**
   Maintaining accurate, segmented and relevant marketing data.

**Important:**
This position requires a hands-on exhibition marketing professional, not someone whose experience is limited to social media posting or general digital marketing. The successful candidate must be capable of understanding exhibitor requirements, identifying the right target audience and independently executing campaigns that bring relevant buyers and decision-makers to our exhibitions.

title: Brand & Strategic Communications Manager
description:
**Induckt Ventures | DeepTech & Emerging Technology Venture Capital Fund**

**Location:**
Delhi NCR

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office

3–5 Years

Brand, Communications & Marketing

Full-Time

About Induckt Ventures

Induckt Ventures is a SEBI-registered venture capital fund focused on investing in DeepTech and emerging technology startups across India and South Asia.

Our investment thesis spans Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Aerospace, Defence Technology, Quantum Computing, Semiconductors, Advanced Manufacturing, Clean Energy, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, and other transformative technologies.

Through our investment platform and broader startup ecosystem, we work closely with founders, institutional investors, family offices, government institutions, incubators, and strategic partners to support innovation and technology-led entrepreneurship.

Role Overview

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and execution-oriented professional to lead the brand positioning, institutional communications, digital presence, and external engagement initiatives of Induckt Ventures.

The individual will be responsible for developing a distinctive institutional identity for the fund, strengthening its visibility within the venture capital and DeepTech ecosystem, and creating meaningful communication with investors, founders, portfolio companies, and strategic stakeholders.

This role requires a combination of strategic thinking, creative execution, business understanding, and excellent communication skills. The candidate will work closely with the Managing Partner, investment team, and senior leadership to establish Induckt Ventures as a recognised name in the venture capital and emerging technology ecosystem.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Institutional Brand Strategy & Positioning**

* Develop and execute the overall brand strategy and positioning of Induckt Ventures.
* Establish a consistent and differentiated institutional identity across all communication channels.
* Strengthen the fund's positioning among institutional investors, family offices, founders, government institutions, and industry stakeholders.
* Develop brand guidelines, visual identity frameworks, corporate profiles, and institutional marketing collateral.
* Ensure consistency in brand messaging, presentation, and communication across the organisation.

**2. Strategic Communications & Thought Leadership**

* Develop communication strategies for the Managing Partner and senior leadership.
* Create high-quality thought leadership content on venture capital, DeepTech, emerging technologies, startup investments, and industry developments.
* Draft articles, opinion pieces, newsletters, blogs, LinkedIn posts, and institutional announcements.
* Manage leadership communication and executive visibility across relevant platforms.
* Build a strong narrative around the fund's investment philosophy, portfolio, achievements, and ecosystem initiatives.

**3. Digital Presence & Content Management**

* Manage the organisation's website, LinkedIn, and other relevant digital platforms.
* Develop and execute a structured digital communication and content calendar.
* Create engaging content highlighting investment activities, portfolio companies, startup innovations, industry insights, and fund developments.
* Coordinate the development of videos, graphics, presentations, infographics, and other digital assets.
* Track digital performance, audience engagement, reach, and brand visibility.

**4. Investor & Institutional Communications**

* Develop professional communication material for existing and prospective investors.
* Support the preparation of fund brochures, investor presentations, corporate profiles, newsletters, and periodic updates.
* Coordinate with the investment and compliance teams to ensure accuracy and consistency of external communications.
* Support investor engagement initiatives, fundraising campaigns, and institutional outreach.
* Assist in developing communication strategies for strategic partnerships and government-backed initiatives.

**5. Media Relations & Public Relations**

* Develop and maintain relationships with relevant media houses, journalists, publications, and industry platforms.
* Identify opportunities for leadership interviews, media coverage, industry features, and speaking engagements.
* Prepare press releases, media statements, announcements, and corporate communication.
* Manage the fund's public image and external communication in coordination with senior management.

**6. Ecosystem Engagement & Event Management**

* Plan and execute investor conferences, DeepTech summits, founder meetups, roundtables, and networking events.
* Manage event branding, promotional campaigns, invitations, and post-event communication.
* Coordinate with incubators, accelerators, industry associations, government bodies, and ecosystem partners.
* Support portfolio company visibility through collaborative campaigns and ecosystem initiatives.
* Develop opportunities for Induckt Ventures to participate in relevant industry forums and conferences.

**7. Marketing Strategy & Performance Management**

* Develop and execute integrated marketing and communication campaigns.
* Identify opportunities to improve institutional visibility and stakeholder engagement.
* Coordinate with external creative agencies, designers, digital marketing partners, and vendors.
* Manage marketing budgets and campaign execution.
* Prepare periodic reports covering brand visibility, digital performance, engagement, and campaign effectiveness.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Business Administration, Public Relations, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in brand management, strategic communications, corporate communications, digital marketing, or public relations.
* Experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, financial services, consulting, or the startup ecosystem will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of institutional branding, business communication, and digital media.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to create professional presentations, marketing collateral, and high-quality content.
* Working knowledge of LinkedIn, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, and other relevant content and design tools.
* Familiarity with AI-powered content creation and digital marketing tools will be an advantage.

Desired Candidate Profile

* Strong creative abilities combined with a commercial and business-oriented mindset.
* Ability to understand and communicate complex financial, investment, and technology concepts.
* Excellent storytelling, writing, and presentation skills.
* Strong ownership and ability to independently manage projects from conceptualisation to execution.
* Ability to work closely with senior management and investment professionals.
* Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on:

1. Growth in institutional brand visibility and recognition.
2. Quality and consistency of corporate communications.
3. LinkedIn growth, engagement, and digital reach.
4. Development and execution of thought leadership initiatives.
5. Quality of investor-facing and institutional marketing material.
6. Media coverage and external brand positioning.
7. Successful execution of investor events and ecosystem engagements.
8. Overall effectiveness of brand-building and communication initiatives.

What We Offer

* An opportunity to build and lead the brand identity of an emerging venture capital platform.
* Direct exposure to venture capital, institutional investors, family offices, and innovative DeepTech startups.
* Opportunity to work closely with the Managing Partner and senior investment leadership.
* Ownership of strategic brand-building and institutional communication initiatives.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth working environment.

Application Process

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV along with relevant work samples, including brand campaigns, corporate communication projects, content portfolios, LinkedIn campaigns, or previous brand-building assignments. at ayush@induckt.vc

* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).

* Build relationships with technical staff and management to determine and resolve issues associated with project implementation, manages and mitigates risk, and ensures that a change control process is in place.

* Strong leadership, communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.

**We makes you stand out?**

* Understanding of insurance and risk management

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Human-AI Interaction & UX Expert (AI Community)
description:
At
**TELUS Digital**
, we don't just build smart AI; we build
**intuitive AI**
. As a
**Human-AI Interaction (HAI) & UX Expert**
, you are the architect of the user experience. You study the "friction" between human intent and machine response, refining the personality, empathy, and logic of the AI. Your goal is to move AI from being a "tool" to becoming a "partner" by optimizing how it handles multi-turn conversations and builds user trust. At TELUS, you ensure technology adapts to the human, not the other way around.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Conversational UX Auditing:**
  Analyze the "flow" of multi-turn interactions to ensure the AI maintains state, reduces cognitive load, and provides concise, actionable answers.
* **Trust & Calibration Analysis:**
  Identify instances where the AI is overconfident (leading to false trust) or overly cautious (leading to frustration) and refine the "Calibration of Trust."
* **Persona & Tone Synthesis:**
  Develop and test specialized personas (e.g., Empathetic Counselor vs. Objective Data Analyst) to ensure tone-alignment across different industries.
* **Accessibility & Inclusivity Design:**
  Evaluate how models handle diverse speech patterns, non-standard dialects, and accessibility needs to ensure the AI is truly global.

Qualification path

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* **Education:**
  Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree specifically in
  **Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Psychology, UX Research, or Behavioral Economics.**
* **Bilingual Language:**
  **Bilingual-level proficiency (C2+)**
  in your primary language is mandatory to evaluate the cultural "vibe" and natural flow of dialogue.
* **English Proficiency:**
  **Minimum**
  **B1 (Intermediate)**
  level English for global community collaboration.

**Assessment:**

In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.

**Payment:**

Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour

Our Payment terms are defined for each project.

**Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community:**

* **Community Connection:**
  Work remotely as part of a
  **1M+ diverse global AI Community**
  of contributors and experts.
* **Impactful Expertise:**
  Use your bilingual language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.
* **Hands-on Innovation:**
  Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.
* **Global Collaboration:**
  Collaborate with a network of specialists across
  **20+ domains**
  and
  **500+ languages and dialects.**
* **Flexible Engagement:**
  Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.

**TELUS Digital AI Community**

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

**Independent Contractor Relationship**

**This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.**

Click here to apply.

By bringing AI-powered systems, product design, software development, and growth marketing under one roof, Clouté eliminates the need for brands to coordinate multiple external teams.
