title: Lead Video Editor
description:
Idea to Edit is a creative studio that makes video content for brands in the US. We run client accounts from Atlanta, and our creative team works from our office in Gandhinagar.

We're looking for a Lead Video Editor: a strong editor first, who can also lead a team of editors. This is a hands-on role. You will edit the most important videos on each account yourself, set the style the rest of the team follows, guide the editors working with you, and be the main contact for US clients on everything related to the edits. We are not looking for a manager who doesn't edit.

**About the work**

Most of our work is social content for US businesses: talking-head videos, B-roll edits, trending formats, and long-form YouTube videos. Each client has its own brand style, captions, fonts, and music, and every video has to match it. We handle a high volume every month, so speed and consistency matter as much as creativity. If you're still reading, add the word CLEANCUT to your email subject line.

**What you'll do**

* Edit long-form YouTube videos (10 to 20 minutes) with strong pacing, B-roll, and a hook in the first 30 seconds
* Edit short-form content for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok
* Find the best moments in long raw footage and shape them into a clear story, without a script
* Turn rough or abrupt footage into smooth, premium-looking edits with the right pacing, transitions, and sound
* Build reusable templates and brand styles for each client (captions, text animations, lower thirds, intros and outros)
* Lead and manage the editors on your team: assign work, set priorities, and make sure every deadline is met
* Make sure every video that leaves our studio is up to the mark. Check the pacing, design, sound, captions, and brand fit, and fix anything that isn't at the highest quality.
* Communicate directly with US clients on Slack and turn their feedback into clear changes
* Keep files and projects organized in Google Drive and Notion or ClickUp

**What we're looking for**

We want someone who:

* Is self-motivated and does not need to be micromanaged
* Is excited to come to work and takes pride in every video
* Has a strong sense of design and aesthetics: typography, color, layout, and what makes a video look premium
* Understands pacing and rhythm, knows when to cut and when to hold, and can make abrupt shots feel smooth
* Is ready to lead the team under them, and knows how to manage people, deadlines, and feedback
* Wants to grow, keeps learning new tools and techniques, and is ready to take on more responsibility over time
* Is a positive person that everyone enjoys being around. Your personality matters as much as your work.
* Takes feedback without getting defensive, and makes revisions quickly
* Asks questions early when footage or notes are unclear
* Understands what feels natural to a US audience

**Skills and experience**

* At least 2 to 3 years of experience working in an agency, or freelancing directly for companies
* A strong portfolio with both long-form and short-form work
* Expert-level Premiere Pro and After Effects
* Music and audio mixing: choosing the right track, cutting music to the edit, balancing voice, music, and sound effects, and clean final levels
* Audio cleanup: removing noise and echo from phone or room recordings
* Color correction, especially natural and consistent skin tones
* Hands-on experience with AI editing tools and techniques, such as Descript, Adobe Enhance Speech, Runway, AI captioning tools, and ChatGPT or Claude Code for scripting and planning
* Experience with cloud editing and review workflows, such as Frame.io, shared Premiere projects, and Google Drive
* Clear written English. You will message US clients directly.

**Job details**

* Salary: ₹50,000 to ₹60,000 per month, based on experience
* Full-time, in-office at our Gandhinagar office. This is not a remote role.
* 6 days a week
* Paid twice a month, every 15 days
* Selection includes test rounds

All applications will be reviewed by email only. Applications submitted through LinkedIn will not be considered.

**Who should apply**

Only apply if you live in Gandhinagar or Ahmedabad, can commute to Gandhinagar daily, or are ready to move to Gandhinagar. In your email, tell us where you live. If you live farther away, confirm that you are ready to move to Gandhinagar before the end of November if you are selected. Emails that don't mention this will not be considered.

**How to apply**

Email info@ideatoedit.com with:

* Your resume
* A portfolio link with at least one long-form video and three short-form videos you edited
* Your years of experience and the agencies or companies you have worked with
* Any experience you have leading or managing other editors
* The AI and cloud tools you use in your editing
* Two references: people you have worked with in the past, with their name, role, and email or phone number
* Where you live, and whether you can commute or relocate

title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.
  
  
At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly - those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you’re not just building the future - you’re an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
Diligent is seeking a Senior Technical Writer to join our Global team and help shape the future of Product Content.
  
  
We’re looking for someone who combines technical documentation expertise with a passion for modern, in-product
  
  
content experiences, and AI-powered knowledge delivery. The ideal candidate will not only create comprehensive
  
  
documentation for Diligent products but will also drive forward–thinking strategies, systems, and processes that
  
  
transform how we enable our users.
  
  
This role is perfect for someone who sees content as more than just documentation – it's a strategic UX component
  
  
that can shape product experience. You’ll need to rapidly develop breadth and depth of expertise in our products and
  
  
services while synthesising technical information into clear, contextual communication that enables users to quickly
  
  
get value from our products. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple time zones. You’ll take
  
  
ownership over your area, driving the content creation process and working independently to ensure successful
  
  
delivery from start to finish.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
 Write clear, concise, complete, and correct content for new and existing software products, spanning
  
  
traditional documentation, in-product content, and contextual help experiences. Author content for multiple
  
  
mediums, including online help, user interfaces, microcopy, tooltips, guided tours, APIs, and other in-product
  
  
content experiences.
  
  
 Review, edit, and standardize UI microcopy and UX content to maintain consistency and quality across
  
  
products.
  
  
 Collaborate effectively with global, cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, software
  
  
engineers, QA, and others.
  
  
 Contribute to AI-powered initiatives.
  
  
 Interview subject matter experts, perform technical research, and test and validate software and prototypes to
  
  
fully understand how to use and support them.
  
  
 Provide feedback to other team members and contribute to team standards and best practices.
  
  
 Communicate proactively, be able to self-manage, and meet deadlines. Articulate the organization’s vision.
  
  
Independently take decisive action to support and enhance that vision.
  
  
 Actively seek out new opportunities to make strategic improvements, communicate value, and develop
  
  
meaningful relationships.
  
  
**Required Experience/Skills**
 5+ years of experience in professional writing, preferably in a technology or Saas environment, with a proven
  
  
track record in creating user-centred content.
  
  
 A passion for excellence in communication, regardless of form. Excellent written and verbal communication in
  
  
English, with an ability to adapt tone and style for global audiences and content type.
  
  
 Can provide 2 to 3 writing samples demonstrating ability to succeed in this role. (Samples may include
  
  
technical documentation, UX writing, or in-product content).
  
  
 Demonstrates an interest in AI-powered content delivery.
  
  
 Forward thinking: develops a vision for what’s next and isn’t content to just maintain existing practices.
  
  
Last Updated Jan 2026 PR-Wri-P3 Senior Technical Writer
  
  
 Openness to and an enthusiasm for in-product content experiences (tooltips, onboarding guides, contextual
  
  
help) rather than limiting focus on traditional help documentation.
  
  
 Writes clear, concise, complete, and correct technical content in a single sourcing environment using
  
  
structured writing principles.
  
  
 Ability to edit and apply standards to the work of others, ensuring all communication has a consistent voice
  
  
and meets our standards.
  
  
 Not content to sit around and await instructions. Constantly strives to improve information products and
  
  
procedures for creating them.
  
  
 Experience working effectively in distributed team environments with strong self-management and timemanagement skills
  
  
 Working knowledge of version control systems such as GitHub.
  
  
 Experience with XML-based authoring tools.
  
  
 Willingness to learn in-product content platforms and embrace modern content delivery approaches.
  
  
Creativity is ingrained in our culture. We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients. We care about our people. Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs. (among others) Diversity is important to us. Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding.
  
  
Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability – to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place.
  
  
Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D.C., London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney.  To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to work onsite at least 50% of the time. title: Senior Technical Writer
description:
**Who is DexCare?**

  

DexCare optimizes time in healthcare, streamlining patient access, reducing waits, and enhancing overall experiences. Guided by our mission – Nobody waits for care – DexCare addresses tech gaps by aligning supply and demand to modernize healthcare infrastructures for an inclusive ecosystem. We are equally committed to our DEIB mission: Creating an inclusive workplace where diversity drives innovation, equity ensures fairness, and belonging strengthens collaboration, enabling everyone to thrive. 

  

 

  

**What is DexCare?**

  

DexCare, a digital care orchestration platform, streamlines care delivery logistics. It empowers healthcare systems to predict constraints and precisely schedule services, optimizecapacity, and cuts operational costs. Currently serving 57 million patients, including Kaiser Permanente and Providence, DexCare ushers in a new era of digital-care access, ensuring health systems can efficiently track and deliver every hour of capacity for consumer ease.

  
  

For more information, visit
www.dexcare.com
or follow us on
LinkedIn
. 

**About Role**
  

One multifunctional technical writer embedded with our platform engineering teams in the Bangalore GCC. The role is API-first — the primary reader is an engineer integrating with DexCare's APIs — but deliberately not API-only: the writer also owns end-user and admin documentation and pivots between the two streams as launches demand. The writer owns API reference documentation, developer integration guides, release notes, and product user/admin documentation across DexCare's product lines (Acquire, Search, Scheduling, PDM, Optimize, Virtual/ODV, Mila).

**What the Role Owns**
  

  
* **API reference documentation:**
  Author and maintain OpenAPI (OAS 3.0) specifications and the reference documentation generated from them, keeping them accurate release over release
  
* **Developer guides:**
  Integration guides, quickstarts, and authentication/tenancy walkthroughs for customer and partner engineers consuming our platform APIs
  
* **Release notes:**
  Own the engineering and product release-notes pipeline on our release cadence, working from Jira and GitHub rather than waiting for inputs
  
* **Docs-as-code workflow:**
  All documentation lives in Markdown on GitHub and moves through pull-request review. Drafting is AI-assisted (we use Claude heavily across R&D); the writer's judgment is the editorial layer on top, not a replacement for it
  
* **User & admin documentation:**
  Second stream, picked up in launch bursts and maintenance: product user manuals, admin-app help content, and customer-facing launch collateral (for example, maintaining the PDM user manual as the product evolves)
  
* **Partnership:**
  Sits with Engineering and Product daily. Must be able to pull accuracy out of busy engineers — reading the code change, the spec, and the ticket — rather than needing content handed over finished
  
  

  
**Must-Have Qualifications**
  

  
* **Range across both documentation types:**
  4–7 years of technical writing with the majority on developer-facing content (API references, SDK docs, integration guides) plus real end-user or admin documentation experience (product manuals, help content). The role is API-first but multifunctional — a portfolio showing only one of the two falls short, and a UI-help-only portfolio does not qualify
  
* **OpenAPI / OAS 3.0 hands-on:**
  Can read, edit, and maintain OAS 3.0 specs directly — not just render them in a portal
  
* **REST fluency:**
  Comfortable with endpoints, request/response shapes, OAuth2/JWT auth, webhooks, and error semantics; can fire a test call in Postman or curl to verify what they are documenting
  
* **GitHub + Markdown:**
  Branches, pull requests, reviews, merge discipline. Docs-as-code is the daily workflow, not an aspiration
  
* **Reads payloads and code:**
  Can read JSON/YAML and follow sample code in at least one of Python, Java, or JavaScript well enough to catch documentation errors
  
* **Strong written English:**
  A writing sample (API reference or developer guide they authored) is required with every submitted profile
  
  

  
**Strong Pluses**
  

  
* **Healthcare technical writing:**
  Prior technical writing in healthcare or healthtech is a big plus — EMR/EHR integrations, HL7 or FHIR interfaces, provider or claims data, HIPAA-aware documentation. A writer who already speaks this language shortens ramp materially; weight this heavily when two profiles are otherwise equal
  
* **Documentation tooling:**
  Redoc, Swagger UI, Stoplight, ReadMe, Docusaurus, or similar API documentation platforms
  
* **AI-assisted documentation:**
  Demonstrated use of AI tools (Claude, Copilot, or similar) in a real documentation workflow — prompting, reviewing, and correcting output rather than pasting it

  

**DexCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

  

 

  

DexCare is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, caste, religion, colour, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, age, disability, or any other status protected under applicable Indian law. DexCare provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities, in line with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.

title: Staff Technical Enablement Consultant
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Staff Technical Enablement Consultant to join our team. This is a Hybrid role in Bangalore, reporting to the Manager, CS Enablement in the CS Enablement department. The Staff Technical Enablement Consultant serves as the technical bridge between product architecture, instructional design, and field readiness, partnering deeply across Professional Services, Technical Success Managers, and Customer Support. This position accelerates time-to-autonomy by reproducing real customer architectures and edge-case issues in lab environments, converting that specialized work into scalable enablement assets and targeted technical coaching.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Triage and prioritize enablement requests from cross-functional teams, translating field pain points and feature releases into a deliverable enablement backlog with clear learning outcomes
* Build and maintain high-fidelity lab sandbox topologies to replicate complex customer deployments and edge-case issues, troubleshooting hands-on with SMEs to validate root causes and workarounds
* Create and maintain canonical enablement assets, including self-paced student guides, topology diagrams, verification rubrics, scenario drills, and troubleshooting runbooks, to increase field autonomy at scale
* Produce authoritative, structured technical source collateral for AI-assisted content generation and perform strict quality assurance to ensure technical accuracy and prevent content drift
* Deliver targeted, high-impact enablement interventions such as topic bootcamps, weekly office hours, and ad-hoc architecture whiteboard deep dives focused on complex topics and new releases

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing a dynamic environment as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You are a dedicated problem-solver who seeks out challenges and is energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hardest problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a continuous learner with a true growth mindset who actively seeks feedback to develop yourself into a better partner and a stronger teammate.
* You are a pragmatic builder obsessed with creating, iterating, and shipping, willing to roll up your sleeves to balance technical excellence with rapid value delivery.
* You champion simplicity and are highly skilled at distilling complex problems, user needs, and technical concepts into clear, actionable plans and precise communication.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
* 5+ years of experience in system/network engineering, cloud architecture, or technical operations with hands-on experience replicating complex topologies in virtual sandbox/lab environments
* Experience designing and authoring technical enablement assets (labs, student guides, verification rubrics, troubleshooting runbooks/decision trees) that are clear, testable, and scalable
* Strong foundation in enterprise networking/security concepts and the ability to whiteboard and explain end-to-end flows (e.g., packet flow, policy processing order, hybrid connectivity, IdP/SCIM concepts)
* Demonstrated cross-functional partnering skills (PS, TSMs, Support, Enablement/LXD, Lab Infra/DevOps) and ability to intake/prioritize requests based on impact and urgency
* Strong communication and facilitation skills across modalities (written self-paced content + live clinics/office hours), with a bias toward improving field autonomy

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience building/operating lab infrastructure and automation (e.g., environment provisioning, tenant resets, repeatable lab reliability) in partnership with Lab Infra/DevOps
* Experience with AI-assisted curriculum workflows (creating “AI-ready” canonical source content, validating AI-generated learning modules, governance to prevent drift/hallucinations)
* Track record of keeping enablement content current in fast-release SaaS environments (e.g., bi-weekly/monthly releases), and/or relevant industry certifications/upskilling momentum

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.
  
  
**Benefits**
Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:
  
  

* Various health plans
* Time off plans for vacation and sick time
* Parental leave options
* Retirement options
* Education reimbursement
* In-office perks, and more!

Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits here.
  
  
By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.
  
  
Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. We strive to create a workplace where employees are treated with respect and have the chance to succeed. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

*Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal*
*link.*
Pay Transparency
  
  
Zscaler complies with all applicable federal, state, and local pay transparency rules.

title: Implementation Lead
description:
**About The Role**
As an Implementation Lead for Employee Transportation Services (ETS), you will own the journey of large enterprise clients from solution deep-dive through to the successful onboarding, launch and stabilization of managed employee commute programs across India and APAC.
  
  
You will act as the critical bridge between Sales, Product and long-term client success — closing mid-funnel deals through in-depth, customized demos, leading complex client integrations and pre-launch readiness, and ensuring a seamless transition from signed deal to a fully integrated, operating program.
  
  
You will partner with customers’ Transport, Admin, HR, Security, IT and Facilities teams, and with Sales, Operations, Product, Engineering, Safety, Customer Trust and Support teams internally, to deliver safe, reliable and cost-efficient commute solutions — from roster and route design through go-live and steady-state performance.
  
  
The role sits at the intersection of operations, program management and customer success, directly impacting service quality, customer satisfaction and revenue growth, and is pivotal to building a repeatable ETS launch engine.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own in-depth, customized ETS solution demos — including client-specific configuration discussions and scenario simulations (e.g., Guard vs. Non-Guard trips, On-Time vs. Delayed trips) — to validate fit and close deals alongside Account Executives, and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sessions after deal signing
* Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the sales cycle, owning and supporting the technical sections of RFPs and client proposals to accelerate deal closures
* Lead end-to-end implementation of ETS programs for enterprise clients — from requirements gathering and site readiness through pilot, go-live and hypercare — ensuring seamless and timely launches
* Partner with customers to understand shift patterns, employee rosters, pickup/drop locations and commute policies, and translate them into routing, fleet and service design
* Define SLAs and success metrics with customers (e.g., on-time performance, seat utilization, trip completion, safety incidents, employee satisfaction) and drive adoption among employees, transport admins and operations teams
* Work with fleet partners, drivers and on-ground operations teams to ensure vehicle, driver and compliance readiness (permits, insurance, driver verification, vehicle fitness) before and after launch
* Implement safety and compliance protocols, including night-shift and women-employee safety requirements, in-vehicle safety features and incident escalation processes
* Coordinate technical onboarding with Product, Engineering and Global Shared Services (GSS) — roster uploads, HRMS/attendance, SFTP and SSO integrations, data pipelines, user and policy configuration, and billing set-up — keeping core engineering focused on product builds
* Navigate client InfoSec and compliance requirements alongside the Customer Trust team, and drive pre-launch readiness and UAT to sign-off so that each program is handed over to Operations fully documented and launch-ready
* Run regular operational reviews with customers, analyze performance data, root-cause service gaps and drive corrective actions and continuous cost and efficiency improvements; identify growth opportunities such as new sites, shifts, shuttle routes and EV adoption
* Relay client feedback, technical requirements and market learnings to the Product team to influence the ETS roadmap, set accurate client expectations on capabilities and timelines, and escalate forward-looking feature requests
* Build and maintain ETS enablement resources — feature lists, FAQs, sales collateral and standardized demo narratives — support repeatable demo environments (test accounts and simulated trips), and test new feature rollouts for incoming clients ahead of launch
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients and deeply understand ETS products, operating model and tools to deliver customer trainings, onboarding sessions and troubleshoot customer issues

**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in a client-facing role (implementation, program/project management, operations, consulting, account management or similar)
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, sites and deadlines in operationally intensive environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage customer leadership as well as on-ground operations and vendor teams
* Demonstrated ability to deliver technical product demonstrations and explain complex solutions clearly to business, technical and operations audiences
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration concepts (SFTP, SSO, HRMS, data pipelines) and experience managing end-to-end implementations, including UAT and InfoSec/compliance reviews
* Proven ability to influence and work across Sales, Product, Engineering and Operations teams without direct authority
* Strong analytical skills, with working proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (SQL or BI tools a plus) to track SLAs and operational KPIs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in employee transportation, corporate commute or shuttle services, fleet management, logistics, mobility or transport/facilities outsourcing
* Familiarity with India transport and compliance requirements — vehicle permits, driver verification and safety norms for night-shift and women-employee transportation
* Experience managing fleet/vendor partners and SLA-driven contracts
* Experience in SaaS, tech or platform-based environments, including rollout of routing, rostering or workforce-mobility technology
* Experience supporting RFPs and enterprise procurement processes, and building enablement material such as training curricula, FAQs and collateral
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, handle on-ground escalations and drive solutions
* Fluency in English and Hindi; additional regional/APAC languages are a plus.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Avionics System Engineer (FMS, ARP47541)
description:
**We are hiring!**

**FMS Aerospace System Testing Engineer**

**Location: Bangalore, Karnataka (onsite)**

**Experience: 3+ Years**

Are you passionate about aviation safety and mission-critical systems?

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

**What You Will Do:**

* Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures.
* Ensure bi-directional requirements traceability from aircraft-level safety objectives down to implementation artifacts.
* Configure and manage Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), System Integration Labs (SIL), and automated test environments.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve defects and root-cause anomalies during integration.
* Generate objective evidence and traceability matrices to support SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits and FAA/EASA certification.

**The Standards You Will Drive:**

* You will directly apply the core ecosystem of aerospace certification guidelines to our testing lifecycle:ARP4754A: Validating system architectures and requirement allocations.
* ARP4761: Utilizing FHA, PSSA, and SSA outputs to drive safety-critical failure-mode testing.
* DO-178C: Executing high-level/system-level software integration tests.
* DO-254: Verifying complex electronic hardware behavior at the system and LRU levels.
* DO-330: Defining Tool Operational Requirements and validating automated verification toolchains.
* DO-356A: Testing system vulnerabilities and verifying airworthiness cybersecurity architectures.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or related fields.
* 3+ years of hands-on avionics testing and integration experience in a certified program.
* Proficiency in Requirements Management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion).
* Experience with test automation scripting (Python, C/C++) and aviation data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX, MIL-STD-1553B).
* A proven track record of generating certification artifacts for regulatory audits.

**How to Apply:**

Ready to build the future of flight? Click "Apply" on this post or send your resume directly to communications@qubistsolutions.com with the subject line "Aerospace Testing Engineer - [Your Name]".

#Hiring #Aerospace #Avionics #SystemsEngineering #DO178C #DO254 #ARP4754A #ARP4761 #DO330 #DO356

title: Sr. Consultant
description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
OpenText Enterprise Information Management (EIM) technologies and business solutions allow organizations to take full advantage of enterprise information to gain better business insight, capitalize on opportunities to positively impact the business, improve process velocity, reduce risks related to information governance, and protect sensitive information and intellectual property from internal leaks and external threats. With growing volumes and a host of formats to manage and leverage, organizations need to bring structure to the unstructured. By doing so, they will be unleashing the power of information to drive faster decision-making, improved agility, strong security policies, and an increased ability to both exploit the opportunities and control the risks of enterprise information. OpenText provides solutions across the entire range of core EIM capabilities – sophisticated, secure, high-value, and cost-effective – onsite, via mobile devices, private cloud, or in the cloud.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**
OpenText provides cloud environment for addressing the B2Bi and MFT needs of various customers from different geos and business domains. Customers can choose the OpenText Managed Service cloud with public, private or hybrid models of deployments Analyst team would be responsible for the analysis of various B2B implementation requests. Team will gather and analyze the customer business requirements and design & develop the mapping specification documents – P2P, Canonical etc. Once the specification is created, it will be handed over to the map development team. During the course of the map development and testing, analyst team will provide the necessary support to the development and QA team by clarifying all their questions. Analyst team will validate the map developed, and provide the necessary approvals and submit the same for the end customer approval. Once the customer approved the map, analyst team will coordinate with Integration team to get the maps deployed in the required environments (Pre-Prod / Prod).
  
  
**What You Need To Succeed**

title: Verification & Validation Engineer (4-8 Years)
description:
**Job Title: Verification & Validation Engineer (4-8 Years)**
**Job Location: Bengaluru**
**About Veoneer:**
Veoneer is a world leader, and over the years, Veoneer has delivered more than 1.1 billion electronic control units and crash sensors to car manufacturers globally.
  
  
Owned by AIP and headquartered in the U.S. Veoneer has approximately 2,550 employees in 11 countries.
  
  
**What Will You Do?**

* Perform end-to-end Verification and Validation (V&V) activities across the software development lifecycle, including requirement analysis, test design, execution, and automation.
* Analyze system and software requirements to derive comprehensive test specifications and verification criteria, with a focus on Passive Safety systems.
* Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases using industry-standard test design techniques.
* Develop and maintain test automation frameworks and scripts using CAPL, Python, or Java.
* Execute communication and diagnostic testing using CAN, CAN-FD, CANTP, and UDS protocols.
* Perform ECU-level testing using Vector tools such as CANalyzer, CANoe, and CANStress.
* Prepare, review, and maintain test artifacts including test plans, test reports, traceability matrices, and review documentation.
* Conduct embedded and hardware-in-the-loop testing, utilizing lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, programmable power supplies, and function generators.
* Ensure safe hardware handling practices, including ESD compliance.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to support defect analysis, debugging, and resolution.
* Provide accurate task estimates and regular progress updates to the Test Lead to support project planning and tracking.
* Identify opportunities for process, product, and infrastructure improvements and actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
* Share insights, technical observations, and best practices during team discussions, fostering a strong collaborative and quality-driven culture.
* Adapt to changing project requirements and support shift or overlap working hours when required.

**What Will You Bring?**

* Experience

+ 4–8 years of hands-on experience in Automotive Software Verification & Validation.

* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and test case design techniques.
* Solid working knowledge of automotive communication protocols: CAN, CAN-FD, CANTP, and UDS.
* Proven experience in automation scripting using CAPL, Python, or Java.
* Hands-on experience with Vector tools: CANalyzer, CANoe, CANStress.
* Experience in embedded testing of automotive ECUs; exposure to Passive Safety / Airbag systems is a strong advantage.
* Good programming, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of ASPICE and/or CMMI processes.
* Experience with Requirements Management tools such as DOORS and CodeBeamer.
* Experience with Source and Issue Management tools like PTC and CodeBeamer.
* Familiarity with hardware testing environments, lab equipment, and ESD handling practices.
* A self-driven, proactive learner with strong ownership and accountability.
* Excellent team player with a consistent focus on quality, timelines, and deliverables.
* Willingness to take on technical challenges and adapt to evolving business and project needs.

**Preferred Qualification: BE / BTech / ME / MTech**

title: Packaging Development - intern
description:
**About PlayShifu**

PlayShifu is one of the fastest growing technology startups that creates AR-powered educational toys. “I wish I had them in my childhood” is the most common thought when one comes across our award-winning products. We have expanded our distribution worldwide to more than 35 countries and still counting.

**About the Role**

PlayShifu is looking for a Packaging Development - Intern to support the sourcing and procurement of packaging materials across our AR-powered toy portfolio. You’ll work closely with Packaging Development, Product, Operations, Quality, Finance, and suppliers, helping ensure the right packaging is sourced at the right cost, quality, and lead time. This is a great starting point for someone looking to build a career at the intersection of packaging, procurement, and product development.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support end-to-end procurement of packaging materials: folding cartons, master cartons, labels, bags, sleeves, trays, inserts, partitions, hangtags, and other printed packaging.
* Float RFQs, collect quotations, and prepare cost comparisons and supplier evaluation sheets.
* Assist in negotiating pricing, MOQ, and lead times with suppliers, under guidance from senior procurement team members.
* Develop and maintain KLDs (Key Line Drawings) for folding cartons, trays, inserts, partitions, sleeves, bags, hangtags, shippers, and other packaging formats.
* Prepare and maintain packaging specifications, BOMs, dimensions, material specifications, and KLD revisions.
* Coordinate samples, mock-ups, trials, and approvals with Packaging Development and Quality teams.
* Convert approved requirements into POs and follow up on supplier acknowledgement and production schedules.
* Track open POs, production, and dispatch timelines to ensure on-time availability of packaging materials.
* Liaise with suppliers to flag and help resolve quality, delivery, or specification-related issues.
* Maintain packaging cost sheets, price masters, supplier databases, and procurement trackers.
* Coordinate with Finance and Operations for GRN, invoice, and PO closure.
* Assist senior team members in identifying new suppliers and cost-saving opportunities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Recent graduate with a Diploma or Bachelor’s in Packaging Technology / Packaging Engineering / Packaging Science. A packaging degree is strongly preferred; candidates from related fields with relevant exposure may also be considered.
* Prior internship, academic project, or coursework in packaging, procurement, sourcing, or packaging development is a plus, but not required.
* Basic understanding of paperboard, corrugated, flexible packaging, labels, and printing processes.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with costing and commercial data is a plus.
* Good communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with suppliers and cross-functional teams.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks, SKUs, and timelines.
* Basic ability to read packaging specifications, BOMs, and technical drawings/dielines (KLDs), with a willingness to learn and build this skill quickly.
* Exposure to toys, consumer products, FMCG, D2C, or retail packaging is a plus, not required.
* Curious, proactive, and eager to learn in a fast-paced startup environment.

**What You’ll Learn & Grow Into**

You’ll start by supporting the day-to-day execution of packaging procurement (RFQs, PO tracking, KLD preparation, sample coordination, and vendor follow-ups) while working closely with senior team members on supplier negotiations and sourcing strategy. As you grow, you’ll gain hands-on exposure to supplier relationships, cost optimization initiatives, and vendor development.

title: Associate Clinical Data Facilitator
description:
**Company:**
Novo Global Business Services (GBS)
  
  
**Department:**
Research & Development
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore, India
  
  
**Your impact begins here**
As Associate Clinical Data Facilitator in Global Business Services in Bangalore, you will make sure the clinical trial data behind Novo’s treatments is accurate, compliant and ready for submission. You will prepare the forms and documents regulatory authorities review, and use Python, VBA and Power BI to replace repetitive manual work with smarter, faster ways of working. Your work helps new treatments move through clinical development with speed and confidence, for people living with serious chronic diseases.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
You thrive in a detail-oriented, globally connected environment and you are energised by finding better ways to get things done. You bring:
  
  

* A Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Life Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Clinical Information Management or an equivalent qualification.
* A minimum of 2–3 years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Strong working knowledge of Python, VBA/macros, Power BI and related automation tools, with hands-on experience in process simplification and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with GxP guidelines, drug development processes and clinical data standards, including CDISC and eCTD requirements.
* Excellent communication, presentation and coordination skills, with fluent written and spoken English.
* The ability to collaborate effectively across professional, regional and cultural boundaries
* Preferrably, at least 2 years of experience within clinical data management systems, project management or related areas.

**What You’ll Do**
You will own the quality and submission-readiness of clinical data forms for your assigned trials, while making the way the team works simpler and more automated.
  
  

* Compile, bookmark, merge and hyperlink sample and completed (e)CRFs, and appendices for Clinical Trial Reports and Non-interventional Study Reports, and make sure they are archived in EDMS on time.
* Prepare (e)CRFs and CDISC submission documents (aCRF, cSDRG) to meet eCTD compliance standards, run electronic quality control checks and support submission deliverables at project level.
* Support the decommissioning of EDC and eCOA systems, including retrieval and archival of audit trails, access reports, Services Documentation Packages and Sponsor archive packages.
* Manage the scanning, tracking and archival of paper-based clinical documents, such as CRFs and patient diaries, in line with records management requirements.
* Identify repetitive manual activities and build sustainable improvements using Python, VBA/macros, Power BI and other AI tools.
* Take ownership of your assigned trials: spot risks to quality or timelines early, propose corrective actions and align on deliverables with stakeholders.

**Who You’ll Work With**
You will join the Clinical Data Facilitator team within Clinical Data Management & Programming, part of Global Business Services in Bangalore. The team manages clinical data forms from end to end across Novo’s global trial portfolio, working where clinical data management, regulatory submissions and process innovation meet. In Research & Development, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing. Curiosity, data, technology, collaboration and operational excellence come together to help meet future health needs. Day to day, you will partner with Clinical Data Managers, SDTM Programmers, Clinical Operations and Regulatory Affairs, as well as vendors and CROs. Together you will agree on deliverables and timelines, speak up early when something is at risk, and keep trials moving with clarity.
  
  
**What You Can Expect Here**
You will work in a collaborative, international setting where your expertise is valued and your ideas for doing things better are welcome. You will build new skills by working with colleagues across the clinical data value chain, and by developing your automation and AI tool capabilities on real work that the team uses every day.
  
  
You will be supported to perform at your best and trusted to take ownership of your trials. Clear expectations and a culture that rewards results mean you can see the effect of your work.
  
  
**Start now**
Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring quality, compliance and smarter ways of working to clinical trial data, apply for the Associate Clinical Data Facilitator role by 20 November 2026. Lasting Health Starts Now – and your contribution can start with it.

title: PMIC Systems Validation Engineer
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering
  
  
**General Summary**

* Job DescriptionAs a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field.
* Additional Job Description

PMIC Systems & Validation EngineerTeam & Product Overview:Qualcomm's Power Management Systems, Validation & Integration team (PMIC-SVI) leads the industry in the system architecture and post-silicon validation of high-performance feature-rich Power Management Integrated Circuits (PMICs), that are embedded in our Chipsets - for smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearables and a variety of cutting-edge consumer electronics. This team gets to work on state-of-art technology to enable products with world’s leading brands.A typical Qualcomm PMIC is a highly advanced IC that has a multitude of IPs viz. switching DC-DC converters, linear regulators, clock oscillators, battery charger, fuel gauge, LED drivers, and ADCs. Additionally, there is an embedded mini-processor running critical firmware (FW) to support power sequencing, interrupt servicing, crash handling and various device reset scenarios. It is also responsible for maintaining various stability & performance related configurations that are part of SoC software driver initializations. Furthermore, it provides an intelligent-framework for sequencing of time-critical-operations, which otherwise can't be guaranteed by any OS / higher-level software. Often, Qualcomm chipset solutions contain multiple PMICs working together in sync – which together constitute a ‘PMIC-System’.Job ResponsibilitiesThis job involves a mix of Architecture, HW Systems, Functional Validation, Chipset integration & customer issue debug support. We are looking for Systems & Validation engineers with preferably
  
  
1 -2 years of experience in analog/power electronics. Depending on your experience level and area of technical expertise you will own and participate in systems definition, HW/SW debugging and validation of PMIC solutions by partnering with various engineering teams like Analog/Digital Design, Software and Customer Engineering in a fast-paced environment.Systems involves coming up with a Top-Level specification (involving HW/FW/SW level partitioning of feature-design, HW Register interfaces, memory sizing, protocol selection, multi-PMIC connectivity grid, debug framework support, etc) to satisfy all chipset level requirements.Validation involves coming up with a comprehensive functional validation plan (that covers both manual and scripted automated test cases), executing them within stipulated time-period, analyzing results at HW-level (via signal measurements), debugging issues & creating reports.Engineers will be responsible to perform risk assessment of development and validation plans; and interact with PMIC Product Management, Design & Characterization teams; other SoC HW/SW Architecture, Development & Validation teams; and finally Customer-Engagement teams across worldwide sites.Education RequirementsA Bachelor's degree in Electronics related Engineering is a must.Master’s degree is preferred esp. with specialization in VLSI / Microelectronics, Power Management, etc.Minimum QualificationsWe are looking for applicants with 1-2 years of job-experience – relevant to various HW/S aspects of any electronic product development. They should be well-versed with knowledge of entire ASIC Flow (from concept-stage to commercial-product support).Preferred QualificationsApplicants should be aware of fundamentals of PMIC, Power Management, Microcontroller architecture, basic-firmware & HW-SW interaction.Applicants should also have strong hands-on lab-experience in Post-Si Validation. (HW-level Bench measurement and/or SW-level logs-based verification).Preferred Skills:
  
  

* Hands-on ability & comfort in using various lab instruments like oscilloscopes, power supplies, JTAG debuggers etc.
* Good understanding of PMIC, Power Electronics , digital & embedded electronics concepts· Good Hardware Debug Skills related to DC -DC (SMPS, LDO) converters preferred.
* Good programming skills in at least one of the following: C#, F#, Python, Perl, LabVIEW or any other scripting language (used in VLSI/Embedded Domain) + understanding of few OOPS concepts.
* Familiarity with HW schematics and ability to trace inter connections on a PCB. Good analytical & communication (verbal/written) skills.
* Ability to seek information pro-actively, understand priorities and juggle multiple tasks in a highly paced environment.
* Experience in automating test-cases via SW-control for HW-systems Ability to come up with a High-Level Strategy for any objective and being able to break it into Mid-level flows & Low-level tasks – for efficient execution.
* Prior experience in leading & executing white-box validation efforts of a HW-module or sub-module, is a big plus.
* Exposure to Assembly-language programming (for microcontroller) is good-to-have. Exposure to tools like JIRA and GIT are a plus.Keywords PMIC, Power Systems, System Architecture, switch mode power supply, SMPS, DC-DC, LDO, ADC, functional Validation, test automation, Voltage Regulators, Battery Chargers, Battery Management/Gauging

**Applicants**

If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail disability-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here. description:

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.
  
  
**SENIOR STAFF POST SILICON VALIDATION APPS ENGINEER**
**The Role**
AMD is looking for a highly experienced Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) to join the Embedded x86 Applications Engineering organization and serve as a technical leader for customer enablement, post-silicon validation, system debug, platform qualification, and technical escalation management.
  
  
This role serves as the senior technical bridge between customers, FAEs, Product Management, Program Management, Silicon Engineering, Platform Engineering, BIOS/Firmware Engineering, Validation, Quality, and Customer Support organizations.
  
  
The SMTS Engineer will provide technical leadership across complex customer engagements, drive resolution of high-impact escalations, influence validation and debug methodologies, and help define support and qualification strategies across AMD Embedded x86 platforms. The role requires deep platform expertise, exceptional debugging skills, strong customer engagement capabilities, and the ability to influence cross-functional engineering organizations without direct authority.
  
  
**The Person**
The ideal candidate is a recognized technical leader with extensive post-silicon validation and platform debug experience, a strong customer-first mindset, and a proven track record of driving complex technical issues to closure.
  
  
This person is comfortable operating in highly ambiguous environments, leading root-cause investigations, mentoring engineers, influencing engineering priorities, and representing AMD in strategic customer engagements.
  
  

* Strong executive-level and customer-facing communication skills.
* Deep technical expertise in platform validation and system architecture.
* Ability to influence technical direction across engineering organizations.
* Recognized problem solver for complex platform and interoperability issues.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Comfortable interacting with customers, engineering directors, architects, validation leads, and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to balance customer urgency with engineering execution discipline.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset and accountability.

A self-starter capable of independently driving highly complex technical investigations while providing technical leadership to broader validation and applications engineering teams.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Customer Technical Ownership

+ Serve as the senior technical lead for customer escalations involving AMD Embedded x86 platforms.
+ Act as the primary technical escalation point for high-priority and business-critical customer issues.
+ Provide technical leadership across customer engagements, platform enablement activities, and production deployments.
+ Influence customer adoption, platform readiness, and long-term customer success.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to MTS engineers and validation teams.
* Drive best practices for validation, debugging, escalation management, and customer engagement.
* Lead cross-functional investigations involving multiple engineering organizations.
* Establish debug methodologies and root-cause frameworks for complex platform issues.

**Post Silicon Validation Leadership**

* Define validation strategies for customer-reported issues.
* Lead validation activities for new platforms, features, and customer deployments.
* Drive interoperability, qualification, compatibility, and production-readiness efforts.
* Review and improve validation coverage based on field learnings and customer feedback.

**Advanced Platform Debug & Root Cause Analysis**
**Lead Investigations Involving**

* PCIe Gen4/Gen5,DDR4/DDR5,Memory training and validation,USB,Networking,Storage and NVMe,Graphics and Display,RAS technologies,Platform security, Silicon-to-system interactions

**Escalation Management**

* Lead engineering escalations for customer-critical issues.
* Partner with BIOS, Firmware, Silicon, Validation, Product, and Quality teams to drive issue resolution.
* Review and approve escalation strategies and debug plans.
* Ensure engineering teams receive complete technical analysis and reproduction data.

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

title: AI Adoption Specialist
description:
**About Astellas**
Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need.
  
  
**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**
We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.
  
  
**Purpose And Scope**

* The AI Adoption Specialist is a member of the DigitalX organization's global Enterprise AI Enablement team, supporting colleagues and business teams across all Astellas regions. The role reports directly to the Pod Lead, Enterprise AI Enablement, and works with the AI Adoption Lead on day-to-day activities to deliver the AI adoption roadmap. The role drives the adoption and value realization of enterprise AI tools, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio agents and GenAI solutions, by analyzing usage, running enablement programs and helping business teams embed AI into everyday work. The role exists to turn AI investment into measurable business value and to build AI literacy across the organization.

title: Bid Manager
description:
**Company Description**
  
**Work with Us. Change the World.**
  
At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
  
  
There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
  
  
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
  
  
**Job Description**
  
Working in partnership with capture managers, client account managers and technical teams, the bid manager is responsible for managing and delivering bids across the UK and Ireland business. Leading bids typically valued between $2M and $10M and taking ownership of the end-to-end bid process, the role ensures submissions are produced on time, fully compliant with client requirements and aligned with agreed pursuit strategies and governance requirements. Accountable for maximising win probability and contributing towards the achievement of a 55-60% win rate.
  
  
The bid manager supports the successful conversion of opportunities into wins through effective bid planning, coordination, content development and stakeholder management, contributing to the achievement of business growth objectives.
  
  
As a bid manager, you will manage the development and delivery of bids across the opportunity lifecycle, from kick-off through to submission, interview preparation and post-bid review. Working closely with capture managers, client account managers, technical teams and other work winning professionals, you will support pursuit strategies, coordinate bid activities and deliver high-quality submissions that maximise AECOM's probability of success.
  
  
Bid management and execution
  

* Manage the development and delivery of bids, ensuring submissions are compliant, high quality and delivered to required deadlines.
* Produce and maintain bid programmes and review schedules.
* Coordinate bid activities and support contributors throughout the bid lifecycle.
* Facilitate kick-off meetings, answer planning sessions, reviews and progress meetings.
* Act as a reviewer on bids and pursuits, providing constructive feedback to strengthen response quality, compliance and client focus.
* Manage content development, including writing, editing, formatting and graphics production.
* Support the implementation of agreed value propositions and win themes throughout the submission.
* Ensure responses are aligned with client requirements and evaluation criteria.
* Manage document control, version management and submission production activities.
* Monitor progress against milestones, identifying risks, issues and dependencies and escalating where appropriate.
* Support interview preparation and presentation development.
* Lead post-submission debriefs and lessons learned reviews to improve future performance.
  

Pursuit strategy and capture support
  

* Work closely with capture managers, client account managers and technical teams to support pursuit planning and bid activities.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of win themes and value propositions in support of successful outcomes.
* Support the planning and facilitation of four box sessions and pursuit reviews, contributing to governance compliance and pursuit readiness.
* Contribute to opportunity qualification and pursuit planning activities through the application of work-winning best practice.
* Maintain and update opportunities where assigned as the marketing proposal lead in Salesforce, ensuring records are accurate and support effective pipeline management and fee conversion.
* Contribute to market, client and competitor research activities where required.
* Facilitate pursuit strategy, win theme and answer planning workshops.
* Ensure bid content aligns with agreed objectives and client requirements.
* Support the development of clear, compelling and client-focused messaging.
  

Stakeholder engagement and collaboration
  

* Build effective working relationships with capture managers, technical teams and work winning colleagues across the UK and Ireland business.
* Coordinate all inputs and facilitate effective communication throughout the bid lifecycle.
* Communicate bid progress, actions, deadlines and requirements clearly and consistently.
* Promote collaboration across multidisciplinary pursuit teams.
* Support the sharing of client, market and competitor intelligence where relevant.
* Champion the effective use of AECOM's work-winning processes, tools and governance requirements.
  

Continuous improvement and knowledge sharing
  

* Capture and share lessons learned and best practice.
* Support the development and maintenance of bid libraries and model answers.
* Contribute to the adoption and effective use of work winning tools and AI-enabled solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve bid quality, efficiency and consistency.
* Actively pursue professional development and work-winning best practice.
* Contribute to training, knowledge-sharing and capability-building initiatives across the work winning community.
  

Team contribution and development
  

* Contribute positively to a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing team culture.
* Share knowledge and experience across the work winning team, supporting the onboarding and development of assistant bid managers and new team members through day-to-day guidance.
* Demonstrate a proactive and flexible approach to supporting team priorities and business needs.
* Take ownership of personal development and actively seek opportunities to broaden work winning capability.
* Act as an ambassador of the work winning team, promoting professionalism, quality and continuous improvement.
  

**Qualifications**
  
Minimum requirements
  

* Minimum five years' experience in bid management or a related work winning role within relevant disciplines/market sectors.
* Experience of coordinating multidisciplinary teams and delivering high-quality submissions to deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Good understanding of bid management best practice and governance processes.
* Ability to interpret client requirements and coordinate compliant responses.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Commercial awareness and understanding of client-focused bidding principles.
* Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team.
* Experience of supporting workshops, reviews and collaborative bid development activities. \
  

Specific skills
  

* Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
* Working knowledge of Adobe InDesign.
* Strong writing, editing and document management skills.
* Effective stakeholder management, meeting and workshop facilitation skills, with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams.
* Ability to analyse information and develop clear, client-focused messaging.
* Desirable: APMP Foundation Certification.
  

**Additional Information**

* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
* A collaborative and positive approach to working with multidisciplinary teams.
* Personal accountability and ownership for delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* A proactive and solutions-focused mindset.
* Resilience and professionalism when working under pressure.
* Flexibility and adaptability across differing sectors, pursuits and priorities.
* A commitment to continuous improvement, learning and professional development.
  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.
***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***
  
**About AECOM**
  
AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, and service recognition awards.

title: Sr. Content Writer
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the role**
As part of the Brand & Content team, you'll help shape how Sprinklr tells its story across every stage of the customer journey. We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable writing a homepage, a campaign, a customer story or a launch video script - and enjoys switching between them.
  
  
You will create content that helps customers understand not just what we build, but why it matters.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Create clear, compelling content across a variety of formats, including web pages, blogs, customer stories, campaign assets, emails, landing pages, social media, paid ads, presentations and video scripts.
* Bring marketing campaigns to life by partnering with Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Demand Generation and Design teams.
* Turn complex product capabilities into simple, customer-focused stories that resonate with enterprise audiences.
* Ensure every piece of content reflects Sprinklr's brand voice, editorial standards and messaging principles.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing creativity with attention to detail and deadlines.
* Use AI as a productivity partner to accelerate research, ideation and first drafts while applying strong editorial judgment to every final deliverable.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5–8 years of experience creating content for B2B SaaS or enterprise technology companies.
* Experience that demonstrates versatility across multiple content formats and channels.
* Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas without losing accuracy.
* A collaborative mindset and experience working with cross-functional marketing teams.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with AI tools and a thoughtful approach to using them in the content creation process.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**

That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**

Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.
