title: Training Content Developer
description:
**About Us**
With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.
  
  
Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.
  
  
At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.
  
  
Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.
  
  
Reports To
  
  
Senior Manager, Technical Content Development
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
The Training Content Developer will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of technical training content and learning paths under the guidance of senior training team members. This role will work closely with internal customer teams (Engineering, Product Management, Support, and others) to ensure accurate, timely technical training is available for all ChargePoint hardware and software products. You will collaborate with technical writers, technical illustrators, and the Staff Training Content Developer to create interactive training experiences for installers, technicians, and other technical audiences. To be successful at ChargePoint, this person must be highly motivated, self-directed, and have a good eye for design and detail while being receptive to feedback and mentorship from senior team members.
  
  
**What You Will Bring To ChargePoint**

* Develop and maintain training content in the learning management system (LMS), following established content standards, style guidelines, and brand requirements.
* Create interactive learning activities, course content, and instructional videos to install, use, and service ChargePoint products (hardware and software).
* Redesign and update existing lessons as directed to align with current standards and style guidelines.
* Learn complex technical products quickly and produce technical training with the assistance of subject matter experts and guidance from the Staff Training Content Developer.
* Actively gather information from and collaborate with engineers, QA engineers, and product managers to identify and capture learning content.
* Support the development of scalable training solutions to ensure programs are consistent and ready for a global audience.
* Design, develop, and conduct assessments and evaluations to measure learner comprehension and course effectiveness.
* Manage individual project tasks across phases of a learning project, including analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation, while escalating risks and blockers to senior team members as needed.
* Prepare content for localization by following established localization guidelines and processes.
* Collaborate with other teams to ensure consistency and clarity across all training and documentation.

**Requirements**

* Minimum of 2-4 years in the design and development of instructional material in a complex product environment (Hardware AND Software).
* Experience working within a learning management system (LMS) is required.
* Strong knowledge of adult learning theory and its application to learning solutions.
* Ability to write behavioral objectives, tests, and course materials using instructional design theories.
* Demonstrated ability to distill technical information from subject matter experts and translate it into training relevant to the target audience.
* Bachelor's degree preferred in Curriculum Development, Instructional Design/Technology, or Education.
* Proficient in Articulate Storyline 360 is required.
* Familiarity with localization processes and preparing content for different regions.
* Experience with raster and vector-based image editing with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).
* Basic knowledge of video editing and production is a plus.
* Knowledge of Jira, Confluence, or similar project management tools is a plus.
* Ability to work on multiple projects concurrently while meeting tight deadlines.

Location: Bangalore, India

title: Founding Sales Executive
description:
**Context**

We run three agencies that sell to overlapping buyers:

* An inbound demand gen and content agency
* A personal branding agency for founders and leaders
* A product development agency

Right now each one sells on its own. That leaves money on the table, because the founder who wants a personal brand often needs content that brings in demand, and a lot of them have a product they haven’t had the bandwidth to build. We want one person running sales across all three.

**The role**

You’ll own the pipeline for all three agencies, from first conversation to signed contract. Some clients will need one agency. Some will need all three. Your job is to figure out which, and to be straight with them about it.

There’s no playbook for this yet. You’ll be building it with us.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and manage pipeline across all three agencies
* Run discovery calls and work out what each prospect needs
* Put together proposals and pricing, sometimes spanning more than one agency
* Close deals and hand them off cleanly to delivery teams
* Spot cross-sell opportunities inside existing clients
* Track what’s working and tell me when something isn’t

**What we’re looking for**

* 3+ years selling services (agency, consulting or B2B)
* You’ve closed deals yourself, not just booked meetings for someone else
* You can talk to a founder about content strategy in one call and a product build in the next without faking it
* You’re comfortable working without a fixed process and writing one as you go
* You’d rather say “we’re not the right fit” than force a bad deal

**Nice to have**

* Experience selling marketing, content or LinkedIn services
* Some exposure to software or product development sales
* An active LinkedIn presence of your own

**What you get**

* Ownership of a sales function from day one
* Direct access to the founders, no layers in between

Collectively, our projects span 120,000+ hectares and will support over 150,000 smallholder farmers and coastal communities.

Our work is backed by a $3M institutional seed round from Peak XV (formerly Sequoia) and Avaana Capital, and driven by a 90+ member team with deep expertise in climate science, carbon markets, and project operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

We are looking for someone to drive business development and commercial execution for our biomass gasification solutions. The role will focus on identifying industrial customers with significant heat and energy requirements, understanding their technical and commercial needs, developing business opportunities and closing contracts for biomass gasification plants.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role that requires a strong understanding of industrial technologies, commercial negotiations and the ability to build relationships within industrial ecosystems. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following -

* **Industrial Business Development:**
  Identify and develop business opportunities with industries that have significant thermal energy and process heat requirements, and where biomass gasification can serve as an alternative to conventional fuels.
* **Lead Generation & Market Mapping:**
  Build a pipeline of prospective industrial customers across sectors such as textiles, food processing, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, paper, ceramics, metals, cement and other energy-intensive industries.
* **Techno-Commercial Assessment:**
  Understand customer requirements, existing heating systems, fuel consumption, energy costs and operational constraints to assess the technical and commercial suitability of biomass gasification solutions.
* **Customer Engagement:**
  Engage with plant heads, factory owners, engineering teams, procurement teams, energy managers and senior decision-makers to understand requirements and build confidence in the proposed solutions.
* **Industrial Networking:**
  Build and leverage relationships within local industrial ecosystems, industry associations and business networks such as FICCI, CII and regional industry forums, particularly across South India.
* **Proposal Development:**
  Coordinate with the HQ engineering and technical teams to prepare technical and commercial proposals, project estimates, financial comparisons, payback assessments and customer presentations.
* **Negotiations & Deal Closure:**
  Lead commercial discussions, negotiate pricing and contract terms, address customer concerns and drive opportunities through to contract closure for biomass gasification plants.
* **Market Intelligence:**
  Track industrial energy demand, competing technologies, conventional fuel prices, customer economics and market developments to identify new business opportunities.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related technical field. MBA is an advantage.
* 5–7 years of experience in techno-commercial sales, industrial equipment sales or industrial energy solutions.
* Prior experience selling industrial machinery or technology such as gasifiers, boilers, burners, furnaces or other thermal equipment to industries.
* Strong understanding of industrial heat requirements, technology feasibility, fuel economics, CAPEX, OPEX and ROI.
* Proven ability to generate leads, build a sales pipeline, develop customer relationships and close commercial deals.
* Strong networking skills and established connections within industrial associations and circles such as FICCI and CII, particularly across South India.
* Excellent proposal development, commercial negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in biomass-based energy, biomass aggregation, briquetting or pellet manufacturing will be a definite advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively across industrial clusters and customer locations.

**How to Apply**

Send your application to talent@equilibriumearth.com

title: Senior Sales Coach (Premium)
description:
**About Leap Scholar**

Leap Scholar helps students achieve their dream of studying abroad by supporting them throughout their study-abroad journey, from choosing the right university to completing their applications and other related services.

**About the Role**

We are looking for experienced Senior Sales Coaches who can handle the first conversation with students planning to study abroad, understand their requirements, recommend the right Leap Scholar services, and convert them into paying customers.

The person will speak with students exploring different countries, understand their academic background, career plans, budget, and university preferences, and explain how Leap Scholar can support their journey through its premium services.

This is not a regular calling or relationship management role. We are looking for someone who can combine student counselling knowledge with strong sales skills and independently close high-value deals.

Once the student purchases the premium package, the person will hand over the student to the counselling team for further guidance and service delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Understand Student Requirements**

* Take the first call with students interested in studying abroad.
* Understand their academic background, work experience, career goals, preferred countries, universities, and budget.
* Understand what the student is looking for and what challenges they are facing.
* Build trust with students and parents through meaningful conversations.

**2. Guide Students and Recommend Solutions**

* Have a good understanding of study-abroad opportunities across countries such as the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, and Europe.
* Understand the student's requirements and explain how Leap Scholar can help.
* Recommend the right premium package based on the student's needs.
* Clearly explain the services included in the package, its benefits, and pricing.

**3. Sales and Revenue Generation**

* Own the sales journey from the first call until the deal is closed.
* Sell premium study-abroad packages with an expected average ticket size of ₹2.5–3 lakh.
* Handle student and parent objections and explain the value of Leap Scholar's services.
* Follow up with interested students and drive them towards closure.
* Achieve monthly sales and revenue targets.

**4. Handover to Counselling Team**

* Once the student purchases the package, hand over the student to the relevant counsellor.
* Share the student's academic profile, country preferences, budget, requirements, and discussion history.
* Ensure the counsellor has all the required information to take the process forward smoothly.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in study-abroad counselling, education consulting, premium EdTech sales, or consultative B2C sales.
* Good understanding of the study-abroad process and multiple international destinations.
* Experience selling high-value products or services is strongly preferred.
* Ability to independently conduct the first call, understand customer requirements, recommend solutions, and close deals.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Good at handling objections, negotiating, and convincing customers.
* Proven track record of achieving individual sales and revenue targets.
* Comfortable working in a target-driven sales environment.

**What Will Make You a Strong Fit?**

* You have personally sold high-ticket products or services.
* You can confidently handle a student and parent conversation without depending on another person to close the sale.
* You understand how to identify customer needs before pitching a product.
* You can balance student guidance with commercial sales conversations.
* You take ownership of the complete sales process, from the first interaction to successful closure.

title: Technical Sales Engineer - Account Growth
description:
We at COMSOL create our own simulation software and provide it to technology enterprises, government facilities, and academic research facilities. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is the premier modeling tool for simulating technical applications in almost all engineering industries and scientific disciplines. Users of the COMSOL® software are the preeminent engineers and scientists in their respective fields who require simulations to advance their innovations and objectives. They invent and optimize new and existing processes and products that matter to the future of our world.COMSOL is seeking a Technical Sales Engineer to join the sales team in Bengaluru office who will be able to inform, sell, support engineers and scientists on the usefulness of simulation using COMSOL® software.
  
  

* Account growth in existing private sector organizations.
* Use your insight, communication skills, and technical acumen to proactively qualify leads marked as prospective customers.
* Methodically identify and qualify simulation requirements for prospective customers through meetings and demonstrations.
* Participate in onsite and web-based customer meetings, workshops, and other marketing/sales events arranged by the team.
* Articulate business cases for the unique capabilities offered by COMSOL, explain licensing models, and help negotiate terms and conditions with legal and procurement departments wherever necessary.
* Support working with prospective customers on evaluations of the COMSOL® software, or facilitate such evaluations through working in collaboration with COMSOL applications engineers.
* Have the willingness and ability to travel for limited periods of time to meet current and potential customers in order to run COMSOL-sponsored events and activities in India.
* Promote effective technical support together with COMSOL applications engineers on the use of the COMSOL® software for customers’ applications.
* Communicate with existing customers on a regular basis to manage their relationship with COMSOL, keeping them informed about new features and technology in the COMSOL® software, as well as events and other useful activities.
* Find new opportunities to sell existing and new COMSOL® software and technology to existing customers, their colleagues and other departments within their organizations.
* A bachelor's/master’s degree in engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or a physical science. Engineering degree in mechanical, electrical, or chemical.
* Prior sales experience for minimum three years.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Sales experience in Engineering Software Solutions (CAD/CAE).
* Coursework based on the following or its equivalent: Computational analyses, modeling, and simulations through numerical methods, such as the Finite Element Method (FEM/FEA), to be used in applications, such as fluid mechanics, transport phenomena, structural mechanics, chemical engineering, applied physics or mathematics.Supporting your success in your role as a Technical Sales Engineer will be other sales engineers, applications engineers, software developers who occupy the top echelons of their areas of expertise. You will see and participate in the development and operation of many and varied cutting-edge new technologies. As a technical sales engineer, you will work with some of the most preeminent engineers and scientists in their respective fields, who are simulating innovations and ideas for the future.COMSOL is the leading innovator of multiphysics software for research and development (R&D). Our products are continuously pushing the boundaries of computer-aided engineering (CAE), so that our customers can solve challenging science and engineering problems and develop better products, faster.The COMSOL product family enables our end users to solve even the most sophisticated science and engineering problems, thanks to our intuitive and flexible graphical user interface. We create the tools that drive new breakthroughs in physics and engineering — and we love what we do.The COMSOL Group is a fast-growing, high-tech engineering software company that was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, in 1986 and has grown to include 16 offices and a distributor network throughout the world.The COMSOL office in Bangalore is spacious, bright, and comfortable. Our talented employees and an active learning environment are the keys to our success.

Top performers will receive a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) for a full-time Inside Sales / Account Executive role.

Who should apply: final-year students graduating in 2027, or 2026 graduates (BBA / BCom / BA / MBA / PGDM / Engineering). Bengaluru-based.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Present Assistents.ai to Global Clients

Join and lead client meetings with business leaders across global markets, including the US, Europe, the Middle East and India. Open meetings professionally, set the agenda, and keep the conversation focused on business outcomes. Present Assistents.ai clearly and confidently: what AI agents do, and why they matter to Finance, Sales, Support, HR and Operations teams.

Run Discovery

Ask strong discovery questions to understand the client's business, pain points, workflows and current technology landscape. Identify decision-makers, influencers and where Assistents.ai can create measurable business value.

Shape Solutions

Translate client problems into practical AI agent use cases. Prepare demo narratives, use-case notes and solution summaries. Work with the tech lead to define the right solution approach and check feasibility.

Run Product Demos

Learn the platform and deliver tailored demos based on the client's industry and use case. Handle business and product questions, and bring in the tech lead for deep technical topics.

Own Follow-Ups and Relationships

Send meeting summaries, next-step emails and use-case notes after every call. Keep the CRM updated and make sure no prospect is lost due to poor follow-up. Build relationships with prospects over the course of the deal.

Help Move Deals to Closure

Qualify leads (need, budget, decision-maker, urgency). Support proposals, pilots and commercial discussions alongside the founder.

Prospecting and Research

Research target accounts and decision-makers. Support outbound outreach on LinkedIn and email to book meetings.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Outstanding spoken and written English. You are the person everyone wants to present.

Confident on camera and in meetings; able to think on your feet.

Curious about AI and technology, and able to explain it in simple business language.

Structured, reliable and fast with follow-ups.

Comfortable joining evening calls with clients in other time zones when needed.

Plus points: sales or business development internships, debate, MUN, Toastmasters, emceeing, theatre, or public speaking experience.

WHAT YOU GET

Real client exposure with global businesses from week one.

Direct mentorship from the founder on enterprise AI sales, discovery and solutioning.

A 6-month internship with a Pre-Placement Offer for top performers.

HOW TO APPLY (MANDATORY)

Record a 2 to 3 minute video, on camera, pitching any one Assistents.ai AI agent (for example, the AR Collections Agent or the Data Analyst Agent) to a CFO. Upload it to Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube (unlisted) and include the link in your application.

Applications without a video will not be reviewed.

SELECTION PROCESS

Step one: video pitch review

Step two: 20-minute live role-play with discovery, a short demo and a pricing objection

Step three: conversation with the founder

Step four: offer

title: Sales Compensation Analyst
description:
This role sits at the intersection of
**Finance, Sales Operations, and Systems**
, supporting commission calculations, platform administration, and performance reporting. You will be responsible for executing day-to-day compensation processes, maintaining data integrity across systems, and assisting with reporting that provides visibility into sales performance.

This is a highly quantitative and detail-oriented role. You will support commission calculations and payout processes while contributing to continuous process improvements as the organization scales. If you enjoy working with complex data, solving compensation challenges, and supporting fast-paced sales organizations, this role offers meaningful impact and professional growth opportunities.

**What You Will Do**

* Assist in the rollout and ongoing administration of sales compensation programs, plan documentation, and user support.
* Execute monthly and quarterly sales commission calculations, validations, reconciliations, and payout preparation, ensuring high accuracy and timeliness.
* Maintain dashboards and analytical models to track quota attainment, commission payouts, and performance trends.
* Support the administration of the organization's Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) platform, including data uploads, basic plan configuration, and user acceptance testing for plan updates.
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Systems teams to ensure data integrity across Salesforce, compensation platforms, and reporting systems, while supporting close and governance processes.
* Respond to routine sales team inquiries regarding commission payouts and provide timely, accurate clarifications.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2-5 years of experience in sales compensation, commissions administration, sales operations, finance, or a related analytical role, preferably within a SaaS or technology environment.
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce and advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, nested formulas, and data analysis workflows.
* Hands-on experience with commission management platforms such as CaptivateIQ, Xactly, Everstage, Spiff, or QuotaPath.
* Solid understanding of sales compensation structures, quota-based incentives, revenue crediting methodologies, and payout mechanics.
* Exceptional attention to detail and analytical rigor, with the ability to communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong sense of ownership and excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently in fast-paced and evolving environments.

**Core Competencies**

title: Senior Business Analyst - Application Support
description:
TITLE
  
  
Senior Business Analyst - Application Support
  
  
**Who We Are**
Duck Creek Technologies is the intelligent solutions provider defining the future of the property and casualty (P&C) insurance industry. Our modern SaaS platform enables insurers to run agile, cloud-based operations and deliver better customer experiences.
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations. This role is aligned to a specific location, and you’ll partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection and collaboration.
  
  
**About Vista**
Duck Creek Technologies is a portfolio company of Vista Equity Partners, a global investment firm that partners with mission-critical enterprise software and technology-enabled businesses to drive growth and operational excellence. As part of a Vista portfolio company, you’ll work in an environment backed by deep expertise, long-term investment, and a strong commitment to building market-leading businesses and meaningful careers.
  
  
**Position Overview**
As a Senior Business Analyst within the Application Support team, you will serve as the functional subject matter expert for Duck Creek Reinsurance (DCR). You will own the end-to-end analysis and resolution of complex client issues, translate reinsurance business needs into effective application solutions, and drive continuous improvement in service quality and product performance. Working closely with clients, functional consultants, Product, Engineering, and Cloud Operations, you will act as a trusted advisor, support releases and change initiatives, mentor less-experienced analysts, and help ensure strong customer outcomes.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Provide expert-level functional support for DCR and own complex client issues end-to-end, serving as the primary functional escalation point. Lead impact assessment, prioritization, investigation, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, resolution validation, and closure.
* Elicit and analyze client requirements and translate them into functional specifications, configuration recommendations, defect reports, or enhancement requests aligned with reinsurance business objectives.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Cloud Operations, functional consultants, and external partners to resolve issues, manage risk, and ensure timely follow-through.
* Lead or support functional configuration, test planning and execution, release readiness, deployment validation, and post-release stabilization for DCR updates, patches, and enhancements.
* Monitor incident trends, case aging, service-level performance, and application health indicators; implement improvements that strengthen reliability, support efficiency, and the client experience.
* Develop and maintain functional guides, troubleshooting procedures, known-error records, and knowledge articles; lead problem-management reviews for recurring or high-impact issues.
* Build strong client relationships and serve as a trusted advisor by clearly communicating impacts, risks, options, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Lead regular client follow-up meetings to provide assistance, review backlog priorities, and deliver timely updates throughout the full lifecycle of client-reported issues and tickets.
* Coach and mentor less-experienced analysts, review complex cases, and promote consistent support standards and share knowledge across the team.
* Maintain current expertise in DCR functionality, reinsurance industry practices, IT service management, and emerging support technologies.
* Perform all other duties and activities as required.
* Act in accordance with and as a good steward of Duck Creek Technologies mission, vision, and core values:
* Mission: To empower insurers/ Reinsurance to reimagine the future of insurance
* Vision: To transform insurance technology, helping insurers be smarter, faster, and more efficient, and ultimately provide the best protection for people and businesses
* Values: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Insurance, or a related field with an analytical focus; equivalent relevant experience may be considered
* 3+ years of progressively responsible experience in application support, business analysis, enterprise software, or insurance technology, with demonstrated success owning complex client issues
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional investigation and resolution of production support issues and communicating with client stakeholders
* Working knowledge of reinsurance business processes and enterprise application support practices
* Experience applying incidents, problems, change, and release management practices in a production environment

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Duck Creek Reinsurance (DCR) or a similar reinsurance administration platform.
* Working knowledge of SQL, application logs, monitoring tools, and service management or case-management platforms
* ITIL certification or practical experience with ITIL-based service management.
* Experience with Agile or Scrum methodologies in application support and product environments

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Advanced functional analysis and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex application and business-process issues independently
* Strong knowledge of DCR functionality, configuration concepts, and reinsurance workflows, or the ability to rapidly build deep product expertise
* Proven end-to-end case ownership, prioritization, judgment, and accountability in high-impact client situations
* Strong requirements elicitation, process analysis, and functional documentation skills, with the ability to translate business needs into actionable solutions
* Ability to interpret system behavior, configuration, logs, data, and performance metrics to support root-cause analysis and informed decision-making
* Strong knowledge of incident, problem, change, and release management practices
* Experience with enterprise software testing, user acceptance testing, release cycles, deployment validation, and post-release support
* Ability to influence and coordinate cross-functional teams without direct authority and drive issues to timely resolution
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor communication for technical, non-technical, client, and executive stakeholders
* Trusted-advisor mindset with the ability to manage expectations, explain risk, and recommend practical solutions
* Ability to mentor analysts, review case quality, facilitate knowledge transfer, and strengthen team capability
* Strategic and continuous-improvement mindset; ability to use trends and service metrics to identify opportunities and implement improvements
* Strong organization, resilience, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and critical incidents in a fast-paced environment
* Proficiency with support tools, case-management systems, application monitoring platforms, and knowledge-management practices
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current on DCR functionality, reinsurance developments, and application support best practices

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/
  
  
AI STATEMENT
  
  
To ensure an equitable and consistent process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews based on their own knowledge and experience. The use of AI tools during interviews is not permitted.
  
  
PRIVACY NOTICE
  
  
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data – Refer Privacy Notice
  
  
NOTICE
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies does not accept agency resumes.

title: Product Lifecycle Program Manager(12-18 Years)
description:
**Meet the Team**
The Product Operations team plays a critical role in delivering Cisco’s next-generation hardware products on a scale. Working at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing, the team ensures seamless product lifecycle execution—from new product introduction to high-volume production and customer delivery. With a strong focus on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence, the team drives impact across global operations and enables successful product outcomes.
  
  
**Your Impact**
The Cisco Product Operations team is seeking a seasoned Product Lifecycle Program Manager (PLPM) to provide strategic leadership over global cost management and the end-to-end product lifecycle from inception to End-of-Life (EOL). This is a high-visibility, senior-level role that requires the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders—including Manufacturing, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership—to align on strategy and execution for a portfolio of complex product solutions. You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Cost Management & Lifecycle Oversight: Serve as the primary architect for end-to-end product lifecycle strategy, driving rigorous cost management protocols from launch through EOL to ensure sustained profitability.
* Engineering Change Governance: Provide authoritative oversight for Engineering Change Management, ensuring seamless technical transitions and minimal operational disruption.
* Product Quality & Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets.
* Complex Problem Resolution: Lead the mitigation of critical sustaining issues, including line-stop resolutions, CAP account management, AVL optimization, and continuous manufacturing process improvement.
* EOL Strategy & Orchestration: Direct the development and execution of holistic EOL strategies, partnering with integrated product teams to ensure smooth sunsetting of legacy solutions.
* Enterprise Risk Management: Oversee proactive risk assessment, including multi-source technology evaluation, component-level analysis, cost variance mitigation, and comprehensive supply chain reviews throughout the lifecycle.
* Field Performance & Margin Optimization: Lead strategic action planning for product field performance and spearhead initiatives to drive continuous improvement in gross margins.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related technical field.
* 12+ years of progressive experience in Supply Chain management within the high-tech sector.
* Proven track record in complex Program Management and executive-level stakeholder management.
* Deep expertise in supply chain dynamics, specifically within high-tech environments, product costing, and sophisticated margin analysis.
* Advanced knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and sustaining product support

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Engineering or Supply Chain Management and/or MBA.
* Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes.
* Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification.
* High proficiency in Agile methodologies and advanced MSFT tools.
* Extensive experience in the high-tech electronics industry and large-scale electronics manufacturing.
* Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

title: PMO Specialist
description:
Job Title: PMO Specialist
  
  
Req ID: 64332
  
  
Job Function: Strategy, Transformation & Business Intelligence

Posting End Date: 12/11/2026

**Recruiter: Sowmya Reddy**
**Hiring Manager: Amy Hunt**
**Career Grade: D**
**About The Role**
The Portfolio Lead: PMO Specialist is the operational partner to Product, Engineering and Delivery leadership for an assigned portfolio. The role turns strategic priorities and roadmaps into realistic, funded and measurable delivery plans, giving leaders confidence that commitments are achievable, sustainable and focused on value.
  
  
The role connects Portfolio planning, Financial management, FinOps, Workforce and capacity, Delivery insight, Governance, Dependencies, Quality and continuous improvement. It provides a trusted view of portfolio health and supports timely, evidence-based decisions.
  
  
Although embedded within a portfolio, the role operates as part of the wider Delivery Operations and PMO community. It adopts common BT standards, tooling, data definitions and governance approaches, and contributes learning back into the community rather than creating local practices in isolation.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Portfolio planning and strategic alignment**

* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Leaders and Delivery Leads to translate strategic objectives and roadmaps into executable portfolio plans.
* Coordinate quarterly, monthly and ongoing portfolio planning, integrating demand, capacity, funding, dependencies and delivery readiness.
* Provide scenario analysis and recommendations to support prioritisation, sequencing and investment trade-offs.
* Maintain an evidence-based view of commitments, milestones, outcomes and delivery confidence.
* Provide complete, timely and evidence-based portfolio inputs into unit-level planning, reporting and assurance, using agreed definitions, standards and reporting cycles.

**Financial Insight, Investment Traceability and FinOps**

* Maintain an integrated view of portfolio investment, financial forecasts and actual expenditure, using Finance-owned information to connect financial performance with delivery progress and expected outcomes.
* Embed FinOps practices so cloud cost, consumption and value are considered in planning, prioritisation and delivery decisions.
* Monitor material cost trends, forecast variance, commitments and optimisation opportunities, ensuring accountable owners understand the insight and act.
* Coordinate reviews and follow-up where expenditure or forecast performance is outside agreed expectations.
* Ensure new demand, proofs of concept and material scope changes identify funding, cloud-cost implications and ongoing run-cost impact before commitment.
* Support consistent cost allocation, tagging, chargeback and showback, escalating data-quality or ownership gaps.

**Delivery performance, insight and forecasting**

* Establish measures covering outcomes, value, predictability, flow, quality and delivery health.
* Turn complex portfolio data into concise insight, options and recommendations for senior decision-makers.
* Maintain delivery forecasts and identify trends, constraints and opportunities early.
* Focus reporting on changes, exceptions, risks, decisions and outcomes rather than routine activity.

**Capacity, workforce and partner planning**

* Maintain a portfolio view of demand, capacity, skills and constraints across employees, partners and suppliers.
* Coordinate capacity and scenario planning to identify gaps, bottlenecks and required interventions.
* Facilitate prioritisation when demand exceeds capacity and provide forward-looking workforce insight.

**Risk, dependency, quality and assurance**

* Coordinate cross-team, cross-programme and cross-portfolio risks, issues and dependencies.
* Work with accountable owners on mitigation, resolution and escalation.
* Provide proportionate assurance that plans are realistic, funded, governed and supported by delivery evidence.
* Champion quality through visibility of technical debt, defects, rework, reliability and operational readiness.

**PMO standards, governance and tooling**

* Operate as a member of the wider Delivery Operations and PMO community, not as a standalone portfolio function.
* Apply agreed BT delivery standards, PMO controls, planning methods, data definitions, governance cadences and reporting practices.
* Maintain a single source of truth for commitments, milestones, dependencies, risks, financial insight and delivery confidence using agreed tooling.
* Design proportionate governance that provides transparency and control without unnecessary overhead.
* Share learning, support peer assurance and improve consistency across portfolios.

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* Commercial thinker: Connects delivery choices to investment, cost, consumption, value and sustainable outcomes.
* Portfolio planning: Integrates strategy, demand, funding, capacity and dependencies into realistic scenarios.
* Data and insight: Creates a trusted performance view and translates complexity into clear recommendations.
* Governance and assurance: Applies proportionate controls, standards and escalation while protecting pace.
* Collaborative partner: Builds alignment across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Finance, Architecture, Commercial and Assurance.
* Solution-focused achiever: Resolves obstacles and maintains momentum in ambiguity.
* Improvement focus: Coordinates sustainable improvements across teams and portfolios.
* Digital fluency: Uses Jira, Confluence, Power BI, or equivalent portfolio tools.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**

* Significant experience in portfolio management, PMO, delivery operations, programme delivery or a comparable complex environment.
* Experience across multiple Product, Engineering and Delivery teams with significant dependencies and competing priorities.
* Practical experience of planning, forecasting, capacity management and delivery insight.
* Experience managing or assuring financial information, forecasts, portfolio costs or related commercial controls.
* Experience applying governance, reporting and data standards across multiple teams.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders through clear, evidence-based insight.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, analytical and problem-solving experience.
* Product operating models and Lean Portfolio Management.
* FinOps in cloud-enabled portfolios.
* SAFe RTE, portfolio, programme or equivalent accreditation.
* Building or improving PMO or Delivery Operations capability.
* Jira, Confluence, Power BI, Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. description:

**Partner with the best**
As a Digital Technology Specialist - Technical Product Management, you’ll be responsible for supporting the global implementation, sustainment and optimization strategy of our Baker Hughes Learning and Competency platforms, anchored on Cornerstone LMS and LXP. The systems lead will be part of the Global Digital HR Technology team and will report into Director- Learning Technology and HR Systems
  
  
The Specialist will manage multiple concurrent projects – including Cornerstone implementation, multiple system migration data and content migration, integrations and enhancements – while providing oversight of ServiceNow support queues, case resolution and SLA adherence for the Baker Hughes Support teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have deep technical and functional experience with Cornerstone, learning and competency systems, and related processes within a global HR Technology landscape.
  
  
The Specialist will gather requirements, analyse problems, design and test solutions, and work with stakeholders and implementation partners to craft scalable, secure and sustainable HR Technology solutions across SSO, integrations and reporting.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have experience providing HR Technology operations support, training others in support matters, and managing ticket data and support metrics to drive incident reduction. The candidate will be comfortable in a fast-paced, global, multi-tenant environment. They will take initiative to drive performance improvement within the learning and competency ecosystem.
  
  
As a Specialist, you will be responsible for:
  
  
  

+ Cornerstone implementation: Leading Cornerstone LMS and LXP projects end-to-end – gathering requirements, fit-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, facilitating testing (SIT/UAT), cutover, go-live and hypercare
+ Migration: Planning and executing migration from legacy LMS platforms to Cornerstone, including users, organizational units, training content, curricula, certifications and learning history, with data validation and reconciliation
+ Configuration & design: Configuring, designing, building, testing, and deploying functionality in Cornerstone Learning, LXP, Competency Management systems
+ SSO & security: Owning SSO and identity setup (SAML 2.0, Azure AD/Entra ID), user provisioning, security roles, permissions, domains and constraints
+ Integrations: Designing, managing and troubleshooting integrations with HRIS (e.g., Workday), third-party content providers and downstream systems via APIs, SFTP feeds and Cornerstone Edge
+ Reporting & analytics: Designing and delivering Cornerstone custom reports, compliance dashboards and data extracts to support business, audit and leadership needs
+ Support & case management: Being the central point of support management for Baker Hughes HR Systems (Learning, Skills and Competency ecosystem) – managing ServiceNow queues, triaging, resolving and escalating cases within SLA, and maintaining knowledge articles
+ Problem solving: Solving routine end user problems as well as identifying, escalating, and performing root cause analysis for recurrent or systemic issues and designing permanent solutions
+ Project management: Managing project plans, timelines, risks, dependencies and status reporting; coordinating with Cornerstone, implementation partners and internal stakeholders
+ Release management: Assessing Cornerstone quarterly releases, performing impact analysis and regression testing, and communicating changes to stakeholders
+ Supporting Learning and Skill mapping and integration activities, and maintaining content quality with skills and related processes
+ Executing product technology and functional capability roadmaps
+ Working with relevant stakeholders to redesign business processes and improve the Learning & Competency Management experience for employees globally
+ Participating in prioritization discussions for business requirements, approving future state design/configurations and ensuring successful implementation
+ Contributing to overall business process improvements and being a catalyst for streamlined and effective processes across the global HR Technology organization
+ Working to improve incident reduction, simplification, process excellence, security, data privacy and compliance

**Fuel your passion**
To be successful in this role you will:
  
  
  

+ Have a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
+ Have minimum 9 years of IT or Technology experience, including 5+ years of hands-on Cornerstone OnDemand
+ Have delivered at least one full lifecycle Cornerstone LMS-LXP implementation and a large-scale migration from a legacy LMS (e.g., SumTotal, SAP SuccessFactors, Saba)
+ Be technically sound, with strong working knowledge of SSO (SAML 2.0, Azure AD/Entra ID), REST APIs, SFTP, data feeds and file formats (CSV/XML)
+ Have deep experience using Migration Utilities, Data Load Wizard / Edge Import and advanced system configuration
+ Be capable of supporting and troubleshooting complex upstream and downstream integrations (e.g., Workday HCM)
+ Have strong reporting experience with Cornerstone custom reports and analytics, along with advanced Excel skills
+ Have hands-on ServiceNow experience – incident, request and problem management, SLAs, knowledge base and queue dashboards
+ Have strong analytical, problem-solving and solution design skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical designs

title: Lead-Inclusion, Well-being & Emp Exp
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
We are looking for a strategic, hands-on People & Culture expert to shape and deliver an integrated agenda across Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI), Health & Wellbeing, and Employee Experience at Volvo Group India. This role will help create an inclusive, healthy and engaging workplace where employees feel respected, supported and able to contribute their best.
  
  
The portfolio is structured across three interconnected focus areas: DEI, Health & Wellbeing, and Employee Experience. You will translate organisational priorities and employee insights into relevant programmes, policies and everyday practices; influence leaders and cross-functional partners; and evaluate impact through evidence and feedback. This is a senior individual-contributor role with end-to-end ownership of initiatives.
  
  
**What will you do?**
**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

* Develop, implement and drive the DEI roadmap aligned with Volvo Group’s global direction, local workforce needs and organisational priorities.
* Strengthen inclusion, belonging, respect, psychological safety and equitable opportunity across the employee lifecycle, partnering with internal functions like Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, P&C Business Partners and business leaders.
* Design and deliver initiatives that address relevant inclusion priorities, including persons with diverse abilities, LGBTQ+ inclusion, diverse life stages and other employee needs and priorities.
* Own employee resource groups and employee-led communities, allyship, awareness campaigns and constructive dialogue across the organisation.
* Review workplace practices, policies, facilities and employee processes to identify potential barriers and recommend practical improvements and sustain leading practices informed by internal reviews and external benchmarking.
* Build leader and manager capability in inclusive leadership, respectful workplaces, bias awareness and inclusive decision-making in a holistic manner.
* Drive inclusive workplace practices that evolve with changing workforce demographics, business priorities and future ways of working, fostering an accessible, equitable and adaptable employee ecosystem.
* Track agreed DEI indicators, review employee insights and representation data where appropriate, and recommend actions to address gaps.

**Health & Wellbeing**

* Design and deliver a comprehensive health and wellbeing roadmap aligned with Volvo Group’s global and local priorities, supporting physical, mental, emotional and social wellbeing.
* Lead health promotion activities, workshops, webinars and campaigns covering mental health, nutrition, fitness, preventive health, stress management, resilience and work-life integration.
* Partner with healthcare providers, occupational health professionals (both in factories and corporate offices), wellbeing experts and other external partners to enhance programme quality, accessibility and relevance.
* Promote mental health awareness and access to appropriate support, including Employee Assistance Programmes (EAPs) and other available resources; handle sensitive employee concerns with discretion and refer to qualified professionals as appropriate.
* Develop inclusive wellbeing interventions that recognise differing employee needs, life stages and work contexts, including employees in factory and office environments.
* Work with managers and relevant functions to encourage healthy work practices, supportive conversations, early identification of concerns and sustainable performance.
* Coordinate with Health & Safety, occupational health, Employee Relations and other designated teams and stakeholders on relevant precautions, workplace health and emergency-response arrangements; ensure responsibilities remain clear and aligned with applicable requirements and Volvo Group policies.
* Monitor participation, accessibility, employee feedback and relevant wellbeing indicators; analyse trends and prepare progress updates and recommendations for leadership, including value and impact where measurable.
* Partner with workplace services and cafeteria partners to promote healthier food choices and provide recommendations that support employees' nutritional wellbeing.
* Evaluate and recommend innovative wellbeing initiatives, including fitness programmes, preventive healthcare offerings and employee benefit enhancements, to strengthen employee wellbeing and engagement.

**Employee Experience**

* Work with relevant stakeholders to execute actions emerging out of the employee listening / feedback and engagement surveys.
* Identify opportunities to improve key employee moments across employee lifecycle.
* Partner with the P&C community to strengthen employee voice, manager communication, trust and consistency of employee-facing practices.
* Track agreed experience measures and evaluate interventions for continuous improvement.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
At
**Group People & Culture**
, a part of Volvo Group, we create the foundation and frameworks for people growth and organizational development, to drive the people agenda that enables the realization of the Volvo Group aspirations through people strategy and commitment. You will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead.

title: Manager, Service Excellence
description:
**Job Summary**
Reporting to the Director of Service Excellence, the Service Excellence Manager will help improve how People Services & Solutions (PSS) delivers services to colleagues, while also leading the transition of People processes into PSS.
  
  
The role will focus primarily on service excellence, including service quality, operational performance, governance, continuous improvement and colleague experience. It will also play an important role in managing process transitions into PSS and ensuring new services are ready for successful delivery.
  
  
You will work with People leaders, Centres of Excellence (CoEs), PSS teams and project teams across regions. You will use data, feedback and service insights to improve performance, strengthen service delivery and help teams adopt new processes and ways of working.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Improve Service Quality and Colleague Experience
  
  
You will help strengthen service delivery across PSS by using service measures, colleague feedback and operational data to understand performance and focus improvement efforts.
  
  
You will support a consistent approach to service quality across teams and locations. This includes reviewing service performance, understanding trends and helping teams make practical changes that improve quality, efficiency and colleague experience.
  
  
You will also help develop service measures and dashboards that give teams clear information to support day-to-day decisions and monitor progress.
  
  
Strengthen Operational Performance
  
  
You will help PSS teams build strong and sustainable service practices through regular performance reviews, clear measures and effective operational controls.
  
  
Working with service delivery teams and leaders, you will help strengthen quality, capability and operational rigor. You will use service reviews and data to highlight areas that need attention and work with teams to address them.
  
  
You will support risk assessments and help ensure appropriate controls are in place to protect service quality and continuity.
  
  
Build Service Capability
  
  
You will help PSS teams develop the skills and knowledge needed to provide a positive and consistent colleague experience.
  
  
This will include coaching, sharing practical guidance and supporting learning activities that strengthen service behaviours, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will encourage teams to learn from feedback, share what works and recognise improvements that make a significant difference to colleagues.
  
  
Lead People Process Transitions
  
  
You will plan and manage the transition of People processes into PSS, from initial planning through knowledge transfer, implementation and stabilisation.
  
  
You will work with the teams involved to agree scope, responsibilities, timelines and readiness requirements. You will track progress, manage risks and help resolve issues that could affect the transition.
  
  
You will make sure essential materials are ready for use, including Desktop Procedures (DTPs), process maps, SLAs/OLAs and training materials. You will also help PSS teams build the knowledge and confidence needed to take ownership of new services.
  
  
Support People Through Change
  
  
You will help colleagues prepare for changes to processes, systems and ways of working. This includes understanding the impact of change, supporting communications and training, and checking that teams are ready before services move into PSS.
  
  
You will bring together different perspectives and encourage open discussion. Communication, training and transition activities should consider the different needs of colleagues across teams and locations.
  
  
Turn Data into Action
  
  
You will use service measures, quality reviews, colleague feedback and operational data to understand patterns and service trends.
  
  
You will turn these insights into practical recommendations that help teams improve service quality, simplify processes and strengthen colleague experience.
  
  
What You’ll Bring
  
  
You will bring experience in service excellence, service delivery, People Operations, HR operations, process improvement, transitions or a related area.
  
  
You will be comfortable working with data, understanding service performance and turning findings into practical improvements. You will be able to organise complex work, communicate clearly and build positive working relationships across teams, levels and regions.
  
  
Experience with service quality, operational governance, organisational change, process mapping or continuous improvement would be useful. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Voice of the Customer, Workday, ServiceNow or process mapping tools would also be helpful, but you do not need experience in all of these areas.
  
  
You should be comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  
  
We recognise that relevant skills can be gained through different roles, industries and career paths.
**You do not need to meet every desirable criterion to apply.**
**Career Stage:**
Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

  **CliftonStrengths**

title: HR Operations Specialist
description:
**About Us**
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
  
  
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
**Available Location: Bengaluru, India**
**What You Would Do Here:**
Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our team and champion this mission within the APJC region. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. You will be instrumental in creating a seamless experience by resolving inquiries, managing data with precision, and ensuring our People processes are efficient and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to provide exceptional support to our internal teams and contribute to building a world-class employee experience as our organization expands.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Champion key employee lifecycle process: Take ownership of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes across APJC, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.
* Be a subject-matter expert for employee inquiries: Provide timely, high-quality support to employee inquiries through Zendesk. Act as a trusted liaison between employees and People/Payroll teams, resolving issues efficiently with empathy and accuracy.
* Elevate the employee experience through cross-functional collaboration: Act as a proactive liaison between employees and specialized teams such as Payroll, Benefits, and Legal to address and resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.
* Ensure data integrity and governance: Maintain and update employee records across People/Payroll systems, performing regular and ad hoc audits to guarantee 100% data accuracy and compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence: Analyze employee feedback and process metrics to identify opportunities for process enhancements. Partner with regional teams to implement scalable solutions that improve the overall People Operations function across APJC.
* Support strategic HR initiatives and projects: Contribute to HR system implementations, vendor management, and regional programs such as annual performance and compensation cycles, benefits enrollment, and year-end Payroll preparation, making them easy to understand and navigate for our employees.

**Skills/experience**

* 5+ years in HR administration and comfortable handling sensitive employee information with discretion.
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail, excellent problem-solving abilities, and effective time management skills.
* Proficient in working with data and skilled in Excel or Google Sheets for analysis and reporting.
* Customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for supporting colleagues and delivering exceptional service.
* Effective communicator, able to clearly articulate information both verbally and in writing to employees across the APJC region.
* Adaptable and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities efficiently.
* Familiarity with Workday or Zendesk would be an advantage.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
  
  
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
  
  
**Project Galileo**
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
  
  
**Athenian Project**
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
  
  
**1.1.1.1**
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
  
  
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
  
  
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
  
  
Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery

You will act as:
  
  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities

Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
  
  
**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

Lastly, what we are not looking for
**,**
we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

title: HR Specialist Operations
description:
**Job Description**
**Role: HR Specialist**
**Location: Bangalore**

**12:00pm to 9:00pm**
