**Introduction:**

* The Global People & Culture Help Desk Specialist is a key member of the People & Culture Operations team and serves as a first point of contact for colleagues seeking support with People & Culture-related questions, requests and processes.
* The role is responsible for providing timely, accurate and colleague-focused support through the People & Culture help desk (“MyCSC Helpdesk”), resolving first-line enquiries wherever possible and ensuring more complex cases are effectively routed to the appropriate People & Culture specialist.
* Operating across APAC, EMEA and AMRS, the Specialist develops a broad working knowledge of global and regional policies, benefits and processes and applies this knowledge consistently while recognizing country-specific requirements.
* In addition to day-to-day case management, the role contributes to accurate employee data and documentation, effective knowledge management and continuous improvement of People & Culture services. The Specialist identifies recurring questions and root causes and works with colleagues across People & Culture to improve processes, knowledge articles and the overall colleague experience.

**Some of the things you’ll be doing:**

* Serve as the first point of contact for People & Culture enquiries, providing timely, accurate, and colleague-focused support through the MyCSC Helpdesk.
* Investigate and resolve enquiries efficiently, responding within agreed service levels and achieving first-contact resolution whenever possible.
* Take ownership of cases from receipt through resolution, including appropriate escalation to specialist teams when additional expertise is required.
* Handle employee information with the highest levels of confidentiality, discretion, and compliance with data privacy requirements.

Employee Support & Service Delivery
  
  

* Manage employee enquiries and cases, maintaining accurate records and ensuring timely follow-up in line with business priorities and service expectations.
* Provide guidance on People & Culture policies, benefits, processes, and self-service tools across APAC, EMEA, and AMRS.
* Support employee lifecycle events by reviewing documentation and coordinating required updates to records and benefit arrangements.
* Identify recurring issues, service challenges, and process gaps, escalating trends and opportunities for improvement to relevant stakeholders.

Employee Data, Records & Administration
  
  

* Maintain accurate employee data and People & Culture records within MyCSC and related systems, ensuring compliance with established procedures.
* Process, validate, and maintain employee documentation and transactions with a strong focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
* Support data quality reviews, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams.
* Ensure employee records and supporting documentation are properly received, recorded, retained, and managed throughout the employee lifecycle.

Knowledge Management, Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Utilize and maintain People & Culture knowledge resources, contributing to the ongoing enhancement of articles, FAQs, process guidance, and standard responses.
* Partner with People & Culture teams, subject matter experts, and specialist functions to deliver seamless and effective colleague support.
* Analyze enquiry trends and recurring cases to identify root causes and recommend improvements to processes, communications, workflows, and self-service capabilities.
* Share best practices, lessons learned, and operational insights to drive consistency, service quality, and continuous improvement across the Help Desk function.

**What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?**

* 3-5 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, or HR Help Desk.
* Strong analytical skills with experience identifying trends, root causes, and process improvement opportunities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and customer-service orientation
* Hands-on experience with HRIS systems

Employee Exit Management:

* Ensuring audit readiness through appropriate documentation, audit trails, approvals and data update.

title: WFM Manager, LMAQ
description:
**Description**
Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate’s route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Drive end-to-end workforce management for the entire LMAQ space, designing and delivering short- and long-term labor planning strategies across all lines of business
* Own forecasting, planning, and execution to ensure operational performance meets or exceeds targets
* Build forecast models to drive headcount planning across spaces, programs, and sub-programs with high utilization, and cross-skilling optimization
* Manage headcount planning across the space, ensuring key programs and business needs are driven without impacting SLA, sustaining operational performance with the least churn for managers
* Ability to partner with multiple teams and build strong stakeholder relationships to drive HC planning for the LMAQ space
* Manage the VCC vs. B&M mix across sites, ensuring compliance, driving seating planning across sites, and driving key operational metrics like cross-site reporting, etc.
* Build a data-driven culture by championing automated solutions to drive LMAQ HC planning at a regular cadence with minimal effort
* Own end-to-end delivery of multiple projects focused on performance optimization and cost efficiency
* Guide the design, development, and maintenance of metrics, reports, analyses, and dashboards that inform key business decisions
* Work through and influence WFM leads and analysts across each space without direct authority, aligning them to a common planning and execution standard
* Demonstrate a strong eye for detail, uncovering trends, going beyond the obvious, and identifying root causes
* Thrive in ambiguous environments and proactively take on new challenges
* Influence hiring quality by raising the bar on interviewing standards across the organization

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 7+ years of operational and/or retail management experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Advanced degree in a quantitative field or an MBA
* Ability to think strategically and drive the detailed execution of specific initiatives
* Experience with workforce management tools and platforms (e.g., NICE, Verint, or proprietary systems)

description:

3. Digital Marketing & Brand Visibility

* Manage Google Business Profile updates and support local SEO initiatives.
* Execute WhatsApp marketing, CRM campaigns, and digital promotions.
* Support marketing campaigns across Zomato, Swiggy, and direct ordering channels.

4. Hyperlocal Marketing & Customer Acquisition

* Execute apartment activations, corporate promotions, food sampling, and neighbourhood campaigns.
* Build relationships with apartment associations, coworking spaces, and local businesses.

5. Influencer Marketing & Customer Engagement

* Coordinate influencer visits, UGC campaigns, and promotional collaborations.
* Execute loyalty, referral, customer engagement, and retention campaigns.

6. Corporate Marketing & Partnerships

* Identify and engage corporate offices, startups, and coworking spaces.
* Generate leads for corporate catering, bulk orders, and recurring meal programmes.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, Mass Communication, or a related field.

* Experience executing digital and offline marketing initiatives.
* Familiarity with Canva, CapCut, Premiere Pro, Meta Business Suite, and Google Business Profile.
* Strong communication, coordination, creativity, and organisational skills.
* Comfortable with field marketing, corporate visits, and customer interactions.
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.

**What We're Looking For**

Someone who takes ownership, executes independently, enjoys creating content, works well with agencies and teams, and understands that marketing should translate into customer acquisition and business growth.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work closely with experienced marketing leadership.
* Gain exposure to brand building, content creation, digital campaigns, and growth marketing.

AI Suite
helps marketers develop winning copies and creatives, optimize campaigns and channels that boost engagement, and help with faster execution.

For over a decade, consumer brands in 60+ countries have been using MoEngage to power digital experiences for over a billion monthly customers. With offices in 15 countries, MoEngage is backed by Goldman Sachs Asset Management, B Capital, Steadview Capital, Multiples Private Equity, Eight Roads, F-Prime Capital, Matrix Partners, Ventureast, and Helion Ventures.

MoEngage was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Real-Time Interaction Management, Q1 2024 report, and Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™ 2023 report. MoEngage was also featured as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omni-Channel Marketing Platforms for B2C Enterprises 2023.

**About the Role :**

We're looking for a content marketer who can translate campaign and GTM ideas into the content assets that bring them to life, with a focus on thought leadership and demand generation. You'll work closely with the regional team to produce case studies and content that supports GTM motions.

This role sits at the intersection of content strategy and content creation: you're not just writing — you're figuring out what assets a campaign actually needs, then building them.

**What You'll Do :**

* Translate campaign ideas into content assets: Work with campaign/demand gen owners to understand a GTM motion's goals and figure out what content (POVs, guides, case studies, landing page copy, sales one-pagers, etc.) will actually move it forward.
* Drive thought leadership content: Develop POV pieces, opinion content, and narrative-driven assets that position the company (and its spokespeople) as category leaders — often based on exec interviews, industry trends, or internal data.
* Support demand generation: Create content assets specifically designed to feed pipeline — gated content, nurture assets, sales enablement collateral, and campaign-specific landing page/microsite copy.
* Partner with regional teams: Work closely with regional marketing to produce case studies, customer stories, and localized/region-specific content that supports local campaigns and GTM needs.
* Collaborate with long-form/SEO writers: Coordinate with the existing content team so thought leadership and campaign assets complement (not duplicate) the SEO content pipeline.
* Own asset planning for campaigns: Build a content plan for each major campaign — what gets made, in what format, for which audience/region, and on what timeline.
* Gather source material: Conduct interviews (execs, customers, SMEs) to source thought leadership angles and case study narratives.
* Maintain narrative consistency: Ensure messaging stays aligned with brand positioning and campaign narrative across all regions and formats.

**What We're Looking For :**

* 5+ years in content marketing, demand generation content, or B2B thought leadership writing.
* Strong portfolio showing campaign-aligned content — not just standalone blog posts, but assets clearly built to support a specific GTM motion or campaign.
* Experience writing or producing case studies, ideally having worked directly with customers/regional teams to source and shape them.
* Ability to translate a campaign brief or business goal into a concrete content plan — this is a strategic/planning skill, not just writing.
* Comfortable conducting interviews (customers, execs, SMEs) and turning raw conversations into narrative content.
* Experience working with regional/local marketing teams and adapting content for different markets (nice to have).
* Strong grasp of demand gen content types (gated assets, nurture content, sales enablement) and how they fit into a funnel.

**Success Looks Like :**

* Every major campaign launches with a content asset plan mapped to its GTM goals, not content created reactively after the fact.
* A steady pipeline of case studies co-developed with regional teams, supporting local demand gen efforts.
* Thought leadership content that's cited/shared externally and ties back to campaign narratives, not generic industry commentary.

title: Senior Account Manager - Digital Marketing & Project Delivery
description:
**Senior Account Manager - Digital Marketing & Project Delivery**

Experience: 6-8 years

Role Type: Full-time | Senior Individual Contributor / Team Management

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Account Manager - Digital Marketing & Project Delivery who can independently manage multiple client accounts, lead client relationships, oversee campaign performance, and ensure timely, high-quality project delivery.

The ideal candidate should have substantial experience working in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple clients and coordinating cross-functional teams across paid media, SEO, social media, content, design, and development.

We are not looking for someone who simply coordinates tasks or communicates updates. We need someone who understands how digital marketing works, can evaluate campaign performance, proactively recommend improvements, solve problems, and take complete ownership of client accounts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Account Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
* Build strong client relationships through proactive communication, strategic recommendations, and consistent delivery.
* Independently lead client meetings, performance reviews, campaign discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable briefs for internal teams.
* Review campaign performance and provide meaningful recommendations beyond routine reporting.
* Confidently handle client questions, objections, escalations, and challenging conversations.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign performance, lead quality, conversion rates, and overall marketing effectiveness.
* Manage client expectations regarding timelines, budgets, deliverables, and performance outcomes.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, additional services, and strategic initiatives.

**2. Project Management & Delivery Ownership**

* Independently manage multiple client accounts and concurrent digital marketing projects.
* Own project planning, execution timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and overall delivery quality.
* Coordinate with performance marketing, SEO, social media, content, design, and development teams.
* Convert client requirements into clearly defined tasks, responsibilities, and deadlines.
* Ensure campaigns, landing pages, creatives, reports, and other deliverables are completed on schedule.
* Track project progress, identify bottlenecks, and proactively resolve delays.
* Prioritise competing client requirements and allocate internal resources effectively.
* Conduct quality checks before deliverables are shared with clients or campaigns go live.
* Maintain structured project trackers, meeting minutes, action items, and follow-up mechanisms.
* Ensure accountability across internal teams and maintain consistent delivery standards.
* Anticipate potential risks and take corrective action before they affect client relationships or project outcomes.

**3. Team Management & Execution Oversight**

* Guide and coordinate team members responsible for campaign execution and other digital marketing deliverables.
* Assign tasks, establish priorities, and ensure accountability for outcomes.
* Review campaign strategies, media plans, optimisation recommendations, and performance reports prepared by the team.
* Provide constructive feedback to improve execution quality, problem-solving, and operational efficiency.
* Support team members in resolving campaign-related and technical challenges.
* Ensure effective collaboration between performance marketing, creative, content, and technical teams.
* Monitor workload distribution, deadlines, and team productivity.
* Step in when necessary to troubleshoot campaign issues, review account configurations, or support critical execution requirements.

**4. Performance Marketing & Technical Expertise**

The candidate must possess strong practical knowledge of paid advertising platforms and be capable of independently evaluating campaign performance and recommending improvements.

* Demonstrate advanced working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
* Understand campaign structures, targeting, bidding strategies, budget allocation, audience segmentation, and optimisation techniques.
* Have practical experience setting up, managing, or optimising paid advertising campaigns.
* Understand conversion tracking, attribution, remarketing, and campaign measurement.
* Possess working knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and conversion tracking implementations.
* Identify potential tracking issues, campaign inefficiencies, landing-page problems, and opportunities for optimisation.
* Understand how CRM data, lead feedback, and offline conversions influence campaign decisions.
* Provide technically sound recommendations to clients and execution teams.

**5. Strategic Thinking & Problem-Solving**

* Analyse client performance and identify areas requiring immediate attention or strategic improvement.
* Recommend appropriate marketing channels, campaign approaches, budget changes, and optimisation priorities.
* Connect campaign performance with business outcomes such as qualified leads, admissions, sales, and revenue.
* Evaluate whether performance challenges originate from targeting, creatives, landing pages, tracking, lead handling, or other funnel stages.
* Develop practical action plans to address performance gaps.
* Make informed recommendations based on data rather than relying solely on execution-team inputs.
* Stay updated on digital advertising developments, platform changes, automation, and emerging marketing practices.

**Key Requirements**

* Minimum 6-8 years of experience in a digital marketing agency, with substantial client-facing responsibilities.
* Proven experience independently managing multiple digital marketing client accounts.
* Strong client servicing, relationship management, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Demonstrated experience in project management, task coordination, resource planning, and delivery ownership.
* Strong hands-on background in Google Ads and Meta Ads, with working knowledge of LinkedIn Ads.
* Solid understanding of GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, attribution, and performance reporting.
* Ability to interpret campaign data and confidently recommend optimisation strategies.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across performance marketing, SEO, social media, creative, content, and development.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, tight deadlines, and multiple client expectations.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead client meetings independently.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
* Ability to guide team members, review their work, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Clients receive proactive, knowledgeable communication and actionable marketing recommendations.
* Projects and campaigns are delivered on time, with clear ownership and minimal follow-up.
* Internal teams have well-defined priorities, responsibilities, and deadlines.
* Campaign performance is actively reviewed, with improvement opportunities identified and acted upon.
* Client escalations are handled independently and professionally.
* Account performance, delivery quality, and client satisfaction improve consistently.

**Who This Role Is Not Suited For**

* Client servicing professionals who primarily forward requests between clients and internal teams.
* Project managers without a strong understanding of digital advertising and campaign performance.
* Performance marketers who prefer campaign execution but have limited client-facing or project management experience.
* Account coordinators who depend entirely on technical teams for campaign insights and recommendations.
* Managers who focus on task allocation without taking ownership of delivery quality and client outcomes.

You choose the channels and formats, and we judge the work by the leads and pipeline it brings.

**How we will measure your work**

We will look at relevant leads and the pipeline they create: demo bookings and sales conversations with people who run education businesses. Reach, engagement and follower growth help us learn what works, but they are not the goal.

**What you need**

* 1 to 3 years of creating social media content yourself, including writing, design and video editing.
* Strong writing for hooks, text posts, captions and carousels.

**Good to have**

* Experience with HubSpot or another marketing automation tool.

title: Social Media & ORM Executive
description:
**Role**
- Social Media & ORM Executive
  
  
**Work Location**
- Work From Office -Bangalore
  
  
**Type Employement**
: Full Time
  
  
**About Lokal**
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
  
  
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved.We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
  
  
Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  
  
Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  
  
Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  
  
Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  
  
Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  
  
Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  
  
Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  
  
Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more
  
  
Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into:
  
  
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
  
  
**About Lokal Matrimony:**
Lokal Matrimony is a hyperlocal matrimony platform focused on helping people discover compatible life partners based on their preferences, community, and regional connections. Our mission is to make partner search more relevant, convenient, and accessible through a compatibility-first approach that helps users find meaningful relationships. We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Social Media & ORM Executive who can manage Lokal's official social media presence across Facebook and Instagram. The role will focus on maintaining content quality, managing user interactions, responding to comments and queries, addressing feedback, and ensuring consistent brand communication across all social media platforms.

to manage and monitor Lokal's social media accounts, maintain online brand reputation, and ensure smooth day-to-day social media operations. title: Assistant Brand Manager Marketing
description:
**WHAT THIS ROLE IS**

This is not a "manage the calendar and coordinate with agencies" brand role. We're looking for someone who can think brand strategy on Monday and be knee-deep in a retail store brief by Wednesday. Equal parts left brain and right brain - someone who can read search volume trends and write a creative brief with equal comfort.

You'll own brand end-to-end: from defining how Livspace shows up in the market, to executing campaigns at individual store level, to managing large media spends across channels. If you've only done one of these things, this probably isn't the role for you.

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**

* **Brand Strategy & Health:**
  Define and protect the brand — positioning, messaging, tone of voice. Own the brand health track: build it, monitor it, and drive actions basis what you see. This includes tracking search metrics, SOV, consumer sentiment, and brand funnel metrics, and translating that into clear POVs for leadership.
* **Campaigns & Communication:**
  Plan and execute integrated campaigns — from large media-spend brand campaigns to hyperlocal store-level activations. You'll develop the comm strategy, write the brief, chase the insight, and guide creative teams (internal and agency) to output that's both creatively strong and commercially effective. You know the difference between a beautiful ad and one that works.
* **Consumer Research & Insights:**
  Commission and synthesize primary research, track competitor moves, and stay close to the customer. Insights should feed everything — campaign strategy, retail experience, brand positioning. You don't just read research decks; you know what question to ask before commissioning one.
* **Retail & Experiential:**
  Own in-store branding and retail communications across formats. Plan and execute events and experiential activations. You understand that brand lives in physical spaces too, and you've done the work to prove it.
* **Agency & Vendor Management:**
  Brief, manage, and push creative agencies to do their best work. Independently find new vendors when needed, negotiate commercials, and manage procurement and finance processes without needing handholding. You know how to get value from a vendor relationship.
* **Cross-functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with category, product, retail, and finance teams to ensure brand is integrated into every customer touchpoint — not bolted on at the end. You're comfortable influencing without authority.

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

2+ years in brand marketing, with visible proof that you've operated across both strategy and execution. Bonus if you've worked on a consumer brand with physical retail.

You should be able to:

* Write a sharp creative brief and know when an agency has answered it (or hasn't)
* Read brand health data and tell a story from it
* Run a campaign from Rs. 2 lakh to Rs. 2 crore with the same rigour
* Navigate procurement, vendor negotiations, and finance processes independently
* Hold your own in a room with a category head, a creative director, or a CFO

title: Product Marketing Manager
description:
Great products don’t win. Great stories about great products do.

We’re hiring: Product Marketing Manager | 3–9 years of experience | Bengaluru (HSR Layout), work from office

At HyperNorm, we’re building an AI-native brand in financial services, and we’re taking it to wealth managers in India, the USA and Singapore. We have the product. Now we need the person who decides how the market understands it: what we say, who we say it to, and why it matters to them.

What you’ll own:

→ Positioning and messaging for each segment we serve: fund managers, wealth advisors and fintech platforms, across three markets

→ Customer and market research that tells us what advisors actually struggle with, not what we assume they do

→ Go-to-market launches, end to end, from first positioning through to adoption

→ Sales enablement that wins deals: pitch narratives, battle cards, competitive analyses and objection handling

→ Bringing the customer’s voice into the product roadmap, so we build what the market will pay for

→ Case studies, product pages and content that turn early users into our loudest proof

→ The numbers: pipeline influence, win rates and adoption, and refining the story until they move

Why this is hard (and why that’s the point):

Finance runs on trust. Advisors won’t switch tools because of a clever tagline. They’ll switch when they believe we understand their clients, their compliance pressures and their day better than anyone else. And what earns trust in Mumbai isn’t what earns it in New York or Singapore. Your job is to find the story that’s true, sharp and credible in all three, and to keep it that way as the product evolves every week.

Who we’re looking for:

🎯 Storytellers: you make complex AI and finance concepts land in one line

🔍 Insight hunters: you talk to customers until the real pain point shows up

🧭 Positioning thinkers: you know that choosing who we’re not for matters as much as who we are for

⚡ Bias for execution: you ship launches, not decks about launches

🤝 Cross-functional operators: Product, Sales and Customer Success trust your judgment

🤖 AI-native: you use AI tools and agents to research, write and ship faster

✅ 3–7 years in product marketing, ideally B2B SaaS, fintech or financial services

⭐ Bonus: experience with wealth management, asset management or investment platforms

What you will get:

Ownership of HyperNorm’s narrative across three markets, direct access to the founders, real influence on what we build, and the chance to define how an AI-native wealth brand is understood from day one.

How to apply:

📩 Email your resume to hr@hypernorm.ai with the subject “Product Marketing Manager – [Your Name]”. Include one example of positioning, messaging or a launch you’re proud of, and tell us what you’d change about how we pitch HyperNorm today.

If you can sharpen our story before you join, imagine what you’ll do after.

Know someone who’d thrive here? Tag them below. 👇

* #Hiring #ProductMarketing #Fintech #WealthTech #HyperNorm

description:
**Category Leader - Functional Packaged Foods**

**About the Opportunity**

Protein Chef is one of the most exciting consumer brands in India today. We're the leader in Functional Food brands, and India's 2nd most followed health food brand — built to make protein and functional nutrition part of everyday Indian meals. We've singlehandedly created the category of High-Protein Breads for breakfast in India, and we're now building out several more such defining categories in the Indian food space — across Snacks, Cookies, and Flours. Each of these represents genuine white space in Indian food, and leading one of them means shaping how millions of Indians eat, not just capturing existing demand.

We're backed by Rainmatter, one of the most respected names in India, alongside Mount Judy Ventures. We've grown more than 3x in the past 15 months, and we're looking to further accelerate this momentum as we expand across Quick Commerce, eCommerce, and beyond.

We're looking for individual Category Leaders to build out and own each of these

categories end-to-end — from strategy to P&L to team. This role, Category Leader for

Functional Packaged Foods, will report to the CBO and be part of the core leadership

team shaping how Protein Chef defines the next generation of Indian food categories.

**Category Strategy**

Understand the category and consumer landscape in depth, and build a clear strategy to expand market share — staying ahead of consumer trends, competitor moves, and platform dynamics, and translating that understanding into a category roadmap.

**New Product Development**

Partner closely with the NPD team to build products that fill genuine gaps in the

category and drive growth. You'll bring the market and consumer lens that shapes

what gets built, and how it's positioned.

**Platform Management & Growth**

**Platform Strategy**

Make and execute month, quarter, and annual plans for each platform, and own the

business reviews — both internal and platform-facing — with clear insight and

forward action plans.

**Team Leadership**

Build and lead your own team of Key Account Managers (KAMs) — setting

account-level targets, coaching execution, and building a high-ownership, data-driven

culture.

**Own the P&L**

Take full ownership of your category's P&L, working across Procurement, Production,

Supply Chain, Advertising, and NPD to drive profitability and efficiency at every stage.

**Leadership**

Be part of the core leadership team that helps shape the strategic direction of the

overall company, beyond just your own category.

**Ideal Background**

* 4–6 years of experience owning a Quick Commerce or Category P&L, either platform-side or brand-side.
* Experience managing FMCG or D2C food products at scale, with a strong grasp of category economics and channel dynamics.
* A track record of building and leading high-performing teams — hiring, coaching, and scaling.
* A strategic, commercially sharp operator and relationship builder — equally comfortable setting category strategy, earning trust with senior stakeholders, and getting into the weeds of execution.

title: Principal Solution Consultant - General Insurance Industry
description:
**Summary**
The Principal Solution Consultant is a high-impact, strategic leadership role essential to Guidewire’s India Market Entry & Penetration. You will be a pivotal member of the India Go-to-Market (GTM) engine, working in lockstep with Field Leadership to transform Guidewire from a global leader into a dominant local force.
  
  
You are a "Market Pioneer" responsible for translating Guidewire’s global SaaS value proposition into a winning strategy for Indian Tier-1 and Tier-2 insurers. Your mission is to disrupt the status quo held by legacy incumbents like by proving Guidewire’s superior agility in the General Insurance industry.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Overview**
Guidewire’s Go to Market organization is focused on scaling AI‑powered innovation, expanding into new markets and product categories, and ensuring every customer is successful and referenceable through structured, data‑driven execution and tight cross‑functional alignment.
  
  
As a Principal Solution Consultant, you sit at the intersection of this vision and our India growth strategy, serving as the senior field‑facing authority on how Guidewire’s platform, cloud services, and ecosystem can unlock value for Indian insurers.
  
  
Operating as a key member of the regional GTM leadership team, you will design and execute market‑entry and expansion plays for India, partnering closely with Sales, Professional Services, Product, and our partner ecosystem. You will champion local market needs back into our global roadmap while coaching and scaling an India‑based Solution Consulting team. This is a high‑impact, highly visible role for someone who is equally comfortable in the boardroom, on customer sites, and in the details of complex insurance workflows.
  
  
**Core Objectives**

* Go-to-Market Strategy: Co-own and execution of the Indian GTM strategy.
* Strategic Deal Lead: Own the functional "Win Theme" for major prospects, moving beyond feature lists to business outcomes.
* Market Challenger: Effectively position Guidewire as the modern SaaS alternative to legacy incumbents.
* Executive Advisor: Have the gravitas to engage with C-suite stakeholders (CEO, CTO, Business Unit Leaders).
* Thought Leadership: Act as the voice of the Indian market, specifically regarding industry trends, to influence global product roadmaps.
* You’ll work closely with Indian customers, SI Partners, internal product and field teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve the above objectives. You’ll also support the development of our local team and help scale our operation across the market.

**Key Responsibilities**

* GTM Strategy & Execution: Partner with Field Leadership to refine the India penetration plan. Identify high-propensity targets, define regional "Win Themes," and tailor the global sales playbook for the Indian context.
* Strategic Market Research: Conduct "boots-on-the-ground" discovery to identify unique Indian functional gaps (e.g., specific IRDAI compliance workflows, UPI-based real-time claims, or localized Health TPA models) vs Guidewire’s "Out-of-the-Box" (OOTB) features.
* Competitive Intelligence: Build a detailed "Battlecard" against local incumbents. Identify their architectural weaknesses in the Indian market and train the wider field team on how to exploit them.
* End-to-End Deal Ownership: Lead the functional sales cycle, from initial discovery and RFI/RFP management to final selection and contract alignment.
* Field Leadership Collaboration: Act as the primary technical/functional advisor to the Regional Sales Director and Managing Director. Provide the "solution air cover" needed to close the first wave of lighthouse customers.
* Consultative Discovery: Uncover the "pain behind the pain" in a prospect’s current operations (e.g., rigid legacy codebases, slow speed-to-market for new products).
* Solution Design: Partner with Account Executives to build a cohesive business case, ensuring all functional risks are mitigated.
* Product Localization Advocacy: Collate recurring requirements from Indian prospects and present a prioritized "India Roadmap" to Global Product Management.
* Team Leadership: Develop the India-based Solution Consulting team by coaching them on advanced storytelling, competitive positioning, and executive presence.
* Ecosystem Integration: Work with the Guidewire Marketplace and local partners to demonstrate a "frictionless" insurance experience (e.g., integrating with the India Stack, UPI, and AI-driven fraud detection).

**Product & Domain Expertise**

* India P&C Mastery: Deep expertise in the Indian General Insurance market.
* Competitive Displacement: Proven ability to position modern SaaS against legacy core insurance solutions. You must be able to articulate why a modern cloud platform beats a "One-Size-Fits-All" legacy suite.
* Digital Ecosystem (India Stack): Knowledge of how to leverage Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker within the insurance lifecycle to create a frictionless, paperless customer journey.
* Guidewire Cloud Value: Ability to sell the "Evergreen" nature of SaaS—proving to Indian CIOs that they will never have to perform a painful 2-year legacy upgrade again.

**Professional Experience**
**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* 12+ Years in Enterprise Pre-Sales/Solution Consulting: A proven track record of leading functional sales cycles for complex, high-value SaaS or Core Systems (Policy, Billing, Claims).
* Market Entry Expertise: Experience working in a "pioneer" or "early-hire" capacity for a global technology firm entering the Indian market is highly desirable.
* Competitive Displacement: Demonstrated success in unseating legacy or entrenched incumbents (specifically TCS BaNCS, SAP, or Oracle) within the Indian Financial Services sector.

**Domain & Technical Mastery**

* Indian P&C Specialist: Deep functional expertise in general insurance. You should understand the nuances of the Indian "Grid" system, TPA integrations, and IRDAI product filing requirements.
* Cloud/SaaS Evangelist: While Guidewire experience is a plus, you must have a strong grasp of Cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure) and the ability to sell the business value of "Evergreen" software over traditional on-premise and custom build models.
* Digital Ecosystem Knowledge: Familiarity with the India Stack (Aadhaar, UPI, eSign) and how these technologies are being leveraged to digitize the insurance value chain.

**Leadership & Strategic Skills**

* Field Partnership: Experience working as a "Strategic Right Hand" to Sales VPs or Managing Directors to build and execute a Go-to-Market (GTM) plan.
* Executive Presence: Exceptional "C-Suite" communication skills; the ability to challenge the thinking of a CEO/CIO and move them from a "safe" legacy choice to a transformative platform.
* Consultative Storytelling: Mastery of "The Challenger Sale" or similar methodologies—turning dry product features into a compelling business narrative that addresses specific Indian market pain points.

**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.
  
  
As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.
  
  
For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire\_PandC.
  
  
Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

If you think you may need disability-related accommodations, please email EmployAbility at accommodations-gw@employ-ability.org.uk, our disability partner, or schedule a call with an EmployAbility expert (calendar booking slot) for a confidential conversation.

title: Head of Brand Partnerships & Monetization
description:
*Founding Commercial Role | Works Directly with the CEO*
**About BeBetta**
BeBetta is one of India’s largest engagement and rewards platforms. We reward users for everyday shopping by letting them scan their bills.
  
  
Underneath that simple action, we’re building something much bigger:
**India’s first verified, SKU-level consumer purchase panel.**
Now, we’re building the revenue engine that monetizes this scale - by enabling brands (FMCG & D2C) to fund rewards for their own customers, and eventually pay for the consumer intelligence our data unlocks.
  
  
**The Role**
This is a
**founding commercial role**
. You will build BeBetta’s
**brand-funded monetization engine from near zero -**
owning partnerships, deal structures, pricing, affiliate rails, and the underlying unit economics. You’ll work directly with the CEO.
  
  
What you build will become a
**core revenue line for the company**
.
  
  
**In one line:**
Move reward costs from our balance sheet to the brands whose customers we influence - and prove it with data.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Brand Partnerships (FMCG + D2C)

Build and own relationships with brand, shopper marketing, and trade marketing teams.
  
  
**Position BeBetta As**
“We reach your verified buyers and increase repeat purchase behavior” - not just attribution.
  
  

* The Funding Ladder

**Move Brands Across Stages**

* BeBetta-funded → Co-funded → Fully brand-funded

Run boosted campaigns as test cases → turn results into proof → convert proof into long-term funded deals.
  
  

* Deal Structuring & Pricing

**Own Commercial Models Such As**

* Cost per verified buyer
* % of basket value
* Budget + target CPA

Design win-win deals that
**unlock brand budgets while protecting margins**
.
  
  

* The Affiliate Rail

**Set Up And Scale Partnerships With Networks Like**

* Cuelinks
* Admitad
* Impact

Enable online brands to start monetizing from day one.
  
  

* Unit Economics & Financial Ownership

**Own And Drive The Core Metrics**

* Cost per verified buyer
* Contribution margin per scan
* Brand-funded share of reward cost

Be equally strong in a
**financial model and a brand pitch**
.
  
  

* Consumer Intelligence Revenue

**Open And Build a Second Revenue Line**

* Engage insights teams & research partners
* Convert our data into paid consumer intelligence products

**You Are**

* A commercial builder (5–10+ years) across brand partnerships, shopper marketing, trade marketing, performance marketing, affiliate marketing, retail media, or CPG/D2C sales
* Deeply familiar with how brand budgets actually work (trade spend, shopper marketing, CAC)
* Analytically sharp - you can build and defend unit economics, not just sell
* Naturally ask: “What’s the cheapest test to prove this?”
* High ownership, comfortable with ambiguity, and experienced in building from scratch
* A strong closer who can operate across CMOs, founders, and data teams

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working with FMCG/CPG brand teams
* Affiliate/performance marketing exposure
* Background in consumer data / retail media / loyalty ecosystems (e.g., Nielsen, Kantar, Numerator, Fetch, CashKaro, Magicpin)
* Early-stage startup experience

**What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)**

* Key “hero brands” moved up the funding ladder
* Repeatable proof packs that convert into funded deals
* Affiliate rail live and contribution-positive
* At least one consumer intelligence pilot launched
* A trusted unit economics model used by leadership

**Why This Role**

* You’re not inheriting a revenue engine - you’re building one from scratch
* You’re helping define a new category in India
* You’ll work directly with the founder with real ownership and real impact

This role will shape what BeBetta becomes.

title: Senior Director / Director - RIM Strategy
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
In the Indian pharmaceutical industry, majority of the top 30 organizations are revising their product portfolio to include complex generics, biologicals, biosimilars etc. They are also expanding into high-value therapy areas such as oncology, cardiology, immunology which contribute significantly in saving human lives. These customers are revisiting their go-to-market strategy to expand their presence in markets beyond US such as like Europe, LATAM, Japan and so on.
  
  
These changes demand a proven unified RIM system in place which can provide a robust data model for the regulatory data, manage/track registrations, handle submissions and health-authority interactions and perform publishing activities.
  
  
The Regulatory Strategy (Sr.) Director builds strong relationships with stakeholders, guides the regulatory and IT leaders on the successful transition & adoption to new ways of working and also guides them on the ways to realise exceptional value from Veeva RIM.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and implement the strategy for Veeva RIM suite of applications, customized to meet the unique needs of the Indian market, while driving broad adoption and usage across both large and small customers in India.
* Engage proactively with customers to ensure their success with our products.
* Win customers seeking robust and unified RIM suite by understanding and clearly communicating Veeva RIM suite value through process improvement as well as business metrics such as speed-to-market, right-first-time and operational excellence.
* Collaborate closely with all internal teams—Product, Services, Solution Consulting, Sales —both locally and globally, to evolve our offerings and maximize the value they deliver to customers.
* Identify opportunities for expansion and work with marketing and sales teams to define strategies to capture these customers.
* Own the growth plans and pricing strategies for our products in India.

**Requirements**

* Around 15 year’s experience working in India or global pharma industry either directly in or as a solution provider/consultant to the life sciences industry
* Understanding of Regulatory business processes and technology in the Life Sciences industry
* CEO mentality to drive outcomes internally and externally. Stays focused on results and drives execution among the team. Able to work with autonomy and adapt to change.
* Ability to critically think and develop a strategy and execution plan across all areas of business (Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Consulting, etc...)
* Excellent spoken, written, presentation skills in English
* Has a purposeful vision about helping the pharma industry deploy innovative digital solutions to solve critical issues

****Nice to Have****

* Has worked on overseas assignments in Europe or US
* Worked with a software or systems integration company, either as an employee or part of a project
* Has worked with Veeva software
* Has worked on global teams on projects related to business or IT transformation

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

title: GTM Manager
description:
At Mstack AI, we are building the world’s first AI-native chemical company. Specialty chemistry powers every physical product on Earth, from battery electrolytes and pharma intermediates to semiconductors and sustainable coatings, yet the industry still relies on trial-and-error R&D methods that take 18+ months per molecule. We compress 18 months of R&D into a matter of days by combining quantum chemistry, generative AI, and real-world custom manufacturing. Backed by $40M from Lightspeed and Alpha Wave Global, we operate across Houston, San Francisco, Mumbai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad. We don’t just predict reactions; we deliver real-world physical production batches.

**ABOUT THE TEAM:**

You will join the team building Chemstack AI, an agentic synthesis R&D platform built on our own Chemistry World Model that reasons from first principles like an expert chemist. It designs synthesis routes, researches literature and patents, predicts reaction conditions and tests reactions virtually before they reach the lab, turning months of R&D into days, with the evidence for every step. Large companies are already trialling it on their own molecules. The team, close to leadership, brings together PhD chemists and specialists in AI, data and product. Our chemists work with the commercial team on each customer, so the science is covered. AI for chemistry is new, and this team is shaping how it is sold. We value ownership, deep curiosity and moving fast while getting the details right.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As a GTM Manager, you will be the trusted partner to the R&D teams we serve, from the first demo through contract and renewal. Our sales team opens the door; from there, the customer is yours. You will help each customer win, lead each team into a new way of working, and turn strong results into lasting partnerships. Success looks like trials that convert and accounts that expand, and your scope grows with them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* *Relationship management:*
  Build trusted relationships across each account, from a chemist to the head of R&D, and shape a joint plan for where Chemstack AI creates the most value.
* *Expectation management:*
  Define with each customer what success means for their R&D, in outcomes they can measure, and align everyone involved around it.
* *Change management:*
  Plan each team’s migration from familiar tools to working with Chemstack AI, address concerns early, and help the first users bring the rest of the team along.

***Execution:***

• Demos: Make the value of Chemstack AI clear from the first meeting and turn interest into commitment. • Onboarding: Own each customer’s start, from agreements and access to a strong kick off, so teams are live fast. • Trials: Run each trial against goals agreed upfront, and close with a proposal their leadership can act on. • Account growth: Grow each signed account into new teams, sites and users, and secure every renewal. • Market insight: Bring back why we win and lose, and shape what we build and how we price it. • Pipeline and process: Keep an accurate view of each deal and renewal, and sharpen how we work with customers.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

• Experience: 4 to 6 years in B2B account management, customer success or enterprise sales, ideally selling software to R&D teams in pharma, life sciences or chemicals.

• Commercial Expertise:

• Proven ability to build trusted relationships with decision makers and their teams in enterprise accounts. • Experience leading enterprise teams through the adoption of new software, and making the change last. • Proficiency in running pilots or trials, writing proposals, and keeping a CRM and forecast leadership can rely on. • Demonstrated track record of turning trials into contracts and growing accounts after the first sale.

• Domain Alignment: Curiosity about chemistry and how chemists work. A science background or a network in pharma or chemicals is a plus, not a requirement.

• Mindset: Owns outcomes, writes and speaks clearly, earns the trust of scientists with evidence rather than a pitch, keeps several accounts moving at once without losing detail, and is comfortable travelling to customer sites.

title: Process Excellence Manager
description:
**Manager – Process Excellence**

**Department: Process Excellence**

**Reporting To: Head – Process Excellence**

**Location: Hosur**

**Role purpose:**

Drive process improvement, standardization, productivity and operational excellence across the plant by developing robust processes, managing improvement projects, strengthening documentation and implementing digital solutions.

**Key responsibilities:**

**1. Process excellence & lean**

• Understand and apply Lean principles by adapting Lean tools, systems and practices to the company's High-Variety, Low-Volume (HVLV) manufacturing environment.

• Identify and eliminate process losses to improve productivity, flow, lead time, quality, cost and resource utilization.

• Drive Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives across the plant.

**2. SOP, work instructions & process documentation**

• Develop and standardize SOPs, Work Instructions and process flows across the complete plant value chain: Order Taking > JO Release > Production Scheduling > RM Issuance > Production > Stock Audit > QC > Packing > Dispatch.

• Define process ownership, checkpoints, documentation requirements and standard formats.

• Ensure SOPs and Work Instructions reflect the actual and improved process.

• Maintain document revision and change control.

• Prepare and maintain the SOP/WI review schedule.

**3. Documentation audit & improvement**

• Establish a mechanism to audit process documentation for completeness, accuracy, timeliness and traceability.

• Identify documentation gaps and coordinate corrective actions with process owners.

• Continuously improve, simplify and standardize documentation.

• Identify opportunities for digitalization of documentation and process records.

• Prepare and maintain the documentation audit schedule.

**4. PEx project planning & execution**

• Maintain a Process Excellence project pipeline covering ongoing, planned and future projects.

• Prioritize projects based on business impact, urgency and feasibility.

• Define project scope, milestones, timelines, owners and expected benefits.

• Track ongoing projects and ensure timely execution and closure.

• Monitor project benefits and ensure sustainability of improvements.

**5. Productivity & process improvement**

• Conduct time studies, process studies, line balancing and capacity analysis.

• Identify bottlenecks and improve manpower and machine utilization.

• Drive improvements in cycle time, throughput, yield, WIP and lead time.

• Support productivity improvement and capacity expansion initiatives.

**6. Data & performance management**

• Analyze operational data to identify improvement opportunities.

• Develop and maintain PEx dashboards and performance metrics.

• Track productivity, OEE, yield, rejection, rework, WIP, lead time and cost.

• Convert data-driven insights into improvement projects.

**7. Digitalization**

• Identify opportunities to digitize manual processes, documentation and data capture.

• Develop digital workflows, dashboards and tracking systems to improve visibility, accuracy and process control.

• Reduce manual data entry and duplicate documentation.

• Work with IT and process owners to implement and sustain digital solutions.

**8. Automation**

• Identify opportunities for process automation, semi-automation and machine/process improvements.

• Support feasibility studies, trials and implementation of automation projects.

• Evaluate automation opportunities based on productivity, quality, cost and ROI.

**9. New process / product support**

• Support NPD and new process implementation through process mapping, capacity study, manpower planning, cycle-time definition and SOP creation.

• Ensure new processes are standardized before implementation.

**Key skills:**

• Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement

• Industrial Engineering

• Process Mapping & Standardization

• Time & Motion Study

• Capacity & Productivity Analysis

• Project Management

• Root Cause Analysis

• Data Analysis

• SOP & Work Instruction Development

• Documentation Management

• Digitalization (Mandatory)

• Automation (Optional)

• Change Management (Optional)

**Key KPIs:**

• Productivity Improvement

• Cost Savings

• Cycle-Time Reduction

• Lead-Time Reduction

• Yield Improvement

• OEE Improvement

• WIP Reduction

• PEx Project Completion

• Project Benefits Realized

• SOP/WI Completion & Compliance

• Documentation Audit Score

• Documentation Improvement / Digitalization Initiatives

**Qualification & experience:**

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical / industrial / production engineering or equivalent.

• 3–8 years of experience in Process Excellence, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Excellence or Operations.

• Strong manufacturing shop-floor exposure.

• Experience in Lean, Kaizen, process improvement and project execution.

• Experience in High-Variety, Low-Volume manufacturing will be an advantage.

**Core expectation:**

The role is expected to understand the existing operating system, identify gaps, adapt Lean and Process Excellence practices to the company's HVLV environment, standardize improved processes, strengthen documentation, drive digitalization and maintain a continuous pipeline of improvement projects.

title: Senior Consultant
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a senior consultant specializing in property and casualty insurance applying 5 to 7 years of experience to analyze client needs optimize core insurance processes and guide technology enabled transformations in a hybrid work model during day shifts with no travel required while delivering measurable value for global clients and wider communities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with property and casualty insurance clients to analyze current underwriting policy administration billing and claims processes and recommend improvements that enhance operational efficiency and service quality for policyholders.
* Design detailed process flows and functional specifications for core insurance platforms that support new product launches rating changes endorsements renewals and cancellations while maintaining regulatory and compliance alignment across regions.
* Coordinate with cross functional business and technology teams to translate complex insurance requirements into clear implementable user stories and configuration guidelines for policy and claims systems.
* Drive gap analysis between existing client system capabilities and target state solutions to identify opportunities for automation straight through processing and improved data quality.
* Guide the configuration and testing of property and casualty products including coverages limits deductibles and business rules to ensure accuracy consistency and alignment with underwriting strategies.
* Perform impact assessments and root cause analysis on production defects and process issues to propose sustainable remediation plans that minimize disruption to business operations.
* Develop and execute comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance criteria for policy billing and claims journeys to validate functional correctness data integrity and integration behavior across upstream and downstream applications.
* Prepare clear client facing documentation including requirement summaries process maps and solution options to support informed decision making by business stakeholders.
* Mentor junior team members on property and casualty domain concepts policy life cycle activities claims workflows and quality standards to strengthen team capability and delivery outcomes.
* Engage with stakeholders during workshops and walkthroughs to clarify assumptions validate requirements and align expectations regarding timelines scope and measurable benefits.
* Support change management activities by preparing user guides training content and walkthrough sessions that help business users adopt new processes and systems with confidence.
* Monitor key performance indicators such as quote turnaround time policy issuance accuracy claims cycle time and premium leakage to assess solution impact and identify further optimization opportunities.
* Contribute to reusable domain assets estimation models and best practices for property and casualty implementations to accelerate future projects and support consistent delivery quality.

**Qualifications**

* Bring five to seven years of hands on experience in property and casualty insurance across underwriting policy administration billing or claims operations with a strong understanding of end to end life cycle events.
* Demonstrate practical exposure to modern insurance platforms or policy administration systems and show the ability to work with configuration driven and rules based solutions in complex environments.
* Exhibit solid analytical and problem solving skills with the capacity to interpret rating structures coverage terms endorsement rules and claims scenarios and convert them into system ready requirements.
* Show familiarity with regulatory and compliance considerations relevant to property and casualty products and explain how these influence process design documentation and control mechanisms.
* Display effective communication and stakeholder management skills with experience facilitating workshops presenting findings and negotiating priorities with business and technology teams in a hybrid work setting.
* Apply working knowledge of data analysis techniques using spreadsheets or query tools to validate policy and claims data identify anomalies and support metrics driven decision making.
* Illustrate experience in preparing and executing test cases or user acceptance scenarios for insurance processes to ensure system changes meet quality expectations before production release.
* Value collaborative and inclusive ways of working while being self driven in managing day shift activities coordinating with distributed teams and meeting delivery commitments without the need for travel.

title: Product Implementation Manager
description:
**What’s The Role**
The Product Implementation Manager (PIM) within the Capability Hub acts as the operational backbone of the Global Product Management organization, serving as a central hub for portfolio governance, compliance, implementation, and strategic portfolio support. The role supports the execution of Global Product Management priorities across lubricant portfolios, including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, and Greases, depending on business requirements and job grade.
  
  
The position focuses on data-driven portfolio management, knowledge management, compliance coordination, analytics, and digital enablement to ensure consistency, scalability, and governance across regions while driving execution against defined KPIs and SLAs. By coordinating cross-functional, cross-regional, and system-related activities, Product Implementation Managers enable Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs to focus on portfolio strategy, innovation, customer engagement, and long-term business growth.
  
  
In addition, PIMs provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to regional FPIMs and RAPMs, ensuring effective integration between global strategy and regional execution. At more senior levels, the role also provides guidance and support to the wider PIM community, drives capability development, and contributes to portfolio optimization, digital transformation, and strategic planning initiatives across the Global Product Management organization.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Portfolio Management & Product Lifecycle Support**

* Manage the deployment, maintenance, and governance of regional and global product portfolios across business systems, including full GPC data ownership.
* Support and maintain Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes, ensuring portfolio data accuracy, integrity, and governance compliance.
* Provide implementation support for product launches, portfolio changes, and withdrawal of obsolete products.
* Support a range of lubricant portfolios including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, Greases, and other assigned portfolios based on business priorities.

**Data Governance, Analytics & Portfolio Optimization**

* Ensure accurate and consistent portfolio data management across multiple systems and regions.
* Develop, maintain, and analyse KPI and SLA dashboards to support portfolio performance monitoring and decision-making.
* Drive analytics and insights to support formulation cost optimization, portfolio rationalization, and business performance improvement.
* Provide structured analysis and recommendations to support regional and global portfolio planning activities.

**Strategic Portfolio Support**

* Support Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs in developing and executing 5+ year portfolio strategies and roadmap plans.
* Provide implementation, risk, feasibility, and execution perspectives to support strategic portfolio decisions.
* Contribute to portfolio optimization initiatives through data-driven insights and business recommendations.

**Compliance, Quality & Governance**

* Coordinate and maintain compliance documentation, including SDS, product registrations, certifications, approvals, waivers, and governance records.
* Manage and maintain digital PPAP records and quality-related portfolio documentation.
* Ensure adherence to internal governance, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain central repositories for formulations, approvals, compliance records, and portfolio documentation.

**PPAP, Licensing & Project Support**

* Support and/or coordinate PPAP activities for automotive-related products, including readiness assessments, documentation, quality assurance requirements, and implementation activities.
* Own or support product licensing activities, including documentation management, approvals, renewals, and implementation support.
* Provide support for Joint Venture (JV), portfolio implementation, and special project activities where applicable.
* Coordinate with manufacturing sites, quality teams, FPIMs, RAPMs, and other stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and compliance.

**Digital Enablement & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as a key user, trainer, and subject matter resource for portfolio management and digital tools.
* Collaborate with digital and system development teams to identify and implement tool enhancements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across portfolio management processes, systems, governance practices, and workflows.
* Support capability-building and digital adoption initiatives across regional and global teams.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Execution Support**

* Provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to FPIMs, RAPMs, and regional stakeholders.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities involving Product Management, Technology, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, and Procurement teams.
* Support additive transitions, supplier escalations, and portfolio-related implementation activities in collaboration with GAAMs and other stakeholders.
* Organize governance forums, stakeholder reviews, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities to drive alignment and best-practice adoption.

**Leadership & Capability Building (Senior PIM Levels)**

* Act as a senior PIM for complex or high-value portfolios, providing guidance, coaching, and support to less experienced PIMs.
* Lead strategic initiatives focused on portfolio transformation, governance excellence, and digital enablement.
* Support long-term capability development across the PIM community.
* Influence portfolio management, governance, and implementation decisions through thought leadership, analytics, and subject matter expertise.
* Champion best practices and drive consistency across regions, functions, and portfolio teams.

**What You Bring**

* A background in physical or chemical product testing, product development, or a formal qualification in technical sciences, engineering, chemistry, mathematics, or a related discipline would be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of lubricant product specifications, formulations, manufacturing processes, and product quality requirements.
* Familiarity with blending operations, supply chain processes, and product lifecycle management concepts.
* Understanding of analytical test methods, quality procedures, and Quality Assurance standards and processes.
* Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in data handling, reporting, data governance, and performance analysis.
* Ability to handle, collate, manipulate, and interpret large volumes of data accurately and with strong attention to detail.
* Experience in developing insights and recommendations through data analysis to support operational and portfolio decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global, regional, and cross-functional teams.
* Experience working with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders, including suppliers, customers, technical teams, and business partners.

* Understand airflow management strategies including hot aisle/cold aisle containment, ventilation requirements, heat load considerations and cooling integration.
* Interface with customers and internal stakeholders to understand project requirements and develop customized solutions.
* Develop engineering documentation, design calculations, validation plans and product specifications.
* Support engineering change management and product lifecycle activities through PDM systems.

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.

* Minimum 3 years of experience in data center rack systems, server cabinets, power equipment enclosures, or related infrastructure products preferred

* switchboard requirements and power distribution equipment layouts.
* Must be proficient in SolidWorks and Product Data Management systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

description:

Data / Sharepoint Management Lead
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Knowledge Management (KM) Lead in our India Proposal Hub reporting to the Global Knowledge Management Lead based in UK. and will support in developing and maintaining a structured, searchable, and governed knowledge repository that enables teams to efficiently access proposal collateral such as standard approved content, methodologies, project experience, lessons learned, templates, and best practices. * Develop and implement the organisation's Knowledge Management strategy and governance framework.

+ Technical methodologies and execution plans
+ Proposal templates and go-bys
+ Project experience lists and profiles
+ Win profiles and case studies
+ CV databases
+ Lessons learned and best practices

Advanced MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
