title: Analyst 3 - Billing Operations & Solutions
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Message Experience Analyst independently manages complex customer-facing billing statements and communication requirements for Residential and Small to Medium Business experiences. The role translates business and regulatory needs into system requirements, performs research and end-to-end validation, resolves issues, and strengthens controls to ensure accurate, timely, compliant, and reliable billing communications. The analyst also supports cross-functional initiatives, continuous improvement, and less-experienced team members. As an experienced professional 3, this role independently manages complex requirements and operational issues, identifies opportunities to strengthen controls and processes, and develops solutions to recurring or higher-impact challenges. The role serves as a knowledgeable resource to partners and contributes to cross-functional initiatives, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Create, maintain, implement, and validate billing statement content, customer communications, and related configurations.
* Analyze complex business requirements, customer scenarios, system logic, dependencies, and implementation impacts.
* Translate business, legal, regulatory, and customer needs into clear specifications, business rules, build execution.
* Research statement content, billing data, bill codes, discount codes, configurations, and production results to determine current functionality and required changes.
* Use SQL, Excel, and other tools to reconcile data, identify trends, investigate issues, and validate system behavior.
* Perform production validation for statement approved communication changes.
* Resolve defects, partner with technology and development teams, and confirm corrections meet requirements.
* Investigate statement discrepancies, incorrect messaging, data-quality issues, and recurring exceptions; coordinate resolution and recommend sustainable improvements.
* Apply quality, compliance, and operational-control standards; identify and escalate significant risks or control gaps.
* Maintain clear documentation of requirements, business rules, decisions, approvals, and implementation outcomes.
* Develop requirements for reporting and analysis on statement quality, defects, operational performance, implementation results, and emerging issues.
* Recommend solutions based on customer impact, business value, system dependencies, timing, and available data; define and evaluate success measures.
* Coordinate and provide subject-matter guidance, and exercise independent judgment on complex matters.
* Support accurate, timely, consistent, and compliant customer billing experiences.
* Maintain regular attendance and work nights, weekends, variable schedules, or overtime as business needs require.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Progressive experience in billing statements, customer communications, business systems, application operations, business analysis, or a comparable function.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex requirements, customer scenarios, system behavior, dependencies, and implementation options independently.
* Experience developing requirements, specifications, business rules, process flows, and operational documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, proofreading, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to recommend sustainable solutions.
* Proficiency with Excel and working knowledge of SQL for research, reconciliation, trend analysis, and validation.
* Experience with customer-facing content, regulated communications, quality control, compliance, data integrity, and operational controls.
* Ability to assess system interactions and the customer, business, operational, and technical impacts of changes.
* Strong written and verbal communication and collaboration skills across business and vendor teams.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, coordinate projects or releases, exercise sound judgment, and resolve complex issues independently.

title: Proposal Manager
description:
**Title:**
Proposal Manager
  
  
**Proposal Manager**
The proposal manager is a key member of the proposals department and will be responsible for supporting the Manager of Proposals in ensuring that KBR continues to deliver the highest quality proposal documentation. The proposal manager forms part of the management team for all of our pursuits and works closely with sales (business development) and operations in ensuring we offer creative, client focused, and commercially astute proposals.
  
  
**Responsibility**
The proposal manager leads small/medium/large sized proposals and pre-qualifications and supports project directors and business development directors on major pursuits.
  
  
**Work Pattern -**
To be aligned to the Houston office timings (6:00pm to 2:00am)
  
  
The proposal manager is responsible for:
  
  

* Proposal planning and co-ordination of proposal team activities. Assisting with the definition of proposal deliverables and facilitating their completion.
* Ensuring adherence to proposals procedures and providing guidance to others involved in proposal preparation processes (from kick-off to red team reviews)
* Ensuring proposals are responsive to ‘invitation to tender’ documents
* Developing proposal budgets with business development managers and proposal leaders
* Developing, coordinating and producing win themes and strategies – differentiating us from our competitors
* Writing individual sections of proposals or, for smaller proposals, the whole proposal
* Conducting reviews of bids prior to submission
* Supporting business development / operations in developing the commercial aspects of the bid
* Coordinating with other KBR offices for inputs and bid development
* Standing in for the senior manager of proposals in his absence
* Supporting the maintenance of data/information needed for the preparation of proposals
* Preparation of expressions of interest, pre-qualifications, client presentations and support on other sales and marketing activities

**Experience**
Skills will have been typically acquired through completion of an undergraduate degree in engineering, science or similar discipline and 10 or more years of combined experience (sales, engineering, construction or operations) in the engineering and construction industry.
  
  
Good understanding of proposal principles and international EPC business.
  
  
Experience in managing and writing persuasive proposals.
  
  
Experience in the hydrocarbons market would be advantageous.
  
  
**Key Competencies**

* Leadership and management - Performs assignments with light supervision and manages others in a matrix environment (including more senior individuals)
* Organisation - high degree of planning and organising skills as well as mature judgement
* Proactive and decisive – an individual that makes things happen and is always looking at what needs to be done in the future
* Writing skills – must be able to write proposal text with persuasive and compelling arguments / justification on why KBR
* Creativity – demonstrates creativity and foresight to develop innovative solutions to differentiate KBR from our competitors
* Interpersonal skills –by their nature bids require frequent interchange of information and interaction with others. The individual must be an excellent communicator and team player.
* Editing skills - must be able to review and edit work of others
* Deadlines – works well under pressure of tight deadlines
* Flexibility –Some evening or weekend work will be required on tight bid deadlines.

title: ServiceNow Solution Consultant
description:
Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking.  Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies.  We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one.
  
  
Support INRY’s ServiceNow sales opportunities by translating customer needs into credible, outcome-focused solution proposals. The Solution Consultant partners with Go-To-Market (GTM), delivery, and technical teams across discovery, qualification, solution design, estimation, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, presentations, and demonstrations. The role also helps keep INRY’s solution offerings, demos, and reusable presales content current and market-ready.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Discovery and qualification: Gather and analyze customer requirements from discovery calls, first meetings, RFPs, and RFIs. Capture business needs, use cases, scope, assumptions, constraints, decision factors, and open questions.
* Solution development: Map customer requirements to relevant ServiceNow capabilities and INRY offerings. Work with GTM, delivery, and technical teams to validate feasibility, dependencies, solution approach, and proposed outcomes.
* Proposals, estimates, and RFX responses: Build proposal presentations, solution descriptions, estimation sheets, and pricing inputs. Draft and coordinate clear, accurate responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, confirming technical and delivery inputs and meeting submission timelines.
* Statements of Work: Develop or contribute to SOWs and related commercial documents, including scope, objectives, deliverables, assumptions, and dependencies; obtain the appropriate internal reviews.
* Customer presentations: Present proposed solutions and INRY capabilities to customers, explain the rationale and expected outcomes, respond to questions, and support customer planning and roadmap conversations.
* Demonstrations and PoCs: Prepare and deliver ServiceNow demonstrations that fit the customer use case. Maintain demo scripts and readiness for supported offerings; coordinate advanced demonstrations and proofs-of-concept with delivery or technical specialists, and contribute to PoC planning and execution.
* Solution and offering assets: Create and update customer-specific introduction and solution decks, service descriptions, offering collateral, industry or event materials, and customer success stories. Maintain reusable proposal and first-call content.
* Platform and market readiness: Stay current with ServiceNow releases, product capabilities, and relevant market needs; reflect useful changes in demos, service descriptions, and solution offerings.
* AI solution positioning: Identify relevant ServiceNow AI opportunities, including Now Assist and agentic AI; help frame customer use cases and business value, and coordinate AI demonstrations or PoCs with AI and technical specialists. Validate feasibility and make assumptions, dependencies, and included versus optional AI scope clear.
* Pod and team coordination: Support assigned GTM or sales-pod deal cadence, track actions and blockers, coordinate contributors, and keep internal stakeholders aligned on deliverables and due dates.
* SSI enablement: Share solution knowledge with colleagues and contribute to internal guidelines, training materials, case studies, and improvements to the team’s content library and presales process.

**Qualifications and skills:**

* 3–4 years of experience in ServiceNow presales, solution consulting, implementation consulting, or a closely related customer-facing role. Direct ServiceNow presales experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of the ServiceNow platform and experience positioning one or more ServiceNow products or workflows for customer needs.
* Experience contributing to proposal writing and estimation, customer presentations or demos, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Ability to understand customer requirements, structure a solution approach, and clearly communicate assumptions, scope, feasibility, and dependencies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, delivery, and technical contributors, while managing multiple deal deadlines.
* Strong written communication, presentation, organization, and customer-engagement skills.
* A consultative approach, techno-functional curiosity, and the ability to tell a clear solution story to technical and non-technical audiences.

**What We Believe In**
At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Senior Workday Integration Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**

  

As a Senior Workday Integration Consultant, you will provide technical leadership for the design, development, deployment, and optimization of enterprise Workday integrations across HCM, Financials, and Professional Services Automation (PSA). You will partner with business stakeholders, architects, and technical teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing integration solutions while driving modernization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the Workday landscape.

  

**What Will You Do:**

  

* Lead the design, development, deployment, and optimization of Workday inbound, outbound, and boomerang integrations across HCM, Financials, and PSA domains.
* Conduct integration workshops with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and design scalable integration solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
* Design and implement integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Cloud Connectors, Web Services APIs, middleware platforms, and Workday Extend capabilities.
* Manage and support Workday releases, enhancements, upgrades, and integration lifecycle activities while ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Provide advanced technical troubleshooting and resolution for complex integration, data, workflow, and platform issues.
* Lead, mentor, and guide Workday technical specialists while promoting knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with business, HR, Finance, PSA, and technology teams to ensure successful delivery of integration initiatives within scope, schedule, and quality expectations.
Manage integration roadmaps, RAID logs, status reporting, risk mitigation activities, and stakeholder communications across multiple projects and support engagements.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 8+ years of experience, including significant hands-on experience in Workday Integration development, support, and solution delivery.
* Deep expertise in Workday Integration technologies, including Workday Studio, EIB, Web Services APIs, Cloud Connectors, PECI, Report Writer, and Enterprise Interface design.
* Strong experience with Workday Business Process Framework, Configurable Security, Calculated Fields, and Workday reporting solutions.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting Workday Extend applications, workflows, integrations, and custom business solutions.
* Strong integration experience using XML, XSLT, Web Services, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware solutions such as Informatica, and enterprise integration technologies.
* Experience supporting Workday HCM, Financials, and Professional Services Automation (PSA) integrations within complex enterprise environments.
* Proven experience leading integration projects, managing stakeholders, conducting workshops, troubleshooting critical production issues, and driving successful delivery outcomes.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams.  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Knowledge and experience with Workday Orchestrate for workflow automation and integration orchestration.
* Experience designing integrations across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise application ecosystems using modern integration architectures.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices.
* Certification in Workday Integration, Workday Extend, or related Workday technical specializations preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, along with certifications in Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is highly desirable.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

description:

What happens when cutting-edge medicines meet equally innovative device technology? Patients receive treatments that can transform lives. As Technical Steward – Devices, you will be at the center of that intersection, providing technical leadership for medical devices and drug-device combination products throughout their lifecycle. From late-stage development and technology transfer to commercialization, lifecycle management, and product retirement, you will ensure that device technologies are fit for purpose, compliant, and capable of supporting reliable product delivery. Working with global suppliers, cross-functional partners, and regulatory stakeholders, you will serve as a trusted device expert, lead strategic product activities, and manage a team of specialists dedicated to advancing some of Novartis’ most important therapies.

* Serve as the device expert for high-priority brands, overseeing auto-injectors and other drug-delivery systems throughout their life-cycle.
* Assess how device technologies operate with drug products, identifying compatibility, performance, quality, and patient-use risks.
* Review supplier documentation and technical data to confirm devices perform as intended and meet health authority requirements.
* Lead technical activities from late-stage development and technology transfer through scale-up, commercialization, life-cycle maintenance, and product retirement.
* Prepare and maintain device documentation, including design history, risk management, human factors, and post-market surveillance files.
* Respond to health authority questions and provide technical input for regulatory submissions involving devices and combination products.
* Investigate device-related quality issues, evaluate proposed changes, and recommend actions that protect product quality and reliable delivery.
* Work with suppliers, development teams, manufacturing sites, quality, and regulatory partners to resolve technical challenges and transfer knowledge.
* Maintain inspection readiness by reviewing technical records and providing device expertise during audits and regulatory inspections.
* Lead and develop a team of seven to eight specialists, setting priorities and ensuring high-quality, timely delivery.

* Degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.
* At least 10 to 12 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including medical devices or drug-device combination products.
* Strong understanding of drug products, device technologies, and their compatibility within injectable drug-delivery systems.
* Demonstrated experience managing external device suppliers, contract manufacturers, and strategic partners across global markets.
* Proven stakeholder and crisis management skills, including regular engagement with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
* Experience leading and developing a team, setting priorities, managing resources, and ensuring high-quality delivery.
* Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing, Good Manufacturing Practice, quality risk management, and global device regulations and standards.
* Fluency in English, with strong communication and data analysis skills, including interpreting large datasets using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

title: Research Technician III - Agriculture
description:
**About IRRI**
The International Rice Research Institute is the world’s premier research organization dedicated to reducing poverty and hunger through rice science. Its 10-year vision is to transform global rice-based agri-food systems through research innovations, demand-driven solutions, and strategic partnerships.
  
  
IRRI applies its expertise to improve nutrition, promote sustainable production, and enhance farmers’ livelihoods without compromising the environment.
  
  
Its research-for-development approach is rooted in collaboration, forming alliances with advanced research institutes; working with governments and national agricultural research and extension systems; and partnering with the development sector while brokering innovative delivery channels through the private sector.
  
  
IRRI’s work is supported by a diverse network of funders aligned with its shared goals.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The International Rice Research Institute (IRRI), with the support of the Government of India, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare, has established the IRRI South Asia Regional Centre (ISARC) in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. ISARC serves as a regional platform for research collaboration, capacity building, training, and service provision to institutions, scientists, farmers, and other stakeholders across India, South Asia, and Africa.
  
  
Building on the promising outcomes of the Carbon Offsetting Rice Emissions (CORE) project, IRRI and Rythu Sadhikara Samstha (RySS) have extended their collaboration through a new initiative entitled “Andhra Pradesh Natural Farming and Low Emission Rice Systems (AP-NATURES)”. The AP-NATURES project aims to generate scientific evidence on greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and water management under Natural Farming (NF) and Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) systems. The project will develop an emissions database and establish emission factors to model the spatial and temporal distribution of GHG emissions and mitigation potential under NF and AWD, while also generating evidence on improved water management practices, water-use efficiency (WUE), and water productivity (WP) under Natural Farming systems. To achieve these objectives, five implementation activities will be undertaken across 18 farmers’ fields in East Godavari, Eluru, and West Godavari districts during Kharif 2026 and Rabi 2026–27.
  
  
The Research Technician will provide dedicated technical and field-level support to facilitate the implementation and timely completion of the planned project activities. The incumbent will assist in coordinating field activities, supporting data collection and monitoring, maintaining project records, and coordinating with farmers and other relevant stakeholders. The incumbent’s support will be essential for ensuring timely field implementation, accurate documentation and data collection, and successful completion of the project deliverables within the defined project period.
  
  
**This position will be based in the IRRI Hyderabad Office, India and may only be filled by permanent citizens of India.**
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Support in the planning of field demonstration and implementation of agreed plan with external stakeholders following the IRRI standardized guidelines.
* Ensure field activities adhere to approved protocols and technical guidelines based on the agreed objectives, outputs, and timelines as reflected in approved impact pathway documents.
* Assist in setting up GHG field experiments, data collection (plant, soil and water) and implementation of package of practices required for experimental field trials and demonstrations conducted in farmers’ fields.
* Support in organization of farmer training, field days, and exposure visits conducted by IRRI and partner institutions.
* Engaging smallholder and women farmers for capacity-building of climate-resilient agronomic practices.
* Support execution of field activities related to low-emission agronomic practices, GHG emissions monitoring and harvest operations.
* Assist field teams, partners, and contract workers during demonstrations, trainings, and field events.
* Maintain inventory of field supplies, seed materials, and equipment, and report when replenishment is needed.
* Maintain and calibrate basic agronomic equipment, as well as some advance equipment (in-field soil and water sensors) and perform minor operational checks and repairs when required.
* Oversee the work of field workers, contract workers and service providers during the routine collection of agronomic and environmental samples in farmers’ fields.
* Communicate with implementation partners, stakeholders and farmers on routine issues to ensure smooth continuation of time-sensitive field activities, and inform the supervisor of any issues arising.
* Support field teams in delivering technical information and recommended practices to farmers and community groups.
* Assist in collecting field data from on-farm trials and coordinating stakeholder visits to demonstration sites.
* Record and encode basic field data for reporting, monitoring, and documentation of project progress.
* Compile, encode and proofread the recorded and observed data, and organize it for analysis by the supervisor and PI.
* Maintain all data files in SharePoint/drive and share it with supervisor and PI on routine basis.
* Monitor the day-to-day progress of research trials, ensuring GHG, soil, plant and water data are collected according to established protocols.
* Perform any other relevant duties, as assigned by supervisor and project leads from time to time

**Qualifications**

* Graduate (BSc. or equivalent) with relevant work experience of 1-2 years or Intermediate with relevant work experience of 7-8 years.

**Skills Required**
**Mandatory**

* Has basic knowledge of computer operation, mainly MS Office programs such as Word and Excel and mobile/computer-based data collection.
* Has experience agricultural projects and crop cultivation.
* Has experience in data collection and recording.
* Has experience in office related work.

**Preferred**

* Has experience in rice production systems and intensive field level
* experience; effective in planning and executing the planned activities

**IRRI offers a highly extensive employee benefits package inclusive of globally-covered medical insurance, retirement plan, life and accident insurance and other allowances.**
**Join our team and be part of our story!**
Please note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
  
  
This position will remain open until filled.

* Ensure the adherence to SLAs, and key metrics according to the organization’s goals and objectives
* Coordinate with internal teams as needed to meet customer needs and requirements, while managing customer expectations.

* 4-8 years of experience in Implementation and support of Enterprise products
* Strong software background and ability to master product functionality, boil down complex requirements into coherent and viable product design and configure software solutions.
* Proven fast learner of enterprise applications, experience in implementing cloud solutions.
* Proven successful track record in large scale enterprise implementations involving integrations using API's and web services, data analysis/ data migrations,
* Experience driving technical discussions, discovery workshops with customers, mapping business requirements to product functionality, for maximum customer impact and understanding.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in the areas of requirements and solution documentation.
* Ability to manage and work across multiple projects. Experience working with remote teams across different timezones
* Strong ability to demo/train and deliver excellent customer presentations.
* Strong logical, analytical and problem-solving skills
* Open to travel on short notice to customer locations when required
* Good to have knowledge of Web Design using HTML, JavaScript
* Good understanding of MS Office, JIRA, Basecamp applications
* Ability to learn new skills and operate in a fast-paced and changing environment.
* Experience in the wellness/spa industry a plus.
* Eagerness to learn about the opportunities and challenges driving revenue in the health and wellness industry.

**Why Zenoti?**

* Be part of an innovative company that is revolutionizing the wellness and beauty industry.
* Work with a dynamic and diverse team that values collaboration, creativity, and growth.
* Opportunity to lead impactful projects and help shape the global success of Zenoti’s platform.
* Attractive compensation.

* Access to regular yoga, meditation, breathwork, and stress management sessions. We also include your family in benefit awareness initiatives.

**Job Description for HS&E**
: As part of the HS&E job family, the Band 1 role plays a crucial role in supporting and assisting the execution of strategies within our team and organization. This role is ideal for individuals who are looking to grow and persevere in a stable external business environment.
  
  
The HSE Data Systems Owner is the CF-HSE business lead for the day-to-day operation, governance, improvement and user enablement of core HSE data systems and reporting. The role connects HSE business processes, system data, analytics and user support so that leaders and sites can use reliable information for risk management, compliance oversight and decision-making.
  
  
The role requires a distinctive combination of HSE process knowledge, data and analytics capability, application management, disciplined execution and customer focus. It works closely with HSE business owners, subject-matter experts, data engineers, digital product teams, vendors and regional or site users.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* HSE Works and enterprise application ownership
* Act as the CF-HSE business focal point for HSE Works modules in scope, including incidents, near miss, KEA, FLRA/ORA, internal compliance, qualified leaders and working-hours/TIR reporting.
* Understand user needs and business processes, translate them into clear system requirements, and help determine when standard application functionality should be used instead of customization.
* Manage user feedback, issue resolution, enhancement requests, testing, training, deployment and adoption in partnership with the delivery product manager, vendors and HSE subject-matter experts.
* Maintain clear application documentation, admin instructions, access arrangements, decision history and continuity plans.
* Support selected HSE enterprise solutions and integrations assigned to the role, including HSE Help Requests and related reporting.
* Power BI reporting and analytics
* Own and maintain designated CF-HSE Power BI reports, including the live HSE report, near-miss reporting, HSE resources and other assigned dashboards.
* Protect report accuracy by managing data relationships, date logic, master-event handling, calculation logic, reporting refreshes and monthly frozen-report processes.
* Create and enhance dashboards that help leaders and sites identify risk, monitor compliance, track action-plan completion and focus intervention.
* Document report purpose, users, owners, source data, refresh frequency, change history and backup support in the CF-HSE Power BI registry.
* Provide technical troubleshooting and guidance to dashboard owners and users.
* HSE data governance and data integrity
* Maintain HSE data integrity, structure and reporting practices, including source-of-truth expectations for HSEWorks, Power BI and approved shared data locations.
* Coordinate monthly data-quality checks and follow the agreed HSE reporting RASCI and validation deadlines.
* Partner with data engineering to add, structure and validate HSE tables in approved data platforms for reporting, citizen development, machine learning and AI use cases.
* Manage or support access requests for HSE data and ensure permissions are traceable and appropriate.
* Document data flows, naming conventions, ownership, calculation rules and critical dependencies.
* SharePoint, knowledge and access administration
* Administer assigned HSE SharePoint sites and support the modern SharePoint operating model, including site setup, standard templates, naming conventions, permissions and content organization.
* Maintain HSE resources and other central HSE content so employees can find authoritative information easily.
* Coordinate distribution lists, access groups and workspace permissions for assigned solutions.
* Create practical user instructions and training for SharePoint and related HSE digital tools.
* Service, support and continuous improvement
* Manage HSE Help Requests as a significant part of the role, including triage, investigation, resolution, trend analysis, backlog control and escalation.
* Use help-request and user-feedback data to identify root causes, recurring issues and improvement priorities.
* Develop communications, release notes, office hours, job aids and training that improve user self-sufficiency and adoption.
* Establish sustainable backup coverage and knowledge transfer so critical processes are not dependent on one person.
* Governance and stakeholder leadership
* Partner with CF-HSE leadership, HSE 5.0, GBS/digital product teams, HSE data engineering, subject-matter experts, vendors and OU/site HSE leaders.
* Prepare recommendations, options and decision materials for product boards and governance reviews.
* Track product or service value, user experience and agreed performance indicators, and communicate progress and risks clearly.
* Operate with strong information stewardship, change control, documentation and business continuity discipline.

**Job Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Demonstrated experience in data analytics, digital systems, application management, business intelligence or a closely related field.
* Hands-on experience developing or sustaining Power BI reports and working with structured data sources.
* Ability to understand business processes, translate user needs into system or reporting requirements, and manage work through deployment.
* Strong problem-solving, documentation and stakeholder-management capability.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts in practical language to HSE leaders and users.
* Commitment to data integrity, information stewardship, compliance and safe business practices.

title: V&V Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  
  
We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Job Summary:**
Join
**Cubic Transportation Systems**
as a V&V Engineer, where you’ll play an important role in validating product functionality, identifying defects, and ensuring reliable, high-quality solutions for our customers.
  
  
In this role, you’ll work across manual testing, system-level validation, and Hardware-Software Integration Testing (H-SIT), collaborating closely with engineering teams to investigate issues and improve product quality. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to test planning, requirements traceability, defect management, and customer-facing test reviews.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Plan and execute tests: Develop test plans, test cases, and functional test specifications for subsystem, system, device, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate hardware and software integration: Perform H-SIT to verify that hardware and software components work together as expected.

* Manage testing activities: Track test progress, coordinate execution schedules, maintain requirements traceability, and report testing status, risks, and outcomes.

* Maintain test environments: Help configure and maintain test environments and support reliability and environmental testing activities.
* Share knowledge: Contribute to test documentation, training materials, and knowledge-sharing activities to strengthen team capabilities.

* Support team development: Contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and other team activities as needed.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in an engineering discipline, or relevant industry experience
* Two (2)+ years years of relevant experience in product testing, software QA, or a Verification & Validation (V&V) environment.
* Strong hands-on experience in manual testing and exploratory testing.
* Practical experience with Hardware-Software Integration Testing (H-SIT).
* Experience preparing, maintaining, and executing test cases and test plans.
* Good understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and software testing methodologies.
* Experience in defect reporting, tracking, and collaboration with development teams.
* Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira and TestRail.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, planning, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
* Working experience with Windows and Linux environments.

**Desirable:**

* Basic knowledge of physical devices and their testing.
* Exposure to API testing and database testing, including basic SQL queries.
* Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and test-driven development.
* Basic UNIX commands, Linux shell scripting, and Confluence.
* Knowledge of Serial and TCP/IP communication protocols.
* Experience with product reliability, performance, or environmental testing.
* Familiarity with smart/payment card technology or public key encryption.
* Experience coordinating testing activities, mentoring team members, or supporting customer-facing reviews.
* ISTQB Foundation certification is desirable.

Employee

title: SharePoint Associate Architect
description:

* You'll champion SharePoint best practices, drive process improvements, effectively manage priorities, and demonstrate strong collaboration, adaptability, and leadership aligned with the values of being Authentic, Bold, and Collaborative.

* Generous Pension Scheme – Employer contributions with options to increase your own contributions

* Flexible Working – A supportive approach to hybrid and flexible working to help you achieve a healthy work-life balance
* Learning & Development – Access to training, tools, and development opportunities to support your ongoing growth and career progression

**Qualifications**
**About you**

* You hold a degree in Information Systems or a related field (or equivalent experience), with significant IT expertise and experience as a SharePoint Architect.
* You have strong hands-on experience designing, developing, and implementing SharePoint solutions across SharePoint Online, Power Platform, APIs, and workflow automation technologies.
* You have a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale solutions throughout the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation and ongoing support.
* You possess broad technical expertise across the Microsoft technology stack, including .NET, SQL Server, Azure services, system integrations, and low-code/no-code platforms.
* You demonstrate excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to collaborate, influence, and deliver results effectively in complex global environments, independently or as part of a team.

As a forward-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
  
  
There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
  
  
Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 5,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, speaking 41 languages across 25 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support female managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

title: Senior BIM Coordinator
description:
**On-site in Hyderabad, India. Please read before applying.**

You will be the technical voice our Saudi clients hear every day. You run multi-discipline BIM coordination on live KSA infrastructure and public-realm packages, working directly with our Managing Director.

**About Invicta-Tech**

Invicta-Tech is a digital design and construction advisory firm. We deliver BIM coordination, models and documentation for Saudi projects from our team in Hyderabad, India.

**What you will own**

* The client coordination call: agenda, clash and comment review, decisions with owners and dates, minutes out the same day.
* One federated model that lines up: Revit, Civil 3D, IFC and DWG on shared coordinates, checked before every append.
* Clash cycles that close: Navisworks tests grouped and prioritised, every clash with an owner and a date.
* Client comments and RFIs logged, assigned to the right discipline lead and closed on time.
* Clean issues: every package checked against the EIR, BEP and MIDP before it goes (naming, coordinates, LOD per element, file health), with transmittals and the drawing register on ACC/BIM 360 or the client's CDE.
* A progress tracker the client trusts: what is open, who owns it, when it closes.
* Modellers who get better: our Revit and Civil 3D modellers work through your checks, and you help them fix issues at source.
* Early warning on scope: when a request goes beyond the BEP or the agreed LOD, you flag it the same day.

Design responsibility stays with the discipline leads and the designer of record. You own coordination and information quality.

**Must-have**

* 6+ years in BIM or design delivery, including 4+ years as a BIM Coordinator running clash tests and coordination meetings yourself.
* You have chaired coordination meetings with a client, PMC or consultant on GCC projects (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar or similar), on site or from an India delivery office. Attending, or preparing reports for someone else's meeting, does not count.
* Multi-discipline coordination: architecture, structure, MEP and infrastructure, not one trade.
* Strong Revit and Navisworks: you set up search sets, tolerances and clash grouping yourself.
* You can federate a Civil 3D model with Revit models and fix a coordinate mismatch at source (survey point, shared coordinates, true north).
* ISO 19650 in practice: EIR, BEP, MIDP/TIDP, LOD per element.
* ACC/BIM 360 or a similar CDE.
* Clear spoken and written English; you can hold a technical discussion with a client alone.
* B.E./B.Tech (Civil, Mechanical or Electrical) or B.Arch.

**Nice to have**

* Saudi projects, especially roads, utilities, landscape or public realm.
* Hands-on Civil 3D (corridors, surfaces, pipe networks).
* Revizto, Solibri or Dynamo.

**The setup**

* Full-time, on-site at our office in Hyderabad, India. You are based in India today; relocating to Hyderabad is fine.
* Our clients in Saudi Arabia work Sunday to Thursday; you'll align your hours with theirs, and working days are agreed at offer. Riyadh is IST minus 2:30, so the client day runs 10:30 to 19:30 IST, and coordination calls can run later.
* A competitive package, your scope in writing, and a growing modelling team under your coordination.

**How to apply**

Apply on LinkedIn with your CV. Add one page at the end of the CV with a sample you built: a clash report, comments log or coordination tracker, blank or with client data removed. On that page, add one line on the last client coordination meeting you ran and one item you closed in it. No client-confidential files.

title: GIS Analyst I
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a dependable, hands-on GIS Analyst to deliver accurate, production-ready geospatial datasets. The role is primarily focused on manual GIS compilation work which includes data capture, digitization, editing, cleaning, quality checks, and delivery, carried out per user and project requirements. You will own day-to-day GIS production tasks end to end and progressively contribute to workflow improvement and semi-automation using Python, AI assistants, and geospatial tools, as the team evolves toward cloud computing and cloud-native geospatial workflows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform GIS production work — digitization, feature capture, editing, attribution, georeferencing, projection management, clipping, mosaicking, format conversion, and map preparation — using industry-standard GIS desktop tools.
* Create, clean, and maintain vector and raster datasets; run geometry repair, topology, duplicate, gap/overlap, attribute, and completeness checks before every delivery.
* Interpret satellite and aerial imagery, basemaps, and reference layers to capture or validate buildings, land use, infrastructure, terrain, and other exposure-related features.
* Process to DEM, DSM, DTM, LiDAR, contours, and elevation-derived data for terrain and building-height analysis under project guidance.
* Manage large datasets in common formats: File Geodatabase, GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoTIFF, CSV, KML/KMZ, and GeoJSON.
* Follow SOPs, naming conventions, folder structures, metadata standards, and QC checklists; maintain traceability of source data and edits.
* Support semi-automation of repetitive steps using ModelBuilder, QGIS Processing Modeler, Python, ArcPy, GDAL, or related libraries.
* Leverage AI assistants such as Claude, where appropriate, to assist with coding, debugging, and developing GIS solutions, while reviewing and validating all AI-assisted output before use.
* Document methods, assumptions, data limitations, validation results, and reusable workflows clearly and professionally.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in GIS, Geoinformatics, Geography, Remote Sensing, Geomatics, Civil/Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands-on GIS or remote-sensing experience; strong practical capability may also be considered.
* Proficiency in ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, or equivalent tools for spatial analysis, digitization, cartography, and quality control.
* Strong understanding of coordinate systems, raster/vector data, geoprocessing, geodatabases, topology validation, and data cleaning.
* Working knowledge of remote-sensing imagery, elevation data, and LiDAR products, with the ability to manage large geospatial datasets accurately.
* Basic-to-intermediate Python for GIS, familiarity with ArcPy or open-source geospatial libraries, and basic SQL skills.
* Ability to troubleshoot and modify existing scripts and automate repetitive GIS workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted scripting and prompt engineering, including validation of AI-generated code and results.

title: ServiceNow Solution Consultant
description:
Support INRY’s ServiceNow sales opportunities by translating customer needs into credible, outcome-focused solution proposals. The Solution Consultant partners with Go-To-Market (GTM), delivery, and technical teams across discovery, qualification, solution design, estimation, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, presentations, and demonstrations. The role also helps keep INRY’s solution offerings, demos, and reusable presales content current and market-ready.

**What you will do:**

* Discovery and qualification: Gather and analyze customer requirements from discovery calls, first meetings, RFPs, and RFIs. Capture business needs, use cases, scope, assumptions, constraints, decision factors, and open questions.
* Solution development: Map customer requirements to relevant ServiceNow capabilities and INRY offerings. Work with GTM, delivery, and technical teams to validate feasibility, dependencies, solution approach, and proposed outcomes.
* Proposals, estimates, and RFX responses: Build proposal presentations, solution descriptions, estimation sheets, and pricing inputs. Draft and coordinate clear, accurate responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, confirming technical and delivery inputs and meeting submission timelines.
* Statements of Work: Develop or contribute to SOWs and related commercial documents, including scope, objectives, deliverables, assumptions, and dependencies; obtain the appropriate internal reviews.
* Customer presentations: Present proposed solutions and INRY capabilities to customers, explain the rationale and expected outcomes, respond to questions, and support customer planning and roadmap conversations.
* Demonstrations and PoCs: Prepare and deliver ServiceNow demonstrations that fit the customer use case. Maintain demo scripts and readiness for supported offerings; coordinate advanced demonstrations and proofs-of-concept with delivery or technical specialists, and contribute to PoC planning and execution.
* Solution and offering assets: Create and update customer-specific introduction and solution decks, service descriptions, offering collateral, industry or event materials, and customer success stories. Maintain reusable proposal and first-call content.
* Platform and market readiness: Stay current with ServiceNow releases, product capabilities, and relevant market needs; reflect useful changes in demos, service descriptions, and solution offerings.
* AI solution positioning: Identify relevant ServiceNow AI opportunities, including Now Assist and agentic AI; help frame customer use cases and business value, and coordinate AI demonstrations or PoCs with AI and technical specialists. Validate feasibility and make assumptions, dependencies, and included versus optional AI scope clear.
* Pod and team coordination: Support assigned GTM or sales-pod deal cadence, track actions and blockers, coordinate contributors, and keep internal stakeholders aligned on deliverables and due dates.
* SSI enablement: Share solution knowledge with colleagues and contribute to internal guidelines, training materials, case studies, and improvements to the team’s content library and presales process.

**Qualifications and skills:**

* 3–4 years of experience in ServiceNow presales, solution consulting, implementation consulting, or a closely related customer-facing role. Direct ServiceNow presales experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of the ServiceNow platform and experience positioning one or more ServiceNow products or workflows for customer needs.
* Experience contributing to proposal writing and estimation, customer presentations or demos, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Ability to understand customer requirements, structure a solution approach, and clearly communicate assumptions, scope, feasibility, and dependencies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, delivery, and technical contributors, while managing multiple deal deadlines.
* Strong written communication, presentation, organization, and customer-engagement skills.
* A consultative approach, techno-functional curiosity, and the ability to tell a clear solution story to technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Senior Workplace Engineer, Employee Technology Services
description:
**Job Description**
Thomson Reuters is looking for a Senior Workplace Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft 365, enterprise AI productivity tools, and automation. You'll work hands-on where M365, Copilot, identity, endpoint management, and AI-enabled support meet.
  
  
In this role, you'll provide third-line support and engineering for our internal Microsoft 365 and AI productivity tools. You'll be the senior escalation point for complex M365 and Copilot issues and own each incident from investigation through to a permanent fix. You'll also spot recurring support patterns and turn them into automation, self-service tools, and engineered solutions. The goal is less repetitive work, faster resolution, more reliable services, and a better experience for employees.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the senior escalation point for Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and the wider M365 admin tools.
* Handle support, configuration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management for Microsoft Copilot and other internal AI tools.
* Diagnose and fix identity, licensing, policy, and integration issues across M365 and AI services.
* Resolve complex escalations that span multiple services, working independently at the third-line level.
* Give technical guidance to L1 and L2 support teams.
* Find the root cause of recurring incidents and drive them to a permanent fix instead of handing them off.
* Keep knowledge articles, runbooks, and support documentation up to date so L1 and L2 can solve more on their own.
* Build automation with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, and similar tools to remove repetitive work and keep configurations consistent.
* Design and deliver AI-enabled support and self-service tools that reduce ticket volume and speed up resolution.
* Turn recurring incident patterns into permanent engineered fixes.
* Work across endpoint management, including Intune-managed devices and modern management, wherever it overlaps with M365 and AI tools.
* Partner with endpoint and identity teams to resolve issues that cross team boundaries.
* Support the adoption, governance, and reliability of AI productivity tools.
* Turn technical capabilities into measurable results for employees.
* Explain technical fixes clearly to non-technical users.
* Decide sensibly whether an issue needs a quick fix or a permanent engineering solution.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of IT support and engineering experience, mainly in End User Computing in a modern enterprise environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least 3 years of hands-on Microsoft 365 experience, including configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and third-line support across the core services.
* Proven hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot or similar enterprise AI productivity tools.
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), or equivalent proven M365 expertise.
* Automation and scripting experience with PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.
* Working knowledge of endpoint management (Intune and modern management) and enterprise identity (Entra ID).
* A track record of resolving complex escalations independently and turning recurring problems into automated or engineered solutions.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* A customer-service mindset focused on the employee experience.
* Strong ownership and the ability to see issues through to closure without escalating them.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Copilot or other AI-related certifications.
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (Entra ID).
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), or equivalent Intune expertise.
* Experience delivering AI-enabled self-service and automation in an enterprise workplace.
* Experience working across M365, endpoint, and identity services.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
  
  
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.
  
  
Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.
  
  
More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

title: System Analyst
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
******About Futureforce University Recruiting******
Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.
  
  
**Job Category**
Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure
  
  
**Job Details**
******About Salesforce******
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword. It's a way of life. We're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce's own business running. We operate Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau, the data and analytics foundation for how Salesforce sells, serves, and makes decisions. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams.
  
  

* Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do.
* Make it stable. Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings.
* Run it well. Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent.
* Make it easy to get help. One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents.
* Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering.

**What it's like to join at this level:**
You'll be a trusted operator on a team that is rebuilding how it works. You already know how to run production; here you'll take the hardest recurring problems, own them to root cause, and turn what you learn into runbooks, monitors, and automation the whole team uses. You'll manage escalations and support processes with guidance from senior leads, and you'll help the analysts around you get better.
  
  
**Who thrives here:**
You're curious, you want to know why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You can explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people, and you leave every system a little better documented and a little more automated than you found it.
  
  
What Are We Looking For?
  
  
As a Senior Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you'll independently own production support and administration for Salesforce's enterprise data and analytics platforms, with a strong grasp of native platform functionality and best practices. You'll help the team respond faster and resolve issues sooner, and you'll keep an eye on how satisfied our customers and partners are. You'll manage escalations across teams and time zones, act as a frontline responder who swarms incidents and knows when to pull in reliability engineers, own root-cause analysis through to resolution, and design monitoring that gives early warning. You'll shape lightweight support processes and reference material, and mentor analysts. You are an individual contributor and a go-to expert for your platform area.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Escalation Management & Incident Response
  
  

* Own escalations on cases, intake, and investigations across teams and time zones: set priority, route to the right engineering, SRE, or vendor owner, drive them to closure, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Run follow-the-sun handoffs so escalations keep moving between Mexico City, Dublin, and Hyderabad without losing context.
* Track escalation trends (volume, repeat causes, time to engage, time to resolve), and bring them to leads and platform engineering to drive fixes.
* Be the escalation point for Tier-2 analysts on complex cases and investigations.
* Be a frontline responder in incidents: connect first, assess impact, and use judgment on when to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs). Manage the case, intake, and stakeholder communication workstream alongside Incident Command. SREs own incident resolution.
* Meet individual and team lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART), and case satisfaction (CSAT) targets while keeping backlog health. You are measured against the same targets as the team.
* Help L7 refine the intake and investigation lifecycle SLAs: mentor Systems Analysts on hitting them, and raise challenges where targets, routing, or processes make them hard to meet.
* Spot patterns in SLA misses and satisfaction feedback, and bring recommended fixes to the L7 and the team.

Problem Management & RCA Ownership
  
  

* Own root-cause analysis and resolution for application bugs and recurring failures, and close RCAs with verified fixes.
* Troubleshoot complex declarative and low-code issues, and recommend code-level fixes to engineering partners.
* Prioritize technical debt against the backlog to improve stability, and recommend fixes.

Reliability & Observability
  
  

* Design and implement proactive monitors, alerts, and automations for platform health.
* Contribute to design reviews and operating-model improvements (for example Operational Readiness practices).
* Use automation and AI to reduce manual work and move the team toward self-healing operations.

Platform Administration & Enhancement
  
  

* Deliver complex declarative solutions (Flows, validation rules, permission models) and manage enhancement projects from inception through support transition.
* Own complex access and role-hierarchy design, bulk data loads and migrations, and sandbox management.
* Reliably handle standard administration so the team can focus on higher-value work.

Process Engineering, SOPs & Support Reference Manuals
  
  

* Own process engineering for your platform area: templates, process design, capture, and lifecycle (create, review, update, retire) of lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs). This is process design, not technical writing.
* Request SRM inputs from Platform Engineering and create or manage them as needed, so support teams have the reference material they need before launch.
* Keep SOPs and SRMs current and findable, and use them to reduce repeat escalations.
* Write knowledge articles and business process maps that let Tier-1/Tier-2 teams resolve issues without escalation.
* Act as SME and point of contact for development and product partners.

Security, SOX & Compliance
  
  

* Maintain compliance with security policies and change controls.
* Support technology compliance activities, audit reporting, and SOX controls, and help close findings.
* Follow the SDLC (Agile) and change, deployment, incident, and problem management processes.

Collaboration & Growth
  
  

* Partner effectively with vendors, engineers, and business teams across time zones.
* Mentor Systems Analysts and new joiners, and share knowledge through documentation and team forums.
* Try new tools and practices, and bring ideas that improve how the team works.

Flexibility
  
  

* On-call and travel as required, subject to local regulations. Other related duties as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, business, or equivalent experience.
* 0-3 years of hands-on platform or systems support, administration, or implementation experience in an enterprise IT environment.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce native functionality and best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage escalations across teams and time zones, respond as a frontline responder in incidents (including knowing when to pull in reliability engineers), and own RCAs through resolution.
* Experience with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules), data loading, and troubleshooting complex data and configuration issues.
* Working knowledge of Service Management practices (incident, problem, change) and the SDLC.
* Ability to design lightweight processes, SOPs, and reference manuals that others can run.
* Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently in a distributed, global team.
* Certifications (achieved): Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201), Advanced Administrator (ADM-211), and Platform App Builder. Platform Developer I achieved or actively pursuing.

**Preferred**

* Certifications: Data 360, Tableau, or other specialist or consultant certifications.
* Hands-on experience with Data 360, Agentforce, CRM Analytics, or Tableau.
* Experience building monitors, alerts, or automation (observability tooling, Flow, scripting).
* Intermediate coding (Apex, Python, SQL).
* Experience in SOX-controlled environments.
* Experience mentoring or informally leading peers.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources help you find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future, but to redefine what's possible, for yourself, for AI, and the world.

description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility.
