By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Role Summary
  
  
The L2 SAN & Storage Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day operations, provisioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of enterprise shared storage devices, fabric networks, and backup technologies. This role provides Level 2 escalation support to ensure the demanding up-time, responsiveness, and performance of production storage and backup environments. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with Dell PowerMax, Dell Unity, and Data Domain, combined with deep knowledge of iSCSI protocols, VMware host environments, and solid ITSM practices.
  
  
Technical & Process Profile Summary
  
  
Storage Technologies: Dell PowerMax, Dell Unity (File & Block)
  
  
Backup Technologies: Dell Data Domain, Veeam, Oracle RMAN
  
  
Protocols & Networking: iSCSI, Fibre Channel (FC)
  
  
Host & Virtualization: VMware vSphere (ESXi), Windows Server, RHEL/OEL
  
  
Monitoring Tools: SolarWinds, Splunk (Log analysis & dashboard tracking)
  
  
Ticketing & Operations: JIRA (Incident, Change, Service Requests), ITSM Framework
  
  
Shift Timings: 24x7 Operations (Rotational Shifts)
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Storage Administration: Perform day-to-day provisioning and allocation of storage, including creating Storage Groups, Aggregates, Volumes, LUNs (Thin/Thick), and managing Storage Virtual Machines (SVM) across Dell PowerMax and Dell Unity platforms.
  
  
Host Connectivity & Virtualization: Configure, map, and troubleshoot host-side storage connectivity within a highly virtualized VMware ESXi environment, including cluster configurations, multi-pathing (PSP/NMP), and datastore management.
  
  
Protocol Management: Implement, manage, and troubleshoot storage connectivity using iSCSI (software/hardware initiators, network binding, CHAP authentication) and Fibre Channel fabric protocols.
  
  
Enterprise Monitoring: Proactively monitor storage array health, replication status, and fabric alerts using SolarWinds. Leverage Splunk to track alerts, analyze system logs, and review dashboards to investigate storage performance anomalies.
  
  
ITSM & Queue Management: Own the operational queue within JIRA, acting as the L2 technical owner for Incident Management, Service Requests, and Problem Management. Ensure all operational activities strictly follow organizational ITSM frameworks.
  
  
Backup & Recovery Operations: Administer and monitor enterprise backups utilizing Dell Data Domain and Veeam. Triage backup failures for business-critical volumes and databases (SQL/Oracle via RMAN).
  
  
Lifecycle & Maintenance: Coordinate with hardware vendors (e.g., Dell) for physical component replacements (disks, controllers, SFPs) and assist L3/Architecture teams with storage microcode/firmware upgrades and data migrations.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent practical combination of education and experience.
  
  
Experience: 5-7 years of dedicated experience in enterprise SAN/NAS storage and backup infrastructure support.
  
  
Storage Expertise: Proven hands-on administration experience with Dell PowerMax and Dell Unity storage arrays.
  
  
Network & Protocols: Direct hands-on experience configuring iSCSI storage networks alongside traditional Fibre Channel switching.
  
  
Virtualization Exposure: Operational knowledge of VMware vSphere environments, focusing on how ESXi hosts interact with shared enterprise storage.
  
  
Tools & Processes: Practical experience tracking work via JIRA and a strong foundational understanding of ITSM methodologies (Incident, Change, and Problem workflows).
  
  
Monitoring Skills: Experience using SolarWinds for infrastructure health monitoring and Splunk for analyzing technical logs.
  
  
Collaborate with client, network, server, database, and application teams to resolve storage and connectivity issues.
  
  
Participate in change management, patching, upgrades, and maintenance windows.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Estimated Pay Range:

title: Technical and programmtic SEO
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Technical & Programmatic SEO Executive to build and scale our organic search presence through programmatic SEO, technical optimization, structured data, and AI-ready content. You will work closely with our data and development teams to create scalable, high-quality, location-specific pages, improve search engine indexation, and enhance Snaphomz’s visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences.

**Job description**

**Role & responsibilities**  
**1. Programmatic SEO (pSEO) Architecture:**

* Excel in: Building scalable URL hierarchies and page templates that can generate 10,000+ neighborhood-specific pages without creating "thin content" or "duplicate content" penalties**.**
* The Mission: You must map "Head Terms" (e.g., *Homes for Sale*) with "Modifiers" (e.g., *Zoned for Duplex in Ocean Park*) to capture users at the exact moment of high-intent research.

**2. Advanced Schema & "AI-Readiness"**

* Excel in: Implementing complex JSON-LD Schema (Place, RealEstateListing, FAQ, LocalBusiness) so that SnapHomz becomes the "Trusted Source" for Googles AI Overviews and LLMs.
* The Mission: Ensure our data is so structured that AI agents can cite SnapHomz as the primary source for municipal intelligence.

**3. Data-to-Content Orchestration**

* Excel in: Bridging the gap between raw data (CSV/JSON) and editorial-grade content. You will oversee the logic that tells an AI writer how to describe a neighborhood's "Zoning Yield" or "Tsunami Risk" in a way that feels human and authoritative.
* The Mission: Turn dry municipal stats into the "Tudum-style" narratives that buyers love.

**4. Crawl Budget & Index Management**

* **Excel in:** Managing the "Crawl Budget" for a multi-million URL site. You must ensure Google prioritizes our high-value LocalWiki pages and listing pages while ignoring low-value filters or sorted lists.
* **Mission:** Maintain a 95%+ indexation rate for all "Money Pages."

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities**

* Audit & Iterate: Perform weekly technical audits using tools like Screaming Frog and Sitebulb to find and fix "leaks" in site authority.
* Collaboration: Work daily with the India Data Team to prioritize which data pillars (Zoning vs. Schools) should be extracted next based on search demand.
* Developer Liaison: Write clear technical requirements (PRDs) for the dev team to implement Server-Driven UI (SDUI) changes or site-speed optimizations.
* Internal Linking: Design the automated "Linking Matrix" that connects the LocalWiki pages to live property listings, passing authority back and forth.

**About Snaphomz**

Snaphomz is an AI-first real estate technology company transforming the U.S. real estate market through innovative AI-driven solutions. Our platform helps buyers, sellers, and real estate professionals make informed decisions by simplifying property discovery, evaluation, and transactions through data, technology, and AI.

title: Implementation Manager - Associate
description:
**Job Description**
Bring your expertise to a client-facing implementation role where you will drive seamless onboarding, strengthen controls, and grow your career through regional mobility and cross-functional partnership.
  
  
As an Associate in Client Onboarding and Services, you will manage end-to-end client onboarding and technical implementation for trade solutions across the Asia Pacific region. You will translate business and product requirements into practical onboarding plans, connectivity setups, and controlled go-live outcomes. You will coordinate across Sales, Product, Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and Client Service to deliver a transparent, well-governed client experience.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end onboarding and implementation for trade products and digital connectivity solutions across the Asia Pacific region.
* Own the primary client-facing implementation relationship from solution finalization through testing, go-live, and handover to ongoing support teams.
* Facilitate discovery sessions and implementation workshops to confirm requirements, scope, operating model, connectivity approach, and delivery milestones.
* Build and maintain implementation plans that define deliverables, dependencies, timelines, owners, risks, and escalation paths.
* Orchestrate multiple concurrent implementations by applying disciplined governance, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment.
* Monitor progress, surface delays or control concerns early, and escalate issues promptly with clear mitigation options.
* Communicate concise, regular updates to clients and internal stakeholders, including senior leaders, with transparent status and next steps.
* Architect connectivity solutions using host-to-host connectivity, application programming interfaces, secure file transfer, SWIFT messaging, and front-end trade platforms, aligned to the approved operating model.
* Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications and align across client technology teams and internal partners.
* Coordinate documentation, account and product setup, entitlements, testing, defect resolution, and production-readiness activities through to completion.
* Improve onboarding outcomes by contributing to process simplification, automation, data analytics, and reusable templates that enhance quality and turnaround times.

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**

* Hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualification.
* Demonstrate 6+ years of relevant experience in transaction banking, trade, client onboarding, technical implementation, project management, or financial-services delivery.
* Apply practical experience implementing trade finance products, digital banking channels, or transaction banking solutions.
* Understand trade products and associated onboarding, documentation, and operational requirements.
* Use technical familiarity with one or more of the following: host-to-host connectivity, application programming interfaces, secure file transfer protocols, SWIFT connectivity and messaging, XML or structured file formats, digital trade or transaction banking portals, and user entitlement/channel-access models.
* Perform effectively in a client-facing implementation, onboarding, project delivery, or service-delivery role.
* Manage milestones, dependencies, risks, controls, and escalations across parallel deliverables and stakeholders.
* Translate client requirements into clear functional or technical implementation requirements and execution-ready plans.
* Solve problems analytically with close attention to detail across documentation, connectivity, testing, and readiness activities.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders in both written and verbal formats.
* Collaborate independently and within a regional, cross-functional, matrix organization while maintaining strong client focus and personal accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**

* Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.
* Create reusable implementation materials, checklists, templates, and best practices to support consistent regional execution.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that simplify onboarding steps, reduce manual activity, and improve turnaround times.
* Share product, technical, and market knowledge across the regional team to strengthen delivery consistency and client outcomes.

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

**Department / Role Overview: Continuous Improvement and Learning and Development**

This role is based in Mumbai, India. The program is designed to lead measurable improvements across service operations and build the capability of leaders and teams to sustain them. Partnering with business owners to standardize processes, solve complex problems, improve performance and embed consistent ways of working across locations. Strengthen connections within and across departments and locations through trusted relationships, collaboration and alignment with key stakeholders.

This is a senior individual contributor role that leads to cross-functional initiatives and coaches others. Business leaders retain accountability for daily operations, staffing, service delivery and process ownership.

**Job Description (Primary Responsibilities)**

* Partner with leaders to identify business problems, establish baselines and prioritize an improvement portfolio aligned with operational goals.
* Lead complex initiatives using Lean Six Sigma and structured problem solving, from diagnosis and pilot through implementation, benefit validation and sustained control.
* Map end-to-end processes using SIPOC and process maps; clarify handoffs, decision rights and RACI responsibilities across functions and locations.
* Coach process owners to establish standard work, current procedures, meaningful KPIs, daily and weekly reviews, and process confirmation routines before pursuing optimization.
* Analyze cycle time, defects, rework, workload and service performance to identify root causes and recommend practical improvements.
* Build project charters and implementation plans; manage milestones, dependencies and risks, and communicate decisions needed from sponsors.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities with Technology and Analytics partners; define business requirements, support testing and measure operational impact.
* Facilitate workshops, coach improvement champions and partner with L&D to translate process changes into training and adoption plans.
* Validate benefits with business owners and Finance where applicable; distinguish realized savings, cost avoidance, capacity released and service improvements.
* Partner across global operations in Latin America, India and the U.S. to align improvement priorities, share best practices and apply consistent CI standards while adapting to local operating needs.

**Desired Skills / Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, business, operations or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* **Experience:**
  At least five years of relevant experience in operations or process improvement, including independent delivery of cross-functional improvements in service or shared-services environments.
* Demonstrated application of Lean Six Sigma or equivalent methods, with examples of measurable results sustained after implementation.
* Experience developing KPIs, analyzing operational data and converting findings into business decisions. Advanced Excel and practical dashboard experience are required.
* Ability to facilitate workshops, coach leaders, manage change and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong written and spoken English, including concise executive updates and effective collaboration across cultures and time zones.
* Ability to build trusted relationships, align competing stakeholder priorities, facilitate workshops, coach leaders and influence without direct authority.
* **Technical:**
  Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification; Black Belt certification or equivalent complex-project experience is an advantage.
* Experience in a global capability center, business process management organization, financial services or property-related service operations.
* Practical SQL and Power BI or equivalent visualization skills; experience defining requirements for workflow automation, low-code tools or AI-enabled process improvements.
* Experience with Salesforce, SharePoint or comparable workflow and knowledge platforms; familiarity with Agile delivery and user acceptance testing.
* **Analytical:**
  Demonstrates analytical rigor, critical thinking, and attention to detail with a consistent and reliable output. Top-ranked performer with a track record of success (academic, professional).
* **Communication:**
  Strong verbal and written skills to communicate effectively with internal professionals and U.S.-based stakeholders across teams.
* **Work Style:**
  Self-starter who learns quickly, manages multiple deadlines with accuracy as the primary standard, and moves comfortably between teams.

**Success Measures and Alignment with Amherst**

title: Sustainability Specialist
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
**Sustainability Specialist**
**Interested in a career that matters?**
Want to make sustainability part of engineering decisions from the very beginning?
  
  
In this role, you will help embed energy, carbon, water, waste and ESG targets into the design basis of a greenfield plant and ensure they are tracked through to handover. Working within Engineering Management, you will collaborate across engineering disciplines and with design contractors, HSE, permitting, utilities and operations to translate sustainability ambitions into practical engineering decisions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
You will drive sustainability and ESG integration across the project, making sustainability a design criterion rather than an end-of-project compliance exercise.
  
  
The role combines technical sustainability expertise with engineering coordination and governance. You will help integrate sustainability targets into the design basis and User Requirement Specifications (URS), monitor performance, and bring sustainability considerations into design reviews and engineering decisions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Embed sustainability and ESG requirements into engineering design, integrating relevant targets into the design basis and URS.
* Drive energy and carbon management, identifying opportunities to minimize operational energy use, emissions and embodied carbon.
* Lead water and wastewater stewardship, optimizing consumption and reuse while considering discharge-quality requirements.
* Promote materials efficiency, waste reduction and circularity, including low-carbon material choices and reduction of construction waste.
* Support environmental compliance and governance, including permits, Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), ESG reporting and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Track and communicate sustainability performance through monthly KPI reporting to the Engineering Management team alongside cost and schedule.

**What you’ll need to be successful in this role**

* A degree in environmental, chemical, energy or process engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in sustainability or environmental engineering within capital projects.
* Practical knowledge of energy and carbon modelling, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), and water-balance methods.
* Familiarity with Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), environmental permitting and ESG reporting frameworks, including the GHG Protocol and CSRD.
* Ability to translate sustainability targets into practical engineering requirements and decisions.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to represent sustainability requirements in multidisciplinary design reviews.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**
It would be an advantage if you bring:
  
  

* Experience supporting sustainability within greenfield industrial or manufacturing projects.
* Exposure to sustainability requirements across project design, construction and handover.
* Experience working across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* An interest in circularity, resource efficiency and integrating sustainability considerations into engineering design.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work in a multidisciplinary engineering environment where sustainability is integrated into project design and decision-making.
  
  
You will collaborate with stakeholders across engineering, design contractors, HSE, permitting, utilities and operations, giving you the opportunity to contribute to sustainability considerations throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
**Working conditions**
**Job Location – Novonesis Plant,**
Patalganga MIDC (Near Panvel, Navi Mumbai)
  
  
**Transport -**
Available from Kharghar Station and Panvel Station.
  
  
**Work:**
- 5 days from office
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Datt Mediproducts Pvt. Ltd. (DMP), established in 1995, is part of a diversified conglomerate with business interests in India and overseas. The company began as a 100% Export Oriented Unit producing textile-based medical disposables and has grown into a trusted manufacturer and marketer of high-quality products that meet international standards. With an ultra-modern manufacturing facility in India, state-of-the-art machinery, and a dedicated team, DMP focuses on delivering next-generation healing solutions globally. The company has a strong customer base across India and multiple international markets, including South Africa, the UAE, the UK, the USA, and several other countries, offering team members exposure to global healthcare markets.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Executive role is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. The Sales Executive will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities, managing existing customer relationships, and promoting DMP’s medical products to healthcare institutions, distributors, and other partners. Daily tasks include conducting sales visits, presenting product features and benefits, negotiating pricing and contracts, and following up on leads to achieve sales targets. The role also involves monitoring market trends, gathering customer feedback, collaborating with internal teams on order processing and delivery, and preparing regular sales reports and forecasts. The Sales Executive will represent the company at meetings, conferences, and industry events as needed, ensuring a professional, customer-focused approach at all times.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong sales and business development skills, including lead generation, client relationship management, and negotiation abilities.
* Knowledge of healthcare or medical devices/products, with the ability to understand technical features and communicate value to customers.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with proficiency in spoken and written English; additional regional languages are an advantage.
* Solid organizational and time management skills, including the ability to manage a sales pipeline and meet targets within deadlines.
* Comfort with basic digital tools such as CRM systems, MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), and email communication.
* Ability to work on-site in Mumbai, travel for client meetings as required, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Prior experience in sales, preferably in medical, pharmaceutical, or healthcare-related sectors.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field is preferred.

title: Sales Executive
description:
# JOB DESCRIPTION – INSIDE SALES ENGINEER

\*\*Company:\*\* Synergie Controls & Systems Pvt. Ltd.

\*\*Location:\*\* Taloja, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

\*\*Department:\*\* Sales & Business Development

\*\*Position:\*\* Inside Sales Engineer

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Work Mode:\*\* Hybrid – Taloja Office + Work from Home as per company policy

\*\*Reporting To:\*\* Sales Manager / Head – Business Development

## 1. Job Purpose

The Inside Sales Engineer will be responsible for \*\*generating and qualifying sales enquiries, customer follow-up, preparing and coordinating quotations, maintaining the sales pipeline, and converting enquiries into orders\*\*.

The candidate will work closely with the \*\*Sales, Estimation, Engineering, Purchase, Stores and Project teams\*\* to ensure timely response to customers and effective closure of business opportunities.

The role is particularly focused on Synergie's \*\*Industrial Automation, Siemens products, PLC/HMI/SCADA, Drives, Control Panels, MCC/PCC Panels, automation projects and services\*\*.

## 2. Key Responsibilities

### A. Lead Generation & Customer Development

- Generate new leads through:

- Cold calling

- Email campaigns

- LinkedIn

- Existing customer references

- Online enquiries

- Industrial databases

- Customer mapping

- Identify potential customers in:

- Steel and metals

- Manufacturing industries

- OEMs

- EPC contractors

- System integrators

- Panel builders

- Pharma

- Food & Beverage

- Packaging

- Water treatment

- Cement, glass, rubber, sugar and other industries

- Develop and maintain a database of prospective customers.

- Identify decision-makers such as Purchase, Electrical, Automation, Maintenance, Projects and Plant Heads.

### B. Enquiry Management

- Receive and understand customer enquiries.

- Review technical requirements, BOQ, BOM, specifications and drawings.

- Clarify missing information with customers.

- Register every enquiry in the CRM/system.

- Categorize enquiries based on product, project value, customer and probability.

- Ensure no enquiry or customer follow-up is missed.

### C. Quotation & Pre-Sales Support

Coordinate with the estimation and engineering teams for preparation of:

- Siemens PLC quotations

- HMI and SCADA solutions

- VFD / AC & DC Drive quotations

- PLC/Automation Panels

- MCC/PCC/LT Panels

- Control Desks

- DCS / PCS7 solutions

- Retrofit and migration projects

- Automation modification and upgradation

- AMC and service requirements

Support preparation of \*\*BOQ/BOM, technical offers and techno-commercial quotations\*\*.

### D. Customer Follow-Up

- Follow up systematically on all submitted quotations.

- Understand the customer's feedback, competition and expected order date.

- Record quotation status in CRM.

- Follow up for:

- Technical approval

- Commercial negotiation

- Purchase order

- Payment

- Dispatch

- Maintain a daily follow-up schedule.

- Escalate high-value or critical opportunities to the Sales Manager.

### E. Sales Conversion

- Work towards converting enquiries into orders.

- Understand why an enquiry is lost and record the reason.

- Track:

- Enquiry value

- Quotation value

- Expected order value

- Probability

- Expected order date

- Competitor

- Gross margin

- Support negotiation with customers within approved company limits.

- Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional products.

### F. CRM & Sales Reporting

Maintain accurate and updated information in \*\*Zoho CRM / company sales systems\*\*.

Daily update should include:

- New enquiries

- Calls made

- Customer discussions

- Quotations submitted

- Follow-ups completed

- Orders received

- Lost enquiries

- Next action and follow-up date

Prepare regular:

- Daily sales activity report

- Weekly enquiry report

- Sales pipeline report

- Quotation follow-up report

- Order conversion report

- Lost enquiry analysis

### G. Customer Relationship Management

- Maintain professional communication with customers.

- Develop long-term relationships with existing customers.

- Regularly contact inactive/old customers.

- Identify new requirements from existing customers.

- Generate opportunities for:

- Retrofit

- PLC migration

- Drive replacement

- Panel modification

- Automation upgradation

- Service

- AMC

- Spares

- New projects

### H. Coordination with Internal Teams

Coordinate closely with:

\*\*Sales → Estimation → Engineering → Purchase → Production → Testing → Projects → Accounts\*\*

Ensure proper communication of customer requirements and commercial commitments.

## 3. Technical Knowledge Required

Candidate should have basic understanding of:

- Siemens PLC – S7-1200 / S7-1500

- HMI

- SCADA / WinCC

- AC Drives / VFD

- DC Drives

- MCC / PCC / LT Panels

- PLC Automation Panels

- Control Panels

- Electrical components

- Motors and basic electrical systems

- Industrial automation

- Basic electrical drawings and BOQ/BOM

Knowledge of \*\*Siemens automation products\*\* will be strongly preferred.

## 4. Qualification

\*\*Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech\*\* in:

- Electrical Engineering

- Electronics Engineering

- Electronics & Telecommunication

- Instrumentation Engineering

- Automation Engineering

MBA/PG Diploma in Sales & Marketing will be an advantage.

## 5. Experience

\*\*Experience:\*\* 1–5 years preferred.

Candidates with experience in:

- Industrial Automation

- Electrical products

- Control Panels

- Siemens products

- Industrial B2B sales

- Technical sales

- Inside sales

- Electrical/automation distribution

will be preferred.

Freshers with strong communication skills and technical knowledge may also be considered for a trainee/entry-level position.

## 6. Required Skills

### Technical Skills

- Basic knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA and Drives

- Understanding of electrical panels and automation products

- Ability to understand BOQ/BOM

- Basic technical proposal understanding

### Sales Skills

- Lead generation

- Cold calling

- Customer follow-up

- Enquiry handling

- Quotation follow-up

- Negotiation

- Order conversion

- Customer relationship management

### Software Skills

- MS Excel

- MS Word

- PowerPoint

- CRM software – preferably Zoho CRM

- Email communication

- Basic knowledge of ERP systems will be an advantage

### Behavioural Skills

- Good spoken and written English

- Good communication skills

- Positive attitude

- Strong follow-up discipline

- Target-oriented approach

- Ability to work independently

- Good coordination skills

- Professional customer handling

- Willingness to learn

## 7. Hybrid Work Model

This position will follow a \*\*hybrid working model\*\*.

The employee may work from home for defined inside-sales activities such as:

- Customer calling

- Email follow-up

- CRM updating

- Lead generation

- Quotation follow-up

- Sales reporting

However, the employee must attend the \*\*Taloja office whenever required\*\* for:

- Sales meetings

- Internal coordination

- Product/technical training

- Quotation discussions

- Customer meetings

- Sales reviews

- Team meetings

- Important project discussions

\*\*Work-from-home is subject to performance, discipline, availability and management approval.\*\*

## 8. Key Performance Indicators – KPIs

The employee will be evaluated on:

| KPI | Measurement |

|---|---|

| New Leads | Number of qualified leads generated |

| Customer Calls | Daily/weekly activity |

| Enquiries | Qualified enquiries generated |

| Quotations | Number and value of quotations |

| Follow-Up | % of quotations followed on time |

| Conversion | Enquiry-to-order conversion % |

| Sales | Monthly / annual order value |

| New Customers | Number of new active customers |

| CRM Discipline | 100% enquiry and follow-up updating |

| Lost Enquiries | Proper reason and analysis |

| Collection Support | Coordination for payment follow-up |

## 9. Sales Target Responsibility

The Inside Sales Engineer will be given \*\*monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets\*\*.

The employee is expected to build a healthy sales pipeline rather than only depend on enquiries received from existing customers.

Performance will be evaluated based on:

\*\*Lead Generation → Qualified Enquiry → Quotation → Follow-Up → Conversion → Order Value → Gross Margin\*\*

## 10. Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a candidate who is:

- Technically inclined

- Comfortable speaking with customers

- Strong in follow-up

- Target-oriented

- Comfortable with telephone-based sales

- Good in Excel and CRM

- Interested in industrial automation

- Willing to learn Siemens products

- Capable of working independently in a hybrid environment

- Focused on converting enquiries into business

## 11. Compensation & Incentives

Salary will be based on \*\*experience, technical knowledge and sales capability\*\*.

Performance-based incentives may be provided based on company sales and incentive policy.

## 12. Career Growth

A successful candidate can grow into:

\*\*Inside Sales Engineer → Senior Inside Sales Engineer → Technical Sales Engineer → Sales Manager → Business Development Manager\*\*

## 13. Important Requirement

\*\*This is not a simple telecalling position.\*\*

The candidate must be capable of understanding the customer's \*\*technical requirement, coordinating with the engineering/estimation team, following up commercially and contributing to actual order conversion.\*\*

title: Territory Manager- Mumbai
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About Lilly**
*At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.*
*We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.*
*Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.*
*We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.*
*If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.*
**About Commercial At Lilly, India**
*The medicines Lilly develops only reach patients if the commercial engine behind them works with precision.*
*At Lilly in India, the commercial function builds and powers that engine, designing the capabilities, generating the intelligence, and developing the strategies that Lilly’s customer-facing teams around the world depend on to connect medicines to the people who need them.*
*The work here is not local in scope.*
*It shapes how Lilly operates commercially across geographies, business units, and markets globally.*
**Job Description**
**Broad Objective of the Role:**
Enhancing the customer experience by identifying the critical need and delivering optimal pharmaceutical based healthcare solutions to achieve business objectives.
  
  
Analyzing market trends and developing a sales plan; Meeting and engaging designated doctors in the assigned territory, promoting company products to customers; strengthening relationships with stakeholders like doctors, paramedics, retailers and stockists in order to achieve individual and pool sales targets using patient focused selling principles while adhering to Lilly compliance guidelines.
  
  
**Key Customers:**
Doctors, paramedical & hospital staff, retailers and stockists.
  
  
**Minimum Qualification:**
Graduation in any field (preferably Science) with minimum one year of sales work experience.
  
  
**Key Competencies:**
Good communication and presentation skills, basic knowledge of therapeutic area and product segment, Emotional Intelligence, Organizational Skills, Learning agility.
  
  
**Area of Responsibility & Key Activities**
**Sales and Territory Planning**
Develop a detailed territory business plan for the portfolio by making strategic decisions about goals, resource investments, and monitor and measure the plan.
  
  

* Based on Retail Call Audit and market analysis, refresh and update MCL from the universal list provided by sales operations.
* Prepare a retail call list for important retailers.
* Prepare a patch plan as per customer availability and schedule.
* Prioritize business opportunities.
* Plan for achieving targets set by the company.
* Track and analyze weekly sales data in order to identify trends and make required modifications to the plan.
* Performance Metrics: Approval of plan by supervisor; Quality of analysis.

**Conducting Customer Calls**

* Meet the required number of customers as per SPP targets and call plan.
* Meet retailers as per SPP target and plan in order to gather information about product trends and competitor data.
* Meet compliance requirements on calls.
* Conduct effective pre-call planning by setting objectives tailored to customer segment, needs, attitudes, motivations, environment and business priorities, then prepare potential solutions.
* Conduct post-call analysis and record next call objective in approved CRM tool.
* Use relevant sales materials to address customer questions, objections, and concerns.
* Promote company products to customers as per the Patient Focused Selling Principles and by using aids provided by Marketing.
* Strengthen relationships with all stakeholders.
* Performance Metrics: SPP target v/s achievement; Adherence to compliance requirements; Sales target v/s achievement.

**Customer, Paramedic Staff and Retailer Engagement**

* Finalize doctors engagement plan for a Quarter.
* Conduct programs as per plan and steer all related logistics and coordination.
* Plan, develop, and implement effective communication (e.g. presentations) in a variety of settings.
* Identify speakers and audience for conducting programs, work with various departments to ensure timely documentation and certification of the speaker.
* Invite doctors for Marketing led programs.
* Conduct Retailer Awareness Programs.
* Conduct Nurses awareness programs to upgrade the knowledge of paramedic staff.
* Conduct programs as per compliance guidelines.
* Performance Metrics: Informal/formal feedback from stakeholders on quality of programs; Adherence to compliance requirements; Program attendance as per target.

**Stockist Management**

* Engage with stockists regularly to strengthen relationship.
* Gather information to analyze sales trends every week.
* Conduct physical stock verification at the Stockist.
* Maintain a balance between first line and second line sales as per the company guidelines.
* Participate in ensuring availability at various retailers like placing and collecting orders.
* Coordinate between Stockist and CFA at the time of closing.
* Identify new stockists and propose to ASM.
* Performance Metrics: Inventory plan v/s achievement.

**Sales and SPP Reporting**

The
**Senior Client Partner**

The role blends new business growth and account expansion, campaign strategy, and cross-functional leadership to deliver measurable results.

— expanding the long tail, driving new activations, and increasing active clients — rather than purely farming an existing book

* Hunt and win new business across SMB and mid-market advertisers, driving new activations and expanding the long tail of active clients.
* Build and execute account growth strategies that create win/win outcomes for X and advertisers.
* Develop and present consultative sales narratives showing how X advertising solutions connect brands with audiences and deliver outcomes.
* Maintain a strong pipeline, forecast accuracy, and disciplined account planning to achieve targets.

**Client & Agency Partnership**

* Establish and nurture senior relationships with advertisers and agency stakeholders; act as a trusted advisor.
* Lead strategic QBRs, planning sessions, and joint business plans; align on objectives, audience, creative approach, and measurement.
* Identify client business challenges and translate them into clear media strategies and platform solutions.
* Operate a client-centric model with full agency ownership — no closed verticals — and the freedom to pursue any vertical or client base.

**Market Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Stay current on X product updates and the broader digital media landscape; translate market changes into client opportunities.
* Collaborate with internal partners (measurement, creative, ops, product, client solutions) to deliver a strong client experience and resolve issues quickly.

* 5+ years in digital media, platform, or ad-tech sales with a track record of exceeding quota and growing a book of business.

* Background from a social media platform, OTT/streaming, or programmatic/publisher environment is strongly preferred (e.g. social platforms, streaming players, DSP/SSP and publisher partners).
* Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills; able to influence senior stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem (formats, measurement, targeting, brand vs. performance objectives).
* Comfortable with data: ability to translate performance signals into insights and clear client recommendations.
* Experience selling across both brand and performance objectives (and ideally video ad solutions).
* Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-change environments; strong collaboration and problem-solving.

**What we offer :-**

* Work with X, a marquee global social platform — standout experience that few in the market can claim, and a strong differentiator for your career.
* An open, uncontested market — X owns the territory here, so how you approach, acquire, and grow clients is genuinely up to you.
* Real ownership — own your book end to end, with full agency ownership and a client-centric (not verticalized) model.
* Territory that scales with you — your remit grows with your caliber, exposure, and the business you can demonstrably manage.
* Autonomy and work-life balance — the freedom to own how you work, backed by a supportive, collaborative team.

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. , the
**Windows and Device Sales (WDS)**
organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve real business outcomes with Microsoft technology.
  
  
WDS plays a critical role in shaping and delivering the endpoint platform that powers modern, secure, and AI‑enabled work. WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners - to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.
  
  
This role contributes to a
**multi‑billion‑dollar business**
and plays a direct role in
**defending and expanding Windows as the enterprise endpoint platform**
, enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.
  
  
As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders - anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders - to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.
  
  
In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. You will articulate differentiated Windows value across security, resiliency, management, and AI workloads; orchestrate partners and internal teams to deliver proof and outcomes; and convert lighthouse wins into repeatable evidence that scales across industries and partners.
  
  
This opportunity will allow you to deepen executive‑level consultative skills, build technical and platform credibility across the Windows ecosystem, and play a visible role in protecting and expanding Microsoft’s commercial footprint in priority accounts.
  
  
#WDS
  
  
[

]
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead Windows endpoint strategy with senior executives: Leverage you technical expertise to lead strategic Windows discussions with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and AI leaders, translating technology capabilities into business value.
* Defend and extend Windows in competitive environments, deepen insights on why customers adopt alternative platforms, articulate fact based & differentiated platform value to protect the Windows socket.
* Modernize endpoint management and identity architectures, helping customers decouple from legacy environments, improve total cost of ownership, and unlock AI‑driven workflows at scale.
* Lead high‑impact customer engagements across discovery, envisioning, proof, and value realization, with clear entry criteria, success measures, and exit plans.
* Deliver lighthouse wins that demonstrate real Windows AI value, converting customer outcomes into evidence such as case studies, reference architectures, and repeatable industry scenarios.
* Orchestrate across internal teams and partners, working closely with account teams, engineering, and OEM/channel partners to ensure clarity of roles, clear hand-offs, escalation process, and accelerated outcomes.
* Provide structured feedback and insights from customer engagements to inform product, go‑to‑market, and partner strategy, identifying patterns that can scale across similar customers.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications (RQs)**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field AND 8+ years of customer‑facing experience in enterprise technology, consultative selling, Specialist, solution architecture, or transformation‑focused roles OR
* Equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated capability and experience in leading technical and executive‑level customer conversations, translating complex platform concepts into clear, outcome‑oriented guidance for CIO, CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders.
* Prior background in technical sales, solutions architecture, GBB or platform Specialist roles, where credibility across both business outcomes and technical depth was required.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Security and compliance technologies, including Microsoft Defender, Entra, Purview, identity and access management, and Zero Trust principles, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value and risk reduction outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

* Strong Windows platform expertise, including Windows Pro and Windows 11 Enterprise, with the ability to articulate differentiated value across security, manageability, performance, and AI for enterprise and commercial customers.
* Experience advising customers on Windows 11 lifecycle strategy, including hardware refresh planning, security posture improvements, and operational readiness.
* Proven experience of modern endpoint management and workplace transformation strategies with expertise in Microsoft Intune, Configuration Manager and cloud-native management. Able to advise senior leaders on device management modernization, security, operational efficiency and AI readiness, guiding customers through strategic platform decisions and transformation roadmaps.
* Strong understanding of AI-ready Windows devices, including Copilot+ PCs, NPUs and specialized AI silicon. Able to translate platform and hardware innovation into measurable business outcomes, productivity gains and competitive advantage for customers evaluating next-generation endpoint strategies.

title: Senior Trade Advisor – Food & Drinks
description:
**Main purpose of job:**

The UK Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade, operating through the British High Commission network in India, is looking to fill a vacancy within the trade team at the British Deputy High Commission Mumbai. The Department works to drive economic growth by supporting UK businesses to trade internationally, attract investment and strengthen the UK’s global trading relationships.

This is an exciting time to join the UK Government’s trade team in India. The UK-India Free Trade Agreement (FTA) marks a significant new chapter in this relationship, creating further opportunities for UK businesses to access and grow in one of the world’s most dynamic markets. Against this backdrop, the job holder will play an important role in supporting UK Food & Drink companies to identify, develop and secure commercial opportunities in India, with a particular focus on helping businesses take advantage of opportunities created by the FTA.

**Food & Drink Trade**

Food & Drink is the UK’s largest manufacturing sector and an important part of the UK-India trading relationship. India’s growing consumer market, changing consumption patterns and the opportunities created through the FTA provide significant potential for UK companies.

**The role will broadly work across three pillars: Commercial Opportunities, Market Development and Market Access.**

The job holder will develop an in-depth understanding of the UK and India Food & Drink sectors and use this knowledge to identify opportunities and build a strong pipeline for UK businesses. They will work directly with UK companies, particularly SMEs, supporting them to understand the India market, identify potential partners, navigate routes to market and progress commercial opportunities.

The job holder will build relationships across the India Food & Drink industry, including with importers, distributors, retailers, buyers, trade associations and other key stakeholders. They will work closely with colleagues across the Department in India and the UK to support UK companies in entering and expanding within the India market and contribute towards wider UK Government commercial and trade objectives.

The role will also support the Senior Sector Manager with sector strategy, market intelligence, stakeholder engagement, reporting and wider delivery of Food & Drink priorities across India.

*We reserve the right to review, revise or amend the roles and responsibilities from time to time reflecting the changing needs of business.*

**Roles and responsibilities / what will the jobholder be expected to achieve:**

**Commercial Opportunities and UK Business Support (25%)**

* Identify, develop and maintain a strong pipeline of commercial opportunities for UK Food & Drink companies in India.
* Promote the opportunities arising from the UK-India FTA to UK Food & Drink businesses and stakeholders.
* Provide practical market-entry support to UK exporters, including SMEs, helping them understand the India market, identify potential partners and navigate routes to market.
* Proactively engage UK companies with strong potential for India and support them in progressing opportunities towards commercial outcomes.
* Work with importers, distributors, retailers, hospitality groups and other buyers to identify demand for UK products.
* Record and report export successes, commercial outcomes and progress against agreed trade targets.

**UK-India FTA Opportunities (10%)**

* Support businesses in understanding relevant FTA benefits and connect them to appropriate government expertise where specialist advice is required.
* Gather business intelligence and feedback on how the FTA is affecting UK companies operating in or seeking to enter India.

**Market Development (10%)**

* Develop strong knowledge of India's Food & Drink market, including consumer trends, distribution channels, emerging opportunities and competitive dynamics.
* Build and maintain relationships with key buyers, importers, distributors, retailers, trade associations and industry stakeholders.
* Identify new opportunities through market research, stakeholder engagement and commercial intelligence.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of the UK Government’s Food & Drink sector strategy for India.

**Trade Promotion and Events (30%)**

* Develop and deliver commercially focused activities including trade missions, buyer-seller engagements, webinars, roundtables, retail promotions and sector events.
* Support Ministerial, senior official and VIP visits involving Food & Drink and wider trade priorities.
* Develop programmes and secure high-quality business participation for visits and events.
* Ensure activities have clearly defined commercial objectives and effective follow-up to maximise business outcomes.

**Market Access (10%)**

* Identify market-access issues affecting UK Food & Drink exporters through engagement with businesses and industry stakeholders.
* Work with relevant UK Government colleagues and sector specialists to help address barriers affecting UK businesses.
* Monitor regulatory and market developments and communicate relevant changes and opportunities to colleagues and businesses.

**Stakeholder Management and Collaboration (10%)**

* Build effective relationships across the British High Commission network, UK Government, India Government, industry associations and the private sector.
* Work collaboratively with colleagues across India and the UK to deliver Food & Drink priorities.
* Represent the British Deputy High Commission and the Department professionally at external meetings, events and industry engagements.

**British Deputy High Commission Mumbai activities (5%)**

* The candidate will be expected to support major diplomatic events with securing sponsorships and participation from businesses.
* The candidate will also be supporting cross-cutting activities to support the working of the diplomatic mission (i.e. the corporate/post contribution).

**Last day to apply for the role is 22 Nov'2026 by 12 PM IST.**

title: Account Manager — Custom Software Development
description:
**Location: Lower Parel, Mumbai (work from office, full-time)**

**Experience: 4–6 years (minimum 4) managing custom software development accounts**

**Reports to: Director of Sales**

Salary:
**₹10 - 15 LPA**
fixed + monthly performance incentives

Hours: Day shift. Evening hours are mandatory on some days to overlap with US clients.

**About Arcitech.ai**

Arcitech.ai is an AI-native business automation company. We design, build and manage custom production software for enterprises across the US, UAE and India, in manufacturing, mining, pharma, education, hospitality and contact centres. We also build AI products including ProSchool.ai, Haire.ai and BPObox. Most of our client relationships are long-term development and managed-services engagements, so account management is central to how we grow.

**The Role**

You'll own a portfolio of custom software development accounts end to end. You'll understand what each client needs, translate it into clear requirements for our development team, and make sure it's delivered on time and to the client's satisfaction.

On your accounts, you act as the product owner. You lead the discovery calls, own the requirements through the full development lifecycle, and keep the client and the engineering team aligned at every stage.

**What You'll Do**

* Discovery & requirements: Run discovery calls with clients to understand their business, workflows and goals. Turn these into clear, prioritised requirements for the development team.
* Product ownership: Own the requirements on your accounts from kickoff to go-live and beyond. This includes clarifying scope, prioritising the backlog, managing change requests, and reviewing deliveries against what the client asked for.
* Delivery coordination: Work daily with PMs, developers, testers and tech leads so that what's built matches what's needed, and lands when it was promised.
* Client reporting: Send weekly and monthly progress reports to every client, on time, in clear business language.
* Issue handling: Acknowledge client issues immediately and log them in Zoho Desk. Update clients daily on open items and escalate early when anything stalls.
* Proposals & SOWs: Turn client requirements into estimates, proposals and SOWs the same day, using our standard templates. You'll validate scope and resourcing with tech leads.
* Account growth: Identify new phases, change requests and renewals inside your accounts, and bring in our sales team.
* New account onboarding: Take over newly won accounts, confirm all project documents and contacts are in place, and start the reporting cycle.
* Process improvement: Improve templates, workflows and response times, including through AI tools.

**What You Need**

* 4–6 years in account management, product ownership, business analysis, project management or delivery management on custom software development engagements. This should be at an IT services or software development company.
* Hands-on experience running discovery or requirement-gathering sessions with clients and writing requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, scope documents.
* A proven track record of managing several client accounts at once through the full lifecycle: discovery, requirements, sprints, QA, UAT, deployment and support.
* Solid understanding of how custom software is scoped and delivered: scope, change requests, resourcing, timelines and dependencies.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You'll work directly with US and UAE clients.
* Strong attention to detail with documents, numbers and structured templates.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho Desk/Projects, Jira, Hubstaff or similar tools, and comfort using AI assistants daily.
* You close loops without being chased and escalate early.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience preparing proposals, estimates or SOWs for software projects.
* Experience on retainer or managed-services accounts.
* Exposure to AI, automation, ERP integration or cloud projects.
* This role is not for you if: your experience is mainly in product SaaS or marketing agencies rather than custom development, or you can't commit to evening hours on some days.

Hiring Process

* Screening call
* AI interview on Haire.ai
* Practical assessment and interview with the Director of Sales and a senior PM or tech lead
* Final round with the CEO

Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of:

https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewAsMember=true

Are you passionate about managing and nurturing relationships with key clients/customers of a business? If your response is a resounding yes, then we are hunting for you.

As a Key Account Manager at SmartQ, your primary goal will be to ensure client satisfaction, retention, and growth of the business. Fostering, sustainable, and profitable relationships with key clients to maximize business opportunities lies at the heart of this role. In addition, a combination of interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of the clients and products will keep you functioning a cut above the rest.

If you are a dynamic, results-oriented manager with a proven track record in steering MNCs toward unprecedented success, we invite you to seize this opportunity to make a profound impact on our global presence. Do you possess all these skills and wish to make an impact in the world of food and technology? Join us now!

**Role:**

• Lead the company's dynamic food service sales efforts, developing and maintaining relationships with food service institutions at all levels.

• Manage an individual expense account within budget guidelines.

• Maintain ongoing relationships with customers, driving conversations to inform them about new product developments.

• Develop quotes and proposals. Attend client meetings, food committee meetings, and other related events.

• Maintain effective, professional relationships with customers, vendors, and fellow employees.

• Administer unit operations in accordance with SmartQ standards, handling contract specifications and statutory regulations.

• Oversee the overall management of the unit, ensuring quality food services and effective partner management.

• Monitor and ensure food services meet agreed standards and specifications.

• Ensure the efficient utilization of resources, including utilities, people, and technology.

• Analyze and assist on-site/off-site partners in effective management.

• Communicate regularly with clients to stay updated on operational activities and developments.

• Complete action plans following client satisfaction surveys and audits.

• Ensure all products are correctly priced in line with client agreements and specifications.

• Complete manpower scheduling within budget, adjusting labor schedules in line with sales.

• Ensure site adherence to safety standards as per SLA.

**Qualifications:**

• Experience in the food industry required.

• Strong work ethic, integrity, and personal accountability to be a self-starter and make independent decisions.

• Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines.

• Flexible and willing to take on various tasks to support team efforts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong interpersonal skills.

• Sound knowledge and experience working with food, technology, and leveraging people.

• Results-oriented, accountable, and able to hold others accountable.

• Proven experience in managing successful teams in a similar environment.

• Basic Food Hygiene certificate and knowledge of HSEQ standards.

• Excellent financial and application acumen.

• Self-motivated, agile, and able to adapt to a changing environment.

• Overall 6+ years of experience, with a minimum of 3 years in a similar role.

• Graduate/Diploma in Hotel Management or a related discipline.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

title: Manager, Talent Business Partner – Mumbai
description:
**Purpose. Performance. People.**
Joining CPP Investments means joining one of the world’s most admired and respected institutional investors to drive a single mandate: to deliver strong, sustainable returns for generations of Canadians.
  
  
With a long-term horizon and global reach, we deploy capital at scale across public and private markets. Our size, stability, and disciplined investment philosophy allow us to pursue complex opportunities and build enduring partnerships worldwide.
  
  
For our people, this means meaningful work with tangible impact, real opportunity, and collaboration with exceptional colleagues who value partnership and performance. Here, you’ll contribute to outcomes that matter alongside team members committed to excellence and shared success.
  
  
**The Role**
The Manager, Talent Business Partner is part of the Talent Business Partner team within Talent Advisory & Development Department. Based in CPP Investments' Mumbai office and reporting to a Managing Director, Talent Business Partner, the role serves as a strategic advisor to business leaders and colleagues across Mumbai and the broader APAC region.
  
  
The Manager will provide advisory support and coaching across Talent priorities, organizational effectiveness, leadership development, workforce planning, employee experience and talent management.
  
  
This role will be required to work closely with Department Talent Business Partners and Talent Centers of Excellence to deliver integrated talent solutions while supporting the continuous development, implementation and improvement of core Talent solutions and deliverables in line with the organization’s strategic objectives.
  
  
The position operates within CPP Investments' hybrid working model, with four days per week in the office, and may require occasional travel based on business needs.
  
  
**The Team**
**Accountabilities**

* Build strong partnerships with business and people leaders, providing trusted advice and coaching on talent, leadership, organizational and people matters aligned with business priorities.
* Lead the delivery of enterprise Talent processes across the portfolio, including performance management, talent reviews, succession planning, potential identification and development planning.
* Support organizational effectiveness and change initiatives by advising on organizational structures, role clarity, workforce and capability needs, talent deployment and change implications.
* Partner with Talent Centres of Excellence and geographically dispersed stakeholders to implement and drive adoption of enterprise Talent programs and practices across Mumbai and APAC.
* Leverage workforce data, employee insights and business context to identify talent risks, trends and opportunities, translating insights into practical recommendations for leaders.
* Support employee engagement, culture and colleague experience priorities, using employee listening and feedback to identify themes and partner with leaders on appropriate actions.
* Support complex employee matters and local Talent governance, partnering with Employee Relations and other specialist teams to manage risk and ensure appropriate application of enterprise practices and relevant local requirements.
* Contribute to Group, Department and APAC Talent initiatives and continuously identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve operational effectiveness and leverage technology to enhance Talent delivery.

**What You Bring**

* 8+ years of relevant Human Resources experience, including experience in an HR/Talent Business Partner or talent advisory role; experience within financial services or another complex global organization is preferred.
* Undergraduate degree required; a degree or professional qualification in Human Resources would be an asset.
* Ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities and drive work through to completion in a fast-paced, global and matrixed organization.
* Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated ability to work effectively across geographically dispersed teams, Talent Business Partners and Centres of Excellence.
* Experience in leading HR cyclical practices, including performance management, succession planning, workforce planning, and change management.
* Strong business acumen and analytical capability, with experience using data and insights to identify issues and translate them into practical recommendations.
* Knowledge of India employment practices and relevant local regulatory and governance requirements.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and leading HR Information Systems (Workday etc.). Hands on Experience on GenAI tools (ChatGPT, CoPilot, Claude etc.) is considered an asset.

You are motivated to contribute to something larger than yourself, approach complex challenges with rigor, and hold yourself to high standards in a collaborative, performance-driven environment.
  
  
We provide colleagues with cutting-edge AI tools, dedicated learning time, and practical support to help them deliver with greater impact.
  
  
**Inclusion & Accessibility**
CPP Investments is committed to equitable access to employment and building a workforce that reflects diverse talent and perspectives. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.
  
  
**Attention: Protect Yourself from Fraud**
CPP Investments is committed to a secure and transparent recruitment process. We will never ask candidates for payment or financial information at any stage of hiring. All legitimate opportunities are posted on our careers page, and communications will come from our applicant tracking system, Workday.
  
  
CPP Investments may use AI tools to help screen and assess applicants by analyzing resumes and applications for relevant skills and experience. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision-making.

title: Manager - Human Resources (Performance & Rewards)
description:
**About Shalina Healthcare:**

We are one of the largest, privately owned pharmaceutical businesses across Africa (Global Head Quarters- Dubai, UAE) with recent forays across multiple, new lines of businesses, viz., Digital Healthcare, Diagnostics, Consumer Healthcare, etc.

Over the last 40 years, operating across multiple geographies, we have made it our mission to provide quality medicines to those who need it the most. We manufacture and distribute branded prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceutical and consumer products, across a broad range of therapeutic groups, including anti-malarial, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory, respiratory, gastrointestinal, nutrition, oral care, dermatology, sexual well-being, and antiseptic liquids & soaps. Leading brands, great teams and a focus on influencing the well-being of people have made Shalina a household name in Africa.

We have a track record few can match, and our brands are among the most trusted in Africa. We are proud of our history and have big ambitions for the future. Our vision for 2030 is to be the health champion of Sub-Saharan Africa. To achieve this, we are looking for the right people to join us and create a lasting impact not just within our company but on the communities that we serve; people who identify with our Core Values and are as passionate about our Mission as we are.

Visit https://www.linkedin.com/company/shalina-healthcare to learn more about us.

*What you become a part of:*

This role is the execution engine behind Shalina’s performance, rewards and people analytics agenda. Working directly with the Head – Performance & Rewards, the incumbent will run the annual performance management cycle end-to-end, execute the annual reward cycle and sales incentive schemes, build the monthly people dashboards that leadership uses to steer the business, and drive special projects that shape how Shalina measures and rewards performance.

It is a hands-on, deadline-driven role. The person will be close to the data, comfortable in the detail, and able to hold a global process to timeline across multiple geographies and Organizational Units (OUs). Design direction is set with the Head – Performance & Rewards; this role makes it happen, accurately and on time.

*What to expect:*

**Performance Management:**

* Run the annual performance management cycle end-to-end across all OUs – goal setting, mid-year review, year-end appraisal, calibration and moderation – to published timelines.
* Administer the cycle on the HR system and drive completion through structured follow-up with OU HR and line managers.
* Prepare calibration and moderation packs – rating distributions, cross-OU comparisons, outlier analysis - so that leadership can decide from clean data.
* Track cycle progress, publish completion scorecards, and escalate slippage early.
* Refresh goal-setting templates, rating guidelines each cycle in line with business priorities.
* Land the process with users: manager briefings, FAQs, toolkits and helpdesk support through the cycle.

**Rewards & Compensation:**

* Execute the annual salary review and bonus cycle: build and issue templates, manage budget allocation and control, model scenarios, validate manager inputs, prepare approval packs and generate letters.
* Administer short-term incentive schemes – eligibility, computation, validation and payout, coordinated with Finance and Payroll.
* Own sales incentive schemes for field forces across geographies: model scheme options and payout curves, run monthly/quarterly computation, validate against sales data, publish achievement and payout reports, and resolve queries and disputes.
* Build offer, retention and out-of-cycle pay proposals with cost modelling, and test them against policy and internal parity.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policy across all performance and compensation activities.

**Analytics and Reporting:**

* Build and publish the monthly people dashboard – headcount, manpower cost, movement, attrition, span and layers, vacancy and cycle progress – accurate and on time, every month.
* Maintain productivity and organization structure analytics: org charts, manpower productivity ratios by channel and country.
* Support the Annual Operating Plan: manpower budgeting and phasing, salary cost projection, increment and incentive provisioning, and variance tracking against plan through the year.
* Build ad-hoc analyses and scenario models to answer leadership questions – cost of a policy change, impact of a structural change, drivers of attrition and cost.
* Convert analysis into a point of view: every recurring report ends in observations and recommendations, not just numbers.
* Own the integrity of the people data behind these outputs: reconcile with OU HR, Finance and Payroll, and fix root causes rather than symptoms.

**Special Projects:**

* Lead or support discrete projects on the performance and rewards agenda – for example incentive scheme redesign, policy harmonisation across geographies, or a productivity review.
* Run projects hands-on: scoping, plan, stakeholder mapping, data gathering, options with costed recommendations, implementation and post-implementation review.
* Assist in preparing leadership and board-level pre-reads on performance and reward matters.

*Essential qualifications, experience and skills:*

* Postgraduate degree or diploma in Human Resources or Management (MBA / MHRM), or a related analytical discipline.
* 5+ years of experience in HR, of which at least 3 years in performance management or/and compensation. Pharma, FMCG or another field-force-heavy business is an advantage.
* Demonstrated hands-on ownership of full annual performance cycle(s) and a full annual reward cycle(s).
* Strong analytical skills with experience in HR analytics, data visualization, and reporting.
* Working knowledge of a core HRMS (SuccessFactors, Darwinbox, Workday, Oracle HCM or similar), specifically the performance and compensation modules.
* Ability to translate data into a clear recommendation, and to defend it with senior stakeholders.
* Meticulous attention to detail – reward and payout numbers must be right the first time.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to present complex numbers simply to non-technical and senior audiences.
* High personal ownership and follow-through; able to run multiple parallel workstreams to hard deadlines without being chased.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, including across geographies and time zones.
* High integrity and discretion in handling confidential compensation and performance data.
