title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery

You will act as:
  
  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities

Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
  
  
**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

Lastly, what we are not looking for
**,**
we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

title: Associate, Growth Strategy & Marketing (B2B)
description:
**Work Location: Andheri East, Mumbai**

**Work Schedule: Mon–Fri, 9–5 PM**

Paradox Media Systems is a US-based performance marketing firm enabling digital monetization at scale across arbitrage models, affiliate marketing, B2B software, and telehealth platforms. Our parent company holds interest in venture capital, commercial real estate, and health tech.

This particular role focuses on Klive, our B2B software product. Klive is a revenue cycle management software for dental practices in the US. Klive automates insurance payment posting, claim follow-ups, benefit verification, and pre-authorizations.

**THE ROLE**

You own Klive's growth end to end: what the brand stands for, what creative gets made, and how the in-house performance marketing team spends budget against it.

A dental practice owner does not buy on a single click: they read, they watch a demo, they weigh a flat monthly fee against the billing service they already pay. Your job is to build the path that takes them from never having heard of Klive to a booked demo to a paying practice.

**THE RESPONSIBILITIES**

This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will plan the strategy and you will also be in the ad accounts, the analytics and the copy docs.

* Brand & Positioning: Own how Klive is presented — the value proposition, messaging hierarchy, competitive framing against outsourced billing services, and consistency of that story across every touchpoint.
* Full-Funnel Growth Planning: Build the plan that moves a practice from first exposure to paying customer. Define the stages, the asset needed at each one, and the conversion target for each handoff.
* Digital Channel Strategy: Decide the channel mix and the role each channel plays — LinkedIn, Meta, Google Search, industry media, partnerships and organic. Set audience strategy, budget allocation and testing priorities per channel.
* Performance Marketing Oversight: Work with the in-house performance marketing team as the strategic owner of Klive's paid programs. Write the briefs, set the targets, review campaign structure and creative, and run the weekly performance review that decides where spend goes next.
* Content & Creative Direction: Shape the content that does the selling — landing pages, ad creative, case studies, comparison pages, demo collateral and email sequences. Write the first drafts yourself where needed.
* Pipeline & Lifecycle: Own the journey after the click: lead qualification, demo booking rate, nurture for practices not yet ready, and the handoff into sales. Work with the team to reduce drop-off at each stage.
* Analytics & Reporting: Monitor spend, lead quality, demo bookings, conversion rates, CAC and payback period. Build the reporting that tells the business what is working and what to stop.
* Testing & Experimentation: Run a continuous testing program across positioning, audiences, creative, landing pages and offers. Document what you learn so it compounds.

**YOUR EXPERIENCE**

**Must Have:**

* 1–3 years in performance marketing or a related field. B2B or SaaS experience preferred; strong B2C candidates who want to move into B2B will be considered.
* Hands-on experience running paid campaigns on at least one of Meta, LinkedIn or Google Ads; enough to brief and review someone else's work credibly.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort owning funnel metrics: CPL, conversion rate, CAC etc.
* Strong written communication. You can write a landing page, an ad, and a cold email that a US business owner would actually read.
* Comfort working on a product you are not an expert in yet, and the curiosity to go learn the industry properly.
* An experiment-driven mindset and willingness to own the number, not just the activity.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience marketing B2B software, SaaS or health tech.
* Experience targeting the US market from India.
* LinkedIn Ads experience specifically, including lead gen forms and ABM-style targeting.
* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools (HubSpot or similar), and with GA4 or attribution tooling.
* Exposure to longer sales cycles, demo-booking funnels or sales-assisted conversion.
* Experience using AI tools for research, content production or workflow automation.
* Any exposure to dental, medical or healthcare practice software.

**WHY JOIN US?**

* Modern Workspace: Work in a relaxed, well-equipped office with access to an on-site cafeteria, games room, gym, and swimming pool.
* Performance Bonus: Eligible employees participate in performance bonus programs after 3 months with the company.
* Own a Product's Growth: You are not running one channel inside a large marketing org. You own how an entire B2B product goes to market, with a performance team to execute behind you.
* US Market Exposure: Build and sell to a US professional-services buyer, with direct access to the practice owners and operators who use the product.
* Learn by Doing: Work on live campaigns and real budgets, with the opportunity to test ideas and see the direct commercial impact of your decisions.

title: Performance Marketing Manager (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
description:
**Roles & Responsibilities**

We are a self-funded jewelry group selling direct to consumers in the US, with a strong B2B business

behind it. Our customers are entirely US-based.

Manufacturing is in-house, so we control product, margin and speed. With no VC money, there is no

pressure to buy growth at any cost. We grow sensibly and keep what works.

We run several distinct consumer brands at different price points. We are now building a central growth

team in Mumbai that will run marketing across most of them.

The role

You will own paid acquisition for one or more of our US brands, mainly on paid channels: Meta, Google,

TikTok, Pinterest etc. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, but we are not hiring someone to

just push buttons.

Platforms automate most of the old legwork: bidding, placements, even audience targeting. What they

cannot do is understand the customer, decide what to say to them, or tell real growth from noise in the

reporting. That is the job.

We want someone who asks why a number moved before acting on it. They should know what a

creative is actually doing for a campaign, and how audiences shape results.

What you'll do

• Plan, run and scale paid campaigns on Meta and Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max),

with clear hypotheses behind each change.

• Understand and identify other channels with opportunities to acquire customers efficiently

• Judge creative on what it does for the campaign: the hook, the message and the offer. Platform

specs are the easy part. Brief the creative team on what to make next and why.

• Think about audiences: who you are reaching, who you are paying to reach again, and what that

does to reported results.

• Separate cause from correlation. Question platform-reported ROAS, and use blended metrics,

holdouts and simple tests to find out what is really driving revenue.

• Use Shopify and analytics data alongside ad platform data to understand customers, not just

campaigns.

• Share learnings across brands, so one brand's win becomes another's starting point.

Full-time, individual contributor

Based in Mumbai

Reports to Head of the growth team

Some overlap with US hours, typically not later than 12 AM IST

Ideal Candidate

* Strong Performance Marketing Manager Profile with D2C/E-commerce background and hands-on paid acquisition experience
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have Minimum 5 yyears of experience in performance marketing
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have experience managing significant budgets on Meta and Google (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and planning, running, and scaling paid campaigns
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1): Must have hands-on experience with Shopify, analytics tools, and spreadsheets
* Mandatory (Skill 1): Must be able to judge creative performance (hook, message, offer), brief creative teams, and separate cause from correlation using blended metrics, holdouts, and tests
* Mandatory (Skill 2): Must have a working understanding of attribution and incrementality to test platform-reported ROAS
* Mandatory (Communication): Must be proficient in clear written English for working with US-based colleagues and customers
* Mandatory (Domain): Must have experience in D2C or e-commerce brands (in-house or agency side)
* Mandatory (Note): Must be willing to work with some overlap with US hours, typically until 12 AM IST
* Preferred (Domain): Experience with US markets or the jewelry industry
* Preferred (Experience 1): Experience with Shopify stores or considered purchases

Experience: 5–8 years · Work from office · 5 days a week · Notice period up to 30 days

description:
**Role : AGM - Personal Care (Anti-pigmentation range)**

**Function : CPC - Expert Marketing**

The AGM – Expert Marketing will own and drive the healthcare professional (HCP) engagement strategy for USV Consumer Personal Care in India. This is a specialized medico-marketing role rather than a general brand management position. The primary objective is to establish scientific credibility of the Consumer Personal care portfolio and expand its recommendation share among dermatologists & other medical practitioners. The role bridges brand strategy, medical affairs, and field excellence to translate clinical differentiation into measurable advocacy and commercial sales growth.

USV Consumer Personal care includes multiple brands like Sebamed, Baby Sebamed,
**Golite, Erytop & Trustretin**
in the areas of Baby & Adult skin & hair care. We are an equal opportunity employer. While you may join in one or more of the brands, you may move across brands depending on your performance.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

●
**HCP Engagement Strategy & KOL Management**

○ Develop and execute a tiered HCP engagement strategy across targeted specialties (dermatologists) for the Personal Care ranges.

○ Define and track the HCP funnel (awareness \ recommendation \ active advocacy) using distinct KPIs such as recommendation rates, share of voice, and prescription audit trends.

○ Build and sustain a structured Key Opinion Leader (KOL) network across Tier 1, 2, and 3 markets with tailored touchpoints.

○ Own the end-to-end advisory board program, including setting the agenda, managing frequency, and implementing clinical insights.

●
**Scientific Communication & Content Development**

○ Create all HCP-facing communication materials, including visual aids, leave-behinds, clinical summaries, FAQs, and product monographs.

○ Partner directly with Scientific Affairs and Regulatory teams to ensure all claims are evidence-backed, compliant, and competitively differentiated.

○ Translate complex scientific dossiers into sharp, credible narratives and messaging for each key SKU.

○ Identify and leverage opportunities for publication support, poster presentations, or white papers within relevant medical forums.

●
**CME & Scientific Events**

○ Plan, design, and execute Continuing Medical Education (CME) programs, symposiums, webinars, and satellite sessions.

○ Ensure event designs focus on genuine clinical education and brand positioning rather than basic logo visibility.

○ Evaluate event ROI by tracking post-CME recommendation intent metrics and subsequent HCP engagement.

●
**Field Force Enablement**

○ Formulate the field detailing strategy, clear call objectives, and Feature-Advantage-Benefit (FAB) frameworks for medical representatives.

○ Collaborate with the L&D team to construct comprehensive training modules covering product science, competitive positioning, and objection handling.

○ Conduct routine field rides to directly assess execution quality and gather frontline market insights.

●
**HCP Coverage & Performance Monitoring**

○ Maintain and update the HCP master list, detailing coverage targets, specialty profiling, tiering, and engagement frequencies.

○ Monitor prescription and recommendation performance utilizing retail and prescription audit data like IQVIA, Health plix, Pharmarack, or equivalents.

○ Conduct quarterly reviews evaluating HCP funnel health, including new activations, lapsed relationships, and conversion rates.

title: Lead Growth
description:
**Job Requirements**
**About the Role**
The Digital Growth team at IDFC FIRST Bank shapes how the Bank engages with its existing customers through digital channels. The team’s work spans all businesses across the Bank. The Growth Lead will define and deliver the growth strategy across these businesses and will be accountable for the outcomes.
  
  
The role is suited to a digital-first professional who can bring structure to ambiguous problems and align senior stakeholders around a common plan.
  
  
The Growth Lead will also help shape how HPE adopts AI and emerging technologies in the way it plans, executes, and measures its work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Strategy and Business Outcomes
  
  

* Define the growth strategy and annual plan for HPE initiatives across the Bank’s businesses, aligned with the Bank’s overall objectives.
* Take ownership of business outcomes, measured through controlled experiments rather than channel metrics such as opens and clicks.
* Prioritise initiatives based on expected impact and review performance regularly, redirecting effort and budget where results fall short.

Customer Engagement
  
  

* Design customer journeys across WhatsApp, email, SMS, push notifications, and in-app messaging that respond to customer behaviour at each stage of the relationship.
* Partner with Analytics and Data Science teams to define customer segments and determine the most relevant engagement strategy for each.
* Set and uphold standards for communication frequency and relevance, ensuring that customer experience is never compromised for short-term results.

Experimentation and Insights
  
  

* Own the experimentation agenda for HPE, ensuring every test starts with a clear hypothesis and concludes with a clear decision.
* Translate learnings into practical recommendations and ensure they inform future planning.

AI and Emerging Technology
  
  

* Identify opportunities to apply AI across the growth process, including predictive targeting, next-best-action models, content generation, and performance analysis.
* Lead pilots with Technology and Data teams and scale use cases that demonstrate value, with appropriate governance for accuracy, compliance, and brand consistency.
* Stay abreast of developments in marketing technology and bring an informed point of view to leadership discussions.

Stakeholder and Programme Management
  
  

* Build strong working relationships with Product, Analytics, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Business teams, bringing them together around shared priorities.
* Plan and manage cross-functional initiatives end to end, including scope, timelines, dependencies, and ownership.
* Present performance, insights, and recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and candour, including learnings from initiatives that did not deliver the expected outcomes.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Education**

* Graduation: Any discipline
* Post-graduation: MBA or equivalent preferred

**Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in growth, lifecycle/CRM marketing, digital marketing, or product roles.
* A proven track record of delivering growth outcomes for a digital, consumer-facing business at scale. Experience in banking, fintech, telecom, e-commerce, or consumer internet businesses is relevant.
* Hands-on experience with customer engagement platforms and experimentation frameworks.

**Skills And Attributes**
We are looking for a professional who combines sound judgement with the ability to bring people together. How the candidate thinks and works matters more than familiarity with any specific tool.
  
  

* Digital-first thinking: Approaches growth through the lens of customer behaviour and data, treating every customer journey as something to be measured and improved.
* Strategic judgement: Connects growth initiatives to business outcomes and makes sound decisions on where to invest time and budget.
* Critical thinking: Identifies the real drivers behind performance, whether the issue lies in targeting or the journey itself, and tests conclusions before acting on them.
* Experimentation discipline: Designs controlled tests with clear hypotheses and can distinguish genuine results from noise.
* AI fluency: Uses AI tools in day-to-day work and has an informed view on where AI adds value to growth and where it introduces risk.
* Stakeholder management: Builds trust across functions and gains alignment from teams outside their reporting line, escalating appropriately when required.
* Customer focus: Balances business goals with customer trust and represents the customer’s interests in decision-making.

* 4+ Years of experience in Proposal management, writing and pursuit mgmt.

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, formatting, tables, headers/footers review, layout consistency, proofreading, PDF preparation, and document clean-up.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, including slide formatting, template alignment, presentation clean-up, visual consistency, image placement, and executive-ready deck preparation.

title: Trainee Payment Analyst
description:
Recruiter for this position: Vipin Yadav
  
Hiring Manager for this position: Himanshu Sharma
  
Division: Global Support & Managed Automation
  
Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications.
  
Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.
  
Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community.
  
Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a technically strong Computer Engineering graduate to join as a Trainee Payment Analyst. You'll work where software engineering meets banking. You'll learn how payment files are generated, transformed, validated and delivered to banks, and you'll help build the tools that automate this work. After a structured training period, you'll take ownership of customer formats.
  
**What You'll Do**

* Payment formats and configuration
* Learn and work with global payment standards:
* ISO 20022: pain.001 (credit transfers), pain.002 (status reports), camt.053/054 (bank statements)
* SEPA, SWIFT MT/MX, and country- and bank-specific formats
* Configure and map payment formats from ERP data (SAP and others) to the format each bank requires
* Help migrate customers between format versions, for example ISO 20022 V3 to V9, to meet bank and SWIFT deadlines
* Testing and validation
* Validate XML payment files against XSD schemas and bank specifications
* Run end-to-end tests in UAT environments, then analyse the bank's acknowledgements and rejections
* Write test cases and keep test evidence for customer sign-off
* Support and troubleshooting
* Investigate customer tickets such as rejected payments, mapping errors, file transfer failures and status mismatches
* Read logs, query databases with SQL and find the root cause, with help from senior analysts
* Coordinate with banks, customers and internal development and cloud teams
* Ways of working
* Work in Agile/Scrum sprints using Jira, and document configurations and decisions in Confluence
* Collaborate with colleagues in India and Europe

**What We're Looking For**
**Must have**

* BE / B.Tech in Computer Engineering, or an equivalent degree in IT or Computer Science (2025 or 2026 graduates welcome)
* Strong grasp of programming fundamentals in at least one language (JavaScript/Node.js, Java or Python)
* Good working knowledge of SQL (joins, filters, aggregations)
* Understanding of data formats: XML, JSON and CSV
* Analytical mindset and close attention to detail, because one wrong field means a failed payment
* Clear written and spoken English

**Good to have**

* XML Schema (XSD), XPath or XSLT
* REST APIs and tools such as Postman
* ETL tools (Pentaho, Talend or similar), or experience transforming data in scripts
* Git, the Linux command line, SFTP
* Basic knowledge of banking, payments or finance (we'll teach the domain)

Internships or academic projects in data integration, automation or fintech
  
**Soft Skills**

* Curiosity and willingness to learn a new domain quickly
* Ownership, and follow-through on tasks and customer issues
* Being comfortable asking questions and documenting what you learn

**What We Offer**

* A structured training programme with a dedicated mentor
* Work with real global customers, banks and modern integration technology
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development
* A clear growth path from Trainee to Payment Analyst, with opportunities in integration and development
* An international team and a hybrid way of working

Next steps: Simply apply here via the internal job market - we will contact you as soon as possible. Good to know: We will contact you first - your current manager will not be informed about your internal application.
  
Your HR Contact for this position is: Vipin Yadav
  
This role is based in: Pune

title: Controls Testing Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**B. Bill of Quantities, Cost Estimation & Proposal Development**
**C. Technical Proposals & Bid Documentation**
**D. Client Engagement & Presales Support**
**E. Internal Collaboration & Presales Standards**
3. AUTHORITIES
  
  

* KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
* System Architecture & Scope Definition
* Develop full IBMS system architecture proposals for mission-critical data center projects during the bid phase, encompassing BMS, FACP, VESDA, Water Leak Detection (WLD), Access Control, CCTV, Rodent Control, and power/environment monitoring subsystems.
* Define BMS controller platform, network topology, and integration architecture — specifying primary, field-level devices, gateways, and communication protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA).
* Prepare detailed I/O point schedules, controller loading calculations, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems during the estimation phase.
* Design IBMS network architecture including data network topology, switch selection criteria, BACnet/IP architecture, and integration requirements for third-party systems (DCIM, EPMS, SCADA/HMI).
* Evaluate and recommend open protocol versus proprietary integration strategies, identifying technical risks and mitigations for the proposed architecture.
* Define subsystem integration requirements, API/protocol mapping, and IBMS-to-DCIM interoperability architecture for high-density and AI data center environments.
* Develop control philosophy summaries and sequences of operation (SOO) drafts to support technical sections of bids, clarifying system-level control strategies without committing to detailed execution design.
* Prepare comprehensive Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for IBMS scope across critical and non-critical data center projects, covering all hardware, software, licensing, integration, engineering, and commissioning cost elements.
* Develop itemized cost estimation sheets with material, labor, third-party integration, software licensing, and contingency allowances, using established Vertiv rate cards and vendor quotations.
* Produce Basis of Estimate (BOE) documents clearly defining scope boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, and unit-cost rationale for each IBMS bid.
* Benchmark IBMS costs against historical project data, vendor list prices, and market intelligence to ensure commercial competitiveness without compromising technical quality.
* Identify and quantify scope risks in estimates, recommending provisional sums and risk allowances where appropriate.
* Prepare and maintain IBMS-specific pricing matrices and parametric estimation models to accelerate turnaround for repeat bid types (colocation, hyperscale, enterprise DC).
* Contribute to internal bid review and approval processes — presenting cost models, assumptions, and risks to senior management and business development leads.
* Lead preparation of technical proposal sections for IBMS scope in RFP/RFQ responses, including executive summaries, technical narratives, compliance matrices, and scope clarification letters.
* Develop technical write-ups describing the proposed IBMS architecture, system capabilities, integration approach, and value differentiators — tailored to client technical and commercial requirements.
* Prepare compliance matrices mapping client specifications and standards requirements (IEC 61850, ASHRAE, TIA-942, NFPA 72, EN 54, IS 3043, NBC 2016) against the proposed solution.
* Produce scope-of-work documents and exclusion lists that define clear contractual boundaries for the IBMS scope within the overall project.
* Develop technical clarification logs and pre-bid query registers, managing responses with accuracy and commercial awareness.
* Prepare value engineering proposals and alternative technical solutions where client requirements offer scope for cost optimization without reducing functional integrity.
* Ensure all bid documents are produced in accordance with Vertiv brand and documentation standards, with consistent formatting and professional presentation.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for IBMS scope during client pre-bid meetings, site surveys, and technical clarification discussions.
* Conduct technical feasibility assessments for proposed IBMS architectures, advising clients and the sales team on achievable scope, realistic timelines, and technical risks.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, solution overviews, and IBMS architecture demonstrations to client technical teams and procurement stakeholders.
* Participate in pre-bid site walks, capturing existing infrastructure constraints, network connectivity requirements, and integration opportunities.
* Support post-submission technical discussions, clarifications, and negotiation of technical scope with clients and consultants.
* Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with key clients, consultants, and specifiers in the data center and critical infrastructure markets.
* Provide technical input to sales team's go/no-go assessments, identifying bid qualification criteria and scope risks early in the sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture, Project Management, and Commercial teams throughout the bid lifecycle, ensuring aligned scope, schedule, and cost assumptions.
* Maintain and continuously improve IBMS presales estimation templates, BOQ master libraries, and technical proposal boilerplate in line with evolving product platforms and market requirements.
* Conduct lessons-learned analysis on won and lost bids to refine estimation accuracy, technical positioning, and proposal quality.
* Support peer review and quality assurance of IBMS proposals prepared by other team members, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with Vertiv standards.
* Provide technical mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior presales engineers and sales staff on IBMS architecture concepts and estimation methodology.
* Interface with the Vertiv product management and engineering teams to stay current on controller platforms, new product introductions, and integration capabilities relevant to presales.

The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Presales & Estimation holds the following delegated authorities within the presales and estimation function:
  
  

* Approve IBMS BOQ, cost estimates, and technical proposals prior to submission to the commercial review board, within authorized value limits.
* Define and confirm IBMS technical scope inclusions and exclusions in bid submissions without requiring individual engineering sign-off for standard scope items.
* Recommend go/no-go decisions on IBMS scope elements and flag technical red-flags to the Bid Manager or Lead Controls Engineer.
* Engage directly with clients, consultants, and specialist vendors during the bid phase for technical clarifications, pre-bid meetings, and scope discussions.
* Request vendor quotations for specialist IBMS equipment, software, and integration services to support estimation.
* Propose value engineering changes and alternative technical solutions during bid development, subject to review by the Lead Controls Engineer.
* Reject internally submitted estimation data or technical content that does not meet Vertiv quality standards or accuracy thresholds.

4. QUALIFICATIONS
**4.1 Education**

* Dip OR bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Automation & Control, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Additional certifications in BMS/IBMS platforms are strongly preferred: Distech Controls, Niagara Framework / Tridium JACE, Honeywell, or Schneider Electric EcoStruxure.
* Training or certification in estimation methodology, technical proposal writing, or pre-sales engineering is a positive differentiator.
* Project management training (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is advantageous for managing complex bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.

**4.2 Experience**

* 5–7 years of progressive experience in IBMS/BMS controls engineering, with a minimum of 4 years in a presales, estimation, or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing IBMS BOQs, cost estimates, and technical proposals for mission-critical data center projects.
* Hands-on experience with BMS controller platforms — DDC/PLC platforms.
* Proven experience defining IBMS network architectures and communication integration strategies (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP, OPC-UA, REST API).
* Experience engaging with clients, consultants, and specifiers in a presales or solution-advisory capacity for critical infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with data center standards and design criteria: ASHRAE, TIA-942, IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, IS 3043, NBC 2016.
* Exposure to high-density cooling architectures (DLC, liquid cooling, CDUs) and AI data center workloads is highly advantageous.

**4.3 Technical Skills Matrix**
**Skill Area**
**Proficiency Required**
**IBMS Subsystems**
Deep understanding of BMS, FACP, VESDA, WLD, Rodent Control, CCTV, Access Control, MDBs, and EPMS in critical data center facilities.
  
  
**Controller Platforms**
Proficiency in controller loading calculations, I/O mapping, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems.
  
  
**BOQ & Cost Estimation**
Ability to prepare detailed, accurate IBMS BOQs and cost estimation sheets including hardware, software, licensing, integration, and engineering effort.
  
  
**Network & Integration Architecture**
Proficiency in IBMS network topology design, protocol selection (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA), switch sizing, and third-party integration mapping (DCIM, SCADA, EPMS).
  
  
**Technical Proposal Writing**
Ability to produce clear, structured technical narratives, compliance matrices, scope-of-work documents, and value engineering proposals for complex bids.
  
  
**Standards & Codes**
Working knowledge of IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, ASHRAE, TIA-942, BS EN 62305, IS 3043, NBC 2016, and Vertiv internal standards (G-FI-PL-006).
  
  
**Thermal Management**
Knowledge of data center thermal management: CRAH/CRAC, chilled water plant, CDU/liquid cooling (DLC), and environmental monitoring in high-density environments.
  
  
**Software Tools**
MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Visio, Project), AutoCAD, estimation/CPQ tools, and documentation management platforms.
  
  
**SCADA / HMI / DCIM**
Familiarity with SCADA/HMI platforms for IBMS visualization, alarm management, and DCIM integration for data center monitoring.
  
  
**4.4 Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to present complex IBMS architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Commercial acumen: ability to balance technical quality with cost competitiveness and understand bid strategy and margin implications.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; able to decompose complex client requirements into definable, priceable scope elements.
* High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy across large, multi-subsystem BOQs and complex technical proposals.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids under time pressure without compromising quality or accuracy.
* Collaborative team player with the confidence to challenge technical and commercial assumptions respectfully and constructively.
* Self-motivated with a quality-first mindset; proactive in identifying risks and gaps during the bid cycle.

5. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
  

* Experience working with the Vertiv InfraSol platform or similar critical infrastructure integrated solutions in a presales or solution architecture capacity.
* Familiarity with AI data center workloads — high-density liquid cooling (DLC/immersion), power distribution architecture, and intelligent environmental monitoring.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, demonstrating structured approach to managing bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.
* Knowledge of ISA/IEC instrumentation standards and engineering flowchart conventions for controls systems architecture.
* Experience preparing parametric estimation models and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) frameworks for repeatable IBMS bid packages.
* Demonstrated experience with multi-hyperscale or multi-colocation client environments — understanding of client template specifications and standard scope requirements.
* Familiarity with sustainability-driven IBMS features: energy monitoring, power analytics, PUE optimization, and ESG reporting integration for data centers.

6. PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS
  
  

* Primarily office-based role with occasional site visits required for pre-bid surveys, client technical meetings, and solution demonstration events.
* Comfortable working in active data center environments during pre-bid site surveys: raised floors, live electrical equipment, and operational cooling infrastructure.
* Ability to work extended hours during peak bid periods, proposal submission deadlines, and multi-bid parallel cycles.
* Travel required: approximately 10–25% of working time, primarily domestic within India, with occasional international travel for major client engagements or vendor partner events.

title: Senior Change Manager (AI Community/ Training)
description:
**Entity**
Technology
  
  
**Job Family Group**
Project Management Group
  
  
**Job Description**
You will work with
  
  
You will join AI Enablement & Programme Management, a new central function that connects bp's AI strategy with delivery. The team creates visibility, consistent execution, strategic partner management and organisation-wide readiness, while delivery & specialist accountabilities remain with the relevant teams. You will support the AI Engagement, Community & Training Lead and work closely with Communications, Training, Workplace and Resilience, AI Governance, Digital Security, business-facing Digital teams, AI specialists and enabling functions. The team is small, collaborative and outcomes-focused, and this role provides the structured delivery capacity needed to turn engagement, community and training strategies into measurable execution.
  
  
Let me tell you about the role
  
  
The AI Engagement, Community and Training Senior Change Manager will translate engagement, communications, community and learning strategies into coordinated plans, milestones and deliverables. You will handle cross-functional delivery across AI communications campaigns, the AI Champion community, the AI Community of Practice, AI learning coordination, trusted guidance and continued development of the AI Hub. The role combines senior project delivery, change and adoption practice, communications coordination, community activation, learning coordination, stakeholder management and digital content delivery. You will deliver through influence in a matrix, recognising that communications and training execution remain owned by specialist teams.
  
  
What you will deliver
  
  
**Planning and project delivery:**
Translate engagement, community and training strategies into integrated plans, milestones, dependencies and deliverables. Establish practical delivery rhythms, maintain momentum and ensure work is completed to agreed quality and outcomes.
  
  
**Cross-functional coordination:**
Coordinate Communications, Training, Workplace and Resilience, AI Governance, Digital Security and other teams to execute shared priorities. Clarify roles and hand-offs, manage dependencies and avoid duplication of specialist responsibilities.
  
  
**Communications delivery:**
Coordinate AI communication campaigns, content development, approvals and associated execution activity. Maintain coherent plans and ensure messages and materials are clear, consistent, timely and connected to adoption objectives.
  
  
**Community activation:**
Re-establish and sustain the AI Champion community and AI Community of Practice. Coordinate operating rhythms, events, content, participation and follow-through so communities share learning, amplify trusted guidance and support adoption.
  
  
**Learning coordination:**
Support the discovery and mapping of AI learning across bp, coordinate gap analysis and manage delivery activity against agreed priorities in partnership with Training teams.
  
  
**AI Hub product and content delivery:**
Manage the continued development and improvement of the consolidated AI Hub. Coordinate backlog, content owners, user needs, publishing activity and lifecycle management so people can access trusted and current AI information.
  
  
**Stakeholder management:**
Build effective working relationships across business-facing Digital teams, AI specialists and enabling functions. Maintain alignment, surface decisions and issues early, and adapt delivery to stakeholder and business needs.
  
  
**Delivery governance and reporting:**
Track progress, dependencies, risks, issues, actions and outcomes across the engagement portfolio. Produce clear status reporting and decision support, and ensure commitments are owned and followed through.
  
  
**Change, adoption and insight:**
Coordinate interventions that improve understanding, confidence and sustained use of AI. Support feedback loops, community listening and confidence measurement, using insight to refine future activity.
  
  
**Continuous improvement:**
See opportunities to simplify plans, content processes, community operations and delivery controls. Capture learning and improve repeatability, quality and pace across the pillar.
  
  
What you will need to be successful (experience and qualifications)
  
  

* Proven experience managing sophisticated technology projects or workstreams across communications, change, engagement, learning, community or digital content in a matrixed organisation.
* Strong project planning and delivery skills, including achievements, dependencies, risks, issues, actions, reporting and outcome tracking. Experience of using AI Tools in project management.
* Experience coordinating communications campaigns and content development across multiple contributors, approvals and channels.
* Experience mobilising and sustaining communities, networks, champion programmes or communities of practice.
* Experience coordinating learning needs discovery, learning portfolios or capability-building activity with specialist training teams.
* Experience handling digital content, intranet or website development and improvement, including backlogs and content lifecycle practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to build trust and deliver through influence.
* Practical understanding of change and adoption approaches and how engagement, learning and community interventions support sustained use.

description:
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 10 countries, and more than 160 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
  
  
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a committed and competent Business Analyst to join our international team. You will act as a key interface between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business needs are clearly understood, analyzed, and translated into well-defined technical requirements.
  
  
You will work closely with business stakeholders, software engineers, technology vendors, and other technical teams to support the design and delivery of effective solutions.
  
  
Key tasks
  
  
Gather, analyze, and understand business requirements from internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Translate business needs into clear and structured functional and technical requirements that can be implemented by development teams.
  
  
Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and software engineers, ensuring a common understanding of requirements and expected outcomes.
  
  
Analyze existing business processes, applications, interfaces, and data flows to identify appropriate solutions.
  
  
Understand the Avaloq Core Banking Platform and the corresponding banking business processes and functional areas.
  
  
Prepare and maintain requirements, functional specifications, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
  
  
Support developers during solution design and implementation by clarifying business and functional requirements.
  
  
Support testing and validation activities to ensure that delivered solutions meet the agreed business requirements.
  
  
Assist in root cause analysis and the resolution of functional and production issues.
  
  
Ensure all documentation aligns with internal standards and best practices. Regularly review and update existing documentation to reflect any changes in processes or systems.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, Finance, or an equivalent field.
  
  
3+ years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, or in a similar role within banking or financial services.
  
  
**Experience With Documenting Business Requirements And Functional Specifications**
Familiarity with developing user stories and use cases
  
  
Strong knowledge of SQL and PL/SQL.
  
  
Strong German and international tax expertise, particularly in CRS, FATCA and US QI, combined with a solid understanding of their impact on banking processes and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), including understanding data integration processes, mappings, interfaces, and ETL/data flows is considered an advantage.
  
  
Excellent analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.
  
  
Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  
  
Quality-conscious, self-motivated, and goal-oriented.
  
  
Open-minded team player with strong communication skills and proficiency in written and spoken English.
  
  
Willingness to develop strong knowledge of the Avaloq platform and complete relevant Avaloq training and certifications Analyst
  
  
**Additional Information**
We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
  
  
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.

* Understand data transformations/aggregation at system hops and identify associated data risks in line with BCBS 239 guidelines

description:

Our Managed Services team supports customers with subscription services on an ongoing basis, helping them to adopt, expand, optimize and maintain their use of Zendesk products as their own businesses grow and evolve. We function as an extension of their teams, consulting on design and configuration best practices, as well as offering the hands-on support they need to make their vision a reality.

* Guide and educate your customers to give them proactive assistance as they maintain and optimize their Zendesk products and also provide business consultation for customers
* Collaborate and work with Managed Services Consultants in all regions globally to gather configuration requirements, offer recommendations, and scope and prioritize tasks within hours available
* Complete detailed account reviews and configuration analyses to identify opportunities for improvement based on best practices and the customers’ unique use case

* Contribute to processes and operational improvements in this new, rapidly growing team

title: Managed Shared Services Consultant
description:
**Job Description**

You will collaborate with our global team of Managed Services Consultants to ensure customers realize ongoing value from their services subscription and view the Managed Services team as an extension of their own. * Task Management: Handle a backlog of work for your customer portfolio, prioritizing tasks within available hours.
* Customer Guidance: Provide proactive assistance and business consultation to help customers maintain and optimize their Zendesk products.
* Global Collaboration: Work with Managed Services Consultants globally to gather configuration requirements, offer recommendations, and prioritize tasks.
* Account Reviews: Conduct detailed account reviews and configuration analyses to identify improvement opportunities based on best practices and unique customer use cases.
* Configuration Updates: Design, configure, test, and roll out complex, high-stakes configuration updates in production environments.

title: Solution Owner - SKF.com & Digital Experience Platforms
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Solution Owner - SKF.com & Digital Experience Platforms
**Reports To:**
Head of Digital Commercial Solutions
**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor
**Location:**
Pune

**Purpose of the role**

Digital experience is becoming increasingly important in how customers discover, engage with, and do business with SKF. As part of SKF's digital transformation journey, we are evolving the capabilities that enable customers, partners, investors, job seekers, and employees to interact with SKF in more seamless, consistent, and personalized ways.

We are looking for a Solution Owner to drive the evolution of key digital experience capabilities, including content management & content lifecycle management, digital asset management, and translation management. These capabilities are fundamental to SKF's ambition of delivering compelling, scalable, and globally consistent digital experiences across channels and markets.

As a Solution Owner, you will be responsible for translating business needs and customer insights into prioritized initiatives that create measurable value. Working closely with stakeholders across business and technology, you will ensure that SKF's digital platforms and capabilities continue to support a modern, efficient, and customer centric digital ecosystem.

In addition to continuously improving today's capabilities, you will help shape SKF's future digital landscape. This includes exploring and enabling new opportunities in AI, automation, content operations, personalization, and customer experience optimization, ensuring SKF is well positioned to adapt to rapidly changing customer expectations and technological advancements.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Shape and drive the vision, strategy, and evolution of SKF's digital experience capabilities, including content management & content lifecycle management, digital asset management, and translation management.
* Own and prioritize the SKF.com product backlog, ensuring investments are aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and SKF's digital transformation roadmap.
* Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to identify opportunities that strengthen SKF's brand, improve customer engagement, and create seamless end-to-end digital journeys.
* Lead the evolution of digital capabilities that enable global content creation, management, localization, and delivery at scale.
* Drive strategic transformation initiatives that modernize how SKF creates, manages, delivers, and optimizes digital experiences across markets, channels, and touchpoints.
* Explore and enable emerging technologies, including AI, automation, and data driven personalization, to improve efficiency, content effectiveness, and customer experiences.
* Define roadmaps and investment priorities that balance innovation, operational excellence, scalability, security, and long term business value.
* Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, architects, UX specialists, web developers, content teams, and external partners to turn strategy into impactful digital solutions.
* Champion a customer centric and data driven approach to decision making, ensuring digital experiences are informed by insights, user behavior, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure digital platforms and capabilities remain secure, resilient, adaptable, and ready to support future business growth and changing customer expectations.
* Build strong partnerships with technology vendors and implementation partners to accelerate innovation and maximize the value of SKF's digital investments.
* Promote modern product management, Agile, and DevSecOps practices that enable continuous improvement, faster delivery, and sustainable digital transformation.

****Main Requirements****

* Solid understanding of modern web and digital experience platforms including headless CMS or DXP platforms, modern frontend frameworks, analytics, technical SEO/GEO and web performance.
* Proven experience in a solution owner, product owner, digital product manager, application owner, or similar role, driving digital products and business capabilities in a complex environment.
* Experience leading digital experience platforms, global enterprise websites, content ecosystems, or customer facing digital solutions.
* Strong product management experience, including roadmap definition, backlog prioritization, value realization, and agile delivery.
* Experience working at the intersection of business and technology, translating strategic objectives into scalable digital capabilities.
* Knowledge of content management, content lifecycle management, digital asset management, translation management, digital experience delivery, or related disciplines.
* Understanding of modern digital ecosystems, including cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data driven decision making, and emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence and automation.
* Experience driving digital transformation initiatives and managing change across organizations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and build alignment across business, IT, and external partners.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to engage audiences ranging from operational teams to senior leadership.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Hardware Security and Connectivity Engineer
description:
**Entity**
Technology
  
  
**Job Family Group**
IT&S Group
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role purpose**
The Security and Connectivity Engineer delivers hands-on engineering, and operational support for EV charging hardware and the connectivity services used by field equipment. Working within the established strategy, requirements and governance. The postholder completes security assessments, operates cellular and hardwired connectivity, implements approved changes, troubleshoots incidents and maintains reliable technical records.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced, practical engineer who independently progresses routine work within defined delivery constraints, produces sound technical evidence and recognises when senior review or formal approval is required.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Hardware security assessment and support**
Contribute to hardware security assessments for EV chargers, embedded systems, load-management systems, battery systems, payment-related field equipment and associated networking components.
  
  
Gather and review supplier evidence against approved security requirements, record gaps and actions, and support verification of remediation.
  
  
Contribute to threat modelling and risk assessment for new products, design changes, connectivity solutions and operational deployments.
  
  
Review hardware, firmware, embedded software and communications information and raise unclear, incomplete or non-conforming evidence for senior review.
  
  
Support vulnerability assessment, penetration testing and technical security testing, ensuring findings and evidence are recorded accurately.
  
  
Maintain traceable assessment records, including requirements, evidence, findings, decisions, deviations, risks, actions and closure status.
  
  
Support security incident investigation for field assets by collecting technical evidence, coordinating suppliers and documenting recovery or remediation activity.
  
  
Apply approved requirements for secure communications, identity, authentication, encryption, access control, logging, monitoring, updates and vulnerability management.
  
  
**Cellular connectivity operations**
Assist with the operations of cellular connectivity services, including SIM estates, APNs and managed IoT connectivity platforms.
  
  
Implement approved firewall, access-control-list, routing, endpoint and connectivity-policy changes and verify the resulting service behaviour.
  
  
Investigate coverage, modem, session, APN, DNS, routing, reachability, roaming, latency and service-performance issues using structured troubleshooting and available evidence.
  
  
Coordinate with mobile network operators, connectivity providers, hardware vendors and regional operations teams to resolve faults.
  
  
Support SIM and APN migrations through preparation, representative testing, change execution, rollback readiness and post-change validation.
  
  
Monitor data usage, tariffs, recurring faults and service trends and identify opportunities to improve availability and cost effectiveness.
  
  
Maintain accurate SIM, APN, ACL, endpoint, configuration, contract and connected-asset records within agreed processes.
  
  
**Site network operations**
Support hardwired connectivity across EV charging sites, including site LAN, WAN, Ethernet and internet-connectivity services.
  
  
Assist with troubleshooting TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLAN, NAT, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewall, cabling and equipment issues affecting field systems.
  
  
Support new-site handover, remediation, network migration, equipment replacement, upgrade and service-change activities.
  
  
Coordinate fault resolution with core-network teams, managed-service partners, site teams, service providers and equipment suppliers.
  
  
Create and maintain network diagrams, configuration records, asset inventories, operating procedures, test records and troubleshooting guides.
  
  
Help move completed sites into the agreed support model with accurate documentation, ownership and escalation routes.
  
  
**Essential Qualifications And Experience**
Degree or equivalent practical experience in cyber security, network engineering, telecommunications, electrical or electronic engineering, computer science, control systems or a related discipline.
  
  
Relevant professional experience in network engineering, telecommunications, infrastructure operations, IoT, operational technology, connected-product security or a related field.
  
  
Practical experience operating or troubleshooting business-critical network or connected-device services.
  
  
Working knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, NAT, DNS, DHCP, VPNs and firewalls.
  
  
Experience implementing and validating firewall, routing, access-control or endpoint changes.
  
  
Working knowledge of cellular services, including 4G/LTE, 5G, SIM lifecycle, APNs and roaming, or the ability to develop this knowledge rapidly.
  
  
Experience reviewing technical evidence, recording findings and following actions through to closure.
  
  
Awareness of cyber security risk assessment methodologies, threat modelling and common controls for connected hardware or operational technology.
  
  
Experience working with third-party service providers, suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  
  
Ability to create clear technical documentation, network diagrams, operating procedures and test records.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to organise work, progress tasks independently and escalate appropriately.
  
  
**Desirable Knowledge And Experience**
Knowledge of EV charging infrastructure, energy systems, distributed critical infrastructure, industrial automation or safety-related environments.
  
  
Knowledge of enterprise and industrial networking technologies.
  
  
Understanding of Public key infrastructure, certificate lifecycle management, secure boot, signed firmware, trusted hardware components and secure remote maintenance.
  
  
Knowledge of Hardware and firmware security testing, penetration testing, packet capture, protocol analysis, forensic investigation or vulnerability management.
  
  
Knowledge of recognised standards and guidance, such as IEC 62443, ISO/IEC 27001, ETSI EN 303 645, NIS2 and applicable product-security legislation.
  
  
Experience in Service-management practice, architecture governance and formal management-of-change processes.
  
  
Relevant professional registration or current certification in engineering, cyber security or networking.
  
  
**Ways of working**
Uses evidence and structured troubleshooting to isolate faults and reach clear technical conclusions.
  
  
Records configurations, changes, test results, assessment evidence and decisions accurately.
  
  
Takes responsibility for assigned issues and maintains momentum without close day-to-day direction.
  
  
Works within approved requirements, designs and controls
  
  
Works constructively across organisational boundaries and with external suppliers.
  
  
Looks for recurring issues, inefficient processes and opportunities to improve reliability, security and supportability.
  
  
Communicates uncertainty explicitly and does not present assumptions as confirmed facts.
  
  
**Working arrangements**
The role works across geographically distributed teams, markets and suppliers.
  
  
Travel to offices, supplier facilities, laboratories and operational sites is not expected.
  
  
Participation in planned changes or incident support outside normal working hours may occasionally be required, subject to applicable arrangements.

title: ESG Expert – ESG & Sustainability
description:
Enzene Biosciences is a Pune-based biologics CDMO serving global pharmaceutical and biotech customers from India and the US. Customers, investors and regulators increasingly assess CDMOs on ESG performance, and we have committed to being rated on the S&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment (DJSI) and EcoVadis.

We’ve completed gap assessments against both frameworks, built our first GHG inventory and published our first Sustainability Report. We’re now looking for an ESG Expert to bring this capability in-house and own it end to end.

**What you’ll do**

* Own the annual S&P Global CSA (DJSI) and EcoVadis submissions, from evidence collection and drafting to portal upload and score analysis
* Drive the gap-closure roadmap across both frameworks before each submission window
* Track yearly methodology changes and translate them into policy, data or disclosure updates
* Lead the Sustainability Report (GRI), BRSR disclosures and CDP (Climate, Water); build readiness for ISSB/IFRS S1 and S2
* Run the GHG inventory (Scope 1, 2, 3) per the GHG Protocol
* Build the ESG data system: KPI dictionary, data owners, collection calendar, quarterly dashboard
* Respond to customer ESG questionnaires, PSCI and supplier sustainability audits, and investor queries
* Draft and maintain ESG policies
* Act as secretary to the CSR & Sustainability Committee
* Manage the ESG vendor, assurance providers and rating-agency relationships

**What we’re looking for**

* Master’s degree with minimum 3 years full-time experience in ESG / sustainability (industry or consulting)
* Hands-on experience filing at least one complete DJSI/CSA and one EcoVadis submission, including evidence collection and portal upload
* EcoVadis corrective action plan experience
* Working knowledge of GRI, BRSR, GHG Protocol and at least one of CDP, SASB or TCFD/ISSB
* Strong written English for public disclosures and policies
* Advanced Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint

**Good to have**

* Pharma, biologics, CDMO, chemicals or regulated manufacturing background
* Track record of improving CSA or EcoVadis scores across cycles
* Exposure to SBTi, LCA/product carbon footprinting, ISO 14001 / 45001 / 50001

Position: Assistant Manager - Fixed Assets

**Job Summary**
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Fixed Assets accounting lead to join our finance team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the company's fixed assets, ensuring compliance with multiple GAAP standards, performing timely monthly closures, and preparing Management Information System (MIS) reports. This role requires proficiency in SAP Hana, advanced Excel skills, and a strong aptitude for automation and advanced technologies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Fixed Assets Management: Maintain the fixed assets register, ensuring all acquisitions, disposals, and depreciation entries are accurately recorded. Conduct regular physical verification of assets and reconcile with the fixed asset register. Coordinate with various departments for capital expenditure (CapEx) budgeting and tracking.
  
  
Compliance and Reporting: Ensure compliance with multiple GAAP standards (e.g., IFRS, US GAAP, local GAAP) in all fixed asset transactions and reporting.
  
  
Prepare and present fixed assets reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
Assist in the preparation of financial statements with specific focus on fixed assets.
  
  
Prepare Management Information System (MIS) reports for senior management.
  
  
Audit and Internal Controls: Prepare audit schedules related to fixed assets and assist auditors in their inquiries.
  
  
Develop and implement internal controls over the fixed assets process to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  
  
Address and resolve audit findings, ensuring no adverse comments, and implement recommendations.
  
  
Monthly Closures: Ensure timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes related to fixed assets.
  
  
Reconcile fixed asset sub-ledger to the general ledger and prepare necessary journal entries. Analyze variances and provide explanations for significant differences.
  
  
Guidance and Evaluation: Provide guidance to management on the evaluation of CapEx and OpEx assessments.
  
  
Offer insights and recommendations on financial impacts related to fixed assets and enterprise asset life cycle management.
  
  
System and Process Improvement: Utilize SAP Hana for asset management, reporting, and analysis.
  
  
Enhance fixed asset processes and workflows for efficiency and accuracy.
  
  
Drive the application of advanced technologies and automation in fixed assets and enterprise asset life cycle management.
  
  
Provide training and support to team members on fixed asset management best practices.
  
  
**Qualifications And Skills**
Professional accounting qualification (e.g., CA, Cost Accountant) preferred.
  
  
3-5 years of experience in fixed assets accounting in a multi-GAAP environment.
  
  
Proficiency in SAP Hana and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  
  
Strong understanding of IFRS, US GAAP, and local GAAP.
  
  
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  
  
Ability to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  
  
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  
  
Go-getter attitude with a focus on ensuring deliverables are met on time.
  
  
**Experience Working In a Listed Company.**
Experience with process improvement initiatives.
  
  
Familiarity with other accounting software and tools.

**AI at the core**
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
  
  
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
****Position Summary****
The Legal AI Researcher is responsible for executing legal workflows in AI development with a strong focus on trust, safety, compliance, and risk validation. As a member of the product design process, the Legal AI Researcher helps shape how Onit’s AI products are built, recommending product design based on legal knowledge and research, and providing independent validation before release. Working under the guidance of Senior and Principal Legal Engineers, this role supports the ethical development of AI, ensures legal risk is documented and mitigated, and contributes to internal compliance, audits, and workflow execution. The position also encourages professional development and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Design Participation: Take part in the product design process from early concept through release, representing legal and trust considerations in design discussions and decisions.
* Legal Workflow Execution: Organise baselines, define research methodologies, and support structured execution of legal AI workflows.
* Compliance & Reporting Support: Assist in audits, prepare privacy statements, model factsheets, and maintain audit logs.
* AI Risk & Validation Tasks: Conduct ethical, legal, and operational risk assessments while maintaining AI risk registry and validating outputs for compliance.
* Trust & Safety Integration: Monitor ongoing legal and risk developments, initiate steps to maintain compliance, and feed findings into trust frameworks.
* Prompt Engineering Support: Contribute to prompt development and iterative improvements in legal AI services.
* Jurisdictional Research: Research and summarise AI regulations relevant to product deployment regions.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Partner with AI engineering team to deliver legally valid and trustworthy AI solutions.
* Learning & Development: Learn from senior team members and work towards higher-impact roles.
* Independent Validation: Perform independent validation of AI features and outputs against legal, company standards and risk requirements before release, documenting findings, exceptions, and remediation, and escalating unresolved issues.

**Required Skills**

* Legal degree or equivalent legal/LegalOps experience.
* Background in legal matter or spend management.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and organisational skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, including the ability to explain legal requirements clearly to product and engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt in Legal Tech environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of AI compliance and legal risk principles.
* Experience in prompt engineering or legal validation of AI.
* Exposure to legal audits, AI fairness, privacy, or regulatory frameworks.
* Prior client presentations or compliance documentation experience.
* Exposure to product design or product development processes, or to translating legal requirements into product features.

**Benefits & Perks That Support You**
Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:
  
  
Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.
  
  
Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.
  
  
Family Support:
***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***
Income Protection:
***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***
Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident
***.***
Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
***Flexi, NPS***
.
  
  
Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

**Customer First -**
Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.

Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.

Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.
  
  
**Intentional Growth -**
