title: Junior Program Associate - Freight
description:
**About Us**
WRI India, an independent knowledge organisation registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development. Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well-being. Know more: wri-india.org
  
  
**Program Overview**
WRI India’s Integrated Transport Program supports India’s decarbonization journey through effective, equitable, and inclusive mobility solutions. The program focuses on advancing sustainable urban transport, including electrification of public transport, clean air initiatives, and hydrogen economy. It emphasizes strategic research, policy support, and capacity building to enable systemic changes at the sub-national level and accelerate electric mobility adoption.
  
  
**Job Highlight**
WRI India is seeking a Junior Program Associate for the Sustainable Cities and Transport Program to support the e-FAST India initiative under its Freight Electrification program. e-FAST India works with stakeholders across the freight ecosystem to accelerate the adoption of electric medium- and heavy-duty trucks (e-MHDTs). The candidate will support research and analysis, data collection, stakeholder engagement, and the development and delivery of project activities and knowledge products. The role offers an opportunity to contribute to practical, evidence-based approaches for freight decarbonisation while working with government, industry, and other ecosystem partners.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Conduct desk research on freight decarbonisation, e-MHDTs, freight operations, charging infrastructure, fleet transition pathways, financing, and relevant policy and market developments.
* Support e-FAST India platform activities, including stakeholder outreach, partner coordination, onboarding, consultations, meetings, workshops, and events.
* Assist in engaging with government agencies, shippers, logistics service providers, vehicle manufacturers, charging-point operators, financiers, and other ecosystem stakeholders to gather inputs and understand their priorities.
* Collect, organise, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data related to freight movement, fleet operations, e-MHDT pilots, route and corridor electrification, vehicle performance, charging requirements, and techno-economic feasibility.
* Support the development and implementation of data-collection tools such as surveys, interview guides, and partner information templates; identify alternative data sources and assist with field-level data collection where required.
* Contribute to mapping freight routes and corridors, e-MHDT pilots, charging infrastructure, and other relevant ecosystem information to inform research and project activities.
* Translate research and stakeholder inputs into clear findings, charts, and actionable insights; prepare presentations, reports, policy briefs, technical notes, meeting summaries, and other project collaterals.
* Support the planning, documentation, and follow-up of project activities, including maintaining records of stakeholder interactions, tracking action points, and coordinating inputs and deliverables with internal and external teams.
* Contribute to communications and knowledge-sharing materials that explain e-FAST India’s work and developments in freight electrification to technical and non-technical audiences.

**What You Will Need**

* Master’s degree in transport planning, transport engineering, urban planning, public policy, energy, logistics, economics, or a related discipline; candidates with 0–2 years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills, including the ability to collect, organise, interpret, and synthesise information from multiple sources.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, is essential.
* Strong writing, analytical, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex information clearly and concisely.
* An understanding of freight transport, logistics, electric mobility, charging infrastructure, or transport decarbonisation is desirable.
* Experience with data analysis or visualisation tools such as advanced Excel, Power BI, R, Python, or Stata is an advantage.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team and engage professionally with stakeholders from government, industry, research, and civil society.
* Willingness to support stakeholder consultations, workshops, and field-based data collection, including occasional travel, as required.

**Potential Salary and Benefits:**
*INR 7,50,000 to 9,00,000 Per Annum*
*“Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills, and internal parity. WRI India offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package.”*

title: Program Officer, Medical Devices (12-month LTE)
description:
**The Foundation**
We are the largest nonprofit fighting poverty, disease, and inequity around the world. Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. We believe our employees should reflect the rich diversity of the global populations we aim to serve. We provide an exceptional benefits package to employees and their families which include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with no premiums, generous paid time off, paid family leave, foundation-paid retirement contribution, regional holidays, and opportunities to engage in several employee communities. As a workplace, we’re committed to creating an environment for you to thrive both personally and professionally.
  
  
**The Team**
The India Country Office (ICO) is central to the foundation’s commitment to advancing equitable health outcomes and strengthening India’s health innovation ecosystem. The Digital, Health Innovations, and Artificial Intelligence (DHAI) Cluster is a core enabler of the ICO’s key goals across our portfolio. The cluster advances R&D and innovation across foundational research; medical devices, vaccines, and drugs, as well as data-science methods (modeling, AI-enabled tools). We approach this by accelerating R&D and the deployment of affordable, high-quality, accessible devices, working with the Government of India - at central and state level, academia, industry, and global networks.
  
  
**Your Role**
As a
**Program Officer, Medical Devices**
you will play a crucial role in shaping and managing a portfolio of critical investments focused on advancing sensor-based, AI-enabled medical device technologies that support improved maternal, neonatal, and women’s health, including devices for respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) management, intrapartum monitoring, antenatal care innovations, as well as neonatal care device packages and algorithmic risk-stratification tools with the potential to improve public health outcomes in high-burden populations. You will collaborate with internal and external partners to drive innovative solutions ensuring medical devices are designed, validated and deployed effectively in public health programs.
  
  
You will bring expertise in medical device development, including clinical use case prioritization and validation, product specifications, sensor, AI vision and algorithm development, regulatory pathways, and market access strategies, and work closely with product development partners, global health organizations, and policymakers to ensure successful implementation of devices for maternal, neonatal, and respiratory health.
  
  
This is a
**12-month limited term employment**
(LTE), based at the foundation’s ICO in
**New Delhi**
, reporting to the Deputy Director, Drugs, Diagnostics & Devices. Relocation will not be provided.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
This is a highly collaborative role and will involve working with multiple Program Strategy Teams (PSTs) in Seattle and teams across the ICO, for new product development and scaling. In this role you will:
  
  

* Design, structure, and manage grants and contracts for AI-enabled medical device innovation for maternal, neonatal, and women health conditions aligned with India and PST goals.
* Identify and select partner institutions and shape scope and strategy for selected grants and contracts to meet selected strategic goals.
* Apply milestone-based technical performance metrics and drive go/no-go decision-making.
* Provide technical and strategic support to grantees and contractors, ensuring alignment with foundation priorities.
* Review interim and final reports; write final evaluation and synthesize and document lessons learned across related grants and contracts.
* Collaborate closely with foundation teams in Seattle and ICO on the medical devices for maternal, neonatal, and respiratory health.
* Analyze opportunities based on medical device advances in maternal, neonatal, and respiratory health needs to find opportunities.
* Establish and maintain relationships with key institutions to build ownership and collaboration to help with adoption and scaling of new/innovative products and technologies.

**Your Experience**

* Bachelor’s in engineering, science or medicine or related fields is required. Master’s or PhD is preferred.
* Minimum of five years’ experience with preference in medical device development including AI-enabled technologies, exposure in regulatory affairs, in India and/or low and middle-income countries (LMICs) contexts.
* Deep understanding of medical device lifecycle - from concept through verification/validation, regulatory approval, and commercialization.
* Familiarity with India’s medical devices policy ecosystem and experience working with relevant agencies (e.g. ANRF, Biodesign programs).
* Portfolio and project management skills; ability to structure, oversee and review large-scale grants and contracts advancing medical device technologies.
* Excellent analytical thinking and communications skills, including the ability to synthesize evidence into actionable insights, prepare high-quality briefings and analyses for leadership, and public speaking.
* Passion for health equity, innovation, and systems change.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a highly matrixed and diverse work environment, with strong collaboration, consultative and negotiation skills.
* Results-driven and self-motivated with ability to inspire the pursuit of excellence.

**Other Attributes**

* Comfortable in a wide range of cultural, geographic and operational situations, demonstrating culturally sensitive behavior with a diverse range of people and a deep commitment to development issues and high standards of personal integrity.
* Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time.
* Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship.

**Application deadline**
: 19 November 2026
  
  
**Hiring Requirements**
As part of our standard hiring process for new employees, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background check.
  
  
**Candidate Accommodations**
We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you have a disability or medical condition and need an accommodation at any stage of the application or interview process—such as an ASL interpreter, alternative interview format, or physical accessibility support—we’re happy to help. Please contact HR@gatesfoundation.org with the position number and a brief description of your accommodation needs. Requests will be handled confidentially.
  
  
**Inclusion Statement**
We are dedicated to the belief that all lives have equal value. We strive for a global and cultural workplace that supports ever greater diversity, equity, and inclusion — of voices, ideas, and approaches — and we support this diversity through all our employment practices.
  
  
All applicants and employees who are drawn to serve our mission will enjoy equality of opportunity and fair treatment without regard to race, color, age, religion, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, disability, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, and prior protected activity.

title: Business Continuity, Crisis Management & Enterprise Risk Professional
description:
Control Risks is seeking a hands-on Business Continuity Management (BCM), Crisis Management (CM) and Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) professional to support the development and implementation of the client's resilience programme. This is a practitioner role focused on building and embedding workable arrangements, not an audit, assurance or purely advisory position. BCM and CM are the primary capabilities, with ERM as an important secondary capability.

**Initial three-month requirement:**

* Undertake current-state reviews and stakeholder discussions.
* Develop the client's BCM Policy, Framework and supporting templates.
* Develop the Crisis Management Policy, Plan and supporting tools.

The individual will work closely with Control Risks during this period. Control Risks will provide the methodology, templates, technical guidance and senior oversight.

Thereafter, the intent is for the individual to transition to the client and take ownership of implementing, embedding and maintaining the programme across the organisation, including:

* Business Impact Analysis and continuity risk assessments
* Recovery strategies and Business Continuity Plans
* Crisis preparedness and practical scenario playbooks
* Training, testing and exercises
* BCM and CM programme governance, reporting and continual improvement
* ERM coordination, risk registers and mitigation tracking

**Requirements:**

* Ideally 7-10 years of relevant experience, with BCM and CM as the primary capabilities and credible ERM exposure.
* Practical experience across the BCM lifecycle, including Business Impact Analysis, recovery strategy, continuity planning, exercises and programme maintenance.
* Hands-on crisis management and incident response experience.
* Credible ERM experience, including risk assessment, risk registers, governance and management reporting.
* Able to draft clear policies and frameworks and implement them operationally.
* Strong stakeholder management, interviewing, workshop facilitation and written communication skills.
* Comfortable producing concise, practical and management-ready documentation.
* Experience in energy, infrastructure, manufacturing or another operationally complex, multi-site environment is advantageous, but not mandatory.

**Qualifications & Knowledge:**

* Graduate degree in business, risk management, engineering, operations or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 22301, with familiarity with ISO 22361 and ISO 31000.
* A relevant BCM, CM or Risk Management certification is desirable, including Business Continuity Institute (BC), Disaster Recovery Institute International (DRII), ISO 22301 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: Consultant for Documentation of Interministerial Consultations and Understanding of Prison Health Services in Mizoram and Punjab, HIV/HEP/ST
description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply
**Here**
PATH is a global nonprofit advancing health innovations for the people who need them most. With 50 years of experience, a global team of experts, and trusted partnerships spanning 70+ countries, PATH turns breakthroughs into better health for millions every single year.
  
  
**Duration**
15 days
  
  
**Cost**
Rs 10,000 per day
  
  
**Period of assignment**
November–December 2026 / dates to be agreed with PATH
  
  
**Background**
Mizoram and Punjab face significant public health and social challenges related to substance use, including the need for coordinated prevention, harm reduction, treatment, rehabilitation, mental health and recovery support. Addressing these challenges requires effective coordination across government departments and sectors, as well as accessible and responsive health services for populations with specific health needs, including people in prisons.
  
  
PATH is supporting processes to strengthen multisectoral responses to substance use in both Mizoram and Punjab. As part of this work, PATH plans to convene interministerial or multisectoral consultations in the two states. These consultations will bring together relevant government departments and ministries, stakeholders responsible for supply, harm, and demand reduction, educational institutions, private healthcare practitioners, and other relevant stakeholders. The consultations will provide an opportunity to discuss implementation gaps, identify priorities, and agree on recommendations and follow-up actions.
  
  
In addition, an understanding of health services in prisons in Mizoram (Aizawl) and Punjab (Patiala) is proposed to understand the availability, accessibility, quality, and continuity of essential health services for people in prison. The consultant will examine general health services and relevant services for communicable diseases, mental health, and substance use disorders, as appropriate to the context and permissions granted by the relevant authorities.
  
  
PATH seeks to engage one consultant to document the consultations in both the states and conduct develop a report on the current status of health services for prison inmates in both the states. The consultant will work in close coordination with PATH’s designated State Coordinators/consultants and other relevant PATH team members and will report to the designated PATH focal point.
  
  
**Scope of work for consultant**
**Documentation of consultation**

* Review the agenda, objectives, background materials, participant lists, and relevant state-level plans or strategies ahead of each consultation.
* Coordinate with the respective PATH State Coordinators to understand the purpose and expected outputs of each consultation and identify sessions or discussions requiring detailed documentation.
* Attend and document the interministerial consultation in Mizoram and the corresponding consultation in Punjab.
* To generate high-quality documentation of the interministerial consultations in Mizoram and Punjab and assess prison health services in both states, identifying key gaps and providing practical recommendations to inform programme and policy action.
* To capture key discussions, stakeholder perspectives, implementation gaps, recommendations, decisions, and agreed follow-up actions.
* To assess the availability and delivery of health services in selected prisons in Mizoram and Punjab, subject to permissions and access granted by the relevant authorities.
* To identify service delivery, infrastructure, human resource, commodity, referral, coordination, and continuity-of-care gaps in prison health services.
* To develop state-specific findings and recommendations, alongside a consolidated analysis of common issues and opportunities across Mizoram and Punjab.
* Share draft consultation documentation with the respective PATH State Coordinators for review and incorporate consolidated feedback.

**Understanding of Prison Health Services in Mizoram and Punjab**

* Identify good practices, service delivery gaps, operational constraints, and opportunities to strengthen prison health services in each state.
* Ensure that all interactions and data collection are conducted respectfully, confidentially, and in accordance with prison rules, permissions, and applicable ethical and safeguarding requirements.

title: Operations Innovations Senior Analyst
description:
**Locations**
: Gurgaon | London
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
BCG’s internal functions are the foundation of how our firm operates— representing thousands of professionals and hundreds of millions in investment that enable BCG to deliver exceptional client impact at global scale. As the firm continues to grow and technology changes rapidly, our internal operations face an extraordinary opportunity: to continue to evolve to an even more scalable, technology-enabled, global organization.
  
  
Our Operational Innovations (OI) team is at the center of this transformation. We are trusted partners to our functions and firm leadership for driving this ambitious change agenda. We enable step-change improvement in the effectiveness and efficiency of the firm by accelerating high-priority initiatives sponsored by the Operations Leadership Team and/or our Operating Committee. From technology & AI deployments to end-to-end process redesign, we partner with functional and geographic leaders to re-architect how the firm operates — faster, smarter, and more connected than ever before.
  
  
We don’t just manage change — we partner with the business to make it happen. Our team helps shape and accelerate BCG’s most strategic initiatives, providing hands-on executional leadership and deep expertise in transformation, digital enablement, and change management. We enable functions to scale effectively, improve performance, and unlock new sources of value through data, automation, and forward-thinking design.
  
  
**Key Activities And Responsibilities Include**

* In partnership with initiative owners and OI Project Managers, provide content support, research, expertise, analyses, or documentation to support project management and accelerate various functional or geographic improvement initiatives. Project emphasis to include operational improvement projects, and often the digital delivery of operational improvements, digital collaboration, and/or digital employee services.
* Support development of deliverables, ensuring highest potential for value delivery. Deliverables could include business improvement plans, process design, effective communication & engagement plans, implementation plans or supporting analyses for any of these. Expectation that analysts can distil key insights from analyses to presentation formats
* Work with line owners and OI team members to identify potential investments and/or process improvements to accelerate BCG’s digital and operational development. Assist in defining end-state processes and organizational models, as well as the path to achieve those end states.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads to support on the ground implementation of Change initiatives including enabling impacted users, embedding behavioral change and doing change impact analysis.
* Work with Program Managers and Change Managers/Leads translate project objectives and change needs into concrete employee communications, engagement actions and campaigns using a range of channels and media.
* Track project success and progress, working with project managers to ensure projects remain on course and objectives are realized on-time and within budget parameters, and that projects deliver against stated objectives and KPIs.
* Support development of senior management reporting and broader communications, as required, in part by providing related analyses and supporting documentation

What You'll Bring
  
  

* University degree or equivalent – ideally in a business related subject
* Experience working in a multi-national or large scale environment
* Data Analysis – strong data analysis skills, able to communicate key insights effectively
* Curiosity and focus on continuous development, learning
* Creativity and openness to new approaches, digital tools, Agile methodologies
* Project and Program Management a plus

Who You'll Work With
  
  
The OI Leadership Team and OI team members, especially project managers and change managers Internal Clients / stakeholders to develop communications to deliver project and stakeholder change objectives External Associates – our network of BCG approved contingent resources, when appropriate.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**You’re Good At**

* Organizing and managing project details with a bias for getting to great output quickly – You are flexible and organized in your work and can be effective across a range of activities and stakeholders
* Working in a complex environment at pace – You are analytical and comfortable managing multiple deliverables with multiple inputs often with high impact, time sensitive requirements
* Data Analysis – Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of information and data to draw out insights and help shape project plans, business cases, etc.
* Stakeholder Engagement – You can hear what someone needs, translate it into your own words, and create it. You are politically and organizationally savvy and can navigate/influence complex matrix organizations
* Structuring and analyzing information. You can take an idea for organizing or analyzing data and turn it into a useful deliverable. Strong attention to detail
* Culture and collaboration – you care deeply about the experience and engagement of your colleagues and believe in the core tenets of BCG’s purpose statements

*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*

title: Business & AI Transformation Consultant
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Process Excellence team works across the business to solve complex problems, improve end-to-end processes and deliver transformation initiatives that strengthen performance, enable growth and simplify how work is done. The team partners with business units, functions and technology teams to diagnose opportunities, redesign processes and operating practices, implement practical solutions, manage change and deliver measurable, sustainable outcomes.
  
  
Artificial intelligence is growing rapidly in scale, importance and business impact. Alongside the team’s established process-excellence and business-transformation agenda, the team is increasing its focus on designing, building and deploying AI-enabled solutions that improve decision-making, productivity and ways of working. This requires combining strong business and consulting disciplines with practical AI, digital and technology capability.
  
  
The team is therefore seeking a consultant with a strong foundation in transformation, business analysis and consulting, together with a greater focus on AI and technology. The Business & AI Transformation Consultant will support the design, build and deployment of AI solutions, alongside business transformation initiatives and process-excellence improvements. Working within defined projects or workstreams, the role will translate business opportunities into practical AI-enabled solutions, redesigned processes and improved ways of working. The role combines traditional consulting disciplines with hands-on AI and digital implementation, including business problem definition, solution design, data and source-system connectivity, prototyping, testing, deployment, stakeholder engagement, change management, adoption and measurement of business value.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* AI solution design, build and deployment: Design, build, test and deploy practical AI solutions that solve business problems and improve how work is performed. Support use-case definition, value and feasibility assessment, data readiness, solution design, prototyping, testing, responsible-AI controls, deployment, adoption and benefits tracking. Build solutions using Microsoft Copilot, GPT-based platforms and Abacus.AI, including copilots, RAG, agents, low-code automation and analytics applications.
* Process excellence and end-to-end improvement: Improve end-to-end processes through process mapping, root-cause analysis and identification of pain points, control gaps and performance opportunities. Help design, implement and sustain future-state improvements.
* Business transformation: Analyse business models, operating practices, capabilities and performance challenges, translating findings into transformation recommendations and practical changes to processes, operating models, technology and ways of working.
* Improvement execution and value delivery: Execute improvement initiatives that contribute to growth, productivity, cost, quality, risk and customer outcomes. Translate recommendations into actions, owners, milestones and measurable benefits.
* Process and operating model design: Design new or integrated processes for strategic, growth and technology-enabled initiatives, defining workflows, roles, decision rights, controls, governance and performance measures.
* Technology and ERP-enabled improvement: Partner with process, data and technology teams to improve technology-enabled processes. Support business requirements, testing, deployment readiness and adoption for ERP modernization and system implementations.
* Project and workstream management: Manage projects and workstreams through clear plans, milestones, risks, dependencies and status reporting. Coordinate contributors, maintain momentum and escalate issues early.
* Stakeholder engagement and influence: Build relationships across business, functional and technology teams. Develop evidence-based recommendations, incorporate feedback and support alignment and decision-making.
* Change management and business continuity: Assess change impacts and develop communications, training, deployment, adoption and business-continuity materials. Monitor adoption and address resistance or capability gaps.
* Workshops and co-design: Facilitate interviews, process mapping, problem-solving and solution-design workshops, translating discussions into clear decisions, actions, owners and next steps.
* Performance management and process health: Define baselines, KPIs and process-health measures. Analyse trends and track benefits across cost, quality, risk, cycle time, adoption and commercial outcomes.
* Executive communication: Develop concise, executive-ready presentations, business cases, decision papers and recommendations with clear storylines, insights and asks.
* Responsible AI and solution quality: Support privacy, security, responsible-AI, human oversight, testing and control requirements. Document risks and limitations and verify outputs before business use.
* Capability and knowledge building: Develop reusable process maps, templates, playbooks, training and implementation materials, and help teams sustain improved ways of working.

**Qualifications**

* Strong preference for experience with a Big 4 firm. Alternatively, a systems integrator, or another recognized strategy execution, operations, digital or implementation consultancy.
* Typically 2-3 years or more of relevant experience in management consulting, business transformation, technology consulting, systems integration, digital delivery or a comparable internal consulting role.
* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, economics, finance, information systems, computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience contributing to one or more end-to-end transformation, process-improvement, ERP, digital or AI-enabled implementation projects, with clear personal ownership of analysis and delivery outputs.
* Evidence of strong academic achievement and analytical capability. Consider achievement in context and recognize equivalent evidence of excellence, leadership or complex problem solving.
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

title: Senior Associate, Clinical Assets

**Who We Are**

Amplify Health Asia Pte. Limited (Amplify Health) is a pan-Asian health technology and analytics company which brings together health technology assets, proprietary data analytics and healthcare expertise to support innovation across the healthcare value chain.

Headquartered in Singapore, Amplify Health operates in 10 markets across the region: Australia, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, New Zealand, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam.

Amplify Health develops integrated solutions that empower healthcare payors, providers and policymakers across Asia to identify value and drive new partnerships, understand variation and address systemic inefficiencies—with the aim of improving outcomes for individuals and the sustainability of health systems.

Powered by a clinically enriched data foundation, Amplify Health’s health intelligence platform combines modular AI solutions, context-aware automation and deep regional insights to offer localised, AI-powered health solutions spanning health payment integrity to chronic disease management. The company’s technology has earned recognition at several industry competitions, including the Celent Model Insurer Awards, ITC Asia Awards and SBR Technology Excellence Awards.

As an ISO27001 certified organisation, Amplify Health maintains clearly defined policies, structured oversight mechanisms and ongoing risk assessments that ensure alignment with global best practices on enterprise data security.

**Our Vision and Ambition**

To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.

Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.

**Senior Associate, Clinical Assets**

The role requires extensive knowledge of clinical classification systems, healthcare terminologies, anatomy, physiology, disease processes, medical procedures, healthcare reimbursement structures, and healthcare data standards. * Maintain terminology reference materials

**Crosswalk & Mapping Management**

* ICD to SNOMED mappings
* ICD-9 to ICD-10 mappings
* ICD-10 to ICD-11 mappings
* CPT to SNOMED mappings
* Internal terminology mappings
* Market-specific coding mappings
* Review crosswalk consistency and integrity
* Assist with mapping governance standards
* Support mapping optimization initiatives

**Clinical Data Standardization**

* Support standardization of healthcare datasets
* Participate in data normalization initiatives
* Review healthcare schemas and taxonomies
* Support data model alignment across platforms
* Ensure consistency of clinical terminology usage
* Develop recommendations for content harmonization

* Assist with knowledge base development

**Clinical Research & Market Intelligence**

* Monitor emerging coding standards and frameworks
* Research global healthcare classification systems
* Evaluate regional reimbursement and coding methodologies

description:
**Position Title:**
AI Deployment & Enablement Lead
  
  
**Position Type:**
Regular - Full-Time
  
  
**Requisition ID:**
43595
  
  
**Overview**
Our Digital Technology team's goal is to leverage technology and data to drive profitable growth, enhance customer experience, and further our purpose of celebrating real connections through delicious, planet-friendly food.
  
  
McCain has embarked on an ambitious digital transformation across our business, from Agriculture and Manufacturing to Commercial and Corporate Functions. As part of this transformation, we are making significant investments in digital capabilities, data, automation, and Artificial Intelligence (AI).
  
  
The AI Deployment & Enablement Lead plays a critical role in helping McCain realize value from AI investments by driving successful deployment, adoption, and business enablement of AI solutions across the enterprise. This role serves as the bridge between AI product teams, technology teams, business stakeholders, and end users to ensure AI capabilities are effectively implemented, embraced, and sustained.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong project execution, stakeholder management, change leadership, and business acumen to accelerate adoption of AI-powered solutions that improve productivity, decision making, employee experience, and business outcomes.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Reporting to the AI Deployment & Enablement Manager, the AI Deployment & Enablement Lead is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing the deployment and adoption of AI solutions across McCain.
  
  
This role partners closely with product owners, AI engineers, business teams, functional leaders, and change management partners to ensure AI capabilities are successfully launched, effectively utilized, and continuously improved. The role focuses on driving business readiness, user adoption, training, communications, stakeholder engagement, value realization, and operational enablement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilites**
**AI Deployment & Implementation**

* Lead deployment planning and execution for AI products, tools, and capabilities.
* Coordinate implementation activities across business, technology, and external partners.
* Ensure deployment plans are aligned to business priorities, timelines, and operational readiness requirements.
* Monitor implementation progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation activities.
* Support pilot programs, proof-of-concepts, and scaled enterprise rollouts.

**Adoption & Enablement**

* Develop strategies to drive successful adoption of AI solutions across functions and regions.
* Create adoption roadmaps and sustainment plans that encourage long-term utilization.
* Identify adoption barriers and implement actions to improve user engagement and effectiveness.
* Measure user adoption, engagement, and business outcomes associated with deployed AI solutions.
* Share best practices and success stories to accelerate enterprise-wide AI maturity.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build strong partnerships with business leaders, product teams, and technology teams.
* Translate technical AI concepts into language that is understandable and actionable for business stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment among cross-functional teams throughout deployment initiatives.
* Act as a trusted advisor supporting business readiness and organizational adoption.

**Change Management & Communications**

* Partner with change management and communications teams to create deployment and adoption strategies.
* Design and execute communication plans to support awareness, understanding, and adoption.
* Assess organizational impacts and help stakeholders prepare for new ways of working.
* Support leaders in effectively communicating AI initiatives and benefits to their teams.

**Training & Learning**

* Identify capability and skill development needs associated with AI adoption.
* Develop and coordinate training materials, learning resources, workshops, and enablement sessions.
* Support the creation of role-based learning pathways for employees and leaders.
* Foster a culture of responsible AI usage and continuous learning.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure deployments align with McCain's AI governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Gather user feedback and deployment insights to inform future product improvements.
* Track key success metrics and provide reporting on adoption, value realization, and business impact.
* Recommend opportunities to improve deployment methodologies and enablement approaches.

**MEASURES OF SUCCESS**
**AI Adoption**

* Adoption targets achieved for deployed AI solutions.
* Growth in active users and sustained utilization over time.
* Positive user experience and satisfaction scores.

**Business Value**

* Demonstrated business outcomes resulting from AI deployments.
* Improvement in productivity, efficiency, decision quality, or user experience.
* Improved realization of expected benefits from AI investments.

**Stakeholder Satisfaction**

* Positive feedback from business leaders and stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration and partnership effectiveness.
* Successful management of deployment timelines and expectations.

**Delivery Excellence**

* AI deployments delivered on schedule and within agreed scope.
* Risks and issues identified and managed effectively.
* Consistent application of deployment and enablement standards.

**Job Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Information Systems, Change Management, Organizational Development, or equivalent experience.
* 5-8 years of experience in technology delivery, product deployment, digital transformation, change management, enablement, or related fields.
* Experience supporting enterprise technology implementations and adoption initiatives.
* Strong understanding of project delivery methodologies and change management practices.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in global organizations.
* Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, automation, or digital technologies preferred.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Strong organizational and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a dynamic environment.
* Experience developing training, communication, and adoption strategies is considered an asset.

**Other Information**

+ AI Product Teams
+ Data & Analytics Teams

+ Business Functional Leaders

+ Cybersecurity & Data Governance Teams
+ Digital Transformation Teams

The ICICI Bank Probationary Officer Program nurtures young professionals to pursue a career in banking, with a strong focus on learning, capability building, and cultural grounding. The program prepares participants to join the Bank as Relationship Managers in a sales role, guided by the Bank’s culture of “seva bhav”- serving customers with integrity, empathy, and responsibility. In this sales role, you will engage closely with customers to understand their needs, build long-term relationships, and responsibly offer appropriate banking solutions, in line with the Bank’s values of truth, trust, and transparency, and the principle of being fair to the customer and fair to the Bank. The role involves continuous customer interactions and may require travel within and around the assigned location or city.

The program includes 2 months of structured classroom training at a residential campus, the cost of which is borne by ICICI Bank. Upon successful completion of the program, you will be placed in Relationship Management (sales) roles at various locations across the country

**Read more about the program below!**

**Eligibility**

* **Education:**
  Graduates, Engineers, Post Graduates

  60% and above in 10th and Graduation
* **Role and Location Fungibility:**

  2 Months Classroom Training

  Lakh
  to
  **₹5.50**
  Lakh (Based on location).

**Selection Process**

* **Online Aptitude Test:**
  Once the applicants are shortlisted, the first step is to undergo an online aptitude test. It comprises of four sections (Verbal, Quantitative, Logical ability, General Awareness).
* **Interview (Face-to-Face):**
  Applicants who have successfully completed the aptitude test shall be invited for the in-person interview. Interview Details will be shared on your registered email ID.

**Role of a Relationship Manager**

After completing the Probationary Officer Program you would take up the role of a Relationship Manager. Please find below the role description of a Relationship Manager.

A
**Relationship Manager**
is a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs. The core philosophy is being “Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank”. At ICICI Bank, our customer-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. Relationship Managers collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best in class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like saving solutions, loan products, overdraft solutions, Insta loans, investment solutions, care products, trade solutions, business loans, or wealth management solutions while upholding our fundamental value of being
**Fair to the Bank**
and
**Fair to the Customer**
.

**Bankable individuals not just Bankers: We hire from diverse educational background!**

We at ICICI Bank are in continuous pursuit of creating consistent customer delight and superior experience. Our Relationship Managers are empowered individuals who champion the cause of customer experience and have penchant for building and nurturing business relationships. If you are an individual, whose heart echoes with our aspiration, look no more. We do not just choose diverse minds but celebrate their success. If you are a bankable individual without banking experience, you are very much welcome .Our training programs equip you to get ready for the role of a Relationship Manager. You are welcome to apply for the role of Relationship Manager.

* Build long-term relationships with acquired clients.
* Identify opportunities for additional services, renewals and account expansion.

**4. Pipeline Management and Reporting**

* Maintain an updated record of prospects, conversations and sales opportunities.
* Share regular updates on leads, meetings, proposals and closures.
* Work towards mutually agreed lead generation and client acquisition targets.

Industries We Are Targeting

We are particularly interested in professionals who have connections or experience working with businesses in the following sectors:

* Fashion, Apparel and Clothing Brands

* Beauty, Skincare and Cosmetics
* Jewellery and Accessories
* Hospitality, Restaurants and Cafés
* Hotels and Travel Businesses
* Education, EdTech and Universities
* Real Estate and Other Consumer-Facing Businesses

* Independent Business Development Professionals
* Freelance Sales and Business Development Consultants
* Agency Business Development Executives
* Client Acquisition Specialists
* Marketing and Advertising Sales Professionals
* B2B Sales Consultants
* Independent Business Development Partners with an existing client network

Required Skills and Experience

* 3+ years of experience in business development, B2B sales, client acquisition or a related field.

* Ability to independently identify prospects and approach decision-makers.
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Understanding of digital marketing and agency service offerings.
* Ability to manage sales conversations and close business opportunities.
* Strong networking and relationship-building capabilities.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented and comfortable working independently.

**An existing network of founders, business owners, marketing heads or decision-makers will be a significant advantage.**

Compensation and Partnership Benefits

This opportunity is designed for ambitious business development professionals who value professional independence, performance-driven rewards and the opportunity to build their earning potential in proportion to the business they generate.

This partnership offers a commission-based earning model where your compensation is directly linked to the business you successfully generate for Gideon Alliance, making this opportunity valuable with:

* **Uncapped Earning Potential:**
  Your earnings can grow with the number and value of clients you successfully acquire.
* **Performance-Linked Rewards:**
  Your contribution to business growth is directly reflected in your earnings.
* **Professional Independence:**
  Enjoy the flexibility to manage your own schedule, prospecting activities and professional network.
* **Agency Support:**
  Focus on building relationships and acquiring clients while our internal team supports you with marketing strategy, service proposals, creative execution and end-to-end client delivery.
* **Long-Term Growth:**

**There is no fixed earning ceiling.**
Your earning potential grows with the value of business you bring to Gideon Alliance. The more successfully you build relationships and acquire clients, the greater your opportunity to earn.

* Opportunity to work with an expanding 360° marketing agency.
* Performance-linked earning potential.
* Flexible working arrangement.

In more than ten countries around the world, The Knot Worldwide champions the power of celebration. Our global family of brands provide best-in-class products, services and content to take celebration planning from inspiration to action. At the core of our business is our industry-leading global online wedding Vendor Marketplace, connecting couples with local wedding professionals and a comprehensive suite of personalized wedding websites, planning tools, invitations, and registry services that make wedding planning easier for couples around the globe. Each year, we connect more than 4.5 million users with around 900,000 global small businesses through our Vendor Marketplace.

At The Knot Worldwide, we believe in doing work that matters. Each year, we help millions of couples around the world celebrate life’s most meaningful moments, while also helping hundreds of thousands of global small business owners get discovered and scale. Life here means working alongside a team that cares deeply, not just about the work you do, but about the life you live. We prioritize employee well-being and development through meaningful opportunities for growth, and we celebrate milestones and wins in a big way. After all, celebrations are what we do best.

We are looking for a dynamic and driven candidate to join our Venue vertical team.   Hustler mindset, relationship-builder, market-awareness, and committed to delivering results.

**WORK MODEL:**

This role is field job in Delhi with initial 1 week training in Gurgaon office and the candidate will be expected to travel across Delhi NCR to meet clients.

**AI FLUENCY**

At TKWW, AI is a tool that helps our teams work smarter, move faster, and spend more time on the work that matters most. We expect every employee, in every role, to build fluency with the AI tools relevant to their work, use them thoughtfully and with sound judgment, and bring curiosity as these tools keep evolving. This isn't about replacing our people's expertise — it's about equipping every employee to use AI to raise the bar on the work we do together.

* **Raise the bar:**
  You define "great" and work backwards. You don't just accept how it's been done, but boldly define how it should be. You are unafraid to innovate, learn, and keep moving forward toward our shared vision.
* **Be all in:**
  You believe in our mission and take ownership of your work. You debate openly to reach the best outcomes, speaking with clarity and care, embracing diverse perspectives, then commit fully.
* **Celebrate impact:**
  You measure success by the outcomes you create. You hold yourself accountable to delivering value, while recognizing progress and the lessons learned along the way. You love to win, together.

**WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:**

We provide meaningful, high-impact benefits designed to support the holistic well-being of our diverse workforce and help our people thrive both professionally and personally. From physical and mental wellness to flexible time off our programs are built around the moments that matter most.

**TOGETHER@TKWW: OUR APPROCH TO HYBRID WORK**

Whether a role is Together@TKWW-eligible or not, we believe in purposeful moments to come together, build strong relationships, and drive bold ideas forward.

description:
Role highlights

* Department: Missions Sales
* Reports to: VP of Mission Sales (dotted line to the CEO of ICEYE India)
* Employment type: Permanent
* Workplace model: Hybrid, with travel

Why this role matters
  
  
As Mission Sales Director, India, you'll lead sovereign satellite and ISR mission sales to Indian government and defence customers, at a time when ICEYE is establishing its local presence and India is rapidly expanding its space-based ISR capabilities.
  
  
You will own the full sales cycle for Missions satellite programmes, from identifying and shaping opportunities to closing multi-year deals. Working closely with the CEO of ICEYE India, you will build strategic relationships with government and defence decision-makers, align our offering with India's priorities for indigenous capability and local partnerships, and deliver sustainable revenue growth together with ICEYE's Missions, Data and Solutions teams.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
  
  
ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
  
  
ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
  
  
Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1,000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
  
  
Day-to-day responsibilities
  
  

* Own and drive revenue growth for ICEYE's Missions business in India
* Identify, shape, qualify and close sovereign satellite and ISR mission opportunities with Indian government and defence customers
* Build and sustain trusted relationships across the Ministry of Defence, the armed forces, defence and intelligence agencies, and the national space ecosystem
* Shape opportunities in line with Indian defence procurement processes and indigenisation priorities, including local industrial partnerships where relevant
* Develop and manage a qualified pipeline, including capture plans, win strategies and accurate forecasting
* Lead complex strategic sales processes, including opportunity reviews, bid or no-bid decisions, proposal coordination and commercial positioning
* Collaborate across Missions, Data and Solutions to align customer needs, technical capabilities and delivery plans
* Represent ICEYE in India through customer meetings, industry events and strategic stakeholder engagement
* Use AI tools to work smarter, from account research and capture planning to proposals and forecasting
* Maintain strong CRM discipline and provide clear market intelligence to support business planning

What we're looking for
  
  
**Must haves**

* 5+ years of strategic sales or business development in aerospace, defence, space, ISR, earth observation or related government technology
* 5+ years of experience selling complex solutions, including to international or export customers
* Experience selling to Indian government customers, defence organisations or public-sector decision-makers
* An existing network across relevant Indian government, defence and space organisations
* Strong understanding of earth observation, ISR or satellite-based capabilities, ideally including SAR
* Familiarity with Indian defence procurement processes and indigenisation and local partnership requirements
* Proven ability to run complex sales cycles, including qualification, opportunity development, capture planning, stakeholder mapping and closing
* Professional working proficiency in English
* Willingness to travel across India and to Finland

**Nice to haves**

* Proficiency in Hindi or other regional languages
* Previous military, defence, intelligence or security-sector experience
* Experience with Indian defence tenders and partnerships with Indian primes or integrators
* Experience producing capture plans and delivering against win strategies
* Hands-on use of AI tools in sales work (research, proposals, automation)
* Experience with Salesforce or another CRM
* Sales training in Miller Heiman, Korn Ferry, Shipley or a similar methodology

Application process
  
  

* Online Assessment
* Recruiter interview
* Peer interview (CEO of ICEYE India)
* VP of Mission Sales interview
* References
* C-suite interview

Working at ICEYE
  
  
At ICEYE, you'll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.
  
  
**How We Work (our Values)**

* Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
* Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the "why" behind decisions.
* See the big picture: Stay close to what's happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
* Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
* Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
* Have fun: What we do matters and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

**Benefits**
Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.
  
  
**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.
  
  
We're committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us and we'll do our best to help.
  
  
Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

title: Cluster Manager - Group Sales Agency - Delhi
company: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited
description:
**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
While the current market sees more than 15 non-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalised service provider (6) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
  
  
Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as ententions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
  
  
**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016.
  
  
ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6 th entrant in a category with well-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
  
  
ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes -
  
  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper-less approach right from identifying to on-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers & employees.

**Key Challenges for the role –**

* Business Challenges: The strategy adopted by the market participants in order to actively and aggressively source business has a key impact on the market dynamics. While there have been service providers who have remained consistently focussed on the risk business, there have been other players who have adopted a very aggressive. Hence how we fare in the market also gets influenced by what strategy these participants pursue.
* Soft Insurance Market: Considering the soft insurance market in India, offering solutions to price sensitive clients may turn risky. Such clients may negotiate hard on the unique solution offered which eats away the cos profitability and may opt to place the business with other manufacturers. It is extremely important to design and customize the right solution for the right set of clients.
* Lack of historical data: Data based analytics is possible for players having historical data and in business for years. At the onset opportunity identification needs to be done basis feedback from partners, clients and experience. The decision to pursue an opportunity might not always be backed by data.
* Inter departmental challenges: Offering and structuring a deal often involves working with various departments like operations, claims, actuarial etc to see what best can be offered. There may be instances that actuarial may not be comfortable offering a particular price that has been made available to the customer and hence working with them to see how best can things be modulated is often a tough ask. Also getting various stakeholders and constituents to the process like operations to understand the sensitivities of the various partners involved and seeing the creation of a process which meets our objective without offending either the partner concerned or the internal norms gets to be a challenge that has to be fought on a daily basis.
* Partners: Given that close to 90 percent of the activity in terms of the deals coming in the market to be fought are from our partners, working with them in terms of structuring their payouts gets to be a challenge. There are peers in the market who adopt aggressive payout strategies whether it be a new business or it be a renewal and have a faster turn-around process for the same to be remitted. Besides this, they keep doing off-sites at local levels for the team players and hence that gets them a marginal head start. Hence these factors have to be taken into account and managed accordingly. How we build a scenario with partners where they start to look at us as a longer duration partnership and work in progress and not just as a transaction basis remains a key. Similarly building a relationship with partners to constantly seek insights on what the competition is upto and also what are some of the new thoughts that can be pursued is a key challenge that needs to be pursued.
* Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4- 7 key result areas)

**Key Result Areas**
Supporting Actions
  
  
Driving sales via Various channels for group sales
  
  

* Initiate and maintain continuous interaction with brokers and other intermediaries
* Obtain quote request from market & Deliver them on time to the client/partners
* Weekly tracking of business growth. Seeking support from various stake holders towards closure of business

Maintaining Pipeline
  
  

* Managing a pipeline to achieve desired numbers ant to continuously updating the same

Partner engagement
  
  

* Understand market dynamics and offering of other manufacturers to the channel partners
* Drive channel strategy as per cos directives to increase revenue growth in profitable segments (like SME and creditor) / large clients
* Take regular feedback from channel partners to innovate products and solutions at an organizational level
* Pursue client specific requirement along with channel partners to support conversion
* Track channel profitability

P & L
  
  

* Working with product team to focus on conversions and retention of profitable clients
* Create additional profitable revenue streams basis new trends in the employee benefit space
* Responsible for driving segmented business and profitability to ensure achievement of target business numbers like SME and creditor.

Renewal persistency
  
  

* Decoding client’s requirement, pain points and opportunity areas
* Providing need based solutions to clients to increase stickiness.
* This would involve building & strengthening relationships across the various stakeholders within the company, within the concerned partner for the account as also within the internal stakeholders in the co. to ensure that the offering we propose, meets their expectations.

Team Management
  
  

* Recruit the best talent from the available clutter
* Mentor, supervise and coach and well as provide direction to subordinates.
* Facilitate development of skills of sub-ordinates to enable them to perform and achieve their roles as well as take on higher responsibilities.

title: Senior Training Content Developer
description:
**Role Title:**
Senior Training Content Developer

**Typical Experience:**
6+ years of full-time Training Design & Development / Instructional Design experience

**Role Description:**

As a Senior Training Content Developer, you play a lead role in designing and building the instructional content that drives change adoption in business transformation initiatives. Within a project setting, you work closely with change practitioners, management consultants, subject matter experts, and other training specialists to translate business and process requirements into effective, engaging learning content. Your primary responsibilities include leading the design and development of end-to-end training content – course materials, job aids, simulations, and assessments – designing role-based training curricula, establishing instructional design standards and content quality benchmarks, and monitoring and measuring training effectiveness and compliance. You take part in work groups, work sessions, and interviews with business and technical representatives, typically as a lead content owner rather than an observer. You bring seasoned, hands-on experience with HCL Digital Consulting practices and techniques specific to training, organizational change management, business transformation, and organizational design, and you are expected to apply that experience with minimal oversight.

In this role, you are expected to operate independently, exercise sound judgment on content design trade-offs, and mentor and review the work of less experienced training developers. Your sphere of influence within the project team generally includes team leaders, project managers, HCL and client peers, and client business users and subject matter experts. From an HCL management perspective, you should contact your HCL Reporting Manager (RM) for career guidance and orientation related to operating principles and project business practices.

Competency requirements for a Senior Training Content Developer will vary in mix and balance based on the opportunities presented by each project assignment. We expect that the majority of the competency examples listed below will be carried out independently, with this role also reviewing and guiding the work of junior training developers.

**Formal Certification and Training:**

Formal certification is not required for this role; however, given the seniority of this position, you should hold – or be actively working towards – a recognized instructional design or talent development credential such as Certified Professional in Talent Development (CPTD), Certified Training and Development Professional (CTDP), or a recognized instructional design certificate (e.g., ATD Instructional Design Certificate).

**Expected Skills and Capabilities:**

* Lead the definition of timing, frequency, stakeholder groups, message content, senders, media types, and feedback loops for a formal communication plan supporting training and content rollout
* Own the gathering and validation of educational requirements, and determine the appropriate proportion of instructional materials to reference documentation
* Apply adult learning theory and instructional design models (e.g., ADDIE, SAM) to structure content that supports retention and on-the-job application
* Demonstrate expert familiarity with learning management systems (LMS) for assigning and tracking corporate training, such as uPerform, including the ability to configure and troubleshoot client-specific LMS setups with minimal assistance
* Demonstrate expert-level proficiency with learning development and deployment tools such as Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, TechSmith Camtasia, GoToWebinar, WebEx, MS Teams, etc.
* Lead the development of instructional courseware covering specific skills and behaviors or general instruction on a particular topic, and review courseware developed by junior training developers
* Lead or co-facilitate training sessions tailored to specific client audiences
* Lead the development of role-based training curricula for in-scope roles in the change initiative
* Evaluate the benefits and limitations of various training delivery modes – computer-based modules, instructor-led training (ILT), virtual instructor-led training (VILT), and hybrid content delivery – and recommend the appropriate mix
* Own the development of the training approach, training plan, and implementation timeline
* Lead the development of reference documentation content, including online help, user manuals, and other reference materials
* Design and lead Train-the-Trainer (TTT) programs
* Lead project estimating activities for the training content development workstream
* Estimate and track effort remaining for assigned tasks and, where applicable, for the broader content development team
* Build credibility and partnership with appropriate client personnel through planned participation in client meetings, presentations, and working sessions
* Prepare personal time and expense reports following established HCL guidelines
* Prepare and present personal and workstream weekly status reports and task sheets that clearly outline issues and progress
* Manage the scope of assigned tasks to stay within project estimates and proactively alert project management to out-of-scope conditions
* Complete all assigned tasks by established project due dates
* Understand the structure of the client assignment (e.g., project plan/scope, statement of work, pricing strategy) and how the training content workstream contributes to the overall goals of the project team
* Provide input to task estimates when requested by project or proposal management
* Actively participate in, and where appropriate lead, status, team-building, and all-hands meetings with project staff
* Demonstrate strong written communication and presentation skills, including to senior client and executive audiences
* Demonstrate proficiency with standard desktop tools used to accomplish daily business activities and facilitate communications
* High proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite of applications
