description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Data Platforms Specialist**
**The opportunity**
We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Risk and Compliance Transformation Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. That’s how we develop outstanding leaders who team to deliver on our promises to all our stakeholders, and in so doing, play a critical role in building a better working world for our people, for our clients and for our communities. Sound interesting? Well, this is just the beginning. Because whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.
  
  
We are looking for a Risk Data Platforms Specialist in the Risk and Compliance Transformation team, with 4-9 years of regulatory reporting data platforms experience with preferred prior experience in capital, financial and other regulatory reports, involving identification of critical data elements, documentation and validation of end-to-end reporting lineage, source-system analysis and data extraction processes, mapping of data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems. In this role, you will play a dual role – a) of documenting data lineage, controls and transformations and b) support the team for overall product or project delivery involving risk data aggregation and reporting, team member technical coaching etc.
  
  
EY Digital Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Risk and Compliance Transformation practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s DE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Hands-on Lineage**

* Identify report owners, critical data elements and reporting metrics
* Use working experience for documenting end-to-end data lineage, CDE identification, controls and evidence
* Understand data transformations/aggregation at system hops and identify associated data risks in line with BCBS 239 guidelines
* Map controls to mitigate data risks and identify any control gaps

**Technical Leadership**

* Demonstrate the right-ways of to capture and validate data lineage documentation
* Map data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems
* Demonstrate critical thinking, strong communication, logical reasoning and technical convincing as needed

**Quality Assurance**

* Perform QA reviews of team deliverables to ensure client expectations on delivery quality are met
* Automation of lineage capture and documentation activities wherever possible using most feasible approaches (Excel/ VBA or Python or any available tool/s)

**Collaboration & Support**

* Ability to work across Regulatory Reporting, Finance, Risk, Data Office and IT
* Provide functional support to all phases of delivery (Sprints, Testing, Hypercare etc.)
* Ability to guide and coach junior team members

**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* 4-9 years of experience in data used for risk, financial and supervisory reporting within the broader data governance context, with right mix of practical lineage capability and strong analytical, investigative, documentation and stakeholder-management skills
* Working experience in Capital Adequacy and Risk Exposures (any 1 or more subject areas of  capital adequacy, own funds, credit risk, market risk, operational risk, leverage, liquidity metrics, large exposures, asset encumbrance)
* Working experience in:

+ Source-system analysis and data extraction processes
+ Mapping of data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems
+ Automation of lineage capture and documentation activities
+ Data catalogue, metadata repository and reporting architecture initiatives
+ Identification of report owners, critical data elements and reporting metrics
+ Documentation and validation of end-to-end reporting lineage
+ Maintenance of reporting inventories, controls and governance documentation
+ Coordination with Data Office, Finance, Risk Management and other stakeholders
+ Good to have:

- Support during regulatory reviews and onsite inspections
- IFRS 9 ECL Models
- Mapping of PD, LGD and EAD inputs, staging, forward-looking information, calibrations, overlays and calculation outputs
- Documentation of model dependencies, assumptions, controls, reconciliations, governance, validation and approvals

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Any Data Engineering certifications such as AWS Data Engineer Certification, Azure Data Engineer Certification, Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer
* AI or ML Certifications

**Education**
:
  
  

* Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

• Specify washer-disinfectors, sterilisers, low-temperature sterilisers, and packing and tracking systems, along with their utility needs (RO water, steam, drainage, exhaust).

**3. Pharmacy**

• Plan the main and satellite pharmacies, including automated dispensing, unit-dose systems, compounding, chemotherapy reconstitution, cold-chain storage and controlled-drug storage.

• Integrate the pharmacy with the Hospital Information System (HIS), the pneumatic tube system and material flows.

**4. Lab**

• Plan the clinical labs (biochemistry, haematology, microbiology, histopathology and molecular), the blood bank and research labs, including total lab automation where it makes sense.

• Define biosafety levels, biosafety cabinets, fume hoods, and the related utility, drainage and effluent requirements.

**5. Shielding**

• Coordinate radiation shielding for X-ray, CT, cath labs, PET-CT, nuclear medicine and LINAC/radiotherapy bunkers, and RF shielding for MRI.

• Review shielding calculations with the Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) / physicist, and coordinate AERB layout approvals and licensing.

**6. Pneumatic Tube**

• Define the stations, zones, routes and capacity of the Pneumatic Tube System (PTS) for samples, blood and medicines.

• Coordinate the PTS with the labs, pharmacy, clinical departments and building services.

**7. Simulation**

• Plan the Medical College simulation and skills centre, including high-fidelity manikins, simulated OT, ICU and ward setups, and AV and debriefing systems.

• Ensure the centre complies with National Medical Commission (NMC) requirements.

description:

**About Othrys Aviation:**

Othrys Aviation is an aircraft manufacturing company focused on designing and developing safe, reliable, and high-performance aviation solutions. We bring together engineering, manufacturing, testing, and innovation to build aircraft that meet stringent operational and regulatory standards.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented
**Aerospace Engineer**
to contribute to the design, development, analysis, testing, and certification of aircraft and related systems.

The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, practical problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across design, manufacturing, quality, testing, supply chain, and regulatory compliance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the conceptual, preliminary, and detailed design of aircraft, airframes, components, and aerospace systems.
* Perform engineering calculations and analyses related to aerodynamics, aircraft structures, loads, stability, performance, weight, and material selection.
* Develop and review 3D models, engineering drawings, assemblies, specifications, and bills of materials.
* Conduct or support structural, stress, fatigue, vibration, thermal, CFD, and finite element analyses, depending on project requirements.
* Assist in the integration of propulsion, avionics, electrical, mechanical, flight-control, and other aircraft systems.
* Translate design requirements into manufacturable engineering solutions.
* Work closely with manufacturing teams to resolve production issues, design deviations, and non-conformities.
* Participate in prototype development, ground testing, flight testing, validation, and verification activities.
* Prepare test plans, procedures, technical reports, compliance documents, and engineering change records.
* Investigate design or test failures, perform root-cause analysis, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure designs comply with applicable aviation regulations, airworthiness requirements, quality standards, and internal engineering processes.
* Support certification activities and coordinate the preparation of technical evidence for regulatory reviews.
* Collaborate with suppliers and vendors to evaluate aerospace components, materials, technical specifications, and manufacturing capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve aircraft performance, safety, reliability, manufacturability, weight, cost, and operational efficiency.
* Maintain accurate configuration control and documentation throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Stay updated on developments in aerospace technology, aircraft manufacturing, materials, propulsion, and regulatory requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–7 years of relevant experience in aerospace engineering, aircraft design, aviation manufacturing, defence, UAVs, or a related engineering environment.
* Strong understanding of engineering mechanics, aerodynamics, aircraft structures, materials, propulsion, flight mechanics, or aircraft systems.
* Experience with engineering design and analysis tools such as
  **CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, ANSYS, NASTRAN, MATLAB/Simulink, or equivalent software**
  .
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, technical specifications, test data, and manufacturing documentation.
* Familiarity with aircraft development, testing, verification, validation, and configuration-management processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause-analysis skills.
* Good technical documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary, safety-critical engineering environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Mechanical, or a related engineering discipline.
* Experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Aircraft structural design and stress analysis
* Aerodynamics and computational fluid dynamics
* Flight mechanics, stability, and control
* Propulsion-system integration
* Avionics or aircraft-system integration
* Composite-material design and manufacturing
* Aircraft performance and weight estimation
* Ground testing or flight testing
* Airworthiness and certification
* Knowledge of aviation standards and regulatory frameworks issued by
  **DGCA, FAA, EASA, or equivalent authorities**
  .
* Familiarity with aerospace quality and development standards such as
  **AS9100, DO-160, ARP4754A, or other applicable standards**
  .
* Experience working with prototype aircraft, unmanned aerial vehicles, light aircraft, or new aircraft-development programmes.
* Exposure to Product Lifecycle Management and configuration-control systems.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to contribute directly to aircraft development and manufacturing.
* Exposure to the complete aircraft-development lifecycle—from design and prototyping to testing and certification.
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering and manufacturing teams.
* A technically challenging environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Competitive compensation based on experience and technical expertise.

**Candidates are encouraged to include details of relevant aircraft, UAV, aerospace design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, or certification projects in their application.**

* Win in AI answers (GEO and AEO) - Grow how often ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and AI Overviews and AI Mode name, cite, and recommend SocialPilot, and how often they name us against our competitors.

* Run outreach and collaborations. Get SocialPilot onto the "best tools" lists, review roundups, publications, Reddit threads, and YouTube videos that rank on Google and that AI answers cite. Set Reddit and YouTube targets with the teams that produce for them. Build lasting relationships with publishers, partners and creators, and earn links and mentions through digital PR.

* Manage our listings and review sites. Own how SocialPilot appears on G2, Capterra, and other review sites, software directories, and AI app directories. Grow reviews and keep how we describe SocialPilot consistent everywhere, so Google and AI assistants understand what we are.

* Get the right content published. Work with the content team to plan, brief, and publish the content organic growth needs, on time. Review the search side, so every page answers a real buyer question well enough for Google and AI answers to use it.

##### **Turn discovery into revenue:**

* Grow revenue from organic. Own new sign-ups, paying customers, and revenue from organic search and AI answers, and keep growing them. Build the monthly forecast for discovery and revenue, and hit it.

* Put buyer pages first. Win back the searches where buyers compare tools, and make sure those pages lead to a trial.

* Diagnose and measure. Use Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, AI visibility tools and log data to find what moved and why. Check rankings live, by country and device, before reporting them. Tie every channel, including AI answers, to the sign-ups and revenue it brings, and turn data into decisions.

* Bring new ideas and test them. Do not wait for a brief. Bring your own ideas for more discovery and revenue every month, from what the best SaaS teams, our competitors, and new AI search features are doing. Size each one, and test the best with the cheapest test, a clear hypothesis, and a kill rule set before the data comes in. Stay ahead of Google updates and changes in AI search, and act on them.

##### **Lead and run organic:**

* Lead the SEO team. Lead the SEO team and do hands-on work alongside them. Set clear weekly targets, review work, coach, and hire. Manage SEO tools and agencies within budget.

* Run technical SEO and guard every release. Own the SEO backlog with our web developers. Crawling, indexing, site architecture, structured data, page speed, migrations, and redirects. No page is removed, redirected, or moved without an SEO check, and every site change goes in a release log, so we always know what changed and when.

* Use AI and automation. Build AI workflows and agents with the team to research, brief, audit, and report faster.

* Work across teams. Partner with content, web, design, product, and paid to ship pages and fixes on time. Set the brief, hold the quality bar, and keep work moving.

##### **Must have skills:**

* 3+ years managing an SEO team with direct reports, while still doing the work yourself. You have set their targets, reviewed their work, grown them, and hired. Informal mentoring does not count.

* Proven revenue impact from SEO. You have grown revenue through organic search and can show the sign-ups, paying customers, or revenue your work brought. You measure SEO by how many new people discover the brand and the revenue that discovery brings, not by traffic or rankings alone. You know which searches bring buyers and which bring readers. You have built an organic forecast and owned a quarterly number. You can walk us through a drop you diagnosed and recovered, or growth you built, and what it was worth.

* 8+ years of hands-on SEO B2B SaaS experience.

* A deep, current understanding of how search is changing across SEO, GEO, and how LLMs find, choose, and cite their sources. You keep up every week and can show what you changed in your own work because of it.

* Reddit and YouTube experience, such as growing a brand's presence in Reddit threads or in YouTube search.

* Hands-on with AI visibility tools such as BrightEdge and Profound. You know what they measure well and what they miss.

* Outreach and listings experience. You have gotten a brand onto third-party lists and roundups, run digital PR and link outreach, built partner and creator collaborations, and managed product listings on review sites and software directories such as G2 and Capterra.

* AI focused. You use AI tools every day, and you have built AI workflows or agents that made your team faster. You can show us one.

* You bring your own ideas. You spot what others miss, size it and test it without being asked, and can show us two or three ideas that came from you, not from a brief, and what they brought.

title: Cluster Manager for Salons
description:
**Company Description**
Naturals Salon & Spa, launched in 2000, is one of the world’s fastest-growing salon chains, with over 800 salons across India and an ambitious target of 3,000 salons by 2029. The brand pioneered the concept of unisex salons in India and has become widely recognized for accessible, high-quality hair, beauty, and wellness services. Naturals serves a diverse clientele through its portfolio of sub-brands, including Naturals Unisex Salon, Naturals Signature Salon, and Naturals W, a women-focused concept. With a mission to create 1,000 successful women entrepreneurs and 50,000 job opportunities by 2029, Naturals offers strong growth prospects for professionals in the beauty and salon management industry. The brand’s partnership with Bollywood actor Kareena Kapoor as ambassador reflects its focus on style, confidence, and continuous expansion.
  
**Role Description**
The Cluster Manager for Salons is a full-time, on-site role based in Coimbatore, responsible for overseeing the performance and operations of multiple Naturals salons within the assigned cluster. This role includes monitoring daily salon activities, ensuring consistent service quality, implementing brand standards, and driving revenue and profitability across locations. The Cluster Manager will guide salon managers on staff scheduling, inventory management, and adherence to hygiene and safety protocols, while supporting training and development of beauty and hair care professionals. They will handle customer escalations, foster strong client relationships, and collaborate with leadership to execute local marketing initiatives and promotional campaigns. The role also involves hiring and onboarding key salon staff, analyzing performance data, and recommending improvements to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Foundational knowledge in cosmetology and hair.
* Strong communication and customer service skills to manage client interactions, resolve concerns, and coordinate with salon managers and staff.
* Experience in hiring, staffing, and basic HR practices to build and retain high-performing salon teams.
* Background in salon, spa, retail, or hospitality operations, with proven ability to manage multiple outlets or a multi-location portfolio.
* Skills in people management, leadership, and performance coaching, with the ability to motivate teams and maintain high service standards.
* Ability to analyze sales, customer feedback, and operational metrics, and take data-driven decisions to improve cluster performance.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the capacity to travel between salons within the Coimbatore cluster as needed.
* Diploma or certification in cosmetology, beauty therapy, or salon management is preferred; a degree in business, hospitality, or related fields is an added advantage.

title: SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Title:**

SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator

**Department:**

SAP Solutions & Delivery

**Experience:**

3+ years of experience(Preferred)

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Functional Expertise:**

SAP FICO preferred, with exposure to SAP S/4HANA and SAP integrations

**Reporting To:**

Delivery Head / Management

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator**

with strong SAP functional knowledge, business analysis capabilities, and project delivery experience.

The role will act as a bridge between customers, business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, and technical developers, ensuring that business requirements are clearly understood, translated into appropriate solution designs, and delivered within agreed timelines.

The primary objective is to
**strengthen functional ownership and delivery coordination**

, allowing the existing SAP development team to focus on technical implementation while ensuring business alignment, solution quality, and predictable project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Business Requirements & Functional Analysis

* Engage with customers and stakeholders to understand business processes and requirements.
* Conduct requirement-gathering workshops and functional discussions.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and development-ready requirements.
* Identify functional gaps, dependencies, and integration requirements.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), and process flows.

2. SAP Solution Design & Functional Leadership

* Evaluate business requirements and recommend suitable SAP solutions.
* Provide functional guidance to SAP ABAP developers and integration teams.
* Review proposed solutions for functional accuracy and business alignment.
* Support SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and third-party integration requirements.
* Coordinate solution design reviews and technical feasibility discussions.
* Ensure consistency with SAP best practices and customer expectations.

3. Project Planning & Delivery Coordination

* Develop project plans, milestones, delivery schedules, and resource requirements.
* Coordinate tasks across functional, development, QA, and deployment teams.
* Track project progress, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular project reviews and communicate status to management.
* Identify potential delivery delays and initiate corrective actions.
* Support multiple concurrent SAP projects and customer engagements.

4. Stakeholder & Customer Management

* Serve as the primary functional and delivery coordination point for assigned projects.
* Facilitate communication between customers, internal teams, and management.
* Manage requirement clarifications, change requests, and scope discussions.
* Coordinate customer demonstrations, reviews, and solution walkthroughs.
* Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and timely resolution of open items.

5. Testing, Deployment & Delivery Assurance

* Define functional acceptance criteria and support test scenario preparation.
* Coordinate SIT, UAT, defect resolution, and customer sign-off.
* Verify that delivered functionality meets agreed requirements.
* Support deployment planning, go-live readiness, and post-production stabilization.
* Maintain functional documentation, project records, and delivery handover materials.

Required Skills & Qualifications

**SAP Functional Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of SAP business processes and functional modules.
* SAP FICO expertise preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC.
* Familiarity with SAP ABAP development concepts, BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs, APIs, and integration scenarios.
* Ability to review functional specifications and communicate effectively with developers.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Proven experience coordinating SAP implementation, enhancement, support, or integration projects.
* Strong requirement-gathering and functional documentation skills.
* Experience in project planning, task tracking, risk management, and delivery reporting.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Experience working directly with customers and cross-functional technical teams.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and delivery commitments.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and decision-making capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3+ years of relevant SAP functional and delivery experience.
* At least 2 years of SAP project coordination or functional leadership experience.
* SAP certification in FICO or S/4HANA is an advantage.
* Exposure to SAP integrations with external enterprise applications, financial systems, and reconciliation platforms.

**Expected Deliverables**

The successful candidate will be responsible for :

* Clearly documented and validated customer requirements.
* Functional specifications ready for technical development.
* Approved solution designs with defined scope and acceptance criteria.
* Structured project plans, milestones, and delivery trackers.
* Regular project status reports with risks, blockers, and action items.
* Coordinated SIT, UAT, customer sign-offs, and deployments.
* Improved predictability, quality, and timeliness of SAP project delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Requirement completeness and accuracy.
* Functional specification quality and development readiness.
* On-time achievement of project milestones.
* Reduction in requirement-related rework.
* Stakeholder communication and issue-resolution effectiveness.
* UAT acceptance and successful delivery sign-offs.
* Overall customer satisfaction and delivery efficiency.

Role Positioning

**This is a functional leadership and delivery coordination role, not a hands-on ABAP development position.**

The candidate must possess sufficient SAP functional and technical understanding to guide development teams, resolve requirement ambiguities, coordinate stakeholders, and take ownership of delivery commitments.

**Our Goal:**

Establish a strong functional and delivery ownership layer between customers and our SAP development team, enabling developers to concentrate on technical execution while improving solution alignment, project governance, and delivery reliability.

--------------------------------------

Before applying, please click here to read State Street’s Internal Mobility Policy.

  

**Are you referring a friend?**
-------------------------------

Please use the “Refer” button on the right in MYWD. If you have any questions about the process please visit the corporate intranet and type in Refer a Friend into the search bar.

  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Global Advisors, one of the largest asset managers in the world. We partner with many of the world’s largest, most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries to help them reach their goals through a rigorous, research-driven investment process. With over four decades of experience and trillions of dollars in assets under management, we offer one of the broadest selections of services across asset classes, risk profiles, regions and styles. As pioneers in index, ETF, and ESG investing, we are always inventing new ways to invest.

Join us if making your mark in the asset management industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

  

**What you will be responsible for**

  

* Work as a member of a broader ISG Multi Asset Class Operations team.
* Work as a member of a broader team in processing the State filing reports. This includes preparing and distributing reports
* Support the Investment and Tax teams within Charitable Asset management group.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on ways to improve operational controls, system(s) enhancements, and process flows.

  **About State Street Investment Management**
  --------------------------------------------

  State Street Investment Management is the asset management business of State Street Corporation, one of the world’s leading providers of financial services to institutional investors, with a heritage dating back over two centuries. With over $3.5 trillion in assets under management, State Street Global Advisors offers one of the broadest selections of services across asset classes, risk profiles, regions and styles. The firm’s investment culture is built on experience and skill that each of its more than 400 investment professionals and over 2,300 employees around the world bring to every client relationship. State Street Global Advisors commands a truly global presence with 22 offices and 11 investment centers across 5 continents with its global headquarters located in Boston, MA. The Outsourced Chief Investment Officer (OCIO) business has more than $90B of AUM at June 30, 2018 with over 30 clients and an investment record that dates back to 1994.As a Business Analyst within State Street Global Advisors OCIO Business, you will be responsible for building and delivering outstanding client service across the full lifecycle of an institutional client’s experience. You will also be part of and collaborate with a talented team responsible for handling the day-to-day needs of our clients. To be successful, you will need to develop an understanding of State Street Investment Management- investment and operational capabilities, the OCIO service offering, culture and vision in order to efficiently diagnose issues and solve problems that inevitably arise in the course of a client relationship. Due to the complex needs of our clients, you will need to build collaborative relationships across our sales, investment, product, marketing, operations, finance, legal, compliance and other internal teams critical to the end-to-end client lifecycle, from initial contact to on-boarding to (hopefully infrequent) off-boarding. title: P&F Lead
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead planning and forecasting activities for India, partnering with commercial teams, in-market finance and shared services. You will translate business plans into clear financial forecasts, challenge assumptions and deliver concise recommendations. We value practical problem solving, collaboration and continuous improvement. This role offers strong learning, visible impact and the chance to help GSK unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Lead end-to-end planning, budgeting and monthly forecasting cycles for India commercial and operational spend. - Consolidate forecast inputs, validate data and deliver clear variance commentary with actionable insight. - Build and maintain financial models and planning system master data to ensure accuracy and auditability. - Partner with commercial teams and project owners to run scenario analysis and support decision making. - Design and deliver automation and process improvements using analytics and reporting tools to reduce manual effort. - Prepare executive-level reports and present concise recommendations to finance leaders and business partners. Why You? Work arrangement: This role is hybrid. You will be expected to work from the office regularly as agreed with your manager and have flexibility to work remotely on other days. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related field. - Minimum 3 years of experience in financial planning and analysis, forecasting or controlling. - Hands-on experience with budgeting, forecasting and month-end processes. - Strong Excel skills and practical experience with ERP or planning systems such as SAP or equivalent. - Clear written and verbal communication skills in English for multinational stakeholders. - Experience working in a matrix organisation and managing competing priorities. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: - Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Tableau or similar planning and reporting tools. - Background in commercial, market finance or project-based finance within healthcare or related industries. - Experience delivering automation, data integration or process improvement projects. - Familiarity with accounting controls, reconciliations and month-end close processes. - Experience presenting to senior leaders and influencing decisions with concise recommendations. - Progress towards or completion of a professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CA or equivalent). How to Apply If this role matches your skills and ambitions, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your CV and a short note explaining why you are interested and how you would contribute. We look forward to hearing from you.

**Skills**

Business Forecasting, Business Reporting Tools, Critical Thinking, Data Analytics, Data Visualization, Digital Fluency, Financial Controlling, Financial Reporting and Analysis, Influencing Without Authority, Stakeholder Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Senior Manager - Regional Logistics-Supply Chain
description:
***Be the First to Apply***

Job Description

Senior Manager - Regional Logistics-Supply ChainThe Regional Logistics Manager - South is responsible for leading logistics operations and customer service execution across the South Region through effective management of CFAs, warehouse operations, inventory controls, customer order fulfilment, market returns, compliance, and service delivery.  
The role is accountable for ensuring high service levels to General Trade, Modern Trade, E-Commerce, Quick Commerce and Institutional customers through efficient execution of regional logistics operations while driving operational excellence, governance, inventory accuracy, cost productivity and stakeholder satisfaction.  
The incumbent will collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Service, Supply Planning, Finance, Quality, Procurement and CFA partners to ensure seamless execution of business requirements and achievement of regional service and cost objectives.

**Role Directly Reports To:**  
Senior Chief Manager – Logistic & Customer Service.

**Positions Reporting Into This Role:**

* Executive – Regional Logistics
* CFA / Warehouse Operations Team (functional coordination and supervision)

**4. Essential Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline with a full-time MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Logistics or Operations Management preferred.
* Additional certification in Logistics, Warehouse Management or Supply Chain Management will be an advantage.

**5. Essential Skills & Experience**

* 5-8 years of overall experience in Supply Chain, Logistics and Distribution, with at least 5 years in a regional logistics management role.
* Experience preferably in FMCG, Consumer Products or Pharmaceutical industries.
* Strong experience in managing multiple CFAs, warehouses, hubs and regional transportation networks.
* Hands-on experience in secondary transportation management, freight negotiations and cost optimization.
* Experience in managing E-commerce, Modern Trade, CSD and Quick Commerce distribution operations.
* Working knowledge of SAP / SAP HANA, preferably SAP SD and MM modules.
* Experience in WMS implementation, warehouse automation and process improvement will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, financial and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage large operational teams, 3PL partners and multiple regional locations.

**6. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Regional Distribution Planning & Inventory Management**

* Ensure effective distribution planning in coordination with Supply Chain Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing Units and Sales Teams.
* Monitor Plan Vs Dispatch adherence and ensure timely stock availability at all regional CFAs.
* Maintain optimum inventory levels at CFA/SKU level in line with sales forecasts and business requirements.
* Plan direct dispatches and optimize volumetric movements wherever commercially viable.
* Coordinate stock allocation against E-commerce, Quick Commerce, Modern Trade and CSD orders / POs.
* Ensure timely stock connect for New Product Development (NPD) and product launches.
* Drive exception management, including inter-CFA transfers, non-moving inventory, excess and slow-moving stock.
* Ensure optimum inventory utilization and adherence to FEFO/FIFO guidelines.
* Monitor stock availability, ageing and inventory accuracy across all regional locations.

**B. Secondary Logistics Management**

* Manage the regional transportation infrastructure covering CFA-to-customer movements.
* Ensure optimum vehicle utilization, route planning and transporter allocation.
* Drive freight cost optimization through effective transporter negotiations, rate benchmarking and route rationalization.
* Ensure adherence to approved freight budgets and regional AOP targets.
* Monitor transit time, vehicle placement, dispatch planning and delivery performance.
* Optimize transportation modes based on product mix, volume, distance and customer requirements.
* Ensure timely transporter invoice verification, processing and payment coordination.
* Manage delayed consignments, transit damages, permits, documentation and other logistics exceptions.
* Coordinate with Corporate Insurance / Finance teams for transit insurance and claims settlement.
* Drive continuous improvement in logistics productivity and cost per case / cost as a percentage of sales.

**C. CFA & Warehouse Operations Management**

* Ensure efficient management and operational governance of all regional CFAs, hubs and warehouses.
* Monitor warehouse space utilization, storage capacity, manpower productivity and material handling efficiency.
* Ensure inventory record accuracy, physical verification and timely reconciliation of stock discrepancies.
* Monitor FEFO/FIFO compliance, batch management and expiry / damage stock segregation.
* Ensure timely processing of saleable returns, damages, expiries, credit notes and stock adjustments.
* Drive warehouse hygiene, safety, statutory compliance and audit readiness.
* Monitor CFA Scorecard performance and implement corrective action plans for underperforming locations.
* Ensure timely uploading of Proof of Delivery (POD), Goods Receipt Notes (GRN) and other operational documents.
* Identify capacity constraints and initiate warehouse expansion, relocation or temporary space arrangements.
* Ensure effective CFA contract management, SLA adherence and periodic performance reviews.

**D. Customer Service & Distribution Excellence**

* Ensure achievement of regional OTIF, targets across MT, CSD, E-commerce, Quick Commerce and GT channels.
* Monitor order fulfilment, billing and delivery turnaround time.
* Drive timely resolution of customer complaints, delivery issues, POD pendency and appointment-related delays.
* Coordinate with Sales and Distribution teams to improve serviceability and customer experience.
* Monitor invoice-wise delivery performance and proactively resolve last-mile challenges.
* Ensure continuous tracking of service-level performance through regular MIS and review mechanisms.

**E. E-commerce & Quick Commerce Fulfilment**

* Manage operational fulfilment requirements for E-commerce and Quick Commerce channels.
* Ensure effective stock connect and order fulfilment for D2C, Seller Flex, Vendor Flex and other fulfilment models.
* Coordinate with Amazon, Flipkart and other platform partners for timely dispatches and deliveries.
* Ensure adherence to customer appointment schedules, order SLAs and fulfilment requirements.
* Optimize direct dispatches and volumetric movements for E-commerce locations.
* Monitor order pendency, cancellation, fulfilment efficiency and delivery performance.

**F. Financial Management & Cost Optimization**

* Ensure regional logistics and distribution expenditure remains within approved AOP budgets.
* Monitor distribution cost as a percentage of sales and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Drive freight rationalization, vehicle utilization improvement, warehouse productivity and operational efficiencies.
* Monitor EBITDA contribution through logistics cost control and process optimization.
* Ensure proper verification of transporter, CFA and 3PL invoices before processing.
* Identify and eliminate avoidable costs arising from detention, underutilization, excess storage and operational inefficiencies.

**G. Process Compliance, Governance & Operational Excellence**

* Ensure compliance with internal SOPs, statutory requirements, CFA agreements and operational policies.
* Drive monthly CSRM activities and half-yearly NDC collection as per the prescribed timelines.
* Ensure timely completion of internal, statutory and third-party audits.
* Drive closure of audit observations and corrective / preventive actions.
* Monitor documentation, POD, GRN, claims and credit note issuance within agreed TAT.
* Ensure operational support for Embellishment Operations, Pirakart, Piraflex and other business initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement, standardization and process digitization across regional operations.

**H. WMS Implementation & Digital Transformation**

* Lead WMS implementation across identified regional hubs / warehouses.
* Ensure timely project execution, master data readiness, process mapping and system integration.
* Coordinate with IT, WMS vendors and operational teams for successful rollout.
* Ensure user training, change management and operational stabilization after go-live.
* Improve warehouse productivity through system-driven picking, put-away, inventory tracking and dispatch processes.
* Monitor system performance and ensure timely resolution of critical operational issues.

**I. Team Management & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Lead, guide and develop the regional logistics and distribution team.
* Establish clear performance objectives and review individual and team KPIs.
* Drive accountability, operational discipline and cross-functional collaboration.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews with CFAs, transporters and service providers.
* Build a strong operational review mechanism through daily MIS, monthly performance reviews and action tracking.
* Develop a culture of customer focus, cost consciousness, ownership and continuous improvement.

title: VP, Internal Audit
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Job Description:**

Blackstone Internal Audit provides independent assurance to executive management and the Blackstone Audit Committee regarding the effectiveness of the Firm’s governance, risk management, and internal control processes. Additionally, BXIA facilitates Blackstone’s SOX Compliance Program by providing oversight, expertise, and support with management’s assessment of the effectiveness of its internal controls over financial reporting. We are seeking a highly motivated VP to lead the Bangalore-based internal audit, SOX and risk advisory activities, providing oversight of deliverables, talent development, stakeholder engagement, and transformation initiatives. The VP will play a critical role in strengthening the Firm’s control environment through a risk-based approach to assurance, while supporting broader Internal Audit objectives and enterprise-wide governance initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:** The BXIA VP will drive key activities undertaken by the Center of Excellence (COE) Internal Audit and SOX teams.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* BXIA COE Team Lead: Lead our COE team of captive and third-party resources in delivery of internal audit, SOX, risk advisory, and audit operations activities, demonstrating accountability and ownership of key deliverables of the team.
* Audit Execution Oversight: Support delivery and oversight of COE internal audit activities, including execution of risk-based audits of business, enterprise, and technology processes across Blackstone's global businesses.
* SOX Program Execution Oversight: Support delivery and oversight of COE SOX program execution activities across each phase of the program, including, planning, documentation, testing and reporting.
* Audit Operations Oversight: Oversee the delivery of audit operations support delivered by the COE, including analytics, dashboards, AI use case development, automation, and operational reporting.
* Quality Review of Deliverables: Oversee the quality and consistency of controls testing, documentation, and related assurance activities performed by the COE across Internal Audit, SOX, risk advisory, and special projects, ensuring adherence to methodology, quality standards, and continuous improvement objectives.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build relationships with key stakeholders; understand their operating and risk environments and serve as a trusted point of contact.
* Innovation & Strategic Initiatives: Drive operational improvements across the COE while supporting key departmental initiatives and overseeing COE resources contributing to strategic projects and special initiatives.
* Team & Talent Development: Drive a high-performance, values-based team culture by motivating, mentoring, coaching, skill-based training and developing team members in alignment with Blackstone principles.
* COE Operations, Resource & Project Management Oversight: Lead resource allocation, capacity planning, project prioritization and delivery monitoring across COE to ensure resources are deployed effectively, priorities are met, risks are escalated, and deliverables are completed timely and in accordance with established expectations.
* Global BXIA Team Partnership: Partner strategically with the Global Internal Audit team by defining the COE team’s objectives in alignment with BXIA’s broader strategy, vision, and operating model.

**Qualifications:** Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who are highly motivated, intelligently curious, and have demonstrated excellence in their prior endeavors. The ideal candidate will bring a passion for building and leading a top-tier Controls, Risk, and Assurance Center of Excellence, deep expertise in internal audit, SOX, risk management, and controls, a selfstarter mentality, and the ability to independently solve complex problems. Strong communication, project management, stakeholder management, and attention to detail are equally important as technical expertise. Successful candidates will have the following attributes:

  

* Educated: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field. CPA preferred; MBA, CIA, CFA, or CISA a plus.
* Experienced: 12+ years of external audit and/or internal audit experience within the Big Four, a similarly recognized global public accounting or consulting firm, or global financial services organization. Additional experience with SOX compliance is preferred.
* Technically Proficient: Demonstrated understanding and practical application of risk and control frameworks (e.g., IIA Standards, ICFR requirements, COSO framework, GAAP).
* Proven Leader: Experience leading teams and managing global or shared-service delivery models, with a strong focus on developing junior talent, fostering team cohesion, and operating effectively within a US-based global organization.
* Sound Judgement: Demonstrated ability to exercise sound risk-based judgment, prioritize competing risks and business needs, and effectively manage upward through timely communication and escalation of significant issues, risks, and decisions.
* Curious & Self-Directed: Ability to stay informed on industry best practices, technology, global markets, and internal audit and ICFR practices; operates with a high degree of autonomy and sound judgment. • Integrity-Driven: Committed to the highest personal and professional standards.
* Analytically Sound: Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills; transformation initiatives, data analytics experience, data visualization tools or audit testing and risk monitoring a plus.
* Project Management & Quality Focused: Strong project management skills with a proven ability to lead complex initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results with attention to detail.
* Interpersonally Skilled: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical topics clearly and influence and engage senior stakeholders across global teams.

title: Creative Director, Copy
description:
#### **Location:**

Bangalore

#### **Experience:**

10+ years, including 3+ years in creative leadership

#### **About the Role**

We are looking for a strategic, business-minded Creative Director, Copy who can turn creative thinking into compelling brand stories, impactful campaigns, and new business opportunities.

This role goes beyond leading a copy team. You will work closely with our Sales, Business Development, and Client Services teams to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts, develop proactive creative ideas, pitch new solutions, and help win new business.

You will lead creative strategy, storytelling, and content development for B2B brands, primarily targeting the US market. The ideal candidate combines exceptional creative judgment, strong business acumen, persuasive presentation skills, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into ideas that drive measurable results.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires complete ownership of creative quality, team performance, client relationships, and contributions to business growth.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Creative Strategy & Direction**

* Lead creative strategy, copy direction, and storytelling across integrated B2B marketing campaigns, digital experiences, video, and sales enablement assets.
* Develop compelling campaign concepts, brand narratives, messaging frameworks, value propositions, and positioning strategies.
* Translate complex technology, products, and business challenges into clear, differentiated, and persuasive communication.
* Partner with design, UX/UI, video, and marketing teams to deliver cohesive, high-impact creative solutions.
* Guide creative development from concept through execution, ensuring originality, strategic relevance, and exceptional quality.
* Ensure all communication meets US English standards and resonates with North American business audiences.

#### **2. Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Partner closely with Sales and Business Development teams to develop creative strategies that help win new business.
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client accounts through proactive campaign ideas, content solutions, and creative recommendations.
* Develop compelling creative concepts, pitch narratives, and presentations that demonstrate business value and growth opportunities.
* Participate in client discovery meetings, strategic workshops, new business pitches, and executive-level presentations.
* Collaborate with Sales and Client Services teams to convert creative opportunities into clearly defined, commercially viable proposals.
* Understand client business objectives, competitive landscapes, and market trends to recommend new creative solutions.
* Contribute to revenue growth through stronger client engagement, account expansion, and new business wins.

#### **3. Client Leadership & Strategic Partnership**

* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders by bringing strategic thinking, creative expertise, and proactive recommendations.
* Lead creative discussions and confidently present concepts, messaging strategies, and campaign recommendations.
* Challenge briefs constructively, identify opportunities beyond the initial scope, and recommend solutions that deliver greater business impact.
* Partner with account and strategy teams to align creative recommendations with client objectives, audience insights, and marketing performance.
* Take ownership of creative direction, stakeholder alignment, and resolution of critical client feedback.

#### **4. Team Leadership & Creative Excellence**

* Lead, mentor, and develop copywriters, strengthening their conceptual thinking, storytelling, writing, and presentation skills.
* Establish high standards for creativity, editorial quality, accountability, and timely delivery.
* Review and guide content across campaigns, websites, video scripts, presentations, and marketing and sales enablement collateral.
* Ensure all deliverables are accurate, brand-aligned, strategically relevant, and client-ready.
* Foster a culture of creative ownership, continuous improvement, collaboration, and innovation.
* Work with project managers and cross-functional leaders to manage priorities, resources, and delivery quality.

#### **5. AI-Powered Creative Innovation**

* Champion the adoption of AI tools and workflows to accelerate creative ideation, content development, research, and production.
* Guide teams in using AI to generate stronger creative concepts, improve productivity, and deliver scalable content solutions.
* Identify and eliminate generic, repetitive, inaccurate, or low-quality AI-generated content.
* Combine human creativity, strategic thinking, and AI capabilities to develop distinctive brand communication.
* Explore AI-powered creative solutions that can be packaged and pitched as new services to existing and prospective clients.
* Maintain editorial quality, originality, brand consistency, and human accountability across all AI-assisted work.

#### **6. Creative Performance & Business Impact**

* Develop messaging strategies aligned with B2B buyer journeys, demand generation, account-based marketing, and sales enablement.
* Collaborate with performance marketing and strategy teams to improve campaign effectiveness and conversion.
* Use audience insights, competitive research, and campaign performance data to strengthen creative recommendations.
* Connect creative ideas to measurable business outcomes, including engagement, lead generation, conversion, and account growth.
* Contribute to pitches, proposals, and creative scoping while balancing quality, timelines, and commercial viability.

#### **Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in copywriting, creative strategy, or integrated marketing, preferably within a digital or creative agency.
* Minimum 3 years of experience leading copywriters or multidisciplinary creative teams.
* Proven experience developing creative strategies and campaigns for B2B brands, particularly for US and North American markets.
* **Exceptional command of US English**, with outstanding storytelling, conceptual writing, editing, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute to new business pitches, client presentations, and account growth opportunities.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect creative solutions to client challenges and commercial objectives.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns, brand narratives, video scripts, digital experiences, and marketing and sales enablement content.
* Strong understanding of B2B marketing, demand generation, buyer journeys, and conversion-focused messaging.
* Ability to engage confidently with senior client stakeholders, sales leaders, and executive teams.
* Proven leadership skills with a strong focus on accountability, mentoring, creative quality, and delivery excellence.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools for creative development, content production, and workflow optimization.
* Strong portfolio showcasing creative thinking, campaign storytelling, strategic messaging, and business impact.

#### **Good to Have**

* Experience working with B2B technology, SaaS, AI, cybersecurity, healthcare, or enterprise brands.
* Experience partnering directly with Sales and Business Development teams to win new business.
* Demonstrated success in identifying and converting upsell or cross-sell opportunities.
* Experience leading high-value client pitches, strategic workshops, and executive presentations.
* Understanding of account-based marketing, demand generation, SEO, AEO, and content performance.
* Experience developing thought leadership, executive communications, product narratives, and video storytelling.
* Experience building AI-powered content workflows and scalable creative solutions.

#### **What We’re Looking For**

We are not looking for someone who only manages copywriters or reviews content.

We are looking for a **creative leader who thinks like a strategist, presents like a storyteller, and approaches opportunities with a business growth mindset.**

Someone who can walk into a client meeting, understand the business challenge, develop a compelling creative idea, and confidently pitch a solution that creates value for the client and growth opportunities for Position².

Above all, we want someone who takes complete ownership of their work, inspires the team to deliver exceptional creative, and plays an active role in winning and growing client business.

title: Technical Implementation Lead
description:
**About Lifesight**
===================

**Lifesight** is a pioneering Unified **Marketing Measurement (UMM)** platform which helps marketers measure, plan and optimise their marketing spend. In a world of fragmented data, unreliable cookies, and outdated reporting, we empower modern businesses to achieve predictable, sustained growth by aligning marketing and finance on a single causal truth.

We are at the forefront of **Agentic Unified Marketing Measurement**. Moving beyond siloed tools and post facto dashboards, our AI-driven causal engine combines Causal MMM, Incrementality testing and Incrementality Adjusted Attribution to create a finance ready marketing decision system.

### **Why We Exist**

Our mission is to eliminate wasted ad spend and remove the guesswork from marketing. Operating as an independent, unbiased measurement layer, Lifesight enables CMOs, CFOs, and performance marketers to confidently answer the only question that matters: *What is the true incremental value of my marketing spend?*

**Join the Future of Decision Intelligence.** We are transforming marketing from a gamble into a science. By joining Lifesight, you will help build the intelligent, agent-ready infrastructure that powers data-driven, optimized decisions for hundreds of top global brands.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

As the Lead – Technical Implementation on our global Solutions team in Bangalore, you'll lead a team of Technical Implementation Specialists and own data onboarding for Lifesight's Unified Marketing Measurement solutions: **Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)**, **Incrementality Experiments**, and **Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)**.

You'll set the standard for how client data gets into Lifesight: scoped clearly, delivered on time, and accurate from day one. This role is for a hands-on leader who can coach a team, run multiple client onboardings in parallel, and speak with equal confidence to a client's data engineer and their CMO.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Lead the team**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of Technical Implementation Specialists; set priorities, review their work, and raise the bar on quality.
* Allocate client onboardings across the team based on complexity, capacity, and skills; step in hands-on when an engagement needs it.
* Build and maintain standard playbooks, checklists, and templates for data onboarding across MMM, Experiments, and MTA.
* Run regular 1:1s and team reviews; give clear feedback and support each specialist's growth.

### **Own data onboarding for MMM, Experiments, and MTA**

* Own end-to-end data onboarding for every client: scoping data requirements, validating pipelines, testing configurations, and signing off on measurement readiness.
* Define what "model-ready" data looks like for each solution: historical spend, KPI, and control variables for MMM; geo and audience-level data for Experiments; event, touchpoint, and conversion data for MTA.
* Oversee how the team combines, cleans, and transforms fragmented, multi-source data across Excel, SQL, and BigQuery.
* Catch data quality issues early (type mismatches, schema inconsistencies, integration gaps, anomalies, outliers) before they affect client outcomes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex implementation issues using internal tooling, APIs, and cross-functional collaboration.

### **Manage projects and timelines**

* Translate client requirements into structured implementation plans with clear milestones, owners, and dates.
* Run multiple onboardings in parallel; track progress, manage dependencies, and keep every project on schedule.
* Spot risks early, escalate with a proposed fix, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Report onboarding status, timelines, and blockers to leadership and client teams.

### **Be the client's trusted technical partner**

* Act as the senior technical point of contact and escalation point for clients during onboarding.
* Lead client calls and workshops; explain data requirements and measurement concepts in plain business language.
* Manage expectations, negotiate scope and timelines, and maintain trust through every engagement.
* Run account health checks and flag risks before they escalate.

### **Improve how we work**

* Use AI tools and prompt engineering to streamline workflows and automate repetitive onboarding tasks across the team.
* Feed structured client and team feedback into Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and tooling.
* Partner with Data Science, Customer Success, and Sales for smooth handoffs from pre-sales through to model delivery.

**P.S.** – The above list need not put a ceiling on your aspirations at Lifesight.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in technical implementation, data onboarding, solutioning, or solutions consulting within B2B SaaS; ideally in data, martech, or adtech.
* 2+ years leading small teams (3–6 people) of implementation, solutions, or data specialists, including hiring, coaching, and performance feedback.
* Strong client-facing experience: you've owned onboardings end to end and been the go-to technical contact for enterprise clients.
* Excellent business communication: you write clearly, present with confidence, and adapt your message for engineers, marketers, and executives alike.
* Excellent project management: you run several projects at once, plan milestones, manage dependencies, and deliver on time. Experience with tools like Jira, Asana, or similar.
* Proven ability to scope complex client requirements and turn them into structured, actionable implementation plans.
* Hands-on experience combining, cleaning, and transforming fragmented, multi-format data using Excel, SQL, and BigQuery; Python or JavaScript is a plus.
* Sharp data hygiene instincts; you spot type errors, schema mismatches, and structural inconsistencies, and teach your team to do the same.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, Google Cloud (BigQuery), and SQL-based transformation workflows.
* Active user of AI tools and prompt engineering techniques (Few-Shot Prompting, Role/Persona Prompting, etc.), and keen to drive their adoption across the team.
* First principles thinking. You take ownership, challenge assumptions, and don't let blockers sit, for yourself or your team.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Direct experience onboarding data for Marketing Mix Models, Incrementality Experiments (geo or audience holdouts), or Multi-Touch Attribution.
* Familiarity with Tag Managers, JS Pixels / SDKs, server-side tracking, AdTech, DSPs, or marketing attribution tools.
* Familiarity with ad platforms and their data exports and APIs: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic, and similar ad networks.
* Experience building scalable onboarding processes or internal tooling for a growing implementation team.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar project management certification.

title: VP, Internal Audit
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

**Job Description:**

Blackstone Internal Audit provides independent assurance to executive management and the Blackstone Audit Committee regarding the effectiveness of the Firm’s governance, risk management, and internal control processes. Additionally, BXIA facilitates Blackstone’s SOX Compliance Program by providing oversight, expertise, and support with management’s assessment of the effectiveness of its internal controls over financial reporting. We are seeking a highly motivated VP to lead the Bangalore-based internal audit, SOX and risk advisory activities, providing oversight of deliverables, talent development, stakeholder engagement, and transformation initiatives. The VP will play a critical role in strengthening the Firm’s control environment through a risk-based approach to assurance, while supporting broader Internal Audit objectives and enterprise-wide governance initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:** The BXIA VP will drive key activities undertaken by the Center of Excellence (COE) Internal Audit and SOX teams.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* BXIA COE Team Lead: Lead our COE team of captive and third-party resources in delivery of internal audit, SOX, risk advisory, and audit operations activities, demonstrating accountability and ownership of key deliverables of the team.
* Audit Execution Oversight: Support delivery and oversight of COE internal audit activities, including execution of risk-based audits of business, enterprise, and technology processes across Blackstone's global businesses.
* SOX Program Execution Oversight: Support delivery and oversight of COE SOX program execution activities across each phase of the program, including, planning, documentation, testing and reporting.
* Audit Operations Oversight: Oversee the delivery of audit operations support delivered by the COE, including analytics, dashboards, AI use case development, automation, and operational reporting.
* Quality Review of Deliverables: Oversee the quality and consistency of controls testing, documentation, and related assurance activities performed by the COE across Internal Audit, SOX, risk advisory, and special projects, ensuring adherence to methodology, quality standards, and continuous improvement objectives.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Build relationships with key stakeholders; understand their operating and risk environments and serve as a trusted point of contact.
* Innovation & Strategic Initiatives: Drive operational improvements across the COE while supporting key departmental initiatives and overseeing COE resources contributing to strategic projects and special initiatives.
* Team & Talent Development: Drive a high-performance, values-based team culture by motivating, mentoring, coaching, skill-based training and developing team members in alignment with Blackstone principles.
* COE Operations, Resource & Project Management Oversight: Lead resource allocation, capacity planning, project prioritization and delivery monitoring across COE to ensure resources are deployed effectively, priorities are met, risks are escalated, and deliverables are completed timely and in accordance with established expectations.
* Global BXIA Team Partnership: Partner strategically with the Global Internal Audit team by defining the COE team’s objectives in alignment with BXIA’s broader strategy, vision, and operating model.

**Qualifications:** Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who are highly motivated, intelligently curious, and have demonstrated excellence in their prior endeavors. The ideal candidate will bring a passion for building and leading a top-tier Controls, Risk, and Assurance Center of Excellence, deep expertise in internal audit, SOX, risk management, and controls, a selfstarter mentality, and the ability to independently solve complex problems. Strong communication, project management, stakeholder management, and attention to detail are equally important as technical expertise. Successful candidates will have the following attributes:

  

* Educated: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or related field. CPA preferred; MBA, CIA, CFA, or CISA a plus.
* Experienced: 12+ years of external audit and/or internal audit experience within the Big Four, a similarly recognized global public accounting or consulting firm, or global financial services organization. Additional experience with SOX compliance is preferred.
* Technically Proficient: Demonstrated understanding and practical application of risk and control frameworks (e.g., IIA Standards, ICFR requirements, COSO framework, GAAP).
* Proven Leader: Experience leading teams and managing global or shared-service delivery models, with a strong focus on developing junior talent, fostering team cohesion, and operating effectively within a US-based global organization.
* Sound Judgement: Demonstrated ability to exercise sound risk-based judgment, prioritize competing risks and business needs, and effectively manage upward through timely communication and escalation of significant issues, risks, and decisions.
* Curious & Self-Directed: Ability to stay informed on industry best practices, technology, global markets, and internal audit and ICFR practices; operates with a high degree of autonomy and sound judgment. • Integrity-Driven: Committed to the highest personal and professional standards.
* Analytically Sound: Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills; transformation initiatives, data analytics experience, data visualization tools or audit testing and risk monitoring a plus.
* Project Management & Quality Focused: Strong project management skills with a proven ability to lead complex initiatives, coordinate stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results with attention to detail.
* Interpersonally Skilled: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical topics clearly and influence and engage senior stakeholders across global teams.

The duties and responsibilities described here are not exhaustive and additional assignments, duties, or responsibilities may be required of this position. Assignments, duties, and responsibilities may be changed at any time, with or without notice, by Blackstone in its sole discretion.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, and training. All Blackstone employees, including but not limited to recruiting personnel and hiring managers, are required to abide by this policy.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, please contact Human Resources at 212-583-5000 (US), +44 (0)20 7451 4000 (EMEA) or +852 3656 8600 (APAC).

The division plays a pivotal role in enabling efficient, secure, and innovative financial operations for global corporates.
