title: Manager, Managed Services
description:
**Why project44?**

At project44, we believe in better.

We challenge the status quo because we know a better supply chain isn't just possible—it's essential. Better for our customers. Better for their business. Better for the world.

With our **Decision Intelligence Platform, Movement,** we're redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real-time, AI-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward.

Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose.

**AI at project44**

We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day-to-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers.

If you're driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team – we should talk.

  

**Role Overview**

As a **Manager,** **Managed Service** , you will play a highly visible role partnering with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure world class delivery across a diverse portfolio. You will drive customer value through data analysis, operational excellence and proactive project management. This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and requires the ability to influence stakeholders, manage multiple complex accounts and translate insights into long-term solutions.

As the Manager, Managed Services, you will lead a team of Managed Service Consultants and own the delivery of a diverse portfolio of enterprise and strategic customers. You will partner with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure strong outcomes in adoption, data quality and service performance, and you will set the operational standards, analytics practices and people development that make the team successful. This role blends strategic leadership with hands-on problem solving. You will influence senior stakeholders, coach your team through complex accounts and turn data insights into scalable, long-term solutions. This role reports to VP, Customer experience, manages a team of 5+ consultants and covers global region. Location: Bengaluru

**What You Will Work On**

* Hire, onboard, lead, coach and develop a team of Managed Service Consultants, setting clear goals, giving regular feedback and building a strong, high-performing culture.

* Own the health of the team’s customer portfolio, including delivery timelines, milestones, end-to-end project plans and risk management across global regions and multiple project44 products.

* Serve as an executive point of contact for key customers and carriers and escalate and resolve complex issues.

* Set the strategy for carrier initiatives, from planning through adoption, and review data-driven insights and best-practice recommendations presented by the team.

* Drive a culture of deep-dive data analysis, ensuring the team identifies patterns, uncovers root causes and delivers improvements that increase data quality and availability, using visualization tools and internal data platforms to triage errors and speed up issue resolution.

* Define and monitor team KPIs, review progress across accounts, and publish regular reports to leadership that highlight risks and business impact.

* Hold customers, carriers and internal teams accountable for actions that improve operational outcomes.

* Partner with Product, Support, Carrier Operations, Engineering and Sales to drive customer value, and represent the voice of the customer and carrier in cross-functional forums.

* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks and process improvements that raise quality, consistency and efficiency across the Managed Services practice, and identify process gaps and share scalable solutions across the organization.

* Allocate and balance workload across the team, and manage capacity, prioritization and competing demands.

* Maintain a deep understanding of carrier integration methods across modes, and guide the team’s technical decision-making.

What You Need

* 8+ years of experience in data analysis, operations, consulting or account management, including at least two years leading or managing a team.

* Experience in SaaS, software or logistics is preferred.

* Proven ability to manage a complex portfolio of enterprise customers and to lead multiple projects with competing priorities.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive audiences.

* Solid understanding of source data, data formats (such as EDI, API and file-based feeds) and data behaviour.

* Proficiency in Excel and SQL, and familiarity with visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Kibana or Observe.

* Experience with APIs or basic coding concepts is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor and develop talent, and to manage performance.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels and a customer-focused, problem-solving mindset.

* Exceptional organizational skills and a track record of process improvement.
* Fluency in English and Spanish. Additional languages are a plus.

**In-office Commitment:** Our office is where ideas spark, connections thrive, and innovation comes alive. The expectation is to be on-site, **in office five days a week** as this offers the chance to immerse yourself in the energy of the office and collaborate with your co-workers. Together, we’re building something extraordinary—learn, grow, and thrive in our fast-paced, transformative environment.

**Diversity & Inclusion:**

At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.

project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!

For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, please email recruiting@project44.com. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**More about project44:**

Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. As transportation and logistics continue to evolve and customer expectations around delivery become more demanding, industry technology must rise to the occasion. In just a few short years, we have created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. Our Advanced Visibility Platform is used by the world’s leading brands to track shipments, collaborate with supply chain partners, drive operational efficiencies, and create outstanding customer experiences.

title: Technical Implementation Lead
description:
**About Lifesight**
===================

**Lifesight** is a pioneering Unified **Marketing Measurement (UMM)** platform which helps marketers measure, plan and optimise their marketing spend. In a world of fragmented data, unreliable cookies, and outdated reporting, we empower modern businesses to achieve predictable, sustained growth by aligning marketing and finance on a single causal truth.

We are at the forefront of **Agentic Unified Marketing Measurement**. Moving beyond siloed tools and post facto dashboards, our AI-driven causal engine combines Causal MMM, Incrementality testing and Incrementality Adjusted Attribution to create a finance ready marketing decision system.

### **Why We Exist**

Our mission is to eliminate wasted ad spend and remove the guesswork from marketing. Operating as an independent, unbiased measurement layer, Lifesight enables CMOs, CFOs, and performance marketers to confidently answer the only question that matters: *What is the true incremental value of my marketing spend?*

**Join the Future of Decision Intelligence.** We are transforming marketing from a gamble into a science. By joining Lifesight, you will help build the intelligent, agent-ready infrastructure that powers data-driven, optimized decisions for hundreds of top global brands.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

As the Lead – Technical Implementation on our global Solutions team in Bangalore, you'll lead a team of Technical Implementation Specialists and own data onboarding for Lifesight's Unified Marketing Measurement solutions: **Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)**, **Incrementality Experiments**, and **Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)**.

You'll set the standard for how client data gets into Lifesight: scoped clearly, delivered on time, and accurate from day one. This role is for a hands-on leader who can coach a team, run multiple client onboardings in parallel, and speak with equal confidence to a client's data engineer and their CMO.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Lead the team**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of Technical Implementation Specialists; set priorities, review their work, and raise the bar on quality.
* Allocate client onboardings across the team based on complexity, capacity, and skills; step in hands-on when an engagement needs it.
* Build and maintain standard playbooks, checklists, and templates for data onboarding across MMM, Experiments, and MTA.
* Run regular 1:1s and team reviews; give clear feedback and support each specialist's growth.

### **Own data onboarding for MMM, Experiments, and MTA**

* Own end-to-end data onboarding for every client: scoping data requirements, validating pipelines, testing configurations, and signing off on measurement readiness.
* Define what "model-ready" data looks like for each solution: historical spend, KPI, and control variables for MMM; geo and audience-level data for Experiments; event, touchpoint, and conversion data for MTA.
* Oversee how the team combines, cleans, and transforms fragmented, multi-source data across Excel, SQL, and BigQuery.
* Catch data quality issues early (type mismatches, schema inconsistencies, integration gaps, anomalies, outliers) before they affect client outcomes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex implementation issues using internal tooling, APIs, and cross-functional collaboration.

### **Manage projects and timelines**

* Translate client requirements into structured implementation plans with clear milestones, owners, and dates.
* Run multiple onboardings in parallel; track progress, manage dependencies, and keep every project on schedule.
* Spot risks early, escalate with a proposed fix, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Report onboarding status, timelines, and blockers to leadership and client teams.

### **Be the client's trusted technical partner**

* Act as the senior technical point of contact and escalation point for clients during onboarding.
* Lead client calls and workshops; explain data requirements and measurement concepts in plain business language.
* Manage expectations, negotiate scope and timelines, and maintain trust through every engagement.
* Run account health checks and flag risks before they escalate.

### **Improve how we work**

* Use AI tools and prompt engineering to streamline workflows and automate repetitive onboarding tasks across the team.
* Feed structured client and team feedback into Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and tooling.
* Partner with Data Science, Customer Success, and Sales for smooth handoffs from pre-sales through to model delivery.

**P.S.** – The above list need not put a ceiling on your aspirations at Lifesight.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in technical implementation, data onboarding, solutioning, or solutions consulting within B2B SaaS; ideally in data, martech, or adtech.
* 2+ years leading small teams (3–6 people) of implementation, solutions, or data specialists, including hiring, coaching, and performance feedback.
* Strong client-facing experience: you've owned onboardings end to end and been the go-to technical contact for enterprise clients.
* Excellent business communication: you write clearly, present with confidence, and adapt your message for engineers, marketers, and executives alike.
* Excellent project management: you run several projects at once, plan milestones, manage dependencies, and deliver on time. Experience with tools like Jira, Asana, or similar.
* Proven ability to scope complex client requirements and turn them into structured, actionable implementation plans.
* Hands-on experience combining, cleaning, and transforming fragmented, multi-format data using Excel, SQL, and BigQuery; Python or JavaScript is a plus.
* Sharp data hygiene instincts; you spot type errors, schema mismatches, and structural inconsistencies, and teach your team to do the same.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, Google Cloud (BigQuery), and SQL-based transformation workflows.
* Active user of AI tools and prompt engineering techniques (Few-Shot Prompting, Role/Persona Prompting, etc.), and keen to drive their adoption across the team.
* First principles thinking. You take ownership, challenge assumptions, and don't let blockers sit, for yourself or your team.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Direct experience onboarding data for Marketing Mix Models, Incrementality Experiments (geo or audience holdouts), or Multi-Touch Attribution.
* Familiarity with Tag Managers, JS Pixels / SDKs, server-side tracking, AdTech, DSPs, or marketing attribution tools.
* Familiarity with ad platforms and their data exports and APIs: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic, and similar ad networks.
* Experience building scalable onboarding processes or internal tooling for a growing implementation team.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar project management certification.

With our **Decision Intelligence Platform, Movement,** we're redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real-time, AI-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward.

Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose.

**AI at project44**

We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day-to-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers.

If you're driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team – we should talk.

  

**Role Overview**

As a **Manager,** **Managed Service** , you will play a highly visible role partnering with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure world class delivery across a diverse portfolio. You will drive customer value through data analysis, operational excellence and proactive project management. This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and requires the ability to influence stakeholders, manage multiple complex accounts and translate insights into long-term solutions.

As the Manager, Managed Services, you will lead a team of Managed Service Consultants and own the delivery of a diverse portfolio of enterprise and strategic customers. You will partner with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure strong outcomes in adoption, data quality and service performance, and you will set the operational standards, analytics practices and people development that make the team successful. This role blends strategic leadership with hands-on problem solving. You will influence senior stakeholders, coach your team through complex accounts and turn data insights into scalable, long-term solutions. This role reports to VP, Customer experience, manages a team of 5+ consultants and covers global region. Location: Bengaluru

**What You Will Work On**

* Hire, onboard, lead, coach and develop a team of Managed Service Consultants, setting clear goals, giving regular feedback and building a strong, high-performing culture.

* Own the health of the team's customer portfolio, including delivery timelines, milestones, end-to-end project plans and risk management across global regions and multiple project44 products.

* Serve as an executive point of contact for key customers and carriers and escalate and resolve complex issues.

* Set the strategy for carrier initiatives, from planning through adoption, and review data-driven insights and best-practice recommendations presented by the team.

* Drive a culture of deep-dive data analysis, ensuring the team identifies patterns, uncovers root causes and delivers improvements that increase data quality and availability, using visualization tools and internal data platforms to triage errors and speed up issue resolution.

* Define and monitor team KPIs, review progress across accounts, and publish regular reports to leadership that highlight risks and business impact.

* Hold customers, carriers and internal teams accountable for actions that improve operational outcomes.

* Partner with Product, Support, Carrier Operations, Engineering and Sales to drive customer value, and represent the voice of the customer and carrier in cross-functional forums.

* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks and process improvements that raise quality, consistency and efficiency across the Managed Services practice, and identify process gaps and share scalable solutions across the organization.

* Allocate and balance workload across the team, and manage capacity, prioritization and competing demands.

* Maintain a deep understanding of carrier integration methods across modes, and guide the team's technical decision-making.

What You Need

* 8+ years of experience in data analysis, operations, consulting or account management, including at least two years leading or managing a team.

* Experience in SaaS, software or logistics is preferred.

* Proven ability to manage a complex portfolio of enterprise customers and to lead multiple projects with competing priorities.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive audiences.

* Solid understanding of source data, data formats (such as EDI, API and file-based feeds) and data behaviour.

* Proficiency in Excel and SQL, and familiarity with visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Kibana or Observe.

* Experience with APIs or basic coding concepts is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor and develop talent, and to manage performance.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels and a customer-focused, problem-solving mindset.

* Exceptional organizational skills and a track record of process improvement.
* Fluency in English and Spanish. Additional languages are a plus.

**In-office Commitment:** Our office is where ideas spark, connections thrive, and innovation comes alive. The expectation is to be on-site, **in office five days a week** as this offers the chance to immerse yourself in the energy of the office and collaborate with your co-workers. Together, we're building something extraordinary—learn, grow, and thrive in our fast-paced, transformative environment.

**Diversity & Inclusion:**

At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We're focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

We're building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.

project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we'd love to review your application!

For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, please email recruiting@project44.com. Even if you don't meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role's requirements.

**More about project44:**

Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. In just a few short years, we have created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. description:
**About the Role**  
  
As an Implementation Lead for Employee Transportation Services (ETS), you will own the journey of large enterprise clients from solution deep-dive through to the successful onboarding, launch and stabilization of managed employee commute programs across India and APAC.  
  
You will act as the critical bridge between Sales, Product and long-term client success — closing mid-funnel deals through in-depth, customized demos, leading complex client integrations and pre-launch readiness, and ensuring a seamless transition from signed deal to a fully integrated, operating program.  
  
You will partner with customers’ Transport, Admin, HR, Security, IT and Facilities teams, and with Sales, Operations, Product, Engineering, Safety, Customer Trust and Support teams internally, to deliver safe, reliable and cost-efficient commute solutions — from roster and route design through go-live and steady-state performance.  
  
The role sits at the intersection of operations, program management and customer success, directly impacting service quality, customer satisfaction and revenue growth, and is pivotal to building a repeatable ETS launch engine.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* Own in-depth, customized ETS solution demos — including client-specific configuration discussions and scenario simulations (e.g., Guard vs. Non-Guard trips, On-Time vs. Delayed trips) — to validate fit and close deals alongside Account Executives, and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sessions after deal signing
* Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the sales cycle, owning and supporting the technical sections of RFPs and client proposals to accelerate deal closures
* Lead end-to-end implementation of ETS programs for enterprise clients — from requirements gathering and site readiness through pilot, go-live and hypercare — ensuring seamless and timely launches
* Partner with customers to understand shift patterns, employee rosters, pickup/drop locations and commute policies, and translate them into routing, fleet and service design
* Define SLAs and success metrics with customers (e.g., on-time performance, seat utilization, trip completion, safety incidents, employee satisfaction) and drive adoption among employees, transport admins and operations teams
* Work with fleet partners, drivers and on-ground operations teams to ensure vehicle, driver and compliance readiness (permits, insurance, driver verification, vehicle fitness) before and after launch
* Implement safety and compliance protocols, including night-shift and women-employee safety requirements, in-vehicle safety features and incident escalation processes
* Coordinate technical onboarding with Product, Engineering and Global Shared Services (GSS) — roster uploads, HRMS/attendance, SFTP and SSO integrations, data pipelines, user and policy configuration, and billing set-up — keeping core engineering focused on product builds
* Navigate client InfoSec and compliance requirements alongside the Customer Trust team, and drive pre-launch readiness and UAT to sign-off so that each program is handed over to Operations fully documented and launch-ready
* Run regular operational reviews with customers, analyze performance data, root-cause service gaps and drive corrective actions and continuous cost and efficiency improvements; identify growth opportunities such as new sites, shifts, shuttle routes and EV adoption
* Relay client feedback, technical requirements and market learnings to the Product team to influence the ETS roadmap, set accurate client expectations on capabilities and timelines, and escalate forward-looking feature requests
* Build and maintain ETS enablement resources — feature lists, FAQs, sales collateral and standardized demo narratives — support repeatable demo environments (test accounts and simulated trips), and test new feature rollouts for incoming clients ahead of launch
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients and deeply understand ETS products, operating model and tools to deliver customer trainings, onboarding sessions and troubleshoot customer issues

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* 4+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in a client-facing role (implementation, program/project management, operations, consulting, account management or similar)
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, sites and deadlines in operationally intensive environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage customer leadership as well as on-ground operations and vendor teams
* Demonstrated ability to deliver technical product demonstrations and explain complex solutions clearly to business, technical and operations audiences
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration concepts (SFTP, SSO, HRMS, data pipelines) and experience managing end-to-end implementations, including UAT and InfoSec/compliance reviews
* Proven ability to influence and work across Sales, Product, Engineering and Operations teams without direct authority
* Strong analytical skills, with working proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (SQL or BI tools a plus) to track SLAs and operational KPIs

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience in employee transportation, corporate commute or shuttle services, fleet management, logistics, mobility or transport/facilities outsourcing
* Familiarity with India transport and compliance requirements — vehicle permits, driver verification and safety norms for night-shift and women-employee transportation
* Experience managing fleet/vendor partners and SLA-driven contracts
* Experience in SaaS, tech or platform-based environments, including rollout of routing, rostering or workforce-mobility technology
* Experience supporting RFPs and enterprise procurement processes, and building enablement material such as training curricula, FAQs and collateral
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, handle on-ground escalations and drive solutions
* Fluency in English and Hindi; additional regional/APAC languages are a plus.

  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: Head of Technical Delivery
description:
MTechZilla is a custom software development company founded in 2021. We build web, mobile, cloud, and AI products for startups and businesses, primarily in the US and Europe. Our team of 30+ has delivered 40+ products.

You will own technical estimates and solution design for new leads, including how we scope, quote, build, and deliver projects from the first discovery call through the final release, as well as client escalations.

You need to be technical enough to design and estimate a solution, and organized enough to run several client projects at once without anything slipping.

What You Will Be Responsible For:

Delivering every project on time, on budget, and at margin

* Own end-to-end delivery across multiple concurrent client projects, from kickoff to release and handover.
* Keep plans, milestones, budgets, and timelines current as priorities shift.
* Track risks, blockers, and dependencies every week, and act on them before they reach the client.
* Plan resources across projects and manage team utilization.
* Manage scope and turn change requests into approved, billable change orders.
* Coordinate with QA on test plans and release checklists so every release is ready before a client sees it.
* Be the escalation point for delivery issues, internally and with clients.

Manage client relationships in the US and Europe

* Act as the main delivery contact for clients across time zones.
* Run status reviews, sprint demos, and steering meetings.
* Present delivery status, risks, and roadmaps to client founders and executives.
* Understand each client’s business and propose technical solutions to their problems.
* Travel for client visits, kickoffs, and workshops.
* Spot follow-on work in existing accounts and bring it to the growth team.

Turning client goals into requirements developers can build from

* Run discovery and requirements workshops with clients.
* Write PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria that developers can build from without guesswork.
* Prioritize features and maintain roadmaps based on business value, effort, and risk.

Design solutions and own estimates for new leads

Every quotation we send depends on this part of the role.

* Join discovery and pre-sales calls as the technical lead.
* Design the solution: architecture, tech stack, integrations, and hosting approach.
* Break requirements into features and tasks, and estimate effort and timelines.
* Complete the technical sections of our quotation template: scope, assumptions, exclusions, team composition, milestones, and timeline.
* Estimate AWS and third-party costs where relevant.
* Review SOWs for technical and delivery feasibility before they are signed.
* Plan and run proofs of concept, including AI and automation use cases, with clear success criteria and a recommendation to build, scale, or stop.

Building delivery processes and documentation that scale

* Set documentation standards in Confluence or Google Docs for requirements, architecture decisions, runbooks, release notes, and handover notes.
* Build a reusable estimation model from past projects, so quotes get faster and more accurate.
* Define and improve our processes for sprints, QA gates, releases, and client reporting.
* Send weekly delivery health, margin, and risk reports to leadership.
* Keep each client’s information, code, and commercial terms strictly separate, in line with every contract’s NDA, scope, and deliverables.

Leading and growing the engineering team

* Lead tech leads, developers, remote contributors, and contractors, and keep them aligned on priorities.
* Run stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives, and follow through on action items.
* Review architecture and code on critical projects.
* Take part in hiring, interviews, and decisions on team structure.

Technical Skills You Need

You do not need to write production code every day. You do need to design a system, judge whether an estimate is realistic, and hold your own with a client’s CTO.

* At least 4 years as a hands-on software engineer before moving into lead or delivery roles.
* Working knowledge of our stack, deep enough to design and review solutions: React and Next.js, React Native, Node.js, and AWS.
* System design: APIs, databases, authentication, scaling, and third-party integrations such as payments, maps, and notifications.
* A track record of estimating software projects, with examples of estimates compared to actual delivery.
* Ability to split a product into an MVP and later phases that fit a client’s budget.
* Working knowledge of security and data protection basics, including GDPR for European clients.
* Familiarity with GitHub or GitLab workflows, CI/CD, and architecture diagrams.

Experience and Qualifications

Required

* 8 to 12 years of total experience, including at least 3 years leading delivery, projects, or engineering teams.
* Experience running multiple software projects at the same time.
* Experience working directly with US or European clients.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum, SDLC, release planning, and QA coordination.
* Hands-on use of Jira or similar tools such as Azure DevOps, Linear, ClickUp, or Asana.
* Clear written English for PRDs, status reports, and executive summaries.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Willingness to travel for client visits, including international travel.

Preferred

* Experience in a software services company, agency, or consulting firm, especially on fixed-price projects.
* Experience building or integrating AI and LLM features.
* Exposure to IoT or connected products in e-mobility, energy, industrial equipment, or logistics.
* Ability to create wireframes, workflow diagrams, and POC briefs.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 6 Months

* You produce quotations and estimates for new leads without the CEO filling in technical or timeline details.
* Projects ship within 10% of their estimated timeline and budget.
* Every client gets a weekly status update, and escalations to the CEO are the exception.
* Every active project has documentation that another team member could pick up and work from.
* We have an estimation model built from at least 10 past projects.

description:
**About Lyzr**
--------------

Lyzr is a Series A–backed enterprise AI company building a full-stack agent infrastructure platform that helps organizations design, deploy, and govern AI agents. Our platform enables enterprises to move beyond isolated AI use cases and into reliable, production-grade agentic workflows with strong controls around security, accuracy, and compliance.

Recognized by Accenture and Harvard Business School–led innovation ecosystems, Lyzr works with global enterprises to reimagine complex workflows using agentic AI. We focus on making AI agents dependable at scale - so teams can replace fragmented tool stacks with a unified, governed intelligence layer.

**About the Role**
------------------

As Lyzr accelerates its growth across enterprise banking, financial services, and highly regulated industries, establishing robust, independent technical governance is critical. We are seeking a **Senior Cyber Security Auditor** to join our newly formed **Security Audit Team**.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

**1. Platform & AI Tech Stack Auditing (2LOD)**

Conduct continuous static and dynamic security assessments (SAST/ DAST/ IAST) across Lyzr’s core codebases, API layers, and multi-tenant microservices.

Audit AI agent orchestration workflows, evaluating prompt security, token limits, access boundary controls, and agent execution logs to prevent unauthorized data access or non-deterministic behavior.

Perform regular penetration testing and threat modeling across internal and external endpoints.

**2.Cloud Infrastructure & Configuration Audit**

Continually audit and monitor Lyzr’s primary **AWS cloud environment** (IAM, KMS, Security Hub, GuardDuty, VPC networking) and secondary **Microsoft Azure** footprints for misconfigurations, excessive permissions, or infrastructure drift.

Validate container and cluster security posture across Kubernetes/Docker deployment pipelines and automated CI/CD workflows.

**3. Governance, Oversight & Risk Escalation**

Function as an objective 2LOD oversight body, reviewing and validating the security controls, code practices, and remediation efforts executed by 1LOD engineering and IT teams.

Log, track, and maintain an independent technical risk register, providing direct, uncompromised reporting and quarterly audit updates to the COO.

Support external SOC 2, ISO 27001, and regulatory readiness by maintaining rigorous, audit-ready operational logs and control evidence.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

5+ years of hands-on experience in technical security auditing, red teaming, penetration testing, or 2LOD security risk engineering within high-growth SaaS, fintech, or cloud platforms.

**Cloud Platform Expertise:** Deep technical mastery of **AWS security architecture** (Identity, KMS, Network Isolation, CloudTrail) with solid working proficiency in **Microsoft Azure** security controls.

**AI & Platform Security:** Strong understanding of emerging AI attack vectors (e.g., prompt injection, data exfiltration via agents, insecure output handling) and familiarity with safety frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs.

**Tooling Proficiency:** Hands-on experience with modern security auditing software (e.g., Wiz, Snyk, Prisma Cloud, SonarQube, Burp Suite, AWS Inspector).

**Communication & Objectivity:** Exceptional technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex security risks directly to executive leadership while maintaining constructive, independent relationships with 1LOD engineering leads.

**Why Join Lyzr**
-----------------

* Join a fast-growing AI company in an exciting market
* Be part of a high-performance sales culture
* Receive coaching, structure, and clear growth opportunities
* Build valuable enterprise sales experience with global customers**Preferred Certifications:** CISSP, CISA, CCSP, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, or Certified Red Team Professional (CRTP).

title: Lead Technical Programme Manager
description:
**About the role**  

**About Tesco Developer Platform (TDP)**
========================================

Tesco Developer Platform (TDP) is at the heart of Tesco’s technology strategy, enabling engineering teams to build, deploy and operate software at scale. TDP provides a paved path for developers by offering reusable platform capabilities, standardised tooling, and self-service infrastructure. The platform is built as a product, focusing on developer experience, reliability, and speed of delivery, while embedding security and operational excellence by design.

Role Context

As a Lead Technical Programme Manager within TDP, you will operate at the intersection of platform engineering, product management, and large-scale programme delivery. You will drive complex, cross-cutting initiatives that improve developer productivity, enable consistent engineering practices, and accelerate value delivery across Tesco’s technology landscape.

Impact & Scope

Core Programme Leadership

* Lead the TDP as a coordinated programme across capability build, platform rollout, and consumer onboarding, ensuring alignment across product, engineering, and dependent teams.
* Establish and run effective programme governance, managing cross-team dependencies, risks, and delivery against agreed outcomes and timelines.

Product–Programme Partnership

* Partner closely with Product leadership to enable delivery of the roadmap, ensuring sequencing of capabilities and dependencies is executable, but remaining aligned to product-led prioritisation and decision-making.
* Translate product roadmap and capability sequencing into a coherent, cross-team delivery plan, ensuring readiness across infrastructure, security, and platform teams.

Adoption & Onboarding

Own the onboarding of teams and workloads that are unblocked by available platform capabilities, ensuring smooth adoption and time-to-value.

* Drive programme-level visibility of onboarding progress, identifying bottlenecks and accelerating adoption across target teams.
* Provide clear signal and feedback to Product on onboarding friction, unmet needs, and patterns of demand to inform future capability prioritisation.

Driving Platform Adoption & Growth

* Coordinate across platform, product, and engineering teams to scale adoption of TDP capabilities, ensuring consistent rollout and reuse across the organisation.
* Align stakeholders across infrastructure, security, and platform domains to unlock adoption at scale.

Execution & Communication

* Communicate programme progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior technology stakeholders, ensuring transparency and informed decision-making.
* Maintain a clear view of delivery status, onboarding pipeline, and capability readiness across all participating teams.

User Insight Enablement

Support and coordinate user research and onboarding learnings with Product and Engineering teams, ensuring insights are surfaced and fed into product decisions (without owning discovery).

Platform Mindset

* Champion a platform-as-a-product operating model, reinforcing standardisation, simplification, and developer experience improvements across teams.

Job Summary

As a Lead Technical Programme Manager, you will deliver complex, cross-functional technology programmes that support colleagues and help serve our customers better. They work collaboratively, influence Product, Engineering, Capability, Infrastructure and Security colleagues and lead the programme to deliver value quickly and often.

  
**You will be responsible for**  

**Job Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead and deliver programmes with multiple business and technical risks that will impact the success of key Tesco business priorities
* Define and track performance against customer and business KPIs
* Managing Risks and Issues and influencing multiple dependent teams
* Establish new or improve existing delivery methodology to deliver the programme goals
* Create and track a plan to deliver the programme goals, including the technical implementation plan. Owning the release plan and stakeholder communication and weekly Governance
* Understand trade-offs in delivery, using experience and influencing skills to drive consensus with our Business, Technology and Engineering teams to obtain the best value and solution
* Able to foresee potential risks and issues, establish a process, facilitate discussion, and manage escalations
* Act on opportunities to adopt trends and new concepts in programme and product delivery
* Able to understand and drive a technical architecture to be able to foresee the impact on dependencies, delivery timelines and implementation plans
* Have good knowledge of System, Software and Data engineering and implementations best practices to appreciate delivery challenges
* Understand technology concepts, grasp new ones quickly and appreciate their implications on delivery
* Effectively manage major incidents, ensuring stakeholders are updated with the right information to drive the correct decisions
* Collaborate with the Product and Engineering teams to define annual budgetary requirements
* Build positive relationships with suppliers & external stakeholders to deliver software or professional services
* Coach peers and other roles, teaching where required, on methodologies and programme management tools and coach/mentor on leadership
* Leading other TPMs in the team and coordinating their plans into wider programme plan
* Play an active leadership role in the TPM guild and community – proactively influencing capability and capacity planning for TPMs

  
**You will need**  

Key People and Teams

Software Development teams, Product Management teams, Programme teams, Capability, Infrastructure, Security and Third party vendors.

Experience

Have a proven record of accomplishment in delivering technology across multiple teams in multiple geographies

Have experience of building credible relationships and influencing senior management & leadership teams

Flexibility, ability to plan and organise, responsiveness, creativity, self-starter

Operational Skills

Programme Methodologies

Managing Risk

Programme Governance

Business Awareness

Communicating and Influencing

Data Analytics and insight

Strategic thinking and problem solving

Finance and Procurement

Embracing and Enabling Change

Curiosity and Learning

Core Technology

Product Methodologies

Retail Technology Awareness

Development Life-cycle

Work Level

I balance exceptional delivery for customers on what matters, engaging teams and colleagues, with the needs of the business. I am an expert and often the first layer of management of people or projects.

  
**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

title: Lead, Technical Services Engineer - Partners
description:
MongoDB's Technical Services Engineering team uses exceptional problem-solving and customer service skills, along with deep technical experience, to advise customers and solve their complex MongoDB problems: consulting on application and schema design, optimizing performance and scalability, resolving production outages, designing and reviewing operational procedures such as business continuity plans, and explaining MongoDB internals.

As Lead, Technical Services Engineer, Partners, you will mentor, train, and coach a team of Partner TSEs while remaining hands-on with the most complex partner and mutual-customer issues. You will work with the team Manager and take on day-to-day operational responsibility for the team, ensuring caseload is addressed accurately, quickly, and professionally, with a constant focus on customer and partner success. You will also collaborate with Customer Success Management, Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and other internal stakeholders on high-profile partners and customers as we migrate and support business-critical applications.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

### **Required**

* 2+ years of experience leading teams, directly or indirectly
* Patience, empathy, and a genuine desire to help others
* ~7 years of experience building, managing, and maintaining complex, mission-critical, large-scale production database systems (RDBMS, NoSQL, or both).
* Coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, JavaScript, Node.js, Go, etc.
* Experience working with APIs to integrate with 3rd-party technologies and software in areas such as security and fraud, big data analytics and AI, healthcare, content management, IoT, database performance monitoring and management, financial services, and telco
* Solid hands-on systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting process, with significant experience analyzing and troubleshooting end-to-end issues holistically in production, from the application tier through the database down to storage
* Troubleshooting experience with the TCP/IP networking stack on OS and hypervisor, including firewalls and load balancers
* Experience using or administering one or more cloud stacks such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting NAS, SAN, local storage, and multi-pathing
* Experience building solutions involving application workloads and use cases
* Strong background in performance tuning and benchmarking, and in providing technical support to internal and/or external customers
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure, and find solutions in real time

### **Preferred**

* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience developing applications in one or more programming languages using a NoSQL or SQL database
* Strong understanding of authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, and AD
* Experience with distributed version control systems, in particular git
* Experience with Kubernetes or other orchestration systems using vendor-specific Enterprise operators
* Experience working with software product teams, and familiarity with product release processes from planning to release

### **Success Measures**

* In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its partner ecosystem, completed New Hire Training, and built working relationships with your team, the Manager, and key partner and internal stakeholders
* In 6 months, you will be running day-to-day team operations (workflow, escalations, meetings) with the Manager, comfortable working frontline with customers and partners, and will have completed the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
* In 12 months, you will be a recognized technical specialist and people leader: your team's engineers are growing and independently handling technical escalations, partner Centers of Excellence are in place for onboarded partners, and you are driving regular pain and bug reporting and operational improvements with Engineering and internal teams

### **Responsibilities**

Team leadership and operations

* Drive customer and partner success by guiding the team to solve complex technical problems, from design through production operations, including managing team workflow, assisting on hands-on customer issues, and managing internal and external escalations
* Work with the team Manager to assume day-to-day operational responsibility for the team, including hiring, training, mentoring, coaching, meetings, and performance evaluations
* Ensure caseload is addressed accurately, quickly, and professionally, and actively monitor partner-related cases to ensure correct handling
* Contribute to internal technical projects, which can include software development, benchmarking, building documentation and training guides, and providing oversight on other engineers' project work
* Ensure we are investing the right resources, addressing the right problems, and scaling the organization properly: drive monthly and quarterly pain and bug reports to Engineering, improve operational workflows with internal teams at MongoDB, coordinate regional trainings, summits, and conferences, and help address market demand for our product and services more broadly

Direct partner support

* Provide in-market support for technology partners to ensure good customer outcomes
* Provide development support through the Design-Win process, helping partners get to market via MongoDB best practices and solution interoperability guidance
* Act as the domain expert and context source for partner-related matters, and facilitate partner engagement as needed
* Onboard partners: document contacts, establish escalation paths, and set up communication channels (Slack, recurring review and check-in cadence)
* Lead Partners Center of Excellence work per onboarded partner: build a partner-specific knowledge base, perform technology reviews of the partner's solution and integration, review partner solution releases for known MongoDB issues, maintain as-built documentation (deployment architecture, product/solution matrix, known issues), communicate best practices, and build a risk mitigation plan

Support for joint and mutual customers

* Lead multi-vendor collaboration when an issue's root cause spans multiple vendors
* Manage mutual support systems and case-handling processes
* Manage partner escalation contacts and processes
* Collaborate with Customer Success Management, Solutions Architects, and other internal stakeholders on high-profile customers as we migrate and support business-critical applications

Program-level objectives the role serves

* Centralized point of contact within Technical Services for partner-account support matters
* Knowledge hub within TS for all partner-related information
* Minimizing technical-interoperability risk for mutual customers
* Champion the customer's and partner's needs and contribute to the evolution of our Developer Data Platform

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

JOB DESCRIPTION

**Innovate in Bengaluru**

This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.

  

**About Lowe’s**

Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com.

**About Lowe’s India**

Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML, enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India

  

**About The Team**

The **Private Brands Team** is committed to delivering a cohesive and consistent brand experience through effective portfolio management and minimizing dependencies on third-party agencies. Our team operates through two distinct functions: Packaging Operations and After Sales Customer Support (ASCS).

The **Packaging Operations Team** is responsible for the execution of our Private Brand strategies. This includes managing packaging, print quality management, packaging innovation, and development. Provides in-house production capabilities for the Private Brands portfolio, through re-fresh and re-design of the SKUs for all Lowe’s brands. This team also ensures that the instruction manuals, legal and packaging copy for the Private Brands products adhere to the quality standards and brand guidelines as set by Lowe's.

  

**Job Summary**

The Senior Manager – Operational Excellence will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, efficiency, and scalability of Private Brands operations. This role will identify process improvement opportunities, eliminate waste and variability, establish performance measures, and deliver cross-functional projects that strengthen end-to-end operational outcomes.

The successful candidate is a strategic, data-driven operations leader with strong project management discipline. They will partner with business stakeholders to design practical solutions, implement sustainable process changes, and build a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and operational rigor.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Lead the operational excellence agenda for Private Brands by identifying, prioritizing, and delivering process-improvement opportunities.
* Assess current-state workflows, identify bottlenecks, handoff gaps, rework, and inefficiencies, and develop future-state processes that improve speed, quality, cost, and stakeholder experience.
* Apply continuous-improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, root-cause analysis, value-stream mapping, and standard work to improve business performance.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, operating procedures, governance mechanisms, and controls to enable consistent execution.
* Drive adoption of simplified, standardized, and scalable ways of working across teams.
  

**Project & Program Management**

* Lead cross-functional projects from problem definition through planning, execution, change adoption, and benefits realization.
* Define project scope, milestones, workplans, dependencies, risks, resource requirements, and success measures.
* Establish clear governance, facilitate stakeholder reviews, manage issue resolution, and provide timely status updates to leadership.
* Balance multiple concurrent initiatives while ensuring delivery against agreed timelines, quality standards, and business outcomes.
* Support change-management activities to ensure new processes, tools, and operating models are effectively embedded.
  

**Performance Management & Analytics**

* Define, track, and improve operational KPIs related to productivity, cycle time, quality, cost, service levels, compliance, and capacity.
* Build reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into performance, improvement opportunities, and project outcomes.
* Use data and business insights to diagnose performance issues, make recommendations, and quantify the value delivered through improvement initiatives.
* Conduct regular operational reviews with stakeholders and translate findings into actionable improvement plans.
  

**Stakeholder & Team Leadership**

* Partner with Private Brands, LGS, PDMs, Category Managers, and other cross-functional teams to improve end-to-end business processes.
* Influence stakeholders at multiple levels through clear communication, structured problem-solving, and a strong focus on business outcomes.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members to build capability in operational excellence, project execution, and continuous improvement.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous learning.
  

**EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

  

* Graduate (in any discipline)

**Work Experience**

**Required**

  

* 13+ Experience in retail, merchandising, Private Brands, product development, packaging, print production, creative operations, or studio management.
* 5+ years of leadership experience
* Experience in retail, merchandising, Private Brands, product development, packaging, print production, creative operations, or studio management.
* Lean, Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, or other relevant process-improvement/project-management certification.
* Experience using operational metrics, dashboards, and data-analysis tools to improve performance.
* Experience working across global or matrixed organizations.
  

  

**Core Competencies:**

  
  

* Operational Excellence
* Continuous Improvement
* Process Design and Standardization
* Project and Program Management
* Strategic Execution
* Data-Driven Decision Making
* Change Management
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* People Leadership
* Executive Communication
  

  

**Licenses and Certifications**

**Required (Any 1)**

* Lean Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, or other relevant process-improvement/project-management certification

title: Technical Implementation Lead
description:
**About Lifesight**
===================

**Lifesight** is a pioneering Unified **Marketing Measurement (UMM)** platform which helps marketers measure, plan and optimise their marketing spend. In a world of fragmented data, unreliable cookies, and outdated reporting, we empower modern businesses to achieve predictable, sustained growth by aligning marketing and finance on a single causal truth.

We are at the forefront of **Agentic Unified Marketing Measurement**. Moving beyond siloed tools and post facto dashboards, our AI-driven causal engine combines Causal MMM, Incrementality testing and Incrementality Adjusted Attribution to create a finance ready marketing decision system.

### **Why We Exist**

Our mission is to eliminate wasted ad spend and remove the guesswork from marketing. Operating as an independent, unbiased measurement layer, Lifesight enables CMOs, CFOs, and performance marketers to confidently answer the only question that matters: *What is the true incremental value of my marketing spend?*

**Join the Future of Decision Intelligence.** We are transforming marketing from a gamble into a science. By joining Lifesight, you will help build the intelligent, agent-ready infrastructure that powers data-driven, optimized decisions for hundreds of top global brands.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

As the Lead – Technical Implementation on our global Solutions team in Bangalore, you'll lead a team of Technical Implementation Specialists and own data onboarding for Lifesight's Unified Marketing Measurement solutions: **Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)**, **Incrementality Experiments**, and **Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)**.

You'll set the standard for how client data gets into Lifesight: scoped clearly, delivered on time, and accurate from day one. This role is for a hands-on leader who can coach a team, run multiple client onboardings in parallel, and speak with equal confidence to a client's data engineer and their CMO.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Lead the team**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of Technical Implementation Specialists; set priorities, review their work, and raise the bar on quality.
* Allocate client onboardings across the team based on complexity, capacity, and skills; step in hands-on when an engagement needs it.
* Build and maintain standard playbooks, checklists, and templates for data onboarding across MMM, Experiments, and MTA.
* Run regular 1:1s and team reviews; give clear feedback and support each specialist's growth.

### **Own data onboarding for MMM, Experiments, and MTA**

* Own end-to-end data onboarding for every client: scoping data requirements, validating pipelines, testing configurations, and signing off on measurement readiness.
* Define what "model-ready" data looks like for each solution: historical spend, KPI, and control variables for MMM; geo and audience-level data for Experiments; event, touchpoint, and conversion data for MTA.
* Oversee how the team combines, cleans, and transforms fragmented, multi-source data across Excel, SQL, and BigQuery.
* Catch data quality issues early (type mismatches, schema inconsistencies, integration gaps, anomalies, outliers) before they affect client outcomes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex implementation issues using internal tooling, APIs, and cross-functional collaboration.

### **Manage projects and timelines**

* Translate client requirements into structured implementation plans with clear milestones, owners, and dates.
* Run multiple onboardings in parallel; track progress, manage dependencies, and keep every project on schedule.
* Spot risks early, escalate with a proposed fix, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Report onboarding status, timelines, and blockers to leadership and client teams.

### **Be the client's trusted technical partner**

* Act as the senior technical point of contact and escalation point for clients during onboarding.
* Lead client calls and workshops; explain data requirements and measurement concepts in plain business language.
* Manage expectations, negotiate scope and timelines, and maintain trust through every engagement.
* Run account health checks and flag risks before they escalate.

### **Improve how we work**

* Use AI tools and prompt engineering to streamline workflows and automate repetitive onboarding tasks across the team.
* Feed structured client and team feedback into Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and tooling.
* Partner with Data Science, Customer Success, and Sales for smooth handoffs from pre-sales through to model delivery.

**P.S.** – The above list need not put a ceiling on your aspirations at Lifesight.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 8+ years in technical implementation, data onboarding, solutioning, or solutions consulting within B2B SaaS; ideally in data, martech, or adtech.
* 2+ years leading small teams (3–6 people) of implementation, solutions, or data specialists, including hiring, coaching, and performance feedback.
* Strong client-facing experience: you've owned onboardings end to end and been the go-to technical contact for enterprise clients.
* Excellent business communication: you write clearly, present with confidence, and adapt your message for engineers, marketers, and executives alike.
* Excellent project management: you run several projects at once, plan milestones, manage dependencies, and deliver on time. Experience with tools like Jira, Asana, or similar.
* Proven ability to scope complex client requirements and turn them into structured, actionable implementation plans.
* Hands-on experience combining, cleaning, and transforming fragmented, multi-format data using Excel, SQL, and BigQuery; Python or JavaScript is a plus.
* Sharp data hygiene instincts; you spot type errors, schema mismatches, and structural inconsistencies, and teach your team to do the same.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs, Google Cloud (BigQuery), and SQL-based transformation workflows.
* Active user of AI tools and prompt engineering techniques (Few-Shot Prompting, Role/Persona Prompting, etc.), and keen to drive their adoption across the team.
* First principles thinking. You take ownership, challenge assumptions, and don't let blockers sit, for yourself or your team.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Direct experience onboarding data for Marketing Mix Models, Incrementality Experiments (geo or audience holdouts), or Multi-Touch Attribution.
* Familiarity with Tag Managers, JS Pixels / SDKs, server-side tracking, AdTech, DSPs, or marketing attribution tools.
* Familiarity with ad platforms and their data exports and APIs: Google Ads, Meta Ads, Programmatic, and similar ad networks.
* Experience building scalable onboarding processes or internal tooling for a growing implementation team.
* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or similar project management certification.

title: Real Estate Sourcing Manager
description:
Company Description

Express Rupya Capital Advisors is a financial advisory firm specializing in arranging institutional funding solutions for Real Estate Developers, NBFCs, HFCs and SMEs.

We work with a network of domestic and international banks, NBFCs, private credit funds, AIFs, institutional investors and family offices to facilitate structured funding solutions for businesses across sectors.

We assist companies in accessing institutional capital for business expansion, project development, acquisitions and working capital requirements, with funding opportunities ranging from ₹20 Cr to ₹1,000 Cr.

Role: Real Estate & Corporate Funding Sourcing Manager

**Location:**
Multiple Cities, India

**Employment Type:**
Freelance / Business Associate

**Compensation:**
Revenue Sharing Basis

Role Description

We are looking for well-connected and experienced professionals across multiple cities who can identify and connect us with companies seeking institutional funding.

The primary responsibility will be to generate qualified funding leads and establish relationships with Real Estate Developers, NBFCs, HFCs and SMEs that have current or upcoming funding requirements.

Candidates should have strong industry connections with promoters, directors, CFOs, senior management, developers and other financial decision-makers who can facilitate funding discussions.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and connect with Real Estate Developers, NBFCs, HFCs and SMEs seeking institutional funding.
* Generate funding proposals for land acquisition and purchase finance.
* Source construction finance and real estate project funding opportunities.
* Identify inventory funding requirements from real estate developers.
* Build relationships with promoters, directors, CFOs and other key decision-makers.
* Understand preliminary funding requirements, ticket sizes and proposed end use.
* Coordinate with the internal advisory team for proposal evaluation and funding execution.
* Develop a strong pipeline of qualified institutional funding opportunities.

Funding Requirements We Cater To

* **Land Purchase Funding:**
  Funding for land acquisition by real estate developers.
* **Construction Finance:**
  Institutional funding for ongoing and upcoming real estate projects.
* **Inventory Funding:**
  Funding against completed or under-construction real estate inventory.
* **Corporate Funding:**
  Structured debt and institutional funding for NBFCs, HFCs and SMEs.

**Funding Ticket Size:**
₹20 Cr to ₹1,000 Cr.

Qualifications

* Strong professional network within the real estate, NBFC, HFC or SME sectors.
* Experience in corporate finance, loan syndication, financial services, real estate consulting, banking or business development.
* Established connections with promoters, directors, CFOs and senior management.
* Ability to identify genuine companies with institutional funding requirements.
* Strong networking, relationship management and communication skills.
* Understanding of corporate debt, structured finance and real estate funding will be an advantage.

Compensation

This is a revenue-sharing opportunity with attractive earning potential linked to successfully converted funding transactions.

* Professionals with established corporate and real estate networks across Indian cities are encouraged to apply.
