title: Client Service Manager - Phoenix
description:
**Job Summary**
Servicing primarily walk-in customers to fulfill the specific transactional requirements of the customer through high quality customer service while increasing product penetration through cross sell and achieving allocated portfolio and revenue targets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure high level of customer service and manage difficult customer situations.
* Ensure resolution of all complaints received for branches through COMMAND.
* Gather/prepare statistics for service quality and productivity indicators
* Ensure compliance with internal and external guidelines and ensure minimal comments in audits and other inspections
* Find ways to improve operational efficiency and control costs to meet cost budgets
* Ensure transactions are processed with a high level of accuracy and commitment within standard turnaround time to satisfy customer needs
* Monitor customer satisfaction survey ratings, net promoter score or any other survey/ feedback ratings taken from customers and ensure continuous improvement if below benchmark, sustain and better-quality service
* Ensure adherence to laid down processes, facilitate first time resolution. Minimize rejections and customer complaints
* Monitor and track transaction volumes and ensure effective transaction migration to alternate channels of banking
* Ensure validity and completeness of transactions processed and ensure concessions relative to exchange rate, fees, charges etc. are authorized/ overridden by appropriate authorities
* Responsible for general reconciliation and control activities
* Be multi-skilled to handle all kinds of transactions and services in the bank as per applicable guidelines
* Sales Referrals: where relevant, identify prospects for cross-selling from observation of customer transactions to highlight to sales staff
* Contribute to branch performance through referrals, efficient customer service, effective operations controls
* He/she is aware of bank’s Mis selling & Sales Policies and ensure adherence all the time.
* Ensure he/ she is fully aware of all the policies and procedures issued in relation to ORMA, Group Code of Conduct, KYC/CDD/EDD & Money laundering prevention. He/she must ensure compliance with these policies and procedures on an ongoing basis. Any suspicious transaction must immediately be reported to the supervising officer.
* Premises management in areas of merchandising, housekeeping as well as store management. Branch upkeep and maintenance
* Responsible for health and safety for all. As part of the Health and Safety guidelines you should:
* Take reasonable care for the health and safety of co-workers and those who may be affected by your actions or your omissions; Co-operate with Management to support and promote Health and safety in the workplace;
* Ensure that your actions do not put others at risk; Work in a healthy and safe manner;
* Encourage others to work in a healthy and safe manner
* Report all accidents and incidents and bring to the attention of the management any hazard in the workplace

**Strategy**

* Client Services: Client Service Managers (CSM) to deliver consistent and high-quality service to Private Banking clients.
* Facilitate a smooth working relationship of Front Office teams with support functions.
* Business Controls: To comply with all applicable money laundering prevention procedures and highlight suspicious activities/behaviour of clients and staff e.g., account irregularities and alert TL of the suspicious transactions on a timely basis.
* Fully compliant with regulations and Group policies and guidelines, and be able to highlight, mitigate and protect the bank against credit, legal, documentation, repetition and other risks; to conduct business at all times in a compliance-conscious manner and alert to the potential risks of money laundering and other undesirable transactions/activity during and after client on-boarding process.

**Business**

* Work with relevant teams to enhance the control environment within the Front Office.

**Processes**

* Provide comprehensive client support services to TL / RMs in executing a broad range of banking and investment transactions for Private Banking clients.
* Provide concise and relevant information flow and execute all client transactional and administrative needs accurately and on a timely basis (information flow and client requests might include but not be limited to exchange rate requests, referral letters).
* Handle and resolve day-to-day queries from clients on transactional activity, operations, systems, account re-balancing processes etc.
* Support TL/RMs to complete sales documentation and related processes (e.g. client profiling / KYC diligence) and input such information together with deal information into data capture and / or transaction processing systems. Assist TL/RMs in preparing Business Credit Application, financial review documentation and other customer correspondence as and when required. Support TL/RMs in attending to and follow-up on customer service issues with clients and internal departments, and in all cases report and escalate customer complaints to management in accordance with established procedures. Failure to report and escalate complaints will result in disciplinary action.
* Handle and ensure clients’ documents and reporting comply with internal process standards.
* Ensure full awareness of and adherence to the policy and procedures e.g. credit policy and operation procedures.

**People & Talent**

* Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values.
* Develop professional skills of oneself, including training, license registrations, and deepening of “knowledge spikes” on specific topics by the CSM Team Leaders.

**Risk Management**

* Responsibility for identifying, assessing, monitoring, controlling and mitigating risks that may be posed by activities conducted by the RMs. Also, an awareness and understanding of the main risks facing the Group and the role the individual plays in managing them.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Lead the Local Client Services Team to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles. Fair Outcomes for Clients, Effective Financial Markets, Financial Crime Compliance, The Right Environment.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Relationship Managers and Team Leaders
* Client Onboarding Managers

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed here for good and the Group’s brand and values.
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.i

**Skills And Experience**

* Diligent & Punctual
* Knowledgeable about the role
* Certified with relevant courses
* Confident
* Fluent in Language
* Banking Exposure
* Management Information Skills
* Good Interpersonal Skills
* Customer and Service Oriented

**Qualifications**

* Post Graduate, consistent academic career
* Client servicing (2 to 5 years)
* Able to pick up new concepts quickly
* Excellent communication, interpersonal & relationship building skills
* Banking knowledge
* Good Interpersonal Skills

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

title: ServiceNow Solution Consultant
description:
Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking.  Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies.  We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one.
  
  
Support INRY’s ServiceNow sales opportunities by translating customer needs into credible, outcome-focused solution proposals. The Solution Consultant partners with Go-To-Market (GTM), delivery, and technical teams across discovery, qualification, solution design, estimation, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, presentations, and demonstrations. The role also helps keep INRY’s solution offerings, demos, and reusable presales content current and market-ready.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Discovery and qualification: Gather and analyze customer requirements from discovery calls, first meetings, RFPs, and RFIs. Capture business needs, use cases, scope, assumptions, constraints, decision factors, and open questions.
* Solution development: Map customer requirements to relevant ServiceNow capabilities and INRY offerings. Work with GTM, delivery, and technical teams to validate feasibility, dependencies, solution approach, and proposed outcomes.
* Proposals, estimates, and RFX responses: Build proposal presentations, solution descriptions, estimation sheets, and pricing inputs. Draft and coordinate clear, accurate responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, confirming technical and delivery inputs and meeting submission timelines.
* Statements of Work: Develop or contribute to SOWs and related commercial documents, including scope, objectives, deliverables, assumptions, and dependencies; obtain the appropriate internal reviews.
* Customer presentations: Present proposed solutions and INRY capabilities to customers, explain the rationale and expected outcomes, respond to questions, and support customer planning and roadmap conversations.
* Demonstrations and PoCs: Prepare and deliver ServiceNow demonstrations that fit the customer use case. Maintain demo scripts and readiness for supported offerings; coordinate advanced demonstrations and proofs-of-concept with delivery or technical specialists, and contribute to PoC planning and execution.
* Solution and offering assets: Create and update customer-specific introduction and solution decks, service descriptions, offering collateral, industry or event materials, and customer success stories. Maintain reusable proposal and first-call content.
* Platform and market readiness: Stay current with ServiceNow releases, product capabilities, and relevant market needs; reflect useful changes in demos, service descriptions, and solution offerings.
* AI solution positioning: Identify relevant ServiceNow AI opportunities, including Now Assist and agentic AI; help frame customer use cases and business value, and coordinate AI demonstrations or PoCs with AI and technical specialists. Validate feasibility and make assumptions, dependencies, and included versus optional AI scope clear.
* Pod and team coordination: Support assigned GTM or sales-pod deal cadence, track actions and blockers, coordinate contributors, and keep internal stakeholders aligned on deliverables and due dates.
* SSI enablement: Share solution knowledge with colleagues and contribute to internal guidelines, training materials, case studies, and improvements to the team’s content library and presales process.

**Qualifications and skills:**

* 3–4 years of experience in ServiceNow presales, solution consulting, implementation consulting, or a closely related customer-facing role. Direct ServiceNow presales experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of the ServiceNow platform and experience positioning one or more ServiceNow products or workflows for customer needs.
* Experience contributing to proposal writing and estimation, customer presentations or demos, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Ability to understand customer requirements, structure a solution approach, and clearly communicate assumptions, scope, feasibility, and dependencies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, delivery, and technical contributors, while managing multiple deal deadlines.
* Strong written communication, presentation, organization, and customer-engagement skills.
* A consultative approach, techno-functional curiosity, and the ability to tell a clear solution story to technical and non-technical audiences.

**What We Believe In**

title: Partner- Risk & Compliance
description:
Job Title: Partner- Risk & Compliance

City: Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune

State/Province: Karnataka, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu

Posting Start Date: 11/6/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Role Purpose**  
Lead and scale the Financial Risk and Regulatory Reporting practice. The role combines deep practitioner credibility, strategic practice building, market enablement, account ownership and selective client delivery. The successful candidate will strengthen capabilities across credit risk, counterparty credit risk, market risk, liquidity risk, interest rate risk and risk/regulatory reporting, while creating a commercially sustainable pipeline and measurable client impact.

**Role Boundary**  
This role is intentionally focused on financial risk and regulatory reporting. Financial crime compliance, AML and fraud experience may be useful as adjacent exposure, but it is not the primary selection criterion for this position.

**͏**
-----

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Practice Leadership and Capability Building**  

* Define and execute the practice strategy, portfolio, operating model and annual growth priorities for Financial Risk and Regulatory Reporting.
* Build differentiated offerings, accelerators, reference architectures, methods, reusable assets and practitioner communities across financial risk domains.
* Develop a strong talent pyramid through hiring, mentoring, certification pathways, succession planning and deployment across priority accounts.
* Create alliances and capability plans around risk platforms, regulatory reporting products, data, analytics and quantitative risk solutions.

**Market and Account Growth**  

* Partner with market, sector, account and sales leaders to identify whitespace in banks and financial institutions where financial risk capabilities are underpenetrated.
* Own selected strategic accounts and shape opportunities from diagnostic and advisory work through transformation, implementation and managed services.
* Lead client conversations, workshops, proposals, solutioning, estimations and oral presentations; convert domain insight into qualified pipeline and revenue.
* Build executive relationships with CRO, CFO, Chief Credit Officer, Treasurer, Head of Market Risk, Head of Regulatory Reporting and Risk Technology leaders.
* Support growth in priority global banking accounts, including institutions with complex credit, market, treasury and regulatory reporting agendas.

**Client Delivery and Billability**  

* Maintain partial billability through advisory, programme leadership, solution assurance, risk transformation or regulatory reporting engagements.
* Provide senior oversight for scope, outcomes, quality, architecture, risk models, controls, data lineage, testing, governance and regulatory readiness.
* Act as the senior practitioner for complex pursuits and programmes, resolving domain issues and protecting delivery credibility.
* Ensure repeatable delivery economics, strong client references and conversion of engagements into follow-on work.

**͏**
-----

**Core Domain Expertise**  

* Credit risk management: origination, underwriting, rating/scoring, limit management, portfolio monitoring, early warning, collections interfaces, IFRS 9 / CECL, expected credit loss and stress testing.
* Counterparty credit risk: exposure measurement, PFE, netting/collateral, limits, XVA awareness, SA-CCR and concentration management.
* Market risk: VaR/expected shortfall, sensitivities, stress testing, FRTB awareness, limits, model governance and market risk reporting.
* Liquidity and treasury risk: liquidity risk measurement, LCR/NSFR awareness, stress testing, funds transfer pricing interfaces and contingency funding.
* Interest rate risk in the banking book: NII/EVE measures, behavioural assumptions, scenario analysis and ALM reporting.
* Risk and regulatory reporting: data sourcing, aggregation, lineage, controls, reconciliations, submissions, attestation and remediation across multi-jurisdictional banking environments.
* Risk data and quantitative analysis: portfolio analytics, model inputs/outputs, data quality, BCBS 239 principles and model risk governance interfaces.

**Platforms and Technology Exposure**  

* Hands-on or programme-level exposure to platforms such as AxiomSL, Moody's Analytics and comparable credit risk, market risk, ALM, risk data or regulatory reporting solutions.
* Understanding of risk data architectures, data lakes/warehouses, finance-risk data integration, APIs, cloud modernisation and analytics platforms.
* Ability to work with quantitative teams and interpret risk measures, models, assumptions and outputs without being limited to a purely functional coordination role.
* Experience leading platform selection, implementation, migration, remediation or managed-service transformation is highly desirable.

**Experience and Qualifications**  

* 18-20 years of relevant experience in banking, consulting, risk advisory, risk technology or regulatory reporting, with significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrable track record of leading and growing a financial risk practice, capability, portfolio or major risk transformation programme.
* Strong practitioner depth in at least two of the following: credit risk, counterparty credit risk, market risk, liquidity/ALM, interest rate risk or risk/regulatory reporting.
* Experience working with global banks and senior client stakeholders; evidence of shaping and winning complex consulting or transformation opportunities.
* Proven ability to balance practice leadership, commercial ownership and selective client billability.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, engineering, computer science, business or a related field.
* Relevant professional credentials such as FRM, CFA, PRM, CQF or equivalent are desirable.

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions.

Applications from people with disabilities are explicitly welcome.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-263606 **Date posted** 11/06/2026

**Title: Analyst - Campaign Operations Analyst, Salesforce MCA and Adobe Campaign**

**Career Level: C3**

**About AstraZeneca**
---------------------

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to turn marketing automation into measurable impact for patients and company outcomes? In the position of Campaign Operations Analyst located in Chennai, you will be responsible for managing multi-channel campaigns using the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform and Adobe Campaign. These campaigns help our medicines and programs reach the people who need them most. Your work will translate strategy into timely, relevant, and compliant communications that support brand objectives and patient outcomes.

You will join a collaborative, fast-moving team that brings marketers, data specialists, and technologists together to deliver at scale. Can you see yourself translating sophisticated requirements into detailed, multi-channel journeys at pace? Here, your expertise in building, testing, and optimizing campaigns will drive outcomes that matter—speed to market, engagement quality, and operational excellence.

**Accountabilities:**

* Campaign Build and Execution: Configure, build, test, and deliver emails, journeys, Cloud Pages, SMS, push notifications, and workflows across Adobe Campaign and the marketing cloud environment provided by Salesforce to meet defined business goals.
* End-to-End Delivery Ownership: Own campaigns from requirements capturing through QA, deployment, monitoring, and post-launch validation, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and impact.
* Collaborate with IT and data teams to enable clean, reliable data flows and integrations from multiple sources. Apply schemas, supplementary data structures, and governance principles to ensure audiences remain accurate and compliant.
* Personalization and Targeting: Implement segmentation, multifaceted content, tailored strategies, classification systems, and targeting logic that increase relevance and performance across channels.
* Quality, Compliance, and Governance: Follow SOPs, SLAs, change control, and access standards; uphold privacy, consent, suppression, and preference management to protect customers and the business.
* Fix and Continuous Improvement: Diagnose and resolve workflow, delivery, journey, automation, and data issues; escalate appropriately and foster insights into platform and process improvements.
* Collaborator Partnership: Translate requirements from business partners into robust technical solutions; communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to diverse collaborators across regions.
* Reusable Assets and Scalability: Build and maintain templates, workflows, automations, and standard configurations that improve consistency, speed, and scale across markets.
* Measurement and Optimization: Supervise campaign health and delivery; validate audiences and outcomes, and recommend enhancements that boost efficiency, data quality, and engagement over time.

**Crucial Skills/Experience:**
------------------------------

* 4-6 years of overall experience in marketing automation with SFMC, covering modules such as Email Studio and Journey Builder, Interaction Studio, Einstein, Automation Studio, and Adobe Campaign.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Campaign and/or the Salesforce digital marketing platform in a campaign operations or marketing automation environment.
* Practical knowledge of Adobe Campaign workflows, deliveries, targeting, segmentation, personalization, typologies, and schemas.
* Knowledge of SFMC capabilities including Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, CloudPages, Data Extensions, and audience segmentation.
* Solid understanding of SQL; exposure to AMPscript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, JSON, SOQL, APIs, and platform integrations is advantageous.
* Good understanding of campaign lifecycle management, data quality, audience segmentation, personalization, QA, and deployment processes.
* Understanding of data security, permission, blocking procedures, preference management, and access-control principles within marketing platforms.
* Strong analytical, solve, communication, and collaborator collaboration skills.
* Ability to work within established SOPs, SLAs, QA, change-management, and production deployment processes.
* Experience managing multiple campaign work in a fast-paced campaign operations environment while maintaining quality and timelines.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Certifications in Marketing Cloud by Salesforce and/or Adobe Campaign.
* Sophisticated AMPscript and SSJS for personalization, CloudPages, and integrations.
* Experience with real-time and batch integrations using APIs, connectors, and event-based architectures.
* Knowledge of deliverability best practices, tracking, and testing tools across email and mobile channels.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, backlog management, and version control for campaign assets.
* Experience in regulated industries and with regional data privacy requirements.

**Why AstraZeneca:**

Join a mission-driven company where technology, data, and science come together to improve lives. You will work alongside marketers, engineers, and scientists who collaborate closely to solve complex challenges, often bringing unexpected teams into the same room to unlock bold thinking. We move with urgency, invest in modern platforms, and empower people to take smart risks while valuing kindness alongside ambition. Your contribution will help shape how we inform, educate, and support patients and healthcare professionals around the world, with the tools and mentorship to keep growing your craft.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. title: Sales Staff
description:
**Company Description**
BUYCEMENT is a growing organization focused on providing reliable cement and construction material solutions to businesses and individual customers. The company aims to simplify the purchasing process by offering transparent pricing, consistent product availability, and dependable delivery services. BUYCEMENT values long-term relationships with clients and partners and emphasizes customer satisfaction and trust. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, collaborate, and help build efficient sales and service processes. The work environment supports professional growth, performance-based recognition, and learning within the construction materials industry.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales Staff role based in Hyderabad. The Sales Staff member will engage with customers, respond to inquiries, and support them in selecting appropriate cement and related products based on project requirements. Daily responsibilities include generating and qualifying leads, following up on sales opportunities, preparing quotations, and maintaining accurate records of client interactions and orders. The role involves coordinating with internal teams for inventory checks, delivery timelines, and invoicing, as well as visiting client locations when required. The Sales Staff will also monitor market trends, competitors, and pricing, and provide feedback to management to help refine sales strategies and customer service standards.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain professional relationships with a diverse customer base.
* Basic knowledge of sales processes, negotiation, and customer service, preferably within construction materials or related industries.
* Ability to work on-site in Hyderabad, manage time effectively, and handle multiple inquiries and tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort with using computers, spreadsheets, and sales or CRM tools to record data, prepare quotations, and track orders.
* Attention to detail, numerical aptitude, and an organized approach to handling documentation, pricing, and order follow-up.
* Willingness to learn product specifications, industry terminology, and market trends relevant to cement and construction materials.
* Minimum educational qualification of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, or a related field is an advantage.
* Previous experience in sales, retail, or field marketing is beneficial but not mandatory; early-career candidates are encouraged to apply.

Bring the target, the achievement, the percentage and the period for your last two or three cycles. We will ask. Thinking and initiative • Finds ways into accounts that others miss, and builds an offer around the client's real problem. • Works without being managed. We care less about whether you have built AI products and more about whether you understand where the money leaks. Travel • Travel to parent-company locations, mainly the US, as accounts mature, building to roughly half the year on a cycle of about 15 days in India followed by 15 days abroad. Valid passport required, US visa preferred.

Good to have • Background at a Tier 1 consulting or systems integration firm. • Familiarity with HIPAA, EHR/EMR ecosystems (Epic, Cerner and similar) and HL7/FHIR interoperability. • Prior experience selling AI, analytics, digital transformation or SaaS into healthcare. • Existing relationships with NASSCOM chapter heads or the GCC Council. • Experience managing strategic accounts and complex pursuits with many stakeholders. • Sales certification covering the full sales motion from prospecting to closing. Salesforce Certified Agentforce Sales Foundations preferred; HubSpot Academy or LinkedIn Learning equivalents also relevant. Education Bachelor's degree required. MBA or PGDM from a premier institute preferred.

Who this is not for • Someone who has sold generic IT services across many industries without going deep in healthcare. • Someone with no existing relationships inside healthcare GCCs. • Someone who needs a pre-built deck or a ready-made list to get a meeting. • Someone who wants a pure account management role. The ideal candidate should have a proven track record of independently acquiring clients, closing business deals, generating revenue and building strong client relationships. We are particularly interested in professionals with an established industry network, experience working with startups and the ability to develop business opportunities from scratch.

The candidate must be a proactive salesperson who takes complete ownership of sales outcomes, understands internal business requirements and converts opportunities into successful commercial engagements.

This role requires someone who can think independently, leverage existing industry connections and consistently deliver measurable business results.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Deal Closures**

* Identify, develop and convert new business opportunities into paying clients.
* Independently manage the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and client engagement to negotiations and deal closures.
* Generate revenue by acquiring new clients and expanding existing accounts.
* Handle high-value accounts and manage commercial negotiations.
* Develop and execute effective sales strategies to achieve business targets.
* Build a healthy sales pipeline and consistently drive closures.

* Leverage existing professional networks and industry connections to generate qualified business opportunities.
* Establish relationships with CXOs, founders, business leaders and key decision-makers.
* Identify potential clients across target industries and markets.
* Develop strategic partnerships and explore new business channels.
* Build long-term relationships that contribute to sustainable business growth.

**3. Startup Ecosystem & Business Growth**

* Bring experience working with startups, emerging businesses or fast-growing organisations.
* Understand startup business environments, limited resources and evolving business requirements.
* Demonstrate the ability to build business opportunities from scratch without relying entirely on an established brand or sales infrastructure.
* Develop practical sales strategies suited to startup environments.
* Drive business growth through proactive networking, client engagement and independent execution.

**4. Internal Coordination & Business Enablement**

* Understand business requirements and opportunities identified by internal teams.
* Collaborate with technical, delivery, operations and leadership teams to convert requirements into commercial opportunities.
* Ensure smooth coordination between sales and internal stakeholders.
* Proactively address business challenges and resolve coordination gaps.
* Take accountability for outcomes instead of shifting responsibilities between departments.

**5. Sales Strategy & Independent Ownership**

* Develop independent sales strategies, execution plans and client acquisition approaches.
* Identify potential bottlenecks in the sales process and implement effective solutions.
* Monitor sales performance, conversion rates and revenue targets.
* Take ownership of business opportunities from initial engagement through final closure.
* Demonstrate strong decision-making, problem-solving and execution capabilities.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* 7–12 years of experience in IT Services Sales, Business Development or B2B Sales.
* Proven track record of independently closing business deals and generating revenue.
* Strong experience in new client acquisition and managing high-value accounts.
* An established professional network with access to relevant business decision-makers.
* Previous experience working with startups or fast-growing organisations.
* Strong understanding of IT services, technology consulting and solution-based selling.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Ability to independently develop sales strategies and drive business closures.
* Strong ownership, accountability and problem-solving capabilities.
* Immediate joiners or candidates with a short notice period preferred.

**Preferred Industry & Service Exposure**

Experience selling any of the following IT services will be an advantage:

* Custom Software Development
* AI/ML and Generative AI Solutions
* Cloud Computing and Digital Transformation
* Product Engineering
* Web and Mobile Application Development
* IT Consulting and Technology Services
* Application Development and Modernisation

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for a hands-on salesperson who can bring business to the organisation, leverage existing industry connections and independently convert opportunities into revenue.

The candidate must be capable of working in a fast-paced startup environment, collaborating with internal teams and resolving business challenges without unnecessary dependency or responsibility shifting.

**Our priority is actual business generation and successful deal closures, not merely lead generation, meeting coordination or sales pipeline management.**

We value professionals who demonstrate ownership, strong commercial understanding, independent thinking and a consistent ability to deliver results.

title: Sales Development Specialist - Night shift
description:

About iCompaas

iCompaas is a leading compliance platform for SaaS businesses on cloud, helping organizations navigate certification lifecycles and regulatory requirements like SOC2 Type2, ISO27001, ISO42001 and GDPR, HIPAA, and DPDPA. We're seeking a strategic and results driven Sales Development Executive to spearhead our business development efforts.
Position Overview

As a Senior Sales Development Executive, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth through strategic inbound and outbound prospecting, building a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities, and creating scalable lead generation processes. This position requires a hunter mentality with 1 to 3+ years of proven success in B2B sales development, particularly in SaaS, technology, and cybersecurity sectors.

**Key Responsibilities
:**
Strategic Outbound Prospecting

* Design and execute targeted account-based prospecting campaigns to penetrate key enterprise and mid-market accounts
* Identify and research high-value prospects across compliance-focused industries (healthcare, finance, technology, etc.)
* Develop and maintain a strategic target account list aligned with company growth objectives
* Utilize advanced prospecting techniques including multi-channel outreach (phone, email, LinkedIn, video)

Lead Generation & Qualification

* Generate a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities through proactive outbound efforts
* Conduct in-depth discovery conversations to understand complex business challenges and compliance pain points
* Qualify leads using BANT/MEDDIC or similar frameworks, focusing on enterprise-level opportunities
* Achieve and exceed monthly/quarterly targets for qualified meetings, SQL generation, and pipeline contribution

Campaign Development & Execution

* Create and test personalized outreach sequences and messaging strategies
* Collaborate with marketing to develop targeted campaigns for specific verticals or use cases
* Analyze campaign performance and optimize strategies based on data-driven insights
* A/B test messaging, timing, and channels to improve conversion rates

CRM & Pipeline Management

* Maintain accurate and detailed records in HubSpot CRM with comprehensive prospect information
* Build and manage a healthy pipeline with consistent activity metrics and progression
* Track and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) including activity metrics, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity
* Ensure seamless handoff of qualified opportunities to Account Executives with detailed context

Collaboration & Enablement

* Partner closely with Account Executives to refine ideal customer profiles (ICP) and targeting criteria
* Provide market intelligence and competitive insights to sales and marketing teams
* Mentor and guide junior SDRs on outbound best practices and effective prospecting techniques
* Contribute to the development of sales playbooks, scripts, and enablement materials

Continuous Improvement

* Stay current on industry trends, compliance regulations, and competitive landscape
* Provide feedback on product positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, and methodologies
* Participate in ongoing training and professional development initiatives

**Required Qualifications**
Experience

* **0-3 years**
   of proven success as a Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative, or similar role in B2B SaaS or technology
* **Minimum 1 years**
   of outbound prospecting experience with demonstrated track record of exceeding quotas
* Experience selling into compliance, security, IT, or related technical buying personas
* Proven success in complex B2B sales cycles with deal values of $50K+

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Technical Skills

* **Advanced proficiency in HubSpot CRM**
   (1+ years preferred) or similar enterprise CRM platforms
* Experience with sales engagement platforms (Outreach, SalesLoft, Apollo, etc.)
* Proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and prospecting tools (ZoomInfo, Lusha, Cognism, etc.)
* Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite / Google Workspace
* Experience with data enrichment and sales intelligence tools

Core Competencies

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with ability to craft compelling, personalized messaging
* Strong business acumen and ability to understand technical concepts related to compliance, cloud security, and regulatory frameworks
* Consultative approach with excellent active listening and questioning skills
* Data-driven mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Self-motivated, highly organized, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment
* Proven ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, NIST)
* Experience in the compliance, cybersecurity, or cloud infrastructure sectors
* Knowledge of cloud computing platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and security solutions
* Previous experience in a leadership or mentorship capacity
* Additional language proficiency (particularly in regional languages for the Hyderabad market)

**Personal Attributes**

* **Hunter mentality**
   with entrepreneurial drive and competitive spirit
* Resilient and persistent with ability to handle rejection and maintain positive attitude
* Strategic thinker who can balance tactical execution with long-term planning
* Coachable and growth-oriented with commitment to continuous improvement
* High integrity and professionalism in all interactions
* Team player who celebrates collective success

**Performance Metrics**

* Number of qualified meetings/opportunities generated monthly
* Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) conversion rate
* Pipeline contribution and influenced revenue
* Activity metrics (calls, emails, social touches)
* Quota attainment and goal achievement
* Lead-to-opportunity conversion rate

**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Compensation**

* **Professional Growth**
  : Clear career progression path to Senior SDR, Team Lead, or Account Executive roles
* **Comprehensive Benefits**
  : PF, and other statutory benefits
* **Learning & Development**

* **Dynamic Work Environment**
  : Collaborative culture with a passionate team driving innovation in compliance technology
* **Modern Tools & Technology**

title: Real Estate & Corporate Funding Sourcing Manager
description:
Company Description

Express Rupya Capital Advisors is a financial advisory firm specializing in arranging institutional funding solutions for Real Estate Developers, NBFCs, HFCs and SMEs.

We work with a network of domestic and international banks, NBFCs, private credit funds, AIFs, institutional investors and family offices to facilitate structured funding solutions for businesses across sectors.

We assist companies in accessing institutional capital for business expansion, project development, acquisitions and working capital requirements, with funding opportunities ranging from ₹20 Cr to ₹1,000 Cr.

Role: Real Estate & Corporate Funding Sourcing Manager

**Location:**
Multiple Cities, India

**Employment Type:**
Freelance / Business Associate

**Compensation:**
Revenue Sharing Basis

Role Description

We are looking for well-connected and experienced professionals across multiple cities who can identify and connect us with companies seeking institutional funding.

The primary responsibility will be to generate qualified funding leads and establish relationships with Real Estate Developers, NBFCs, HFCs and SMEs that have current or upcoming funding requirements.

Candidates should have strong industry connections with promoters, directors, CFOs, senior management, developers and other financial decision-makers who can facilitate funding discussions.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and connect with Real Estate Developers, NBFCs, HFCs and SMEs seeking institutional funding.
* Generate funding proposals for land acquisition and purchase finance.
* Source construction finance and real estate project funding opportunities.
* Identify inventory funding requirements from real estate developers.
* Build relationships with promoters, directors, CFOs and other key decision-makers.
* Understand preliminary funding requirements, ticket sizes and proposed end use.
* Coordinate with the internal advisory team for proposal evaluation and funding execution.

* **Construction Finance:**
  Institutional funding for ongoing and upcoming real estate projects.
* **Inventory Funding:**
  Funding against completed or under-construction real estate inventory.
* **Corporate Funding:**
  Structured debt and institutional funding for NBFCs, HFCs and SMEs.

**Funding Ticket Size:**
₹20 Cr to ₹1,000 Cr.

Qualifications

* Strong professional network within the real estate, NBFC, HFC or SME sectors.
* Experience in corporate finance, loan syndication, financial services, real estate consulting, banking or business development.
* Established connections with promoters, directors, CFOs and senior management.
* Ability to identify genuine companies with institutional funding requirements.
* Strong networking, relationship management and communication skills.
* Understanding of corporate debt, structured finance and real estate funding will be an advantage.

Compensation

This is a revenue-sharing opportunity with attractive earning potential linked to successfully converted funding transactions.

* Professionals with established corporate and real estate networks across Indian cities are encouraged to apply.

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
Zenoti provides an all-in-one, cloud-based software solution for the beauty and wellness industry. Our solution allows users to seamlessly manage every aspect of the business in a comprehensive mobile solution: online appointment bookings, POS, CRM, employee management, inventory management, built-in marketing programs and more. Zenoti helps clients streamline their systems and reduce costs, while simultaneously improving customer retention and spending. Our platform is engineered for reliability and scale and harnesses the power of enterprise-level technology for businesses of all sizes
  
  
Zenoti powers more than 30,000 salons, spas, medspas and fitness studios in over 50 countries. This includes a vast portfolio of global brands, such as European Wax Center, Hand & Stone, Massage Heights, Rush Hair & Beauty, Sono Bello, Profile by Sanford, Hair Cuttery, CorePower Yoga and TONI&GUY.
  
  
Our recent accomplishments include surpassing a $1 billion unicorn valuation, being named Next Tech Titan by GeekWire, raising an $80 million investment from TPG, ranking as the 316th fastest-growing company in North America on Deloitte’s 2020 Technology Fast 500™. We are also proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work CertifiedTM for 2021-2022 as this reaffirms our commitment to empowering people to feel good and find their greatness. To learn more about Zenoti visit: https://www.zenoti.com
  
  
**What's the opportunity?**
As a Sales Operations Analyst, working Night-Shift, you will be the first point of contact for our US AE and SDR teams on the sales tech stack. You will keep reps selling by resolving their questions quickly, onboarding new hires onto our tools, and administering the systems they rely on, including Salesforce, CPQ, Highspot, Ring Central, Gong, Outreach, Qualified, Zoom and Jira. You will also protect data quality through governance and drive process efficiency as we scale.
  
  
**What will I be doing?**
***Rep support and onboarding***

* Act as the primary contact for rep questions on the sales tech stack, resolving the issue or unblocking the rep within agreed response times.
* Direct reps to the agreed support channels so requests are visible to the team, can be tracked, and patterns in support needs can be spotted.
* Communicate across departments to unblock reps: contact the relevant teams, state the requirement and its urgency, follow up to resolution and keep the rep informed.
* Onboard and configure all new hires on the tech stack (access, licences, setup, readiness), hitting agreed deadlines, and maintain the onboarding readiness tracker and tech stack evaluation checklist.
* Maintain rep-facing documentation in Confluence: FAQs, process guides, tool documentation and training materials. Update them as processes and tools change.
* Deliver training sessions and ask-me-anything (AMA) sessions to reps, including for new tool launches and go-lives, and keep the content current.
* Share a daily handover of open and closed items, blockers and risks, on time, every working day.
* Work independently during your shift, including when managers and senior Sales Ops leads are offline. Resolve rep questions without escalating wherever you can. Escalate urgent issues straight away through the agreed escalation route, meaning anything that stops a rep closing, signing or selling, such as a deal closing at quarter-end or a quote blocking a signature. Log everything else in the daily handover for the team’s next working hours.

***Quote, contract and billing support***

* Handle DocuSign and billing system requests before billing is set up, so that closed deals are not delayed.
* Run closed account checks and make corrections so deal and account records are accurate before they move downstream.
* Support sales teams through billing system changes and go-lives with clear guidance and documentation.

***Systems administration***

* Administer Jira, including projects, workflows, automation rules, request templates, automated responses, permissions and the sales operations request queue.
* Maintain and optimise the tech stack, including Jira, a Custom CPQ, DocuSign, Highspot, Outreach, RingCentral, Gong, Zoom, Qualifed and Confluence, with regular tool hygiene checks.
* Administer Gong, including user and domain settings, and investigate recording issues.
* Evaluate new releases and new technology, test and roll out approved changes within agreed timelines, and present recommendations.
* Find the root cause of recurring issues and fix it with a process, automation or documentation change.

***Data governance and reporting***

* Govern Salesforce data across leads, opportunities and accounts, and perform bulk updates.
* Own the review and correction of sync issues between Outreach and Salesforce.
* Own recurring daily, month-end and quarter-end tasks to fixed dates: clearing exceptions, checking closure accuracy, updating currency rates and maintaining dashboard filters.
* Fulfil ad-hoc reporting and dashboard requests in Salesforce.
* Act as a functional expert in sales operations: own, document and improve ops processes, streamline workflows and ensure SOPs are followed.

**How We Work**
These are the standards we work to, and we assess them in interviews alongside technical skills.
  
  

* Reps come first. Our priority is to keep reps selling.
* Solutions-oriented. You bring solutions, recommendations and root cause analysis, and lead with a proposed fix instead of information alone.
* You own an item through to the outcome and don't stop at identifying the problem.
* Reliable commitments. The dates you give are dates we can plan around. You deliver without being chased, and if a date is at risk, you say so before it passes.
* Proactive communication. You update stakeholders on status, blockers and slipping deadlines, and share a daily handover.
* Accurate reporting. You measure your own work against the data and report your results as they are.
* Confidentiality and Integrity apply rules consistently, without favouring particular reps.
* Speed and priorities. You work fast and prioritise by rep impact and deadline.
* Cross-functional teamwork. You work with colleagues across functions. When an issue needs another team, you co-ordinate the communication and urgency and own it to completion.

**Is this role for you?**
**This Role Is For You If**

* You get satisfaction from resolving a rep's problem and seeing it through to the end.
* You are comfortable working night shift hours.
* You write clearly and keep documentation current as processes change.
* You can drive work across teams and follow up until it is resolved.
* You keep your commitments without being chased and raise problems early with a proposed fix.

**What skills do I need?**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree. An MBA is a plus.
* A minimum of 2 years of experience in sales operations or a related function.
* Strong understanding of how SaaS organisations operate and scale.
* 2+ years of Salesforce experience including bulk loads, data governance, leads, contacts, accounts and opportunities, as well as building and maintaining reports and dashboards.
* 2+ years of experience administering Jira, including workflows, automation rules and request templates.
* Experience owning and administering a sales tech stack, including onboarding users and supporting them directly.
* CPQ experience.
* Experience supporting quote, contract or billing processes, such as DocuSign or a billing system.
* Excellent written communication and problem-solving skills, with a track record of writing clear documentation.
* Responsive and service-minded.
* Strong attention to detail and a process-driven approach, and the ability to prioritise multiple requests.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce opportunity stages and our sales tech stack, enough to answer most rep questions without escalating.
* Willingness to work extended hours during periods of high demand, such as quarter-close or year-end.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on administration of Outreach, Highspot, Gong or RingCentral.
* Salesforce Administrator certification.
* Experience building automation, for example Jira automation rules or Salesforce Flow.
* Experience delivering training to sales teams.
* Experience evaluating new technology and presenting a recommendation.

**Hours**

* 8:30 PM - 4:30 AM IST (US Winter)
* 7:30 PM - 3:30 AM IST (US Summer)

title: Sales Compensation Analyst
description:
This role sits at the intersection of
**Finance, Sales Operations, and Systems**
, supporting commission calculations, platform administration, and performance reporting. You will be responsible for executing day-to-day compensation processes, maintaining data integrity across systems, and assisting with reporting that provides visibility into sales performance.

This is a highly quantitative and detail-oriented role. You will support commission calculations and payout processes while contributing to continuous process improvements as the organization scales. If you enjoy working with complex data, solving compensation challenges, and supporting fast-paced sales organizations, this role offers meaningful impact and professional growth opportunities.

**What You Will Do**

* Assist in the rollout and ongoing administration of sales compensation programs, plan documentation, and user support.
* Execute monthly and quarterly sales commission calculations, validations, reconciliations, and payout preparation, ensuring high accuracy and timeliness.
* Maintain dashboards and analytical models to track quota attainment, commission payouts, and performance trends.
* Support the administration of the organization's Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) platform, including data uploads, basic plan configuration, and user acceptance testing for plan updates.
* Partner cross-functionally with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Accounting, and Systems teams to ensure data integrity across Salesforce, compensation platforms, and reporting systems, while supporting close and governance processes.
* Respond to routine sales team inquiries regarding commission payouts and provide timely, accurate clarifications.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2-5 years of experience in sales compensation, commissions administration, sales operations, finance, or a related analytical role, preferably within a SaaS or technology environment.
* Strong proficiency in Salesforce and advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including pivot tables, nested formulas, and data analysis workflows.
* Hands-on experience with commission management platforms such as CaptivateIQ, Xactly, Everstage, Spiff, or QuotaPath.
* Solid understanding of sales compensation structures, quota-based incentives, revenue crediting methodologies, and payout mechanics.
* Exceptional attention to detail and analytical rigor, with the ability to communicate findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong sense of ownership and excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently in fast-paced and evolving environments.

**Core Competencies**

1. **Variable Compensation Administration**
2. Solid understanding of commission calculation logic, payout cycles, and compensation plan mechanics.
3. **Data-Driven Analysis & Reporting**
4. Builds analytical models, audits payouts, and turns attainment data into actionable insights and recommendations.
5. **Process Execution & Attention to Detail**
6. Follows established processes accurately while maintaining a high level of data integrity and precision.
7. **Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Management**
8. Collaborates effectively with Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Accounting teams; manages inquiries and escalations professionally.
9. **Communication & Support**
10. Clearly explains commission calculations, compensation policies, and payout outcomes while delivering excellent internal customer support.

title: Area Manager - Techno Commercial Marketing
description:

Alcon is now exploring the Nano domain. Drawing on the state-of-the-art laboratory and research facility of the group at Goa, it is already in the process of development of various additives for slag, fly-ash and other minerals which enhance the properties and usage of such materials in the construction domain. Alcon has also developed products in “ready to use” form for mortars, castable, graded sand, special purpose premixes, which will serve the construction industry in reducing wastages, efficient time management and to produce quality work. To achieve these goals, a concerted effort is essential needing a collaborative approach from experts in various fields.  Onboard, train, and hand-hold channel partners by providing product knowledge, sales support, technical guidance, and market-development assistance to strengthen their performance and market reach.

 Monitor channel sales, partner productivity, and regional business performance, and implement initiatives to drive sales growth through the channel network.

 Provide field-level customer and channel support, track product performance, and collect customer feedback and market intelligence to support R&D improvements and new product development.

 Represent the company at industry events, trade shows, technical seminars, and customer forums to strengthen brand visibility, develop business relationships, and generate new opportunities.

Qualifications and Competencies

Education

B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering or Science graduate, with management degree is an added advantage

Experience

The candidate we are looking for is about 8-10 years’ experience in Ready mix concrete plants and/or in construction chemicals domain having thorough knowledge of concrete and concrete mix design trials , screeds, grouts and construction chemicals etc.

Technical knowledge

Strong techno-commercial acumen: Ability to explain complex product benefits in simple terms to non-technical buyers.

Skills

Proven track record in field sales, trials, and channel development in the construction sector.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills; fluent in English and Hindi (regional languages a plus).

Willingness to travel extensively across India; aged 37-35 with high energy and ambition and a drive to excel in marketing and taking products all across India.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Operations Executive
description:
**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ-EQ**
Is a global investor services group with deep expertise in private markets. We support investment managers, asset owners and global businesses with the administration, compliance, governance, data and reporting that their structures depend on.
  
  
Across 25 jurisdictions, our 6,500+ professionals combine technical strength, connected technology and human understanding – the IQ and the EQ – to free clients from operational complexity and give them the peace of mind to focus on their core business activities.
  
  
Our IQ is our technical, regulatory and operational expertise, underpinned by data, technology and coordinated global delivery. Our EQ is our human partnership: understanding the business behind the numbers, the culture behind the structures and the individuals behind the screens.
  
  
With more than US$950 billion of assets under administration, our global client base includes 13 of the world’s top 15 private equity firms\* and 19 of the top 25 private debt firms\*\*.
  
  
One relationship connects our clients to the right expertise as needs evolve, helping them move forward with clarity and confidence, wherever they operate..
  
  
To find out more about IQ-EQ visit iqeq.com
  
  
**Job Description**
Are you passionate about marketing technology, digital campaigns and creating seamless online experiences? Do you enjoy using data, marketing automation and digital platforms to help drive business growth?
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Marketing Executive, Digital Channels to join our global marketing team. In this role, you'll help manage and optimise our digital marketing ecosystem, supporting campaigns, website development, customer journeys and marketing automation initiatives that connect our services with audiences worldwide.
  
  
Working closely with colleagues across Europe, Asia and the Americas, you'll play a key role in enhancing digital performance, improving user experiences and delivering impactful global marketing campaigns.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* You'll manage and optimise digital marketing campaigns and automation programmes through HubSpot.
* You'll maintain CRM data quality, audience segmentation, lead scoring and customer journey workflows.
* You'll coordinate website updates, landing pages and digital content in partnership with internal teams and external developers.
* You'll monitor campaign, website and digital channel performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations.
* You'll support the continuous improvement of IQ-EQ's digital marketing ecosystem, user experience and marketing technology capabilities.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health & Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances & Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.

**Qualifications**
**About You**

* You're confident using HubSpot, Hootsuite or other digital marketing platforms, and have a solid understanding of website CMS platforms and web analytics.
* You bring a naturally analytical mindset and enjoy using data to drive decisions and improvements.
* Experience with tracking fundamentals and Google Tag Manager would be beneficial, but isn't essential.
* You communicate effectively in English, both written and verbal, and can build strong relationships with stakeholders.
* You're flexible in working European business hours and thrive in a collaborative, global environment.

**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
  
  
There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
  
  
Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 25 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
  
  
We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success.

Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group
  
  
**Job Title**
**Senior Manager – Digital Product & Engagement**
**Job Overview**
This is a senior leadership role at the Evernorth Hyderabad Office and sits within the Data, Digital and AI Portfolio for The Cigna Group. The role is responsible for building and scaling Digital Product and Engagement capabilities in Hyderabad while partnering closely with US-based Product, Customer Engagement, and Technology leaders to deliver high-impact digital, engagement, data, and AI-enabled products.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead teams spanning Product Management and Engagement Delivery, driving strategy, organizational effectiveness, execution, and business outcomes across platform, data, customer engagement, personalization, campaign, digital experience, and AI product portfolios.
  
  
This role combines organizational leadership with hands-on product and engagement leadership. While accountable for developing talent, scaling operating models, and driving portfolio outcomes, the leader must also be comfortable directly leading strategic initiatives, influencing executive stakeholders, shaping product direction, and stepping into complex or ambiguous business problems when needed.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strategic digital leader who can operate effectively across strategy, discovery, execution, and organizational leadership while building strong teams, strong partnerships, and measurable business outcomes
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Digital Leadership**

* Partner closely with US-based Product, Engineering, Analytics, Experience, and Digital Engagement leaders to translate enterprise priorities into product strategy, roadmaps, investment decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
* Drive implementation and adherence to product strategy across platform, data, customer engagement, personalization, digital experience, campaign, and AI-enabled product portfolios.
* Act as a strategic extension of US Product leadership, providing thought leadership on priorities, sequencing, tradeoffs, investments, and organizational capabilities.
* Directly lead select high-priority initiatives and complex cross-functional efforts that require senior product leadership and executive alignment.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on product direction, customer needs, organizational priorities, and business value realization.
* Build and maintain strong partnerships with key US-based and Hyderabad-based stakeholders, fostering trust, collaboration, alignment, and shared accountability across Product Management, Engagement Delivery, Engineering, Analytics, Experience, and Business teams.
* Develop and maintain a portfolio roadmap that provides transparency into priorities, dependencies, investment areas, risks, and expected outcomes while ensuring alignment with enterprise and DDAI strategic objectives.

**Product Management & Engagement Delivery Leadership**

* Lead and develop teams across digital (product and engagement), ensuring strong alignment between product strategy, planning, execution, and business outcomes.
* Establish clear operating models, roles, decision rights, and accountability across digital functions.
* Ensure digital teams operate as an integrated organization that enables effective planning, prioritization, execution, stakeholder management, and outcome delivery.
* Build leadership depth across both disciplines through coaching, succession planning, organizational development, and talent management.
* Create a high-performing culture focused on customer value, ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration.

**Organizational Leadership**

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers and Engagement Delivery experts while establishing scalable operating models, standards, and career paths aligned with global digital practices.
* Mentor digital leaders and individual contributors, strengthening capabilities in strategy, discovery, roadmap planning, stakeholder management, and execution.
* Position Hyderabad as a trusted strategic product and engagement partner that contributes to enterprise direction and outcomes, not simply execution.
* Foster a culture of innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Accelerate organizational knowledge and business acumen across the Hyderabad team by enabling deep understanding of The Cigna Group's business model, lines of business, strategic priorities, organizational structure, Digital strategy, and Data, Digital & AI (DDAI) objectives.
* Establish a culture of continuous learning and capability development by identifying skill gaps, promoting upskilling opportunities, enabling access to required tools and resources, and ensuring team members are equipped to meet current and future business needs.

**Operating Model & Delivery Excellence**

* Partner closely with Business, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, Customer Experience, and Engagement Delivery teams to align product strategy with delivery and business objectives.
* Act as a coordination and escalation point for major cross-functional dependencies, risks, and delivery challenges. Identify and remove critical blockers for the digital team.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery effectiveness, stakeholder satisfaction, planning accuracy, and execution quality.
* Balance innovation with execution discipline to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, reliable, and adoption-ready.

**Customer & Business Outcomes**

* Ensure product investments are grounded in customer needs, business priorities, and data-driven insights.
* Serve as the primary storyteller and advocate for Hyderabad digital capabilities, clearly articulating the "What, So What, and Now What" of team accomplishments, strategic initiatives, business outcomes, and future opportunities across leadership, governance, and operational forums.
* Establish mechanisms to track, measure, and communicate business value delivered, including customer impact, operational efficiencies, adoption, engagement outcomes, financial benefits, and strategic contributions, creating visibility for leadership and supporting investment decisions.
* Use customer insights, behavioral data, journey analytics, and product performance to inform strategic decisions and prioritization.
* Hold teams accountable for measurable business and customer outcomes across discovery, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

**Education**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field from a top‑tier institution.
  
  
**Experience**
14+ years of experience in product management, digital product development, customer engagement, campaign products, or platform product roles, with meaningful leadership responsibility.
  
  

* Proven experience building and scaling product management teams, including hiring, mentoring, and developing product leaders.
* Strong track record owning end-to-end product lifecycles, from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous optimization.
* Experience delivering data-driven, digital engagement, campaign, and AI-enabled products in close partnership with engineering, analytics, design, marketing, and AI teams.
* Hands-on experience with customer/member engagement products, campaign management platforms, digital communication journeys, segmentation, personalization, and experimentation.
* Ability to use customer insights, behavioral data, campaign performance, and journey analytics to shape product priorities and improve engagement outcomes.
* Demonstrated success partnering closely with US‑based Product leaders and senior stakeholders in a global, matrixed environment.
* Experience operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology, analytics, customer experience, and customer/member engagement.

**Skills**
Strong grounding in product strategy and discovery, including problem framing, customer research, engagement journey mapping, and outcome-driven roadmaps.
  
  
Solid understanding of modern digital and platform architectures, APIs, and data‑driven systems.
  
  
Experience working with AI‑enabled products and AI Product Managers, without requiring deep model‑level ownership.
  
  
Strong understanding of engagement product capabilities such as campaign orchestration, lifecycle journeys, personalization, digital communications, CRM/marketing technology, and experimentation.
  
  
Ability to connect engagement strategy with product execution, ensuring campaigns and digital experiences are measurable, scalable, compliant, and adoption focused.
  
  
Ability to partner effectively with US Product leaders, engineering, data, design, marketing, experience, and AI delivery teams.
  
  
Strong analytical mindset to define success metrics, track engagement outcomes, interpret customer behavior, and drive prioritization decisions.
  
  
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at executive levels.
  
  
Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving clarity across complex, global problem spaces
  
  
**Work Hours**

* 2:30 PM IST to 11.30PM IST

Evernorth Health Services, a division of The Cigna Group, creates pharmacy, care and benefit solutions to improve health and increase vitality. We relentlessly innovate to make the prediction, prevention and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.
