- The ability to work in a fast-paced and future-oriented environment.
  
- Digital proficiency and adaptability to work in an integrated online and offline sales environment.
  
  
**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**
  
- Engage with customers, making them feel expected and welcome while understanding their needs.
  
- Demonstrate expertise in IKEA products, actively sharing knowledge of their features and benefits.

- Conduct 1:1 planning appointments, communicate the benefits of solutions, and convert planning offers into orders.
  
- Offer relevant services, finalize purchases, and provide excellent after-sales support.
  
- Ensure efficient returns processing and coordinate with matrix stores when necessary.
  
- Maximize sales while maintaining profitability by promoting top-selling and priority products.
  
- Maintain product presentation, merchandising, and digital tools for an enhanced shopping experience.
  
- Uphold IKEA’s values and sustainability commitments, differentiating IKEA from other retailers.
  
- Collaborate with the team to continuously improve customer service and the overall shopping experience.
  
  
**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**
  
We are the ones meeting our customers – in our stores, online, in our catalogue and beyond. We have knowledge of the IKEA product range, local markets and customer needs and we constantly find new ways of making real connections with our customers to maximize sales and profitability. Together with thousands of colleagues around the world we’re a diverse team working for the continued global success of the IKEA Concept – a concept that helps millions of customers create a better everyday life!
  
  
Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% "qualified". If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. We look forward to receiving your application.
  
From: "Why Women Don't Apply for Jobs Unless They're 100% Qualified" by Tara Sophia Mohr, August 2014"

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Business Development Manager – Enterprise**

Experience: 8–10 Years

Location: Pune/Remote

Function: Sales & Business Development

**About Enreap**

Enreap is a technology consulting and services organization helping enterprises accelerate digital transformation through solutions across Atlassian, AWS, DevOps, Cloud, monday.com and Project Portfolio Management (PPM). We partner with organizations to streamline operations, modernize technology environments and drive business outcomes through technology-led transformation.

**The Opportunity**

We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Manager – Enterprise with strong experience in B2B technology sales and enterprise business development. The role will focus on acquiring new enterprise customers, driving strategic account growth and building a robust sales pipeline for DevOps and Cloud Transformation implementation services, Managed Teams (MT) and Managed Services (MS) across Enreap's target markets.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong hunting mindset, consultative selling capabilities and the ability to engage senior stakeholders, develop strategic accounts and drive complex enterprise sales cycles from opportunity identification to closure.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Enterprise Business Development: Build, develop and own a qualified sales pipeline for large enterprise opportunities across implementation services, Managed Teams and Managed Services.
2. End-to-End Sales Ownership: Drive the complete sales lifecycle, including prospecting, lead generation, discovery, solution positioning, proposal development, commercial negotiations and deal closure.
3. New Logo Acquisition: Identify and acquire new enterprise customers by leveraging industry networks, strategic prospecting, referrals and partner ecosystems.
4. Account Expansion: Develop existing licence customers into services engagements, implementation projects and multi-year Managed Services contracts.
5. Strategic Alliances & Partnerships: Collaborate with Atlassian enterprise account teams and ecosystem partners to identify, develop and close partner-led business opportunities.
6. Strategic Account Management: Create and execute account plans for identified enterprise accounts, map key decision-makers and build relationships with CXOs, business leaders and technology stakeholders.
7. Consultative Solution Selling: Work closely with pre-sales and delivery teams to understand customer requirements, shape solutions and position Enreap's services in line with business objectives.
8. RFP & Proposal Management: Lead responses to RFPs and tenders in collaboration with pre-sales teams, including solution scoping, effort estimation, commercial pricing and Statement of Work (SOW) inputs.
9. Sales Forecasting & Reporting: Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline visibility and CRM hygiene, with regular reporting on business development activities, revenue targets and deal progress.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 8–10 years of experience in B2B enterprise sales, business development or strategic sales within the IT services or technology consulting industry.
* Strong track record of acquiring new enterprise customers and independently closing high-value services deals.
* Experience selling DevOps, Cloud Transformation, IT Consulting, Implementation Services, Managed Teams or Managed Services.
* Understanding of enterprise technology solutions and the ability to drive consultative, value-based selling.
* Proven experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and senior decision-makers.
* Exposure to the Atlassian ecosystem and experience working with technology OEMs or channel partners will be an added advantage.
* Strong capabilities in prospecting, account planning, negotiation, commercial structuring and deal closure.
* Experience working with CRM platforms and maintaining sales pipeline and forecasting discipline.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Self-driven, target-oriented professional with a strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate in a growth-focused environment.

**Why Join Enreap?**

* Opportunity to drive enterprise business growth across a diverse technology services portfolio.
* Work closely with leading technology ecosystems and enterprise customers.
* Ownership of strategic accounts, new business acquisition and revenue growth.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to Enreap's expansion across markets.

title: Cafe Partnerships Associate, Food and Beverage
description:
I am looking for a serial cafe hopper in Pune.

I run Blendonomics. We supply coffee beans, hot chocolate and beverage products to cafes across India. Pune is already one of our important markets, and I am spending time here to grow it: more cafes on board, and a strong distributor network across the city.

I need one person on the ground who loves cafes as much as I do.

This is not a target-pushing sales job. You will be the person Pune cafes know from Blendonomics. You visit cafes, run tastings, listen to owners and baristas, and help them decide if our products fit their menu. What you hear in the field comes straight to me and our head office team, and it shapes what we do next.

What you will do

• Visit cafes across Pune that have asked to try our products, and find new ones on your own beat.

• Run tastings and explain the product in clear, honest terms.

• Find out what works on a cafe's menu, what worries the owner, and what they need.

• Log every visit the same day and send a short field report every week.

• Follow up with cafes so they keep ordering because the product works for them.

• Work with me, our head office team and our distribution partners in Pune.

You must have

• Some experience in or with cafes, restaurants, hotels, catering, food delivery or food brands. Any role counts: barista, floor staff, kitchen, outlet operations, restaurant onboarding, food sales, food content, internships or part-time work.

• Good spoken and written English. Marathi and Hindi too.

• A two-wheeler and a valid licence, and you are happy to be on the road most days.

• You live in Pune.

• You are available full-time. This role does not suit students in regular day college.

What you get

• A core-team role. You work directly with me.

• Fixed pay based on your experience, fuel support, and earnings on every order from cafes you bring in.

• A trial period to start. If it works, a full-time role with a clear path to lead the Pune market.

• Hands-on training in the cafe business, our products and B2B sales.

How to apply

Apply on LinkedIn with your resume and answer the screening questions. My team calls shortlisted candidates first, then we meet for an interview.

title: Manager-Admissions and Outreach
description:
**Job Opening: Manager – Admissions and Outreach**

**Reports to:**
Head – Marketing and Admissions

**Location:**
Nayanta University Campus, Bavdhan, Pune, Maharashtra 411021

**Nature and Days of Work:**
Full-time, On-site (Monday to Friday; flexibility required for events and travel)

**About Nayanta University**

Nayanta University is a multidisciplinary higher education initiative of the Nayanta Education Foundation, built in partnership with the Confederation of Indian Industry (CII) to bring together academia and industry. It is founded by a group of distinguished industry and academic leaders — including Kris Gopalakrishnan, Dr Naushad Forbes (Chancellor), Banmali Agrawala, Bharat Puri, Dr Farhad Forbes, Meher Pudumjee, Dr Ashok Misra, Dr Pankaj Chandra, Nadir Godrej, Ramesh Mangaleswaran, and Dr Satish Reddy — with Dr Ranjan Banerjee as Vice-Chancellor. Nayanta's purpose is to develop curious, ethical, and responsible leaders who can contribute to a fairer and more sustainable world.

The University blends arts, sciences, and technology with real-world problem-solving, offering undergraduate programmes and lifelong learning options built around four pillars: Care (mentorship and personalised development), Curiosity (a culture of inquiry and original thinking), Confidence (immersive, project-based learning that builds leadership and communication skills), and Careers (three one-month sector immersions — corporate, social, and government — followed by a five-month internship). Nayanta is committed to recruiting capable students from every socio-economic background and to building an open, collaborative academic community.

**Why Join Us?**

* Student-Centred Impact: Shape how prospective students and families experience Nayanta, from first contact through to enrolment and the first day on campus.
* Ownership from the Ground Up: Build and run the student admissions and retention engine for a growing university, with the autonomy to design strategy as well as execute it.
* Collaborative Culture: Work closely with academic, marketing, operations, and admissions teams in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment.
* Professional Growth: Gain depth in admissions strategy, student and parent engagement, retention, events, and student recruitment within a fast-growing institution.

**Role Overview**

The Manager – Admissions and Outreach will own the end-to-end student admissions process and the retention of admitted students for Nayanta University. The role combines disciplined, applicant-facing admissions management and sustained engagement with admitted students and their families through to enrolment, with planning and communications for outreach events — leading the admissions counselling and outreach team to bring in, and retain, a strong, diverse cohort of students each year.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Outreach Events and Communications**

* Support the outreach strategy in line with Nayanta's enrolment goals, with a focus on planning and executing outreach events — webinars, campus tours, school visits, and education fairs.
* Own communications for outreach events — invitations, reminders, and follow-ups across email and WhatsApp — and maintain a communication tracker to ensure timely, consistent messaging to students, parents, schools, and counsellors.
* Maintain school and counsellor databases built from past applications and enrolments, and use them for targeted event communications.
* Represent Nayanta University professionally at external events, fairs, and school engagements.

**2. Admissions Process Management**

* Own the execution and continuous improvement of the end-to-end admissions process, from application review and shortlisting through entrance tests, interviews and the release of offers.
* Manage the external interface with applicants and parents, and the internal approval workflow, ensuring a smooth, transparent, and timely process.
* Liaise with internal teams (academics, operations, finance) and external partners to resolve issues in real time through the admissions cycle.
* Oversee invoicing and the fee payment process for admitted students.

**3. Applicant and Family Engagement and Retention**

* Ensure prospective students and parents receive timely, accurate guidance through every stage of the admissions journey — inquiry, application, interview, and offer.
* Design and oversee engagement touchpoints — counselling sessions, parent interactions, webinars, welcome meets, and campus tours — to support conversion from inquiry to enrolment.
* Track applicant engagement using CRM tools, ensuring timely follow-up and a well-documented, data-driven funnel.
* Own the retention of admitted students from offer to enrolment — addressing student and parent queries and concerns, including on fees, deferments, and withdrawals, in a timely and empathetic manner.
* Design and oversee pre-joining engagement touchpoints for admitted students and families, and track drop-offs to minimise attrition before the start of the academic year.

**4. Team and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Coordinate closely with Marketing, Academics, and University leadership to align event messaging, admissions criteria, enrolment targets, and retention goals.
* Report regularly on event participation, funnel conversion, retention, and admissions progress to University leadership.

**5. Insights and Continuous Improvement**

* Collect and analyse feedback on messaging, events, the applicant experience, and reasons for drop-offs, and recommend changes to improve conversion and retention for subsequent admission cycles.
* Stay current on competitor positioning and trends in student recruitment and retention.

The stated responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of duties.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree required (Education, Psychology, Communications, or Management preferred); a Master's degree is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience in student admissions, outreach, counselling, or recruitment within higher education, schools, or ed-tech organisations, including experience managing a process or team end to end.
* Demonstrated experience addressing student and parent queries and supporting the retention of admitted students through to enrolment.
* Prior exposure to CRM-driven admissions funnels, event coordination and communications, and conversion tracking from inquiry to enrolment.

**Technical & Functional Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High organisational capability with close attention to detail.
* Working knowledge of CRM tools and strong Excel proficiency; comfort with data-driven funnel management.
* Ability to manage multiple events, communications, timelines, and stakeholder relationships simultaneously.
* Familiarity with school networks and education-sector trends.

**Leadership & Personal Attributes**

* Warm, engaging, and student-focused communication style, with the gravitas to also lead a team.
* Strategic and highly organised, with the ability to manage complex, multi-stage processes end to end.
* Empathy, patience, and confidence in addressing student and parent concerns.
* A genuine belief that access to the right education, at the right moment, can change what someone is capable of.
* Professional presence, with strong relationship-building and people-leadership skills.

**Remuneration**

Compensation will be competitive and benchmarked to industry and sector norms, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

**Application Process**

Interested candidates may email their CV in PDF format to careers@nayanta.edu.in with the subject line: Application for Manager – Admissions and Outreach.

title: Tech S and T- Tech Strategy - Senior consultant-GDSF04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Strategy Consultant**
**THE OPPORTUNITY:**
EY's Technology Strategy & Transformation (TST) team is at the forefront of delivering cutting-edge consulting and advisory services to some of the largest enterprises across the globe. Our technology practice is recognized by industry analysts as a leader in leveraging business and technology to drive strategic business-led, tech-enabled e2e transformation. We serve clients across all major industries and work with organizations of different sizes, helping guide them to achieve business success while delivering strategic IT value.
  
  
**Scope of engagements**
We are currently seeking experienced, seasoned IT Strategy practitioners who can be positioned at the crucial intersection of business, technology and customer to devise creative new strategies based on trends, insights and data. We are looking for folks who have experience in advising clients to …
  
  

* reset, reimagine and re-think their business and operating models with tech-enabled, cutting-edge solutions that re-energize performance across the enterprise
* set and drive enterprise tech vision and strategy in alignment with corporate / business unit strategy, customer focus and solution teams
* drive increased value from technology spend with focus on optimizing cost, agility, productivity and performance

We work with clients to address issues of importance to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in creating value and delivering world-class IT capabilities to support futuristic business needs. Working closely with our industry groups and leveraging the Ernst & Young brand as independent, trusted advisors, we provide our high-profile clients with range of services including:
  
  

* Tech Strategy & Vision
* IT Operating Model optimization
* 3/5-year Transformation strategy, roadmaps & blueprints
* Office of CIO functions (IT Finance, Sourcing, Project Portfolio Mgt. etc)
* Product strategy & management
* M&A due-diligence, planning and post integration/separation
* Enterprise Architecture Services

**Key responsibilities of candidate include:**

* Understanding the business strategy & vision and translating them into enterprise-wide technology vision & strategy in alignment with strategic priorities for growth, customer experience, efficiency etc.
* Analyze value chain and business capabilities to develop clear understanding of strategic objectives, KPI’s, processes and underlying systems that deliver the business outcomes
* Assess the impact of the business strategy on business capability model and business processes to identify optimization opportunities (through tech-enabled solutions) across organization, systems, data, infrastructure and applications
* Have strong experience in analysing business models, business model innovation/ incubation, and experience in one or more of the following areas preferred: Market Strategy, Pricing/ Monetization, Finance, Ecosystem Management, and/ or Product Management
* Ability to analyse client’s (IT) Operating Model including the organization structure, processes and governance while developing recommendations and/or creating actionable roadmaps
* Significant experience in: 1) developing business capability model for the enterprise; 2) analysing enterprise-wide portfolio of systems / platforms and 3) function as guardian of the transformation strategy and business architecture to make sure that new initiatives comply with strategic priorities
* Solid experience in guiding our clients through large, enterprise-wide transformation to implement their strategies and business architecture. Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the IT strategic and improvement agenda
* Be a trusted advisor on 'innovation' with ability to frame key business and technology trends within the context of the client's objectives. Ability to identify the potential implications and impacts of the associated trends.
* Leverage EY’s global network, and leverage the cross-functional expertise to develop relevant architecture insights

**Within the team, your role will include the following additional responsibilities:**

* Ability to lead conversations with the client stakeholders. Strong communication skills as the profile requires interactions with CIO, CEO, CFO and other senior leadership
* Build and develop trusted relationships as a strategic technology advisor with clients and work internally across EY advisory teams to bring our clients the most comprehensive, end-to-end services and effectively address their business challenges.
* Building and growing TST Strategy practice, developing and maintaining client relationships, and selling and delivering work as an engagement leader or Subject Matter Specialist.
* Develop thought leadership and define approaches to provide structured solutions to complex technology strategy problems of clients, by recombining existing methodologies and teams
* Managing engagement teams and providing leadership in the assessment, design, and management of successful Business - IT transformation engagements in collaboration with our clients. They should provide high quality client services by directing daily progress of engagement work, informing EY leadership of engagement status, and managing staff performance
* Help recruit, develop and retain strategy professionals, coach and mentor team members, deliver architecture-related training and take on other practice management tasks as needed (e.g., development of practice offerings)
* Should be very good at using various tools (Such as Word, Excel, Powerpoint, visualization tools, MS-Project, etc.)
* Would support in developing new solution offerings, tools and knowledge repositories
* People skill has worked independently on projects or as part of small consulting teams
* Should be self-driven and organized person with ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high pressure environment
* Should have experience in pursuit teams including conceptualizing propositions and presenting solutions to client
* Create expert content for point-of-view and use advanced presentation, public speaking, content creation and communication skills for C-Level discussions.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of a specific industry, client or technology and function as an expert to advise senior leadership.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong academic background with BE/B.tech and MBA from top Tier-1 B-schools
* A background in Strategy Consulting (in top tier consulting firms), with 5+ years of relevant experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformations
* Min. of 5+ years of specific industry / sector experience through completed client engagements related to business transformation. Should have experience in any one or two industry sectors such as Financial services, Retail, Healthcare/Pharma, Telecom, e-commerce, etc.
* Demonstrated experience of driving business workshops as well as conducting deep-dive technology workshops to collaboratively develop transformation vision, strategy, roadmaps and blueprints
* Experience with assessing maturity of IT operating models & organizations structure to determine optimization opportunities. Should understand IT - business alignment, IT strategy and planning, development of current and future state IT architecture, roadmaps, IT/Digital maturity assessment, etc.
* Experience with large transformation related to customer experience, process re-engineering, digital, cloud, automation, AI/ML/advanced analytics, next-gen / emerging tech (IoT, blockchain, virtual twins etc).
* Conducting research and analyses of operational effectiveness, processes, stakeholders, etc., creating end-to-end visibility into how the organization executes their operations today and identifying systemic issues impacting business performance
* Should have experience in designing and managing an effective IT governance framework across the spectrum of IT service delivery
* Should be able to analyze data and translate findings into meaningful insights, integrating relevant business knowledge
* Should have knowledge about or exposure to areas such as IT Service Management and Governance, Agile methodologies, Data visualization, Cloud technologies, emerging technologies

**The following are preferred, but not required:**

* Advanced business and/or technology degrees from tier-1 schools (MBA, Masters)
* Experience in presenting directly to the C-Suite and explain complex concepts to anyone from an intern to a CFO, CHRO or CMO
* Experience working with IT leadership (e.g., CIO, IT Director) and business leadership (e.g., CFO, COO, BU leader, etc.) to help shape and guide the strategic and improvement agenda.
* Speaking at industry conferences, round tables, and other public forums
* Authoring articles and white papers
* Business / technology innovation experience with emerging tech solutions leveraging power of combinatorial technologies AI/ML, Data Automation, Blockchain, IoT, etc
* Exposure across key technology domains is preferred (application, data, DevOps, infrastructure, cloud, network. security etc)
* Demonstrated capability to drive sales and bring a network of client relationships to the firm
* Relevant industry certification (e.g., TOGAF Biz Architect, Business Process Framework (eTOM Practitioner of TMForum), AWS Cloud Certified etc.).

**Overall Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of the current IT environment and industry IT trends to identify the engagement and client service issues.
* Ability to act as day-to-day client contact on the project engagement; run client status and other client meetings and deliver executive-level presentations that drive actions and decisions.
* Proven delivery skills including the ability to scope/size a project; staff a team with the appropriate skill set; provide subject matter direction and guidance to a team; and manage the delivery of an engagement.
* Ability to identify opportunities and help generate sell-on work during client engagements by understanding a range services and offerings and coordinating with personnel in other service lines to help sell integrated solutions that meet client needs.
* Experience in creating points of view on relevant industry trends, solutions, methodologies, and analytical frameworks and tools to bring strategic perspectives to existing solutions.
* Experience in managing a portfolio of executive level clients and developing long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Experience in building strong teams with a solid understanding of project management, industry content knowledge, and effective client communications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Title: Accounts Reconciliation Executive

**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Industry:** Hospitality  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Okhla, Delhi

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Reconciliation Executive to manage daily sales reconciliation, customer account reconciliation, payment tracking and property-wise revenue reporting.

The candidate will be responsible for verifying sales transactions across online travel agency (OTA) platforms and the Ezee Property Management System (PMS), identifying discrepancies, maintaining accurate financial records and supporting daily settlement and night audit activities.

Key Responsibilities

* **Sales Reconciliation:** Perform daily reconciliation of sales recorded on OTA platforms against Ezee PMS records and identify discrepancies.
* **Customer & Commission Reconciliation:** Reconcile customer accounts, OTA commissions and related financial transactions to ensure accuracy.
* **Accounts Receivable Management:** Track outstanding payments and regularly adjust customer accounts against received payments and pending invoices.
* **Sales Reporting:** Prepare and maintain daily sales performance reports, including revenue, booking and payment details.
* **Property-Wise Reporting:** Prepare individual and consolidated property-wise revenue reports to monitor sales performance.
* **CP Plan Settlement:** Maintain reconciliation records and support the settlement of Continental Plan (CP) bookings.
* **Night Audit Support:** Coordinate with property teams to verify daily sales, bookings and financial transactions and support night audit activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Basic knowledge of accounting principles and accounts receivable.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Understanding of sales reconciliation and customer account management.
* Ability to track payments, outstanding balances and financial transactions.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to identify discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records.
* Knowledge of OTA platforms such as MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, Agoda, etc. will be an advantage.
* Experience with Ezee PMS or other hotel management software will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with experience in hotel, hospitality or travel industry accounting will be preferred.
* Experience in OTA reconciliation, hotel billing or revenue reconciliation will be an added advantage.
* Candidates should be comfortable coordinating with property teams and handling daily reconciliation activities.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have Experience in Hospitality Industry ?
* Do you have Knowledge of OTA platforms and Ezee PMS ?

title: Sales & Operations Manager
description:
**About Us**
------------

Reflaunt is a leading circular fashion technology platform enabling brands and retailers to launch and scale branded resale programs. By powering end-to-end resale ecosystems, Reflaunt helps partners unlock new revenue streams while driving sustainability

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking a detail-oriented and commercially driven Senior Executive – Sales & E-commerce Operations to manage and optimise the day-to-day performance of Reflaunt-powered resale platforms.

This is a cross-functional role at the intersection of digital merchandising, partner management, operational execution, and AI-enabled workflows. You will play a key role in leveraging data and emerging technologies to drive efficiency, improve catalogue quality, and unlock growth opportunities.

The ideal candidate is analytical, tech-savvy, and solution-oriented, with the ability to work across stakeholders while continuously identifying smarter, more scalable ways of working.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **E-commerce Merchandising**

* Own and optimise online merchandising across categories, brands, and resale programs
* Manage product onboarding, categorisation, tagging, and content accuracy
* Ensure accurate product lifecycle status (active, hotlist, markdown, rejected, etc.)
* Monitor stock availability, pricing, and sell-through performance
* Drive seasonal drops, launches, and trading initiatives
* Identify gaps, risks, and opportunities impacting sales and customer experience
* Leverage AI-enabled tools to enhance catalogue quality, content enrichment, and merchandising efficiency

### **Sales & Partner Operations**

* Manage day-to-day coordination with assigned brand partners
* Drive partner onboarding and ensure ongoing operational alignment
* Track and resolve issues related to cancellations, returns, stock sync, and catalogue errors
* Share regular performance insights and actionable recommendations with partners
* Ensure adherence to Reflaunt processes and SLAs
* Use data and AI-driven insights to proactively identify partner growth opportunities

### **Operations & Fulfilment**

* Oversee order flow and ensure smooth execution from listing to delivery
* Coordinate with operations, logistics, and warehouse teams
* Monitor inventory health and proactively flag discrepancies
* Drive resolution of fulfilment-related issues impacting customer experience
* Identify and implement process improvements, including automation and AI-led efficiencies

### **Performance & Reporting**

* Own tracking of key KPIs: sales, conversion, sell-through, cancellations, and availability
* Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights
* Conduct ad-hoc analysis across categories, partners, and campaigns
* Maintain dashboards and ensure data accuracy
* Leverage AI tools and data models to identify trends, forecast performance, and recommend actions

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Operations, Tech, Commercial, and Marketing teams
* Act as a key link between merchandising, partner needs, and operational execution
* Support resolution of catalogue, pricing, and fulfilment issues
* Contribute to building scalable, tech-enabled processes as Reflaunt grows

**Required Skills & Experience**
--------------------------------

### **Experience**

* 5-7 years of experience in e-commerce, sales operations, merchandising, or similar roles
* Experience with marketplaces or resale models is a plus
* Exposure to fashion, luxury, or sustainability-driven businesses preferred

### **Skills**

* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
* Commercial mindset with understanding of e-commerce performance metrics
* Proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets (pivots, basic formulas)
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Comfortable working with AI tools and digital platforms to improve workflows and efficiency
* Curiosity and adaptability towards emerging technologies and automation
* Proactive, ownership-driven, and solution-oriented

title: Head of Finance Indian Subcontinent
description:
### **Job Title**

Head of Finance Indian Subcontinent

### **Job Description**

**Job title:** **Head of Finance Indian Subcontinent**

**Location** : Gurgaon, Bharti Worldmark

**Your role:**

The Head of Finance Indian Subcontinent is a critical role as India is a key growth market that requires strong finance leadership from both a finance business partner perspective, as well as a license to operate / compliance perspective.

The main remit of the role is to drive sustainable business value and robust financial governance across the zone. The job incumbent will act as a strategic Finance Business Partner to the Zone Leader and Leadership team, translating business, market regulatory, and operational developments into clear financial insights, disciplined decision-making, and executable performance actions.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Leads the strategic financial direction of the zone, ensuring that financial strategies are aligned with the overall corporate vision and driving the long-term growth and profitability of the organization.
* Serves as a key member of the zone leadership team, providing expert financial guidance and strategic insights to influence critical business decisions, shape corporate strategy, and achieve financial objectives.
* Drives the strategic and operational financial planning process for the zone, including AOP support to the business, rolling forecasts, scenario planning, and performance / business reviews.
* Drives revenue growth, margin expansion, cost productivity and profitable market share development across businesses, customer segments, and sales channels.
* Supports key commercial decisions on pricing, tender strategy, sales channels, customer lifetime value, strategic deals, partnerships, financing solutions, and investment allocation.
* Ensures a strong and efficient internal control environment and high quality of financial statements across the zone.
* Drives month-end close discipline, reporting quality, standardization, automation and simplification across finance processes.
* Drives working capital discipline across receivables, inventory, order book quality, revenue recognition, and cash acceleration initiatives.
* Leads cross-functional teams in the development of financial models and business cases for high-impact projects, ensuring that all assumptions are rigorously tested and that recommendations are aligned with the company’s long-term strategic priorities.
* Ensures the organization’s financial practices adhere to the highest standards of integrity, compliance, and corporate governance, working closely with audit, compliance, and legal teams to manage financial risks and address regulatory requirements.
* Leads finance transformation and organizational improvements, including digital finance, analytics and process simplification.
* Builds and maintains strong relationships with key stakeholders, including senior executives, board members, and external partners, ensuring that financial perspectives are integrated into all major business decisions and that the finance function is viewed as a strategic partner.
* Develops a high-performing zone finance organization, with clear accountabilities, succession planning and capability building.
* Mentors and develops finance managers and specialists within the organization, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous learning, and ensuring that the finance team is equipped to support the company’s growth and innovation objectives at the highest levels.

**You're the right fit if:**

* Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting or a related discipline. A professional finance qualification would be a plus.
* Deep understanding of medtech / health systems / health technology.
* 8+ years of broad-based finance leadership experience, including operational, commercial, and strategic finance roles in a complex matrix organization.
* Strong experience across FP&A, business partnering, accounting, internal control, statutory reporting, tax, treasury, audit, and commercial finance domains.
* Experience in regional, zonal or global business partnering roles.
* Experience having built engaged teams, and developed talents and succession plans.
* Demonstrated growth and transformation mindset.
* Able to influence across a complex matrix.

**About Philips**

We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.

* Learn more about our business .
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.
* Learn more about our culture.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here .

Rio Tinto is a leading global mining and materials company. We operate in 35 countries where we produce iron ore, copper, aluminium, critical minerals, and other materials needed for the global energy transition and for people, communities, and nations to thrive.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Established in 2004, **OLIVER** is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of **The Brandtech Group**, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our **AI solutions** enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

**Role:** Social Media Manager

**Location:** Gurgaon, India

  

**About the role:**

We're looking for a Social Marketing Manager to shape the voice of one of the world's most culturally significant brands. You aren't just managing social media; you're driving high-impact, strategic opportunities in the Indian market, specifically focusing on YouTube Shopping. You are deeply invested in understanding what drives our audience, and equally passionate about how our products can empower creators to build sustainable, meaningful careers through YouTube Shopping in India. You will use social platforms to deepen our connection with communities, relying on data to uncover insights that drive real-world business results. You will also be the frontline defender of our brand, using your analytical expertise to set up processes that escalate potential risks and respond thoughtfully to what matters most to our users.

The role is highly cross-functional and international. You will collaborate daily with local, regional (APAC), and global YouTube product marketing managers, alongside cross-functional teams in partnerships, legal, communications, and policy

  

**What you will be doing:**

* **Always-On Shopping Strategy:** Lead the strategy and operations for creator-facing social channels, driving the adoption of YouTube Shopping features. Elevate content that moves creators from awareness to consistent tagging habits.
* **Creator-to-Creator (C2C) Excellence:** Shift the Shopping showcase strategy toward a centralized, high-volume C2C content engine. You will champion utility-driven content—like step-by-step How-Tos and creator collaborations—that clearly explains the value of Shopping and drives action.
* **Campaigns & Initiatives:** Partner with marketing peers locally and across regions to develop and execute campaigns that deliver on business goals.
* **Fuel the Creative:** Engage and lead our social media, influencer, and content agencies. You will guide them to build effective, best in class, innovative campaigns & content targeted at casual and intentful creators.
* **Data-Driven Optimization:** Track the real business impact of our social efforts. You will use performance indicators to measure how Shopping content drives views and engagements, identifying what resonates best with creators (e.g., direct value vs. promotional content).
* **Run the Engine:** Support full-time employees (FTE) in ensuring compliance with Statements of Work (SOWs), Purchase Orders (POs), and invoicing for all external agency partners.

  

**What you need to be great in this role:**

* **The Foundation:** A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent work experience) and 5 to 7 years of experience planning, executing, and optimizing impactful social media and influencer campaigns.
* **The YouTube DNA:** A deep understanding of YouTube's ecosystem (users, creators, advertisers) and our multi-format products (long-form, short-form, streaming). A strong grasp of the e-commerce landscape and how it intersects with content creation is essential.
* **Agency Expertise:** Proven experience leading and collaborating with social media, influencer, and content production agency partners.
* **Cultural Fluency:** A comprehensive understanding of the Indian influencer ecosystem, local social media best practices, and the top agencies operating in the market.
* **Analytical Rigor:** A strong track record of creativity paired with data-driven optimization. You should be well-versed in social analytics and listening tools (experience with Sprinklr or BrandWatch is a plus).
* **Communication & Hustle:** Outstanding written and oral communication skills in English. Fluency in Hindi (and knowledge of other regional Indian languages) is an added advantage. You must be a scrappy, proactive problem-solver with a strong bias for action and a track record of making things happen in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* **AI Native:** You possess a strong willingness and capability to integrate AI solutions into daily operations, continuously seeking ways to improve efficiency and work quality.

title: Area Sales manager-Hospital
description:
**We Are The People Who Give Possibilities Purpose**
BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary\*\*
  
  
Responsible for achieving sales targets and market share growth for CareFusion 303, Inc. products within an assigned territory, focusing on the hospital market segment. This role involves developing and executing strategic sales plans, building strong customer relationships, and managing a sales team to drive revenue and ensure customer satisfaction.
  
  
Job Responsibilities\*\*
  
  

* Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to penetrate new accounts and expand existing business within the hospital sector.
* Achieve and exceed assigned sales quotas and market share objectives.
* Manage and mentor a team of sales representatives, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback.
* Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, including hospital administrators, purchasing managers, physicians, and other healthcare professionals.
* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, and in-service training to educate customers on the features, benefits, and clinical value of CareFusion products.
* Analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to identify new business opportunities and adjust sales strategies accordingly.
* Negotiate contracts and pricing agreements with hospital systems and group purchasing organizations (GPOs).
* Collaborate with marketing, clinical, and customer service teams to ensure seamless product delivery, support, and customer satisfaction.
* Prepare and submit regular sales forecasts, activity reports, and other administrative documents as required.
* Attend industry conferences, trade shows, and sales meetings to represent CareFusion and stay abreast of market developments.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies, procedures, and ethical standards.

Job Qualifications\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 5-7 years of progressive sales experience in the medical device or pharmaceutical industry, with at least 3 years in a sales management or leadership role.
* Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and driving market share growth within the hospital environment.
* Strong understanding of hospital operations, purchasing processes, and healthcare economics.
* Demonstrated ability to build, lead, and motivate high-performing sales teams.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to travel extensively within the assigned territory, including overnight stays, as required.
* Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce.com) and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Valid driver's license and a clean driving record.

Why Join Us?
  
  
To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.
  
  
We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

title: Area Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Shriram Life Insurance focuses on delivering affordable, high-quality insurance solutions designed for everyday individuals across India. The organization combines a strong customer-centric approach with technology-led innovation, offering digital platforms such as ShriMithra, Astra, ShriA, and Smart Suraksha Card for seamless service. A significant portion of its business comes from rural areas, reflecting a commitment to serving both rural and urban communities and expanding financial security nationwide. With decades of trust and operational excellence, Shriram Life Insurance is guided by core values of integrity, efficiency, and long-term customer relationships.

**Role Description**
The Area Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The Area Manager will oversee sales and distribution activities within the assigned region, including managing branch operations, guiding field teams, and ensuring achievement of business targets. Daily responsibilities include monitoring performance metrics, driving customer acquisition and retention, and implementing company strategies and processes in line with regulatory and internal guidelines. * Strong skills in customer relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and conflict resolution.
* Proficiency in data analysis, performance tracking, and using digital tools or CRM systems to manage operations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with diverse teams.
* Proven capability in planning, organizing, and executing market initiatives in both urban and rural segments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field; an MBA or equivalent professional qualification is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area, with flexibility to travel within the region as required.

title: Sales Associate
description:
**Company Description**
Various Retail Stores in Kolkata offer a range of consumer products and services, providing customers with convenient access to everyday essentials and lifestyle items. These stores focus on delivering reliable service, maintaining well-organized retail environments, and ensuring a positive shopping experience. Team members are encouraged to provide friendly, efficient assistance and uphold store standards. The work environment values collaboration, accountability, and customer satisfaction, creating opportunities for learning and growth in retail operations.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Associate role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kolkata. In this role, the Sales Associate assists customers with product selection, answers questions, and provides information on features, prices, and promotions. Responsibilities include maintaining merchandise displays, stocking shelves, organizing inventory, and ensuring the store is clean and presentable. The Sales Associate processes sales transactions at the checkout, handles returns or exchanges in line with store policy, and supports loss-prevention efforts by following security procedures. The role also involves working with team members to meet sales targets, learning about new products, and delivering consistent, courteous service to all customers.

* Strong customer service orientation, including the ability to engage with customers professionally and handle inquiries or concerns with patience.
* Basic sales and retail operation skills, such as understanding promotions, assisting with upselling, and supporting daily store activities.
* Good communication skills, including clear spoken English and local language abilities, and the capacity to work effectively with diverse customers and colleagues.
* Attention to detail and reliability in handling cash, processing transactions accurately, and following store procedures.
* Ability to stand for extended periods, move merchandise as needed, and maintain store cleanliness and organization.
* Teamwork and flexibility, including willingness to work shifts, weekends, and holidays as required by store operations.
* Prior retail or customer-facing experience is an advantage but not always required; training may be provided.
* Minimum educational qualification typically at the high school level or equivalent, with openness to candidates eager to learn and grow in retail.

title: Tender & Liaison Officer/Manager
description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Tender & Liaison Officer responsible for managing the complete tendering process, coordinating with government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), and private organizations, and ensuring timely submission of tenders. The candidate will also be responsible for maintaining effective liaison with relevant authorities and ensuring compliance with tender requirements.

* Identify and monitor tender opportunities through GeM, CPPP, e-procurement portals, government websites and other platforms.
* Prepare, review and submit tenders, quotations, bids and proposals within specified deadlines.
* Coordinate with government departments, PSUs, procurement authorities and other agencies regarding tender-related matters.
* Handle online tender submission, bid opening, corrigendum updates and follow-ups.
* Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Accounts, Finance, Production and Legal for tender documentation.
* Follow up on submitted tenders, work orders, purchase orders and payment-related matters.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with government officials, consultants and procurement agencies.
* Track tender results and prepare regular MIS reports for management.
* Travel to Pan India as and when required -

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PG Diploma in Marketing or Business Administration preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in tender management and government liaison.
* Good knowledge of GeM Portal, CPPP and various e-tendering platforms.
* Strong documentation, communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tenders and meet strict deadlines.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of tenders identified and submitted.
* Accuracy and timely submission of tender documents.
* Tender qualification and success ratio.
* Effective coordination and follow-up with authorities.
* Timely completion of tender-related documentation.
* Revenue generated through successful tender participation.

title: Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses
description:
**Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses**

**Brainware University seeks an analytical and resourceful professional to lead a team of bright young AI researchers to work on problems relating to admissions, placements, HR, cost control, programme performance and institutional growth.**

**The role**

You will translate management concerns into clearly formulated problems, identify the questions that matter, investigate available evidence and recommend practical solutions.

The work will rely primarily on secondary research, supplemented by available university data discussions with relevant colleagues and market research.

Information will sometimes be incomplete. You must be able to make reasonable assumptions, explain their basis and assess how they affect your conclusions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Structure problems into specific questions, research tasks and measurable outcomes.
* Research comparable institutions, industry practices, market trends and relevant benchmarks.
* Develop realistic estimates and financial or operational models using clearly stated assumptions.
* Assess alternative solutions in terms of cost, feasibility, likely benefit and implementation requirements.
* Present concise recommendations explaining what should be done, why, by whom and how results should be measured.
* Refine recommendations as new evidence becomes available.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and practical judgement.
* Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
* Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets and incomplete information.
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply.
* Ability to work independently and question assumptions constructively.
* Responsible use of AI research tools, including verification of sources and calculations.

**Candidates may come from consulting, business analysis, economics, finance, operations, market research or related backgrounds. Experience in higher education would be preferred. Demonstrated problem-solving ability will carry more weight than a particular degree or designation.**

The expected output is a workable recommendation supported by evidence, transparent assumptions and an implementation plan.

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical case exercise and discuss their reasoning, assumptions and recommendations.

**Locations : Both Salt Lake and Barasat**

Remuneration: Commensurate with capability and experience.

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a brief example of a problem you have analysed, explaining your approach, recommendation and outcome, to ds.cho@brainwareuniversity.ac.in.

**Role Title: AVP, Sourcing Manager (L10)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The AVP Sourcing will execute and carry out the sourcing process, ensure supplier compliance during on-boarding and engagement for renewal time periods, review contractual agreements of assigned suppliers, including developing certain sourcing category strategies for Global hubs (US and Philippines). In this role, you will manage and mitigate supplier as well as business risks and work closely with the Business leaders and Sourcing Leaders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Regularly meet with business owners across Synchrony lines of businesses (LOBs) and/or Sourcing Leaders to provide guidance and direction to functional teams, with strong process responsibility to develop comprehensive plan to execute while meeting business needs (i.e., examine scope, cost, availability of products/services and market conditions to complete projects).
* Expertise on Global Supply markets (US and Philippines) in terms of supplier/products/services and local compliance requirement for suppliers.
* Drive sourcing initiatives with focus on driving productivity, cost saving benefits and identifying rationalization opportunities.
* Leverage professional expertise with Legal and business owners to review and modify contractual terms & conditions.
* Oversight of supplier compliance with regulatory and reputational requirements throughout all stages of the sourcing process.
* Conduct and assist RFIs/RFPs, market research and identification, qualification and competitive analysis of required products and services.

We are looking for a Risk Data Platforms Specialist in the Risk and Compliance Transformation team, with 4-9 years of regulatory reporting data platforms experience with preferred prior experience in capital, financial and other regulatory reports, involving identification of critical data elements, documentation and validation of end-to-end reporting lineage, source-system analysis and data extraction processes, mapping of data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems. EY Digital Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. The Risk and Compliance Transformation practice works with clients to analyse, formulate, design, mobilize and drive digital transformation initiatives. We advise clients on their most pressing digital challenges and opportunities surround business strategy, customer, growth, profit optimization, innovation, technology strategy, and digital transformation. We also have a unique ability to help our clients translate strategy into actionable technical design, and transformation planning/mobilization. * Map data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems

* Ability to guide and coach junior team members

**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* 4-9 years of experience in data used for risk, financial and supervisory reporting within the broader data governance context, with right mix of practical lineage capability and strong analytical, investigative, documentation and stakeholder-management skills
* Working experience in Capital Adequacy and Risk Exposures (any 1 or more subject areas of  capital adequacy, own funds, credit risk, market risk, operational risk, leverage, liquidity metrics, large exposures, asset encumbrance)
* Working experience in:

+ Source-system analysis and data extraction processes
+ Mapping of data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems
+ Automation of lineage capture and documentation activities
+ Data catalogue, metadata repository and reporting architecture initiatives
+ Identification of report owners, critical data elements and reporting metrics

- IFRS 9 ECL Models

- Documentation of model dependencies, assumptions, controls, reconciliations, governance, validation and approvals

**Education**
:
  
  

* Degree: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The role will be responsible for building senior-level institutional relationships, identifying business opportunities, understanding organizational requirements, developing customized engagement models, leading commercial discussions, and converting opportunities into workshops, pilots, paid programs, semester engagements, and long-term or annual partnerships.

This is a strategic institutional business development role, not a conventional course-sales position. * Identify new institutional business opportunities across education, training, skilling, employability, internship, projects, and industry-academia collaboration.

* Coordinate with Management on strategic university and government opportunities.
* Internal Coordination

* Ensure smooth transition from business development to program execution.
* Support institutional feedback and relationship management after program delivery.

**Required Experience & Background**

* 6-10 years of relevant professional experience.
* Experience in B2B business development, institutional sales, EdTech, education, corporate training, skill development, or industry-academia relations.
* Proven experience personally handling institutional or corporate decision-makers.
* Demonstrated experience in developing accounts and converting relationships into business.

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic B2B Business Development
* Institutional Relationship Management
* Senior Stakeholder Management
* Consultative Selling
* Proposal Development
* Commercial Negotiation
* Business Closure
* Networking & Partnership Development
* Team Guidance
* CRM & Pipeline Management
* Presentation & Communication

* Strong relationship-oriented approach rather than transactional selling.
* Ability to understand client/institutional requirements before proposing solutions.
* Strong ownership and follow-through.
* Comfortable with frequent local travel and face-to-face institutional meetings.
* Strong professional communication and presentation capability.
* Good English communication; Bengali strongly preferred for West Bengal institutional relationships, with Hindi considered an advantage.

* Proposal value and conversion
* Workshops/pilots initiated
* Paid program closures
* Repeat business and annual partnerships
* Institutional relationship depth
* Revenue contribution
* Team pipeline governance

Webskitters Academy is the training and skill development division of Webskitters Technology Solutions Pvt. Backed by the strong legacy of a globally recognized IT organization with over 15 years of industry excellence, Webskitters Academy focuses on delivering career-oriented training programs in emerging technologies and professional domains.

The Academy is committed to nurturing future-ready talent through hands-on learning, live project exposure, industry mentorship, and structured development programs. About the Role

We are looking for a Business Development Manager to own new-business acquisition for the **US and Canada** (primary markets), with **Latin America** as a secondary market. This is a hands-on, full-cycle B2B recruitment and staffing sales role. You will build pipeline, win employers, secure live mandates, close commercial terms and grow each client into repeat hiring or wider RPO / search opportunities. The role is revenue-accountable, and activity alone is not success.

Key Responsibilities

* Own North America new-business revenue and new-client acquisition, and achieve the agreed monthly target after the 90-day ramp.
* Build a US / Canada target-account list by industry, geography and employer size, and identify CHROs, HR / TA heads, founders, procurement and hiring managers.
* Generate outbound pipeline independently through LinkedIn / Sales Navigator, email, phone, referrals, networking, events, RFPs and partners.
* Run discovery on hiring volumes, role mix, urgency, vendor model, MSP / VMS requirements, fee expectations and decision process before committing to delivery.
* Sell permanent recruitment, executive search, contract / temporary staffing, RPO, international recruitment and volume / project hiring.
* Lead proposals, fee defence, MSA / terms, negotiation and closure while protecting margin.
* Work closely with recruiters, delivery, operations and finance on live accounts, and grow accounts into repeat requisitions and RPO opportunities.
* Update the CRM daily, with a clear next step on every opportunity.

Performance Expectations (after 90-day ramp)

* **New business revenue:** monthly target of 7x fixed monthly gross salary
* **Qualified pipeline:** minimum 4x the next-90-day revenue target
* **Decision-maker meetings:** minimum 8 per month (target 10)
* **New activated clients:** minimum 1 per month
* **Qualified client mandates:** minimum 4 per month
* **Win rate:** minimum 20% (target 25%+)
* **Outbound activity:** minimum 60 meaningful touches per week
* **CRM and forecast:** 100% of opportunities updated weekly, with forecast within ±10% of actual revenue

Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, HR, Communications or a related field (an equivalent proven B2B sales record may be accepted). An MBA / PGDM is preferred but not mandatory.
* 3 to 8 years of experience in recruitment / staffing / HR services sales or international B2B sales to North American employers.
* Proven full-cycle sales skills: prospecting, discovery, proposal, negotiation and close.
* Knowledge of contingency / direct hire, retained search, RPO or contract staffing models.
* CRM discipline (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho or equivalent).
* Strong commercial negotiation skills, including fee defence and objection handling.
* Fluent spoken and written English. Hindi is preferred.

Good to Have

* US staffing terminology: direct hire, contract, MSP / VMS, vendor onboarding.
* Experience with RPO, volume hiring, RFP / RFQ and MSA handling.
* Relevant certification in recruitment sales, consultative selling or RPO / MSP / VMS.

Behavioural Competencies

* Hunter mindset: self-starter, resilient, comfortable creating demand from zero
* Ownership of revenue and client activation
* Consultative approach to client needs
* Strong follow-through and written communication across time zones

Compensation and Schedule

* fixed gross approx. ₹50,000 to ₹65,000 per month; final offer based on experience
* Evening / night shift aligned to North American hours
* Monday to Friday

title: Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Fenestro Engineers is a growing engineering organization focused on delivering high-quality, reliable solutions to clients across diverse industries. The company emphasizes technical excellence, customer satisfaction, and long-term partnerships, working closely with clients to understand and address their unique project requirements. Fenestro Engineers values collaboration and integrity, encouraging team members to contribute ideas and take ownership of their work. The organization provides opportunities for professional growth and development in a supportive, performance-driven environment. Team members are encouraged to build strong relationships with customers and help expand the company’s presence in the market.

**Role Description**
The Sales Executive will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, generating leads, and managing the end-to-end sales cycle for Fenestro Engineers’ products and services. Day-to-day activities include visiting prospective and existing clients, presenting solutions, preparing proposals and quotations, negotiating terms, and closing deals. The role involves close collaboration with the technical and operations teams to ensure accurate scoping of requirements and timely delivery. The Sales Executive will maintain detailed records of customer interactions, update sales reports, and contribute to sales forecasts and planning. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kerala, India, requiring regular travel within the region to meet clients and attend industry events.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sales and business development skills, including lead generation, opportunity qualification, and deal closure.
* Customer relationship management abilities, with experience in building trust, handling inquiries, and providing post-sales support.
* Solid communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear, non-technical language.
* Basic understanding of engineering or construction domains (e.g., building materials, structural or mechanical solutions) is highly beneficial.
* Proficiency in using office productivity tools and CRM or sales management software to track activities and performance.
* Ability to work independently in the field, manage time effectively, and meet targets in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in technical sales.
* Prior experience in industrial, engineering, or construction-related sales in Kerala or nearby regions is an advantage.
* Comfort with on-site client visits and travel within Kerala, with a valid driver’s license or reliable means of transportation.

Promittens Technologies Solutions is a customer-first organization focused on delivering innovation, excellence, and tailored solutions for its clients. With a transparent and value-driven approach, Promittens ensures seamless experiences in every client engagement. Its commitment to customer satisfaction drives its success and inspires a culture of collaboration.

**Job Title: Independent Sales Consultant (Revenue Sharing Model)**

Overview

We are looking for dynamic and self-motivated Independent Sales Consultants to promote and generate business for our products and services. This is a revenue-sharing opportunity, ideal for professionals with strong networks and sales experience. Consultants will earn a percentage of revenue from every successful deal they bring in.

·      Sales professionals

·      Business consultants

·      Freelancers

·      Marketing professionals

·      Individuals with strong business networks
