title: Yarn Marketing Manager (Spinning Mills)
description:
**Position: Yarn Marketing Manager**

* Job Description

To lead and drive domestic and international cotton yarn marketing activities, develop new business opportunities, strengthen customer relationships, achieve sales and profitability targets, and ensure effective utilization of the spinning mill's production capacity through strategic sales planning and market development.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Sales & Marketing Management
* Develop and implement marketing strategies for cotton yarn sales in domestic and international markets.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales volume and revenue targets.
* Develop new customers and expand existing business relationships.
* Identify potential markets, customer segments and business opportunities.
* Drive sales of combed, compact, knitting and weaving yarn.
* Ensure optimum sales realization and contribution margins.
* Monitor market demand, competitor activities and cotton yarn price movements.
* Domestic Market Development
* Develop business with knitting units, weaving mills, textile manufacturers and garment exporters.
* Establish strong relationships with yarn dealers, traders, fabric manufacturers and direct consumers.
* Expand customer base in major textile markets such as Tiruppur, Coimbatore, Erode, Karur, Mumbai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad and other textile centres.
* Conduct regular customer visits and market surveys.
* Generate new business enquiries and convert them into confirmed orders.
* Export Marketing
* Develop new international customers and export markets.
* Identify potential buyers, importers, textile mills and international sourcing agents.
* Coordinate with export documentation, logistics and commercial departments.
* Negotiate export prices, payment terms and delivery schedules.
* Monitor international cotton yarn market trends and export competitiveness.
* Develop long-term business relationships with overseas customers.
* Product & Technical Knowledge
* Develop strong knowledge of cotton yarn specifications and applications.
* Promote different yarn counts and product categories.
* Understand customer requirements relating to yarn quality, count, strength, CSP, U%, imperfections, hairiness and contamination.
* Coordinate with production and quality teams to ensure product consistency.
* Handle customer complaints relating to yarn quality and coordinate corrective actions.
* Pricing & Commercial Management
* Prepare competitive yarn pricing strategies based on cotton prices, conversion costs and market demand.
* Monitor daily cotton and yarn market prices.
* Negotiate selling prices with customers.
* Monitor contribution margins and customer-wise profitability.
* Ensure timely order confirmation and commercial documentation.
* Coordinate credit limits, outstanding payments and collections with the finance department.
* Order & Dispatch Coordination
* Coordinate with production planning for order execution.
* Monitor customer order booking and pending order positions.
* Ensure timely availability of finished yarn.
* Coordinate with stores, packing, dispatch and logistics departments.
* Track order delivery schedules and ensure customer commitments are fulfilled.
* Team Management
* Lead, guide and motivate the yarn marketing team.
* Set individual sales targets and review team performance.
* Develop customer-wise and territory-wise sales plans.
* Monitor daily sales activities and prepare management reports.
* Improve team productivity and market coverage.
* Management Reporting
* Submit daily, weekly and monthly sales reports.
* Monitor sales volume, average realization and contribution.
* Prepare customer-wise sales performance reports.
* Analyse market trends and competitor pricing.
* Provide sales forecasts and future business projections to senior management.
* Product Knowledge Required

**The Candidate Should Have Good Knowledge Of**

* 100% Cotton Yarn
* Combed Cotton Yarn
* Compact Cotton Yarn
* Knitting Yarn
* Weaving Yarn
* Different yarn counts (Ne 20s to 80s, depending on product portfolio)
* Ring Spun and Compact Spun Yarn
* Yarn quality parameters and testing standards
* Required Skills & Competencies
* Strong knowledge of the spinning industry and cotton yarn markets.
* Excellent domestic and export marketing skills.
* Strong customer relationship management capabilities.
* Good negotiation and commercial decision-making skills.
* Knowledge of cotton procurement and yarn price movements.
* Ability to develop new markets and generate business.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

Good communication and presentation skills.
  
  

* Proficiency in MS Excel, ERP and sales reporting systems.
* Ability to work under sales targets and business pressure.
* Educational Qualification & Experience
* B.Tech / B.Sc. Textile Technology, Textile Engineering or equivalent.
* MBA in Marketing will be an added advantage.
* Minimum 8-15 years of experience in cotton yarn marketing.
* Previous experience in a reputed spinning mill is preferred.
* Experience handling domestic and export yarn customers.
* Proven track record in achieving sales volume and profitability targets.

The Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing the company's digital marketing strategy, strengthening brand presence across digital platforms, driving consumer engagement and delivering measurable marketing outcomes.

The role requires a combination of strategic thinking, creative direction, campaign management and performance analysis. The ideal candidate should understand consumer behaviour, have a strong sense of brand storytelling and know how to translate business objectives into effective digital marketing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Digital Marketing Strategy & Planning

- Develop and implement an integrated digital marketing strategy aligned with business and brand objectives.  
- Create annual, quarterly and monthly digital marketing plans.  
- Define target audiences, content pillars, campaign themes and platform-specific strategies.  
- Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness, consumer engagement, website traffic and online sales.  
- Plan and manage digital marketing budgets and campaign allocations.  
- Monitor competitors, industry developments and emerging digital marketing trends.

2. Social Media Strategy & Management

- Lead the brand's presence across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms.  
- Develop and manage monthly content calendars and campaign schedules.  
- Establish a consistent brand voice, visual identity and communication strategy.  
- Drive organic reach, engagement, community growth and brand visibility.  
- Oversee publishing, audience interaction, social listening and community management.  
- Identify opportunities for innovative content formats, reels, storytelling and consumer-led campaigns.

3. Content Strategy & Creative Direction

- Lead the development of creative concepts, campaign ideas and brand storytelling.  
- Guide the content creation team, graphic designers, video editors, photographers and external agencies.  
- Plan product shoots, food photography, lifestyle content, founder-led videos and brand films.  
- Develop creative briefs and ensure content aligns with brand positioning and guidelines.  
- Drive campaigns that communicate product quality, brand values, product benefits and consumer trust.  
- Ensure consistent quality and timely execution of all digital content.

4. Paid Digital Marketing & Campaign Management

- Plan, execute and optimise digital advertising campaigns across Meta, Google and other relevant platforms.  
- Define campaign objectives, audience targeting, budgets and performance benchmarks.  
- Monitor campaign performance and optimise for reach, engagement, traffic, leads and conversions.  
- Work with performance marketing specialists or agencies to improve campaign effectiveness.  
- Track key metrics such as ROAS, CPC, CPM, CTR, CPA and conversion rates.  
- Ensure appropriate tracking and measurement through tools such as Meta Pixel, Conversions API and Google Analytics.

5. Influencer & Creator Marketing

- Develop and execute influencer marketing and creator collaboration strategies.  
- Identify suitable influencers and content creators aligned with the brand.  
- Coordinate collaborations, product seeding, campaign briefs and deliverables.  
- Build user-generated content initiatives and consumer engagement campaigns.  
- Evaluate influencer campaign performance and return on investment.

6. E-commerce & Digital Growth Coordination

- Work closely with the e-commerce team to drive online visibility and product discovery.  
- Support promotional campaigns across the company website, marketplaces and quick-commerce platforms.  
- Coordinate digital campaigns that contribute to website traffic, customer acquisition and online sales.  
- Ensure consistency in product communication and brand presentation across digital touchpoints.  
- Identify opportunities to improve the digital consumer journey.

7. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Monitoring

- Establish digital marketing KPIs and performance benchmarks.  
- Monitor social media growth, reach, engagement, website traffic and campaign performance.  
- Analyse content performance and identify opportunities for improvement.  
- Prepare monthly digital marketing performance reports.  
- Track campaign budgets, spending efficiency and marketing returns.  
- Present actionable insights and recommendations to management.

8. Team & Agency Management

- Manage and guide the social media and content execution team.  
- Coordinate with internal marketing, sales and e-commerce teams.  
- Manage external agencies, freelancers, influencers and other marketing partners.  
- Establish workflows, timelines, approval processes and accountability within the team.  
- Ensure timely delivery and quality of all marketing initiatives.

Candidate Profile

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication, Business Administration or a related field.  
- 4–6 years of experience in digital marketing and social media management.  
- Experience in managing digital marketing for FMCG, food, retail or consumer brands will be a strong advantage.  
- Strong understanding of social media platforms, digital advertising and content strategy.  
- Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.  
- Knowledge of Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite and digital reporting tools.  
- Understanding of SEO, website analytics, conversion optimisation and e-commerce marketing.  
- Strong creative thinking, storytelling and brand-building capabilities.  
- Experience managing teams, creative agencies and marketing budgets.  
- Excellent communication, presentation and leadership skills.  
- Ability to interpret data and translate insights into marketing decisions.  
- Malayalam and English communication skills preferred.

What We’re Looking For

- A strategic thinker who understands both brand building and business growth.  
- Someone who can combine creativity with data-driven decision-making.  
- A strong leader who can guide creative teams and manage multiple marketing initiatives.  
- Someone who takes ownership of digital marketing performance and campaign outcomes.  
- A trend-aware professional who brings fresh ideas and innovative approaches.  
- Someone who can build a consistent, recognisable and trusted digital identity for Mother’s.

Why Join Mother’s?

- Be part of an established food and FMCG brand with a legacy of over five decades.  
- Opportunity to lead and shape the brand's digital marketing direction.  
- Freedom to experiment with creative campaigns and innovative marketing strategies.  
- Work closely with management and cross-functional teams.  
- Play a significant role in building a growing consumer brand.  
- Opportunity to make a measurable impact on brand growth and business performance.

title: Partnerships & GTM - Biochar
description:
Category: Full-time

Starting date: Immediate

Location: Bangalore

Reporting to: Head of Origination

**About Equilibrium:**

Equilibrium is a full-stack carbon removal developer building one of the largest high-integrity carbon portfolios from the Global South, with a ~20Mt CO₂ removal pipeline. We develop bankable, high-impact projects by integrating advanced climate science, an in-house digital MRV platform, and innovative blended finance.

Our portfolio spans across nature-based and engineered removal: on nature-based, we have large-scale agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, and mangrove restoration initiatives; on engineered removal, we are building India's leading biochar platform with large-scale commercial operations. Collectively, our projects span 120,000+ hectares and will support over 150,000 smallholder farmers and coastal communities.

Our work is backed by a $3M institutional seed round from Peak XV (formerly Sequoia) and Avaana Capital, and driven by a 90+ member team with deep expertise in climate science, carbon markets, and project operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

We are looking for someone to drive business development and commercial execution for our biomass gasification solutions. The role will focus on identifying industrial customers with significant heat and energy requirements, understanding their technical and commercial needs, developing business opportunities and closing contracts for biomass gasification plants.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role that requires a strong understanding of industrial technologies, commercial negotiations and the ability to build relationships within industrial ecosystems. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following -

* **Industrial Business Development:**
  Identify and develop business opportunities with industries that have significant thermal energy and process heat requirements, and where biomass gasification can serve as an alternative to conventional fuels.
* **Lead Generation & Market Mapping:**
  Build a pipeline of prospective industrial customers across sectors such as textiles, food processing, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, paper, ceramics, metals, cement and other energy-intensive industries.
* **Techno-Commercial Assessment:**
  Understand customer requirements, existing heating systems, fuel consumption, energy costs and operational constraints to assess the technical and commercial suitability of biomass gasification solutions.
* **Customer Engagement:**
  Engage with plant heads, factory owners, engineering teams, procurement teams, energy managers and senior decision-makers to understand requirements and build confidence in the proposed solutions.
* **Industrial Networking:**
  Build and leverage relationships within local industrial ecosystems, industry associations and business networks such as FICCI, CII and regional industry forums, particularly across South India.
* **Proposal Development:**
  Coordinate with the HQ engineering and technical teams to prepare technical and commercial proposals, project estimates, financial comparisons, payback assessments and customer presentations.
* **Negotiations & Deal Closure:**
  Lead commercial discussions, negotiate pricing and contract terms, address customer concerns and drive opportunities through to contract closure for biomass gasification plants.
* **Market Intelligence:**
  Track industrial energy demand, competing technologies, conventional fuel prices, customer economics and market developments to identify new business opportunities.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related technical field. MBA is an advantage.
* 5–7 years of experience in techno-commercial sales, industrial equipment sales or industrial energy solutions.
* Prior experience selling industrial machinery or technology such as gasifiers, boilers, burners, furnaces or other thermal equipment to industries.
* Strong understanding of industrial heat requirements, technology feasibility, fuel economics, CAPEX, OPEX and ROI.
* Proven ability to generate leads, build a sales pipeline, develop customer relationships and close commercial deals.
* Strong networking skills and established connections within industrial associations and circles such as FICCI and CII, particularly across South India.
* Excellent proposal development, commercial negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience in biomass-based energy, biomass aggregation, briquetting or pellet manufacturing will be a definite advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively across industrial clusters and customer locations.

**How to Apply**

Send your application to talent@equilibriumearth.com

title: GTM Manager
description:
At Mstack AI, we are building the world’s first AI-native chemical company. Specialty chemistry powers every physical product on Earth, from battery electrolytes and pharma intermediates to semiconductors and sustainable coatings, yet the industry still relies on trial-and-error R&D methods that take 18+ months per molecule. We compress 18 months of R&D into a matter of days by combining quantum chemistry, generative AI, and real-world custom manufacturing. Backed by $40M from Lightspeed and Alpha Wave Global, we operate across Houston, San Francisco, Mumbai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad. We don’t just predict reactions; we deliver real-world physical production batches.

**ABOUT THE TEAM:**

You will join the team building Chemstack AI, an agentic synthesis R&D platform built on our own Chemistry World Model that reasons from first principles like an expert chemist. It designs synthesis routes, researches literature and patents, predicts reaction conditions and tests reactions virtually before they reach the lab, turning months of R&D into days, with the evidence for every step. Large companies are already trialling it on their own molecules. The team, close to leadership, brings together PhD chemists and specialists in AI, data and product. Our chemists work with the commercial team on each customer, so the science is covered. AI for chemistry is new, and this team is shaping how it is sold. We value ownership, deep curiosity and moving fast while getting the details right.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As a GTM Manager, you will be the trusted partner to the R&D teams we serve, from the first demo through contract and renewal. Our sales team opens the door; from there, the customer is yours. You will help each customer win, lead each team into a new way of working, and turn strong results into lasting partnerships. Success looks like trials that convert and accounts that expand, and your scope grows with them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* *Relationship management:*
  Build trusted relationships across each account, from a chemist to the head of R&D, and shape a joint plan for where Chemstack AI creates the most value.
* *Expectation management:*
  Define with each customer what success means for their R&D, in outcomes they can measure, and align everyone involved around it.
* *Change management:*
  Plan each team’s migration from familiar tools to working with Chemstack AI, address concerns early, and help the first users bring the rest of the team along.

***Execution:***

• Demos: Make the value of Chemstack AI clear from the first meeting and turn interest into commitment. • Onboarding: Own each customer’s start, from agreements and access to a strong kick off, so teams are live fast. • Trials: Run each trial against goals agreed upfront, and close with a proposal their leadership can act on. • Account growth: Grow each signed account into new teams, sites and users, and secure every renewal. • Market insight: Bring back why we win and lose, and shape what we build and how we price it. • Pipeline and process: Keep an accurate view of each deal and renewal, and sharpen how we work with customers.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

• Experience: 4 to 6 years in B2B account management, customer success or enterprise sales, ideally selling software to R&D teams in pharma, life sciences or chemicals.

• Commercial Expertise:

• Proven ability to build trusted relationships with decision makers and their teams in enterprise accounts. • Experience leading enterprise teams through the adoption of new software, and making the change last. • Proficiency in running pilots or trials, writing proposals, and keeping a CRM and forecast leadership can rely on. • Demonstrated track record of turning trials into contracts and growing accounts after the first sale.

• Domain Alignment: Curiosity about chemistry and how chemists work. A science background or a network in pharma or chemicals is a plus, not a requirement.

• Mindset: Owns outcomes, writes and speaks clearly, earns the trust of scientists with evidence rather than a pitch, keeps several accounts moving at once without losing detail, and is comfortable travelling to customer sites.

title: Sr Staff FAE, RTL to GDS Implementation
description:
Alternate Job Titles
  
  

* Sr Staff Application Engineer, Digital Implementation
* Sr Staff Engineer, Physical Design Solutions
* Sr Staff FAE, RTL to GDS Implementation
* Technical Application Engineer, Backend P&R (Principal Level)
* Solutions Engineer, ASIC Design Flow
* Sr StaffApplication Engineer, Fusion Compiler
* Lead Application Engineer, Advanced Node Implementation

We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent years building expertise in physical design, and you know that the difference between a chip that tapes out on schedule and one that slips by a quarter usually comes down to a methodology decision made during floorplanning or a timing bottleneck nobody caught until route. You do not just run tools, you understand why multi-source CTS works beautifully on one block and creates hold violations on another, and you can explain that tradeoff in a way that reshapes how a customer team approaches their next design.
  
  
Customer problems energize you. You like being the person who gets called when a design is stuck at 97% timing closure on a 3nm node and the team has exhausted their options. You dig in, isolate the issue, and come back with a solution that actually works, not a workaround that pushes the problem to signoff. Sitting with R&D to translate a customer pain point into a feature request feels as natural to you as sitting with a customer team to show them how a new Fusion Compiler capability solves the exact challenge they described last quarter.
  
  
At this level, you bring perspective. You have seen enough designs, enough nodes, and enough tool generations to spot patterns others miss. You know when a customer issue is a one-off design quirk and when it signals a methodology gap that will affect ten other customers in six months. At Synopsys, you will work on the designs that power AI accelerators, autonomous vehicles, and 5G infrastructure, and the customers you support will remember your name because you helped them ship.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Deploy Fusion Compiler and ICC2 on customer designs at advanced nodes (5nm, 3nm, and beyond), solving complex PPA challenges using machine learning placement, physical synthesis, and multi-source CTS techniques
* Work directly with customers to develop, debug, and optimize RTL to GDS implementation flows, identifying design bottlenecks and tool behavior that blocks timing closure or violates power budgets
* Run competitive benchmarks to demonstrate Synopsys implementation solutions against rival tools, documenting QoR improvements and building the technical narrative that wins customer evaluations and displaces competition
* Translate customer findings into clear, actionable requirements for Synopsys R&D, driving tool enhancements that solve both immediate design challenges and long-term methodology gaps across the customer base
* Lead customer migration to new EDA tool versions by validating flows, identifying regressions, ensuring PPA gains carry through to production designs, and building confidence in adoption
* Act as the technical bridge between customers and Synopsys R&D, representing customer needs internally with credibility and representing product capabilities externally with authority
* Proactively identify recurring customer pain points across engagements and develop reusable solutions, scripts, or methodologies that scale beyond a single design or customer and influence product direction

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Customers tape out on schedule because the flow you debugged or methodology you built removed the bottleneck that was blocking their critical path to production
* Synopsys wins competitive evaluations because the benchmark results you generated prove measurable PPA advantage on real customer designs at the most advanced nodes
* R&D ships features that matter because the requirements you wrote were specific, grounded in actual design challenges, and tied directly to customer business outcomes
* Advanced node adoption accelerates across your customer base because the migration methodology you validated gives teams confidence to move to the next tool release without risking schedule
* Customer engineering teams adopt new Fusion Compiler capabilities faster because you showed them exactly how machine learning placement or advanced CTS solves their specific timing or congestion problem
* Synopsys product strategy improves because the customer insights you surface reveal gaps or opportunities the product team had not yet identified or prioritized
* Your customers view Synopsys as a strategic partner, not a vendor, because you consistently deliver solutions that work under pressure, on their timeline, and at their scale

What You'll Need
  
  

* 10+ years of hands-on ASIC design or application engineering experience, with deep expertise in physical implementation including placement, optimization, CTS, and routing
* Expert-level knowledge of Synopsys backend tools, specifically Fusion Compiler and ICC2, including logical and physical synthesis, timing closure techniques, macro placement, and routing at advanced nodes
* Strong working knowledge of RTL to GDS full flow, with the ability to debug issues anywhere from synthesis through signoff and articulate root cause to both customers and R&D
* Demonstrated experience working directly with customers or cross-functional engineering teams to solve complex technical problems under tight schedules and high stakes
* Deep understanding of advanced node design challenges (5nm and below) and the methodologies required to achieve timing, power, and area targets at scale
* Experience with static timing analysis tools like PrimeTime is a strong plus, as is familiarity with front-end synthesis flows in Design Compiler or Fusion Compiler
* Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Who You Are
  
  

* You can walk into a customer war room where a design is failing timing by 500ps at 3nm, ask three diagnostic questions, and know where to start looking before anyone finishes answering
* You do not wait for perfect information to act, you work with what you have, isolate variables, and move toward a solution while others are still debating the scope of the problem
* You can translate a dense timing report into a two-sentence explanation of what is broken and what needs to change, and that explanation makes sense to both the customer lead and the R&D architect
* You are comfortable being the customer advocate in a room full of R&D engineers and the product expert in a room full of skeptical customer architects, and you do not lose credibility in either setting
* You know when to escalate and when to solve it yourself, and you have the judgment and experience to tell the difference in real time without second-guessing
* You stay current on what is changing in advanced node design and EDA methodology, not because it is required, but because you are genuinely curious about how the next generation of chips gets built and you want to be part of shaping that

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will join the Application Engineering team in Bengaluru, working closely with Synopsys R&D, product management, and field teams globally to support customers across Asia and beyond. This team sits at the intersection of product development and customer success, and your work will directly shape both what we build and how customers use it.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: AI Architect
description:

* Lead technical discovery workshops with client business, architecture, data, engineering, and technology teams.

title: Technical Success Manager- ANZ
description:

title: ServiceNow Solution Consultant
description:
Cprime is an AI-first, human-centered partner, combining strategic consulting with industry-leading platforms to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, and shift enterprise toward AI native thinking.  Founded in 2003 and headquartered in the US, our clients span the globe and include more than 300 of the Fortune 500 companies.  We bring deep expertise across Atlassian, IBM Apptio, ServiceNow, cloud, data, and enterprise agility to enable intelligent enterprises where people and AI orchestrate as one.
  
  
Support INRY’s ServiceNow sales opportunities by translating customer needs into credible, outcome-focused solution proposals. The Solution Consultant partners with Go-To-Market (GTM), delivery, and technical teams across discovery, qualification, solution design, estimation, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, presentations, and demonstrations. The role also helps keep INRY’s solution offerings, demos, and reusable presales content current and market-ready.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Discovery and qualification: Gather and analyze customer requirements from discovery calls, first meetings, RFPs, and RFIs. Capture business needs, use cases, scope, assumptions, constraints, decision factors, and open questions.
* Solution development: Map customer requirements to relevant ServiceNow capabilities and INRY offerings. Work with GTM, delivery, and technical teams to validate feasibility, dependencies, solution approach, and proposed outcomes.
* Proposals, estimates, and RFX responses: Build proposal presentations, solution descriptions, estimation sheets, and pricing inputs. Draft and coordinate clear, accurate responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, confirming technical and delivery inputs and meeting submission timelines.
* Statements of Work: Develop or contribute to SOWs and related commercial documents, including scope, objectives, deliverables, assumptions, and dependencies; obtain the appropriate internal reviews.
* Customer presentations: Present proposed solutions and INRY capabilities to customers, explain the rationale and expected outcomes, respond to questions, and support customer planning and roadmap conversations.
* Demonstrations and PoCs: Prepare and deliver ServiceNow demonstrations that fit the customer use case. Maintain demo scripts and readiness for supported offerings; coordinate advanced demonstrations and proofs-of-concept with delivery or technical specialists, and contribute to PoC planning and execution.
* Solution and offering assets: Create and update customer-specific introduction and solution decks, service descriptions, offering collateral, industry or event materials, and customer success stories. Maintain reusable proposal and first-call content.
* Platform and market readiness: Stay current with ServiceNow releases, product capabilities, and relevant market needs; reflect useful changes in demos, service descriptions, and solution offerings.
* AI solution positioning: Identify relevant ServiceNow AI opportunities, including Now Assist and agentic AI; help frame customer use cases and business value, and coordinate AI demonstrations or PoCs with AI and technical specialists. Validate feasibility and make assumptions, dependencies, and included versus optional AI scope clear.
* Pod and team coordination: Support assigned GTM or sales-pod deal cadence, track actions and blockers, coordinate contributors, and keep internal stakeholders aligned on deliverables and due dates.
* SSI enablement: Share solution knowledge with colleagues and contribute to internal guidelines, training materials, case studies, and improvements to the team’s content library and presales process.

**Qualifications and skills:**

* 3–4 years of experience in ServiceNow presales, solution consulting, implementation consulting, or a closely related customer-facing role. Direct ServiceNow presales experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of the ServiceNow platform and experience positioning one or more ServiceNow products or workflows for customer needs.
* Experience contributing to proposal writing and estimation, customer presentations or demos, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Ability to understand customer requirements, structure a solution approach, and clearly communicate assumptions, scope, feasibility, and dependencies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, delivery, and technical contributors, while managing multiple deal deadlines.
* Strong written communication, presentation, organization, and customer-engagement skills.
* A consultative approach, techno-functional curiosity, and the ability to tell a clear solution story to technical and non-technical audiences.

**What We Believe In**
At Cprime we believe in facilitating social justice action internally, in industry, and within our communities. We believe part of our mission is to expand the minds, hearts, and opportunities of our Cprime teammates and within the broader community to include those who have been historically marginalized.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
Cprime is an equal-opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Salesforce Success Architect
description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together technical architects, customer support engineers, and product advisors. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.
  
  
Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.
  
  
The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:
  
  

* Drive Customer Impact - Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lead with Multi-Cloud Expertise - Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your designated Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Industry Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems - Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**Required Multi-Cloud Aptitude**
We are looking for individuals with expertise spanning multiple Industry Clouds (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) from the following list. Prioritization of these clouds is geographically diverse, but we are primarily seeking skills in:
  
  

* Life Sciences Cloud
* Public Sector
* Financial Services Cloud
* Revenue Cloud & Billing
* Manufacturing Cloud
* Automotive Cloud
* Education Cloud
* Net Zero Cloud
* Non-Profit
* Loyalty Cloud

**Basic Requirements**

* Solution Design & Architecture
* 8+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.
* Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.
* Communication & Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

**Desired Technical Skills**

* Secure & Scalable Architecture: Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and security configurations. Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Salesforce Development: Hands-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* Data Management & Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).
* System Integration & Extensibility: Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects, and tools like Salesforce Connect.
* OmniStudio Knowledge: Experience with OmniStudio components is required.
* DevOps (Core + Industry): Strong understanding of software development and delivery process, assessing architecture environments and requirements in order to implement management solutions.

**Certifications**

* Required: Salesforce Admin, Platform Developer 1 and JavaScript Developer
* Highly Desired: Certified Architect Credentials (Application and System Architect), Platform App Builder, Salesforce Advanced Admin and an Accredited Professional credential in at least one Industry Cloud specialization (e.g., Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, or Public Sector Solutions).

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*

title: ServiceNow Solution Consultant
description:
Support INRY’s ServiceNow sales opportunities by translating customer needs into credible, outcome-focused solution proposals. The Solution Consultant partners with Go-To-Market (GTM), delivery, and technical teams across discovery, qualification, solution design, estimation, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, presentations, and demonstrations. The role also helps keep INRY’s solution offerings, demos, and reusable presales content current and market-ready.

**What you will do:**

* Discovery and qualification: Gather and analyze customer requirements from discovery calls, first meetings, RFPs, and RFIs. Capture business needs, use cases, scope, assumptions, constraints, decision factors, and open questions.
* Solution development: Map customer requirements to relevant ServiceNow capabilities and INRY offerings. Work with GTM, delivery, and technical teams to validate feasibility, dependencies, solution approach, and proposed outcomes.
* Proposals, estimates, and RFX responses: Build proposal presentations, solution descriptions, estimation sheets, and pricing inputs. Draft and coordinate clear, accurate responses to RFPs, RFIs, and RFQs, confirming technical and delivery inputs and meeting submission timelines.
* Statements of Work: Develop or contribute to SOWs and related commercial documents, including scope, objectives, deliverables, assumptions, and dependencies; obtain the appropriate internal reviews.
* Customer presentations: Present proposed solutions and INRY capabilities to customers, explain the rationale and expected outcomes, respond to questions, and support customer planning and roadmap conversations.
* Demonstrations and PoCs: Prepare and deliver ServiceNow demonstrations that fit the customer use case. Maintain demo scripts and readiness for supported offerings; coordinate advanced demonstrations and proofs-of-concept with delivery or technical specialists, and contribute to PoC planning and execution.
* Solution and offering assets: Create and update customer-specific introduction and solution decks, service descriptions, offering collateral, industry or event materials, and customer success stories. Maintain reusable proposal and first-call content.
* Platform and market readiness: Stay current with ServiceNow releases, product capabilities, and relevant market needs; reflect useful changes in demos, service descriptions, and solution offerings.
* AI solution positioning: Identify relevant ServiceNow AI opportunities, including Now Assist and agentic AI; help frame customer use cases and business value, and coordinate AI demonstrations or PoCs with AI and technical specialists. Validate feasibility and make assumptions, dependencies, and included versus optional AI scope clear.
* Pod and team coordination: Support assigned GTM or sales-pod deal cadence, track actions and blockers, coordinate contributors, and keep internal stakeholders aligned on deliverables and due dates.
* SSI enablement: Share solution knowledge with colleagues and contribute to internal guidelines, training materials, case studies, and improvements to the team’s content library and presales process.

**Qualifications and skills:**

* 3–4 years of experience in ServiceNow presales, solution consulting, implementation consulting, or a closely related customer-facing role. Direct ServiceNow presales experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of the ServiceNow platform and experience positioning one or more ServiceNow products or workflows for customer needs.
* Experience contributing to proposal writing and estimation, customer presentations or demos, and RFP/RFI responses.
* Ability to understand customer requirements, structure a solution approach, and clearly communicate assumptions, scope, feasibility, and dependencies.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with sales, delivery, and technical contributors, while managing multiple deal deadlines.
* Strong written communication, presentation, organization, and customer-engagement skills.
* A consultative approach, techno-functional curiosity, and the ability to tell a clear solution story to technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Controls Testing Engineer
description:
**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. System Architecture & Scope Definition**

* Develop full IBMS system architecture proposals for mission-critical data center projects during the bid phase, encompassing BMS, FACP, VESDA, Water Leak Detection (WLD), Access Control, CCTV, Rodent Control, and power/environment monitoring subsystems.
* Define BMS controller platform, network topology, and integration architecture — specifying primary, field-level devices, gateways, and communication protocols (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA).
* Prepare detailed I/O point schedules, controller loading calculations, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems during the estimation phase.
* Design IBMS network architecture including data network topology, switch selection criteria, BACnet/IP architecture, and integration requirements for third-party systems (DCIM, EPMS, SCADA/HMI).
* Evaluate and recommend open protocol versus proprietary integration strategies, identifying technical risks and mitigations for the proposed architecture.
* Define subsystem integration requirements, API/protocol mapping, and IBMS-to-DCIM interoperability architecture for high-density and AI data center environments.
Develop control philosophy summaries and sequences of operation (SOO) drafts to support technical sections of bids, clarifying system-level control strategies without committing to detailed execution design.  

**B. Bill of Quantities, Cost Estimation & Proposal Development**

* Prepare comprehensive Bill of Quantities (BOQ) for IBMS scope across critical and non-critical data center projects, covering all hardware, software, licensing, integration, engineering, and commissioning cost elements.
* Develop itemized cost estimation sheets with material, labor, third-party integration, software licensing, and contingency allowances, using established Vertiv rate cards and vendor quotations.
* Produce Basis of Estimate (BOE) documents clearly defining scope boundaries, assumptions, exclusions, and unit-cost rationale for each IBMS bid.
* Benchmark IBMS costs against historical project data, vendor list prices, and market intelligence to ensure commercial competitiveness without compromising technical quality.
* Identify and quantify scope risks in estimates, recommending provisional sums and risk allowances where appropriate.
* Prepare and maintain IBMS-specific pricing matrices and parametric estimation models to accelerate turnaround for repeat bid types (colocation, hyperscale, enterprise DC).
* Contribute to internal bid review and approval processes — presenting cost models, assumptions, and risks to senior management and business development leads.

**C. Technical Proposals & Bid Documentation**

* Lead preparation of technical proposal sections for IBMS scope in RFP/RFQ responses, including executive summaries, technical narratives, compliance matrices, and scope clarification letters.
* Develop technical write-ups describing the proposed IBMS architecture, system capabilities, integration approach, and value differentiators — tailored to client technical and commercial requirements.
* Prepare compliance matrices mapping client specifications and standards requirements (IEC 61850, ASHRAE, TIA-942, NFPA 72, EN 54, IS 3043, NBC 2016) against the proposed solution.
* Produce scope-of-work documents and exclusion lists that define clear contractual boundaries for the IBMS scope within the overall project.
* Develop technical clarification logs and pre-bid query registers, managing responses with accuracy and commercial awareness.
* Prepare value engineering proposals and alternative technical solutions where client requirements offer scope for cost optimization without reducing functional integrity.
* Ensure all bid documents are produced in accordance with Vertiv brand and documentation standards, with consistent formatting and professional presentation.

**D. Client Engagement & Presales Support**

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for IBMS scope during client pre-bid meetings, site surveys, and technical clarification discussions.
* Conduct technical feasibility assessments for proposed IBMS architectures, advising clients and the sales team on achievable scope, realistic timelines, and technical risks.
* Prepare and deliver technical presentations, solution overviews, and IBMS architecture demonstrations to client technical teams and procurement stakeholders.
* Participate in pre-bid site walks, capturing existing infrastructure constraints, network connectivity requirements, and integration opportunities.
* Support post-submission technical discussions, clarifications, and negotiation of technical scope with clients and consultants.
* Build and maintain trusted technical relationships with key clients, consultants, and specifiers in the data center and critical infrastructure markets.
* Provide technical input to sales team's go/no-go assessments, identifying bid qualification criteria and scope risks early in the sales cycle.

**E. Internal Collaboration & Presales Standards**

* Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architecture, Project Management, and Commercial teams throughout the bid lifecycle, ensuring aligned scope, schedule, and cost assumptions.
* Maintain and continuously improve IBMS presales estimation templates, BOQ master libraries, and technical proposal boilerplate in line with evolving product platforms and market requirements.
* Conduct lessons-learned analysis on won and lost bids to refine estimation accuracy, technical positioning, and proposal quality.
* Support peer review and quality assurance of IBMS proposals prepared by other team members, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and compliance with Vertiv standards.
* Provide technical mentoring and knowledge transfer to junior presales engineers and sales staff on IBMS architecture concepts and estimation methodology.
* Interface with the Vertiv product management and engineering teams to stay current on controller platforms, new product introductions, and integration capabilities relevant to presales.

3. AUTHORITIES

The IBMS System Architecture Expert – Presales & Estimation holds the following delegated authorities within the presales and estimation function:

* Approve IBMS BOQ, cost estimates, and technical proposals prior to submission to the commercial review board, within authorized value limits.
* Define and confirm IBMS technical scope inclusions and exclusions in bid submissions without requiring individual engineering sign-off for standard scope items.
* Recommend go/no-go decisions on IBMS scope elements and flag technical red-flags to the Bid Manager or Lead Controls Engineer.
* Engage directly with clients, consultants, and specialist vendors during the bid phase for technical clarifications, pre-bid meetings, and scope discussions.
* Request vendor quotations for specialist IBMS equipment, software, and integration services to support estimation.
* Propose value engineering changes and alternative technical solutions during bid development, subject to review by the Lead Controls Engineer.
* Reject internally submitted estimation data or technical content that does not meet Vertiv quality standards or accuracy thresholds.

4. QUALIFICATIONS **4.1 Education**

* Dip OR bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation, Automation & Control, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Additional certifications in BMS/IBMS platforms are strongly preferred: Distech Controls, Niagara Framework / Tridium JACE, Honeywell, or Schneider Electric EcoStruxure.
* Training or certification in estimation methodology, technical proposal writing, or pre-sales engineering is a positive differentiator.
* Project management training (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent) is advantageous for managing complex bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.

**4.2 Experience**

* 5–7 years of progressive experience in IBMS/BMS controls engineering, with a minimum of 4 years in a presales, estimation, or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing IBMS BOQs, cost estimates, and technical proposals for mission-critical data center projects.
* Hands-on experience with BMS controller platforms — DDC/PLC platforms.
* Proven experience defining IBMS network architectures and communication integration strategies (BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP, OPC-UA, REST API).
* Experience engaging with clients, consultants, and specifiers in a presales or solution-advisory capacity for critical infrastructure projects.
* Familiarity with data center standards and design criteria: ASHRAE, TIA-942, IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, IS 3043, NBC 2016.
* Exposure to high-density cooling architectures (DLC, liquid cooling, CDUs) and AI data center workloads is highly advantageous.

**4.3 Technical Skills Matrix****Skill Area** **Proficiency Required**

**IBMS Subsystems**

Deep understanding of BMS, FACP, VESDA, WLD, Rodent Control, CCTV, Access Control, MDBs, and EPMS in critical data center facilities.

  

**Controller Platforms**

Proficiency in controller loading calculations, I/O mapping, and scan-time calculations for DDC/PLC systems.

  

**BOQ & Cost Estimation**

Ability to prepare detailed, accurate IBMS BOQs and cost estimation sheets including hardware, software, licensing, integration, and engineering effort.

  

**Network & Integration Architecture**

Proficiency in IBMS network topology design, protocol selection (BACnet/IP, Modbus, SNMP, OPC-UA), switch sizing, and third-party integration mapping (DCIM, SCADA, EPMS).

  

**Technical Proposal Writing**

Ability to produce clear, structured technical narratives, compliance matrices, scope-of-work documents, and value engineering proposals for complex bids.

  

**Standards & Codes**

Working knowledge of IEC 61850, EN 54, NFPA 72, ASHRAE, TIA-942, BS EN 62305, IS 3043, NBC 2016, and Vertiv internal standards (G-FI-PL-006).

  

**Thermal Management**

Knowledge of data center thermal management: CRAH/CRAC, chilled water plant, CDU/liquid cooling (DLC), and environmental monitoring in high-density environments.

  

**Software Tools**

MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Visio, Project), AutoCAD, estimation/CPQ tools, and documentation management platforms.

  

**SCADA / HMI / DCIM**

Familiarity with SCADA/HMI platforms for IBMS visualization, alarm management, and DCIM integration for data center monitoring.

**4.4 Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent written and verbal communication in English; ability to present complex IBMS architecture concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Commercial acumen: ability to balance technical quality with cost competitiveness and understand bid strategy and margin implications.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; able to decompose complex client requirements into definable, priceable scope elements.
* High attention to detail with the ability to maintain accuracy across large, multi-subsystem BOQs and complex technical proposals.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent bids under time pressure without compromising quality or accuracy.
* Collaborative team player with the confidence to challenge technical and commercial assumptions respectfully and constructively.
* Self-motivated with a quality-first mindset; proactive in identifying risks and gaps during the bid cycle.

5. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience working with the Vertiv InfraSol platform or similar critical infrastructure integrated solutions in a presales or solution architecture capacity.
* Familiarity with AI data center workloads — high-density liquid cooling (DLC/immersion), power distribution architecture, and intelligent environmental monitoring.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, demonstrating structured approach to managing bid timelines and multi-stakeholder reviews.
* Knowledge of ISA/IEC instrumentation standards and engineering flowchart conventions for controls systems architecture.
* Experience preparing parametric estimation models and CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) frameworks for repeatable IBMS bid packages.
* Demonstrated experience with multi-hyperscale or multi-colocation client environments — understanding of client template specifications and standard scope requirements.
* Familiarity with sustainability-driven IBMS features: energy monitoring, power analytics, PUE optimization, and ESG reporting integration for data centers.

6. PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

* Primarily office-based role with occasional site visits required for pre-bid surveys, client technical meetings, and solution demonstration events.
* Comfortable working in active data center environments during pre-bid site surveys: raised floors, live electrical equipment, and operational cooling infrastructure.
* Ability to work extended hours during peak bid periods, proposal submission deadlines, and multi-bid parallel cycles.
* Travel required: approximately 10–25% of working time, primarily domestic within India, with occasional international travel for major client engagements or vendor partner events.

* Prior consulting experience with a leading consulting firm at Associate level or equivalent, including strategy, operations, transformation, digital, or value-creation work. Alternatively MBA from a leading business school

title: Associate Specialist, Implementation
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Associate Specialist, Implementation
  
  
**Overview**

* In a customer-facing environment, take ownership of a cross-functional processing implementation project team of technical and non-technical electronic payment processing experts from both Mastercard and our customer
* Deliver standard through complex implementation activities ensuring quality and reliability of the implementations.
* Are you motivated to be a part of driving a world beyond cash?
* Have you good knowledge about electronic payment and related processes such as authorization, clearing and settlement?
* Are you able to cope with a fast changing and ambiguous environment?

Role
  
  

* Act as central point of contact for customers and/ or Mastercard customer representatives throughout processing implementation project end-to-end execution.
* Assess and document customer needs and according implementation impacts on customers’ and Mastercard’s core and non-core processing systems and platforms.
* Define scope, plan and drive customer processing implementation projects of new electronic payments processing business activities following the global project coordination methodology.
* Handle multiple customer processing implementation projects in parallel

**All About You**

* 1 to 2 years of experience in “Information Technology” system knowledge, with good understanding of network technology, applications, and project management.
* Basic knowledge of payment transaction processing and industry business knowledge
* Ability to interact well with the customer
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Desire to learn independently
* Ability to work in a matrixed organizations and cross functional teams
* Ability to manage change in a technical work environment
* Open to work for Night Shift – CST Timings (Non Negotiable)

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Global Business Process Analyst - Global Commercial
description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Global Business Process Analyst will drive the optimization, harmonization, and digital enablement of commercial processes across Sulzer’s three divisions Flow, Services and Chemtech.
  
  
This role supports strategic initiatives within the Sulzer 2028 Strategy, enabling agile, data-driven decision-making and scalable process improvements across global sales and commercial operations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead a newly established global function to optimise end‑to‑end commercial processes—spanning lead‑to‑order, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management—using LEAN and Six Sigma principles.
* Design and govern enterprise‑wide commercial process standards, facilitating workshops to define challenges, capture requirements, and map global “as‑is” and “to‑be” processes.
* Act as the strategic link between business and IT, partnering across Commercial Excellence, Finance, Operations, and IT to shape solutions, support Salesforce CRM/CPQ initiatives, and manage UAT and deployment.
* Strengthen global commercial systems and data governance, overseeing Salesforce CRM, CPQ, master data, and champion networks across all business units.
* Drive change, adoption, and governance by delivering training, documentation, and stakeholder engagement while promoting compliance, accountability, and ethical business practices.

Your Profile
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* 4–7 years of experience in business process analysis, preferably in B2B commercial environments
* Strong understanding of sales and service workflows across multiple business units
* Proficiency in process mapping and continuous improvement methodologies
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce, SAP SD, CPQ, and BI tools
* Any Salesforce Certification (Administration, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud or CPQ specialist) will be preferred.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in a global context
* Fluent in English; additional languages (e.g., German, French) are a plus

What we offer you
  
  

* Strategic role in shaping Sulzer’s global commercial transformation
* Exposure to diverse functions, cultures, and business units
* Opportunities for professional growth and innovation
* Competitive compensation and benefits

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.
  
  
We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

title: Cafe Partnerships Associate, Food and Beverage
description:
I am looking for a serial cafe hopper in Pune.

I run Blendonomics. We supply coffee beans, hot chocolate and beverage products to cafes across India. Pune is already one of our important markets, and I am spending time here to grow it: more cafes on board, and a strong distributor network across the city.

I need one person on the ground who loves cafes as much as I do.

This is not a target-pushing sales job. You will be the person Pune cafes know from Blendonomics. You visit cafes, run tastings, listen to owners and baristas, and help them decide if our products fit their menu. What you hear in the field comes straight to me and our head office team, and it shapes what we do next.

What you will do

• Visit cafes across Pune that have asked to try our products, and find new ones on your own beat.

• Run tastings and explain the product in clear, honest terms.

• Find out what works on a cafe's menu, what worries the owner, and what they need.

• Log every visit the same day and send a short field report every week.

• Follow up with cafes so they keep ordering because the product works for them.

• Work with me, our head office team and our distribution partners in Pune.

You must have

• Some experience in or with cafes, restaurants, hotels, catering, food delivery or food brands. Any role counts: barista, floor staff, kitchen, outlet operations, restaurant onboarding, food sales, food content, internships or part-time work.

• Good spoken and written English. Marathi and Hindi too.

• A two-wheeler and a valid licence, and you are happy to be on the road most days.

• You live in Pune.

• You are available full-time. This role does not suit students in regular day college.

What you get

• A core-team role. You work directly with me.

• Fixed pay based on your experience, fuel support, and earnings on every order from cafes you bring in.

• A trial period to start. If it works, a full-time role with a clear path to lead the Pune market.

• Hands-on training in the cafe business, our products and B2B sales.

How to apply

Apply on LinkedIn with your resume and answer the screening questions. My team calls shortlisted candidates first, then we meet for an interview.

title: Assistant Manager/Sr.Analyst – Cost Estimation, Pune Corporate Office
description:
**This is Pune based position, Client name is confidential**

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Cost Estimation & Pricing Specialist to join our finance and costing team (reporting to Head Finance). In this role, you will lead the end-to-end process from analyzing Customer Request for Quotes (RFQs) to delivering final pricing models. You will act as a strategic partner to management by driving make-vs-buy analyses, outside processing decisions, and capital investment evaluations.

The ideal candidate holds an ICWA / CMA qualification with 5 to 6 years of experience, preferably within the automotive industry, and also possesses knowledge in Activity-Based Costing (ABC).

**Key Responsibilities**

1. RFQ Analysis & Customer Pricing

* Deconstruct complex Customer RFQs to evaluate technical, commercial, and volume requirements.
* Develop accurate cost estimates for new products, engineering changes, and prototype developments.
* Build granular pricing models that incorporate material, labor, overheads, and target margins to present to commercial teams.
* Costing for Primary and secondary Plant
* Should have handled export-related businesses.

2. Strategic Cost Governance (Make vs. Buy)

* Evaluate Make/Buy/Outside Processing decisions by analyzing internal capacities, tooling costs, and external vendor capabilities.
* Collaborate with Supply Chain and Operations to identify cost-reduction opportunities through optimized sourcing and subcontracting.
* Assess Subcontractor / Outside Processing Vendor quotes to ensure transparency and cost competitiveness.

**3**
. Investment & Capital Expenditure (CapEx) Evaluation

* Conduct financial appraisals for investment decisions, including new machinery, tooling, and facility expansions.
* Calculate ROI, Payback Period, and Net Present Value (NPV) for proposed projects to guide management approvals.
* Track post-investment performance to ensure projected cost savings or capacities are realized.

4. Advanced Cost Accounting (Activity-Based Costing)

* Design and maintain Activity-Based Costing (ABC) models to accurately allocate overheads across diverse product lines.
* Analyze cost drivers to eliminate non-value-added expenses and improve product-level profitability.

Perform regular variance analyses (Standard vs. Actual costs) and implement corrective actions.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Professional Qualification: ICWA / CMA
* Experience: 5–6 years of core industrial costing experience, with a strong preference for the automotive domain (Tier-1 or OEM).
* Technical Costing: Strong command over Activity-Based Costing (ABC), standard costing, and marginal costing principles.
* Tools: Proficiency in ERP systems (Oracle, or similar) and advanced MS Excel (financial modelling, macros).

**Key Competencies:**

* Deep understanding of manufacturing processes (e.g., machining, stamping, casting, assembly) and their associated cost structures.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills to work alongside Engineering, Procurement, and Sales teams.
* Sharp analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.

Reporting would be to Director - Finance

**Job Description**
**Job Description: Senior Specialist – US / UK Accounts Receivable & Collections**

* Department: Finance & Operations Governance
* Experience Level: 8–10 Years (B2B Global/US Collections Focus)
* Reporting To: Finance Head
* Location: Pune, India
* Work Schedule: US Business Hours (Aligning with US Client Time Zones)
* Employment Type: Full-Time
* Executive Summary & Purpose

The
**Senior Specialist – US Accounts Receivable & Collections**
is directly responsible for safeguarding Indovance’s working capital by managing the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) loop for our US engineering and CAD/BIM services portfolio.
  
  
This is an strategic, outcome-oriented role focused on systematically reducing Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), driving past-due balance recoveries (30–120+ days), enforcing contract payment terms, and rapidly resolving billing or milestone disputes. Acting as the primary commercial bridge between US client Accounts Payable (AP) departments and internal Indovance stakeholders (Billing, Sales, Project Delivery), the candidate will implement clear, quantitative collection guardrails to optimize cash conversion and eliminate financial leakage.
  
  

* Key Operational & Strategic Responsibilities
* US Customer Collections & Cash Conversion Management
* Portfolio Ownership: Independently drive collections for assigned US engineering, architectural, and structural client accounts.
* Active Engagement: Maintain direct, structured communication via phone calls and formal written correspondence with customer AP teams, Controllers, and Procurement Leads to lock in payment dates and remittance details.
* Behavioral Tracking: Monitor historical payment cycles and customer settlement behaviors to proactively flag accounts with impending overdue risks.
* Systematic Cadence: Establish clear, automated follow-up rhythms for pre-due invoice acknowledgments, payment approvals, and scheduled remittance verification.
* Aged Receivables Recovery & Risk Governance
* Ageing Analysis & Prioritization: Continuously audit AR ageing schedules (30, 60, 90, and 120+ days) to prioritize intervention based on exposure value and collection probability.
* Targeted Recovery Plans: Design and execute account-specific recovery strategies for high-value delinquent balances and broken payment promises.
* Bad Debt Mitigation: Identify bad debt risks early; prepare structured escalation dossiers for executive leadership and enforce commercial pause/hold triggers on deliverable releases in accordance with corporate policy.
* Audit & Reporting: Maintain real-time collection notes and weekly AR risk registers detailing committed cash flows, pending collection hurdles, and probability-weighted recoveries.
* Dispute Resolution & Cross-Functional Alignment
* Root-Cause Analysis: Investigate overdue balances resulting from missing Purchase Orders (POs), scope deviations, short payments, tax deductions, or incorrect invoice routing.
* Internal Coordination: Work closely with Indovance Delivery Leads, Project Managers, and Billing Specialists to validate timesheets, project milestone completions, and change orders.
* Deduction & Credit Management: Reconcile short payments, credit notes, and unapplied cash balances to ensure accurate customer ledger positions.
* Process Feedback Loop: Identify recurring billing errors or customer approval bottlenecks and provide actionable feedback to upstream billing and contracting teams.
* Billing System & Customer Portal Integration
* Portal Management: Navigate customer AP platforms (e.g., Coupa, Ariba, Bill.com) to track invoice submission approvals, payment batches, and approval routing.
* ERP Precision: Ensure accurate, daily recordkeeping of remittance receipts, payment applications, and communication histories in enterprise accounting systems (e.g., Zoho Books, NetSuite).
* Compliance & Governance: Align all client outreach with US commercial payment practices and Indovance’s internal governance standards.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Target Metrics

**Performance Metric**
**Objective / Target Standard**
**Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)**
Achieve and maintain account portfolio DSO within targets.
  
  
**Overdue Reduction (>60/90 Days)**
Reduce >60-day past-due balance to < 5% of total portfolio exposure.
  
  
**Collection Efficiency Index (CEI)**
Achieve >90% cash collection target on total current receivables monthly.
  
  
**Dispute Resolution SLA**
Identify, assign, and resolve invoice discrepancies within 5 business days.
