title: Senior Executive - Accounts Receivable & Payable
description:
**About Position:**

We are seeking a Senior Executive - Accounts Receivable & Payable (AR/AP) with 5-8 years of experience to manage end-to-end receivables and payables operations while ensuring financial accuracy, process compliance, and timely execution of transactions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in customer invoicing, vendor payments, collections, reconciliations, financial reporting, and ERP systems. This role requires close collaboration with customers, vendors, project teams, procurement, and finance stakeholders to support efficient financial operations and maintain strong accounting controls.

* **Role: Senior Executive - Accounts Receivable & Payable**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 5 to 8 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

* Prepare, validate, and process customer invoices in accordance with contractual terms and billing schedules.
* Ensure accurate billing for Time & Material (T&M), Fixed Price, Managed Services, and milestone-based engagements.
* Monitor customer receivables and proactively follow up on outstanding payments and overdue invoices.
* Track AR ageing reports and coordinate resolution of disputed or delayed customer payments.
* Perform customer account reconciliations and investigate billing discrepancies.
* Record customer payments and support cash application activities.
* Maintain billing trackers, collection reports, receivable dashboards, and AR records.
* Review, validate, and process vendor invoices against purchase orders, contracts, and approval workflows.
* Coordinate with procurement and business teams to resolve invoice discrepancies and payment-related issues.
* Process vendor payments in accordance with payment terms, company policies, and compliance requirements.
* Perform vendor account reconciliations and review supplier statements.
* Monitor outstanding AP transactions and ensure timely processing and closure of invoices.
* Support employee reimbursement and expense claim processing activities.
* Perform periodic reconciliation of Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, and General Ledger accounts.
* Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies, unmatched transactions, and reconciliation variances.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing activities.
* Maintain financial records, transaction documentation, and audit-ready supporting documents.
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, approval matrices, and financial procedures.
* Prepare AR/AP MIS reports, ageing reports, reconciliation reports, payment trackers, and management dashboards.
* Collaborate with customers, vendors, finance teams, procurement teams, and business stakeholders to resolve operational issues.
* Support process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, and control effectiveness.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

* 5 to 8 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, or Shared Services environments.
* Strong understanding of customer invoicing, vendor invoicing, collections, payment processing, and reconciliation activities.
* Hands-on experience managing AR ageing, collections follow-up, vendor payments, and account reconciliation processes.
* Working knowledge of General Ledger accounting and core accounting principles.
* Experience supporting month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial closing activities.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, reconciliation activities, and financial reporting.
* Experience working with ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar financial systems.
* Strong understanding of financial controls, accounting compliance requirements, and audit processes.
* Experience maintaining accounting records, documentation, and audit support files.
* Ability to analyze financial data, identify discrepancies, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Experience preparing ageing reports, payment reports, reconciliation statements, and management summaries.
* Ability to independently coordinate with customers, vendors, procurement teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Good organizational and time-management abilities with the capability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to work effectively in a deadline-driven environment while maintaining high levels of accuracy.
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

title: FinOps Manager - AP, Accounts Payable Operations team
description:
**Description**
FinOps Manager – Accounts Payable
  
  
Amazon Financial Operations | Level 5 | Full-Time | US Shift
  
  
Every payment Amazon makes to a supplier starts with a promise - and the Accounts Payable Operations team is the engine that keeps that promise, at massive scale, across dozens of subsidiaries and global marketplaces. As a FinOps Manager – AP, you’ll lead a core US-shift team responsible for the full invoice lifecycle - from ingestion through successful payment execution - ensuring that tens of thousands of vendors worldwide are paid accurately and on time.
  
  
This is a high-visibility leadership role at the intersection of operational excellence and financial transformation. You’ll own the transition of multiple subsidiary AP processes into a centralized operating model, build the playbooks that scale our operations for Amazon’s continued expansion, and drive automation initiatives that directly reduce manual touchpoints and cost-per-transaction. If you’re energized by building teams, simplifying complexity, and delivering measurable outcomes in a fast-moving environment - this role was made for you.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The FinOps Manager – Accounts Payable will lead a team supporting core US-shift AP operations and play a critical role in ensuring financial operations are scalable, efficient, and prepared for continued business growth.
  
  
The role will have end-to-end ownership of the Accounts Payable process, from invoice ingestion through invoice processing, exception/hold resolution, and successful payment execution. The manager will work closely with upstream and downstream teams across Finance, Procurement, Technology, and business functions to ensure timely and accurate processing and payments.
  
  
The role will also be responsible for transitioning and stabilizing AP processes for multiple subsidiaries. This includes building and developing high-performing teams, managing operational performance, establishing priorities, driving process improvements, and ensuring compliance with global policies, controls, and service-level commitments.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a strong people leader and operational owner with a passion for process innovation, automation, controllership, and customer/vendor experience. The candidate should be comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and independently solving complex and ambiguous business problems.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 10+ years of post-qualification experience in Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, Shared Services, or a related field.
* 5+ years of project management and people management experience, including experience leading cross-functional initiatives with technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong understanding of Accounts Payable operations and end-to-end financial processes.
* Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale operations, transitions, and process changes.
* Strong customer focus with experience managing internal and external stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently and make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Results-oriented mindset with a demonstrated ability to delive

r against challenging goals.
  
  

* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability and willingness to work in flexible/night shifts, weekends, and holidays based on business requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience driving continuous improvement initiatives that improved controllership, operational efficiency, or scalability with measurable results.
* 4+ years of experience identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, performing root-cause analysis, and developing and implementing escalation/corrective-action plans.
* 4+ years of experience mentoring and developing junior finance, operations, or business team members.
* Experience managing global or multi-geography Accounts Payable operations.
* Experience with process transitions, migrations, or integration of new subsidiaries.
* Experience working with automation, workflow, self-service, or finance technology solutions.
* Experience developing operational metrics and using data to drive business decisions.

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, manage, and develop a team of AP Specialists and Operations Managers supporting end-to-end Accounts Payable operations.
* Own day-to-day operational performance and ensure accuracy, timeliness, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.
* Successfully lead the transition of multiple subsidiary AP processes into the operations team, ensuring smooth migration, stabilization, and business continuity.
* Manage hiring, onboarding, training, coaching, performance management, and career development for team members.
* Establish team priorities, allocate workload effectively, and ensure appropriate resource planning based on business requirements and volume forecasts.
* Drive systems, process, and operational improvements to enable on-time and accurate vendor payments.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes through automation, standardization, and self-service solutions.
* Own and drive adherence to AP policies, procedures, and controls while ensuring consistency across global entities.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex vendor, customer, payment, invoice, and operational issues, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate stakeholder communication.
* Proactively identify recurring issues, analyze service trends, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Develop, maintain, and monitor operational metrics and dashboards covering SLA performance, payment timeliness, productivity, quality, defects, backlog, cost, and customer/vendor experience.
* Drive cost optimization initiatives and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
* Partner with Finance leadership to forecast future headcount requirements based on business growth, transaction volumes, country expansion, and operational demand.
* Expand self-service capabilities and digital solutions to improve the vendor experience while reducing manual intervention.
* Provide regular weekly and monthly business reviews, performance updates, and operational insights to Director- and VP-level Finance stakeholders.
* Develop, implement, and maintain effective internal controls across AP processes.
* Partner with Internal Audit, controllership, compliance, and finance teams to address control gaps and audit requirements.
* Lead cross-functional technology, systems, and process-improvement initiatives involving Finance, Procurement, Operations, and technical teams.
* Work effectively with stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, including support for US business hours, flexible/night shifts, weekends, and holidays based on business requirements.
* Ensure operational readiness for new business launches, subsidiary transitions, process changes, and organizational growth.

How you’ll spend your time: Expect roughly 40% leading and coaching your team, 25% on cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication, 20% on process improvement and automation projects, and 15% on deep-focus analysis (metrics, controls, forecasting).
  
  
People Leadership
  
  
The manager will be responsible for building and maintaining a high-performing AP organization by:
  
  

* Hiring and developing strong finance and operations talent.
* Establishing clear performance expectations and measurable goals.
* Conducting regular performance reviews and providing actionable feedback.
* Identifying development opportunities and creating career progression plans for team members.
* Coaching employees to improve operational, analytical, and leadership capabilities.
* Building a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, customer obsession, and operational excellence.

Process & Operational Excellence
  
  

* The role requires a strong focus on continuously improving AP operations by:
* Identifying process gaps, inefficiencies, and recurring defects.
* Performing root-cause analysis and implementing sustainable solutions.
* Standardizing processes across subsidiaries and geographies.
* Reducing manual effort through automation and self-service.
* Improving payment accuracy and timeliness.
* Driving measurable improvements in productivity, cost, quality, and customer/vendor experience.
* Establishing mechanisms to monitor and prevent negative service trends.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* The candidate will work extensively with Finance, Procurement, Controllership, Internal Audit, Technology, Operations, and external vendors across multiple geographies.
* The role requires the ability to communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, influence decisions, manage escalations, and drive cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.

A day in the life
  
  
What This Role Offers You
  
  
You’ll have a front-row seat to Amazon’s financial infrastructure at global scale - leading a team that directly impacts supplier relationships, cash management, and controllership across every marketplace Amazon operates in. This is not a maintain-the-status-quo role: you’ll build new operating models, drive automation, and shape the future of how Amazon pays its partners.
  
  
Key Performance Areas
  
  
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through**

* Operational Excellence – Accuracy, productivity, quality, and SLA adherence.

ii. Payment Performance – Timely and accurate vendor payments.
  
  
iii. People Leadership – Team engagement, performance, retention, and career development.
  
  
iv. Process Improvement – Automation, standardization, and measurable efficiency gains.
  
  

* Customer/Vendor Experience – Effective resolution of issues and improvement in service levels.

vi. Controllership & Compliance – Strong internal controls and audit readiness.
  
  
vii. Cost Optimization – Productivity improvements and effective resource utilization.
  
  
viii. Business Growth & Scalability – Readiness to support new subsidiaries, geographies, volumes, and business requirements.
  
  
**About The Team**
About the Team
  
  
Accounts Payable Operations supports multiple geographies and marketplaces globally and provides critical financial services across the organization.
  
  
**The Team Is Responsible For**

* Manual and automated invoice processing.
* Invoice ingestion and validation.
* Resolution of invoice holds and exceptions.
* Ensuring timely and accurate supplier payments.
* Vendor account setup and maintenance.
* Responding to supplier and business partner queries.
* Supporting subsidiary transitions and process migrations.
* Driving automation and process improvements across AP operations.

The team operates in a highly dynamic environment and partners with multiple global stakeholders to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely payments to suppliers while continuously improving the overall vendor experience.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of Accounts Payable (AP) experience
* 4+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 4+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
* 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
* 3+ years of directly managing and leading a team of 3+ members experience
* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience, or a PMP and 5+ years of team management experience
* Experience in a customer-focused field or business
* Experience working proactively and independently, meeting deadlines, and delivering on projects and tasks
* Experience in problem solving and delivering results
* Experience in oral and written communication
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Master's/Bachelor's degree with 10+ years of post-qualification experience in Shared Services, Accounts Payable
* Candidate is expected to collaborate with multiple geographies including US and work in flexible shifts/ night hours and during holidays/weekends based on business requirement

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
* 4+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
* 4+ years of mentoring junior finance and/or business team members experience
* 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience

title: Junior Cash Application Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**
Execute day to day cash posting activities within the Order to Cash process under close guidance. Post customer payments against open items, match remittances, clear suspense/on account items, and support bank reconciliations and month end tasks. Maintain high data accuracy, follow Versigent controls and work instructions, and collaborate with Collections/Credit and Treasury to ensure timely, compliant, and high quality cash application service.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Cash Posting & Clearing
* Post daily incoming cash to customer accounts (bank statements, lockbox, SEPA/ACH, wire, checks).
* Match remittances and reference data (payer, invoice, amount, discounts, short pays); clear unapplied/on account items per SOP.
* Escalate missing/incomplete remittance info; support invoice level research with Collections/Credit.
* Support month end close activities (cut offs, checklists, reconciliations).
* Controls, Documentation & Compliance
* Follow documented work instructions/SOPs, segregation of duties, and basic control checks.
* Maintain accurate posting records and audit trail; file supporting evidence (SharePoint/Workflow).
* Support internal/external audit requests.
* Stakeholder Collaboration
* Communicate proactively with Collections, Credit, Billing, Treasury and local finance to resolve mismatches and missing data.
* Provide timely status updates and respond to inquiries professionally.
* Continuous Improvement
* Identify minor issues (e.g., recurring remittance gaps) and propose simple fixes.
* Update checklists and suggest SOP clarifications.

**Education & Experience**
**Basic Requirements (R – required, P – preferred)**

* Education in Finance/Accounting/Economics or related (P).
* At least 1 year in AR/OTC/cash application or accounting operations (P).
* Technical Skills
* Basic understanding of AR and OTC cash flow (R).
* MS Excel (lookups, filters, pivots basic) (R).
* Exposure to SAP/major ERP and bank portals (P).
* Ability to read bank statements and remittance advices (R).

**Soft Skills**

* English (written/spoken) at working proficiency (R).
* High attention to detail, numerical accuracy (R).
* Good organization, time management, ability to meet daily cut‑offs (R).
* Teamwork, willingness to learn, positive and proactive attitude (R).
* Flexibility to support shift coverage when needed (P).

title: Vendor Management Office (VMO) Lead
description:
**Entity**
Technology
  
  
**Job Family Group**
Business Support Group
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Description
  
  
GBS plays a crucial role as a transformation partner to the Group, particularly as the organization changes directions to an IEC and seeks opportunities to streamline, becoming more effective and efficient to deliver the strategy. The Business Enablement and Advisory team (BE&A), part of the Digital Solutions and Transformation team within GBS, partners closely with the business and Group Functions to support their transformation goals. This includes a diverse range of value levers such as location optimization, digitization, automation, process streamlining, analytics and insights, third-party cost, and operating model. One growing area of opportunity is reducing third-party costs through the use of the Vendor Management Office (VMO).
  
  
The VMO is a centralized contractor acquisition and management team that partners with business entities to enable cost savings through a streamlined vendor strategy. It provides end-to-end support for the third-party lifecycle, introducing visibility and consistency for all non-employee labour spend. Additionally, the VMO's management of vendor portfolios and internal resource utilization allows hiring managers and workstream leads to focus on strategic work rather than resource management. This VMO Team Lead role is an important enabler to the ambition of expanding the VMO offering across all businesses and functions in the organisation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* The role will involve a blend of operational duties and project-based tasks. Responsibilities include assisting in the day-to-day operational management of current processes (see Key Accountabilities), supporting cost efficiency initiatives and ensuring high-quality service delivery.
* The VMO Lead will handle entity specific demand (P&O, Technology, Finance etc) and scope, being responsible for the lifecycle management of at least 10,000 non-employee labour.
* The role will also be a key enabler in supporting the reduction of 3d party costs.
* The VMO Lead will handle new demand and emerging scope from the respective entity necessitating program management. Supported by the VMO Manager this will involve consolidating existing demands, leading partnerships for the new scope, and allocating resources accordingly before implementing full lifecycle management.
* Given the multiple concurrent initiatives seeking to demonstrate the VMO, it is important to ensure close program management and delivery within timelines and budget.

**Key Skills**
Domain – Procurement and Sourcing Technology – SAP (Ariba, SRM, ERP MM, SAP S/4 HANA, Fieldglass), Integration with other non-SAP P2P systems. Methodologies – PMP and/or Agile Participant management – partnering and influencing across a diverse collaborator group
  
  
Key accountabilities
  
  
The VMO Lead will oversee demand management, vendor relationships, Commercial optimization and end-to-end third- party lifecycle support for a defined vendor pool and business unit. The typical lifecycle accountabilities would entail third-party worker triage and demand management, on/off-boarding, end-to-end lifecycle tracking, fulfilment channels, and reporting and analytics. The VMO's responsibility for end-to-end CW/SOW management requires close coordination and collaboration with vendors, procurement/sourcing teams, hiring managers, and workstream leads to facilitate demand closure and subsequent lifecycle management.
  
  
Triage
  
  

* Requirement gathering and strategic fulfilment.
* Basic screening and selection support.
* Spend and headcount visibility.

On/Off Boarding
  
  

* NTID creation / deactivation.
* Asset allocation / return.

**End-to-End lifecycle tracking.**

* Administrative support.
* Monthly reconciliations.

Fulfillment Channels
  
  

* Coordination with Vendors, Sourcing & Procurement.
* Monthly accruals and spend reconciliation.

**Analytics And Reporting**

* Analytics across vendors, regions, skillset.
* Demand Status Tracking with predictive fulfillment.

Additionally, the role will require ownership of cost efficiency initiatives on behalf of the corresponding entity. This means partnering with stakeholders to support the identification and implementation of opportunities for cost savings through vendor negotiations and optimizing third-party costs (e.g., rate cards, vendor margins, worker locations, vendor rationalization, etc.). This will also mean a requirement for cross-functional coordination across Procurement, Finance, Technology, Legal, and other teams to support agreed actions on vendor management strategies
  
  
The role will require close engagement with a diverse stakeholder group to align vendor strategies, cost targets, and priorities. Establish appropriate governance and providing regular updates, analytics, and performance reporting to senior managers (typically VP and above).
  
  
The VMO Lead will manage a small team (typically up to 10) that is aligned to a specific business of function entity, supporting the respective entity scope such as demand management, cost reduction, vendor relationships, and end-to-end third-party lifecycle support.
  
  
The VMO Lead will also support efforts to educate internal teams on vendor management best practices, policies, and procedures, fostering a culture of effective vendor relationship management across the organization.
  
  
**Essential Education**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Economics, or related field

**Essential Experience And Job Requirements**

* Overall 7+ years of experence with Minimum of 5years of experience in business/digital transformation, business analysis, or operations support, with a focus on Source to Pay processes.
* Proven experience in supporting transformational change across multi-disciplined, global teams.
* Exposure to or experience in project management, SAP Procurement technology, and procurement domain expertise.
* Strong emphasis on internal and external stakeholder engagement at all organizational levels within large multinational corporations.
* Familiarity with and experience in Agile methodology.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
* Solid experience in project coordination and administration activities, coupled with strong problem-solving skills, effective communication, and interpersonal skills
* Good to have resource hiring experience for contractors and employees
* Proficient in data analytics, with the ability to analyze, interpret, and present data to support strategic decision-makings

Desirable criteria
  
  

* Desirable: Industry certifications around project management (ICP Agile/PMP), technology SAP (MM, SRM, Ariba, Fieldglass) and domain (CSCP, CPIM etc.)
* Track record of driving efficiencies through effective vendor and contractor management.

Additional information
  
  
**Key Challenges**

* Complex organisation with highly diversified range of stakeholders across the business and GBS (the role requires the incumbent to build trusting relationships with key business stakeholders)
* Managing multiple concurrent initiatives and engagements, competing priorities
* Managing engagements across different functions and geographies
* Complex systems landscape

title: Co-Lead – Emerging Technologies
description: Job Description: Co-Lead – Emerging Technologies Role: Co-Lead (Emerging Technologies) Mapped Domain: Enterprise Solutions with AI/ML Reporting to: Vice President / Head of Vertical, NeGD, Digital India Corporation Location: New Delhi, India About the Role We are actively seeking an exceptional technologist and strategic evangelist to serve as Co-Lead – Emerging Technologies at NeGD. This position acts as the institutional anchor for ideating, prototyping, scaling, and operationalizing Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions across public governance, while integrating complementary emerging disciplines such as Blockchain, Internet of Things (IoT), and Drones/GIS. The Co-Lead will advise Central Line Ministries and State Governments on the entire lifecycle of AI/ML interventions—ranging from problem statement framing and model validation to ethical AI guardrails and production-grade integration with core digital platforms. Furthermore, the incumbent will head Business Development for the emerging tech vertical—engaging user ministries (such as Agriculture, Health, Education, Revenue, and Urban Development), creating scalable pilot concepts, securing project funding/sanctions, and building productive partnerships with deep-tech startups, industry accelerators, and premier research institutions. Roles & Responsibilities •AI/ML Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Lead the technical conceptualization, design, and pilot development of state-of-the-art AI/ML and Generative AI applications for governance (e.g., automated document processing, computer vision for scheme monitoring, predictive citizen service delivery, and NLP/conversational interfaces). •Cross-Disciplinary Emerging Tech Integration: Evaluate and architect end-to-end solutions incorporating complementary emerging technologies: oBlockchain: For tamper-proof public registries, credential issuance, and land/supply chain traceability. oInternet of Things (IoT): For smart sensors, environmental monitoring, smart meters, and public utility optimization. oDrones, Aerial & GIS Tech: For spatial mapping, agricultural crop assessment, infrastructure surveying, and disaster management. •Business Development & Project Sanctions: Actively engage with Central Ministries and State Line Departments to assess digital bottlenecks, author concept notes, present high-impact use case demonstrations, and secure client buy-in and project funding for emerging tech deployments. •Ethical AI & Responsible Tech Frameworks: Define guidelines for ethical AI, algorithmic transparency, bias mitigation, explainability, and data security in public decision systems. •Procurement Toolkit & Innovation Challenges: Develop Model RFPs, Technical Evaluation Frameworks, and outcome-based SLAs for procuring deep-tech, AI/ML, and IoT systems. Organize national Hackathons, Grand Challenges, and Sandboxes in partnership with startups and incubators. •Technical Appraisal & Advisory: Appraise AI/ML DPRs submitted by states, evaluating training dataset viability, compute requirements, algorithmic soundness, and deployment architectures. •Capacity Building & Knowledge Dissemination: Curate executive masterclasses, developer workshops, and practical AI toolkits for government officers, State e-Governance Mission Teams, and technical staff. •Ecosystem Partnerships: Work in deep synergy with IndiaAI, Bhashini, MeitY Startup Hub (MSH), academic institutions (IITs/IIITs), and leading industry consortia. Eligibility Criteria •Educational Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech / M.Sc / MCA / MBA / Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or related Software technical fields. •Total Work Experience: Minimum 8+ years of professional experience in technology development, data science, and IT project implementation. •Specialized Experience: oAt least 4 years of specialized experience in designing, building, and deploying production-grade AI / Machine Learning solutions through their full lifecycle. oDemonstrated hands-on familiarity with modern ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), NLP/LLM fine-tuning, computer vision, and API-based model serving. oDemonstrated working comprehension and project experience interfacing AI with adjacent frontier technologies (Blockchain, IoT, Drone/GIS systems). oProven track record in Business Development, use case commercialization, tech advocacy, or client solution consulting in public or enterprise domains. •Desired Certifications: Professional AI/ML certifications (Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty, or equivalent). Skills & Attributes •Deep technical expertise across algorithms, neural network architectures, edge deployment, and cloud-based AI infrastructure. •Strong entrepreneurial mindset with proven capability to originate new business opportunities, engage ministerial clients, and communicate complex tech concepts to non-technical stakeholders. •Familiarity with public procurement policies, RFP evaluation criteria, and government contracting guidelines. •Strong published research, white paper authorship, or recognized open-source contributions are highly desirable. •Agile project management skills with ability to lead high-performing, technical cross-functional teams.

•

Preferred, not mandatory – CISSP, CISM, CEH, CCSP or an equivalent cloud security

title: Senior Energy Market Consultant - Power
description:
**Description**
ICF is seeking a talented consultant to support our growing team and client base in the area of power markets advisory consulting. Professionals with 5 years of experience in US power market analysis/forecasting/economics are ideal candidates for the role.
  
  
As a Senior Energy Consultant, you will be responsible for leading a team of analysts to develop and defend power price forecasts, power plant proformas and financial projections using grid software models (e.g. PROMOD, PSLF, TARA etc.), issuing detailed market reports, growing our business with new and existing clients, mentoring and developing junior staff, and contributing to ICF’s thought leadership and competitive positioning in the market.
  
  
In this practice area, ICF’s typical client base includes owners and developers of power plants, banks and investors, and occasionally government entities and other stakeholders. We advise on asset transactions, support siting and financing of new power plants, and provide expert testimony in litigation cases among other work. Great managers at ICF are both analytically sharp and great communicators and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative work environment.
  
  
ICF’s practice covers all major market areas in the US, including ERCOT, PJM, ISO-NE, NYISO, MISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, and SERC, with specialized teams serving each region.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead a dedicated team of analysts to perform detailed energy market modelling and long-term forecasting efforts for market prices, plant/grid operations, and plant economics
* Manage multiple projects with overlapping timelines while ensuring excellent quality, consistency, and client support
* Review and provide direct feedback to the team on quantitative modeling approaches and results
* Communicate effectively with a diverse client base as a subject-matter expert in US wholesale power markets
* Grow ICF’s business by leading interactions with potential clients and developing proposals
* Mentor and develop junior staff as well as collaborate with ICF senior management on key business decisions

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative-focused field. Candidates majoring in other fields must clearly demonstrate equivalent quantitative aptitude
* 5+ years of work experience in North American electric power sector, including market analysis, Power Flow studies and forecasting
* Experience with a minimum of one of the following: ERCOT, PJM, ISONE, NYISO, MISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, and SERC
* Deep familiarity with market modeling approaches and tools (e.g. PROMOD, PSLF, etc.)
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong capabilities in Microsoft Office
* Experience independently conducting and supervising technical analysis

**Preferred Skills:**

* Master’s degree in any of the aforementioned fields or closely related areas
* Consulting background preferred. However, other experience with financial analysis, asset valuation, or power plant development is a plus
* Business development and managerial experience

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

title: Pod Lead, Delivery Architect
description:
**What Amphare is**

Amphare Technologies builds governed, AI-native software delivery. The method is atomikd: scope is decomposed into machine-checkable units, each with a contract and an evidence grade, scheduled in waves and shipped inside a release envelope. The kernel is AmphSE: it sits above the coding agents and enforces the gates. The instrument is CodeSentinel: it reads the code and grades the evidence. The map is RepoGraph: the code graph every atom is planned against. The proof is a services pod that delivers real client software with all three and feeds what it learns back into the product.

The hybrid is deliberate. Service work funds the product and tests it against reality. The product makes the service faster, and lets us show a client exactly what was built, how it was verified, and by whom. Showing the client that is the business.

**Why this role exists**

Someone has to hold the whole project: the client's actual problem, the architecture that answers it, the estimate the business signed, the waves that get it built, and the evidence that proves it shipped. In a traditional firm that is a project manager, an architect, a scrum master and a BA, plus a steering committee. Here it is you, with three strong colleagues and a kernel that enforces the gates you set. You are the person a client trusts because you can draw the system on one page and defend every box. You are the person the pod trusts because when the critical path is blocked, you open the editor.

**What you own**

* The engagement. One at a time for the first pod. From sales handover to acceptance: scope, commercial envelope (what the fixed price can absorb), risk, client relationship, and the decision to say no when the evidence says no. Pricing new work and signing contracts stay with the founder.
* Solution shape. Architecture, stack choice for the client's constraints (we are stack-agnostic by principle), integration boundaries, non-functional requirements, and the trade-offs written down where the client can read them. You are accountable for the user experience too; specialist design is engaged per engagement from outside the pod.
* The Epic Map and the estimate. Decomposition to the level where effort can be measured and compared with what we actually spent. Your estimates are checked against outcomes every wave. Wave scheduling and the release envelope. What ships, in what order, with what dependencies, under what gate. Short, written, evidence-first.
* Pod governance. The gates agents and humans pass through, the evidence grades we accept, the retros that change the method. "AI proposes, humans approve" is a rule you enforce, including on yourself.
* The pod itself. Growing the three people beside you, and writing down how this pod works so the next pod can copy it.

**Who we are looking for**

* You have shipped production software as an engineer and later run delivery for teams larger than this pod, and you know what that cost.
* You have personally fixed a bad estimate, in front of a client, with numbers rather than apologies.
* You can draw a system on one page and answer "why not the obvious alternative" for every component.
* You have read code an agent wrote for you closely enough to send it back. More than once.
* You have written requirements, test plans and release notes yourself because nobody else was going to, and they were good.
* You can name a ceremony you removed from a team and what you replaced it with.
* You are commercially literate: blended rates, margin, fixed-price risk, what a change request costs.

*Signals this is not your role*

* You manage through status meetings and feel exposed without a PMO.
* You last committed code three or more years ago and are comfortable with that.
* You believe "architect" means not touching the keyboard.
* You see AI coding tools as a productivity add-on for juniors.
* You cannot do your best work until scope is frozen.
* You prefer to be told the method rather than to improve it.

title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Overview of Role:
  
  
The AI Forward Deployed Engineer partners directly with business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities and convert them into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. The role combines strong software engineering, generative AI and machine learning capability with stakeholder-facing delivery. It owns the journey from discovery and rapid prototyping through enterprise integration, production deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
  
  
KPIs:
  
  

* Business Impact: Measured value delivered through AI solutions, including efficiency, quality, revenue, cost or risk outcomes.
* Time to Production: Speed and predictability in progressing priority use cases from discovery and proof of concept to production.
* Solution Quality and Reliability: Accuracy, relevance, latency, availability, scalability and operational stability of deployed solutions.
* Adoption and Stakeholder Satisfaction: Active usage, stakeholder feedback and successful integration into business workflows.
* Security and Governance: Adherence to data privacy, access control, responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.
* Reusability and Enablement: Reusable accelerators, reference implementations, documentation and knowledge transfer created for broader adoption.

Key Year One Deliverables:
  
  

* Opportunity and Current-State Assessment: Assess priority business opportunities, existing AI capabilities, data sources, platforms, integrations and delivery constraints.
* Stakeholder Needs Analysis: Define business objectives, user needs, success measures, adoption barriers and technical requirements with key stakeholders.
* Prioritized Delivery Roadmap: Create and maintain a roadmap based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk and resource needs.
* Prototypes and Proofs of Concept: Develop rapid prototypes to validate technical feasibility, user value and solution direction.
* Production AI Solutions: Build, deploy and operationalize selected AI solutions with appropriate security, scalability, reliability and support readiness.
* Enterprise Integration: Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, identity systems, APIs, data sources and operational workflows.
* Evaluation and Observability: Establish evaluation, error-analysis, logging, metrics, tracing, usage and cost-monitoring mechanisms.
* Documentation and Enablement: Deliver architecture documentation, runbooks, reusable patterns, training and knowledge transfer for users and support teams.

Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Data Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience developing software, machine learning or generative AI solutions through internships, academic projects or professional environments; production deployment experience is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience and Skills:
  
  

* Software Engineering: Strong Python programming; backend and API development using FastAPI, Flask REST or equivalent; REST APIs, SQL, relational databases, Git, testing, debugging and code review.
* Generative AI and Context Engineering: Large language models, prompt and context engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, tool/function calling, memory, agent orchestration and evaluation.
* Machine Learning: ML and deep-learning fundamentals, natural language processing, model evaluation, data preprocessing and experience with PyTorch and/or TensorFlow.
* Production Engineering: Containerization, CI/CD, cloud or on-premises deployment, observability, performance tuning, scalability, resilience and production troubleshooting. Familiarity with multi-model architectures, AI gateways, model routing, token and cost management, and model selection is preferred.
* Data and Integration: Data pipelines, enterprise application integration, identity and access management, secure configuration and interoperability across systems.
* AI Quality and Governance: Evaluation frameworks, error analysis, guardrails, responsible AI, data privacy, security, access control, lifecycle management and usage/cost monitoring.
* Forward Deployed Delivery: Stakeholder discovery, problem decomposition, rapid prototyping, ambiguity management, end-to-end ownership, documentation and knowledge transfer.
* Good to Have: Microsoft Azure and Azure OpenAI; LangGraph, LangChain or comparable frameworks; Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector or FAISS; Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and Redis; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana; LiteLLM or comparable AI gateways.

Key Behaviors:
  
  

* Customer and Business Focus: Builds trusted stakeholder relationships and keeps solutions anchored to measurable user and business outcomes.
* Ownership: Takes responsibility from discovery through production stabilization, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Problem Solving: Uses structured analysis and hands-on troubleshooting across application, model, data, integration and infrastructure layers.
* Agility and Adaptability: Works effectively with ambiguity, changing priorities and evolving AI technologies.
* Collaboration and Communication: Explains complex topics clearly and works effectively across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security and business teams.
* Continuous Learning: Actively evaluates new approaches while applying sound engineering judgment, governance and evidence-based decision-making.
* Attention to Detail: Maintains high standards for quality, security, documentation and operational readiness.

Reporting Structure:
  
  
This role reports to the Innovation department lead.
  
  
Visteon Culture
  
  
If you thrive in a fast-paced organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability and a growth mindset to stay ahead of the curve, Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking and continuous learning help us keep pace with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and remain market leaders. At Visteon, you can be more.

title: Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses
description:
**Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses**

**Brainware University seeks an analytical and resourceful professional to lead a team of bright young AI researchers to work on problems relating to admissions, placements, HR, cost control, programme performance and institutional growth.**

**The role**

You will translate management concerns into clearly formulated problems, identify the questions that matter, investigate available evidence and recommend practical solutions.

The work will rely primarily on secondary research, supplemented by available university data discussions with relevant colleagues and market research.

Information will sometimes be incomplete. You must be able to make reasonable assumptions, explain their basis and assess how they affect your conclusions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Structure problems into specific questions, research tasks and measurable outcomes.
* Research comparable institutions, industry practices, market trends and relevant benchmarks.
* Develop realistic estimates and financial or operational models using clearly stated assumptions.
* Assess alternative solutions in terms of cost, feasibility, likely benefit and implementation requirements.
* Present concise recommendations explaining what should be done, why, by whom and how results should be measured.
* Refine recommendations as new evidence becomes available.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and practical judgement.
* Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
* Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets and incomplete information.
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply.
* Ability to work independently and question assumptions constructively.
* Responsible use of AI research tools, including verification of sources and calculations.

**Candidates may come from consulting, business analysis, economics, finance, operations, market research or related backgrounds. Experience in higher education would be preferred. Demonstrated problem-solving ability will carry more weight than a particular degree or designation.**

The expected output is a workable recommendation supported by evidence, transparent assumptions and an implementation plan.

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical case exercise and discuss their reasoning, assumptions and recommendations.

**Locations : Both Salt Lake and Barasat**

Remuneration: Commensurate with capability and experience.

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a brief example of a problem you have analysed, explaining your approach, recommendation and outcome, to ds.cho@brainwareuniversity.ac.in.

title: AI Strategy Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M is a leading white-label growth partner for digital agencies worldwide, helping them scale through expert web development, digital marketing, and AI-powered solutions.

With 13+ years of experience, 350+ professionals, and 400+ agency partners globally, E2M offers services across WordPress, Shopify, SEO, PPC, content marketing, and AI automation.

Driven by an agency-first approach and our Black Label Standard, we work as an extension of our partners' teams, delivering quality, innovation, and reliable digital solutions that help them grow.

**Role Overview:**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:**
  Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:**
  Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:**
  APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:**
  GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:**
  Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

description:

• Drive the ELV, IT, MEPF, Interiors, Medical Equipment consultants, OEMs and system integrators so their designs match the digital architecture.

• Ensure integration with the Hospital Information System (HIS), Integrated Building Management System (IBMS), ELV and security systems using open protocols and interoperable standards.

• Lead value engineering of technology selection, system convergence, quantities and phasing to optimise capital and lifecycle cost.

• Prepare specifications, BOQ inputs, RFPs and technical bid evaluations, and review consultant and vendor submissions.

• Plan the centralised command centre for clinical, facility, security, emergency and fire and life safety (FLS) monitoring, including the video wall, dashboards, workstations and the room layout.

title: Medical Equipment Planner
description:
**General**

• Prepare the department-wise Medical Equipment Master List from the clinical brief and Schedule of Accommodation, working with management, clinicians, operators and the Medical Planner.

• Provide equipment inputs for Room Data Sheets (RDS) and Room Layout Sheets (RLS), and coordinate them with Architecture, Structure, MEPF, Medical Gas, ELV and Interiors.

• Drive the specialist consultants and OEMs, and review their submissions for completeness, compliance and constructability.

• Lead value engineering of equipment selection, quantities, technology levels and phasing.

• Prepare technical specifications, budget estimates, BOQ inputs, tender documents and technical bid evaluations.

**1. Group 1-2-3 Equipment**

• Classify all equipment into Group 1 (contractor supply and install), Group 2 (owner supply, contractor install) and Group 3 (owner supply and placement).

• Freeze the service requirements for each group in time for DD and GFC: power, data, water, drainage, medical gas, exhaust, structural loads and ceiling supports.

• Coordinate pre-installation needs, site readiness, delivery routes, installation, testing and commissioning.

**2. CSSD**

• Plan the Central Sterile Services Department (CSSD) workflow, separating dirty, clean, sterile and storage zones.

• Specify washer-disinfectors, sterilisers, low-temperature sterilisers, and packing and tracking systems, along with their utility needs (RO water, steam, drainage, exhaust).

**3. Pharmacy**

• Plan the main and satellite pharmacies, including automated dispensing, unit-dose systems, compounding, chemotherapy reconstitution, cold-chain storage and controlled-drug storage.

• Integrate the pharmacy with the Hospital Information System (HIS), the pneumatic tube system and material flows.

**4. Lab**

• Plan the clinical labs (biochemistry, haematology, microbiology, histopathology and molecular), the blood bank and research labs, including total lab automation where it makes sense.

• Define biosafety levels, biosafety cabinets, fume hoods, and the related utility, drainage and effluent requirements.

**5. Shielding**

• Coordinate radiation shielding for X-ray, CT, cath labs, PET-CT, nuclear medicine and LINAC/radiotherapy bunkers, and RF shielding for MRI.

• Review shielding calculations with the Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) / physicist, and coordinate AERB layout approvals and licensing.

**6. Pneumatic Tube**

• Define the stations, zones, routes and capacity of the Pneumatic Tube System (PTS) for samples, blood and medicines.

• Coordinate the PTS with the labs, pharmacy, clinical departments and building services.

**7. Simulation**

• Plan the Medical College simulation and skills centre, including high-fidelity manikins, simulated OT, ICU and ward setups, and AV and debriefing systems.

• Ensure the centre complies with National Medical Commission (NMC) requirements.

title: Head of Commercial
description:
**Position : Head – Commercial**

**Department - Commercial**

**Location – Manufacturing Plant, Sanand.**

**Reports to – CEO**

**Role Overview :**

Head – Commercial will lead the end-to-end commercial function for the organization, driving pricing strategy, distribution excellence, customer partnerships, regulatory compliance, tendering, and order management across domestic and international markets. The role is critical in ensuring profitability, market competitiveness, and adherence to stringent medical device regulations.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**Commercial Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and execute the overall commercial strategy aligned with business growth objectives
* Lead cross-functional alignment across sales, finance, supply chain, regulatory, and operations
* Drive revenue growth, margin expansion, and market penetration

**Pricing Strategy & Governance**

* Develop pricing frameworks considering regulatory caps (if applicable), reimbursement structures, and competitive landscape
* Ensure compliance with pricing regulations in domestic and export markets
* Drive margin optimization through structured pricing reviews and cost analysis

**Distribution & Channel Management**

* Design and optimize distribution networks including distributors, dealers, and institutional channels (hospitals, government bodies)
* Ensure efficient logistics, inventory control, and demand planning
* Evaluate and onboard channel partners with strong governance mechanisms

**Customer & Key Account Management**

* Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders including hospitals, healthcare providers, and institutional buyers
* Lead commercial negotiations, contracts, and long-term agreements
* Drive customer satisfaction, retention, and service excellence

**Regulatory Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure adherence to medical device regulations (e.g., CDSCO, ISO standards, and international regulatory requirements)
* Oversee compliance in contracts, pricing, and commercial practices
* Collaborate with regulatory and quality teams to ensure audit readiness

**Tendering & Institutional Business**

* Lead strategy and execution for government and private tenders
* Ensure competitive, compliant, and profitable bid submissions
* Manage GeM portal participation and large institutional contracts

**Order Management (Domestic & Export)**

* Oversee end-to-end order lifecycle from order booking to delivery and payment realization
* Ensure compliance with export regulations, documentation, and international trade

terms (Incoterms)

* Coordinate with supply chain and logistics for timely fulfilment.

**Financial & Risk Management**

* Own commercial P&L elements including revenue, margins, and working capital
* Monitor receivables, credit policies, and financial exposure
* Identify and mitigate commercial and contractual risks

title: SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Title:**

SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator

**Department:**

SAP Solutions & Delivery

**Experience:**

3+ years of experience(Preferred)

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Functional Expertise:**

SAP FICO preferred, with exposure to SAP S/4HANA and SAP integrations

**Reporting To:**

Delivery Head / Management

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator**

with strong SAP functional knowledge, business analysis capabilities, and project delivery experience.

The role will act as a bridge between customers, business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, and technical developers, ensuring that business requirements are clearly understood, translated into appropriate solution designs, and delivered within agreed timelines.

The primary objective is to
**strengthen functional ownership and delivery coordination**

, allowing the existing SAP development team to focus on technical implementation while ensuring business alignment, solution quality, and predictable project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Business Requirements & Functional Analysis

* Engage with customers and stakeholders to understand business processes and requirements.
* Conduct requirement-gathering workshops and functional discussions.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and development-ready requirements.
* Identify functional gaps, dependencies, and integration requirements.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), and process flows.

2. SAP Solution Design & Functional Leadership

* Evaluate business requirements and recommend suitable SAP solutions.
* Provide functional guidance to SAP ABAP developers and integration teams.
* Review proposed solutions for functional accuracy and business alignment.
* Support SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and third-party integration requirements.
* Coordinate solution design reviews and technical feasibility discussions.
* Ensure consistency with SAP best practices and customer expectations.

3. Project Planning & Delivery Coordination

* Develop project plans, milestones, delivery schedules, and resource requirements.
* Coordinate tasks across functional, development, QA, and deployment teams.
* Track project progress, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular project reviews and communicate status to management.
* Identify potential delivery delays and initiate corrective actions.
* Support multiple concurrent SAP projects and customer engagements.

4. Stakeholder & Customer Management

* Serve as the primary functional and delivery coordination point for assigned projects.
* Facilitate communication between customers, internal teams, and management.
* Manage requirement clarifications, change requests, and scope discussions.
* Coordinate customer demonstrations, reviews, and solution walkthroughs.
* Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and timely resolution of open items.

5. Testing, Deployment & Delivery Assurance

* Define functional acceptance criteria and support test scenario preparation.
* Coordinate SIT, UAT, defect resolution, and customer sign-off.
* Verify that delivered functionality meets agreed requirements.
* Support deployment planning, go-live readiness, and post-production stabilization.
* Maintain functional documentation, project records, and delivery handover materials.

Required Skills & Qualifications

**SAP Functional Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of SAP business processes and functional modules.
* SAP FICO expertise preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC.
* Familiarity with SAP ABAP development concepts, BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs, APIs, and integration scenarios.
* Ability to review functional specifications and communicate effectively with developers.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Proven experience coordinating SAP implementation, enhancement, support, or integration projects.
* Strong requirement-gathering and functional documentation skills.
* Experience in project planning, task tracking, risk management, and delivery reporting.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Experience working directly with customers and cross-functional technical teams.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and delivery commitments.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and decision-making capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3+ years of relevant SAP functional and delivery experience.
* At least 2 years of SAP project coordination or functional leadership experience.
* SAP certification in FICO or S/4HANA is an advantage.
* Exposure to SAP integrations with external enterprise applications, financial systems, and reconciliation platforms.

**Expected Deliverables**

The successful candidate will be responsible for :

* Clearly documented and validated customer requirements.
* Functional specifications ready for technical development.
* Approved solution designs with defined scope and acceptance criteria.
* Structured project plans, milestones, and delivery trackers.
* Regular project status reports with risks, blockers, and action items.
* Coordinated SIT, UAT, customer sign-offs, and deployments.
* Improved predictability, quality, and timeliness of SAP project delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Requirement completeness and accuracy.
* Functional specification quality and development readiness.
* On-time achievement of project milestones.
* Reduction in requirement-related rework.
* Stakeholder communication and issue-resolution effectiveness.
* UAT acceptance and successful delivery sign-offs.
* Overall customer satisfaction and delivery efficiency.

Role Positioning

**This is a functional leadership and delivery coordination role, not a hands-on ABAP development position.**

The candidate must possess sufficient SAP functional and technical understanding to guide development teams, resolve requirement ambiguities, coordinate stakeholders, and take ownership of delivery commitments.

**Our Goal:**

Establish a strong functional and delivery ownership layer between customers and our SAP development team, enabling developers to concentrate on technical execution while improving solution alignment, project governance, and delivery reliability.

title: Staff Customer Experience Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Are you an experienced professional with a strong technical background in customer experience and a deep-seated passion for building lasting relationships with senior-level customers? If so, you will thrive on our team which values collaboration, technical credibility, and the opportunity to drive customer success through innovative solutions using Nutanix technology, all while having the potential for career advancement in a supportive and empowering environment.
  
  
**About The Team**
At Nutanix, you would be joining the Customer Success team, a group dedicated to driving adoption and ensuring customer satisfaction with our hybrid multicloud solutions for our strategic customers. This cohesive team is deeply motivated by a shared commitment to ensuring our customers' long-term success and value realization. Operating from key locations, the team prides itself on fostering collaboration and building strong relationships with customers. The culture emphasizes teamwork, deep technical credibility, and a commitment to being trusted advisors, which aligns with the mission of enhancing customer experience and delivering value through effective engagement and proactive support.
  
  
This is a technical role that requires strong customer management skills. You’ll collaborate with customer IT operations and architecture teams, as well as with business and IT leadership. Strategy and goals will be defined with customer leadership. Goals will be achieved by customer operations and architecture teams guided and informed by your deep technical and architectural knowledge. You will be expected to achieve the Nutanix Certified Expert (NCX) certification (training will be provided for this) within your first 6-12 months. NCX is an architectural certification earned by developing and documenting a Nutanix design, and defending it in front of a panel of experts.
  
  
You will report to the Regional Leader of Customer Success, who believes in the power of partnerships and collaboration, where every team member actively engages clients to help them realize their goals and achieve meaningful outcomes. The work setup is primarily remote, allowing you to operate efficiently within your designated region without the need for a traditional office space. Instead of commuting to an office every day, you'll spend most of your time engaging directly with customers to build relationships, understand their needs, resolve their issues, and drive their outcomes. The role does require weekly travel within your region, but you can expect overnight stays due to the regional landscape and logistics, ensuring you remain connected to both your customers and your team.
  
  
Your Role
  
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned customer accounts to ensure their success with Nutanix technology.
* Act as the post-sales trusted advisor for 10-12 strategic customers, overseeing customer needs from deployment to adoption to long-term operation to expansion.
* Collaborate with internal teams to optimize resource utilization and serve customer requirements effectively.
* Collaborate with customers to understand their business goals and technical requirements.
* Partner with customer architects team to help align architecture to customer business needs.
* Create and document tailored Customer Success Plans that align with customers' business and technology goals, conduct reviews, and track progress.
* Monitor customer satisfaction metrics (e.g., NPS, CSAT) and proactively address any concerns.
* Drive product adoption and expansion among customer organizations through deep technical understanding and proactive relationship management.
* Provide actionable insights on technology usage, maturity, and best practices to help customers achieve operational efficiency.
* Collect and advocate customer feedback to influence future product development and service enhancements at Nutanix.
* Lead the technical onboarding process for new customers ensuring alignment with customer’s desired outcomes.

The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities.
  
  
What You Will Bring
  
  

* 8-12 years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, demonstrating credibility with mid-senior level business and technical audiences.
* Understanding of and experience with architectural frameworks such as ITIL, TOGAF, etc.
* Deep technical knowledge of data center technology and virtualization, ideally with a focus on hybrid multicloud solutions. Experience with containerization and AI infrastructure is highly desirable.
* Understanding of large scale customer operational standards and processes.
* Technical credibility supported by relevant certifications (e.g., VCDX, VCAP, NPX, NCX, ITIL v4, TOGAF).
* Excellent communication and relationship skills, capable of advocating for customer needs and delivering constructive feedback to internal teams.
* A customer-centric mindset with a passion for driving positive outcomes and applying problem-solving strategies.

Work Arrangement
  
  
Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. For most roles, that will mean coming into an office a minimum of 2 - 3 days per week, however certain roles and/or teams may require more frequent in-office presence. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.
  
  
--

title: GTM Manager
description:
At Mstack AI, we are building the world’s first AI-native chemical company. Specialty chemistry powers every physical product on Earth, from battery electrolytes and pharma intermediates to semiconductors and sustainable coatings, yet the industry still relies on trial-and-error R&D methods that take 18+ months per molecule. We compress 18 months of R&D into a matter of days by combining quantum chemistry, generative AI, and real-world custom manufacturing. Backed by $40M from Lightspeed and Alpha Wave Global, we operate across Houston, San Francisco, Mumbai, Bangalore, and Hyderabad. We don’t just predict reactions; we deliver real-world physical production batches.

**ABOUT THE TEAM:**

You will join the team building Chemstack AI, an agentic synthesis R&D platform built on our own Chemistry World Model that reasons from first principles like an expert chemist. It designs synthesis routes, researches literature and patents, predicts reaction conditions and tests reactions virtually before they reach the lab, turning months of R&D into days, with the evidence for every step. Large companies are already trialling it on their own molecules. The team, close to leadership, brings together PhD chemists and specialists in AI, data and product. Our chemists work with the commercial team on each customer, so the science is covered. AI for chemistry is new, and this team is shaping how it is sold. We value ownership, deep curiosity and moving fast while getting the details right.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

As a GTM Manager, you will be the trusted partner to the R&D teams we serve, from the first demo through contract and renewal. Our sales team opens the door; from there, the customer is yours. You will help each customer win, lead each team into a new way of working, and turn strong results into lasting partnerships. Success looks like trials that convert and accounts that expand, and your scope grows with them.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* *Relationship management:*
  Build trusted relationships across each account, from a chemist to the head of R&D, and shape a joint plan for where Chemstack AI creates the most value.
* *Expectation management:*
  Define with each customer what success means for their R&D, in outcomes they can measure, and align everyone involved around it.
* *Change management:*
  Plan each team’s migration from familiar tools to working with Chemstack AI, address concerns early, and help the first users bring the rest of the team along.

***Execution:***

• Demos: Make the value of Chemstack AI clear from the first meeting and turn interest into commitment. • Onboarding: Own each customer’s start, from agreements and access to a strong kick off, so teams are live fast. • Trials: Run each trial against goals agreed upfront, and close with a proposal their leadership can act on. • Account growth: Grow each signed account into new teams, sites and users, and secure every renewal. • Market insight: Bring back why we win and lose, and shape what we build and how we price it. • Pipeline and process: Keep an accurate view of each deal and renewal, and sharpen how we work with customers.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

• Experience: 4 to 6 years in B2B account management, customer success or enterprise sales, ideally selling software to R&D teams in pharma, life sciences or chemicals.

• Commercial Expertise:

• Proven ability to build trusted relationships with decision makers and their teams in enterprise accounts. • Experience leading enterprise teams through the adoption of new software, and making the change last. • Proficiency in running pilots or trials, writing proposals, and keeping a CRM and forecast leadership can rely on. • Demonstrated track record of turning trials into contracts and growing accounts after the first sale.

• Domain Alignment: Curiosity about chemistry and how chemists work. A science background or a network in pharma or chemicals is a plus, not a requirement.

• Mindset: Owns outcomes, writes and speaks clearly, earns the trust of scientists with evidence rather than a pitch, keeps several accounts moving at once without losing detail, and is comfortable travelling to customer sites.

At Mojro, we don’t just optimize logistics – we reimagine it. Our platforms – PlanWyse (route and load optimization) and ExecuteWyse (real-time execution monitoring) – reduce transportation costs, raise service levels and power smarter, faster decisions for customers such as Unilever, Asian Paints, Berger and Godrej.

*why*
the optimization engine produced a given plan – and what to change when the plan isn’t right.
  
  
This role suits someone who has implemented a complex, decision-heavy SaaS product – a TMS or routing platform, or a supply chain planning, inventory or scheduling tool – and wants end-to-end ownership rather than a single slice of the lifecycle. You will also lead Mojro’s Customer Success Engineering (CSE) team. This is a hands-on leadership role: you remain the team’s strongest troubleshooter, not only its manager.
