* Author and own SOWs, Functional and Technical Design Documents (FDD/TDD), workflow diagrams and architecture specifications.
* Translate customer business rules – fleet, time windows, capacities, service levels, costs – into a working solution configuration.
* Integrations and technical delivery
* Own integrations with customer ERP, WMS, OMS and other systems via API, webhook and FTP/SFTP.
* Perform data mapping, environment setup and interface validation.
* Debug issues hands-on using SQL, Postman, logs and browser developer tools.

* Prepare go-live plans, risk assessments, cutover checklists and hypercare.

* Act as the primary technical contact for live accounts, alongside the Customer Success Manager.
* Run proactive technical health checks, usage reviews and periodic technical reviews with customer teams.
* Resolve complex product and integration issues, involving L3 Engineering only when needed.
* Identify technical expansion opportunities and support CS on renewals, upsells and cross-sells.
* Optimization and plan quality
* Diagnose plan-quality issues: unassigned orders, capacity or time-window violations, cost or utilization outliers.
* Tune constraints and parameters with customers, and explain trade-offs in business terms.
* Feed patterns back to Product to improve the engine and its defaults.
* Product feedback
* Surface product gaps, missing APIs and enhancement needs from implementations and live accounts.
* Work with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support prioritization.
* Leadership and team enablement
* Lead and manage the CSE team: hiring, goals, performance reviews and development.
* Act as the team’s technical escalation point, stepping in personally on the hardest integration and production issues.
* Review solution designs and integration approaches before every go-live.
* Prioritize technical issues across concurrent implementations and allocate the team accordingly.
* Mentor engineers on integration debugging, troubleshooting, documentation and customer communication.
* Own the team’s implementation standards, deployment templates, playbooks and knowledge-base content.
* Support Sales and Pre-Sales with technical scoping and feasibility for complex deals.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 8–10 years in B2B SaaS implementation, technical account management, customer success engineering or solutions consulting for a complex enterprise product.
* Background in either: (a) logistics, TMS, routing or visibility platforms; or (b) optimization or planning software – supply chain planning, inventory, demand, scheduling or similar.
* Experience leading a team of engineers or consultants while staying hands-on yourself.
* Hands-on SQL, REST APIs, Postman and log interpretation; you still debug integrations yourself.
* Proven experience writing SOWs, FDDs/TDDs and workflow or architecture documentation.
* Experience owning customer accounts after go-live, not only through implementation.
* Ability to run several enterprise projects at once with strong project discipline.
* Clear communication with both customer IT and operations or business stakeholders.

**Good to have**

* Exposure to optimization concepts: constraints, objective functions, heuristics or solvers.
* Familiarity with Jira, HubSpot and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
* Knowledge of authentication flows (SSO, OAuth, MFA) and cloud deployment basics.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Operations Research, IT or a related field; equivalent depth of SaaS implementation experience will be considered.

**What Success Looks Like In Your First Year**

* You have taken at least two enterprise accounts live as the technical owner.
* Your live accounts run with stable integrations and few repeat escalations.
* Customers trust you to explain and improve plan quality without needing Engineering in the room.
* Your CSE team resolves most escalations without you, and works to standards and playbooks you set.

title: Manager, Managed Services
description:
**Why project44?**

 

 

At project44, we believe in better. 

 

We challenge the status quo because we know a better supply chain isn't just possible—it's essential. Better for our customers. Better for their business. Better for the world. 

 

With our
**Decision Intelligence Platform, Movement,**

we're redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real-time, AI-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward. 

 

Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose. 

 

**AI at project44**

 

 

We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day-to-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers. 

 

If you're driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team – we should talk.

 

 

**Role Overview**

 

As a
**Manager,**
**Managed Service**

, you will play a highly visible role partnering with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure world class delivery across a diverse portfolio. You will drive customer value through data analysis, operational excellence and proactive project management. This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and requires the ability to influence stakeholders, manage multiple complex accounts and translate insights into long-term solutions.

 

As the Manager, Managed Services, you will lead a team of Managed Service Consultants and own the delivery of a diverse portfolio of

enterprise

and strategic customers. You will partner with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure

strong outcomes in

adoption

, data

quality

and service performance

, and you will set the operational standards, analytics practices and people development that make the team successful. This role blends strategic leadership with hands-on problem solving. You will influence senior stakeholders, coach your team through complex accounts and turn data insights into scalable, long-term solutions. This role reports to VP,

Customer experience, manages a team of 5+ consultants and covers global region. Location: Bengaluru

 

**What You Will Work On**

* Hire

  , onboard, lead, coach and develop a team of Managed Service Consultants, setting clear goals, giving regular feedback and building a strong, high-performing culture.

* Own the health of the team’s customer portfolio, including delivery timelines, milestones, end-to-end project plans and risk management across global regions and multiple project44 products.

* Serve as an executive point of contact for key customers and carriers and escalate and resolve complex issues.

* Set the strategy for carrier initiatives, from planning through adoption, and review data-driven insights and best-practice recommendations presented by the team.

* Drive a culture of deep-dive data analysis, ensuring the team identifies patterns, uncovers root causes and delivers improvements that increase data quality and availability, using visualization tools and internal data platforms to triage errors and speed up issue resolution.

* Define and monitor team KPIs, review progress across accounts, and publish regular reports to leadership that highlight risks and business impact.

* Hold customers, carriers and internal teams accountable for actions that improve operational outcomes.

* Partner with Product, Support, Carrier Operations, Engineering and Sales to drive customer value, and represent the voice of the customer and carrier in cross-functional forums.

* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks and process improvements that raise quality, consistency and efficiency across the Managed Services practice, and identify process gaps and share scalable solutions across the organization.

* Allocate and balance workload across the team, and manage capacity, prioritization and competing demands.

* Maintain a deep understanding of carrier integration methods across modes, and guide the team’s technical decision-making.

What You Need

 

* 8+ years of experience in data analysis, operations, consulting or account management, including at least two years leading or managing a team.

* Experience in SaaS, software or logistics is preferred.

* Proven ability to manage a complex portfolio of enterprise customers and to lead multiple projects with competing priorities.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive audiences.

* Solid understanding of source data, data formats (such as EDI, API and file-based feeds) and data behaviour.

* Proficiency in Excel and SQL, and familiarity with visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Kibana or Observe.

* Experience with APIs or basic coding concepts is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor and develop talent, and to manage performance.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels and a customer-focused, problem-solving mindset.

* Exceptional organizational skills and a track record of process improvement.
* Fluency in English and Spanish. Additional languages are a plus.

**In-office Commitment:**

Our office is where ideas spark, connections thrive, and innovation comes alive. The expectation is to be on-site,
**in office five days a week**

as this offers the chance to immerse yourself in the energy of the office and collaborate with your co-workers. Together, we’re building something extraordinary—learn, grow, and thrive in our fast-paced, transformative environment.

 

**Diversity & Inclusion:**

 

At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

 

We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.

 

project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!

 

For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, please email


recruiting@project44.com

. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

 

**More about project44:**

 

Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. As transportation and logistics continue to evolve and customer expectations around delivery become more demanding, industry technology must rise to the occasion. In just a few short years, we have created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. Our Advanced Visibility Platform is used by the world’s leading brands to track shipments, collaborate with supply chain partners, drive operational efficiencies, and create outstanding customer experiences.

title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery

You will act as:
  
  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities

Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
  
  
**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

Lastly, what we are not looking for
**,**
we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. As a  HSBC Premier Elite Relationship Manager, you will be joining our dedicated team of experts with enhanced coverage to focus on client needs. You will become part of our exclusively chosen relationship manager who will be assigned with the top-notch HSBC Premier Elite clientele portfolio.  You will work collaboratively with Investment and Insurance Specialist Team to support client’s entire life journey.   You will also have a dedicated team of HSBC Premier Elite Assistant Manager to partner with you on executing client’s transactions and ensuring a smooth flow of services.  All these are unique in making your career journey different from any other.

title: Technical Implementation Lead
description:
**About Lifesight**

**Lifesight**
is a pioneering Unified
**Marketing Measurement (UMM)**
platform which helps marketers measure, plan and optimise their marketing spend. In a world of fragmented data, unreliable cookies, and outdated reporting, we empower modern businesses to achieve predictable, sustained growth by aligning marketing and finance on a single causal truth.

We are at the forefront of
**Agentic Unified Marketing Measurement**
. Moving beyond siloed tools and post facto dashboards, our AI-driven causal engine combines Causal MMM, Incrementality testing and Incrementality Adjusted Attribution to create a finance ready marketing decision system.

**Why We Exist:**

Our mission is to eliminate wasted ad spend and remove the guesswork from marketing. Operating as an independent, unbiased measurement layer, Lifesight enables CMOs, CFOs, and performance marketers to confidently answer the only question that matters:
*What is the true incremental value of my marketing spend?*

**Join the Future of Decision Intelligence.**
We are transforming marketing from a gamble into a science. By joining Lifesight, you will help build the intelligent, agent-ready infrastructure that powers data-driven, optimized decisions for hundreds of top global brands.

**Position Overview**

As the Lead – Technical Implementation on our global Solutions team in Bangalore, you'll lead a team of Technical Implementation Specialists and own data onboarding for Lifesight's Unified Marketing Measurement solutions:
**Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM)**
,
**Incrementality Experiments**
, and
**Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA)**
.

You'll set the standard for how client data gets into Lifesight: scoped clearly, delivered on time, and accurate from day one. This role is for a hands-on leader who can coach a team, run multiple client onboardings in parallel, and speak with equal confidence to a client's data engineer and their CMO.

**What You'll Do:**

**Lead the team**

* Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of Technical Implementation Specialists; set priorities, review their work, and raise the bar on quality.
* Allocate client onboardings across the team based on complexity, capacity, and skills; step in hands-on when an engagement needs it.
* Build and maintain standard playbooks, checklists, and templates for data onboarding across MMM, Experiments, and MTA.
* Run regular 1:1s and team reviews; give clear feedback and support each specialist's growth.

**Own data onboarding for MMM, Experiments, and MTA**

* Own end-to-end data onboarding for every client: scoping data requirements, validating pipelines, testing configurations, and signing off on measurement readiness.
* Define what "model-ready" data looks like for each solution: historical spend, KPI, and control variables for MMM; geo and audience-level data for Experiments; event, touchpoint, and conversion data for MTA.
* Oversee how the team combines, cleans, and transforms fragmented, multi-source data across Excel, SQL, and BigQuery.
* Catch data quality issues early (type mismatches, schema inconsistencies, integration gaps, anomalies, outliers) before they affect client outcomes.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex implementation issues using internal tooling, APIs, and cross-functional collaboration.

**Manage projects and timelines**

* Translate client requirements into structured implementation plans with clear milestones, owners, and dates.
* Run multiple onboardings in parallel; track progress, manage dependencies, and keep every project on schedule.
* Spot risks early, escalate with a proposed fix, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Report onboarding status, timelines, and blockers to leadership and client teams.

**Be the client's trusted technical partner**

* Act as the senior technical point of contact and escalation point for clients during onboarding.
* Lead client calls and workshops; explain data requirements and measurement concepts in plain business language.
* Manage expectations, negotiate scope and timelines, and maintain trust through every engagement.
* Run account health checks and flag risks before they escalate.

**Improve how we work**

* Use AI tools and prompt engineering to streamline workflows and automate repetitive onboarding tasks across the team.
* Feed structured client and team feedback into Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and tooling.
* Partner with Data Science, Customer Success, and Sales for smooth handoffs from pre-sales through to model delivery.

**P.S.**
– The above list need not put a ceiling on your aspirations at Lifesight.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 8+ years in technical implementation, data onboarding, solutioning, or solutions consulting within B2B SaaS; ideally in data, martech, or adtech.
* 2+ years leading small teams (3–6 people) of implementation, solutions, or data specialists, including hiring, coaching, and performance feedback.

title: Implementation Lead
description:
**About The Role**
As an Implementation Lead for Employee Transportation Services (ETS), you will own the journey of large enterprise clients from solution deep-dive through to the successful onboarding, launch and stabilization of managed employee commute programs across India and APAC.
  
  
You will act as the critical bridge between Sales, Product and long-term client success — closing mid-funnel deals through in-depth, customized demos, leading complex client integrations and pre-launch readiness, and ensuring a seamless transition from signed deal to a fully integrated, operating program.
  
  
You will partner with customers’ Transport, Admin, HR, Security, IT and Facilities teams, and with Sales, Operations, Product, Engineering, Safety, Customer Trust and Support teams internally, to deliver safe, reliable and cost-efficient commute solutions — from roster and route design through go-live and steady-state performance.
  
  
The role sits at the intersection of operations, program management and customer success, directly impacting service quality, customer satisfaction and revenue growth, and is pivotal to building a repeatable ETS launch engine.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own in-depth, customized ETS solution demos — including client-specific configuration discussions and scenario simulations (e.g., Guard vs. Non-Guard trips, On-Time vs. Delayed trips) — to validate fit and close deals alongside Account Executives, and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sessions after deal signing
* Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the sales cycle, owning and supporting the technical sections of RFPs and client proposals to accelerate deal closures
* Lead end-to-end implementation of ETS programs for enterprise clients — from requirements gathering and site readiness through pilot, go-live and hypercare — ensuring seamless and timely launches
* Partner with customers to understand shift patterns, employee rosters, pickup/drop locations and commute policies, and translate them into routing, fleet and service design
* Define SLAs and success metrics with customers (e.g., on-time performance, seat utilization, trip completion, safety incidents, employee satisfaction) and drive adoption among employees, transport admins and operations teams
* Work with fleet partners, drivers and on-ground operations teams to ensure vehicle, driver and compliance readiness (permits, insurance, driver verification, vehicle fitness) before and after launch
* Implement safety and compliance protocols, including night-shift and women-employee safety requirements, in-vehicle safety features and incident escalation processes
* Coordinate technical onboarding with Product, Engineering and Global Shared Services (GSS) — roster uploads, HRMS/attendance, SFTP and SSO integrations, data pipelines, user and policy configuration, and billing set-up — keeping core engineering focused on product builds
* Navigate client InfoSec and compliance requirements alongside the Customer Trust team, and drive pre-launch readiness and UAT to sign-off so that each program is handed over to Operations fully documented and launch-ready
* Run regular operational reviews with customers, analyze performance data, root-cause service gaps and drive corrective actions and continuous cost and efficiency improvements; identify growth opportunities such as new sites, shifts, shuttle routes and EV adoption
* Relay client feedback, technical requirements and market learnings to the Product team to influence the ETS roadmap, set accurate client expectations on capabilities and timelines, and escalate forward-looking feature requests
* Build and maintain ETS enablement resources — feature lists, FAQs, sales collateral and standardized demo narratives — support repeatable demo environments (test accounts and simulated trips), and test new feature rollouts for incoming clients ahead of launch
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients and deeply understand ETS products, operating model and tools to deliver customer trainings, onboarding sessions and troubleshoot customer issues

**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in a client-facing role (implementation, program/project management, operations, consulting, account management or similar)
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, sites and deadlines in operationally intensive environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage customer leadership as well as on-ground operations and vendor teams
* Demonstrated ability to deliver technical product demonstrations and explain complex solutions clearly to business, technical and operations audiences
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration concepts (SFTP, SSO, HRMS, data pipelines) and experience managing end-to-end implementations, including UAT and InfoSec/compliance reviews
* Proven ability to influence and work across Sales, Product, Engineering and Operations teams without direct authority
* Strong analytical skills, with working proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (SQL or BI tools a plus) to track SLAs and operational KPIs

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in employee transportation, corporate commute or shuttle services, fleet management, logistics, mobility or transport/facilities outsourcing
* Familiarity with India transport and compliance requirements — vehicle permits, driver verification and safety norms for night-shift and women-employee transportation
* Experience managing fleet/vendor partners and SLA-driven contracts
* Experience in SaaS, tech or platform-based environments, including rollout of routing, rostering or workforce-mobility technology
* Experience supporting RFPs and enterprise procurement processes, and building enablement material such as training curricula, FAQs and collateral
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, handle on-ground escalations and drive solutions
* Fluency in English and Hindi; additional regional/APAC languages are a plus.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.
  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

title: I&P-GN - SONG-MT-DSMS-Customer Lifecycle Campaign-GEN AI-Senior Manager
description:
**Job Summary:**
The I&P Global Network Song practice works with clients across their marketing, sales and services functions, providing transformation services driven by key offerings like Living Marketing, Connected Commerce and Next-Generation Customer Care. This is a leadership role for a CVM practitioner who has operated across both Consumer and Enterprise sides of the business. You will own the Next Best Action and Customer Value Management agenda end-to-end — setting the strategy, shaping the decisioning and agentic AI architecture, leading a multi-track delivery team, and carrying the senior client relationship. You will be the single accountable leader stitching together Prepaid Consumer growth and Enterprise Postpaid retention into one coherent lifecycle engagement programme.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* NBA-CVM Strategy & Transformation Leadership:
* Define and own the multi-year NBA-CVM transformation roadmap spanning Consumer (Prepaid and Consumer Postpaid) and Enterprise Postpaid portfolios.
* Set the value agenda against hard telco levers — ARPU uplift, churn and involuntary disconnection reduction, recharge frequency and top-up value, data attach, cross-sell and upsell, and revenue per enterprise account.
* Build the CVM operating model — governance forums, decision rights, campaign-to-cash measurement, and the operating rhythm between marketing, sales, product, data and IT.
* Shaping the Agentic AI vision:
* Drive the adoption of AI and Generative AI capabilities within lifecycle marketing, including customer segmentation, content generation, audience intelligence, next best action recommendations, campaign orchestration and performance optimization.
* Identify and scale high-value AI use cases that improve personalization, campaign effectiveness, marketing productivity and customer experience outcomes across the lifecycle journey.
* Build business cases for AI-enabled marketing transformation, demonstrating impact through campaign cycle-time reduction, improved customer engagement, operational efficiency and personalization at scale.
* Consumer & Enterprise Portfolio Ownership:
* Translate two very different commercial logics into one lifecycle framework — high-volume, high-frequency, price-elastic Prepaid Consumer engagement alongside relationship-led, contract-bound Enterprise Postpaid account management.
* Ensure Consumer and Enterprise tracks share a common customer data foundation, decisioning engine, offer library and measurement language while respecting the differences in buying cycle, decision unit and channel mix.
* Decisioning & Offer Framework:
* Own the target-state real-time decisioning architecture — Next Best Action / Next Best Offer strategy design, engagement policies, arbitration and prioritisation logic, adaptive and predictive model deployment, and inbound versus outbound channel orchestration.
* Govern the offer and proposition library, eligibility and suppression frameworks, contact policy, and offer economics across segments.
* Client & Stakeholder Leadership:
* Act as the trusted advisor to CMO, CDO, Chief Commercial Officer, Head of CVM and Enterprise Business Head level stakeholders.
* Manage a complex stakeholder ecosystem across client business, technology and analytics teams, Accenture account leadership, delivery centres and platform partners.
* Own escalation management and course correction across concurrent client engagements.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building:
* Lead and develop a team of Managers and Consultants across campaign strategy, decisioning, journey orchestration and analytics tracks.
* Build telco CVM and GenAI capability within the practice — assets, accelerators, reusable NBA playbooks, points of view and credentials.
* Commercial & Delivery Governance:
* Own delivery quality, project financials, resource planning, staffing pyramid and utilisation across engagements.
* Manage risk and contingency planning across multi-country, multi-vendor programme environments.
* Business Development:
* Create business cases, shape solutions, respond to RFPs and develop proposals that bring the best of Accenture's telco CVM, martech and AI capabilities to clients.
* Identify and convert expansion opportunities within existing telco accounts.

title: Strategic Account Manager
description:
**Job Title: Strategic Account Manager**
**Job Description**
The Strategic Account Manager builds and grows high-value relationships with senior stakeholders in biotech and pharmaceutical organizations, driving revenue growth and market share through strategic account planning, business development, and cross-functional collaboration. This role focuses on positioning the company as a trusted partner, managing complex sales cycles, and leveraging CRM tools to maintain a robust pipeline and deliver clear, measurable results.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain deep, long-term relationships with senior decision-makers within biotech and pharma customer accounts, positioning the organization as a trusted strategic partner.
* Create and execute strategic account plans that clearly define revenue growth objectives, project pipelines, and stakeholder maps to achieve significant share gain within key accounts.
* Independently identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities, while also collaborating closely with Indian channel partners to expand reach and accelerate growth.
* Work closely with Central Asia marketing and sales teams, customer support, finance, supply chain, and digital teams to deliver tailored solutions that address customers pain points and business challenges.
* Use CRM tools to plan and manage sales activities, maintain an accurate and up-to-date pipeline, qualify leads, and manage the sales funnel from opportunity creation through to closure.
* Provide regular, structured reporting on pipeline status, sales activities, and forecasted revenue to management, ensuring transparency and data-driven decision-making.
* Continuously monitor account performance and market trends within the biotech and pharma sectors to identify new opportunities and adjust account strategies as needed.
* Champion customer needs internally and coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure a high level of customer satisfaction and long-term account retention.

**Essential Skills**

* 510 years of experience in sales or key account management, preferably in the biotech, pharmaceutical, or life sciences sector.
* Proven expertise in strategic key account planning, including developing account strategies, stakeholder maps, and growth plans.
* Strong track record in managing and growing complex accounts, with the ability to build trusted relationships with decision-makers.
* Demonstrated ability to identify, develop, and close new business opportunities within a competitive market environment.
* Experience using CRM systems to plan and manage sales activities, track pipeline, qualify leads, and manage the sales funnel.
* Solid understanding of products and solutions related to antibodies or similar life science reagents, and the ability to communicate their value to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to translate sales data and pipeline metrics into actionable insights.

**Additional Skills & Qualifications**

* Experience working with channel partners to drive joint business development and revenue growth.
* Experience in biotech, pharma, or life sciences environments, with familiarity with customer workflows and pain points.
* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, collaborating with marketing, sales, customer support, finance, supply chain, and digital functions.
* Strategic mindset with a proactive, results-oriented approach to account management and business development.
* Comfort with managing multiple complex accounts simultaneously and prioritizing activities to meet growth targets.

**Work Environment**
The Strategic Account Manager operates in a dynamic, customer-focused commercial environment within the biotech and pharma sectors. The role involves frequent collaboration with regional marketing and sales teams, customer support, finance, supply chain, and digital functions, often across different geographies such as Central Asia and India. Work is highly driven by data and technology, with regular use of CRM platforms to manage pipelines, plan activities, and report on performance. The position typically follows standard business hours, with flexibility required to meet customer needs and coordinate with global stakeholders. The culture emphasizes partnership, transparency, and cross-functional teamwork, offering the opportunity to shape strategic account strategies and directly influence business growth.

title: Partnerships Manager, Dodo Payments
description:
**About The Opportunity**

* Dodo Payments is a Merchant of Record for developers and digital businesses selling globally. This role owns relationships with payment processors and rails, as well as agencies, dev shops, and platforms that bring merchants to Dodo. One side lowers payment costs; the other grows merchant reach.
* You’ll be Dodo’s first full-time partnerships hire. Today, these relationships are handled deal-by-deal by founders and revenue teams. You’ll turn them into a scalable function: a rail coverage map, a partner program with clear tiers and economics, and a pipeline on both sides.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Own rail partnerships: map current collection and payout coverage by country, currency, and payment method; identify gaps; decide which partner closes each gap.
* Source and negotiate full-cycle deals with processors, acquirers, APM providers, payout and FX rails, and banking partners — including MDR, FX spreads, settlement timelines, reserves, and volume commitments.
* Own onboarding of new rails: collaborate with compliance on KYB and due diligence, and with engineering on integration timelines until first live transaction.
* Track and optimize partner health and cost: monitor cost, approval rates, uptime, settlement delays, and escalations for every live rail; reduce blended payment cost by corridor quarter over quarter.
* Design partner program: build tiers for referral partners, agencies, dev shops, and technology platforms — each with clear economics (revenue share, referral fees) and a standard agreement.
* Qualify inbound partner requests quickly and proactively source outbound partners who already reach target merchants.
* Activate partners: create onboarding kits, pitch materials, deal registration, and seamless handoff to sales so signed partners send their first merchant live within weeks.
* Track partner-sourced revenue: monitor every merchant from referral to live volume; ensure partners are paid correctly and on time.
* Maintain competitive intelligence: know who’s launching what, who’s pricing aggressively, and which rails and partners competitors rely on.

**Skills & Qualifications**
**Must-Have**

* 3 to 5 years in partnerships, alliances, banking relationships, or payments BD at a payment aggregator, PSP, cross-border fintech, neobank, or B2B SaaS company with a real partner program.
* Hands-on experience negotiating commercial deals with processors, banks, payout providers, or channel partners — not just attending meetings.
* Experience building or scaling a partner or referral program and ability to show what it generated.
* Working fluency in payments mechanics: MDR and interchange, settlement cycles, FX spreads, chargebacks, rolling reserves, KYB.
* Comfort reading partner agreements and identifying clauses that cost the company money.
* Proven ability to turn messy work into trackers, scorecards, or SOPs without being asked.

**Preferred**

* Bonus: exposure to cross-border flows (RBI PA-CB, international payouts, APMs in SEA, MENA, LATAM, or Europe).
* Experience with partners like Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, Adyen, Worldpay, or Stripe.
* Experience recruiting agencies and dev shops as resellers.

**Loaction & Highlights**

* Location: Bangalore, in-office.
* Travel: occasional for partner meetings and industry events.

Skills: payments,partnerships,deals

📍

**💰 ₹3.6 LPA + Uncapped Incentives**

**⚡ Immediate joiners preferred**

This is not a traditional content-writing job.

We’re looking for someone who
**understands how social media works**
— and can use that understanding to create better content.

You should be obsessed with questions like:

**Why did people stop scrolling?**

**Why did they drop?**

**Why did they watch till the end?**

**Why did they save or share it?**

**Why did one post take off while another died?**

**You should understand hooks, retention, drop-offs, watch time, saves, shares, engagement and distribution**
— and how to use these signals to improve the next piece of content.

What You’ll Do

Create and write content for
**LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube**
.

Research ideas, develop hooks, write posts/scripts/captions, study competitors and continuously analyze content performance.

You’ll look at metrics such as:

**LinkedIn:**
Impressions, out-of-network reach, profile visits, followers gained, comments, reposts, saves and comment impressions.

**Instagram:**
Reach, likes, saves, shares, watch time, average watch time, retention and where viewers drop off.

**YouTube:**
Watch time, average view duration, audience retention, likes/dislikes, viewers and subscribers gained.

The expectation is simple:

**Don’t just create content.**

**Understand why it performs.**

**Then make the next piece better.**

Who We Want

We strongly prefer candidates who are already
**strong on at least one platform**
.

— LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube or another major social platform.

* Strong understanding of social media content and platform behaviour
* High learning ability
* Strong research and analytical thinking
* Ability to identify patterns from content data
* Curiosity about why content wins or loses
* The ability to write, not just generate ideas

**You don’t need to be an expert on every platform.**

**But you need to be exceptionally good at understanding at least one.**

**We help anyone, anywhere, Rank Top 3 on Amazon.**

**You’ll create content around Amazon, e-commerce, marketing, growth and business**
while helping build our presence across social platforms.

Virtual Interview

In-office Culture Fit Round in Meerut

Apply only if you are available to work
**6 days a week from our Meerut office**
and can attend the in-office round if shortlisted.

Our
**LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube**
are already on this page.

**Do your homework.**

**Come prepared to tell us:**

**Who are we?**

**What do we do?**

**Who do we help?**

**Why does our content work?**

description:
**Pay:**

On-site, Monday through Friday

**Reports to:**
Chief Executive Officer

**About XpertDox**

XpertDox, Inc. is a physician-founded, venture-backed healthcare AI company headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, with a global delivery team in India. Our platform, XpertCoding, autonomously codes outpatient medical claims directly from clinical documentation using neural networks, machine learning, and natural language processing. We serve outpatient healthcare organizations in almost all 50 states, with deep expertise in Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), women’s health and OB/GYN practices, and behavioral health providers.

**Position Summary**

You own how XpertDox is found and measured online: organic search on Google and Bing, visibility in AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews, the XpertDox website itself, and the analytics that connect a visitor to a demo request and a demo request to a client. You report to the CEO and work alongside the existing marketing lead, who keeps content, campaigns, and brand; you own search, the website, and analytics. This is a hands-on role first. You build the pages, configure the tracking, and run the search program yourself, then hire one to two specialists in your first year and lead them. It is not a strategy-only seat, and it is not a fit for someone who wants to direct an agency and review reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

In this role you will:

* Own organic search performance for XpertDox: keyword strategy for non-branded terms in autonomous medical coding and adjacent categories, technical SEO, on-page optimization, and internal linking.
* Own XpertDox’s visibility in AI answer engines: make XpertDox the source these engines cite and recommend for questions about autonomous coding, and measure how often that happens.
* Own the XpertDox website end to end: build, edit, and publish pages, maintain site structure, speed, and technical health, and ship a landing page for every campaign, conference, and content asset.
* Raise the rate at which visitors become demo requests, using layout tests, form placement, and behavioral data, and document what each test showed.
* Own GA4, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity, and tag management: configuration, event and conversion tracking, dashboards, and monthly reporting to the CEO.
* Maintain lead source attribution from first touch through the CRM so every inbound lead is traceable to a channel and a page.
* Brief the marketing lead on which topics and pages to produce, based on search and AI search demand.
* Hire, onboard, and lead one to two search or analytics specialists within the first year.
* Author a 90-day plan within your first two weeks and present progress to the CEO quarterly.

**Required Qualifications**

* Eight or more years in SEO or organic growth, including three or more years personally owning a company website end to end.
* Demonstrable AI search results: specific, dated examples of increasing citations or recommendations in AI answer engines, with the numbers.
* Before-and-after numbers for organic traffic and conversion that you personally drove, with the changes that produced them.
* Hands-on ownership of GA4, Google Search Console, and a tag manager, including event and conversion configuration.
* Personally built and shipped web pages using HTML, CSS, and a CMS; directing others to build pages does not meet this requirement.
* Experience marketing to a United States audience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* B2B software marketing with long sales cycles and a demo-request funnel.
* Marketing in US healthcare, revenue cycle, or health IT.
* Python or SQL for SEO automation, data pulls, and reporting.

**Location and Schedule**

This role is on-site at our Noida or Bengaluru office, Monday through Friday, 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST, to overlap with the Arizona workday. It is not a remote position. Occasional travel to the Scottsdale, Arizona headquarters may be required; XpertDox may sponsor a B2 visa for that travel.

**Compensation**

* Base salary of ₹30 to ₹45 lakh per year, commensurate with experience.
* Stock options.
* Relocation assistance to Noida, reimbursed against receipts.

**Benefits**

* Leave per XIPL policy.
* Company cab service for all Noida employees.

**To Apply**

Apply at
https://careers.xpertdox.com/

XIPL is an equal opportunity employer.yer.

title: Regulatory Capital Reporting & Analysis - Associate
description:

As a Regulatory Capital Reporting & Analysis Associate on the U.S. Regulatory Capital and Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) Reporting team within Firmwide Regulatory Reporting & Analysis (FRRA), you will oversee the production and integrity of regulatory reports for Capital and Risk-Weighted Assets under Basel III Standardized and Advanced Approaches. * Ensure RWA and related balances comply with regulatory instructions within a robust control and procedural framework.

* Execute internal controls for quarter‑end close and CCAR/Risk Appetite reporting.
* Run cross‑report error reviews and revision decision forums to determine regulatory reporting impacts; communicate instruction changes promptly to stakeholders.

description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. **Job Description:**

* This Vice President will play a key leadership role within Finance Portfolio Management group, supporting the valuation processes across Blackstone Private Equity Strategies(BPES), BXCI, BXMA, Blackstone Infrastructure Partners, Strategic Partners, and GP Stakes.
* The role combines broad private investment valuation expertise with end-to-end management of the Valuation Team's.
* The Vice President will partner with business unit valuation teams, investment teams, finance teams, senior management, auditors, third-party valuation specialists, and vendor leadership to deliver accurate, timely, well-controlled, and scalable valuation processes and related analytics.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual valuation processes across all Finance Portfolio Management business units, adapting the approach and deliverables to the investment strategies, asset classes, and governance requirements of each business.
* Build, review, and maintain valuation models in collaboration with investment teams and finance teams, while coordinating with third-party independent valuation specialists where applicable.
* Apply and promote valuation best practices, including compliance with ASC 820 Fair Value guidance and applicable internal valuation policies and procedures.
* Perform and review analyses that incorporate relevant transaction structures, valuation methodologies, financial models, market data, comparable companies or transactions, appropriate proxies, reserves and valuation adjustments, and relevant accounting, regulatory, and risk considerations.
* Review portfolio company dashboards, portfolio summaries, liquidity analyses, company performance metrics, valuation analytics, committee materials, and other recurring or ad hoc deliverables prepared by junior team members and offshore vendors.
* Analyze and formally communicate key valuation results, judgments, issues, exceptions, and risks to senior management and relevant valuation committees.
* Support LP, stakeholder, and management reporting by maintaining reliable company performance metrics and valuation analytics on centralized platforms.
* Support year-end and interim audit valuation testing, including coordination of valuation models, supporting documentation, data requests, and responses to auditor inquiries.
* Identify and implement process improvements, controls, standardization, automation, and other scalable solutions across business units and vendor-supported workflows, with a particular focus on AI and agentic related solutions.
* Lead special projects and ad hoc analyses based on the needs of senior management and Finance Portfolio Management leadership.

**Offshore Vendor Management:**

* Own the end-to-end operating model for valuation deliverables from planning and work allocation through execution, review, issue resolution, approval, and final delivery.
* Translate business requirements into clear vendor work plans, procedures, templates, calendars, service expectations, quality standards, and escalation protocols. Review and maintain standard operating procedures.
* Coordinate deliverables across internal business unit teams and offshore vendor teams, ensuring that responsibilities, dependencies, inputs, due dates, and review requirements are clearly defined.
* Monitor vendor capacity, staffing, training, knowledge transfer, workflow status, timeliness, accuracy, and completeness, with particular focus on month-end and quarter-end execution.
* Establish and maintain quality-control and management-reporting routines, including deliverable tracking, review evidence, issue logs, root-cause analysis, remediation plans, and performance metrics.
* Serve as the primary day-to-day escalation point for vendor delivery issues; drive timely resolution and elevate material risks, recurring deficiencies, or capacity constraints to appropriate internal and vendor leadership.
* Lead vendor governance forums and periodic performance reviews, and partner with internal stakeholders to continuously improve service quality, controls, efficiency, and scalability.
* Maintain effective documentation of vendor-supported processes, procedures, roles, controls, approvals, and business continuity arrangements.

**Leadership and Team Development:**

* Lead people activities, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management, development, and team culture, and actively support the careers of junior team members.
* Provide clear direction, technical coaching, and timely feedback to internal staff and offshore vendor resources.
* Promote consistent standards, accountability, collaboration, and effective knowledge sharing across a multi-business-unit and multi-location operating model.

**Qualifications:**

* 10 - 15 years of relevant valuation experience at a public accounting firm, third-party valuation provider, investment bank, asset manager, or comparable financial institution. Experience in the alternative investments firm is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field.
* Progress toward or completion of a finance-related professional qualification, such as CFA or CPA, preferred.
* Detailed knowledge of private investment valuation and the application of valuation methodologies across a range of asset classes and investment strategies.
* Strong understanding of financial instrument valuation, financial modeling, market data, and risk measurement in complex product areas.
* Demonstrated experience managing outsourced or offshore service providers, including workflow oversight, quality control, issue management, performance monitoring, and senior stakeholder communication.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, competing priorities, and deadline-driven monthly and quarterly deliverables across business units.
* Strong leadership, judgment, and organizational skills, with the ability to establish accountability across teams that do not all report directly to the role.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex valuation matters and escalate issues clearly and concisely.

title: Lead, Technical Services Engineer - Partners
description:
MongoDB's Technical Services Engineering team uses exceptional problem-solving and customer service skills, along with deep technical experience, to advise customers and solve their complex MongoDB problems: consulting on application and schema design, optimizing performance and scalability, resolving production outages, designing and reviewing operational procedures such as business continuity plans, and explaining MongoDB internals.

As Lead, Technical Services Engineer, Partners, you will mentor, train, and coach a team of Partner TSEs while remaining hands-on with the most complex partner and mutual-customer issues. You will work with the team Manager and take on day-to-day operational responsibility for the team, ensuring caseload is addressed accurately, quickly, and professionally, with a constant focus on customer and partner success. You will also collaborate with Customer Success Management, Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and other internal stakeholders on high-profile partners and customers as we migrate and support business-critical applications.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

### **Required**

* 2+ years of experience leading teams, directly or indirectly
* Patience, empathy, and a genuine desire to help others
* ~7 years of experience building, managing, and maintaining complex, mission-critical, large-scale production database systems (RDBMS, NoSQL, or both).
* Coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, JavaScript, Node.js, Go, etc.
* Experience working with APIs to integrate with 3rd-party technologies and software in areas such as security and fraud, big data analytics and AI, healthcare, content management, IoT, database performance monitoring and management, financial services, and telco
* Solid hands-on systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting process, with significant experience analyzing and troubleshooting end-to-end issues holistically in production, from the application tier through the database down to storage
* Troubleshooting experience with the TCP/IP networking stack on OS and hypervisor, including firewalls and load balancers
* Experience using or administering one or more cloud stacks such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting NAS, SAN, local storage, and multi-pathing
* Experience building solutions involving application workloads and use cases
* Strong background in performance tuning and benchmarking, and in providing technical support to internal and/or external customers
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure, and find solutions in real time

### **Preferred**

* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience developing applications in one or more programming languages using a NoSQL or SQL database
* Strong understanding of authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, and AD
* Experience with distributed version control systems, in particular git
* Experience with Kubernetes or other orchestration systems using vendor-specific Enterprise operators
* Experience working with software product teams, and familiarity with product release processes from planning to release

### **Success Measures**

* In 3 months, you will have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its partner ecosystem, completed New Hire Training, and built working relationships with your team, the Manager, and key partner and internal stakeholders
* In 6 months, you will be running day-to-day team operations (workflow, escalations, meetings) with the Manager, comfortable working frontline with customers and partners, and will have completed the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam
* In 12 months, you will be a recognized technical specialist and people leader: your team's engineers are growing and independently handling technical escalations, partner Centers of Excellence are in place for onboarded partners, and you are driving regular pain and bug reporting and operational improvements with Engineering and internal teams

### **Responsibilities**

Team leadership and operations

* Drive customer and partner success by guiding the team to solve complex technical problems, from design through production operations, including managing team workflow, assisting on hands-on customer issues, and managing internal and external escalations
* Work with the team Manager to assume day-to-day operational responsibility for the team, including hiring, training, mentoring, coaching, meetings, and performance evaluations
* Ensure caseload is addressed accurately, quickly, and professionally, and actively monitor partner-related cases to ensure correct handling
* Contribute to internal technical projects, which can include software development, benchmarking, building documentation and training guides, and providing oversight on other engineers' project work
* Ensure we are investing the right resources, addressing the right problems, and scaling the organization properly: drive monthly and quarterly pain and bug reports to Engineering, improve operational workflows with internal teams at MongoDB, coordinate regional trainings, summits, and conferences, and help address market demand for our product and services more broadly

Direct partner support

* Provide in-market support for technology partners to ensure good customer outcomes
* Provide development support through the Design-Win process, helping partners get to market via MongoDB best practices and solution interoperability guidance
* Act as the domain expert and context source for partner-related matters, and facilitate partner engagement as needed
* Onboard partners: document contacts, establish escalation paths, and set up communication channels (Slack, recurring review and check-in cadence)
* Lead Partners Center of Excellence work per onboarded partner: build a partner-specific knowledge base, perform technology reviews of the partner's solution and integration, review partner solution releases for known MongoDB issues, maintain as-built documentation (deployment architecture, product/solution matrix, known issues), communicate best practices, and build a risk mitigation plan

Support for joint and mutual customers

* Lead multi-vendor collaboration when an issue's root cause spans multiple vendors
* Manage mutual support systems and case-handling processes
* Manage partner escalation contacts and processes
* Collaborate with Customer Success Management, Solutions Architects, and other internal stakeholders on high-profile customers as we migrate and support business-critical applications

Program-level objectives the role serves

* Centralized point of contact within Technical Services for partner-account support matters
* Knowledge hub within TS for all partner-related information
* Minimizing technical-interoperability risk for mutual customers
* Champion the customer's and partner's needs and contribute to the evolution of our Developer Data Platform

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

Because medicine should fit into life, not force life to fit around it. With more than 70 medicines across 11 therapeutic areas, Azurity's mission is fueled by a growing portfolio that reaches millions of people in more than 50 countries. Learn more at www.azurity.com and LinkedIn.

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**

Azurity's Legal team supports a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products in the U.S. and globally. We are seeking a dynamic, commercially oriented attorney to serve as a key legal resource for promotional review and commercial activities, partnering closely with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Compliance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to support compliant product promotion and commercialization.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Serve as a primary legal reviewer in Azurity's Promotional Materials Review Committee (PMRC/MLR) process, reviewing U.S. and global promotional and non-promotional materials and advising on applicable legal and compliance requirements.

* Partner with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Compliance, and other stakeholders to advise on compliant commercial strategies, brand plans, campaigns, and tactics, including appropriate claims, messaging, and supporting materials.
* Help oversee and continuously improve the PMRC/MLR review process, including workflows, governance, escalation pathways, consistency of review, and development of practical guidance and best practices.
* Proactively identify, analyze, and assess legal and compliance risks relating to Azurity products and commercial activities, including risks arising under applicable U.S. and global pharmaceutical advertising and promotional requirements.
* Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, including marketing, sales and commercial operations agreements, statements of work, consulting arrangements, and change orders.
* Provide legal support on other commercial, compliance, and cross-functional matters as needed.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* LL.B. / LL.M. from a recognized college or university, with approximately 5+ years of post-qualification legal experience, including at least 2+ years of experience supporting pharmaceutical promotional/MLR review for products marketed in the U.S.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing pharmaceutical promotional and non-promotional materials and advising Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, and Compliance stakeholders.
* Strong working knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical laws, regulations, and industry requirements, including the Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, HIPAA, and Sunshine Act, as applicable to pharmaceutical commercial activities.
* Familiarity with FDA requirements and principles governing prescription drug advertising and promotion, including claims, fair balance, substantiation, and scientific communications.
* Experience with or knowledge of global pharmaceutical advertising and promotional requirements strongly preferred.
* Experience with Vodori or a similar pharmaceutical promotional review and approval platform preferred.
* Experience supporting innovator and/or 505(b)(2) pharmaceutical products preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal guidance and work effectively with stakeholders across geographies and functions.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

description:
**Job Description: Meta Ads Expert – Lead Generation & Meeting Bookings**

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Meta Ads Expert who specialises in lead generation and qualified meeting bookings for service-based businesses.

The ideal candidate has a proven track record of running Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns that generate high-quality leads, book sales meetings, and contribute to revenue growth.

We are specifically looking for someone with experience in B2B services, agencies, IT services, software development, consulting, or other high-ticket service businesses.

Important: Candidates with only D2C, e-commerce, or product sales advertising experience should not apply. We need someone who understands service-based lead generation and the process of converting prospects into qualified sales opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

* Plan, launch, and optimise Meta Ads campaigns focused on lead generation and qualified meeting bookings.
* Generate high-quality leads for service-based businesses targeting markets such as the USA, UK, Europe, and other international markets.
* Develop effective campaign strategies across Facebook and Instagram to reach the right target audience.
* Build and test audience segments, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, creatives, ad copy, and landing pages.
* Optimise campaigns for cost per lead (CPL), cost per qualified lead, cost per booked meeting, show-up rate, and lead-to-customer conversion.
* Develop and test lead forms, landing pages, funnels, retargeting campaigns, and conversion strategies.
* Track and analyse campaign performance using Meta Ads Manager, Pixel, Conversions API, GA4, and CRM integrations.
* Work closely with the sales and marketing teams to improve lead quality and meeting conversion rates.
* Regularly experiment with creatives, offers, messaging, audiences, and campaign structures to improve results.
* Manage advertising budgets efficiently while maintaining lead quality and scalability.
* Prepare regular performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.

Required Skills & Experience

* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads campaigns.
* Demonstrable experience in lead generation for B2B services, agencies, IT services, consulting, or other service-based businesses.
* Proven ability to generate qualified leads and book sales meetings, not just generate form submissions.
* Experience running campaigns for international markets, preferably the USA and UK.
* Strong understanding of lead funnels, audience targeting, retargeting, conversion tracking, and campaign optimisation.
* Experience with CRM platforms and lead tracking, including integration with landing pages and lead forms.
* Ability to analyse performance metrics and make data-driven decisions.
* Strong understanding of ad creatives, copy testing, and landing-page conversion optimisation.

Performance Metrics You Should Understand

You should be comfortable tracking and improving:

* Cost per lead (CPL)
* Cost per qualified lead (CPQL)
* Cost per booked meeting
* Meeting show-up rate
* Lead-to-meeting conversion rate
* Meeting-to-customer conversion rate
* Customer acquisition cost (CAC)
* Return on ad spend and overall campaign profitability

Who Should Not Apply

* Candidates whose experience is limited to D2C or e-commerce advertising.
* Candidates who have only run campaigns for product sales, online stores, or catalogue sales.
* Candidates who focus only on impressions, reach, clicks, or cheap leads without considering lead quality.
* Candidates without hands-on experience managing and optimising Meta Ads campaigns.
* Candidates unable to demonstrate actual campaign results.

What We’re Looking For

We value practical experience, ownership, experimentation, and measurable results. You should be able to explain what campaigns you have run, the markets you targeted, the budgets you managed, the cost of acquiring qualified leads, and how your campaigns contributed to sales meetings and business growth.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Curation Specialist - India
description:
**Job Title:**
Curation Specialist

**Location:**
Remote, India

**Work Hours:**
8:00 AM to 5:00 PM IST

**Employment:**
Full Time

**Experience:**
Junior to mid-level: 1–5 years in talent acquisition, recruiting, or a similar function in a hyper-growth, competitive environment

**Position Overview**

The Curation Specialist builds and runs private talent communities for direct sourcing programs within Global Clients – APAC. You find people with the skills and interest to become contract workers, keep them engaged, and put the right candidates in front of recruiters the moment roles open. You work in WorkLLama, a direct sourcing platform, with AI-assisted search and Boolean sourcing.

The role suits a talent acquisition professional with one to five years of experience and a concentration in sourcing, ideally from a staffing firm, recruitment process outsourcing (RPO) provider, or direct sourcing program. You care about the candidate experience, write clearly, and like watching a well-kept pipeline turn into hires.

Raise is a workforce solutions company that connects people in meaningful work.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Pooling and Proactive Recruitment**

• Use client historical and active job data to spot roles and locations with volume hiring potential, then build and maintain targeted talent pools.

• Source candidates into talent pools through internal channels (client applicant tracking systems, alumni and retirees, silver medalists, and internal networks) and external channels (Raise databases, job boards, social media and email campaigns, hiring events, and campus outreach).

• Create and manage Expression of Interest (EOI) job postings across internal and external platforms.

• Screen candidates by phone, digital interview, and skills assessment to keep talent pools current and qualified.

• Enrich candidate profiles with screening notes and keep statuses up to date.

• Alert the Delivery and marketing teams when a talent pool needs more external sourcing or marketing support.

**Active Job Management**

• Use AI suggestions and Boolean search to find matching candidates in the talent community and pools.

• Shortlist qualified candidates for recruiter screening and further evaluation.

• Reach out by SMS and email to confirm candidate interest and generate referrals.

• Deliver a high-quality candidate experience through every stage, including interviews and offers.

**Candidate Engagement**

• Give candidates timely updates on their application status.

• Record feedback on candidate profiles so the next conversation starts where the last one ended.

• Run 60-day check-ins with the talent community to confirm fit for upcoming roles, using automation where it helps.

• Build long-term relationships that keep the pipeline healthy for current and upcoming needs.

**Local Compliance and Candidate Process**

• Write and publish job postings that meet the employment, equal opportunity, and anti-discrimination rules of each country you post in, including what a posting may and may not ask for.

• Run a consistent candidate process: screen every candidate against the same job-related criteria, and keep personal questions out of screening.

• Handle candidate data in line with local privacy law. Get consent before collecting data, use it only for the purpose stated, and keep records accurate and secure.

• In India, this includes the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and the equal opportunity and equal pay requirements of Indian labour law. Postings must not state preferences based on gender, caste, religion, marital status, or disability.

• Raise compliance questions early with the Regional Account Director, and stay current as local rules change.

**Core Competencies**

•
**Sourcing craft:**
Builds strong Boolean strings, uses AI search well, and knows where hard-to-find talent spends time.

•
**Candidate care:**
Treats every candidate as a future hire and keeps them informed.

•
**Communication:**
Excellent written and verbal communication, with a focus on candidate care and customer service.

•
**Data-minded:**
Uses reporting to see which pools are healthy, which need work, and where to focus next.

•
**Resourcefulness:**
Solves problems proactively and finds a new route when a channel runs dry.

**Technical Skills**

The Curation Specialist works across several systems every day and should be comfortable with each of the following:

•
**Applicant tracking systems (ATS):**
Manages candidate records, statuses, and notes accurately.

•
**Direct sourcing platforms:**
Builds and manages talent pools and EOI postings. WorkLLama experience is a plus.

•
**Sourcing tools:**
Uses Boolean search, AI-assisted matching, job boards, and social platforms to find and engage talent.

•
**Reporting tools:**
Uses Microsoft Excel or similar tools to track pipeline activity and report on results.

**Education & Experience**

• One to five years in talent acquisition, recruiting, or a similar function in a hyper-growth, competitive environment, with a concentration in sourcing.

• Strategic sourcing and talent engagement experience.

• Prior experience at a staffing firm, RPO, or in a direct sourcing environment.

• Proficiency with applicant tracking systems and recruitment technology.

• Familiarity with data reporting and analysis tools.

• Must reside in India and have the right to work there.

**Why This Role Matters**

You sit at the front of talent acquisition innovation. Your work keeps each client's private talent community a competitive advantage: responsive, relationship-driven, and aligned with what the business needs next. Every pipeline you build and every candidate you keep engaged shortens the path to a hire.

**Our Commitment**

Raise is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to gender, caste, religion, marital status, disability, or any other status protected under Indian law.

We collect and use your personal data only to assess your application, with your consent, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
