title: Associate-Resource Management
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Resource Management Advanced Associate**
As a Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will be part of an industry leading, high performing and agile team of workforce management professionals providing exceptional client service to our stakeholders and helping our employees gain differential experiences that are aligned to their career aspirations.
  
  
We provide learning and growth opportunities to build your ability to analyze, innovate, think and act globally. You’ll be part of an organization that is focused on optimization, is solution oriented, innovates and provides best in class services to the client serving teams.
  
  
**The opportunity**
EY Global Delivery Services (EY GDS) is a dynamic and global service delivery network of over 50,000 professionals working across borders, to provide innovative and strategic business solutions to EY member firms and EY clients globally. Resource Management plays a vital role in the firm’s Next Wave strategy and it’s purpose of building a better working world.
  
  
We offer a great place to work for every person joining EY. At GDS, you will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a truly global environment. You will learn and gain experiences from industry leading WFM professionals and a path breaking leadership team.
  
  
We invest in your learning and development. We’ll help you develop the technical and soft skills you need. We support your professional development with a combination of learning, networking, experiences, and coaching. As part of a 300+ member team, supporting 4 unique Service Lines, you will always have opportunities to showcase your skills and contribute to the firm’s strategic initiatives.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As an Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will work as the staffing point of contact for the assigned region/service/competency team and will be responsible to work with the service delivery managers in capturing staffing demand projections, analyze demand intake patterns, demand – supply matching, demand – supply gaps, schedule individuals on projects, optimize employee utilization and bench management.
  
  
**Some of your key responsibilities include:**

* Capture demand projections, understand demands heuristics and identify actionable demand.
* Calculate staffing requirements based on demand projections, delivery deadlines and productivity targets.
* Identify suitable staffing options based on matching skills, roles and experiences.
* Create staffing schedules to maximize service and minimize cost.
* Timely update of employee schedules on the schedule management tool (Retain).
* Timely review and resolution of scheduling conflicts.
* Proactive review of resource availability/future project demands.
* Minimize bench pipeline through proactive deployment on projects.
* Minimize open, unfulfilled demand.
* Track monitor and report on WFM KPIs such as employee utilization, time to fulfil demand, unfulfilled demand % and bench aging.
* Basic reporting and analysis.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
Graduates with 2-3 years of relevant workforce management experience. Understanding of business models, operational and financial aspects of service delivery will be preferred. The suitable candidate should have good analytical skills, can compute staffing demands, validate skills and experiences associated with the demand, identify suitable fulfilment options from the internal pool of professionals available for allocation or on bench and negotiate staffing solutions with the service delivery managers.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Excellent analytical skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel.
* Excellent teaming and interpersonal skills.
* Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on workforce management concepts, resource deployment and scheduling.
* Working knowledge and subject matter expertise in resource management, demand planning and scheduling in reputed consulting, technology, financial services, accounting and professional services organizations.

**What We Look For**
We are looking for go-getters with a solution oriented and analytical mindset. Someone who is good with numbers and has the willingness to learn. The successful candidate will be one who combines computer skills and mathematical ability with a working knowledge of the business and the negotiation skills of a salesman.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Manager, Service Excellence
description:
**Job Summary**
---------------

Reporting to the Director of Service Excellence, the Service Excellence Manager will help improve how People Services & Solutions (PSS) delivers services to colleagues, while also leading the transition of People processes into PSS.

The role will focus primarily on service excellence, including service quality, operational performance, governance, continuous improvement and colleague experience. It will also play an important role in managing process transitions into PSS and ensuring new services are ready for successful delivery.

You will work with People leaders, Centres of Excellence (CoEs), PSS teams and project teams across regions. You will use data, feedback and service insights to improve performance, strengthen service delivery and help teams adopt new processes and ways of working.

  
  

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Improve Service Quality and Colleague Experience**

You will help strengthen service delivery across PSS by using service measures, colleague feedback and operational data to understand performance and focus improvement efforts.

You will support a consistent approach to service quality across teams and locations. This includes reviewing service performance, understanding trends and helping teams make practical changes that improve quality, efficiency and colleague experience.

You will also help develop service measures and dashboards that give teams clear information to support day-to-day decisions and monitor progress.

### **Strengthen Operational Performance**

You will help PSS teams build strong and sustainable service practices through regular performance reviews, clear measures and effective operational controls.

Working with service delivery teams and leaders, you will help strengthen quality, capability and operational rigor. You will use service reviews and data to highlight areas that need attention and work with teams to address them.

You will support risk assessments and help ensure appropriate controls are in place to protect service quality and continuity.

### **Build Service Capability**

You will help PSS teams develop the skills and knowledge needed to provide a positive and consistent colleague experience.

This will include coaching, sharing practical guidance and supporting learning activities that strengthen service behaviours, problem-solving and continuous improvement.

You will encourage teams to learn from feedback, share what works and recognise improvements that make a significant difference to colleagues.

### **Lead People Process Transitions**

You will plan and manage the transition of People processes into PSS, from initial planning through knowledge transfer, implementation and stabilisation.

You will work with the teams involved to agree scope, responsibilities, timelines and readiness requirements. You will track progress, manage risks and help resolve issues that could affect the transition.

You will make sure essential materials are ready for use, including Desktop Procedures (DTPs), process maps, SLAs/OLAs and training materials. You will also help PSS teams build the knowledge and confidence needed to take ownership of new services.

### **Support People Through Change**

You will help colleagues prepare for changes to processes, systems and ways of working. This includes understanding the impact of change, supporting communications and training, and checking that teams are ready before services move into PSS.

You will bring together different perspectives and encourage open discussion. Communication, training and transition activities should consider the different needs of colleagues across teams and locations.

### **Turn Data into Action**

You will use service measures, quality reviews, colleague feedback and operational data to understand patterns and service trends.

You will turn these insights into practical recommendations that help teams improve service quality, simplify processes and strengthen colleague experience.

  
  

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

You will bring experience in service excellence, service delivery, People Operations, HR operations, process improvement, transitions or a related area.

You will be comfortable working with data, understanding service performance and turning findings into practical improvements. You will be able to organise complex work, communicate clearly and build positive working relationships across teams, levels and regions.

Experience with service quality, operational governance, organisational change, process mapping or continuous improvement would be useful. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Voice of the Customer, Workday, ServiceNow or process mapping tools would also be helpful, but you do not need experience in all of these areas.

You should be comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

We recognise that relevant skills can be gained through different roles, industries and career paths. **You do not need to meet every desirable criterion to apply.**

**Career Stage:**

Manager

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

title: Senior Analyst, Learning - Continuous Listening
description:
Job Description:

**Role Purpose**
================

Lead the delivery and continuous improvement of enterprise Learning Applications, while also providing technical application and integration leadership for the Continuous Listening platform.

The role is primarily accountable for the global learning technology portfolio, including Cornerstone OnDemand adjacent learning platforms and application rationalization. It also owns the technical enablement of Continuous Listening on Qualtrics, with emphasis on integrations, data flows, identity and access, security, releases and production support.

This role combines program management, stakeholder leadership and application ownership. It translates business priorities into governed roadmaps, coordinates cross-functional delivery, manages vendors and ensures solutions are scalable, secure, supportable and aligned with Schneider Digital architecture.

**Scope and Impact**
====================

* Primary responsibility for global Learning Applications serving employees, partners, customers and other learning populations.
* Technical and integration responsibility for the global Continuous Listening platform and its connected HR data and reporting ecosystem.
* Leadership of multi-region programs, releases, pilots, upgrades, integrations, migrations, application lifecycle decisions and operational improvements.
* Senior stakeholder interface across Global HR COEs, business leaders, Schneider Digital, Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Data, Procurement, regional teams and strategic vendors.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Learning Applications Leadership**
------------------------------------

* Define and deliver the learning technology roadmap aligned with enterprise HR and Schneider Digital strategy.
* Own the application lifecycle for Cornerstone OnDemand and connected learning platforms, including roadmap, releases, upgrades, feature enablement, service performance and lifecycle decisions.
* Program-manage the transition to Learn / Single Architecture and selected Learn+ capabilities, coordinating environment readiness, configuration, integrations, UAT, cutover, hypercare and stabilization.
* Coordinate learning integrations across HR master data, identity and access, skills, content providers, analytics and data platforms, collaboration tools and external learning audiences.
* Lead portfolio rationalization, supporting retain, integrate, consolidate, replace and retire decisions across global and regional learning applications.
* Coordinate responsible-AI, data, content, privacy, cybersecurity and production-readiness governance for AI-enabled learning capabilities.
* Drive adoption and measurable value across discoverability, learner engagement, time to competence, administration efficiency, platform reliability and workforce readiness.

**Continuous Listening Technology and Integration Ownership**
-------------------------------------------------------------

* Own the technical application lifecycle and roadmap for the Qualtrics Continuous Listening platform, including environments, configuration governance, releases, vendor changes and transition to steady-state support.
* Lead integration design and delivery across HR source systems, employee and organizational data, identity and access management, SSO, APIs, middleware, secure file transfers, survey distribution processes, dashboards and approved downstream analytics.
* Define and govern interface specifications, data mapping, transformation rules, scheduling, reconciliation, monitoring, error handling and support ownership for end-to-end data flows.
* Coordinate technical readiness for survey waves and dashboards, including population and hierarchy validation, role-based access, anonymity and confidentiality controls, testing, deployment, hypercare and rollback planning.
* Ensure controls for privileged access, personal and employee-experience data, retention, encryption, audit logging, third-party security, privacy reviews, application certification and remediation evidence.
* Lead incident and problem management for platform, integration, data-quality and reporting issues, including root-cause analysis, vendor escalation and corrective-action tracking.
* Maintain solution architecture, integration inventory, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, access models, environment strategy, release calendar, runbooks and operational documentation.
* Translate listening, survey and dashboard requirements into scalable technical designs and clearly communicate feasibility, constraints, dependencies and risks to business stakeholders.
* Provide technical governance for platform enhancements and AI-enabled listening use cases before production release.

**Program and Project Leadership**
----------------------------------

* Lead end-to-end delivery from intake and discovery through planning, execution, UAT, launch, stabilization and benefits realization.
* Build integrated plans covering scope, milestones, stage gates, resources, financials, RAID, dependencies, change, adoption, vendor deliverables and operational handover.
* Run steering reviews, decision forums, executive reporting, escalation management and cross-functional delivery cadences.
* Establish clear readiness and go/no-go criteria covering business, technical, data, security, privacy, support and change readiness.
* Apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban and enterprise stage-gate practices based on initiative needs.

**Stakeholder, Change and Vendor Management**
---------------------------------------------

* Serve as a senior technology partner to Learning, Employee Listening and HR COEs, translating priorities into executable digital roadmaps.
* Facilitate requirements, prioritization and trade-off decisions among business owners, regions, technical teams and vendors.
* Prepare executive-ready status reports, decision papers, recommendations and QBR materials.
* Drive structured change, communications, administrator enablement, user readiness and adoption measurement.
* Hold Cornerstone, Qualtrics and service partners accountable for technical deliverables, issue resolution, roadmap commitments and SLA performance.
* Support renewals, SOWs, license planning, commercial assessments, forecasts and benefits reporting.

**Operational Excellence, Risk and Compliance**
-----------------------------------------------

* Ensure clean transition to operations with defined L1/L2/L3 ownership, runbooks, monitoring, escalation paths and service reviews.
* Drive incident reduction, change success, integration reliability, data quality and mean time to restore.
* Ensure architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, data-protection, accessibility and production-readiness requirements are completed before release.
* Promote reusable technical standards, integration patterns, delivery checklists, governance templates and lessons learned.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Required**
------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, HR Technology, Learning Technologies or a related field.
* 8 to 10 years of progressive experience in enterprise applications, HR technology or digital transformation, including at least 3 years leading global or multi-region initiatives.
* Strong experience with enterprise learning platforms such as Cornerstone OnDemand, including application lifecycle, releases, integrations and production support.
* Technical application or integration experience with survey and employee-experience platforms such as Qualtrics.
* Hands-on experience defining or governing integrations using APIs, SSO/SAML, secure file transfer, middleware/connectors, HR data feeds, organizational hierarchies and analytics or dashboard data flows.
* Experience with UAT, cutover, hypercare, release management, operational handover, incident/problem management and vendor-led technical delivery.
* Demonstrated stakeholder-management experience across senior HR, business, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Data, Procurement and vendor organizations.
* Strong understanding of SaaS security, access controls, data privacy, application certification, audit evidence and service management.
* Excellent program management, executive communication, facilitation, negotiation and structured problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

* PMP or PRINCE2 Practitioner.
* Agile Scrum Master or SAFe certification.
* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Cornerstone OnDemand Administrator or relevant vendor certification.
* Qualtrics platform or integration training/certification.
* Azure Integration Services, API management, Power BI, data fundamentals or AI-focused certification.

(External) English Qualifications:

**Success Metrics**
===================

* On-time and on-budget delivery of learning and Continuous Listening technology roadmap commitments.
* Successful Learn / Learn+ releases against technical readiness, UAT, cutover, security and stabilization criteria.
* Reliable Qualtrics integrations, accurate survey populations and hierarchies, stable dashboard data flows and successful production releases.
* Platform stability, SLA achievement, change success, incident reduction and improved MTTR.

* Strong stakeholder confidence, timely decisions, transparent risks and effective vendor performance.

**Working Model**
=================

title: Implementation Lead
description:
**About the Role**  
  
As an Implementation Lead for Employee Transportation Services (ETS), you will own the journey of large enterprise clients from solution deep-dive through to the successful onboarding, launch and stabilization of managed employee commute programs across India and APAC.  
  
You will act as the critical bridge between Sales, Product and long-term client success — closing mid-funnel deals through in-depth, customized demos, leading complex client integrations and pre-launch readiness, and ensuring a seamless transition from signed deal to a fully integrated, operating program.  
  
You will partner with customers’ Transport, Admin, HR, Security, IT and Facilities teams, and with Sales, Operations, Product, Engineering, Safety, Customer Trust and Support teams internally, to deliver safe, reliable and cost-efficient commute solutions — from roster and route design through go-live and steady-state performance.  
  
The role sits at the intersection of operations, program management and customer success, directly impacting service quality, customer satisfaction and revenue growth, and is pivotal to building a repeatable ETS launch engine.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* Own in-depth, customized ETS solution demos — including client-specific configuration discussions and scenario simulations (e.g., Guard vs. Non-Guard trips, On-Time vs. Delayed trips) — to validate fit and close deals alongside Account Executives, and lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) sessions after deal signing
* Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the sales cycle, owning and supporting the technical sections of RFPs and client proposals to accelerate deal closures
* Lead end-to-end implementation of ETS programs for enterprise clients — from requirements gathering and site readiness through pilot, go-live and hypercare — ensuring seamless and timely launches
* Partner with customers to understand shift patterns, employee rosters, pickup/drop locations and commute policies, and translate them into routing, fleet and service design
* Define SLAs and success metrics with customers (e.g., on-time performance, seat utilization, trip completion, safety incidents, employee satisfaction) and drive adoption among employees, transport admins and operations teams
* Work with fleet partners, drivers and on-ground operations teams to ensure vehicle, driver and compliance readiness (permits, insurance, driver verification, vehicle fitness) before and after launch
* Implement safety and compliance protocols, including night-shift and women-employee safety requirements, in-vehicle safety features and incident escalation processes
* Coordinate technical onboarding with Product, Engineering and Global Shared Services (GSS) — roster uploads, HRMS/attendance, SFTP and SSO integrations, data pipelines, user and policy configuration, and billing set-up — keeping core engineering focused on product builds
* Navigate client InfoSec and compliance requirements alongside the Customer Trust team, and drive pre-launch readiness and UAT to sign-off so that each program is handed over to Operations fully documented and launch-ready
* Run regular operational reviews with customers, analyze performance data, root-cause service gaps and drive corrective actions and continuous cost and efficiency improvements; identify growth opportunities such as new sites, shifts, shuttle routes and EV adoption
* Relay client feedback, technical requirements and market learnings to the Product team to influence the ETS roadmap, set accurate client expectations on capabilities and timelines, and escalate forward-looking feature requests
* Build and maintain ETS enablement resources — feature lists, FAQs, sales collateral and standardized demo narratives — support repeatable demo environments (test accounts and simulated trips), and test new feature rollouts for incoming clients ahead of launch
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients and deeply understand ETS products, operating model and tools to deliver customer trainings, onboarding sessions and troubleshoot customer issues

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* 4+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in a client-facing role (implementation, program/project management, operations, consulting, account management or similar)
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, sites and deadlines in operationally intensive environments
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage customer leadership as well as on-ground operations and vendor teams
* Demonstrated ability to deliver technical product demonstrations and explain complex solutions clearly to business, technical and operations audiences
* Working knowledge of enterprise integration concepts (SFTP, SSO, HRMS, data pipelines) and experience managing end-to-end implementations, including UAT and InfoSec/compliance reviews
* Proven ability to influence and work across Sales, Product, Engineering and Operations teams without direct authority
* Strong analytical skills, with working proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (SQL or BI tools a plus) to track SLAs and operational KPIs

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience in employee transportation, corporate commute or shuttle services, fleet management, logistics, mobility or transport/facilities outsourcing
* Familiarity with India transport and compliance requirements — vehicle permits, driver verification and safety norms for night-shift and women-employee transportation
* Experience managing fleet/vendor partners and SLA-driven contracts
* Experience in SaaS, tech or platform-based environments, including rollout of routing, rostering or workforce-mobility technology
* Experience supporting RFPs and enterprise procurement processes, and building enablement material such as training curricula, FAQs and collateral
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, handle on-ground escalations and drive solutions
* Fluency in English and Hindi; additional regional/APAC languages are a plus.

  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

title: Senior Workday Integration Consultant
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role:**

  

As a Senior Workday Integration Consultant, you will provide technical leadership for the design, development, deployment, and optimization of enterprise Workday integrations across HCM, Financials, and Professional Services Automation (PSA). You will partner with business stakeholders, architects, and technical teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performing integration solutions while driving modernization, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the Workday landscape.

  

**What Will You Do:**

  

* Lead the design, development, deployment, and optimization of Workday inbound, outbound, and boomerang integrations across HCM, Financials, and PSA domains.
* Conduct integration workshops with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and design scalable integration solutions aligned with organizational objectives.
* Design and implement integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Cloud Connectors, Web Services APIs, middleware platforms, and Workday Extend capabilities.
* Manage and support Workday releases, enhancements, upgrades, and integration lifecycle activities while ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Provide advanced technical troubleshooting and resolution for complex integration, data, workflow, and platform issues.
* Lead, mentor, and guide Workday technical specialists while promoting knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with business, HR, Finance, PSA, and technology teams to ensure successful delivery of integration initiatives within scope, schedule, and quality expectations.
Manage integration roadmaps, RAID logs, status reporting, risk mitigation activities, and stakeholder communications across multiple projects and support engagements.  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  
The career path ahead is full of exciting opportunities to grow and advance within the job family. With dedication and hard work, you can climb the ladder to higher bands, achieving coveted positions such as Principal Engineer or Vice President of Software. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* 8+ years of experience, including significant hands-on experience in Workday Integration development, support, and solution delivery.
* Deep expertise in Workday Integration technologies, including Workday Studio, EIB, Web Services APIs, Cloud Connectors, PECI, Report Writer, and Enterprise Interface design.
* Strong experience with Workday Business Process Framework, Configurable Security, Calculated Fields, and Workday reporting solutions.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting Workday Extend applications, workflows, integrations, and custom business solutions.
* Strong integration experience using XML, XSLT, Web Services, REST/SOAP APIs, middleware solutions such as Informatica, and enterprise integration technologies.
* Experience supporting Workday HCM, Financials, and Professional Services Automation (PSA) integrations within complex enterprise environments.
* Proven experience leading integration projects, managing stakeholders, conducting workshops, troubleshooting critical production issues, and driving successful delivery outcomes.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business teams.  

**Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

  

* Knowledge and experience with Workday Orchestrate for workflow automation and integration orchestration.
* Experience designing integrations across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise application ecosystems using modern integration architectures.
* Experience with DevOps tools, CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices.
* Certification in Workday Integration, Workday Extend, or related Workday technical specializations preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, along with certifications in Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), is highly desirable.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.

**About the Role**

Azurity’s Legal team supports a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products in the U.S. and globally. We are seeking a dynamic, commercially oriented attorney to serve as a key legal resource for promotional review and commercial activities, partnering closely with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Compliance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to support compliant product promotion and commercialization.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Serve as a primary legal reviewer in Azurity’s Promotional Materials Review Committee (PMRC/MLR) process, reviewing U.S. and global promotional and non-promotional materials and advising on applicable legal and compliance requirements.
* Provide legal advice on prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceutical advertising, promotional messaging and activities, including sales and speaker materials, digital and social media, training materials, scientific communications, disease awareness materials, patient support materials, payor materials, and advisory board materials.
* Partner with Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, Compliance, and other stakeholders to advise on compliant commercial strategies, brand plans, campaigns, and tactics, including appropriate claims, messaging, and supporting materials.
* Help oversee and continuously improve the PMRC/MLR review process, including workflows, governance, escalation pathways, consistency of review, and development of practical guidance and best practices.
* Proactively identify, analyze, and assess legal and compliance risks relating to Azurity products and commercial activities, including risks arising under applicable U.S. and global pharmaceutical advertising and promotional requirements.

* Provide legal support on other commercial, compliance, and cross-functional matters as needed.

**Qualifications and Education Requirements**

* LL.B. / LL.M. from a recognized college or university, with approximately 5+ years of post-qualification legal experience, including at least 2+ years of experience supporting pharmaceutical promotional/MLR review for products marketed in the U.S.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing pharmaceutical promotional and non-promotional materials and advising Commercial, Medical, Regulatory, and Compliance stakeholders.
* Strong working knowledge of U.S. pharmaceutical laws, regulations, and industry requirements, including the Anti-Kickback Statute, False Claims Act, HIPAA, and Sunshine Act, as applicable to pharmaceutical commercial activities.

* Experience with or knowledge of global pharmaceutical advertising and promotional requirements strongly preferred.
* Experience with Vodori or a similar pharmaceutical promotional review and approval platform preferred.
* Experience supporting innovator and/or 505(b)(2) pharmaceutical products preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal guidance and work effectively with stakeholders across geographies and functions.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

description:

Job Summary

The Compliance Analyst is responsible for supporting the execution, administration, and continuous improvement of HR compliance programs across the global organization. Reporting to the Manager, HR Compliance, this role helps ensure adherence to employment laws, regulatory requirements, internal controls, company policies, and data privacy standards while supporting operational excellence within the People Operations function.

The Compliance Specialist serves as a trusted compliance partner to HR stakeholders and plays a key role in regulatory reporting, audit readiness, compliance investigations, risk mitigation, and governance activities. This position works closely with Legal, Internal Audit, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, HR Technology, Employee Relations, and senior business leaders to address compliance requirements, support audits, resolve complex issues, and mitigate organizational risk.

The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Core Responsibilities

HR Compliance Operations

* Administer and support HR compliance programs and activities across the employee lifecycle.

* Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, local, and international employment regulations, company policies, and internal controls.

* Maintain compliance records, documentation, tracking tools, and reporting schedules.

* Support regulatory reporting requirements and government submissions.

* Assist in conducting compliance assessments, monitoring controls, and identifying areas of risk.

* Ensure compliance-related activities are completed accurately and within established timelines.

* Support I-9 employment eligibility verification and reverification tracking for newhires and terminations.

Support occupational health and credentialing administration, including drug screens, physicals, titers, and Letters of Compliance for client and program-specific populations (e.g., IRG nursing, commercial client credentialing).

* Maintain accurate documentation of compliance matters, investigations, and resolutions.

Monitor trends and recurring issues to identify opportunities for improvement and risk reduction.  



Legal & Executive Stakeholder Partnership

* Serve as a key liaison between People Operations and Legal on compliance-related matters, policy interpretation, regulatory inquiries, investigations, and audit requests.

* Prepare compliance analyses, reports, risk assessments, and supporting documentation for leadership review.

* Support investigations involving regulatory, employment, or policy-related concerns.

* Present compliance findings, recommendations, and status updates to managers and leadership stakeholders as required.

* Collaborate with leadership teams to ensure compliance risks are appropriately identified, documented, and resolved.

Build effective working relationships with stakeholders across multiple functions and organizational levels.  



Regulatory Compliance & Audit Support

* Coordinate and support internal audits, external audits, and compliance reviews.

* Prepare audit documentation, reports, evidence, and responses to information requests.

* Monitor regulatory developments and support implementation of changes to compliance processes, procedures, and policies.

* Track audit findings, action plans, and remediation activities to ensure timely completion.

* Maintain audit-ready records and documentation to support regulatory and internal governance requirements.

Support compliance initiatives related to employment law, data privacy, internal controls, and regulatory obligations.  



Background Screening & Compliance Vendor Management

* Support administration of global background screening programs and related compliance activities.

* Partner with Talent Acquisition, Legal, HR Operations, and vendors to ensure background screening processes comply with company policies and local regulations.

* Monitor vendor performance, service levels, and compliance requirements.

* Assist with compliance-related vendor audits, reporting, and governance activities.

* Coordinate documentation, reporting, and issue resolution with compliance vendors and regulatory bodies as needed.

Ensure appropriate record retention and documentation standards are maintained.  



Systems, Reporting & Analytics

* Prepare compliance reports, dashboards, metrics, and operational analyses.

* Analyze compliance trends, audit results, and case data to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.

* Support regulatory reporting and workforce compliance reporting requirements.

* Partner with HR Technology and Reporting teams to ensure data integrity and reporting accuracy within Workday and related systems.

* Assist with system testing, compliance controls, reporting enhancements, and process automation initiatives.

Leverage data and analytics to support risk mitigation and decision-making.  



Continuous Improvement & Governance

* Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes, controls, service delivery, and operating procedures.

* Support the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, policies, process documentation, and job aids.

* Participate in compliance projects, system implementations, audits, and transformation initiatives.

* Assist with process standardization, automation, and adoption of new technologies, including AI-enabled solutions where appropriate.

Promote best practices and foster a culture of compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement.  



Additional Responsibilities

* Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

* Support enterprise compliance initiatives and governance activities.

Maintain the highest levels of confidentiality, professionalism, integrity, and ethical conduct.  



Qualifications

Education

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Public Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field.

Preferred

Professional certification such as PHR, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, CHRC, CCEP, or other relevant compliance or HR certifications.  



Experience & Skills

Required

* Experience supporting compliance programs, audits, regulatory reporting, investigations, or governance activities.

* Knowledge of employment law compliance, HR policies, internal controls, and regulatory requirements.

* Experience partnering with Legal, Internal Audit, Employee Relations, and senior business leaders on compliance-related matters.

* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate risk and recommend solutions.

* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization.

* Experience preparing executive-level reports, compliance analyses, and audit documentation.

Preferred

* Experience supporting government reporting requirements, including EEO-1 and other regulatory submissions.

Experience utilizing reporting, analytics, and automation tools to improve compliance operations.

title: Global AML Center (GAC) Operations & CAO – Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.

As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.

**Why this role is important to us**

The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.

Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.

**What you will be responsible for**

As Vice President you will:

***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders

* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards

* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance

* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model

* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking

* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability

* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls

* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance

* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds

* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value

* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda

* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning

* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy

* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials

* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time

* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through

* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning

* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure

* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements

* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed

* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight

* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability

* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required

* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization

* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential

* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working
  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls

* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans

* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment

* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models

* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers

* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them

* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions

* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively

* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning

* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials

* A collaborative leadership style that balances empowerment with accountability

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in AML/KYC, financial crime or operations within a large global financial institution

* Demonstrated experience leading strategic transformation and technology change programs, from business case to adoption

* Significant senior people leadership experience, including leading leaders

* Experience in business management role, including budget, headcount and governance ownership, is strongly preferred

* Bachelor’s degree required

* Strong knowledge of global AML/KYC regulatory requirements

* Experience with KYC workflow platforms (e.g., Fenergo/FenX), automation tools or AI solutions is an advantage

* Change or project management credentials (e.g., PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile) are an advantage

* Professional certifications such as CAMS or ICA are an advantage

description:
### **Summary**

Location: Hyderabad, India #LI-Hybrid
  
  
Internal job title: Associate Director, PO&CF Data Enablement
  
  
About the Role:
  
The Associate Director, PO&CF Data Enablement will lead the strategy, governance, adoption, and value realization of enterprise data enablement capabilities across People & Organization (P&O) and Corporate Functions.
  
The role will be responsible for establishing AI-ready, analytics-ready, and business-consumable data ecosystems through semantic technologies, metadata management, ontologies, knowledge graphs, enterprise taxonomies, data products, and knowledge management frameworks.
  
This role serves as a strategic bridge between business stakeholders, Enterprise Data Management, Data Governance, Data & AI teams, and technology organizations to ensure enterprise knowledge and data assets are discoverable, trusted, reusable, and consumable for Analytics, GenAI, Agentic AI, Semantic Search, Knowledge Discovery, and Decision Intelligence use cases.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Data Enablement Strategy & Roadmap**: define and execute the PO&CF Data Enablement strategy and roadmap, driving enterprise adoption of Semantic Layer, metadata and knowledge management, and AI-ready data capabilities. It will establish standards for data discoverability, interoperability, governance, and reuse, while building a long-term roadmap to enable AI, Analytics, Reporting, Knowledge Management, and Agentic AI initiatives and accelerate business outcomes through trusted, governed, and reusable data and knowledge assets.
* **Semantic Layer & Knowledge Architecture Leadership**: own the Semantic Layer strategy, governance, and adoption across PO&CF, driving the development of enterprise knowledge models, semantic assets, ontologies, taxonomies, and knowledge graphs. It will establish semantic frameworks that connect structured and unstructured data, integrate metadata, semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, and AI-ready architectures into the enterprise data ecosystem, and promote reusable business concepts and knowledge assets across domains.
* **Metadata, Knowledge Management & Governance**: drive enterprise metadata management and governance, leveraging platforms such as Collibra to lead ontology development, taxonomy management, business glossary governance, and knowledge modelling. It will establish consistent standards for business definitions, controls, policies, data, and knowledge assets, while partnering with Enterprise Data Management and business stakeholders to strengthen data discoverability, consistency, and trust across the organization.

It will drive the adoption of RAG and GraphRAG architectures, partner with Data Science, Analytics, and AI teams to accelerate enterprise AI initiatives, and ensure knowledge assets can be effectively consumed across modern AI platforms and agentic ecosystems.

**Job Purpose**

  
  

The **Senior Associate – HR Data Analytics** supports Amgen’s mission to serve patients by providing actionable workforce insights that enable data-driven decisions across Global Human Resources. This role partners with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), HR Business Partners, and business leaders to deliver analytical solutions, dashboards, and reports that improve the effectiveness of people programs and organizational outcomes.

The position plays a key role in advancing Amgen’s people analytics capability, ensuring data accuracy, governance, and accessibility while helping translate complex data into strategic insights aligned with business priorities.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain **HR analytics dashboards and reports** (e.g., headcount, attrition, diversity, hiring, mobility) using **Power BI**, **Workday**, and **Visier**.
* Partner with HR and business stakeholders to **analyze workforce data**, identify trends, and generate insights that inform talent, DE&I, and workforce planning strategies.
* Perform **data validation and quality checks** to ensure consistency and integrity across HR systems and reports.
* Support **predictive analytics** initiatives (e.g., attrition risk modeling, engagement analysis, workforce forecasting).
* Collaborate with HRIS and IT teams to enhance **data governance, reporting processes, and automation**.
* Deliver insights and recommendations through **data storytelling**, visualizations, and executive presentations.
* Contribute to the **evolution of Amgen’s People Analytics roadmap**, supporting digital transformation initiatives and standardization of global HR metrics.
  

  

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Human Resources, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Administration, or a related field**.
* 5 -9 years of experience in **HR analytics, people insights, or workforce planning**.
* Proficiency in **data visualization tools** (Power BI, Tableau, Visier) and HR systems (**Workday**).
* Solid understanding of **HR metrics**, workforce trends, and key people analytics concepts.
* Demonstrated ability to translate data into insights and communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Industrial/Organizational Psychology, or Business Intelligence.
* Experience in **SQL**, **Python**, or other analytics programming languages.
* Familiarity with **Alteryx**, or **data integration tools**.
* Experience in global or matrixed organizations, preferably in the **biotech or pharmaceutical industry**.
* Strong interpersonal and influencing skills; ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
* Survey designing and data processing experience prefer
* Survey designing and data processing experience preferred, including the ability to create effective survey instruments and analyze responses to generate actionable insights.
  

  

**Competencies**

* Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving
* Business Acumen & HR Knowledge
* Data Visualization & Storytelling
* Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
* Continuous Improvement & Innovation
* Integrity, Confidentiality, and Compliance
  

  

**Career Path**

This role typically progresses to:

* **Manager, HR Data Analytics / People Insights**
* **Manager, Workforce Planning**
* **HR Business Partner (Data-driven focus)**

**Role Overview:**

The role will be responsible for supporting and managing financial reporting, statutory and regulatory compliance, and financial accounting activities within the organization. The individual will ensure accuracy, integrity and timely delivery of financial information while ensuring adherence to applicable accounting standards, regulatory guidelines and statutory requirements.

The role will involve working closely with internal finance teams, auditors, business stakeholders and regulatory authorities to ensure robust financial controls, accurate reporting and effective compliance management.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Financial Reporting & Accounting**

* Manage and support periodic financial closing and reporting activities.
* Prepare and review financial statements, schedules and supporting documentation.
* Ensure accurate accounting and reporting in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS, IFRS and Indian GAAP, as relevant.
* Analyse financial data, identify variances and provide relevant explanations.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of financial reports to internal and external stakeholders.

**2. Regulatory & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory and statutory reporting requirements.
* Support compliance with IRDAI guidelines and other relevant regulatory requirements applicable to the life insurance industry.
* Coordinate preparation and submission of regulatory returns and disclosures.
* Monitor changes in accounting standards and regulatory requirements and assess their impact on financial reporting.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and compliance records.

**3. Audit & Internal Controls**

* Coordinate with internal and external auditors during statutory and regulatory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.
* Support maintenance and strengthening of internal financial controls.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial records and supporting documentation.

**4. Process Improvement & Stakeholder Management**

* Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting processes, controls and operational efficiency.
* Work collaboratively with finance, actuarial, taxation, legal and other relevant teams.
* Support implementation of changes arising from new accounting standards or regulatory requirements.
* Ensure adherence to established policies, procedures and reporting timelines.

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred/mandatory depending on role seniority.
* Semi-qualified CA / CMA / relevant finance qualifications may be considered for junior positions.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and statutory compliance.

**Experience & Competencies:**

* Experience in financial reporting, accounting, statutory compliance or financial control.
* Knowledge of Ind AS, IFRS and Indian GAAP.
* Understanding of regulatory reporting requirements and statutory compliance.
* Exposure to audit coordination and financial closing processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
* Attention to detail and ability to work within defined reporting timelines.
* Experience in the insurance or financial services industry would be an advantage.

title: Compliance Officer (Mumbai)
description:
**About Artha Group**

Artha Group is a performance-first investment house managing ₹2,300 crores across domestic and international investment vehicles, including Category I & II AIFs, LLPs, and Private Limited companies. With active investments in 130+ startups, with 32+ successful exits, and 10+ renewable energy projects. We operate at the convergence of capital precision and operational depth.

**Job Title:**
**Compliance Officer**

**Location: Lower Parel, Mumbai**

**Position Overview**

Artha Group is a leading multi-fund venture capital platform. Compliance at this firm is not a support function. It is a cornerstone of how we operate, how we grow, and how we earn and maintain the trust of our investors, our regulators, and our partners. The Compliance Officer in Mumbai owns that cornerstone. You will be the firm's primary regulatory authority across all Mumbai-based entities, with scope extending to GIFT City operations as part of a unified compliance mandate. This role demands someone who is meticulous without being rigid, authoritative without being bureaucratic, and deeply comfortable operating at the intersection of law, finance, and institutional governance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Regulatory Compliance - SEBI, RBI, MCA, and IFSCA**

* Own end-to-end compliance with all applicable SEBI regulations governing Alternative Investment Funds, fund management, PPM updates, annual compliance audit reports, valuation disclosures, and investor reporting obligations.
* Ensure full adherence to RBI and FEMA requirements including foreign investment reporting, Form 15CA/CB, Form 3CEB, ECB compliances, and all cross-border transaction obligations.
* Oversee all MCA and ROC obligations including statutory filings, board resolutions, and secretarial compliance under the Companies Act across all group entities.

**Obtain confirmation of timely and accurate completion of all statutory filings across entities, including IT returns, TDS, and GST, as part of monthly governance activities, and escalate any gaps or omissions without exception.**

* Own the compliance calendar as a regulatory obligation. Every filing, every deadline, and every disclosure is tracked, prepared, and submitted on time.
* Monitor regulatory developments across SEBI, RBI, MCA, IFSCA, and other applicable bodies, and brief internal stakeholders on implications and required actions.
* Ensure all IFSCA compliance requirements pertaining to GIFT City operations are met with the same rigour and consistency as Mumbai obligations.
* Serve as the firm's primary point of contact with all regulatory authorities, ensuring every interaction is handled with professionalism and precision.

**Fund and AIF Compliance**

* Ensure full regulatory compliance across Category I, II and III AIFs, covering SEBI AIF Regulations, AML, KYC, FATCA, and CRS protocols without exception.
* Oversee compliance across the complete investment lifecycle including due diligence, deal structuring, fund investments, and exits, ensuring every stage is executed within the applicable regulatory framework.
* Ensure that all compliance requirements pertaining to new fund entity structures are addressed comprehensively, from formation through ongoing statutory obligations.
* Own all compliance pertaining to investor onboarding, investor reporting, and fund disclosures. Every process must meet the required regulatory standard before it is finalised or communicated externally.
* Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready compliance documentation across every investment, fund structure, and regulatory interaction.

**Corporate and Establishment Compliance**

* Oversee all statutory obligations for Mumbai-based entities including Shops and Establishments, professional tax, labour law filings, and associated requirements.
* Ensure timely payment of all statutory dues across entities. Penalties, notices, or fines are to be identified early, escalated immediately, and closed without delay.
* Coordinate regulatory audits, inspections, and responses in consultation with external advisors, and ensure the firm is always prepared, never reactive.
* Conduct periodic reviews of internal controls and work with external auditors to ensure documentation across all entities and fund structures is thorough and defensible.

**Qualifications**

* Company Secretary (CS) qualification is essential. CA qualification is equally considered.
* 8 to 10 years of experience in compliance within a financial services environment, with strong exposure to AIF compliance, fund management, investment-related regulatory work, or mutual funds.
* Deep working knowledge of SEBI AIF Regulations, FEMA, RBI guidelines, PMLA, GST, TDS, ROC filings, and Companies Act compliance.
* Familiarity with IFSCA regulations and GIFT City fund structures is a meaningful advantage.
* Exceptional attention to detail. You read everything, verify everything, and hold the line on standards regardless of the pressure to move fast.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can distil a complex regulatory matter into a clear brief for leadership and correspond with regulatory authorities with authority and precision.
* Someone who understands that while compliance does not operate in a silo, it cannot be compromised by one either.

**Compensation**

* Fixed Annual Salary: Rs. 32,00,000, paid monthly
* Fixed Retention Bonus: Rs. 3,00,000, paid at the end of each year
* ESOP Eligibility: Rs. 2,50,000, vesting as per policy
* Total Annual Compensation: Rs. 37,50,000

* Experience in clinical development operations or clinical trial outsourcing
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
* Balanced judgment between client risk and clinical trial timelines
* Comfort working with clinical study budgets, contracting negotiation principles, and global site contracting processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent and 5+ years of experience in clinical development operations or clinical trial outsourcing, OR
* Juris Doctorate or equivalent and 2+ years of experience in clinical development operations or clinical trial outsourcing
* Experience with clinical study budgets and contracting negotiation principles, practices, processes, and activities
* Working knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Precise communication and presentation skills, with the ability to plan, identify, and mitigate risks to site contracting timelines
* Success working in a highly matrix-based organization
* Fluency in written and spoken English

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in drafting and negotiation of Clinical Trial Agreements with clinical trial sites in a global operation

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

title: Regulatory and Licensing Manager
description:
**Regulatory and Licensing Manager**

**Location:**
Mumbai

**About Us**

Traya is an Indian direct-to-consumer hair care platform that provides a holistic treatment for individuals experiencing hair loss. Through personalized consultations, we identify the root cause of hair fall using a combination of Ayurveda, Allopathy, and Nutrition. Our unique diagnostic platform, combined with medically trained hair coaches and proprietary tech, ensures customers receive customized solutions delivered right to their doorstep — and the ongoing guidance they need to stay on track. Founded by Saloni Anand (techie-turned-marketeer) and Altaf Saiyed (Stanford GSB alumnus), Traya’s mission is to de-stigmatize hair loss, address its emotional and psychological impact, and make effective treatment accessible to all.

**Our Vision**

We aim to create a global awareness movement around hair loss while delivering a scientifically proven, holistic solution that combines the best of three sciences.

**The role**

You will own every licence a Traya Centre needs to open and stay open, across Maharashtra, Telangana, and Karnataka, and eventually pan-India.

**What you'll do**

• Clinical registration (Karnataka / Telangana): file and secure KPME registration for every

Bangalore centre, and keep layouts, staffing and documents compliant

• Shops & Establishments: register every new centre under the state S&E Acts in Maharashtra,

Karnataka, Telangana

• Trade licences: obtain trade licences from the local municipal body (BMC, TMC, NMMC, PMC,

PCMC, BBMP and tier-2 corporations)

• File early: start applications the day an agreement is signed, using a document checklist that BD

collects at LOI stage

• Run the tracker: maintain one licence tracker by centre (status, filing date, expected date,

blocker) and review it weekly with BD and the Chief of Staff

• Renewals and inspections: keep every licence across current centers, and handle inspections

and notices

• Manage partners: work with internal legal, the external compliance consultant and local liaison

agents, and hold them to timelines

• Stay ahead of rule changes: track regulatory changes in each state and flag what they mean for

new and existing centres

**What success looks like**

• Every application filed within 2 working days of agreement signing

• Zero go-lives delayed by a licence

• Clinical license in hand within a few days of completing site in that city

• Zero lapsed licences or penalties across the network

**What you bring**

• 4–8 years in licensing or liaison for a multi-site chain: clinics, diagnostics, pharmacy, or hospital

• Has personally licensed 25+ centers

• Hands-on experience with KPME or a similar clinical-establishment registration

• Knows S&E and trade-licence processes first-hand in Mumbai, Pune and Bangalore, including the municipal ward offices

• Highly organised: comfortable running a 200+ line tracker and chasing every item to closure

• Persistent and on the ground: willing to follow up in person at government offices

• Fluent in Kannada or Telugu, plus Hindi and English. Marathi is good to have

**Good to have**

• Law, commerce or company-secretary background

• Experience setting up a licensing function or SOPs at a fast-growing healthcare chain

title: Sr HR Generalist, India
description:
**Job Purpose**
Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a next-generation power semiconductor leader driving innovation in gallium nitride (GaN) and high-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) technologies. Our products enable faster, more efficient power delivery across AI data centers, high-performance computing, energy and grid infrastructure, and industrial electrification.
  
  
With more than 30 years of combined expertise in wide bandgap technologies, GaNFast™ power ICs integrate GaN power, drive, control, sensing, and protection, delivering faster power delivery, higher system density, and greater efficiency. GeneSiC™ high-voltage SiC devices leverage patented trench-assisted planar technology to provide industry-leading voltage capability, efficiency, and reliability for medium-voltage grid and infrastructure applications.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on
**Senior HR Generalist**
to join our new site in Pune, India. As the onsite HR partner for our Pune Center of Excellence, you will help stand up the site from the ground up — site setup, regulatory registrations, payroll and benefits once our India entity is established — and then own the employee lifecycle as the team grows. **Site setup and regulatory**

* Lead the HR and administrative work to set up the Pune site, including registrations, licenses and local regulatory requirements

* Partner closely with Finance on payroll, statutory payments, budgeting, and reconciliations

* Support Facilities on office readiness, vendor management, access, safety and workplace services
