* Run day-to-day HR operations for India: employee records, letters, HRIS data, onboarding and offboarding
* Lead the EOR-to-direct employment conversion, including offer letters, benefits transfer and payroll cutover
* Set up payroll and benefits once the India entity is established, and manage payroll vendors and statutory deductions
* Build India HR policies, the employee handbook and standard processes aligned with global Navitas practices
* Support headcount planning and organization design with site and global HR leadership

**Benefits**

* Administer group medical insurance and other benefit programs; run renewals and vendor RFPs
* Support annual compensation review, bonus and equity administration

**Compliance and employee relations**

* Keep Navitas compliant with Indian labor law, including the Labor Codes, Shops and Establishments registration, PF, ESI, gratuity, Professional Tax and leave rules
* Set up and maintain the Internal Committee and training under the POSH Act
* Handle employee relations matters, investigations and performance concerns with fairness and discretion
* Coordinate with legal counsel and auditors on registrations, filings and inspections

**Employee engagement**

* Build a connected culture for the India team through engagement programs, recognition and team events
* Act as a trusted advisor to employees and managers on people matters

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field
* 5+ years of progressive HR experience in India, including senior HR generalist, HR business partner or HR operations roles
* Working knowledge of SEZ requirements, Maharashtra state incentives, Indian labor law, statutory compliance and payroll
* Comfortable working closely with Finance and taking on Facilities and Finance support as needed
* Experience in a multinational company, ideally reporting to a US or global HR team
* Strong judgment with confidential information and sensitive employee matters
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable working across time zones with US-based teams
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities with a high degree of accountability
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HRIS/payroll systems

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting a multinational, growth-stage, or matrixed organization.
* Experience in semiconductor, electronics, manufacturing or deep-tech engineering companies
* Experience setting up a new entity or office, or converting EOR or contractor workers to direct employment
* Hands-on HRIS experience (for example Oracle, Paycom, or similar)
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

title: Human Resources Manager - India & US
description:
Position: Human Resources Manager - India & US

Location: Pune

Industry: IT/Software

**Role Summary**

**We are looking for an experienced HR Manager who will act as a generalist across both our India and US locations. You will oversee day-to-day HR operations, lead recruitment, and manage facilities, while staying hands-on with execution. This role suits someone who can set up good processes, handle the operational details themselves, and work across two countries and time zones with confidence.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**HR Operations and Compliance**

* Manage the full employee lifecycle across both locations: onboarding, confirmations, transfers, separations, and exit formalities.
* Own payroll inputs, attendance, leave, and benefits administration in coordination with payroll providers or internal finance.
* Maintain employee records and HRIS data accurately, and ensure policies are current and consistently applied.
* Ensure compliance with local labour laws. In India, this includes PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, Shops and Establishments registrations, and POSH obligations. In the US, this includes federal and state employment requirements, I-9 verification, and benefits compliance
* Handle employee queries, grievances, and disciplinary matters in a fair, documented, and confidential manner.
* Prepare HR reports and dashboards (headcount, attrition, leave, compliance status) for leadership.

**Recruitment**

* Own end-to-end hiring for both locations: requisition intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer management, and joining formalities.
* Work with hiring managers to define role requirements and interview processes.
* Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job boards, and campus or employer-branding channels.
* Track recruitment metrics such as time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and offer acceptance rates.
* Support a consistent candidate experience across India and US hiring processes, including any cross-border hiring considerations.

**Facilities and Workplace Administration**

* Oversee office operations in both locations: space planning, seating, supplies, housekeeping, and maintenance.
* Manage vendor relationships and contracts for facilities services (housekeeping, security, pantry, AMC, utilities, courier, and similar).
* Coordinate workplace safety, fire and emergency drills, and statutory safety inspections as required.
* Manage the budget for facilities and admin, and track spend against it.
* Support travel, visa-related logistics, and coordination where needed.

**Hands-On Generalist Work**

* Handle HR queries and tasks directly rather than only delegating them.
* Support employee engagement initiatives, events, and recognition programs.
* Contribute to policy drafting and process improvement across both locations.
* Act as a point of coordination between the India and US teams on HR matters.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 14 to 18 years of HR generalist experience, with at least 3 years in a managerial or lead role.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance. Familiarity with US employment law and multi-state compliance is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in full-cycle recruitment, including for mid-level and senior roles.
* Experience managing facilities or admin functions, or coordinating vendors and budgets.
* Experience working with a team or stakeholders across more than one country.
* Proficiency with HRIS and payroll systems, and strong skills in Excel or Google Sheets.

**Key Competencies**

* **Operational discipline:**
  Keeps processes accurate, documented, and on schedule.
* **Confidentiality and judgement:**
  Handles sensitive employee matters with discretion and fairness.
* **Cross-cultural communication:**
  Works well with teams in different countries and time zones.
* **Hands-on ownership:**
  Takes tasks from start to finish without needing close supervision.
* **Stakeholder management:**
  Builds trust with employees, managers, and leadership.
* **Adaptability:**
  Manages competing priorities in a growing organisation.

Kindly share your details at praveen.dighe@hwtglobal.com

title: Founder's Office Associate
description:
Without® is building one of India's first commercial-scale recycled materials plants, turning post-consumer plastic waste into materials that replace virgin plastic.

We need a Founder's Office Associate to make the founder and the founder's office run smoother, faster and with fewer dropped balls. You'll work across accounts, finance, legal, HR and people, reporting to the Chief of Staff. Often you'll be the first face of Without that a partner, a new hire or a vendor meets, so how you show up matters as much as what you get done. If you're early in your career and want to see how a company actually gets built, this is the seat.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* A Bachelor's degree in any discipline (commerce, law, business or management is a bonus, not a filter).
* 0–3 years of experience. Freshers are welcome.
* Excellent communication, written and spoken, in English and Hindi, Marathi is a plus.
* A people person. You build trust quickly with colleagues, candidates, partners and vendors, and you handle sensitive information with discretion.
* AI-savvy: you already use AI tools to draft, research, summarise and automate, and you're curious about what else they can do. "I've tried ChatGPT once" doesn't count.
* Detail-oriented to the point of being slightly annoying about it. Numbers tie out, names are spelt right, nothing slips.
* Comfortable with systems and data: spreadsheets, trackers, dashboards and tools like Zoho, Notion etc
* Organised and on top of things. You know what's due, what's late and who's waiting on whom, without being asked.
* Smart, quick to learn and unafraid of work that's new to you, whether that's a GST notice, an offer letter or a board deck.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* **Founder's Office Support**

  — Work within the founder's office team and make everyone's job easier. Follow up on open items, chase decisions and deadlines across teams, and take routine work off the team's plate. Make sure nothing the team commits to falls through.
* **Chief of Staff Projects**

  — Work directly with the Chief of Staff on company priorities, weekly reviews and special projects. Turn loose ideas into plans with owners and dates.
* **Accounts & Finance**

  — Track invoices, payments, expenses and reimbursements. Coordinate with our accountants and CA on monthly closing, GST and TDS filings. Keep cash, receivables and payables reports up to date.
* **Legal & Compliance**

  — Maintain the contracts and agreements register, track renewals and statutory deadlines, and coordinate with lawyers on NDAs, MoUs and vendor agreements. Keep company documents filed, current and findable.
* **HR & People**

title: Sr HR Generalist, India
description:
**Job Purpose:**

Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a next-generation power semiconductor leader driving innovation in gallium nitride (GaN) and high-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) technologies. Our products enable faster, more efficient power delivery across AI data centers, high-performance computing, energy and grid infrastructure, and industrial electrification.

With more than 30 years of combined expertise in wide bandgap technologies, GaNFast™ power ICs integrate GaN power, drive, control, sensing, and protection, delivering faster power delivery, higher system density, and greater efficiency. GeneSiC™ high-voltage SiC devices leverage patented trench-assisted planar technology to provide industry-leading voltage capability, efficiency, and reliability for medium-voltage grid and infrastructure applications.

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on **Senior HR Generalist** to join our new site in Pune, India. As the onsite HR partner for our Pune Center of Excellence, you will help stand up the site from the ground up — site setup, regulatory registrations, payroll and benefits once our India entity is established — and then own the employee lifecycle as the team grows. This is an individual contributor role with high visibility and broad scope. You will partner closely with Finance and stretch to support Facilities and Finance activities while the site builds out. It is ideal for someone who enjoys creating structure where little exists yet.

**Key Responsibilities and Duties:**

**Site setup and regulatory**

* Lead the HR and administrative work to set up the Pune site, including registrations, licenses and local regulatory requirements
* Manage Special Economic Zone (SEZ) requirements, approvals and ongoing compliance as they relate to HR and employment
* Identify and apply for Maharashtra state incentives and related programs in partnership with Finance
* Track and interpret local regulatory updates and advise global HR and site leadership

**Finance and Facilities support**

* Partner closely with Finance on payroll, statutory payments, budgeting, and reconciliations
* Support Finance activities temporarily until the India Finance Lead is in place, including invoice processing, vendor onboarding and local banking coordination as needed
* Support Facilities on office readiness, vendor management, access, safety and workplace services

**HR operations and shared services**

* Run day-to-day HR operations for India: employee records, letters, HRIS data, onboarding and offboarding
* Lead the EOR-to-direct employment conversion, including offer letters, benefits transfer and payroll cutover
* Set up payroll and benefits once the India entity is established, and manage payroll vendors and statutory deductions
* Build India HR policies, the employee handbook and standard processes aligned with global Navitas practices
Support headcount planning and organization design with site and global HR leadership  

**Benefits**

* Administer group medical insurance and other benefit programs; run renewals and vendor RFPs
Support annual compensation review, bonus and equity administration  

**Compliance and employee relations**

* Keep Navitas compliant with Indian labor law, including the Labor Codes, Shops and Establishments registration, PF, ESI, gratuity, Professional Tax and leave rules
* Set up and maintain the Internal Committee and training under the POSH Act
* Handle employee relations matters, investigations and performance concerns with fairness and discretion
* Coordinate with legal counsel and auditors on registrations, filings and inspections

**Employee engagement**

* Build a connected culture for the India team through engagement programs, recognition and team events
* Act as a trusted advisor to employees and managers on people matters

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field
* 5+ years of progressive HR experience in India, including senior HR generalist, HR business partner or HR operations roles
* Working knowledge of SEZ requirements, Maharashtra state incentives, Indian labor law, statutory compliance and payroll
* Comfortable working closely with Finance and taking on Facilities and Finance support as needed
* Experience in a multinational company, ideally reporting to a US or global HR team
* Strong judgment with confidential information and sensitive employee matters
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable working across time zones with US-based teams
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities with a high degree of accountability
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HRIS/payroll systems

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting a multinational, growth-stage, or matrixed organization.
* Experience in semiconductor, electronics, manufacturing or deep-tech engineering companies
* Experience setting up a new entity or office, or converting EOR or contractor workers to direct employment
* Hands-on HRIS experience (for example Oracle, Paycom, or similar)
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

description:

Operating around the clock and around the world, V. gives every client the quality and efficiency they need in every sector. Covering crew management and recruitment, quality ship management and technical services, together with supporting management and commercial services, V. has an unrivalled industry knowledge with performance assured. Our values, We Care, We Collaborate, We Challenge, We are Consistent, We Commit and Deliver, are at the heart of everything we do and they support our strategy of Investing in Talent. We are always interested in making contact with talented individuals - people who will demonstrate our values and deliver great service, for internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Overall Purpose of The Job**
To ensure Technical policies and procedures are consistently applied across their assigned vessels.
  
  
Be the Primary Responsible & Accountable person for the assigned Vessels. Manage the Vessels to the highest Safety Standards in compliance with legal and regulatory requirements and in accordance with V.Ships VMS, ensuring flawless service delivery to customers. Trust the fleet cell team to support him/her throughout all fleet operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Tasks**
**Safety**
Safety is our first priority and the Fleet Superintendent has, in cooperation with the Fleet Manager, the authority and the accountability for taking necessary decisions that ensure constant safe operation and that everybody comes home safe and that we protect the environment.
  
  
**Customer**
Our Customers are our second priority after safety. The Fleet Superintendent is responsible for delivery of technical management service to the Customer. The Fleet Superintendent’s position is the link between the Customer and his/her ship and the responsible person for ensuring that the Customer fully benefits from the operational performance of his/her ship.
  
  
**Ownership**
Own the operation of the vessels managing them to the highest safety standards, effectively and efficiently in the provision of management services required under the Management Agreement and VMS. Plan, control and execute all activities connected with maintenance, repairs, dry-docking, conversion or modification of assigned vessels. This to be in line with Flag, Class and Statutory Requirements.
  
  
**Leadership**
Authorise selection process of Senior Officers for assigned Vessels, build and maintain a professional and effective working relationship with senior ship colleagues to influence the development of a strong safety culture. Conduct Senior Officer Performance Appraisals in accordance with VMS procedures and play an active role in their personal development
  
  
**PMS**
Responsible for PMS, to ensure that the job descriptions and maintenance intervals assigned to all machineries is as per makers manual, and that repairs history / spares consumed are correctly recorded in ShipSure for future reference and insurance claims / audits.
  
  
**Client**
Serve as the first contact point for the assigned vessels and liaise with respective Clients. Provide timely & accurate reports to Clients regarding the management, expenditure & condition of the Vessel as per the SMA and as agreed with the Clients.
  
  
**Monitor**
Monitor vessel performance trends including speed, fuel and lubricating oil consumptions, and implement timely remedial actions where these are outside agreed or expected parameters. Monitor and energy consumption on board the ships, ensuring that the vessels are operated most economically at all times.
  
  
**Report Issues**
Ensure that any issues that affect, or may affect, the safety, environmental or operational performance of assigned vessels are reported in time.
  
  
**Planning**
Plan Dry Dock, Vacation, Ships inspections and other absences with your Fleet Manager to ensure a consistent service to your Customers. Prepare ‘visitation’ plans to gain thorough knowledge of the assigned vessels and safety culture onboard.
  
  
**Quality**
In conjunction with the Shipboard team and the Marine Superintendent prepare vessels for inspection/audit by PSC, Flag, Oil Major and similar bodies. Deficiencies which can have an adverse effect on the commercial operation of the ship should be promptly reported to your line manager. Ensure all third party inspections are passed and that observations match individual KPI.
  
  
**Reporting**
To be an advocate of ShipSure and ensure it is properly utilised within the fleet cell. Support and assist colleagues where required and provide constructive feedback to aid continuous improvement of the system.
  
  
**Finance**
Work with relevant members of the Fleet Cell and Vessel to co-ordinate all information required for the preparation of the vessels’ running cost budget. Maintain strict control of all aspects of vessel expenditure. No out of Budget spending without prior consent of the Client.
  
  
**Day to Day**
Discuss with Ships’ Command the work plan, running costs, spares and stores situation and other issues of concern and report/correction on same.

V. Group can offer you a market leading salary and benefits package, in addition to significant opportunities for career growth and personal development. This a great opportunity to join a true leader in the maritime sector - a company that has exciting plans for future growth.

* Good communication (oral and written) and English language skills,
* Good interpersonal skills with the ability to engage and interact with people at all levels.

* Previous experience as a Fleet Superintendent in a Technical Department, or previous experience in a Senior Engineering/Naval Architecture position in the Marine Industry.

title: Head of Customs Operations (F-Card Holder)
description:
**About ClearancePort**

ClearancePort builds AI software for India's customs house agents, freight forwarders and exporters. Our platform connects customer enquiries, quotes, bookings, documents and customs checks around each shipment, from customer email to a shipment ready to move and file. We are a founding team in New Delhi, starting with one export lane and running real shipments through the platform. A licensed partner CHA files them while we prepare to apply for our own licence.

**About the role**

ClearancePort is hiring its first Head of Customs Operations: a licensed customs broker (F card) who will run our customs desk and keep us compliant. You will also be the authorised person on our own customs broker licence.

* **Location:**
  Delhi NCR, on-site, with regular visits to ICD Tughlakabad, ICD Patparganj and IGI Air Cargo
* **Reports to:**
  Founder
* **Type:**
  Full-time, permanent, founding team
* **Pay:**
  ₹8.4–12 lakh a year fixed, plus ESOPs

**What you'll own**

You will own every customs outcome: first by managing our partner CHA, then by running our own licensed desk.

**Customs operations**

* Run the customs desk end to end, for exports (Shipping Bill, Let Export Order, EGM) and imports (IGM, Bill of Entry, Out of Charge).
* Onboard exporters with a document checklist, verified KYC and written authorisation.
* Manage our partner CHA: review every filing before it is submitted, track turnaround and escalate errors.
* Write the standard operating procedure for each customs stage, and keep an error log that feeds back into the procedures.
* Handle examinations, queries and hold-ups at the customs station, and keep documentation-caused demurrage and detention down.

**Compliance**

* Make sure every client has written authorisation and verified KYC before we act for them (CBLR Reg 10(a), 10(n)).
* Keep records audit-ready for at least five years (Reg 10(p)).
* Advise clients to comply with customs law, and escalate non-compliance as the regulations require (Reg 10(d)).
* Lead our response to customs queries, show-cause notices, audits and penalty proceedings.
* Track customs circulars, tariff changes and trade-agreement rules, and brief the team and clients.

**Our licence and team**

* Be the authorised person (the employee who has passed the exam) on our Form B2 customs broker licence application.
* Once we are licensed, authorise G-card staff to sign, file those authorities with the Deputy or Assistant Commissioner, and supervise all filing.
* Hire and train one or two G-card filing executives and an H-card documentation executive, and sponsor staff for the G-card exam.

**Product**

* Act as ClearancePort's customs domain owner for HS classification rules (General Rules of Interpretation first), valuation, duty and exemption logic.
* Review what our AI drafts (HS codes, values, notification claims), and decide which steps can be automated and which always need a human.
* Build the certificate-of-origin and preference-claim workflow for the India–EU FTA, expected in force from early 2027.
* Work weekly with our engineers, and test new features on real shipments before release.

**Customers and partners**

* Join sales calls with exporters as our customs expert.
* Maintain working relationships with customs officers, CFS and ICD operators, shipping lines and airline agents.

**Your first 90 days**

By day 90, the desk runs on written procedures and every partner filing has passed your review.

* **Days 1–30:**
  Learn ClearancePort; shadow the partner CHA on 10 shipments; agree the partner's turnaround times and our review process
* **Days 31–60:**
  A written procedure for every customs stage; an exporter onboarding checklist covering KYC and authorisation; the error log live
* **Days 61–90:**
  Classification and duty rulebook, version 1, reviewed with engineers; 30+ shipments reviewed; licence application file drafted

**How we'll measure success**

At 12 months we judge the role on clean filings, speed, and a granted licence.

* **CBLR violations or penalties:**
  zero
* **Filings accepted without amendment or query:**
  baseline set on the first 50 shipments, improving every quarter
* **Ops hours per shipment:**
  half the baseline from our first manual shipments
* **Demurrage or detention caused by documentation:**
  baseline set on the first 50 shipments, improving every quarter
* **Customs broker licence:**
  application filed and licence granted
* **Team:**
  one or two G-card filers hired and trained
* **Procedures:**
  written for every customs stage and reviewed quarterly

**What you bring**

* You have passed both the written and oral customs broker exams under CBLR 2018 (F card), and can show the result.
* You are free to be our authorised person: not currently named as the qualified person on another firm's licence, which the regulations forbid (Reg 7(2)(b)).
* 10+ years in customs clearance, including hands-on work at Delhi customs stations (ICD Tughlakabad, ICD Patparganj or IGI Air Cargo), for both sea and air.
* You have filed on ICEGATE through filing software (such as Live IMPEX or Logi-Sys) and handled e-Sanchit uploads.
* Strong in HS classification, valuation and exemption notifications.
* A clean record: no CBLR penalty, suspension or revocation against you or any firm you were authorised for.
* You have led a team of filing or documentation staff.
* A graduate degree; fluent English and Hindi.
* Willing to work on-site and at customs stations as needed.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with certificates of origin and preference claims under India's trade agreements.
* Experience with exporters in textiles and apparel, leather, engineering goods or home décor.
* Experience with FTWZ, SEZ or EOU procedures.
* You have taken staff through the G-card exam.
* Comfortable with software and AI tools; you have helped build or roll out an internal system.
* Startup experience, or you have set up a new branch.

**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay depending on experience, plus ESOPs.
* A founding-team seat: you will shape how customs work in India is done with AI.
* A budget to hire and train your own filing team.
* The company furnishes the licence security deposit and pays the licence fees and DSC tokens.
* You work directly with the founder and our engineers, and your rules become the product.

**How to apply**

Send your CV, a copy of your F card or exam result, and a short note on the hardest clearance you have handled to mail@clearanceport.com.

1. A 30-minute call with the founder, where we confirm your exam result and current authorisations.
2. A case interview on three real customs situations.
3. A work sample: review three draft filings in ClearancePort and find what's wrong.
4. Reference checks with two past employers or clients.
5. Offer

title: Urban Services Program Head
description:
Urban Services Programme Head

Executive leadership | Public services | Independent assessments

**LOCATION**

**NCR or any A-Tier city**

**ENGAGEMENT**

**Short-term | 3-4 months**

**OPENINGS**

**01**

We are inviting applications from senior urban-services professionals to lead a time-bound assessment and improvement-planning programme. This position brings together on-ground verification, operations analysis, technical planning and digital evidence systems to support informed decisions by public-sector leadership.

Your mandate

Own the integrated delivery strategy, coordinate specialised teams and ensure that findings are evidence-led, practical and submitted on schedule.

What you will lead

* **Build the programme architecture.**
  Translate a multi-area, 90-day assignment into an inception sprint, fieldwork calendar, interim review, draft synthesis and final submission. Establish clear dependencies, owners, escalation points and milestones across all specialist and field teams.
* **Direct a truly independent baseline.**
  Make sure the programme tests reported service performance against field proof. Oversee household and business samples, waste-transfer measurements, high-volume generator checks, GPS-based fleet reviews, facility-status verification and complete area-by-area coverage.
* **Shape improvement priorities.**
  Guide the analysis of four-stream separation, collection reliability, public-space waste accumulation, difficult-to-serve neighbourhoods and infrastructure shortfalls. Translate verified gaps into a coherent master plan and localised plans with achievable monthly service targets.
* **Review plant, fleet and financial gaps.**
  Bring together assessments of transfer sites, recovery and treatment capacity, fleet requirements, capital infrastructure needs, costs per tonne, user-fee trends, staffing systems and awareness expenditure, ensuring that proposed resource needs reconcile with the baseline.
* **Oversee provider and contract monitoring.**
  Ensure private service operators are assessed consistently on approved operating routes, vehicle tracking, crew deployment, service records and contractual performance measures. Sponsor an exception log and a concise format for monthly management reviews.
* **Steer route and territory planning.**
  Check that current collection paths are corroborated by location traces and physical observation, that priority areas receive workable primary and secondary route redesign, and that recommendations align with fleet capacity and receiving facilities.

**ROLE DETAILS / CONTINUED**

Urban Services Programme Head

Delivery, quality and collaboration

* **Connect the digital and analytical outputs.**
  Ensure the geospatial evidence repository, locality scorecards, live management dashboard, facility information portal and mobile workflows tell one consistent story. Review the structure of executive indicators for a future integrated monitoring room.
* **Protect evidence standards and impartiality.**
  Require time-stamped and location-linked records, photographs where applicable, independent rechecks and traceable corrections. Keep this diagnostic assignment separate from contract-award decisions, service operations and procurement drafting.
* **Lead high-level institutional coordination.**
  Handle senior reviews, obtain timely decisions and maintain constructive working relationships with public authorities, operators and independent technical partners. Prevent duplication of external assessments while using validated reference information.
* **Provide direction on community communication.**
  Use observed participation and separation gaps to inform outreach priorities, resident segments, communication channels and measurable behavioural goals; guide strategy, rather than undertaking a public campaign as an operating service.
* **Secure final handover and continuity.**
  Check that validated records, maps, plans, technical documentation and software administration materials are accepted and transferred. Arrange a workable continuity plan for post-project access to the management platform.

What you will help deliver

* Integrated work plan, governance routines, programme risk register and weekly leadership reviews.
* Consolidated service-gap assessment, sequenced master/local plans and evidence-based resource priorities.
* Accepted management presentations, operator-performance summaries and coordinated specialist outputs.
* Quality-reviewed final submissions, information transfer and executive briefing materials.

Who should apply

* Postgraduate qualification in Engineering, Planning, Environment or Management.
* At least 15 years in urban services, including a minimum of 8 years dedicated to municipal solid waste systems.
* Leadership of at least one city-level waste-service assessment, plan or programme for an urban population of 10 lakh or more.
* Senior consulting leaders or programme heads able to direct multidisciplinary teams and communicate with public-sector decision-makers.

How to apply

mail to careers@humanmatrix.co.in

title: Country Manager India
description:
We exist to create positive change for people and the planet. Join us and make a difference too!
  
  
**Purpose of Position**
To develop and drive business growth strategies for the country and be expected to provide the country team leadership, vision and energy as necessary to ensure the full business potential is realised whilst maintaining, upholding and promoting the integrity of BSI products, services and reputation. Responsible for ensuring we live by our philosophy and making excellence a habit. The role has overall P&L accountability for the India Assurance business, with direct responsibility for Sales and dotted-line responsibility for Operations in India.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities**
**Strategic**

* Lead the deployment and implementation of the strategy and multi-year plan of the Assurance streams, adapting it to the market context in India, in line with the Group Strategic plan, maximising profitable growth across our chosen sector/streams
* Contribute to shaping the assurance stream strategy as a member of the Assurance Executive.
* Contribute to the innovation agenda of the Assurance streams and support pilot initiatives adopting new technologies and processes (e.g. digitisation), providing direction and oversight of the change process to adapt existing ways of working and to increase operational efficiency and utilisation
* Build impactful and collaborative relationships with BSI colleagues across our multi-layered matrix organisation to support existing businesses, leverage growth opportunities as One BSI

**Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and motivate India’s leadership teams to drive sales and contribute to achieving our profitable growth strategy. Embed sales improvement programmes and support delivery optimisation according to cluster plans.
* Provide leadership by ‘setting the tone’ for behaviours, building an inclusive culture that is in line with our Values and Excellence Behaviours
* Ensure the Client is at the core of our strategy, and a client-centric approach is taken to our actions.
* Provide commercial thought leadership and represent BSI to the relevant stakeholders in India.

**Commercial**

* Have direct responsibility for the Sales function in India, including the development and execution of sales strategy, pipeline management and achievement of agreed sales and revenue targets.
* Establish, foster and sustain relationships with significant clients and stakeholders to understand clients’ needs and market trends better to inform new product development and opportunities to exploit BSI’s product suite, in particular leading the selection of the key accounts in the geographies and empowering the right teams to develop the relationships with those clients.
* Build, continuously develop and execute a compelling Sales plan that drives BSI positioning, offers integrated solutions to our clients with alignment to the group strategy
* Actively partner with colleagues across geographies and Streams to understand the broader products and services portfolio, identifying and implementing joint opportunities that enable the business growth agenda.
* Create and embed effective cross-sell strategies and processes to move the business from transactional selling to solutions that add value for our clients, building and promoting integrated services across Assurance and other streams.
* Identifies and executes opportunities for mergers, acquisitions, partnerships and alliances for the Assurance Stream in India, working in coordination with the Assurance Leadership team and with the support of the Director of Corporate Development.
* Own the P&L for the India Assurance business, including cost planning, including the annual budgeting, forecasting and strategic review processes for the Assurance Stream.
* Effectively manage all key financial metrics with accountability for delivering on budget revenue and contribution expectations and manage performance within the countries in all Assurance sub-streams (System Certification Services and Training Services)
* Be the ‘face of BSI’ by identifying relevant stakeholders and developing and maintaining relationships with key clients and stakeholders.

**Dotted- Line Responsibilities – Operations**

* Provide dotted-line leadership and oversight of Assurance Operations in India, ensuring operational performance and service delivery are aligned with business objectives, client commitments and the overall India Assurance strategy.
* Ensures BSI’s compliance with all relevant Accreditation requirements at all times.
* Ensure compliance with BSI’s policies and technical and legal requirements and thereby protect BSI’s brand reputation and intellectual property

**People**

* Lead, develop and manage Assurance resources in India, working with the Senior HR Business Partner to develop and execute a People plan to meet current and future business needs.
* Build organisational design and capability in India through investment in skills, knowledge and experience to create a resilient and agile organisation
* Build and develop a capable, resilient, diverse, and inclusive leadership team, leading the development and implementation of human resources strategies to ensure the recruitment, development, and retention of the highest-calibre professionals and leaders at all business levels.

**Key Success / Performance Indicators**
The geographic scope of the role covers India, and some more comprehensive international travel will also be required. Includes all aspects of general management, P&L accountability for India Assurance, direct sales responsibility and dotted-line Operations oversight:
  
  

* P&L performance – Revenue, contribution and delivery against budget
* Client growth - Average Revenue Per Account and total number of clients
* Client satisfaction retention
* Sales, revenue and contribution targets
* Employee engagement
* Innovation

**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

* Strong market understanding and knowledge of industry players
* Proven experience in developing, motivating and leading a winning team.
* Proven experience in a senior leadership position, ideally within a matrix organisation
* Proven experience in managing P&L and financial performance, including revenue, profitability, budgeting and forecasting.
* Proven experience in leading Sales and developing and executing commercial strategies to deliver sustainable revenue growth.
* The ability to develop effective relationships and, therefore, operate successfully at all levels, within and outside the organisation, is essential, along with good communication and presentation skills.
* An understanding of the business planning and budgetary control processes.
* BSI business language is English; therefore, a good level of written and spoken English is a must.
* Out-of-the-box thinker, self-motivated and result-driven
* Creator and fighter with a can-do mentality
* Ability to prioritise and handle multiple work demands and pressures, with a higher average amount of resilience
* Commercial thinker with sound knowledge of the systems certification industry would be advantageous
* Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple disciplines, regions and cultures
* Ability to influence & persuade others; with an inspirational leadership style
* Strong team player, adept at coaching and supporting others
* Proactive & goal-orientated – driven to achieve tangible commercial results for the business

**About Us**
BSI is a business improvement and standards company and for over a century BSI has been recognized for having a positive impact on organizations and society, building trust and enhancing lives.
  
  
Today BSI partners with more than 77,500 clients in 195 countries and engages with a 15,000 strong global community of experts, industry and consumer groups, organizations and governments.
  
  
Utilizing its extensive expertise in key industry sectors - including automotive, aerospace, built environment, food and retail, and healthcare - BSI delivers on its purpose by helping its clients fulfil theirs.
  
  
Living by our core values of Client-Centricity, Agility, and Collaboration, BSI provides organizations with the confidence to grow by partnering with them to tackle society’s critical issues – from climate change to building trust in digital transformation and everything in between - to accelerate progress towards a better society and a sustainable world.
  
  
BSI is an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

title: Area Credit Manager - WC | Rudrapur
description:
* POSITION DESCRIPTION

JOB TITLE : Area Credit Manager-Working Capital
  
  
GRADE : AVP-I
  
  
DEPARTMENT : Credit
  
  
LOCATION : RO
  
  
SUB-DEPARTMENT : Credit Working Capital
  
  
TYPE OF POSITION : Permanent
  
  
REPORTS TO : Regional Credit Manager-Working Capital
  
  
REPORTING INTO
  
  
Credit Manager-Working Capital
  
  

* ROLE PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE

* WORKING CAPITAL vertical is a growing business for Ujjivan. The Area Credit Manager will be an important position that will drive the Portfolio growth for the particular Area which involves multiple Branches.
* Underwriting of Working Capital - Fund Based & Non-Fund Based customers for Facility amount up to 10 Cr
* Implement robust credit underwriting policies and processes for large ticket size WORKING CAPITAL loans in the Area and ensure that the processes/policies are effectively managed on the field
* Conduct income appraisal and working capital gap of WORKING CAPITAL borrowers. In depth understanding and analysis of P & L Account and Balance Sheet including cash flows of self-employed borrowers.
* Ratio analysis of financials and loans for lending to self-employed customers.
* Responsible for underwriting and building quality secured portfolio.
* Engage with Risk committee to monitor credit risk and ensure Risk is managed proactively, involve in IDM (Inter Departmental Meeting), Risk Committee meetings, Audit closure meeting
* Work closely with Business and Collections team to manage collections in different buckets at the field
* Manage cost and productivity of team and vendors.
* SIZE OF THE ROLE

FINANCIAL SIZE
  
  
NON-FINANCIAL SIZE
  
  

* Portfolio size of 100 Cr
* 20-25 vendors (legal, technical etc.)
* Multiple Fund Based and Non Fund based offerings
* 20-30 files per month
* Coordination with CAD and Operations for case disbursement
* KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

**Business/ Financials**

* Underwriting target customer and understanding their working capital requirement
* Evaluate and assess whether collateral security is adequate.
* Implement Credit policies and processes for WORKING CAPITAL in field
* Implement new policies, amendments and technology changes through proper communication / training
* Participate in collection of dues from customers to maintain low delinquency/Bounce Rate
* Review and suggest policy and process changes based on the field understanding / feedback from the field team
* Ensure the portfolio quality in excellent category through induction of good quality customers in WORKING CAPITAL
* Effectively monitor external risk by keeping a tab on macro level inputs, field issues and customer dynamics
* Identify, highlight and address emerging risks proactively along with the risk and compliance departments
* Conduct Periodic review of Portfolio Quality and Collection to take necessary actions.
* Conduct periodic reviews with Credit Managers for driving desirable credit performance
* Be updated about the competition in the field and update the management on regular basis
* Monitor credit staff expenses across and ensure the same within the budget

**Customer (Both Internal & External)**

* Supervising the team in the given region for building of a performing portfolio.
* Work with Area Business Managers and Regional Business Managers for onboarding good customers, building quality portfolio, effective implementation of Credit Policies and team management
* Engage with vendors, FCU and other agencies to ensure productivity and cost control.
* Engage with Product Management Team for necessary changes in products as per the observations from the field
* Engage with Recruitment Manager for timely recruitment and induction of new employees
* Engage branch supervisors to understand the customer and field staff requirements while framing the policies and processes
* Ensure that credit responds to Customer’s and branch staff queries and issues timely.
* Engage with HR to ensure all staffing and training requirements are met in a timely manner
* Ensure the key MIS’s and reports are effectively delivered to management for managing business, portfolio, team and risk in the field

**Internal Process**

* Full adherence to all Regulatory Norms, Internal Policy & Process with respect to Credit & Collections
* Deliver High TAT applications are addressed immediately.
* Provide timely compliances to internal and external audit reports
* Present major findings to Risk Committee on High-Risk branches, IDM Issues and on monthly basis in coordination with Audit and Vigilance
* Implement accountability to address policy/process violations
* Timely escalation of critical cases to Credit Head and obtain appropriate deviation approvals
* Monitor timely & accurate submission of daily, weekly & monthly reports
* Monitor health of portfolio

**Innovation & Learning**

* Engage with HR to execute all training programs on Credit Policies and Processes
* Ensure structured induction plan for new joinees, lateral hires and internally promoted candidates
* Responsible for on time hiring of the right people for the assigned hubs
* Ensure goal-setting, midyear review and annual appraisal process happens within specified timelines for self and reportees
* Monitor performance of direct and skip level eportees against defined goals/metrics and take corrective action wherever required
* Ensure staff attrition is below defined limits at regional level
* Pursue Relevant Courses to the team and for the self and Groom team members for cross learning and provide growth opportunities
* Visit Field regularly with Subordinates to keep abreast of area related issues, underwriting performances, Performance of Competitors, and any staff related issues which may pose a risk to portfolio
* Monitor performance of staff against defined goals/metrics and take corrective action wherever required; undertake disciplinary and attendance monitoring of the team.
* MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

Educational
  
  
**Qualifications**

* CA or MBA in Finance from a reputed college or B.Com, M.Com with relevant experience

**Experience**

* Preferred experience of 5-10 years or more in Credit Secured Loan products in working capital limits and term loans.
* Experience in Team Handling and Credit Risk Management

Certifications
  
  

* Relevant certifications shall be an added advantage

Functional Skills
  
  

* Knowledge of Underwriting of loans (Credit, product & process)
* Knowledge of Documentation and Regulatory requirements
* Knowledge of financial analysis, working capital gap & cash flow determination
* Adequate Computer Knowledge
* Evaluate and assess collateral security/collateral documentation adequate for the lending
* Ability to speak and read regional language(s)- is desirable. Ability to communicate in English (Read-speak-write) is required. Has good verbal fluency and uses simple, clear and purposeful language

Behavioral Skills
  
  

* Accuracy, precision and attention to detail
* Pro-activeness and initiative taking
* Training skills and Co-ordination skills
* Interpersonal, Communication and Presentation skills
* Ownership, Leadership and team handling
* Problem Solving, conflict management skills
* Good personal discipline and planning
* Ability to form good working relationships with other functions
* Decision Making skills
* Performance oriented

Competencies Required
  
  

* Good Computer Knowledge
* Competent to handle MIS systems and Lending Software
* KEY INTERACTIONS

INTERNAL
  
  
EXTERNAL
  
  
Regional Credit Manager, Credit Managers, Regional Business Managers, Area Managers, Product Managers
  
  
Customers and Community
  
  
Vigilance Managers, Legal Managers, Audit Manager, Risk Managers, Collection Manager

title: Manager - Technology (CRM & Contact Centre Systems)
description:
GA Digital Web Word Pvt. Ltd. is hiring a Manager - Technology for deployment at the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Headquarters, New Delhi.

The role owns the technology stack behind Aadhaar's resident grievance and query ecosystem - CRM implementation, the Avaya communication system, SMS and USSD gateways, and the integrations that connect them to the wider UIDAI ecosystem.

Position: Manager - Technology (Band 'E', PMU)

Location: UIDAI Headquarters, New Delhi (On-site)

CTC: Rs. 14.00 lakhs to Rs. 26.00 lakhs per annum (Band 'E' - PMU, as per prevailing HR Policy)

Engagement: Contractual, through GA Digital Web Word Pvt. Ltd.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and implement CRM projects, including adherence to UIDAI SDLC, preparation of concept notes / BRD / IAD, facilitating solution design and POCs, monitoring development, and facilitating QA / testing / UAT and documentation.
* Coordinate with Aadhaar ecosystem stakeholders and partners and capture all functional requirements for the CRM implementation.
* Manage the Avaya communication system and SMS gateways.
* Extend the CRM application to all required internal and external stakeholders for end-to-end resolution of grievances and queries.
* Own technical integration (API based or otherwise) of the CRM system with all dependent systems in the UIDAI ecosystem.
* Own the RFP process including preparation, bid evaluation, formulation of SLA methodologies, vendor on-boarding and invoicing.
* Manage data migration, transformation, cleaning, reconciliation and data defect resolution.
* Ensure end-to-end, real-time SMS delivery and service availability through close coordination with the service provider (on-boarded NICSI gateway), Netcore system, Tech Centre, MSP and telecom service providers.
* Monitor the operation of SMS and USSD services; analyse process data and prepare MIS reports.
* Analyse queries, complaints and grievances from residents and civil society organisations and suggest resolutions.
* Own monthly SMS estimation, operation, maintenance and monitoring of daily KPI reports.
* Review SMS audit and Information Security (IS) policy compliance as per guidelines.
* Assess the effectiveness of the existing grievance redressal mechanism, including call centre operations and the CRM solution, and suggest improvements.

Eligibility (Mandatory)

* Education: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech / MCA / MBA
* Minimum 7-8 years of relevant IT industry experience.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in project management.
* 3-4 years of experience implementing CRM and call centre related applications and infrastructure in a reputed organisation, preferably open source based CRM or MS Dynamics CRM.

Desirable (Added Advantage)

* 2-3 years of experience with Avaya Communication Systems and Toll Free Number operations.
* Experience in e-Governance projects, including an understanding of government processes, RFPs, contract and vendor management.
* Experience in inbound / outbound SMS and USSD services, SMPP platform, SMS gateway and related data analytics.

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn, or email your updated CV along with your current CTC, expected CTC and notice period to cfo@gadigital.in

* Job Context & Major Challenges: Write the specific aspects of the job that provide a challenge (internal and external) to the jobholder in the context of the Business/Unit/Function/Department/Section

**Organizational Context**
**Key Aspects:**
As the lending arm of Aditya Birla Financial Services Group (ABFSG), Aditya Birla Finance Limited (ABFL) offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas.
  
  
Being one of the most preferred asset classes in the lending space today lends this business the immense challenge of competing with all FIs / banks in a highly price sensitive target segment.
  
  

* of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and Mortgages. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABFL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid-sized Banks and NBFCs
* Having focused traditionally on secured lending verticals and built a strong balance sheet on the same, ABFL has ventured into Unsecured Business segment in order to effectively capitalize on its financial base with carefully managed exposures in this higher yield segment
* The Unsecured Business segment products line caters to funding short term and medium term working capital needs of small businesses (BIL) and individuals (PIL), via a suite of customized short and long tenured products, without any security/ collateral.
* Risk function is engaged in evaluating the creditworthiness of both business and personal loan applications by considering quantitative & qualitative factors like the client credibility, size of the client business, earnings of an individual, capital adequacy, liquidity and management quality

**Job Context**
**Key Aspects:**

* To ensure smooth and institutionalized flow of the BIL & PIL proposals at all the branches across their region
* To manage is responsible for analyzing the credit proposal with the required due diligence and to ensure that all information required to take a credit decision is captured in the proposal.
* To maintain stipulated TAT in credit appraisal process and co-ordinate with sales team for faster decisions to improvise TATs of the overall sanction process.
* To manage a team of Credit Analysts who will carry out the due-diligence, analysis and recommend credit proposals for approval.

**Key Challenges**

* To ensure timely availability of accurate data and information for exhaustive credit appraisals as each proposal has its respective structuring complexities as per the customer, product & regulatory requirements.
* To ensure efficient TATs in highly competitive & dynamic market conditions
* To ensure credit risk and customer risk are mitigated at all times
* To facilitate seamless cross functional coordination for timely approval of credit proposals.
* To ensure sticky accounts as well as pending documents are monitored and regularized on a regular basis
* To ensure self and team are constantly updated on economic/ industry/ sectoral knowledge and trends

****Enabling Skill Sets & Qualifications****

* Critical skill required to meet this role are a strong analytical acumen, evaluation skills, detail orientation and decision making skills, initiative & target orientation, market intelligence, team management

The education & experience required to meet this profile is Chartered Accountant or MBA with minimum 4-7yrs of experience in credit and risk functions of Banks/NBFCs.
  
  

* Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4- 7 key result areas)

**Key Result Areas**
Supporting Actions
  
  
**Accountability**
Supporting Actions
  
  
Credit Underwriting Management
  
  

* Oversee the credit proposals evaluation and ensure that the client creditworthiness, business strength, market credibility, Financial statements, Income Tax returns, cash flow statements, repayment track record, average bank balance & adherence to other internal credit norms are followed
* Ensure direct and thorough investigation is undertaken to obtain relevant credit information through personal interaction with customer.
* Approve/ decision credit proposals at the local/ regional level and recommend for further approval/ decision to Zonal / National / Credit Committee levels for certain proposals
* Ensure timely submission of Credit Appraisal Memo to the Zonal Credit Manager for all proposals highlighting the key risks associated with the borrower to enable a prudent credit lending decisions
* Ensure no loss of revenue by issuing proper sanction letter and capturing the right deviation while assessing a case
* Ensure document execution from RMs & the handover of complete documentation to Operations team for disbursement of loans.
* Undertake detailed external research and market feedback on the loan proposal and evaluate the proposal in accordance

Documentation & MIS
  
  

* To maintain thorough documentation process for effective tracking of proposal documents and TAT monitoring
* To ensure compliance with robust documentation mechanism
* To oversee the preparation of MIS & trend charts on portfolio progress/variances/defaults for all the loans during their credit life cycle and derive insights at a regional level for relevant action
* To oversee the preparation of regular MIS for areas under risk management and give regional level presentations to various Zonal/ Corporate stakeholders

Process Management
  
  

* Ensure end to end processes are understood and followed by the regional team as per the SOPs at the local assessment level
* Monitor loans by tracking various covenants and sanction condition put in the proposals at the time of approvals
* Ensure data is captured in the requisite systems by the team to ensure proper MIS generation for business decisions
* Monitor the overdue position for the region and take appropriate steps to support the recovery process through the team.
* Handle customer escalations and complaints during and post disbursements in certain cases
* Drive continuous improvement in credit approval process to meet the dynamic business needs and institute mechanisms to mitigate risk associated with the products and customer satisfaction.

Team Management
  
  

* Manage, guide and develop a team of credit analysts to ensure that TAT, Process and Credit Quality are adhered to.
* Implement training modules as required for Local Credit Process team, Sales team on product, processes, legal and technical aspects

title: Practice Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Vivodent India is a growing dental and oral care practice committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered clinical services. The organization focuses on combining modern dental technologies with personalized care to improve patient outcomes and satisfaction. Vivodent India promotes a collaborative work environment where clinical and administrative teams work closely to ensure smooth practice operations. The practice emphasizes ethical treatment, transparent communication, and continuous improvement in service standards. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas that enhance patient experience and operational efficiency.

**Role Description**
The Practice Manager role at Vivodent India is a full-time, on-site position based in Gurgaon. The Practice Manager oversees daily clinic operations, including appointment scheduling, patient flow management, and coordination between clinical and administrative staff. This role is responsible for supervising front-desk activities, managing patient inquiries, and ensuring a welcoming, professional environment. The Practice Manager monitors operational processes, implements workflow improvements, and supports compliance with clinical, legal, and safety standards. The role also includes managing inventory and vendor relationships, assisting with basic financial tracking such as billing oversight and reporting, and supporting local marketing or community outreach initiatives. The Practice Manager works closely with leadership to align practice operations with business goals and maintain high levels of patient satisfaction.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in clinic, hospital, or healthcare practice management, including day-to-day operations and staff coordination.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage schedules, patient flow, and multiple administrative tasks efficiently.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with patients, clinical teams, and external partners.
* Basic understanding of billing, invoicing, and financial tracking in a healthcare or service environment.
* Working knowledge of practice management software, office productivity tools, and digital record-keeping.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain patient confidentiality.
* Problem-solving mindset with the capacity to address operational issues and improve workflows.
* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business administration, or a related field is preferred.
* Prior experience in dental or oral care settings is an advantage but not mandatory.
* Commitment to patient-centered care, ethical practices, and collaboration within a multidisciplinary team.

Own the production P&L: COGS, wastage, rejections and lead times, with a clear focus on cost and margin

production, track POs and forecast demand, and is open to new ways of working

Hands on experience building and managing vendor and artisan networks

A leader who solves problems on the ground and gets things done in a fast growing company

Work directly with the founders to shape sourcing and production for two growing brands, Dressfolk and Freefall by Huma Qureshi

Help take an Indian handloom brand to customers in 20+ countries

Build the supply chain for new categories from the ground up

Make a real difference to the livelihoods of 900+ weavers

Long term growth and ESOPs for high performers

Reach out to careers@dressfolk.com

We are looking for an experienced
**Staff Global Business Partner (GBP)**
to partner with site leadership.
  
  
This is a senior HR business partnering role for an individual who can operate at both strategic and operational depth, translating business priorities into organization, workforce and talent strategies while staying closely connected to leaders and teams at the point of operations.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, bringing strong business acumen, independent judgment and people expertise to complex organizational decisions. The role requires someone who can see around corners, connect signals across the organization and external environment, challenge constructively, and translate insights into practical actions that improve organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, talent readiness and employee experience.
  
  
The GBP will work closely with the Global Executive Business Partner (GEBP), Country People Leaders (CPLs), site and functional leadership, HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Employee Relations and People Services to ensure global People strategies translate effectively into the local operating environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic People & Organization Leadership**

* Translate business strategy, operating priorities and future capability requirements into a clear, forward-looking people agenda.
* Advise leaders on organization design, workforce strategy, capability building, leadership effectiveness and talent priorities, connecting near-term business requirements with longer-term organizational health.
* Understand the business beyond the People agenda, including operating priorities, organizational dependencies, workforce dynamics and external market factors that may affect talent or execution.
* Anticipate emerging organizational and workforce risks and opportunities, bringing forward recommendations before issues become critical.
* Balance global consistency with local effectiveness, adapting implementation approaches while preserving the intent of enterprise frameworks.

**Senior Leader Partnership & Coaching**

* Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leaders, bringing an independent point of view grounded in business context, data and organizational insight.
* Coach leaders through complex organization, talent, leadership and workforce decisions.
* Constructively challenge assumptions and help leaders understand the people and organizational implications of business decisions.
* Strengthen leadership effectiveness and accountability, particularly during periods of rapid growth, transformation or uncertainty.
* Build strong relationships deeper into the organization to maintain a direct understanding of business realities and emerging people issues.

**Organization & Talent**

* Shape organization and workforce plans that build the capabilities required for future business needs.
* Lead succession planning, talent reviews, leadership pipeline development and critical talent interventions.
* Identify organizational capability gaps and mobilize the appropriate development, hiring, movement or succession strategies.
* Enable talent movement and development across organizations, sites and geographies rather than solving talent needs within organizational boundaries alone.
* Partner with leaders to strengthen team effectiveness, leadership capability and organizational health.

**Team Member Insights, Culture & Change**

* Maintain a strong pulse on the organization through employee listening, leader engagement, workforce data and close connection to operations.
* Connect seemingly separate employee, talent, organizational and business signals to identify underlying themes and emerging risks.
* Help leaders navigate complex change with clarity, empathy and execution discipline, ensuring that decisions are understood and translated effectively through the organization.
* Strengthen leadership capability to communicate context, listen effectively and close the loop on employee feedback.
* Partner with leaders to anticipate how AI will reshape work, roles, skills and workforce needs, translating implications into talent and organization strategies.
* Champion Micron values and foster an inclusive, accountable and high-performing culture.

**Data, Insights & Decision Quality**

* Using AI to enhance workforce analytics and organizational insights to move leaders from data to diagnosis to action, rather than simply reporting metrics.
* Integrate quantitative data with qualitative signals from leaders, team members and the external environment to develop a holistic view of organizational health.
* Identify trends, challenge assumptions and develop executive-ready insights that support timely leadership decisions.
* Define measurable outcomes for key people priorities and maintain accountability for impact and follow-through.
* Partner across People teams to improve data quality and decision effectiveness where gaps exist.

**Enterprise Partnership & Execution**

* Connect effectively across GEBP, CPL, site leadership, COEs, Employee Relations, People Services and other partners to deliver integrated solutions.
* Bring the right expertise together around business problems rather than acting as the sole owner of every HR activity.
* Influence global and regional People solutions by bringing forward local business insights and implementation learnings.
* Lead critical People initiatives from diagnosis through execution, ensuring clear ownership, disciplined follow-through and measurable outcomes.
* Simplify and prioritize work to focus HRBP capacity on activities that create the greatest business and organizational value.

* At least 8 to 10 years HR Business Partner experience supporting complex, matrixed and operationally intensive organizations.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organization, workforce, talent and leadership matters.
* Strong business acumen with demonstrated ability to understand operating priorities and translate them into people and organization implications.
* Strong AI fluency, with demonstrated ability to apply AI to improve work, generate insights and support business and people decisions.
* Demonstrated capability in several of the following areas:

+ organization design and effectiveness
+ strategic workforce planning
+ talent and succession management
+ leadership coaching
+ organizational change
+ employee engagement and organizational health
