title: Independent Director
description:
**Two responsibilities that must remain connected**

The seat combines Risk Management Committee participation with CSR oversight. The connection is deliberate. A life-sciences organisation affects patients, customers, employees, communities and health systems through both its commercial operations and its social programmes. The director must ensure that risk decisions respect this consequence while preventing CSR from becoming brand activity detached from measurable need.

**Enterprise risk agenda**

The member will challenge the aggregation of quality, regulatory, supply, clinical or product, cyber/data, financial and reputation risks. The Board needs scenarios showing how a quality event, supply interruption or data failure travels across patients, regulators, revenue, liquidity and disclosure. Risk appetite should identify which standards are inviolable even under commercial or supply pressure.

Critical supply and manufacturing dependencies will be mapped beyond immediate vendors. Alternate qualification, inventory, cold or controlled conditions where relevant, transport, capacity and geopolitical exposure should be understood with realistic lead times. Contingency actions must be safe and regulatorily executable.

Technology and data oversight will cover sensitive information, access, third parties, validated systems, cyber detection and recovery. Restoration should establish accuracy and traceability, not merely availability. Material AI or analytical uses require ownership, approved data, validation, human review and correction pathways.

**Risk ownership and assurance**

Every principal risk should have an executive owner, a defined control standard, evidence of independent challenge and a threshold for Board escalation. The director will test whether quality, regulatory, information-security and business-continuity assurance examine the same critical path or leave gaps between functions. Closure will mean demonstrated control performance over time; an accepted action plan, revised procedure or target date is not itself remediation.

**Product and quality consequence**

The Board should receive serious deviations, complaints, field events, recalls or corrective actions in consequence terms. Recurrence and near misses can be more informative than a lagging count. The director will ask whether operating and commercial incentives influence escalation, investigation or closure.

**CSR and access**

Programmes should define the unmet need, beneficiary, delivery model, accountable technical authority, safeguard, outcome and exit. Health access is not proven by units distributed or people reached. The committee will examine continuity, appropriate use, follow-up and whether activity produced a defensible benefit.

Implementing partners need competence, financial integrity, safeguarding, local legitimacy and data protection. Programme selection must remain distinct from commercial influence, referral or market access. Beneficiaries should have a grievance and remedy route appropriate to the potential harm.

**First-year contribution**

The appointee will lead one integrated scenario joining a high-consequence operating risk with customer/patient response and community impact. Separately, the director will require one material CSR programme to be assessed against an independent outcome baseline rather than activity volume.

**Candidate profile**

Suitable candidates include healthcare or life-sciences CEOs, quality/regulatory leaders with enterprise breadth, CROs, public-health executives, clinicians with board experience and governance-grade CSR/ESG leaders. Applicants must understand both consequence and oversight boundaries. Independence, DIN and databank compliance are required, together with availability during a significant quality, supply or data event.

title: Staff Global Business Partner
description:
Job ID

JR116891

**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

We are looking for an experienced **Staff Global Business Partner (GBP)** to partner with site leadership.

This is a senior HR business partnering role for an individual who can operate at both strategic and operational depth, translating business priorities into organization, workforce and talent strategies while staying closely connected to leaders and teams at the point of operations.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders, bringing strong business acumen, independent judgment and people expertise to complex organizational decisions. The role requires someone who can see around corners, connect signals across the organization and external environment, challenge constructively, and translate insights into practical actions that improve organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, talent readiness and employee experience.

The GBP will work closely with the Global Executive Business Partner (GEBP), Country People Leaders (CPLs), site and functional leadership, HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Employee Relations and People Services to ensure global People strategies translate effectively into the local operating environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic People & Organization Leadership**

* Translate business strategy, operating priorities and future capability requirements into a clear, forward-looking people agenda.
* Advise leaders on organization design, workforce strategy, capability building, leadership effectiveness and talent priorities, connecting near-term business requirements with longer-term organizational health.
* Understand the business beyond the People agenda, including operating priorities, organizational dependencies, workforce dynamics and external market factors that may affect talent or execution.
* Anticipate emerging organizational and workforce risks and opportunities, bringing forward recommendations before issues become critical.
* Balance global consistency with local effectiveness, adapting implementation approaches while preserving the intent of enterprise frameworks.

**Senior Leader Partnership & Coaching**

* Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leaders, bringing an independent point of view grounded in business context, data and organizational insight.
* Coach leaders through complex organization, talent, leadership and workforce decisions.
* Constructively challenge assumptions and help leaders understand the people and organizational implications of business decisions.
* Strengthen leadership effectiveness and accountability, particularly during periods of rapid growth, transformation or uncertainty.
* Build strong relationships deeper into the organization to maintain a direct understanding of business realities and emerging people issues.

**Organization & Talent**

* Shape organization and workforce plans that build the capabilities required for future business needs.
* Lead succession planning, talent reviews, leadership pipeline development and critical talent interventions.
* Identify organizational capability gaps and mobilize the appropriate development, hiring, movement or succession strategies.
* Enable talent movement and development across organizations, sites and geographies rather than solving talent needs within organizational boundaries alone.
* Partner with leaders to strengthen team effectiveness, leadership capability and organizational health.

**Team Member Insights, Culture & Change**

* Maintain a strong pulse on the organization through employee listening, leader engagement, workforce data and close connection to operations.
* Connect seemingly separate employee, talent, organizational and business signals to identify underlying themes and emerging risks.
* Help leaders navigate complex change with clarity, empathy and execution discipline, ensuring that decisions are understood and translated effectively through the organization.
* Strengthen leadership capability to communicate context, listen effectively and close the loop on employee feedback.
* Partner with leaders to anticipate how AI will reshape work, roles, skills and workforce needs, translating implications into talent and organization strategies.
* Champion Micron values and foster an inclusive, accountable and high-performing culture.

**Data, Insights & Decision Quality**

* Using AI to enhance workforce analytics and organizational insights to move leaders from data to diagnosis to action, rather than simply reporting metrics.
* Integrate quantitative data with qualitative signals from leaders, team members and the external environment to develop a holistic view of organizational health.
* Identify trends, challenge assumptions and develop executive-ready insights that support timely leadership decisions.
* Define measurable outcomes for key people priorities and maintain accountability for impact and follow-through.
* Partner across People teams to improve data quality and decision effectiveness where gaps exist.

**Enterprise Partnership & Execution**

* Connect effectively across GEBP, CPL, site leadership, COEs, Employee Relations, People Services and other partners to deliver integrated solutions.
* Bring the right expertise together around business problems rather than acting as the sole owner of every HR activity.
* Influence global and regional People solutions by bringing forward local business insights and implementation learnings.
* Lead critical People initiatives from diagnosis through execution, ensuring clear ownership, disciplined follow-through and measurable outcomes.
* Simplify and prioritize work to focus HRBP capacity on activities that create the greatest business and organizational value.

**Required Qualifications**

* Master's/Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Organizational Development or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 8 to 10 years HR Business Partner experience supporting complex, matrixed and operationally intensive organizations.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders on organization, workforce, talent and leadership matters.
* Strong business acumen with demonstrated ability to understand operating priorities and translate them into people and organization implications.
* Strong AI fluency, with demonstrated ability to apply AI to improve work, generate insights and support business and people decisions.
* Demonstrated capability in several of the following areas:
  + organization design and effectiveness
  + strategic workforce planning
  + talent and succession management
  + leadership coaching
  + organizational change
  + employee engagement and organizational health
  + people analytics and insight generation
* Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to challenge constructively without relying on positional authority.
* Strong judgment and comfort operating independently in complex or ambiguous situations.
* Ability to translate complex issues into concise recommendations and executive-level narratives.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting semiconductor, manufacturing, engineering or other complex technology/operations environments.
* Experience working within a multinational, matrixed organization across multiple countries or sites.
* Experience partnering across global and local HR teams and translating enterprise programs into locally effective solutions.
  

  

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**

We are an industry leader in innovative memory and storage solutions transforming how the world uses information to enrich life *for all*. With a relentless focus on our customers, technology leadership, and manufacturing and operational excellence, Micron delivers a rich portfolio of high-performance DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through our Micron® and Crucial® brands. Every day, the innovations that our people create fuel the data economy, enabling advances in artificial intelligence and 5G applications that unleash opportunities — from the data center to the intelligent edge and across the client and mobile user experience.

To request assistance with the application process and/or for reasonable accommodations, please contact hrsupport\_india@micron.com

* Diploma or certification in cosmetology, beauty therapy, or salon management is preferred; a degree in business, hospitality, or related fields is an added advantage.

title: Associate-Resource Management
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Resource Management Advanced Associate**
As a Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will be part of an industry leading, high performing and agile team of workforce management professionals providing exceptional client service to our stakeholders and helping our employees gain differential experiences that are aligned to their career aspirations.
  
  
We provide learning and growth opportunities to build your ability to analyze, innovate, think and act globally. You’ll be part of an organization that is focused on optimization, is solution oriented, innovates and provides best in class services to the client serving teams.
  
  
**The opportunity**
EY Global Delivery Services (EY GDS) is a dynamic and global service delivery network of over 50,000 professionals working across borders, to provide innovative and strategic business solutions to EY member firms and EY clients globally. Resource Management plays a vital role in the firm’s Next Wave strategy and it’s purpose of building a better working world.
  
  
We offer a great place to work for every person joining EY. At GDS, you will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a truly global environment. You will learn and gain experiences from industry leading WFM professionals and a path breaking leadership team.
  
  
We invest in your learning and development. We’ll help you develop the technical and soft skills you need. We support your professional development with a combination of learning, networking, experiences, and coaching. As part of a 300+ member team, supporting 4 unique Service Lines, you will always have opportunities to showcase your skills and contribute to the firm’s strategic initiatives.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As an Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will work as the staffing point of contact for the assigned region/service/competency team and will be responsible to work with the service delivery managers in capturing staffing demand projections, analyze demand intake patterns, demand – supply matching, demand – supply gaps, schedule individuals on projects, optimize employee utilization and bench management.
  
  
**Some of your key responsibilities include:**

* Capture demand projections, understand demands heuristics and identify actionable demand.
* Calculate staffing requirements based on demand projections, delivery deadlines and productivity targets.
* Identify suitable staffing options based on matching skills, roles and experiences.
* Create staffing schedules to maximize service and minimize cost.

The suitable candidate should have good analytical skills, can compute staffing demands, validate skills and experiences associated with the demand, identify suitable fulfilment options from the internal pool of professionals available for allocation or on bench and negotiate staffing solutions with the service delivery managers.

* Basic knowledge of MS Excel.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Experience on workforce management concepts, resource deployment and scheduling.
* Working knowledge and subject matter expertise in resource management, demand planning and scheduling in reputed consulting, technology, financial services, accounting and professional services organizations.

The successful candidate will be one who combines computer skills and mathematical ability with a working knowledge of the business and the negotiation skills of a salesman.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**

title: General Manager and Branch Head
description:
General Manager – Lachmandas Trading Company, (Aswani Lachmandas Group), Ernakulam branch.

1. About Aswani Lachmandas Group

The **Aswani Lachmandas Group** is a diversified, family-led business group with a strong presence in trading, distribution, retail and allied businesses. Built on a legacy of trust, entrepreneurship and long-standing relationships with principals, customers and business partners, the Group has grown through a combination of strong market execution, people development and disciplined business practices.

The Group believes in combining its traditional strengths in distribution and trade relationships with modern management practices, technology, process discipline and continuous improvement.

2. About Lachmandas Trading Company

**Lachmandas Trading Company (LTC)** is a key distribution and trading business within the Aswani Lachmandas Group. The company has an established presence in the FMCG and tobacco distribution ecosystem and works with a large network of retailers and trade partners.

The business operates across multiple categories and channels, including cigarette/tobacco and non-tobacco products, supported by a field sales force, channel managers, team leaders, godown and logistics personnel, accounts and billing teams, and HR support.

The **Devi Complex Branch** is an important operating unit of the company. The General Manager will be responsible for providing overall leadership to the branch, ensuring coordinated functioning across sales, collections, operations, logistics, finance, administration and people management.

3. Position

**Designation:** General Manager  
**Location:** Devi Complex Branch  
**Reporting To:** Management / Directors  
**Department:** Overall Branch Operations

4. Role Purpose

The General Manager will be responsible for the **overall business performance, profitability, operational efficiency and people management of the Devi Complex Branch**.

The role requires the GM to act as the single point of coordination and accountability for all major branch functions, with a focus on:

* Driving sales and category growth
* Improving retail throughput and market execution
* Ensuring timely collections and reducing receivables
* Strengthening process discipline and compliance
* Ensuring accurate inventory and efficient logistics
* Developing and managing the branch team
* Improving coordination between departments
* Identifying operational gaps and building the required support structure

The GM will work through the respective Channel Managers, Team Leaders, Salesmen, Godown Coordinator, Stock In-charges, Accounts and Billing In-charge, and HR support staff.

The objective is to build a **high-performing, process-driven and accountable branch that consistently delivers sales growth, strong collections, efficient operations and excellent customer service**.

5. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Overall Branch Leadership and Business Management

* Take complete ownership of the overall performance of the Devi Complex Branch.
* Develop annual, quarterly and monthly business plans in line with company objectives.
* Translate management objectives into clear departmental and individual targets.
* Conduct regular performance reviews across sales, collections, operations and support functions.
* Ensure effective coordination between all departments and eliminate operational silos.
* Identify gaps in people, processes, systems and infrastructure and recommend corrective action.
* Escalate key business risks, market developments and operational challenges to management in a timely manner.
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability, discipline and continuous improvement.

B. Sales and Business Growth

The GM will oversee both the **cigarette/tobacco and non-tobacco businesses**, working through the respective Channel Managers, Team Leaders and Salesmen.

Key responsibilities:

* Drive achievement of sales targets across all channels and categories.
* Improve **retail throughput** and productivity across the outlet universe.
* Increase active outlet coverage and improve the quality of productive outlets.
* Identify opportunities to grow existing categories and introduce new categories.
* Monitor market trends, competition, retailer feedback and emerging opportunities.
* Improve beat productivity, salesman productivity and outlet-level performance.
* Ensure effective execution of company and principal-led initiatives.
* Work with Channel Managers to develop focused plans for underperforming territories, categories or teams.
* Review sales performance regularly and take prompt corrective action where targets are not being achieved.

C. Cigarette / Tobacco Business Management

Working with the relevant Channel Managers and sales leadership team, the GM will be responsible for:

* Driving sustainable sales and retail throughput growth.
* Ensuring strong market execution and availability.
* Monitoring competitive activity and taking appropriate action to protect and grow market share.
* Reducing business loss arising from competition, poor execution or process gaps.
* Ensuring compliance with all company, principal and regulatory processes.
* Monitoring GR management and related processes.
* Ensuring timely management of outstanding receivables and LTA payments.
* Improving database accuracy and ensuring correct customer, outlet and transaction information.
* Reviewing market-level exceptions and ensuring timely resolution.
* Driving accountability across the sales hierarchy.

D. Non-Tobacco Sales and Category Management

The GM will lead the non-tobacco business through the Channel Managers, Team Leaders and Salesmen.

Key responsibilities include:

* Drive growth across all assigned non-tobacco categories.
* Develop specific growth plans for **GR1A, GR1B and GR2** categories.
* Improve category-wise outlet penetration and retail throughput.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling and expanding product range across existing outlets.
* Improve new outlet acquisition and productive outlet conversion.
* Ensure focused execution of category-specific targets and schemes.
* Monitor category profitability and business quality.
* Ensure adherence to all sales, credit, billing and process requirements.
* Maintain strict control over outstanding receivables.
* Identify underperforming categories, territories and sales personnel and implement corrective action plans.

E. Collections, Outstanding and Receivables Management

One of the GM's key responsibilities will be to ensure that sales growth is accompanied by strong financial discipline.

The GM will:

* Monitor outstanding receivables across all businesses and categories.
* Ensure timely collection of dues and reduce overdue balances.
* Review ageing reports on a regular basis.
* Work with sales and accounts teams to resolve collection bottlenecks.
* Ensure appropriate follow-up on high-risk and long-pending accounts.
* Prevent uncontrolled credit extension.
* Ensure adherence to approved credit policies and limits.
* Monitor LTA and other pending payments.
* Establish clear accountability for outstanding management at Channel Manager, Team Leader and Salesman levels.
* Maintain a healthy balance between sales growth and quality of receivables.

F. Godown, Inventory and Logistics Management

The GM will oversee godown and delivery operations with the support of the **Godown Coordinator and Stock In-charges**.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensure smooth and efficient functioning of the godown.
* Maintain accurate inventory and stock records.
* Monitor stock shortages, damages, discrepancies and WSP shortages.
* Ensure timely investigation and closure of stock variances.
* Improve stock handling, storage and movement practices.
* Ensure prompt and accurate order processing and dispatch.
* Monitor delivery turnaround time and customer service levels.
* Ensure efficient vehicle utilisation and vehicle management.
* Track vehicle maintenance, statutory requirements and license renewals.
* Ensure proper scheduling and deployment of delivery resources.
* Maintain high standards of godown cleanliness, hygiene and safety.
* Conduct periodic stock verification and reconciliation.
* Identify opportunities to reduce operational inefficiencies and logistics costs.

G. Billing, Accounts and Compliance

Working closely with the **Accounts and Billing In-charge**, the GM will ensure:

* Prompt and accurate billing.
* Timely completion of accounting and bookkeeping activities.
* Proper adherence to internal processes and financial controls.
* Timely renewal and management of insurance policies and other relevant statutory requirements.
* Proper documentation and record maintenance.
* Timely reconciliation of key accounts and transactions.
* Coordination between sales, godown and accounts to prevent billing and stock discrepancies.
* Timely escalation and resolution of financial or process-related exceptions.
* Compliance with company policies, statutory requirements and principal guidelines.

H. Human Resources and People Management

The GM will work with HR Assistants and management to build a strong and motivated branch team.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensure appropriate manpower planning across departments.
* Identify manpower gaps and initiate timely recruitment.
* Participate in the selection and onboarding of key employees.
* Ensure proper induction and role clarity for new employees.
* Monitor attendance, payroll inputs and workforce-related records.
* Conduct regular performance reviews of key team members.
* Identify training and capability-building requirements.
* Develop succession and backup plans for critical roles.
* Improve employee engagement and morale.
* Implement staff welfare initiatives in coordination with management and HR.
* Address employee grievances and workplace issues in a timely and fair manner.
* Promote a culture of discipline, teamwork, accountability and respect.

6. Process Compliance and Internal Controls

The GM will be responsible for ensuring that the branch operates in a disciplined and process-oriented manner.

This includes:

* Ensuring compliance with approved company processes.
* Identifying areas of process leakage or non-compliance.
* Ensuring timely corrective action.
* Maintaining accurate business and operational data.
* Improving database accuracy.
* Ensuring proper documentation and approvals.
* Monitoring key control points across sales, collections, stock, billing and expenses.
* Supporting internal audits and implementing corrective actions.
* Developing simple dashboards and review mechanisms to track key branch KPIs.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the General Manager will be measured across the following areas:

Business Performance

* Achievement of sales targets
* Sales growth versus previous year
* Category-wise growth
* Retail throughput growth
* Productive outlet growth
* Outlet penetration and market coverage
* Sales team productivity

Collections and Financial Discipline

* Outstanding levels
* Ageing of receivables
* Collection efficiency
* Reduction in overdue accounts
* Timeliness of LTA and other payments

Operations and Logistics

* Stock accuracy
* Reduction in stock shortages and discrepancies
* WSP shortage management
* Delivery turnaround time
* Vehicle utilisation and management
* Godown hygiene and operational standards

Process and Compliance

* Process adherence
* Audit observations and closure
* Database accuracy
* Timely license and insurance renewals
* Billing and documentation accuracy

People Management

* Employee productivity
* Recruitment turnaround time
* Employee retention
* Staff welfare and engagement
* Performance management and team development

8. Authority and Resource Support

The General Manager will have the responsibility to identify gaps in the existing organisation structure, skills or support systems.

Where a genuine gap is identified, the GM may recommend:

* Recruitment of additional functional in-charges
* Restructuring of responsibilities
* Additional manpower
* Process improvements
* Technology or reporting support
* Training and capability development

Management will support the strengthening of the branch structure wherever there is a clear business need and a defined improvement plan.

The expectation from the GM is not necessarily to personally execute every activity, but to **build the right team, establish clear accountability, review performance rigorously and ensure that outcomes are delivered**.

9. Desired Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should possess:

* Strong experience in FMCG, distribution, trading, sales or branch management.
* Demonstrated experience in managing multiple teams and functions.
* Strong understanding of sales, collections and receivables management.
* Experience in distribution operations, inventory and logistics management.
* Ability to analyse business data and translate insights into action.
* Strong leadership and people-management capabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* High levels of ownership, integrity and process discipline.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Comfort in dealing with frontline employees as well as senior management.

10. The Role in One Statement

**The General Manager is the overall business and operating leader of the Devi Complex Branch, responsible for ensuring better sales, stronger collections, controlled receivables, efficient operations, accurate stock, prompt deliveries, process compliance and a motivated, accountable workforce.**

The GM's success will be measured not merely by individual departmental performance, but by the ability to create a **well-coordinated, profitable, disciplined and continuously improving branch operation**.

* Commuter assistance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Bachelor's (Required)

* Sales management: 5 years (Required)
* General Management: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

You will lead and manage all the customer accounts in India with a team of customer success professionals. We are actively seeking a highly enthusiastic and deeply empathetic Product Accessibility Engineer to become an integral part of our dynamic team. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute significantly to our core mission: ensuring all our applications are universally accessible to every individual, irrespective of their abilities or challenges.
  
  
As a Product Accessibility Engineer, you will be immersed in the complete product development lifecycle, from the initial conceptual design phases through to meticulous testing and final deployment. This hands-on experience will provide invaluable insights and practical skills within the rapidly expanding and critically important field of digital accessibility. You will collaborate closely with various teams, including product managers, designers, and engineers, to identify potential accessibility barriers, propose innovative solutions, and implement best practices that adhere to global accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG).

title: Senior Software Engineering Manager, Product Security
description:
Senior Software Engineering Manager, Product SecurityThis role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

**Job Description:**

**About the Role**
==================

As a Senior Software Engineering Manager within HPE’s Product Security Office (PSO), you will build and lead a high-performing development team responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and operating secure, reliable, and scalable software. Your team will deliver applications, platforms, APIs, automation, and integrations that enable product teams to identify, manage, and reduce security risk across the product lifecycle.

This is a build-and-scale people leadership role. You will create the team environment, delivery discipline, and engineering practices needed to turn product security priorities into dependable capabilities used across HPE. You will set clear priorities, develop engineering talent, establish repeatable operating mechanisms, and ensure the team delivers measurable outcomes with strong security, quality, reliability, and maintainability.

Operating within PSO’s matrixed model, you will balance shared engineering capacity across multiple product security capabilities, partnering with capability owners who define business outcomes and priorities while retaining accountability for people leadership, engineering execution, and technical delivery. You will bring enough technical depth to guide decisions, challenge approaches, review engineering quality, and remove obstacles while holding engineers accountable for technical ownership and execution.

You will partner with PSO leaders, product and capability owners, architects, program managers, product engineering teams, and adjacent cybersecurity organizations to align roadmaps, manage dependencies, and scale solutions across diverse product environments. The role manages individual contributors and succeeds by building a capable team—not by acting as the primary architect or personally owning every technical decision.

**What you’ll do:**
===================

**Build and Lead the Engineering Team**

* Hire, onboard, lead, and develop a team of individual-contributor software and security engineers, setting clear expectations, goals, development plans, and accountability for results.
* Create an inclusive, high-trust engineering culture grounded in ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenge.
* Provide regular coaching, feedback, career development, and performance support while building succession strength and expanding the team’s technical capabilities.
* Match work to skills and development needs, delegate meaningful ownership, and ensure senior engineers lead design and implementation within clear decision boundaries.
* Plan team capacity, workload, and skill coverage; identify resourcing risks and recommend hiring, development, or partner strategies.

**Drive Engineering Delivery and Operations**

* Translate Product Security Office priorities and capability roadmaps into clear engineering plans, milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead day-to-day engineering execution, including prioritization, sprint and release planning, dependency management, risk tracking, escalation, and delivery reviews.
* Ensure the team builds and operates secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable software, services, automation, APIs, data integrations, and product security tooling.
* Establish effective engineering practices for design review, source control, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, incident response, and operational support.
* Balance new capability development with operational reliability, technical debt reduction, defect remediation, platform modernization, and lifecycle maintenance.
* Define and monitor meaningful measures for delivery predictability, quality, reliability, security, adoption, and engineering effectiveness.

**Shape Product Security Capabilities**

* Partner with product and capability owners to understand user needs, clarify requirements, prioritize engineering investments, and sequence delivery across the Product Security Office capability portfolio.
* Guide development of reusable product security platforms and services that improve vulnerability management, security assessment, secure development, reporting, workflow automation, or related security outcomes.
* Promote automation and responsible use of AI-assisted engineering where they improve speed, consistency, coverage, or user experience while preserving validation, traceability, security, and human accountability.
* Ensure security, privacy, data-handling, resilience, and compliance considerations are incorporated into solution design and delivery.
* Use stakeholder feedback, operational data, and engineering insights to identify opportunities for simplification, reuse, integration, and continuous improvement.

**Lead Across Teams and Boundaries**

* Build strong working relationships across Product Security, product engineering, security research, vulnerability response, infrastructure, architecture, and enterprise technology teams.
* Align stakeholders on priorities, scope, tradeoffs, dependencies, and delivery commitments, escalating material risks with clear options and recommendations.
* Provide transparent capacity, dependency, and engineering investment tradeoffs across the PSO portfolio, helping leadership determine when capabilities should be built, integrated, scaled, modernized, consolidated, or retired.
* Coordinate effectively with globally distributed teams and partners while establishing clear ownership, handoffs, documentation, and operating rhythms.
* Communicate engineering progress, risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to technical teams, product leaders, and senior stakeholders.
* Represent the team in planning, architecture, operational, and leadership forums while ensuring individual contributors retain appropriate technical visibility and ownership.

**What you need to bring:**
===========================

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, software engineering, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 10 or more years of relevant software engineering, security engineering, or technology experience, including 3+ years of people management experience directly managing software engineers.
* Proven experience leading teams that design, build, release, and operate enterprise software, platforms, services, automation, or developer-facing capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage individual contributors, develop talent, set clear priorities, address performance issues, and create accountability for delivery and engineering quality.
* Experience establishing or improving engineering practices across software design, code review, testing, CI/CD, secure development, release management, observability, and operational support.
* Experience managing roadmaps, delivery plans, dependencies, technical debt, operational risk, and competing stakeholder priorities in a complex or matrixed organization.
* Strong technical understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, cloud environments, containers, data platforms, source control, CI/CD, and secure software development practices.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to explain technical risks and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams and collaborating across time zones, cultures, and organizational boundaries.
* Experience with Python, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript, React, Node.js, SQL or NoSQL data platforms, REST APIs, Linux, GitHub, Jenkins or GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, or comparable technologies.
* Experience applying AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, or agentic methods within secure engineering workflows, including appropriate validation and human oversight.
* Experience improving engineering operating models, building a new team or capability, or scaling a platform from project-based delivery to sustainable operations.
* Working knowledge of common software weaknesses, OWASP guidance, threat modeling, software supply-chain security, and secure development lifecycle principles.
* Relevant engineering, cloud, agile, or security certifications are helpful but not required.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* A capable, engaged engineering team has clear priorities, meaningful ownership, strong development support, and accountability for outcomes.
* Product security capabilities move from ambiguous needs to predictable delivery through clear roadmaps, operating rhythms, engineering standards, and decision ownership.
* Software and automation are secure, reliable, maintainable, measurable, and supported through disciplined lifecycle and operational practices.
* Product and capability owners have a trusted engineering partner that provides transparent delivery commitments, credible tradeoffs, and timely escalation of risks.
* Reusable platforms, integrations, automation, and engineering practices reduce fragmentation and improve the scale and effectiveness of Product Security Office capabilities.
* The team becomes increasingly self-sufficient as engineers grow in technical ownership, judgment, collaboration, and leadership.

**Accessibility**

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

**What We Can Offer You:**

**Health & Wellbeing**

title: Staff Customer Experience Manager
description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Are you an experienced professional with a strong technical background in customer experience and a deep-seated passion for building lasting relationships with senior-level customers? If so, you will thrive on our team which values collaboration, technical credibility, and the opportunity to drive customer success through innovative solutions using Nutanix technology, all while having the potential for career advancement in a supportive and empowering environment.

**About the Team**
------------------

At Nutanix, you would be joining the Customer Success team, a group dedicated to driving adoption and ensuring customer satisfaction with our hybrid multicloud solutions for our strategic customers. This cohesive team is deeply motivated by a shared commitment to ensuring our customers' long-term success and value realization. Operating from key locations, the team prides itself on fostering collaboration and building strong relationships with customers. The culture emphasizes teamwork, deep technical credibility, and a commitment to being trusted advisors, which aligns with the mission of enhancing customer experience and delivering value through effective engagement and proactive support.

This is a technical role that requires strong customer management skills. You’ll collaborate with customer IT operations and architecture teams, as well as with business and IT leadership. Strategy and goals will be defined with customer leadership. Goals will be achieved by customer operations and architecture teams guided and informed by your deep technical and architectural knowledge. You will be expected to achieve the Nutanix Certified Expert (NCX) certification (training will be provided for this) within your first 6-12 months. NCX is an architectural certification earned by developing and documenting a Nutanix design, and defending it in front of a panel of experts.

You will report to the Regional Leader of Customer Success, who believes in the power of partnerships and collaboration, where every team member actively engages clients to help them realize their goals and achieve meaningful outcomes. The work setup is primarily remote, allowing you to operate efficiently within your designated region without the need for a traditional office space. Instead of commuting to an office every day, you'll spend most of your time engaging directly with customers to build relationships, understand their needs, resolve their issues, and drive their outcomes. The role does require weekly travel within your region, but you can expect overnight stays due to the regional landscape and logistics, ensuring you remain connected to both your customers and your team.

**Your Role**
-------------

* Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned customer accounts to ensure their success with Nutanix technology.
* Act as the post-sales trusted advisor for 10-12 strategic customers, overseeing customer needs from deployment to adoption to long-term operation to expansion.
* Collaborate with internal teams to optimize resource utilization and serve customer requirements effectively.
* Collaborate with customers to understand their business goals and technical requirements.
* Partner with customer architects team to help align architecture to customer business needs.
* Create and document tailored Customer Success Plans that align with customers' business and technology goals, conduct reviews, and track progress.
* Monitor customer satisfaction metrics (e.g., NPS, CSAT) and proactively address any concerns.
* Drive product adoption and expansion among customer organizations through deep technical understanding and proactive relationship management.
* Provide actionable insights on technology usage, maturity, and best practices to help customers achieve operational efficiency.
* Collect and advocate customer feedback to influence future product development and service enhancements at Nutanix.
* Lead the technical onboarding process for new customers ensuring alignment with customer’s desired outcomes.

The role involves performing duties requiring the application of professional expertise and the exercise of independent judgment/discretion, creativity, problem-solving, and decision-making in carrying out responsibilities, as applicable to the position. The specific responsibilities of the role may vary based on business needs and role requirements. Employees can refer to the applicable guidelines and career frameworks for additional information regarding role expectations and responsibilities.

**What You Will Bring**
-----------------------

* 8-12 years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, demonstrating credibility with mid-senior level business and technical audiences.
* Understanding of and experience with architectural frameworks such as ITIL, TOGAF, etc.
* Deep technical knowledge of data center technology and virtualization, ideally with a focus on hybrid multicloud solutions. Experience with containerization and AI infrastructure is highly desirable.
* Understanding of large scale customer operational standards and processes.
* Technical credibility supported by relevant certifications (e.g., VCDX, VCAP, NPX, NCX, ITIL v4, TOGAF).
* Excellent communication and relationship skills, capable of advocating for customer needs and delivering constructive feedback to internal teams.
* A customer-centric mindset with a passion for driving positive outcomes and applying problem-solving strategies.

**Work Arrangement**
--------------------

Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. For most roles, that will mean coming into an office a minimum of 2 - 3 days per week, however certain roles and/or teams may require more frequent in-office presence. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

title: Workstation Engineer
description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At **Worldwide Clinical Trials** , we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.

  

With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.

  

**SUMMARY:** The Workstation Engineer is responsible for the design, lifecycle management, security, standardization, and continuous improvement of Worldwide's end-user computing environment. This role ensures that employee devices, operating systems, endpoint management platforms, and productivity tools remain secure, reliable, compliant, and aligned with business needs.

The Workstation Engineer evaluates emerging technologies, maintains endpoint technology roadmaps, manages hardware and software standards, validates compatibility, administers endpoint management solutions, and supports the deployment of secure workstation technologies across a global enterprise environment. The role works closely with Security, Infrastructure, Service Desk, Procurement, and business stakeholders to deliver a modern digital workplace experience. Industry best practices emphasize endpoint lifecycle management, modern device management, cloud-managed endpoints, automation, and Zero Trust security principles.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIE** S

Tasks may include but are not limited to

Endpoint Strategy & Roadmap

* Own and maintain the global workstation hardware roadmap.
* Define and manage approved standards for laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals, and mobile computing devices.
* Develop lifecycle and refresh strategies for end-user hardware.
* Recommend future-state endpoint solutions aligned with business, security, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with Procurement and vendors to evaluate new hardware platforms and technologies.

Technology Evaluation & Innovation

* Research, evaluate, and assess new endpoint technologies, operating systems, management tools, and productivity solutions.
* Conduct proofs of concept (POCs) and pilot programs for emerging technologies.
* Evaluate compatibility, supportability, security risks, and operational impact of new solutions.
* Provide recommendations based on technical, business, security, and user experience considerations.

Hardware & Software Compatibility Testing

* Design, coordinate, and execute testing activities for workstation hardware, operating systems, drivers, applications, and peripherals.
* Validate compatibility between business applications and supported endpoint platforms.
* Develop testing standards, procedures, and acceptance criteria.
* Document findings and support enterprise-wide deployment decisions.

Endpoint Engineering & Administration

* Engineer, deploy, and maintain Windows and macOS workstation environments.
* Manage endpoint configuration standards and images.
* Configure and support endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Jamf, and related technologies.
* Develop automation and self-service solutions to improve endpoint management and user experience.
* Create and maintain endpoint configuration, compliance, and security policies.

Patch & Vulnerability Management

* Test, validate, and deploy operating system, driver, firmware, and application updates.
* Assess software patches for potential business impact prior to enterprise deployment.
* Develop deployment schedules and rollout strategies.
* Monitor patch compliance and remediation activities.
* Partner with Cybersecurity teams to address endpoint vulnerabilities and reduce risk exposure.

Security & Compliance

* Support Zero Trust and endpoint security initiatives.
* Ensure workstation configurations comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Security teams to implement endpoint protection, encryption, device compliance, and conditional access controls.
* Participate in security reviews, audits, and compliance assessments.

Operational Support

* Serve as Tier 3 escalation support for complex workstation-related incidents and problems.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Engage vendors and manufacturers to resolve product defects and technical issues.
* Support major incidents impacting endpoint services.

Documentation & Process Improvement

* Develop and maintain technical standards, procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Maintain endpoint architecture documentation and hardware standards catalogs.
* Continuously improve workstation deployment, support, and lifecycle processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.

Project Participation

* Lead or participate in endpoint modernization initiatives.
* Support workstation-related workstreams for mergers, acquisitions, office openings, and technology refresh projects.
Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Networking, Cybersecurity, and Service Desk teams to deliver endpoint solutions.  

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Technology evaluation and decision-making.
* Project and change management.
* Process improvement mindset.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to balance security, usability, and operational requirements.
* Vendor management and stakeholder engagement.
* Documentation and knowledge management.
* Customer-focused approach.
* Ability to work independently in a global environment.
* Success Measures
* The Workstation Engineer will be measured on:
* Endpoint compliance and security posture.
* Hardware roadmap effectiveness and lifecycle management.
* Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance.
* Device reliability and user experience metrics.
* Reduction in endpoint-related incidents.
* Successful delivery of endpoint modernization initiatives.
* Automation and operational efficiency improvements.
Quality of documentation and technical standards.  

REQUIREMENTS:
  
Education

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Experience

* 5+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, workstation engineering, desktop engineering, or end-user computing.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale Windows workstation environments.
* Experience with endpoint lifecycle management and hardware standardization.
* Experience testing and validating hardware and software compatibility.
* Experience managing software deployment and patch management processes.

Technical Skills

* Windows 10/11 administration and engineering.
* Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager.
* Windows Autopilot.
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Microsoft 365 platform.
* PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Endpoint security technologies.
* Software packaging and deployment.
* Hardware lifecycle and asset management.
* Driver and firmware management.
* Device compliance and configuration management.
* Remote support and endpoint troubleshooting.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting macOS environments.
* Experience with Jamf Pro.
* Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or other virtual desktop technologies.
* Experience with Tanium or similar endpoint management platforms.
* Experience with Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX/DEM) tools.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate.
* Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator (or successor certification).
* Experience operating within a regulated environment such as healthcare, clinical research, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industries.

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

  
  

**Discover the Difference**

  

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do. Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit **http://www.worldwide.com/careers** **,** or connect with us on **LinkedIn** .

description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
This role leads a team supporting Revenue Analytics and Operations in protecting billing accuracy, revenue integrity, and customer experience. The Manager is accountable for team delivery and performance, including the timely and accurate resolution of customer account, order, and billing-related issues; oversight of ticket queues and reporting; and adherence to established company policies, controls, and procedures. Responsibilities also include managing operational risks and escalations, establishing priorities, monitoring quality and productivity, and driving improvements to policies, processes, reporting, and controls. The role develops employees through ongoing coaching and performance management, promotes effective collaboration with cross-functional partners, and ensures the team has the knowledge, tools, and direction needed to achieve business objectives. Success requires strong leadership, operational judgment, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and the ability to translate trends and business needs into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Leads, coaches, and develops a team responsible for resolving customer account, order, billing, and revenue-related issues accurately and within established turnaround expectations.
* Establishes team priorities and allocates work based on ticket volume, issue complexity, business impact, employee capacity, and service-level expectations.
* Oversee ticket queues and operational reports, monitoring aging, backlog, recurring issues, productivity, quality, and emerging customer, financial, or operational risks.
* Manages significant or unresolved escalations, removes barriers to resolution, and coordinates with cross-functional partners to drive timely and sustainable outcomes.
* Ensures corrective orders, adjustments, billing-code changes, and other resolution activities comply with established company policies, controls, procedures, and approval requirements.
* Reviews trends and root-cause analyses to identify systemic issues, recurring process failures, and opportunities to protect revenue integrity and improve customer experience.
* Establishes and monitors team performance measures, including resolution timeliness, quality, productivity, backlog, and adherence to operational requirements.
* Ensures audit documentation, reporting, tracking, and follow-up activities are accurate, complete, and sufficient to support governance and control requirements.
* Leads the review of significant process exceptions and partners with appropriate teams and management to address root causes, reinforce accountability, and reduce recurrence.
* Prioritizes and drives improvements to resolution speed, data quality, operational efficiency, process consistency, reporting, policies, procedures, and controls.
* Communicates team performance, operational risks, escalations, trends, and recommended actions clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Develop employees through regular coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing, performance management, and development planning.
* Promotes a collaborative and accountable team environment that supports sound judgment, continuous learning, and consistent execution.
* Supports governance initiatives, business reviews, reporting needs, and special projects with broader organizational impact.
* Exercises independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Maintains regular, consistent, and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights, weekends, variable schedules, and overtime as necessary.
* Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Skills And Experience**

* Strong people-leadership skills, with experience coaching employees, managing performance, and supporting professional development.
* Strong operational-management skills, including the ability to establish priorities, allocate work, manage competing demands, and drive timely, accurate execution.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends and risks, assess root causes, and make sound decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to oversee ticket queues, reporting, quality, productivity, backlog, and service-level performance.
* Ability to apply policies, procedures, controls, and governance requirements consistently while exercising sound judgment in complex or escalated situations.
* Experience leading process improvements that strengthen resolution speed, data quality, operational efficiency, control effectiveness, and customer experience.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate performance, risks, complex findings, and recommendations clearly to employees, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships, influence decisions, and coordinate solutions across teams.
* Ability to manage change, reinforce accountability, and maintain team engagement in a complex and evolving operational environment.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Sufficient knowledge of SQL Server or comparable data-query tools to oversee analytical work, evaluate findings, and guide issue resolution.
* Prior experience leading employees or an operational team.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Knowledge of CSG and/or Amdocs, or related experience working with customer billing systems.
* Strong knowledge of customer account, order, billing, and revenue-related processes, including billing cycles, adjustments, charge structures, and common billing discrepancies.

**Employees at All Levels Are Expected To**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience - think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff - be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team - make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System - a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company - by joining huddles, making callbacks and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Respect and promote inclusion and diversity.

title: Head of Digital Platforms & Customer Experience COE - Senior Vice President
description:
**Role Purpose**
Lead the digital platforms and end-to-end customer experience agenda for UAE Wealth, creating differentiated, seamless and trusted experiences across the full client lifecycle.
  
  
The role brings together digital platform strategy and execution, customer experience, complaints and root-cause management, governance and regulatory readiness, third-party oversight, and AI-enabled transformation. The mandate is to ensure digital capabilities translate into measurable client and business outcomes while maintaining strong governance, controls and operational resilience.
  
  
A critical leadership priority is to build a world-class, high-performing and future-ready team, using AI and new ways of working to materially improve how the organization designs, delivers, governs and continuously improves client experiences.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Digital Platforms Strategy & Leadership
* Own the UAE Wealth digital platforms agenda and define the strategic roadmap across client and banker experiences.
* Drive adoption, simplification and continuous enhancement of digital capabilities, ensuring technology investments deliver tangible client and business outcomes.
* Connect platform strategy to the broader Digital Growth and Wealth Continuum agenda, identifying opportunities to digitize and reimagine journeys.
* Champion AI-first thinking, applying AI and automation to transform client experiences, employee workflows and platform management.
* End-to-End Customer Experience
* Own the client experience across the lifecycle, from onboarding and transacting through servicing and ongoing relationship management.
* Establish a strong voice-of-client discipline using NPS, complaints, feedback and other experience signals to identify systemic opportunities for improvement.
* Translate client insights into prioritized interventions across digital, process, servicing and people dimensions.
* Set clear experience standards across channels and ensure digital and human interactions operate as one cohesive journey.
* Complaints, Root Cause & Experience Management
* Establish rigorous management of complaints and material experience failures, moving beyond issue resolution toward prevention.
* Apply structured root-cause analysis across process/technology, behavioral and systemic dimensions.
* Partner across Platforms, Operations, Controls, Segments and other stakeholders to address underlying causes and reduce recurrence.
* Build management visibility of material experience issues and drive actions through sustainable closure.
* Holistic Third-Party Governance
* Provide holistic oversight of third parties supporting digital platforms and customer experiences.
* Establish clear governance across third-party performance, service quality, controls, resilience, risk and issue management.
* Ensure third-party dependencies are understood across the end-to-end client journey rather than managed in functional silos.
* Drive clear accountability and escalation for material third-party risks and service failures.
* Governance & Regulatory Leadership
* Bring strong understanding of the UAE governance and regulatory landscape and translate regulatory expectations into sustainable platform and customer-experience practices.
* Embed appropriate governance throughout digital platform strategy, design, delivery and ongoing management.
* Partner closely with Risk, Controls, Compliance, Legal, Operations and Technology to anticipate emerging requirements and maintain regulatory readiness.
* Establish transparent governance forums, management information and escalation mechanisms for key platform and customer-experience risks.
* AI-Enabled Transformation
* Set an ambitious agenda for AI across customer experiences, employee productivity, analytics, controls and platform operations.
* Identify opportunities to redesign work and experiences, rather than simply automate existing processes.
* Embed appropriate governance, risk management and accountability into AI-enabled capabilities.
* Build AI fluency across the team so emerging technology becomes part of everyday problem-solving and delivery.
* Build a World-Class Team
* Build and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary organization spanning digital platforms, customer experience, product thinking, governance, data and AI.
* Create an environment of strong ownership, client obsession, constructive challenge and continuous improvement.
* Develop future-ready talent through targeted capability building, broader exposure and AI-enabled ways of working.
* Foster active engagement and psychological safety so issues and opportunities surface early, while maintaining clear accountability and high execution standards.

**Key Measures of Success**

* Digital adoption and platform engagement
* Client experience and NPS improvement
* Reduction in complaint volumes and recurrence
* Digital journey completion and servicing effectiveness
* Platform reliability and operational resilience
* Third-party performance, risk and issue closure
* Regulatory and governance outcomes
* Root-cause and management-action closure
* AI adoption and measurable productivity and experience improvements
* Team capability, engagement and talent development

**Scope & Authority**
The role has broad cross-functional reach across Digital, Segments, Product, Onboarding, Servicing, Technology, Operations, Governance, Risk, Controls, Compliance and third-party partners.
  
  
The Center of Excellene role will represent the combined digital platform and client-experience agenda in senior UAE management and governance forums, convene stakeholders to resolve cross-functional issues, and drive accountability for material platform and customer-experience outcomes.
  
  
**Candidate Profile**

* 12+ years of experience in wealth management, banking, digital platforms, technology-enabled transformation or customer experience, with substantial senior leadership exposure.
* Proven ability to lead complex digital platforms and end-to-end transformation in a highly regulated environment.
* Strong customer orientation, with experience translating customer insights and complaints into systemic improvements.
* Deep understanding of governance, risk and regulatory expectations, ideally within the UAE or a comparable regulated financial-services market.
* Demonstrated ability to govern complex ecosystems involving technology and third-party providers.
* Strong understanding of AI and emerging digital capabilities, with the ability to translate technology into practical customer, employee and business outcomes.
* Track record of building and developing world-class teams, attracting strong talent and creating future-ready capabilities.
* Strong executive presence and ability to influence across Technology, Business, Operations, Risk and Control functions without relying solely on formal authority.
* Commercial judgment and the ability to balance client outcomes, growth, innovation, regulatory obligations and risk management.
* SVP/C14 gravitas to represent UAE Digital Platforms & Customer Experience with senior management and relevant governance forums.

title: Care Services Manager
description:
**Job Description**
As a Care Services Manager, you will oversee the operational delivery of Care Services for assigned customers, ensuring contractual commitments, service quality targets, and customer expectations are consistently achieved. You will manage service performance, team workload, escalations, and operational efficiency while maintaining strong customer relationships and driving continuous improvement.
  
  
Working closely with customers, Care delivery teams, program managers, and other stakeholders, you will ensure effective case management, service governance, transition activities, and successful delivery of support services throughout the customer lifecycle.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Manage the delivery of Care Services, including case handling, emergency support, and software upgrade services.
* Monitor and drive operational performance, service quality, team efficiency, and workload management.
* Ensure adherence to Care processes, service governance requirements, customer SLAs, and operational KPIs.
* Lead service reviews, KPI tracking, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Manage customer escalations and act as the primary point of contact for Care-related operational matters.
* Support customer satisfaction initiatives, including EBCS, OES, OPVi, and related improvement actions.
* Collaborate with Care Program Managers to ensure service data, installed base information, and contract records are accurate and maintained.
* Support customer-facing activities by providing operational guidance, escalation management, and process expertise.
* Contribute to or lead the successful transition of services from project delivery into operational Care support.
* Lead small projects and coordinate resource allocation to meet customer and business objectives.

**Key Skills And Experience**

* Experience in service delivery, customer support, or telecommunications operations management.
* Strong understanding of Care Services, incident management, escalation management, and operational support processes.
* Experience managing service performance through KPIs, SLAs, governance reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong customer relationship and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to analyze complex operational issues and implement effective corrective actions.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing operational priorities.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to lead small teams, manage workloads, and drive performance improvements.

Nice to have:
  
  

* Experience within telecommunications managed services or network operations environments.
* Knowledge of software upgrade management, technical support services, and service transition processes.
* Familiarity with customer satisfaction frameworks such as EBCS, OES, and OPVi.
* Experience with operational reporting, cost tracking, and service governance processes.

Additional information:
  
  
The organization is evolving. While no final decisions have been taken, Nokia is planning to divest the PB ECE unit during the first half of 2027, and this role is planned to transfer to

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.
