title: Analyst 4 - Billing Operations & Solutions
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.  
**Job Summary**

The Access Control Analyst supports enterprise access provisioning across billing, customer care, and operational platforms to help ensure employees and business partners have accurate, timely, and appropriate system access. The role supports access requests, provisioning workflows, approvals, exception management, operational controls, and compliance requirements while partnering across business and technology teams to deliver consistent and reliable access experience. As a lead professional-professional 4, this role operates with a high degree of independence in a complex, high-volume environment and exercises judgment in matters of significance. The role provides subject-matter expertise, leads projects and improvement initiatives, and identifies opportunities to strengthen controls, improve automation, reduce provisioning fallout, and enhance the access experience.

**Job Description**

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Supports enterprise control-access provisioning for billing, customer care, commerce, PII, and other operational platforms.
* Analyzes complex access requests, business requirements, approval standards, and system dependencies to determine the appropriate provisioning action.
* Supports joiner, mover, and leaver processes by validating that system access aligns with an employee’s job status, job code, organizational assignment, and approved access configuration.
* Reviews automated provisioning outcomes and investigates records that require manual processing or exception handling.
* Analyzes job-code, location, division, and business information to support accurate provisioning within the appropriate system environment.
* Validates access assignments against approved role-based, job-code-based, or standards.
* Review access requests for completeness and confirm that required manager, business, security, or secondary approvals are in place before provisioning.
* Investigate provisioning fallout, incomplete requests, access discrepancies, and other exceptions; determine contributing conditions and coordinates resolution with the appropriate partners.
* Identifies recurring provisioning exceptions and recommends configuration, process, documentation, training, or automation improvements.
* Applies established access-control requirements and approval standards when reviewing and fulfilling control-access requests.
* Supports access-review, audit, control-testing, and compliance activities by providing complete, accurate, and timely documentation or evidence.
* Helps ensure that sensitive and PII-related access is provisioned only after required approvals and validations have been completed.
* Identifies potential control gaps, processing risks, and inconsistent access conditions and escalates concerns through the appropriate channels.
* Maintains accurate records of access requests, approvals, provisioning decisions, exceptions, and remediation activities.
* Monitors request volumes, case activity, aging, service-level performance, and other operational measures across supported tools and work queues.
* Analyzes missed service levels, processing trends, and recurring issues to identify contributing factors and recommend corrective actions.
* Develops and maintains operational reporting that provides visibility into workload, performance, exceptions, and emerging risks.
* Uses Excel and other reporting or analytical tools to reconcile data, identify trends, validate results, and support operational and leadership decisions.

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
Job Title
  
  
Customer Experience Program Manager, Customer Recovery & Acceleration
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Customer Experience (CX) Program Manager is a strategic, customer-facing leader within the Product Success Organization, responsible for stabilizing, recovering, and accelerating high-risk or stalled customers.
  
  
This role operates as a rapid-response, outcome-oriented engagement leader, partnering with customers who are blocked in adoption, at risk of churn, or struggling to realize value. The CX Program Manager orchestrates cross-functional intervention plans to diagnose root causes, align stakeholders, and drive measurable turnaround outcomes.
  
  
This role focuses on systemic adoption, value realization, and operational recovery. Engagements are structured as approximately 90-day coordinated recovery cycles, primarily serving High Touch and Upper Growth customers. The position plays a critical role in protecting revenue, improving customer health, and building repeatable recovery playbooks across the customer base.
  
  
Work Location & Schedule
  
  
Work Location: Sky tech, Financial District, Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Work Schedule**

* This role supports customers and stakeholders primarily during U.S. business hours.
* Expected working hours are 01:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST, with occasional flexibility required to support collaboration with U.S.-based teams and business needs.
* Participation in after-hours support rotations and select holiday coverage may be required based on product, region, or business needs.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Recovery & Stabilization
  
  

* Lead targeted intervention engagements (approximately 90 days) for high-risk, stalled, or underperforming customers
* Rapidly assess customer health across product usage, workflows, data quality, and organizational alignment
* Define and execute a structured Customer Recovery Plan with clear milestones and measurable success criteria

Cross-Functional Orchestration
  
  

* Mobilize and coordinate the right internal resources based on the customer’s specific recovery needs
* Ensure all teams are aligned to a single recovery strategy, timeline, and accountable owner
* Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain execution momentum across workstreams

Executive Alignment & Communication
  
  

* Engage customer executives and senior stakeholders to align on recovery goals, reset accountability, and communicate progress
* Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the duration of the ICU engagement
* Deliver structured updates and executive-level summaries on a regular cadence

Playbook Development & Scaling
  
  

* Build and refine CX playbooks, intervention frameworks, and engagement models
* Partner with Product Success and Insights teams to scale learnings and improve early risk detection
* Contribute to the broader Customer Success strategy through repeatable, data-backed recovery frameworks

Data-Driven Insights
  
  

* Leverage usage data, health scores, and engagement signals to diagnose issues and track recovery progress
* Identify leading indicators of churn risk and recovery success to improve future intervention models
* Validate success outcomes against customer-defined goals at engagement close

Cross-Functional Partnerships
  
  

* Customer Success: Handoff coordination, health monitoring, and post-ICU continuity
* Functional Experts: Subject matter depth and product best-practice guidance
* Product & Engineering: Issue escalation, roadmap alignment, and product gap feedback
* Data & Analytics / Insights: Usage analysis, health scoring, and performance insights
* Services & Implementation: Re-implementation support, configuration guidance, and workflow redesign

Success Measures
  
  

* Reduction in churn risk and improvement in health scores across ICU-managed accounts
* Measurable increase in product adoption and depth of usage
* Increased retention confidence and renewal rates
* Scalable recovery playbooks and repeatable intervention patterns

**Qualifications Required**

* 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Program Management, Consulting, or Services within SaaS
* Proven ability to turn around at-risk customer situations and drive measurable outcomes
* Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills
* Experience working with enterprise or high-touch customers in complex, multi-stakeholder environments
* Excellent communication skills with demonstrated executive presence

**Preferred**

* Experience in renewal risk mitigation or churn prevention strategies
* Background in nonprofit, fundraising, or comparable mission-driven verticals
* Familiarity with change management and adoption frameworks
* Experience leveraging data and product usage insights to drive decision-making

Core Competencies
  
  

* Outcome-obsessed and relentlessly action-oriented
* Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis skills
* Ability to influence and lead without direct authority in complex environments
* Ability to simplify complexity into clear, executable plans

Why This Role Matters
  
  
The ICU Program Manager serves as a critical safeguard for customer success and retention. By stepping in at pivotal moments of risk, this role ensures customers are not lost due to misalignment, stalled adoption, or unrealized value.
  
  
Through structured recovery, cross-functional coordination, and relentless focus on outcomes, the ICU Program Manager transforms vulnerable customers into stable, successful, and growing advocates—while strengthening the organization’s overall customer success strategy.
  
  
This is not a support role. It is not a break/fix function. It is a high-impact, outcomes-driven leadership engagement that directly protects revenue, accelerates adoption, and builds the repeatable systems that make every future customer engagement stronger.

title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery

You will act as:
  
  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities

Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
  
  
**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

Lastly, what we are not looking for
**,**
we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Working as part of the Consulting team, you will take part in engagements related to a wide range of topics. Some examples of domains in which you will support our clients include the following:
  
  

* Defined Benefits Operations (E.g. - Benefits calculations, Benefits Review), Benefits Calculation for Retirement, Termination, Disability, Death, Divorce.
* ERISA Compliance - US Retirement Plan Testing (ADP & ACP Testing, Corrective Distribution) & Reporting experience.

* Money in and Loans -Must have experience in handling money in & Loan related activities, i.e. Check processing, contribution, loan initiation, Loan repayments, re-amortization etc.

* Understanding of business rules of Payout, Qualified/Non-Qualified Plans, Roth Conversion, Roth IRA, Fiduciaries, Defined contribution, Defined Benefits/Pension
* Exposure to Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation (PBGC) study and Public Pensions
* Understanding of plan administration, group and account setup, eligibility
* Understanding of Vesting rules and Investment management

title: Government Account Manager
description:
**About the Company**

BPL Medical Technologies is a leading Indian medical technology company committed to advancing healthcare through innovative, reliable, and accessible solutions. With a strong legacy and nationwide presence, BPL serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers across India and select international markets.

The company offers a diverse portfolio across patient monitoring, imaging, and critical care, supported by robust manufacturing, service, and distribution capabilities. With a growing installed base and a focus on quality and customer trust, BPL continues to strengthen its position as a trusted partner in healthcare delivery.

Driven by innovation and operational excellence, BPL is focused on building future-ready capabilities and delivering long-term value to customers, partners, and stakeholders.

Get to know about us -
**https://www.bplmedicaltechnologies.com/**

**Role Summary**

A senior sales leader to own and grow BPL's Government Business across the entire South zone. This is a zonal-level role for someone with 15–20 years of experience who understands government policy, process, and stakeholder dynamics as well as the medical device business itself. With established government, corporate, and customer relationships to drive institutional and tender-based business across South India.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Government Business Strategy & Ownership**

* Own the revenue and growth targets for Government Business across the South zone.
* Develop and execute strategies to grow government, PSU, and institutional business across South India.
* Track government healthcare policies, budgets, and schemes (state and central) relevant to medical device procurement.

**Tender & Institutional Business Management**

* Drive participation in government tenders, ensuring compliance with technical and commercial requirements.
* Oversee the tendering process end-to-end, from opportunity identification to order execution.
* Partner with the Tender & Documentation team to ensure timely, accurate submissions.

**Stakeholder & Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with government officials, health department stakeholders, PSU decisionmakers, and key opinion leaders across the South zone.
* Represent BPL at government forums, health department meetings, and industry associations.
* Navigate government procurement processes, empanelment, and compliance requirements.

**Team & Channel Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the regional government business team across South zone states.
* Build and manage channel/dealer relationships supporting government business.

**Business Planning & Reporting**

* Set targets for government business across South zone states/territories based on potential.
* Track competitive activity, win/loss trends, and market intelligence for government tenders.
* Report on pipeline, order book, and revenue performance to senior leadership.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 15–20 years of overall experience, with substantial experience in government sales business preferably within the medical device or healthcare industry.
* Proven track record of managing government business at a zonal or regional level.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; MBA preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of government policies, procurement processes, and public health schemes.
* Established network of government, corporate, and customer relationships across South India.
* Deep knowledge of the medical device industry and institutional buying behaviour.
* Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to operate independently across multiple states/territories.
* Strong analytical and business planning skills.

**Why This Role Matters**

You'll be BPL's senior-most voice in government healthcare procurement across the South, gaining:

* Zonal-level ownership of Government Business, with real influence over how BPL wins in the public sector.
* Direct engagement with senior government and health department stakeholders across South India.
* The opportunity to lead and build out a regional team as the business scales.
* The chance to work in a company with real purpose — where stronger institutional relationships translate directly into wider access to healthcare.

**Base Location - Hyderabad / Chennai**

**Responsibilities**

* Subject matter expert for Real Estate Fund Administration (FA), Real Estate Technology, and Fund Implementations.
* Consistent involvement with troubleshooting and resolving business user’s requests in Yardi.

* Work with Real Estate accounting team to ensure best practices are utilized across all of Fund Administration.
* Leverage accounting experience to support and optimize financial processes.

* Coordination of Yardi system configuration information with Tech team.
* Coordination of data testing and validation for funds being implemented/migrated
* Coordination of custom reporting setup
* Ability to test solutions in a sandbox environment before deploying to Production.
* Ability to manage the full Project Management Lifecycle for new Yardi features and solutions, from Scoping to Launch.

**Requirements**

* Information Technology literate, proficient in Yardi (Investment Management a plus), and strong Excel skills
* Strong understanding of different types of investments
* Broad market knowledge
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Critical thinking skills, keen attention to detail, and ability to navigate unexpected challenges
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments, and manage ambiguity
* 5 years in fintech, financial services, real estate, finance, or accounting

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting (or related field)
* Knowledge of current industry standards (ex: ILPA reporting, return calculation methodology, performance modeling, etc.) a plus

title: RSC Job dev114
description:
**What do you get when you bring together the brightest minds and place them into an exciting, fast-paced environment that fosters intellectual growth and rewards based on impact, not tenure?**
You get one of the fastest growing Software-as-a-Service companies in the United States. iCIMS is an Inc. 500 & Deloitte Fast 500 ASP Software Firm focused on solving corporate business issues through the implementation of easy-to-use, web-based software solutions. Our core product, iRecruiter, automates the recruiting operations of over 400 worldwide companies, including adidas, Continental Airlines, XM Satellite Radio, New Balance, Tommy Hilfiger, FedEx, and more.
  
  
iCIMS has brought together the best-of-the-best, including graduates from Cornell, Brown, Columbia, Harvard, Princeton, and more. We encourage a relaxed but professional atmosphere that allows every employee, no matter what level, to work directly with today's leading organizations and make a noticeable impact on their bottom lines.
  
  
As a member of the Account Services Department, the Manager will work closely with the iCIMS customers to ensure all their needs and expectations are met.
  
  

* The Manager should have a strong knowledge of ASP systems and the ability to quickly learn and master the iRecruiter system to effectively communicate to customers the best and most efficient methods of utilizing iCIMS products.
* The Manager should possess outstanding interpersonal skills and the ability to effectively manage multiple accounts.
* The Manager is expected to be able to identify a customer's needs and when new opportunities exist to add additional products and services.
* Participation in sales presentations through conference calls and seminars, on-site customer meetings, and client surveys.
* Work with the iCIMS Marketing team to develop client references, case studies, and testimonials.
* Proactively contact assigned clients and work towards 100% renewal rate.
* Work escalated customer issues.
* Some travel required.
* Bachelor degree with strong academic track record.
* Experience with all Microsoft Windows operating systems
* Hands-on user for Microsoft Internet Explorer and related web-based technologies.
* Must have strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision or formal structure.
* Previous experience with client relations and experience in HR systems and/or software project management are significant plus.

title: Salesforce Success Architect
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together technical architects, customer support engineers, and product advisors. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.
  
  
Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.
  
  
The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:
  
  

* Drive Customer Impact - Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lead with Multi-Cloud Expertise - Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your designated Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Industry Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems - Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**Required Multi-Cloud Aptitude**
We are looking for individuals with expertise spanning multiple Industry Clouds (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) from the following list. Prioritization of these clouds is geographically diverse, but we are primarily seeking skills in:
  
  

* Life Sciences Cloud
* Public Sector
* Financial Services Cloud
* Revenue Cloud & Billing
* Manufacturing Cloud
* Automotive Cloud
* Education Cloud
* Net Zero Cloud
* Non-Profit
* Loyalty Cloud

**Basic Requirements**

* Solution Design & Architecture
* 8+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.
* Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.
* Communication & Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options, and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

**Desired Technical Skills**

* Secure & Scalable Architecture: Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and security configurations. Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Salesforce Development: Hands-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* Data Management & Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).
* System Integration & Extensibility: Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects, and tools like Salesforce Connect.
* OmniStudio Knowledge: Experience with OmniStudio components is required.
* DevOps (Core + Industry): Strong understanding of software development and delivery process, assessing architecture environments and requirements in order to implement management solutions.

**Certifications**

* Required: Salesforce Admin, Platform Developer 1 and JavaScript Developer
* Highly Desired: Certified Architect Credentials (Application and System Architect), Platform App Builder, Salesforce Advanced Admin and an Accredited Professional credential in at least one Industry Cloud specialization (e.g., Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, or Public Sector Solutions).

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Operation Manager
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Operations Manager

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage and develop one or more specialized customer service and operations functional teams within Operations area with complex and risk in functional area
* Develop strategies to improve staffing processes, ensure specialized functions meet regulatory guidelines in support of risk management and compliance
* Engage stakeholders and internal partners associated within the Operations area
* Work independently on moderately complex issues and projects
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and risk control development and escalates issues to more experienced management
* Provide training, performance, evaluation and coaching of less experienced team
* Make decisions and resolve issues regarding resources, objectives and operations of functional area and team to meet business objectives
* Interpret and develop policies and procedures for operation functions with low to moderate complexity within scope of responsibility
* Provide responsibility for budget and financial performance
* Collaborate and influence all levels of professionals including more experienced managers

12 Nov 2026

title: Unix Infra, Veritas clustering, Patching/Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist

**Why HSBC**

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

**The Opportunity**

This role focuses on keeping critical Linux and Unix infrastructure secure, current and reliable through patching, upgrades and automation. You’ll take ownership of in-place upgrades across RHEL estates and support core platform components including Veritas clustering and storage services. Working closely with DevOps and application teams you’ll enable consistent installations and configurations that meet agreed standards. The work sits in a regulated environment where stability, risk control and clear communication matter. Success means smoother upgrade outcomes, fewer recurring issues and infrastructure that is easier to operate through automation. You’ll also support incident troubleshooting and partner with vendors when deeper investigation is needed.

**What you'll be doing**

* Support and manage Unix infrastructure tasks including patching and vulnerability remediation for services in scope
* Perform in-place upgrades from RHEL7 to 8 and RHEL8 to 9 using Leapp
* Install and configure applications in line with team requirements and standards
* Create, modify and configure file systems including SAN and VxFS file systems
* Automate repeatable Unix tasks using Ansible and standard deployment tools
* Execute Infoscale VCS patching and upgrades and support firmware upgrades
* Configure and maintain VCS installations and changes required for application needs
* Troubleshoot OS issues and raise vendor cases with RHEL and VCS where required

**What we're looking for**

* Bring proven Linux administration and architecture experience across the server lifecycle including provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades and decommissioning
* Demonstrate hands-on capability performing in-place upgrades and resolving issues that arise during upgrades
* Apply hands-on experience with Veritas Volume Manager, VCS cluster and Veritas NetBackup client
* Partner effectively with DevOps and application teams to interpret requirements and implement standard installations and configurations
* Implement DR and role swap scenarios including replication approaches to meet required RPO and RTO outcomes
* Use shell or Python scripting to automate infrastructure activities
* Configure storage and file systems across NAS and SAN solutions in standalone and clustered environments including replication
* Work with network components and services including load balancers, routers, proxies and firewalls

**Modernise Core Unix Platforms**

If you want your work to translate into safer patching, smoother upgrades and infrastructure that operates with less manual effort this role offers plenty of scope. You’ll help keep essential services dependable by combining hands-on engineering with automation and strong partnering across teams. The role suits someone who enjoys improving how platforms run day to day while keeping a close eye on risk and stability. Apply to help shape a more secure and maintainable Unix and Linux estate at HSBC.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

title: Global AML Center (GAC) Operations & CAO – Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.

As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.

**Why this role is important to us**

The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.

Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.

**What you will be responsible for**

As Vice President you will:

***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders

* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards

* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance

* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model

* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking

* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability

* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls

* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance

* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds

* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value

* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda

* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning

* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy

* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials

* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time

* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through

* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning

* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure

* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements

* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed

* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight

* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability

* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required

* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization

* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential

* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working
  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls

* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans

* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment

* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models

* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers

* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them

* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions

* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively

* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning

* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials

* A collaborative leadership style that balances empowerment with accountability

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in AML/KYC, financial crime or operations within a large global financial institution

* Demonstrated experience leading strategic transformation and technology change programs, from business case to adoption

* Significant senior people leadership experience, including leading leaders

* Experience in business management role, including budget, headcount and governance ownership, is strongly preferred

* Bachelor’s degree required

* Strong knowledge of global AML/KYC regulatory requirements

* Experience with KYC workflow platforms (e.g., Fenergo/FenX), automation tools or AI solutions is an advantage

* Change or project management credentials (e.g., PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile) are an advantage

* Professional certifications such as CAMS or ICA are an advantage

* Proven ability to present to and work effectively with an executive audience

* Excellent verbal and written English and advanced MS Office skills
  

  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

description:
* INTRODUCTION TO EVERNORTH:

Evernorth Health Services India, established in Hyderabad in 2024, is an innovation hub for Evernorth Health Services, the pharmacy, care and benefits division of The Cigna Group. The innovation hub will support innovation-focused areas, such as generative AI, product development, process improvement, analytics, and software engineering across The Cigna Group and its businesses. Evernorth Health Services India builds on The Cigna Group’s existing presence in India.
  
**About Evernorth Health Services:** Evernorth Health Services (Evernorth) is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group - a Fortune 16 global health company with 75,000 employees, 186 million customers in more than 30 countries and jurisdictions around the world. Evernorth exists to make the prediction, prevention, and treatment of illness and disease more accessible to millions of people. We do this by creating and connecting premier health services offerings, such as benefits management, pharmacy, care solutions, insights and intelligence.
  
**About Cigna:** The Cigna Group is a global health company committed to improving the health and vitality of individuals and communities around the world and includes products and services marketed under its Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services subsidiaries. Cigna Healthcare is the health benefits provider of The Cigna Group, serving customers and clients through its U.S. Employer, U.S. Government, and International Health business. Evernorth Health Services is the pharmacy, care and benefits solution division of The Cigna Group
  
  
**Job Title:**  
Senior Manager – Digital Product Engagement
  
  
Job Overview
  
This is a senior leadership role at the Evernorth Hyderabad Office and sits within the Data, Digital and AI Portfolio for The Cigna Group. The role is responsible for building and scaling Digital Product and Engagement capabilities in Hyderabad while partnering closely with US-based Product, Customer Engagement, and Technology leaders to deliver high-impact digital, engagement, data, and AI-enabled products.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead teams spanning Product Management and Engagement Delivery, driving strategy, organizational effectiveness, execution, and business outcomes across platform, data, customer engagement, personalization, campaign, digital experience, and AI product portfolios.
  
  
This role combines organizational leadership with hands-on product and engagement leadership. While accountable for developing talent, scaling operating models, and driving portfolio outcomes, the leader must also be comfortable directly leading strategic initiatives, influencing executive stakeholders, shaping product direction, and stepping into complex or ambiguous business problems when needed.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strategic digital leader who can operate effectively across strategy, discovery, execution, and organizational leadership while building strong teams, strong partnerships, and measurable business outcomes
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategy Digital Leadership
  

* Partner closely with US-based Product, Engineering, Analytics, Experience, and Digital Engagement leaders to translate enterprise priorities into product strategy, roadmaps, investment decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
* Drive implementation and adherence to product strategy across platform, data, customer engagement, personalization, digital experience, campaign, and AI-enabled product portfolios.
* Act as a strategic extension of US Product leadership, providing thought leadership on priorities, sequencing, tradeoffs, investments, and organizational capabilities.
* Directly lead select high-priority initiatives and complex cross-functional efforts that require senior product leadership and executive alignment.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on product direction, customer needs, organizational priorities, and business value realization.
* Build and maintain strong partnerships with key US-based and Hyderabad-based stakeholders, fostering trust, collaboration, alignment, and shared accountability across Product Management, Engagement Delivery, Engineering, Analytics, Experience, and Business teams.
* Develop and maintain a portfolio roadmap that provides transparency into priorities, dependencies, investment areas, risks, and expected outcomes while ensuring alignment with enterprise and DDAI strategic objectives.

Product Management Engagement Delivery Leadership
  

* Lead and develop teams across digital (product and engagement), ensuring strong alignment between product strategy, planning, execution, and business outcomes.
* Establish clear operating models, roles, decision rights, and accountability across digital functions.
* Ensure digital teams operate as an integrated organization that enables effective planning, prioritization, execution, stakeholder management, and outcome delivery.
* Build leadership depth across both disciplines through coaching, succession planning, organizational development, and talent management.
* Create a high-performing culture focused on customer value, ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration.

·
  
Organizational Leadership
  

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers and Engagement Delivery experts while establishing scalable operating models, standards, and career paths aligned with global digital practices.
* Mentor digital leaders and individual contributors, strengthening capabilities in strategy, discovery, roadmap planning, stakeholder management, and execution.
* Position Hyderabad as a trusted strategic product and engagement partner that contributes to enterprise direction and outcomes, not simply execution.
* Foster a culture of innovation, customer focus, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Accelerate organizational knowledge and business acumen across the Hyderabad team by enabling deep understanding of The Cigna Groups business model, lines of business, strategic priorities, organizational structure, Digital strategy, and Data, Digital AI (DDAI) objectives.
* Establish a culture of continuous learning and capability development by identifying skill gaps, promoting upskilling opportunities, enabling access to required tools and resources, and ensuring team members are equipped to meet current and future business needs.

Operating Model Delivery Excellence
  

* Partner closely with Business, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, Customer Experience, and Engagement Delivery teams to align product strategy with delivery and business objectives.
* Act as a coordination and escalation point for major cross-functional dependencies, risks, and delivery challenges. Identify and remove critical blockers for the digital team.
* Drive continuous improvement in delivery effectiveness, stakeholder satisfaction, planning accuracy, and execution quality.
* Balance innovation with execution discipline to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, compliant, reliable, and adoption-ready.

Customer Business Outcomes
  

* Ensure product investments are grounded in customer needs, business priorities, and data-driven insights.
* Serve as the primary storyteller and advocate for Hyderabad digital capabilities, clearly articulating theWhat, So What, and Now What of team accomplishments, strategic initiatives, business outcomes, and future opportunities across leadership, governance, and operational forums.
* Establish mechanisms to track, measure, and communicate business value delivered, including customer impact, operational efficiencies, adoption, engagement outcomes, financial benefits, and strategic contributions, creating visibility for leadership and supporting investment decisions.

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field from a top‑tier institution.

14 years of experience in product management, digital product development, customer engagement, campaign products, or platform product roles, with meaningful leadership responsibility.

* Strong track record owning end-to-end product lifecycles, from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous optimization.
* Experience delivering data-driven, digital engagement, campaign, and AI-enabled products in close partnership with engineering, analytics, design, marketing, and AI teams.
* Hands-on experience with customer/member engagement products, campaign management platforms, digital communication journeys, segmentation, personalization, and experimentation.
* Ability to use customer insights, behavioral data, campaign performance, and journey analytics to shape product priorities and improve engagement outcomes.
* Demonstrated success partnering closely with US‑based Product leaders and senior stakeholders in a global, matrixed environment.
* Experience operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology, analytics, customer experience, and customer/member engagement.

Skills
  
Strong grounding in product strategy and discovery, including problem framing, customer research, engagement journey mapping, and outcome-driven roadmaps.
  
Solid understanding of modern digital and platform architectures, APIs, and data‑driven systems.
  
Experience working with AI‑enabled products and AI Product Managers, without requiring deep model‑level ownership.
  
Strong understanding of engagement product capabilities such as campaign orchestration, lifecycle journeys, personalization, digital communications, CRM/marketing technology, and experimentation.
  
Ability to connect engagement strategy with product execution, ensuring campaigns and digital experiences are measurable, scalable, compliant, and adoption focused.

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at executive levels.
  
Comfort operating in ambiguity and driving clarity across complex, global problem spaces

title: Senior Manager, AI & Data Quality Engineering
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.



  

**This role requires working from our Hyderabad office 2-3 days a week**  
  
**What You Will Do**

Lead distributed Data Quality, Reporting QA, Application QA, and automation teams across India and the USA.

Define and own the Insights-wide quality operating model, standards, governance, and release gates.

Establish automated validation for data completeness, accuracy, freshness, reconciliation, referential integrity, duplication, and anomaly detection.

Lead quality strategy for Financial Data Mart and CMDM modernization, including Databricks, Synapse, Power BI, row-level security, workspace synchronization, and customer rollouts.

Govern testing across the full release lifecycle: data pipelines, semantic models, reports, application workflows, APIs, embeds, scheduling, and production monitoring.

Expand automated test frameworks using Playwright, Cucumber, TypeScript, Python, SQL, and CI/CD pipelines.

Partner with Data Engineering, BI, Application Engineering, Product, Support, and SRE teams to resolve systemic quality issues.

Use production-quality signals such as report load time, refresh failures, data incidents, defect escape rate, and customer-impact trends to prioritize improvements.

Build talent across India and the USA through hiring, coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and consistent performance management.

Create effective follow-the-sun operating practices with clear ownership, handoffs, escalation paths, and shared documentation.

  

**AI & Quality Engineering Leadership**

Make AI a practical, measurable part of the quality strategy by:

Driving AI-assisted test-case generation, test maintenance, and regression prioritization.

Building intelligent defect triage, routing, root-cause investigation, and ticket-drafting workflows.

Applying anomaly detection and AI-assisted reconciliation to data pipelines and reporting outputs.

Using AI agents and natural-language workflows to improve quality operations while preserving human approval for consequential decisions.

Defining evaluation standards for AI outputs, including accuracy, consistency, explainability, hallucination risk, business-rule compliance, and drift.

Establishing guardrails for privacy, security, auditability, model governance, and safe use of enterprise data.

  

**What You Will Need**

Significant experience leading QA, Data Quality, Data Engineering QA, BI QA, or Quality Engineering teams.

Experience managing distributed teams across multiple geographies and time zones.

Strong SQL expertise for data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and test-data preparation.

Hands-on experience with Databricks and modern data-platform testing.

Experience with Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or comparable data-pipeline platforms.

Strong Power BI experience, including paginated reports, semantic models, row-level security, workspaces, refreshes, exports, and report validation.

Demonstrated experience designing quality automation strategies across data, reporting, APIs, and applications.

Strong AI, Generative AI, or machine-learning experience applied to software quality, data quality, analytics, or engineering productivity.

Experience evaluating AI outputs for accuracy, consistency, bias, hallucination risk, and business-rule compliance.

Knowledge of AI agents, LLM workflows, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop controls.

Experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Python, TypeScript, or equivalent automation technologies.

Experience with GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Jira, and release-management practices.

Strong communication skills and the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders.

  

**And It’s Great to Have**

Experience building configuration-driven Data Quality frameworks using ADF, SQL, Databricks, or Synapse.

Experience with Power BI APIs, automated report comparison, and large-scale regression testing.

Experience with OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, Application Insights, or comparable observability platforms.

Experience applying AI to ticket triage, incident investigation, test maintenance, or defect prioritization.

Experience with data governance, metric standardization, master data, or customer-facing analytics platforms.

Experience supporting high-availability reporting platforms and production incident management.

  

**Success in This Role**

Reduced data and reporting defects reaching customers.

Increased automated test coverage and faster regression cycles.

Improved Financial Data Mart and reporting release confidence.

Faster root-cause analysis and defect resolution.

Measured adoption of safe, explainable AI quality workflows.

Better coordination between India and USA teams.

Improved production reliability and customer trust in Insights reporting.





**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION** : ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at **abcfitness.com** .

About ABC Fitness

ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.

From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at **abcfitness.com**

title: Engineering Manager / Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**WHAT MAKES US, US**

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

  

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer-focused, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

  

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

  

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**

Product Development is a major part of SimCorp, where software engineering teams work consistently towards producing top-quality solutions. Engineering Managers are leading these teams, and they are key to our success. We are growing and evolving Investment Accounting, a key element in the long standing success of SimCorp and covers all rules and calculation methods in order to provide our clients with a legally binding subledger for all supported asset classes.

  

**WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

* First and foremost, you are going to hire and onboard software engineers in Noida & Hyderabad, build and develop engineering teams, thereby be the driver in our quest to scale up our engineering capacity

* You are the leader of 1-2 teams of Software Engineers with responsibility for growing and upskilling your team through 1:1s, feedback, mentoring, coaching, and goal setting

* You have responsibility for both the short-term deliverables in the sprints and the long-term improvements of your team(s)

* You are responsible for creating a healthy working environment for your teams

* You work closely with your peers in both Engineering Management and Product Management to understand and refine the customer outcomes that you and your teams are responsible for delivering

* You collaborate with other leaders to deliver cross area initiatives, and to ensure knowledge sharing and consistency where needed

* You understand and define relevant engineering metrics to gain insight into your team’s performance and to help drive improvement

* You are responsible for the planning and the delivery of the outcomes of your teams

  

**WHAT WE VALUE**

* Experience with engineer recruitment and building engineering teams
* Overall 10+ years of experience, including:
* 5+ years of software engineering experience. Especially into **.Net Technologies**
* 0-5 years of (people, process, technical) leadership experience.
* Knowledge and experience with AI, with the purpose of improving efficiency
* Strong experience with .NET ecosystem (C#, .NET Core / .NET 6+, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs) in building scalable, enterprise-grade applications.
* Solid understanding of web application architecture, including RESTful services, microservices / modular monolith patterns, and event-driven systems.
* Working knowledge of modern UI frameworks such as Angular, React, or similar (Angular preferred), with an ability to guide teams on front-end integration patterns.
* Experience building and operating solutions on Microsoft Azure
* Proficiency in cloud-native design principles, CI/CD pipelines, observability, resilience, and scalability.
* Strong understanding of software engineering practices - API design, secure coding, performance optimization and distributed system design.
* Familiarity with data storage technologies (SQL Server, NoSQL, caching strategies)
* Experience from a workplace that produces financial software, uses investment management software, has a global workforce, and distributed teams
* Personal accountability and initiative. When something is unclear, you dig in rather than waiting for someone to hand you an answer. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and you follow through.
Stakeholder management and collaboration across borders.  

  

Good to Have

* Exposure to financial systems / capital markets platforms or high-volume transactional systems.
* Experience with frontend micro-frontend (MFE) architectures
* Knowledge of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and engineering productivity practices.
Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures and platform engineering concepts.  

**BENEFITS**

* **Global hybrid work policy** - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* **Culture** – Inclusive and diverse company culture
* **Work-life balance** – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace
* **Empowerment** – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes
* **Career & Growth** – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

  

**NEXT STEPS**

Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

  

**WHO WE ARE**

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.
