title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About SmartQ:**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of:

https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewAsMember=true

Are you passionate about managing and nurturing relationships with key clients/customers of a business? If your response is a resounding yes, then we are hunting for you.

As a Key Account Manager at SmartQ, your primary goal will be to ensure client satisfaction, retention, and growth of the business. Fostering, sustainable, and profitable relationships with key clients to maximize business opportunities lies at the heart of this role. In addition, a combination of interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, and a deep understanding of the clients and products will keep you functioning a cut above the rest.

If you are a dynamic, results-oriented manager with a proven track record in steering MNCs toward unprecedented success, we invite you to seize this opportunity to make a profound impact on our global presence. Do you possess all these skills and wish to make an impact in the world of food and technology? Join us now!

**Role:**

• Lead the company's dynamic food service sales efforts, developing and maintaining relationships with food service institutions at all levels.

• Manage an individual expense account within budget guidelines.

• Maintain ongoing relationships with customers, driving conversations to inform them about new product developments.

• Develop quotes and proposals. Attend client meetings, food committee meetings, and other related events.

• Maintain effective, professional relationships with customers, vendors, and fellow employees.

• Administer unit operations in accordance with SmartQ standards, handling contract specifications and statutory regulations.

• Oversee the overall management of the unit, ensuring quality food services and effective partner management.

• Monitor and ensure food services meet agreed standards and specifications.

• Ensure the efficient utilization of resources, including utilities, people, and technology.

• Analyze and assist on-site/off-site partners in effective management.

• Communicate regularly with clients to stay updated on operational activities and developments.

• Complete action plans following client satisfaction surveys and audits.

• Ensure all products are correctly priced in line with client agreements and specifications.

• Complete manpower scheduling within budget, adjusting labor schedules in line with sales.

• Ensure site adherence to safety standards as per SLA.

**Qualifications:**

• Experience in the food industry required.

• Strong work ethic, integrity, and personal accountability to be a self-starter and make independent decisions.

• Ability to handle pressure and meet deadlines.

• Flexible and willing to take on various tasks to support team efforts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong interpersonal skills.

• Sound knowledge and experience working with food, technology, and leveraging people.

• Results-oriented, accountable, and able to hold others accountable.

• Proven experience in managing successful teams in a similar environment.

• Basic Food Hygiene certificate and knowledge of HSEQ standards.

• Excellent financial and application acumen.

• Self-motivated, agile, and able to adapt to a changing environment.

• Overall 6+ years of experience, with a minimum of 3 years in a similar role.

• Graduate/Diploma in Hotel Management or a related discipline.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery

You will act as:
  
  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities

Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
  
  
**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

Lastly, what we are not looking for
**,**
we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.

title: Account Manager — Custom Software Development
description:
**Location: Lower Parel, Mumbai (work from office, full-time)**

**Experience: 4–6 years (minimum 4) managing custom software development accounts**

**Reports to: Director of Sales**

Salary:
**₹10 - 15 LPA**
fixed + monthly performance incentives

Hours: Day shift. Evening hours are mandatory on some days to overlap with US clients.

**About Arcitech.ai**

Arcitech.ai is an AI-native business automation company. We design, build and manage custom production software for enterprises across the US, UAE and India, in manufacturing, mining, pharma, education, hospitality and contact centres. We also build AI products including ProSchool.ai, Haire.ai and BPObox. Most of our client relationships are long-term development and managed-services engagements, so account management is central to how we grow.

**The Role**

You'll own a portfolio of custom software development accounts end to end. You'll understand what each client needs, translate it into clear requirements for our development team, and make sure it's delivered on time and to the client's satisfaction.

On your accounts, you act as the product owner. You lead the discovery calls, own the requirements through the full development lifecycle, and keep the client and the engineering team aligned at every stage.

**What You'll Do**

* Discovery & requirements: Run discovery calls with clients to understand their business, workflows and goals. Turn these into clear, prioritised requirements for the development team.
* Product ownership: Own the requirements on your accounts from kickoff to go-live and beyond. This includes clarifying scope, prioritising the backlog, managing change requests, and reviewing deliveries against what the client asked for.
* Delivery coordination: Work daily with PMs, developers, testers and tech leads so that what's built matches what's needed, and lands when it was promised.
* Client reporting: Send weekly and monthly progress reports to every client, on time, in clear business language.
* Issue handling: Acknowledge client issues immediately and log them in Zoho Desk. Update clients daily on open items and escalate early when anything stalls.
* Proposals & SOWs: Turn client requirements into estimates, proposals and SOWs the same day, using our standard templates. You'll validate scope and resourcing with tech leads.
* Account growth: Identify new phases, change requests and renewals inside your accounts, and bring in our sales team.
* New account onboarding: Take over newly won accounts, confirm all project documents and contacts are in place, and start the reporting cycle.
* Process improvement: Improve templates, workflows and response times, including through AI tools.

**What You Need**

* 4–6 years in account management, product ownership, business analysis, project management or delivery management on custom software development engagements. This should be at an IT services or software development company.
* Hands-on experience running discovery or requirement-gathering sessions with clients and writing requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, scope documents.
* A proven track record of managing several client accounts at once through the full lifecycle: discovery, requirements, sprints, QA, UAT, deployment and support.
* Solid understanding of how custom software is scoped and delivered: scope, change requests, resourcing, timelines and dependencies.
* Excellent written and spoken English. You'll work directly with US and UAE clients.
* Strong attention to detail with documents, numbers and structured templates.
* Hands-on experience with Zoho Desk/Projects, Jira, Hubstaff or similar tools, and comfort using AI assistants daily.
* You close loops without being chased and escalate early.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience preparing proposals, estimates or SOWs for software projects.
* Experience on retainer or managed-services accounts.
* Exposure to AI, automation, ERP integration or cloud projects.
* This role is not for you if: your experience is mainly in product SaaS or marketing agencies rather than custom development, or you can't commit to evening hours on some days.

Hiring Process

* Screening call
* AI interview on Haire.ai
* Practical assessment and interview with the Director of Sales and a senior PM or tech lead
* Final round with the CEO

DBS Treasures Private is dedicated to delivering exceptional wealth management and banking experiences to Ultra High Net Worth Individuals (UHNI) through personalized engagement, superior service standards, and holistic financial solutions.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Treasures Private Client (TPC) Service Manager is responsible for delivering proactive, prompt, and superior service experiences to Ultra High Net Worth (UHNI) clients. The role focuses on ensuring seamless servicing, managing operational requests, driving client engagement, maintaining compliance standards, and partnering with Relationship Managers to deepen client relationships and enhance overall customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Deliver superior client servicing within defined turnaround times (TATs).
* Act as the primary service contact and ensure complete ownership of client requests and resolutions.
* Maintain high standards of operational control, compliance, and risk management.
* Ensure proactive engagement and regular interaction with TPC clients.
* Drive adoption and usage of digital banking solutions and channels.
* Support Relationship Managers in enhancing client experience and strengthening relationships.
* Generate referrals and identify cross-sell opportunities through superior service delivery.
* Ensure seamless execution of KYC and all client-related compliance requirements.

**Job Duties & Responsibilities**

* Liaise with branches and internal support teams to resolve operational and service-related requests.
* Achieve high First Time Resolution (FTR) rates for client requests and service issues.
* Ensure monthly client contactability and engagement through CCM.
* Manage KYC reviews and all compliance-related processes for assigned clients.
* Conduct welcome calls for all New-to-Bank (NTB) clients.
* Drive usage and adoption of Online Banking, Mobile Banking, Debit Cards, and Credit Cards.
* Ensure timely resolution of all non-technical complaints within defined service standards.
* Partner with Relationship Managers to conduct regular client meetings and strengthen relationships.
* Identify opportunities to cross-sell relevant banking products and services.
* Generate client referrals through exceptional service experiences.
* Support Relationship Managers in deepening client relationships and increasing wallet share.
* Maintain a client-first approach while ensuring complete ownership of operational and servicing requirements.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of client requests and deliver an outstanding client experience.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in client servicing, wealth management, private banking, or relationship support functions.
* Minimum 5 years of experience servicing HNI/UHNI clients.
* Strong understanding of wealth management and private banking service standards.
* Proven ability to manage client relationships and service delivery in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience handling operational processes, client servicing, and compliance requirements.
* Strong customer service orientation and problem-solving capabilities.

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduate or Postgraduate degree.
* MBA preferred.

**Core Competencies**

* Client Relationship Management
* Service Excellence & Customer Experience
* Stakeholder Management
* Problem Solving & Resolution Management
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills
* Operational Effectiveness
* Client-Centric Mindset
* Result Orientation & Ownership

**Technical Competencies**

* Understanding of Wealth Management and Private Banking products and services.
* Knowledge of KYC, AML, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with Digital Banking platforms and customer servicing tools.
* Understanding of banking operations, service processes, and complaint management.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders for seamless service delivery.

**Work Relationship**

* Close partnership with Relationship Managers to support client engagement and growth.
* Regular interaction with Branch Operations, Service Teams, Compliance, and other support functions.
* Collaboration with Product and Digital Banking teams to improve customer adoption of banking solutions.
* Direct engagement with Treasures Private clients to ensure superior service delivery and satisfaction.

**DBS India – Culture & Behaviours**

* Demonstrate business performance through PRIDE 2.0 value-based propositions.

* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain, and enhance DBS's reputation.
* Continuously enhance knowledge, skills, and competencies.

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**Job Summary**
Individuals have implied authority to do what is necessary in carrying out their Responsibilities below, subject to the requirements of the Sources of Authority Framework including compliance with the Group Delegated Authorities Manual (including Financial authorities, Power of Attorney Policy and Group Authorised Signature Book). Including individuals’ authorities derived from Committees.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Drive profitable growth by acquiring, developing and servicing long-term relationships with HNW clients.

**Business**

* Accountable for the performance of individual’s and the cluster’s client book.
* Develop and implement the business/sales plans for the cluster, including individual’s own book.
* Deliver NNM, AUM, and revenue growth targets and key operating metrics for the cluster (such as tail accounts management, client acquisition, client satisfaction, portfolio mix).
* Generate healthy pipeline of target market prospects and convert them into clients.
* Grow client portfolio size by deepening existing customer relationships.
* Implement an asset allocation in line with client needs, and model portfolios as benchmarks.
* Deliver, monitor and review solutions to clients based on client investment profile.
* Conduct periodic reviews of client accounts in accordance with established procedures.
* Deliver profitable growth by controlling costs and mitigating operational losses.
* Deliver positive client performance in line with client investment profiles.

**Processes**

* Support the continuous improvement of processes to increase operational efficiency and effectiveness.
* Support the effective management of operational risks across the Business and in compliance with applicable internal policies, and external laws and regulations at a global level.
* Support the delivery of Business strategy in a safe and well-controlled manner and on an end-to-end basis.
* Ensure sales management, suitability and onboarding processes are applied appropriately.

**People and Talent**

* Apply a sufficiently robust level of oversight and support to limit errors or malfeasance by team members, to drive business ethically and in compliance, and to develop the skills of their team members.
* Build a top team capable of ensuring delivery of the business’ short and longer-term objectives.
* Develop and embed a high performance culture with specific focus on RM capability, effectiveness and productivity, through coaching and guidance to ensure the RM delivers against the financial, non-financial and risk/control objectives.
* Build an environment of collaboration within the team by ensuring that the issues are raised and blockages are resolved in a timely manner.
* Drive RM resourcing, performance management and recognition within the team.
* Identify and address the top concerns and opportunities for performance improvement in the team.
* Manage the team’s discretionary spend, expense management.

**Risk Management**

* Do what is right in order to avoid reputational risks and operational losses.
* Understand the risk and control environment within area of responsibility and drive rectification as required.
* Handle customer issues, complaints, and product enquiries on timely basis in accordance with established procedures.
* Ensure that Risk Management matters that are brought to attention are subject to direct remedial action and/or ensure adequate reporting to the relevant Risk Committees and/or line management.

**Governance**

* Awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
* Ensure adherence with the highest standards of ethics and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations forms part of the culture.
* Participate in Local Client Committee and other relevant committees where applicable.
* Engage with all audit report findings and ensure feedback is acted upon.

**Regulatory & Business conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct
* Lead the cluster to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles, such as Fair Outcomes for Clients; Financial Crime Prevention; The Right Environment.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key Stakeholders**

* COO
* Platform Managers
* Client Service Managers
* Product Specialists and dedicated functional partners
* Relevant Front office colleagues

* Embed Here for good and the Group’s brand and values.
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Region, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.
* Work effectively across SCB, using values behaviours to drive overall business growth.

**Skills And Experience**

* Wealth Management
* Relationship Management
* New money to the Bank

**Motivations**

* Discretionary TVC
* Hybrid Working
* Work closely with Global stakeholders

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* Graduate/Post-Graduate

**Certifications / Qualifications**

* NISM/IRDA

**Languages**

* English, local language

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.

description:

Subko is committed to an ideal: to help reimagine, re-design. and re-invent an unlikely

origin- the Indian Subcontinent as a legitimate contributor to the global specialty coffee,

craft baking and pod-to-bar chocolate making movements. Only raw materials enter

Subko’s facilities: all of the coffee, bakehouse and cacao products are crafted from

scratch, in house. From crop to cup, pod to bar, and farm to table. We aim to provide a

detailed, high quality coffee, bake and chocolate experience to all our guests.

**About the role:**

The Key Account Manager | Quick Commerce & E- Commerce is responsible for the

day-to-day management of Subko's marketplace and quick commerce accounts. The

role focuses on driving operational excellence across platforms by ensuring listing

accuracy, catalogue health, pricing consistency, inventory availability, promotional

execution, and platform performance.

Working closely with the Quick Commerce & Ecommerce Manager, this role acts as the

bridge between platform partners and internal teams including Supply Chain,

Operations, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Experience to ensure seamless

execution and sustainable business growth.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

1. Marketplace & Platform Management

* Manage the day-to-day operations of assigned Ecommerce and Quick Commerce platforms including Instamart, Blinkit, Zepto, Amazon, Flipkart, Noon, and other relevant marketplaces.

description:
**Overview**

With a vision to **build and sell Microsoft AI‑powered platforms, cloud services, and devices through a rich partner ecosystem**, the **Windows and Device Sales (WDS)** organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve real business outcomes with Microsoft technology.

WDS plays a critical role in shaping and delivering the endpoint platform that powers modern, secure, and AI‑enabled work. WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners - to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.

This role contributes to a **multi‑billion‑dollar business** and plays a direct role in **defending and expanding Windows as the enterprise endpoint platform**, enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.

As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders - anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders - to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.

In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. You will articulate differentiated Windows value across security, resiliency, management, and AI workloads; orchestrate partners and internal teams to deliver proof and outcomes; and convert lighthouse wins into repeatable evidence that scales across industries and partners.

This opportunity will allow you to deepen executive‑level consultative skills, build technical and platform credibility across the Windows ecosystem, and play a visible role in protecting and expanding Microsoft’s commercial footprint in priority accounts.

#WDS

[*This role is flexible in that you can work partially from home*]

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* **Lead Windows endpoint strategy with senior executives**: Leverage you technical expertise to lead strategic Windows discussions with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and AI leaders, translating technology capabilities into business value.
* **Defend and extend Windows in competitive environments,** deepen insights on why customers adopt alternative platforms, articulate fact based & differentiated platform value to protect the Windows socket.
* **Modernize endpoint management and identity architectures**, helping customers decouple from legacy environments, improve total cost of ownership, and unlock AI‑driven workflows at scale.
* **Lead high****‑****impact customer engagements** across discovery, envisioning, proof, and value realization, with clear entry criteria, success measures, and exit plans.
* **Deliver lighthouse wins that demonstrate real Windows AI value**, converting customer outcomes into evidence such as case studies, reference architectures, and repeatable industry scenarios.
* **Orchestrate across internal teams and partners**, working closely with account teams, engineering, and OEM/channel partners to ensure clarity of roles, clear hand-offs, escalation process, and accelerated outcomes.
* **Provide structured feedback and insights** from customer engagements to inform product, go‑to‑market, and partner strategy, identifying patterns that can scale across similar customers.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications (RQs)**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field **AND** 8+ years of customer‑facing experience in enterprise technology, consultative selling, Specialist, solution architecture, or transformation‑focused roles  
  **OR**
* Equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated capability and experience in **leading technical and executive‑level customer conversations**, translating complex platform concepts into **clear, outcome‑oriented guidance** for CIO, CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders.
* **Prior background in technical sales, solutions architecture, GBB or platform Specialist roles**, where credibility across both business outcomes and technical depth was required.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Security and compliance technologies, including Microsoft Defender, Entra, Purview, identity and access management, and Zero Trust principles, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value and risk reduction outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

* **Experience advising customers on Windows 11 lifecycle strategy**, including hardware refresh planning, security posture improvements, and operational readiness.

Able to advise senior leaders on device management modernization, security, operational efficiency and AI readiness, guiding customers through strategic platform decisions and transformation roadmaps.
* **Strong understanding of AI-ready Windows devices**, including Copilot+ PCs, NPUs and specialized AI silicon. description:
**About Avaya**

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

**Job Information**
-------------------

Job Code: 00194006

Job Family: Research and Development

Job Function: Software Engineering

**About The Opportunity**
-------------------------

Design, code, secure and evolve cloud-native platforms across Azure, GCP, AWS and hybrid environments. Build platform capabilities with Terraform, Kubernetes, GitOps and software engineering—and actively advance agentic platform development, from AI-assisted design and code creation to reusable agents and tool-integrated engineering workflows. Security, compliance and operational rigor are integral to delivery. Thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like engineering environment with rapid delivery, high ownership, hands-on problem solving and disciplined production quality.

  

**What you will build**
=======================

  

* Design and implement reusable Terraform modules, cloud landing-zone components, provisioning and lifecycle workflows across Azure, GCP and AWS; engineer resilient multi-region and dedicated-instance patterns.
* Build and maintain production Kubernetes foundations: clusters, node pools, networking, autoscaling, storage, workload identity, capacity, upgrades and recovery.
* Develop GitOps delivery platforms using Argo CD, Helm, GitHub Actions and automated validation, promotion, rollback and drift detection.
* Own platform services and their integration: Istio/service mesh, Keycloak/OIDC, cert-manager/PKI, API gateways, ingress/egress, DNS, secrets management and cloud-native networking.
* Engineer private networking, routing, firewall policy, WAF, VPN/private interconnect, TLS/mTLS, segmentation, load balancing and end-to-end connectivity troubleshooting.
* Codify zero-trust and least-privilege controls across identities, workloads, environments, networks, secrets, administrative access and service-to-service communication.
* Design and automate technical safeguards, traceable changes, evidence capture, continuous monitoring, vulnerability response and environment separation supporting FedRAMP, PCI DSS and SOC 2 requirements. Partner with GRC/Security to map implementations to applicable control obligations; do not equate platform features with certification or authorization.
* Engineer the observability stack end to end using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Grafana Alloy and OpenTelemetry: metrics collection, long-term retention, centralized logs, alerting, dashboards, telemetry pipelines, capacity signals and incident diagnostics.
* Deploy, scale, tune, secure and troubleshoot stateful platform components—including Kafka, Redis, relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MariaDB) and document databases (e.g., MongoDB)—covering operators, persistence, replication, backup/restore, upgrades, availability, throughput and recovery.
* Own secure API gateway and ingress architecture: authentication and authorization, TLS termination, rate limiting, routing, API lifecycle integration, firewall/WAF policy, and service-mesh connectivity.
* Develop platform tooling in Python, Go or Bash; eliminate recurring operational toil with durable engineering fixes and self-service capabilities.
* Develop and integrate agentic platform-development capabilities—not just production-operations agents—including AI-assisted Terraform/module and Helm/chart authoring, platform API and controller development, architecture analysis, code review, test generation, infrastructure-plan validation, safe change proposals, developer-facing tools, and reusable agent workflows integrated with GitOps/CI/CD.
* Use and extend agentic development workflows across the full engineering lifecycle—architecture exploration, Terraform/Helm authoring, code reviews, automated tests, environment validation, pull requests and release readiness—not only production diagnosis and remediation.

**About The Requirements**
--------------------------

**Required experience**
=======================

  

* 8+ years in software, cloud, DevOps/SRE or platform engineering, with substantial hands-on design and implementation.
* Advanced Terraform and Kubernetes skills; production experience with Argo CD, GitOps, Helm and CI/CD.
* Deep experience with Azure plus GCP or AWS; ability to transfer architecture patterns across cloud providers.
* Strong Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, PKI, routing, firewall, IAM/RBAC and distributed-system troubleshooting.
* Hands-on with several platform components such as Istio, Keycloak, cert-manager, API gateways and secrets management, with ability to learn the others.
* Practical deployment, scaling, hardening and operational troubleshooting of Kafka, Redis and relational/document databases in Kubernetes or managed cloud services; experience with API gateways and secure API exposure.
* Hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Grafana Alloy or equivalent metrics/logging pipelines, including cardinality, retention, alert quality and production troubleshooting.
* Demonstrated experience implementing security controls in regulated environments and supporting FedRAMP, PCI DSS, SOC 2 or comparably rigorous programs.
* Coding ability in Python, Go or equivalent; evidence of shipping automation and reusable engineering components.
* Ability to reason from application behavior through cluster, identity, certificate, network and cloud dependencies.
* Demonstrated ownership in a fast-paced, startup-like environment: rapid iteration, shifting priorities, independently driving work to production and balancing speed with security and reliability.

**Preferred**
=============

  

* Multi-tenant or customer-dedicated SaaS, hybrid/air-gapped architectures, Kubernetes operators/CRDs, cloud cost management.
* Compliance-as-code, automated audit evidence, policy engines, vulnerability scanning and supply-chain security.
* Hands-on experience building or extending agentic development workflows, agent tool integrations or shared engineering capabilities for infrastructure and Kubernetes—not only using AI coding assistants.

**Success in the first 6–12 months**
====================================

  

* Deliver reusable cloud/Kubernetes capabilities that reduce custom environment work and deployment variability.
* Remove material gaps in security posture and make evidence collection and drift detection more repeatable.
* Improve deployment safety, platform upgradeability and production diagnostics with measurable outcomes.
* Build or substantially improve deployment, resilience, scaling and observability for Kafka, Redis, relational and document databases and gateway services; reduce operational bottlenecks.
* Build and share agentic platform-development workflows that help engineers design, implement, test and evolve secure infrastructure faster, with measurable quality and review controls.

Leveling | Senior: independently owns significant subsystems and implementations. Principal: sets cross-platform architecture and standards, resolves cross-domain design decisions and mentors multiple teams.

**Experience**
--------------

12+ Years of Experience

**Education**
-------------

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Advance Degree preferred

**Preferred Certifications**
----------------------------

----------

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Minimal level of relevant work experience required.

You will work with
  
  
You will join AI Enablement & Programme Management, a new central function that connects bp's AI strategy with delivery. You will support the AI Engagement, Community & Training Lead and work closely with Communications, Training, Workplace and Resilience, AI Governance, Digital Security, business-facing Digital teams, AI specialists and enabling functions. The AI Engagement, Community and Training Senior Change Manager will translate engagement, communications, community and learning strategies into coordinated plans, milestones and deliverables. You will handle cross-functional delivery across AI communications campaigns, the AI Champion community, the AI Community of Practice, AI learning coordination, trusted guidance and continued development of the AI Hub. The role combines senior project delivery, change and adoption practice, communications coordination, community activation, learning coordination, stakeholder management and digital content delivery. You will deliver through influence in a matrix, recognising that communications and training execution remain owned by specialist teams.
  
  
What you will deliver
  
  
**Planning and project delivery:**
Translate engagement, community and training strategies into integrated plans, milestones, dependencies and deliverables. Establish practical delivery rhythms, maintain momentum and ensure work is completed to agreed quality and outcomes.
  
  
**Cross-functional coordination:**
Coordinate Communications, Training, Workplace and Resilience, AI Governance, Digital Security and other teams to execute shared priorities. Clarify roles and hand-offs, manage dependencies and avoid duplication of specialist responsibilities.
  
  
**Communications delivery:**
Coordinate AI communication campaigns, content development, approvals and associated execution activity. Maintain coherent plans and ensure messages and materials are clear, consistent, timely and connected to adoption objectives.
  
  
**Community activation:**
Re-establish and sustain the AI Champion community and AI Community of Practice. Coordinate operating rhythms, events, content, participation and follow-through so communities share learning, amplify trusted guidance and support adoption.
  
  
**Learning coordination:**
Support the discovery and mapping of AI learning across bp, coordinate gap analysis and manage delivery activity against agreed priorities in partnership with Training teams.
  
  
**AI Hub product and content delivery:**
Manage the continued development and improvement of the consolidated AI Hub. Coordinate backlog, content owners, user needs, publishing activity and lifecycle management so people can access trusted and current AI information.
  
  
**Stakeholder management:**
Build effective working relationships across business-facing Digital teams, AI specialists and enabling functions. Maintain alignment, surface decisions and issues early, and adapt delivery to stakeholder and business needs.
  
  
**Delivery governance and reporting:**
Track progress, dependencies, risks, issues, actions and outcomes across the engagement portfolio. Produce clear status reporting and decision support, and ensure commitments are owned and followed through.
  
  
**Change, adoption and insight:**
Coordinate interventions that improve understanding, confidence and sustained use of AI. Support feedback loops, community listening and confidence measurement, using insight to refine future activity.
  
  
**Continuous improvement:**
See opportunities to simplify plans, content processes, community operations and delivery controls. Capture learning and improve repeatability, quality and pace across the pillar.
  
  
What you will need to be successful (experience and qualifications)
  
  

* Proven experience managing sophisticated technology projects or workstreams across communications, change, engagement, learning, community or digital content in a matrixed organisation.
* Strong project planning and delivery skills, including achievements, dependencies, risks, issues, actions, reporting and outcome tracking. Experience of using AI Tools in project management.
* Experience coordinating communications campaigns and content development across multiple contributors, approvals and channels.
* Experience mobilising and sustaining communities, networks, champion programmes or communities of practice.
* Experience coordinating learning needs discovery, learning portfolios or capability-building activity with specialist training teams.
* Experience handling digital content, intranet or website development and improvement, including backlogs and content lifecycle practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to build trust and deliver through influence.
* Practical understanding of change and adoption approaches and how engagement, learning and community interventions support sustained use.
* Ability to use feedback, qualitative insight and performance measures to improve delivery and demonstrate outcomes.
* Strong judgement, organisation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage ambiguity and challenging priorities.

At this level, the AI Engagement, Community and Training Senior Project Manager independently leads sophisticated delivery across multiple interconnected workstreams. They turn strategy into structured, measurable execution; coordinate customers across organisational boundaries; and maintain clear governance over progress, dependencies, risks and outcomes. They give practical insight to evolving roadmaps, build trust through reliable delivery and use feedback to improve future interventions. title: AVP - Global Indian Premier RM
description:
****Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.****
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Role Purpose (overall High Level Summary Of The Role)**
To grow and nurture HSBC NR Premier relationships (the HNI segment of the PLB customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan. Manage clients with a portfolio between USD 0.5M to USD 1M. To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards. The jobholder should also have a detailed understanding of financial and banking products to deliver best outcomes to clients.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities: Key activities and decision making areas**
Impact on the Business / Function
  
  

* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and RBWM performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date

**Typical Targets and Measures**

* Demonstrate excellent understanding of client needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve closure of sales
* Through disciplined portfolio management, develop strategies to increase wallet share of existing clients and actively manage a prospect pipeline
* Specific metrics include, but not limited to: Revenue , AUM, TRB, number of products sold to client, number of referrals, total balance of relationship portfolio

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client
* Client experience and/or client satisfaction metric
* Measured by client appointments and retention
* Measured by increase in portfolio penetration with diversified product and service mix
* Measured by adoption of global target operating model
* Measured by client appreciation and no complaints

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Ensuring that sales & operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank plc FIM, BIM and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Ensure that all cross border guidelines as per the country of residence and location of clients are adhered to while engaging with NRI customers
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority (RAA)
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant MI to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Measured by compliance to KYC requirements, credit, service standards and reducing operational losses.
* Measured through sales quality score with nil exceptions
* Measured by internal audit standards
* Measured by number of information security breaches (none)
* Measured by client complaints
* Measured by no adverse feedback received from Local Credit Team, Global Wealth credit, or from a Credit Risk Review
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner

****Knowledge & Experience****

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* Minimum of five years proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
* Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
* Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
* Strong technical skills in wealth management
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
* Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
* Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
* Local regulatory & license requirements - job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by country
* Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit & Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
* Able to communicate well in English and local languages

**Accreditations**

* Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market AMFI & IRDA

**Leadership Capabilities**

* Have an understanding of the immediate regional Global Wealth strategy and the ability to plan own activities accordingly
* Be ambitious about providing the highest standards of delivery to colleagues and clients
* Show ability to set stretch goals for self and the ability to deliver these with courage and tenacity
* Be authentic and show ability to engage with colleagues and clients to deliver at pace
* Make considered decisions that protect HSBC & Global Wealth values, reputation and businesses

****Technical Capabilities****
**Client Skills**

**Role Context**
(The environment and operating conditions of the role including the extent of guidance and authority)
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest foreign banks in India with a strong franchise and significant brand equity. As a worldwide Group initiative, the objective of HSBC Premier is to deliver a truly global proposition for the wealthiest HSBC personal customers and to establish HSBC as a complete financial services provider for HNIs.
  
  
The principal regulations under which the jobholder operates includes PBT FIM, MLPP and all other local regulations issued from time to time by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and other statutory bodies. He/she will manage assigned relationships independently within the overall policy framework laid down by the bank and operational policies and procedures laid down by compliance. The jobholder will be guided by the service proposition and the enhancements in the service scope from time to time, and is expected to work closely with the Branches and support functions on operational issues.
  
  
He/she is expected to independently exercise broad discretion in carrying out his/her duties and is not expected to make reference to his/her superior on day-to-day routine matters. The jobholder being a senior member in the Premier channel is required to provide guidance and direction to other members of the Premier channel.
  
  
**Note: Capability Requirements**
( for the role holder, to be assessed through the selection process)
  
  
**Management of Risk**
(Operational Risk / FIM requirements)
  
  

* Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.

**Observation of Internal Controls**

* Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.

**Role Dimensions**

**USD’000**

* Portfolio Size of Total Relationship Value of 25 lakhs or more per customer
* Portfolio Size of Premier clients or number of relationships as dictated by market requirements
* Growth in Income, balances, clients volumes, number of clients, etc.

**Major Challenges**
(The challenges inherent in the role that require a continual test of the role holder’s abilities)
  
  
Given the growth aspirations of the WM business, the jobholder is to constantly develop and grow Premier relationships in a highly competitive market. The jobholder will need to continuously operate in a dynamic environment, proactively resolve and address the financial needs of his customers, to win their confidence and fulfil the role of a “one-point” contact for his customers. The said role requires the relationship manager to balance customer servicing activity along with sales acquisition while ensuring the necessary growth in the existing portfolio coupled with minimal attrition.
  
  
The incumbent will be required to manage the HNI Premier customers with a portfolio between USD 0.5M to USD1M
  
  
**Leadership Capabilities**

* Have an understanding of the immediate regional Global Wealth strategy and the ability to plan own activities accordingly
* Be ambitious about providing the highest standards of delivery to colleagues and clients
* Show ability to set stretch goals for self and the ability to deliver these with courage and tenacity
* Be authentic and show ability to engage with colleagues and clients to deliver at pace
* Make considered decisions that protect HSBC & Global Wealth values, reputation and businesses

****Client Skills****

* Portfolio management
* Communicating & influencing

**Business Acumen**

* Marketplace knowledge
* Business understanding

**Solutions**

* HSBC services and propositions

**Processes**

* Business processes
* Tools and systems

****Additional Notes :****

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable .
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Engagement Manager (HCM Implementation, People Manager)
description:
**About Darwinbox**
Darwinboxis Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery

You will act as:
  
  

* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities

Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.
  
  
**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

Lastly, what we are not looking for
**,**
we’re not looking for traditional implementation managers nor project coordinators and definitely not people who measure success by whether the tracker is green.
