**Key Responsibility position overview**

**Position Overview**

ACL Digital is seeking an experienced business leader to lead its State and Federal Government business across the United States. This individual will be responsible for developing strategic client relationships, driving new business opportunities, managing key accounts, and overseeing end-to-end client delivery across
**Statement of Work (SOW), Professional Services, and Contingent Workforce Staffing engagements**
.

The role requires a strong understanding of the U.S. public-sector contracting ecosystem, government procurement processes, staffing programs, and technology services delivery. The individual will lead business development initiatives, manage the complete RFP and proposal lifecycle, establish strategic partnerships, and ensure successful execution of client engagements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Growth**

* Develop and execute strategies to expand ACL Digital's presence across State and Federal Government accounts.
* Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities across government agencies, departments, municipalities, and public-sector organizations.
* Drive new opportunities across SOW-based technology engagements, IT professional services, project-based solutions, and contingent workforce staffing.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through direct client relationships, strategic partnerships, and government contracting channels.
* Develop strategic account plans and identify opportunities for expanding existing engagements.
* Establish relationships with prime contractors, systems integrators, government consulting firms, and subcontracting partners.

**2. RFP, RFI, RFQ & Proposal Management**

* Lead and manage the end-to-end RFP, RFI, RFQ, and RFE process for State and Federal opportunities.
* Identify relevant government bids, contract opportunities, and procurement requirements.
* Evaluate bid opportunities, assess qualification criteria, and coordinate go/no-go decisions.
* Own proposal development, response strategy, solution coordination, pricing inputs, compliance documentation, and timely submission.
* Collaborate with technical, delivery, recruitment, legal, contracts, and leadership teams to develop compelling and competitive proposals.
* Ensure proposals meet all technical, commercial, contractual, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate presentations, client discussions, oral presentations, and subsequent negotiations.
* Track submitted proposals, manage clarifications, and drive opportunities through contract award and onboarding.

**3. Strategic Client & Account Management**

* Build and maintain executive-level relationships with government clients, procurement leaders, program directors, and IT decisionmakers.
* Serve as the senior point of contact for strategic State and Federal accounts.
* Understand client priorities, procurement requirements, technology initiatives, and workforce needs.
* Drive account expansion, client retention, executive reviews, and strategic account planning.
* Position ACL Digital as a comprehensive technology and workforce solutions partner.

**4. SOW & Professional Services Leadership**

* Drive opportunities and oversee engagements across SOW-based technology services.
* Identify project-based opportunities and develop solutions aligned with government requirements.
* Oversee the SOW lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, solution development, proposal preparation, contracting, resource planning, and project execution.
* Partner with technical and delivery leaders to develop differentiated solutions and ensure successful project outcomes.
* Monitor project milestones, delivery quality, contractual commitments, and client satisfaction.

**5. Contingent Workforce & Staffing Program Management**

* Drive contingent workforce staffing opportunities across State and Federal Government programs.
* Develop relationships with MSPs, VMS providers, prime vendors, staffing partners, and government procurement organizations.
* Identify opportunities across staffing contracts, master service agreements, task orders, and government workforce programs.
* Oversee the staffing program lifecycle, including requisition fulfillment, sourcing, onboarding, compliance, resource management, and offboarding.
* Establish delivery governance, fulfillment SLAs, recruitment performance metrics, and operational controls.
* Ensure workforce quality, compliance, and consistent service delivery.

**6. Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Provide leadership and oversight for client delivery and program operations across State and Federal accounts.
* Establish delivery governance, reporting mechanisms, performance metrics, and operational review processes.
* Coordinate across sales, recruiting, program management, technical delivery, HR, legal, and compliance teams.
* Monitor fulfillment rates, resource utilization, project delivery milestones, and client satisfaction.
* Proactively resolve client escalations and delivery challenges.
* Ensure adherence to contractual, security, regulatory, and client-specific compliance requirements.

**7. Government Contracting & Strategic Partnerships**

* Develop a strong understanding of State and Federal procurement frameworks, contracting vehicles, and public-sector buying processes.
* Leverage opportunities through various state term contracts, cooperative purchasing agreements, and other relevant procurement channels.
* Build relationships with prime contractors and identify teaming, subcontracting, and strategic partnership opportunities.
* Work with internal legal and contracts teams to support contract negotiations, compliance, and successful contract execution.
* Monitor government spending priorities, procurement trends, and upcoming contract opportunities.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 8–10+ years of experience in U.S. IT services, technology consulting, professional services, staffing, or contingent workforce solutions.
* Demonstrated experience working with State and/or Federal Government clients.
* Proven track record in business development, client relationship management, and delivery leadership.
* Strong experience managing RFP, RFI, RFQ, and RFE responses and government proposal processes.
* Experience winning and managing SOW-based technology services engagements.
* Significant understanding of contingent workforce staffing programs and resource deployment models.
* Experience working with government agencies, MSPs, prime contractors, systems integrators, and public-sector procurement organizations.
* Understanding of government contracting processes, contract vehicles, subcontracting models, and compliance requirements.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams across sales, recruitment, program management, and delivery.
* Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with federal and state-level master contracts.
* Existing relationships with State agencies, Federal departments, prime contractors, and public-sector technology partners.
* Familiarity with government procurement platforms, security requirements, and public-sector regulations.
* Experience supporting government technology modernization initiatives across Cloud, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Application Modernization, and Digital Transformation.
* Exposure to SLED (State, Local, and Education) and Federal markets.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* New business opportunities and client acquisition.
* Growth in SOW and project-based services engagements.
* Expansion of contingent workforce staffing programs.
* Number and quality of RFP/RFI/RFQ/RFE submissions and contract awards.
* Growth in strategic government and prime contractor relationships.
* Client retention, satisfaction, and account expansion.
* Resource fulfillment, delivery performance, and compliance.
* Successful execution and transition of awarded contracts into delivery.

**Leadership Expectations**

* The individual will serve as the business and delivery leader for ACL Digital's State and Federal portfolio, combining strong business development capabilities with client relationship management, proposal leadership, and delivery oversight.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently developing market opportunities, building strategic government and partner relationships, leading competitive bid processes, winning new engagements, and ensuring successful execution across SOW and contingent workforce programs.

title: Pod Lead, Delivery Architect
description:
**What Amphare is**

Amphare Technologies builds governed, AI-native software delivery. The method is atomikd: scope is decomposed into machine-checkable units, each with a contract and an evidence grade, scheduled in waves and shipped inside a release envelope. The kernel is AmphSE: it sits above the coding agents and enforces the gates. The instrument is CodeSentinel: it reads the code and grades the evidence. The map is RepoGraph: the code graph every atom is planned against. The proof is a services pod that delivers real client software with all three and feeds what it learns back into the product.

The hybrid is deliberate. Service work funds the product and tests it against reality. The product makes the service faster, and lets us show a client exactly what was built, how it was verified, and by whom. Showing the client that is the business.

**Why this role exists**

Someone has to hold the whole project: the client's actual problem, the architecture that answers it, the estimate the business signed, the waves that get it built, and the evidence that proves it shipped. In a traditional firm that is a project manager, an architect, a scrum master and a BA, plus a steering committee. Here it is you, with three strong colleagues and a kernel that enforces the gates you set. You are the person a client trusts because you can draw the system on one page and defend every box. You are the person the pod trusts because when the critical path is blocked, you open the editor.

**What you own**

* The engagement. One at a time for the first pod. From sales handover to acceptance: scope, commercial envelope (what the fixed price can absorb), risk, client relationship, and the decision to say no when the evidence says no. Pricing new work and signing contracts stay with the founder.
* Solution shape. Architecture, stack choice for the client's constraints (we are stack-agnostic by principle), integration boundaries, non-functional requirements, and the trade-offs written down where the client can read them. You are accountable for the user experience too; specialist design is engaged per engagement from outside the pod.
* The Epic Map and the estimate. Decomposition to the level where effort can be measured and compared with what we actually spent. Your estimates are checked against outcomes every wave. Wave scheduling and the release envelope. What ships, in what order, with what dependencies, under what gate. Short, written, evidence-first.
* Pod governance. The gates agents and humans pass through, the evidence grades we accept, the retros that change the method. "AI proposes, humans approve" is a rule you enforce, including on yourself.
* The pod itself. Growing the three people beside you, and writing down how this pod works so the next pod can copy it.

**Who we are looking for**

* You have shipped production software as an engineer and later run delivery for teams larger than this pod, and you know what that cost.
* You have personally fixed a bad estimate, in front of a client, with numbers rather than apologies.
* You can draw a system on one page and answer "why not the obvious alternative" for every component.
* You have read code an agent wrote for you closely enough to send it back. More than once.
* You have written requirements, test plans and release notes yourself because nobody else was going to, and they were good.
* You can name a ceremony you removed from a team and what you replaced it with.
* You are commercially literate: blended rates, margin, fixed-price risk, what a change request costs.

*Signals this is not your role*

* You manage through status meetings and feel exposed without a PMO.
* You last committed code three or more years ago and are comfortable with that.
* You believe "architect" means not touching the keyboard.
* You see AI coding tools as a productivity add-on for juniors.
* You cannot do your best work until scope is frozen.
* You prefer to be told the method rather than to improve it.

title: Cluster Manager for Salons
description:
**Company Description**
Naturals Salon & Spa, launched in 2000, is one of the world’s fastest-growing salon chains, with over 800 salons across India and an ambitious target of 3,000 salons by 2029. The brand pioneered the concept of unisex salons in India and has become widely recognized for accessible, high-quality hair, beauty, and wellness services. Naturals serves a diverse clientele through its portfolio of sub-brands, including Naturals Unisex Salon, Naturals Signature Salon, and Naturals W, a women-focused concept. With a mission to create 1,000 successful women entrepreneurs and 50,000 job opportunities by 2029, Naturals offers strong growth prospects for professionals in the beauty and salon management industry. The brand’s partnership with Bollywood actor Kareena Kapoor as ambassador reflects its focus on style, confidence, and continuous expansion.
  
**Role Description**
The Cluster Manager for Salons is a full-time, on-site role based in Coimbatore, responsible for overseeing the performance and operations of multiple Naturals salons within the assigned cluster. This role includes monitoring daily salon activities, ensuring consistent service quality, implementing brand standards, and driving revenue and profitability across locations. The Cluster Manager will guide salon managers on staff scheduling, inventory management, and adherence to hygiene and safety protocols, while supporting training and development of beauty and hair care professionals. They will handle customer escalations, foster strong client relationships, and collaborate with leadership to execute local marketing initiatives and promotional campaigns. The role also involves hiring and onboarding key salon staff, analyzing performance data, and recommending improvements to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Foundational knowledge in cosmetology and hair.
* Strong communication and customer service skills to manage client interactions, resolve concerns, and coordinate with salon managers and staff.
* Experience in hiring, staffing, and basic HR practices to build and retain high-performing salon teams.

title: General Manager and Branch Head
description:
General Manager – Lachmandas Trading Company, (Aswani Lachmandas Group), Ernakulam branch.

1. About Aswani Lachmandas Group

The **Aswani Lachmandas Group** is a diversified, family-led business group with a strong presence in trading, distribution, retail and allied businesses. Built on a legacy of trust, entrepreneurship and long-standing relationships with principals, customers and business partners, the Group has grown through a combination of strong market execution, people development and disciplined business practices.

The Group believes in combining its traditional strengths in distribution and trade relationships with modern management practices, technology, process discipline and continuous improvement.

2. About Lachmandas Trading Company

**Lachmandas Trading Company (LTC)** is a key distribution and trading business within the Aswani Lachmandas Group. The company has an established presence in the FMCG and tobacco distribution ecosystem and works with a large network of retailers and trade partners.

The business operates across multiple categories and channels, including cigarette/tobacco and non-tobacco products, supported by a field sales force, channel managers, team leaders, godown and logistics personnel, accounts and billing teams, and HR support.

The **Devi Complex Branch** is an important operating unit of the company. The General Manager will be responsible for providing overall leadership to the branch, ensuring coordinated functioning across sales, collections, operations, logistics, finance, administration and people management.

3. Position

**Designation:** General Manager  
**Location:** Devi Complex Branch  
**Reporting To:** Management / Directors  
**Department:** Overall Branch Operations

4. Role Purpose

The General Manager will be responsible for the **overall business performance, profitability, operational efficiency and people management of the Devi Complex Branch**.

The role requires the GM to act as the single point of coordination and accountability for all major branch functions, with a focus on:

* Driving sales and category growth
* Improving retail throughput and market execution
* Ensuring timely collections and reducing receivables
* Strengthening process discipline and compliance
* Ensuring accurate inventory and efficient logistics
* Developing and managing the branch team
* Improving coordination between departments
* Identifying operational gaps and building the required support structure

The GM will work through the respective Channel Managers, Team Leaders, Salesmen, Godown Coordinator, Stock In-charges, Accounts and Billing In-charge, and HR support staff.

The objective is to build a **high-performing, process-driven and accountable branch that consistently delivers sales growth, strong collections, efficient operations and excellent customer service**.

5. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Overall Branch Leadership and Business Management

* Take complete ownership of the overall performance of the Devi Complex Branch.
* Develop annual, quarterly and monthly business plans in line with company objectives.
* Translate management objectives into clear departmental and individual targets.
* Conduct regular performance reviews across sales, collections, operations and support functions.
* Ensure effective coordination between all departments and eliminate operational silos.
* Identify gaps in people, processes, systems and infrastructure and recommend corrective action.
* Escalate key business risks, market developments and operational challenges to management in a timely manner.
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability, discipline and continuous improvement.

B. Sales and Business Growth

The GM will oversee both the **cigarette/tobacco and non-tobacco businesses**, working through the respective Channel Managers, Team Leaders and Salesmen.

Key responsibilities:

* Drive achievement of sales targets across all channels and categories.
* Improve **retail throughput** and productivity across the outlet universe.
* Increase active outlet coverage and improve the quality of productive outlets.
* Identify opportunities to grow existing categories and introduce new categories.
* Monitor market trends, competition, retailer feedback and emerging opportunities.
* Improve beat productivity, salesman productivity and outlet-level performance.
* Ensure effective execution of company and principal-led initiatives.
* Work with Channel Managers to develop focused plans for underperforming territories, categories or teams.
* Review sales performance regularly and take prompt corrective action where targets are not being achieved.

C. Cigarette / Tobacco Business Management

Working with the relevant Channel Managers and sales leadership team, the GM will be responsible for:

* Driving sustainable sales and retail throughput growth.
* Ensuring strong market execution and availability.
* Monitoring competitive activity and taking appropriate action to protect and grow market share.
* Reducing business loss arising from competition, poor execution or process gaps.
* Ensuring compliance with all company, principal and regulatory processes.
* Monitoring GR management and related processes.
* Ensuring timely management of outstanding receivables and LTA payments.
* Improving database accuracy and ensuring correct customer, outlet and transaction information.
* Reviewing market-level exceptions and ensuring timely resolution.
* Driving accountability across the sales hierarchy.

D. Non-Tobacco Sales and Category Management

The GM will lead the non-tobacco business through the Channel Managers, Team Leaders and Salesmen.

Key responsibilities include:

* Drive growth across all assigned non-tobacco categories.
* Develop specific growth plans for **GR1A, GR1B and GR2** categories.
* Improve category-wise outlet penetration and retail throughput.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling and expanding product range across existing outlets.
* Improve new outlet acquisition and productive outlet conversion.
* Ensure focused execution of category-specific targets and schemes.
* Monitor category profitability and business quality.
* Ensure adherence to all sales, credit, billing and process requirements.
* Maintain strict control over outstanding receivables.
* Identify underperforming categories, territories and sales personnel and implement corrective action plans.

E. Collections, Outstanding and Receivables Management

One of the GM's key responsibilities will be to ensure that sales growth is accompanied by strong financial discipline.

The GM will:

* Monitor outstanding receivables across all businesses and categories.
* Ensure timely collection of dues and reduce overdue balances.
* Review ageing reports on a regular basis.
* Work with sales and accounts teams to resolve collection bottlenecks.
* Ensure appropriate follow-up on high-risk and long-pending accounts.
* Prevent uncontrolled credit extension.
* Ensure adherence to approved credit policies and limits.
* Monitor LTA and other pending payments.
* Establish clear accountability for outstanding management at Channel Manager, Team Leader and Salesman levels.
* Maintain a healthy balance between sales growth and quality of receivables.

F. Godown, Inventory and Logistics Management

The GM will oversee godown and delivery operations with the support of the **Godown Coordinator and Stock In-charges**.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensure smooth and efficient functioning of the godown.
* Maintain accurate inventory and stock records.
* Monitor stock shortages, damages, discrepancies and WSP shortages.
* Ensure timely investigation and closure of stock variances.
* Improve stock handling, storage and movement practices.
* Ensure prompt and accurate order processing and dispatch.
* Monitor delivery turnaround time and customer service levels.
* Ensure efficient vehicle utilisation and vehicle management.
* Track vehicle maintenance, statutory requirements and license renewals.
* Ensure proper scheduling and deployment of delivery resources.
* Maintain high standards of godown cleanliness, hygiene and safety.
* Conduct periodic stock verification and reconciliation.
* Identify opportunities to reduce operational inefficiencies and logistics costs.

G. Billing, Accounts and Compliance

Working closely with the **Accounts and Billing In-charge**, the GM will ensure:

* Prompt and accurate billing.
* Timely completion of accounting and bookkeeping activities.
* Proper adherence to internal processes and financial controls.
* Timely renewal and management of insurance policies and other relevant statutory requirements.
* Proper documentation and record maintenance.
* Timely reconciliation of key accounts and transactions.
* Coordination between sales, godown and accounts to prevent billing and stock discrepancies.
* Timely escalation and resolution of financial or process-related exceptions.
* Compliance with company policies, statutory requirements and principal guidelines.

H. Human Resources and People Management

The GM will work with HR Assistants and management to build a strong and motivated branch team.

Responsibilities include:

* Ensure appropriate manpower planning across departments.
* Identify manpower gaps and initiate timely recruitment.
* Participate in the selection and onboarding of key employees.
* Ensure proper induction and role clarity for new employees.
* Monitor attendance, payroll inputs and workforce-related records.
* Conduct regular performance reviews of key team members.
* Identify training and capability-building requirements.
* Develop succession and backup plans for critical roles.
* Improve employee engagement and morale.
* Implement staff welfare initiatives in coordination with management and HR.
* Address employee grievances and workplace issues in a timely and fair manner.
* Promote a culture of discipline, teamwork, accountability and respect.

6. Process Compliance and Internal Controls

The GM will be responsible for ensuring that the branch operates in a disciplined and process-oriented manner.

This includes:

* Ensuring compliance with approved company processes.
* Identifying areas of process leakage or non-compliance.
* Ensuring timely corrective action.
* Maintaining accurate business and operational data.
* Improving database accuracy.
* Ensuring proper documentation and approvals.
* Monitoring key control points across sales, collections, stock, billing and expenses.
* Supporting internal audits and implementing corrective actions.
* Developing simple dashboards and review mechanisms to track key branch KPIs.

7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the General Manager will be measured across the following areas:

Business Performance

* Achievement of sales targets
* Sales growth versus previous year
* Category-wise growth
* Retail throughput growth
* Productive outlet growth
* Outlet penetration and market coverage
* Sales team productivity

Collections and Financial Discipline

* Outstanding levels
* Ageing of receivables
* Collection efficiency
* Reduction in overdue accounts
* Timeliness of LTA and other payments

Operations and Logistics

* Stock accuracy
* Reduction in stock shortages and discrepancies
* WSP shortage management
* Delivery turnaround time
* Vehicle utilisation and management
* Godown hygiene and operational standards

Process and Compliance

* Process adherence
* Audit observations and closure
* Database accuracy
* Timely license and insurance renewals
* Billing and documentation accuracy

People Management

* Employee productivity
* Recruitment turnaround time
* Employee retention
* Staff welfare and engagement
* Performance management and team development

8. Authority and Resource Support

The General Manager will have the responsibility to identify gaps in the existing organisation structure, skills or support systems.

Where a genuine gap is identified, the GM may recommend:

* Recruitment of additional functional in-charges
* Restructuring of responsibilities
* Additional manpower
* Process improvements
* Technology or reporting support
* Training and capability development

Management will support the strengthening of the branch structure wherever there is a clear business need and a defined improvement plan.

The expectation from the GM is not necessarily to personally execute every activity, but to **build the right team, establish clear accountability, review performance rigorously and ensure that outcomes are delivered**.

9. Desired Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should possess:

* Strong experience in FMCG, distribution, trading, sales or branch management.
* Demonstrated experience in managing multiple teams and functions.
* Strong understanding of sales, collections and receivables management.
* Experience in distribution operations, inventory and logistics management.
* Ability to analyse business data and translate insights into action.
* Strong leadership and people-management capabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* High levels of ownership, integrity and process discipline.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Comfort in dealing with frontline employees as well as senior management.

10. The Role in One Statement

**The General Manager is the overall business and operating leader of the Devi Complex Branch, responsible for ensuring better sales, stronger collections, controlled receivables, efficient operations, accurate stock, prompt deliveries, process compliance and a motivated, accountable workforce.**

The GM's success will be measured not merely by individual departmental performance, but by the ability to create a **well-coordinated, profitable, disciplined and continuously improving branch operation**.

title: IT Service Desk Technician
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a dedicated and customer-focused IT Service Desk Technician to join our team. This position will be responsible for providing remote technical support and assistance to end-users across the organization. They will play a crucial role in resolving IT-related issues remotely, ensuring the smooth operation of systems, and delivering exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a remote support environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide remote technical support and assistance to end-users, addressing basic software and account related issues like password troubleshooting, bitlocker recovery, and o365 tools.
* Respond to incoming support requests via various channels (phone, email, chat), ensuring timely and accurate resolution that align with SLAs and KPIs.
* Troubleshoot and diagnose technical issues reported by end-users, utilizing remote tools and diagnostic techniques.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to appropriate support teams or senior analysts for further investigation and resolution.
* Follow standard operating procedures to assist with IT account provisioning and deprovisioning. Maintain thorough and accurate records of support interactions, actions taken, and resolutions provided.
* Provide clear and concise instructions to end-users regarding system usage, troubleshooting steps, and preventive measures.
* Contribute to the knowledge base by creating and updating support articles, guides, and FAQs.
* Stay updated with the organization's IT policies, procedures, and technologies to ensure accurate and effective support delivery.

**Skills And Experience**

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in an IT Service Desk or Technical Support role, preferably in a remote support environment.
* Strong knowledge of IT fundamentals, including hardware, operating systems (MAC, Windows 10, 11), networking, and productivity software such as PDF software, Office 365.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting common desktop, laptop, and mobile device issues.
* Familiarity with remote support tools and technologies.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate technical information effectively to non-technical users.
* Customer-centric approach with a passion for delivering exceptional customer service.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to multi-task and quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with IT Service Management practices (eg. Incident/problem/change management, etc.) using enterprise ticketing systems and tools.
* Willingness to work in different shifts to provide 24/7 support, if required.

Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**About ATS**
ATS is an industry-leading automation solutions provider to many of the world’s most successful companies. ATS uses its extensive knowledge base and global capabilities in custom automation, repeat automation, automation products and value-added services, including pre-automation and after-sales services, to address the sophisticated manufacturing automation systems and service needs of multinational customers in markets such as life sciences, food & beverage, transportation, consumer products, and energy. Founded in 1978, ATS employs over 6,000 people at more than 50 manufacturing facilities and over 75 offices in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, South Asia, and China. The Company’s shares are traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol ATS.

Support endpoint security, antivirus management, system patching, and access control measures. Ensure compliance with IT and information security policies. Identify, report, and assist in managing information security incidents.

**Asset & Vendor Management:**

Maintain an inventory of IT hardware, software, AV, and network assets. Track software licences, warranties, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), and asset lifecycles. Coordinate procurement, repairs, replacements, and vendor support activities.

**Event & Operational Support:**

Provide IT support for examinations, admissions, conferences, workshops, convocations, and other institutional events. Ensure the uninterrupted availability and smooth functioning of technology services during critical academic and institutional activities.

description:
Purpose
  
  
As a Support Specialist, you will provide professional healthcare software support, resulting in high client satisfaction. This includes assessing, documenting, and resolving fundamental client technical issues within an inbound contact center. This role informs internal and external stakeholders of the process, status, and resolution of the technical problems with frequent written and verbal communication.
  
  
Clinisys AI Philosophy
  
  
Building an AI-first organization is central to Clinisys’s purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI-enabled, cloud-based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI-enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. We must drive an AI-first sense of purpose and urgency.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Receives and responds to incoming client requests via telephone and web portal.
* Identifies, assesses criticality, and prioritizes resolution of all new and existing issues.
* Researches, manages, and documents issues and document resolutions while effectively communicating status and partnering with the client.
* Works independently to resolve basic issues while collaborating with senior resources to develop more complex skill sets
* Manages and documents resolution process and effectively communicates updates to the client.
* Manages personal backlog utilizing established case management best practices.
* Maintains high Client Satisfaction Scores.
* Stays current with product and industry updates and changes.
* Leverages approved AI-assisted resources to support troubleshooting, knowledge discovery, documentation, and customer communications while ensuring accuracy and appropriate professional judgment.
* Triage and escalate complex or risk issues to appropriate senior staff
* Continually learns and expands knowledge of Clinisys applications, environments, and systems.
* References knowledgebase articles.
* On-call/holiday rotation(s) required.
* All other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Skills**

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent interpersonal and professional communication skills
* Strong time management and organizational skills
* Ability to understand and articulate technical concepts and derive solutions
* Ability to deal with complex and challenging client issues
* Demonstrated ability to resolve complex customer issues

**Required Experience & Education**

* Associate’s degree in technology, lab sciences or healthcare related field; or two years equivalent experience
* 2-4 years’ experience with a technical aptitude in one of these areas:
* Healthcare technology
* Healthcare
* Laboratory sciences
* Technology
* Client support

**Preferred Experience & Education**

* College coursework or certification in a related field
* Prior experience providing support to customers in highly technical environments
* Technical certifications and/or training: Examples:
* SQL
* Reading, interpreting, and troubleshooting HL7 messages
* Networking
* Database Administration
* Java
* Microsoft Technologies
* Productivity tools such as word processing and spreadsheet applications
* Experience supporting enterprise operating systems
* Proficient typing skills

Supervisory Responsibilities
  
  

* None

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. real-time construction intelligence. Our hardware platform, “Observance”, uses LiDAR scanning,

thermal imaging, and AI-powered analysis to deliver BIM Models, deviation detection, and as-built

intelligence. We are committed to pushing the boundaries of technology across diverse sectors.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a proactive Senior IT Administrator to own day-to-day IT operations while building out a more mature infrastructure, identity, endpoint and security backbone as Inkers scales. You will administer Microsoft 365 and endpoint/MDM environments end to end, strengthen identity and access management, support cloud administration across AWS/Azure, and act as the go-to escalation point for complex issues. You will anticipate needs and follow vendors and renewals through to closure, while keeping the workplace infrastructure and services our teams rely on every day running smoothly.

**This is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru.**

**Responsibilities**

•Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive): licensing, mail flow, retention policies and PowerShell-driven automation.

•Manage identity and access across Active Directory, Group Policy and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): user provisioning and deprovisioning, security groups, MFA and Conditional Access.

•Administer endpoint and MDM environments (Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro or equivalent) across Windows, macOS and iOS: enrolment, compliance policies, configuration profiles and app deployment.

•Provide IT support for hardware, software, network, email and systems; set up and configure laptops, desktops, monitors, printers and other equipment.

•Install, configure and troubleshoot Windows and Linux systems.

•Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, switches, routers and other network issues; support enterprise networking (e.g. Cisco Meraki) where applicable.

•Assist with AWS/Azure cloud monitoring, administration and cost/performance optimisation.

•Maintain IT asset records, software licences and equipment inventories; maintain IT documentation, SOPs and troubleshooting records.

•Perform system updates, antivirus/EDR checks, backups and other security activities; support ISO 27001-aligned security and audit practices.

•Support CCTV, NVR, access-control and other office and site IT infrastructure.

•Own employee onboarding and offboarding from the IT side: system setup, access management, ID card and asset handover.

•Track IT issues end-to-end and ensure timely resolution; act as the Level 2/3 escalation point for IT.

•Coordinate with vendors for internet, hardware, software and other IT services; compare quotes and keep contracts, renewals and invoices in order.

•Own workplace infrastructure upkeep: schedule preventive maintenance and servicing of air-conditioning, water purification, pantry and beverage equipment, and biometric/attendance devices with the respective vendors.

•Negotiate, obtain and renew Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for IT and workplace equipment; maintain an AMC and warranty tracker with renewal dates.

•Plan and procure office equipment, consumables and everyday workplace essentials so that supplies never run short; review and shortlist service vendors (such as pantry and catering) periodically.

•Arrange employee ID cards and business cards as part of onboarding and role changes.

•Be proactive: keep a preventive-maintenance calendar, raise renewals and replacements ahead of time, and flag issues before they affect the team.

**Qualifications**

•4+ years of experience in IT Administration, IT Support or System Administration.

•Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, IT or a related field.

•Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux systems, computer hardware, networking and troubleshooting.

•Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 / Google Workspace administration.

•Working knowledge of AWS/Azure or other cloud platforms.

•Experience with MDM/endpoint management (Intune, Jamf or similar) is a strong plus.

•Exposure to information security practices and frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001) is a plus.

•Experience in vendor coordination, procurement and handling AMCs and renewals for IT and workplace equipment.

•Good communication, coordination and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple requirements.

•Willingness to travel and work at project sites when required.

**Language Requirements**

•Mandatory: fluency in English, Hindi and Kannada (spoken and written).

•Added advantage: any additional language (e.g. Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Marathi).

**Key Qualities**

Ownership, proactiveness, strong follow-up, vendor coordination, discretion with confidential information, and a service mindset.

**Work Location : HSR Layout, Bangalore (On-site : Mon-Sat)**

title: Professional, Product Support
description:
**PeopleSoft Financial Systems Production Support**
The Corporate Functions Technology Finance team is recruiting a new role to support our single Global instance of PeopleSoft 9.2 , operating across 80+ countries with annual revenue exceeding $20B
  
  
**About The Team**
The CFT Finance Global Production team is responsible for serving as a critical specialist for JLL's PeopleSoft 9.2 Financial Management platform within the IT organization. This role ensures seamless business continuity through proactive system monitoring, rapid issue resolution, and comprehensive support for critical financial processes. In addition, the role will provide technical and functional support across 3rd party applications that JLL has implemented to support our end to end financial process - activities will include Security, Configuration and onboarding new entities.
  
  
The successful candidate will maintain exceptional system reliability while serving as the primary technical liaison between IT and finance teams, delivering flawless support during month-end closes and collaborating on strategic enhancement initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Support & System Maintenance**

* Issue Resolution: Analyse and resolve complex production issues within PeopleSoft Financial Modules, performing root cause analysis and implementing permanent fixes to prevent recurrence.
* System Monitoring: Proactively monitor system performance, data integrity, and user experience to identify and address potential issues before they impact business operations.
* Incident Management: Respond to user-reported issues, prioritize based on business impact, and coordinate with technical teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Configuration Management: Review, test, and implement system configuration changes to optimize performance and meet evolving business requirements including 3rd party finance applications.
* Batch Monitoring: Monitor and validate scheduled processes for optimal performance and reliability, proactively identifying inefficiencies or failures and escalating critical issues to appropriate technical teams and business stakeholders with detailed analysis and recommended remediation steps.
* Platform Monitoring: Conduct first-level analysis of system slowdowns and failures, performing initial diagnostic assessments and root cause identification to provide comprehensive issue summaries and technical findings to escalation teams for advanced resolution.

**Business Analysis & System Enhancement**

* Requirements Gathering: Partner with finance and accounting teams to understand business needs and translate them into detailed functional specifications for system enhancements.
* Gap Analysis: Evaluate current system capabilities against business requirements, identifying solutions through configuration changes, customizations, or new functionality.
* Impact Assessment: Analyse the technical and business impact of proposed changes, ensuring compatibility with existing integrations and workflows.
* Enhancement Support: Participate in PeopleSoft enhancement initiatives, providing functional expertise during requirements, design, and testing phases.
* System Implementation Support: Contribute to rollout of new modules, features, and functionality across multiple business units and geographic regions.
* Integration Analysis: Collaborate with technical teams to analyse requirements for interfaces between PeopleSoft and external systems.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive functional specifications, system documentation, and process guides.

**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* User Acceptance Testing: Design, coordinate, and execute comprehensive UAT programs for system changes and enhancements.
* Test Planning: Develop test scenarios, test data, and validation criteria to ensure system changes meet business requirements.
* Regression Testing: Perform thorough testing to ensure new changes don't negatively impact existing functionality.
* Data Validation: Verify data accuracy and integrity following system changes or data migrations.

**User Support & Training**

* End-User Support: Provide expert-level support to business users, troubleshooting issues and providing guidance on system functionality.
* Training Development: Create training materials, user guides, and documentation to support system adoption and user proficiency.
* Knowledge Transfer: Mentor junior team members and share expertise with other IT teams supporting PeopleSoft environments.
* System Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert for PeopleSoft Financial Modules within the IT organization.

**Technical Analysis & Optimization**

* Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyse system performance metrics, identifying opportunities for optimization and efficiency improvements.
* Incident Response: Serve as first-line technical responder for user requests, system alerts, and operational issues, providing immediate analysis and resolution while collaborating with Level 2+ teams on escalated P2 and P1 incidents.
* Performance Optimization: Apply techno-functional expertise to optimize system performance and user experience, conducting comprehensive technical assessments that bridge business requirements with technical solutions and support continuous improvement initiatives.
* Data Analysis: Utilize SQL, PSQuery, and other tools to investigate data issues, perform system analysis, and support troubleshooting efforts.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline business processes through system configuration changes and automation.
* Vendor Coordination: Interface with Oracle support and third-party vendors to resolve technical issues and evaluate new functionality.

**Success Metrics & Performance Standards**

* System Reliability: 99.8% uptime, 15-minute response time for critical issues.
* Close Support: 100% on-time closes with zero system delays, 95% user satisfaction.
* Issue Resolution: 95% SLA compliance, 90% stakeholder satisfaction.
* Innovation: 30% reduction in manual effort through automation.
* Collaboration: 100% deliverable completion, 90% estimate accuracy.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3-5 years supporting PeopleSoft Financial Management 9.2 in enterprise IT environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
* Deep functional knowledge of PeopleSoft FSCM 9.2 modules with expertise in production support methodologies.
* Experience with system monitoring and incident management.
* SQL skills and PSQuery experience for rapid troubleshooting and data analysis.
* Strong understanding of financial close processes and month-end support requirements.
* Excellent communication and incident management capabilities.
* Proven ability to work under pressure during critical business periods.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PeopleSoft certifications in Financial Management.
* Experience with process automation tools and emerging technologies including GenAI applications for IT support.
* Background in predictive analytics and proactive monitoring solutions.
* Experience mentoring technical teams and leading cross-functional initiatives.
* JLL systems and process experience.

title: Software Support Engineer - Engines
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
**Esko**
is a part of Veralto’s Product Quality & Innovation companies. Esko is a global provider of integrated software and hardware solutions that accelerate the go-to-market process of packaged goods. Our products empower teams to support and manage the packaging design and print processes for brand owners, retailers, pre-media and trade shops, manufacturers, and converters.
  
  
**Veralto**

Our industry-leading companies and globally recognized brands are building on a long-established legacy of innovation and customer trust to create a safer, cleaner, more vibrant future. Veralto is headquartered in Waltham, Mass. with 13 operating companies and 300+ locations worldwide. Our global team of 16,000 associates is committed to making an enduring positive impact on the world and is united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™.
  
  
Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto (VLTO) is creating today.
  
  
**Veralto’s Product Quality & Innovation companies**
—Esko, Linx, Pantone, Videojet, and X-Rite—help package and protect the world’s food, medicine, and essentials, tracing and authenticating billions of goods that travel the global supply chain every day.
  
  
**Veralto’s Water Quality companies**
—Aquatic Informatics, ChemTreat, Hach, McCrometer, OTT HydroMet, Sea-Bird Scientific, Trojan Technologies and XOS—help manage, treat, purify, and protect the global water supply, from municipal and industrial wastewater treatment facilities to lakes, rivers, watersheds, and oceans.
  
  
**Job Summary**

**Software Support Engineer – Engines**

You will work directly with customers to resolve complex technical challenges, keep them informed throughout the resolution process, and help them continuously derive maximum value from Esko software. The role requires proactive engagement, strong technical expertise, and the ability to anticipate customer challenges while building trusted, long-term partnerships.
  
  
**Job Description**
**WITHIN YOUR ROLE, YOU WILL:**

* Provide technical support for Esko Prepress Engines solutions, assisting customers with complex technical requests and ensuring a smooth support and deployment experience.
* Keep customers informed with clear and consistent updates throughout the issue resolution process.
* Continuously learn and adapt to new technologies and industry trends to effectively support evolving customer environments.

**Issue Resolution & Ownership**

* React promptly to customer-reported issues and take ownership in driving them toward resolution.
* Proactively anticipate potential customer challenges and address them before they escalate.
* Demonstrate strong technical capability to resolve complex issues efficiently and effectively.

**Customer Relationship & Value Realisation**

* Build and maintain trusted partnerships with customers by acting as their advocate within Esko.
* Ensure customers continuously derive maximum value from Esko software solutions.
* Support customers in achieving an optimal usage experience through guidance and engagement.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work as part of a customer-centric team supporting Subject Matter Experts and enterprise customers.
* Contribute to improving support effectiveness by proactively identifying recurring issues and opportunities for long-term resolution.
* Engage with internal teams to enhance processes and ensure consistent customer experience.

**WE ARE LOOKING FOR A PROFESSIONAL WHO IS:**

* A good communicator with the ability to defuse tense customer situations.
* Empathetic towards colleagues, customers, and suppliers.
* Proactive in addressing problems and curious about preventing similar issues in the future.
* An excellent listener, able to understand customer needs and manage expectations.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
* Knowledgeable about how web applications work, through experience or qualification.
* Comfortable working in a 24/7 support environment.
* Willing to work rotational shifts and weekends as part of scheduled workdays.
* Willing to work in hybrid mode (office and work‑from‑home) based on team planning.

**SHIFT DETAILS**

* First Shift: 03:30 AM – 12:00 PM IST
* Second Shift: 12:00 PM – 09:00 PM IST
* Night Shift: 06:30 PM – 03:30 AM IST (next day)

Weekend work (Saturday and/or Sunday) may be scheduled. These will count as regular workdays, with alternate days off provided based on schedule planning by the Team Leader.
  
  
**YOUR EDUCATION AND BACKGROUND EXPERIENCE WILL INCLUDE:**

* Experience in problem solving, and a quick learner.
* Analytical mindset, with a calm, methodical approach to problem solving.
* Direct experience of handling complex technical issues with customers and/or suppliers.
* OR: 2+ years of experience in prepress for packaging, workflow administrator for prepress automation systems or Esko software (Automation Engine, Imaging Engine, PackProof, FlexRip, WebCenter.)

title: Citrix Engineer
description:
Working closely with Operations, Engineering, Product, and Infrastructure teams, the Systems Engineer 2 (IC2) will be responsible for supporting, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise Citrix infrastructure and virtual application delivery environments supporting Oracle Health customers.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with
**Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops , Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Group Policy (GPO), virtualization technologies, and networking fundamentals**
. The role requires strong troubleshooting capabilities, experience supporting production environments, and the ability to resolve standard technical issues independently while following established policies and procedures.

The position involves providing Citrix
**prod support**
for Oracle Health customer environments, ensuring system availability, operational stability, performance, and security. Key activities include incident and service request management, monitoring, system administration, troubleshooting, software updates, patching, upgrades, and customer change management.

The successful candidate will also support Oracle Applications and legacy applications, respond to application-related service requests, coordinate testing of application releases, document defects, and collaborate with IT and Development teams to resolve issues. The role may include user training, application access administration, reporting, and participation in operational meetings as required.

The candidate will contribute to root cause analysis (RCA), on-call support, automation initiatives, technical documentation, and continuous improvement activities aimed at improving service reliability and reducing operational effort.

This role requires effective communication, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, customer-focused Citrix environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Incident Management & Support – Service Request:**

* Supports the end-to-end incident management lifecycle to ensure systems are stable, secure, and performing accurately.
* May participate in incident review meetings to understand and provide some feedback for operational performance and solution implementation.
* Engages with cross-functional teams (e.g., Development, Cloud Engineering, Product Engineering, other IT teams) to support implementation and/or resolution for incidents, risks, or migrations.

**Production Support and Incident Management**

* Provide 12x7 production support for Oracle Health customer environments, ensuring system availability, reliability, and operational continuity.
* Manage incidents, service requests (SRs), and customer escalations, ensuring timely investigation, resolution, and communication.
* Participate in on-call support for critical production incidents and service restoration activities.
* Troubleshoot Citrix application delivery, virtual desktop access, user session, connectivity, and infrastructure-related issues.

**Change Management and Customer Support**

* Execute approved customer change management activities, including planned maintenance, infrastructure upgrades, and go-live support.
* Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Technical Program Managers (TPMs), and Infrastructure teams during customer-impacting activities.
* Ensure changes are implemented in accordance with established change management policies and procedures.
* Perform pre-change and post-change validation to confirm system functionality and service availability.
* Communicate maintenance progress, risks, and technical issues to relevant stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks.

**System Installation & Configuration – Software Administration:**

* Maintains operating systems to ensure effective installation and performance as instructed.
* Assists in the administration of middleware products in environments.
* Begins to support the deployment, maintenance, and operation of internal applications as needed.
* Performs regular administration and conducts basic performance trend analyses and server capacity to ensure service performance meets standards.
* Builds working knowledge of application monitoring tools to ensure efficiency.

Required Qualifications

* **3 to 5 years of related experience**
  in a medium to large distributed network and computing environment.
* Bachelor’s degree (BS) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience working with enterprise servers and systems.
* Hands-on experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD) or similar application virtualization technologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Knowledge of Windows Operating Systems
* Experience with cloud infrastructure such as OCI, AWS or Azure is an added advantage.
* Basic networking knowledge
* Able to work in a collaborative team environment.
* Experience with Windows Server patching, security vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Understanding of ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management practices.

title: Senior Workplace Engineer, Employee Technology Services
description:
**Job Description**
Thomson Reuters is looking for a Senior Workplace Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft 365, enterprise AI productivity tools, and automation. You'll work hands-on where M365, Copilot, identity, endpoint management, and AI-enabled support meet.
  
  
In this role, you'll provide third-line support and engineering for our internal Microsoft 365 and AI productivity tools. You'll be the senior escalation point for complex M365 and Copilot issues and own each incident from investigation through to a permanent fix. You'll also spot recurring support patterns and turn them into automation, self-service tools, and engineered solutions. The goal is less repetitive work, faster resolution, more reliable services, and a better experience for employees.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the senior escalation point for Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and the wider M365 admin tools.
* Handle support, configuration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management for Microsoft Copilot and other internal AI tools.
* Diagnose and fix identity, licensing, policy, and integration issues across M365 and AI services.
* Resolve complex escalations that span multiple services, working independently at the third-line level.
* Give technical guidance to L1 and L2 support teams.
* Find the root cause of recurring incidents and drive them to a permanent fix instead of handing them off.
* Keep knowledge articles, runbooks, and support documentation up to date so L1 and L2 can solve more on their own.
* Build automation with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, and similar tools to remove repetitive work and keep configurations consistent.
* Design and deliver AI-enabled support and self-service tools that reduce ticket volume and speed up resolution.
* Turn recurring incident patterns into permanent engineered fixes.
* Work across endpoint management, including Intune-managed devices and modern management, wherever it overlaps with M365 and AI tools.
* Partner with endpoint and identity teams to resolve issues that cross team boundaries.
* Support the adoption, governance, and reliability of AI productivity tools.
* Turn technical capabilities into measurable results for employees.
* Explain technical fixes clearly to non-technical users.
* Decide sensibly whether an issue needs a quick fix or a permanent engineering solution.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of IT support and engineering experience, mainly in End User Computing in a modern enterprise environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least 3 years of hands-on Microsoft 365 experience, including configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and third-line support across the core services.
* Proven hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot or similar enterprise AI productivity tools.
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102), or equivalent proven M365 expertise.
* Automation and scripting experience with PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.
* Working knowledge of endpoint management (Intune and modern management) and enterprise identity (Entra ID).
* A track record of resolving complex escalations independently and turning recurring problems into automated or engineered solutions.
* Strong written and spoken English.
* A customer-service mindset focused on the employee experience.
* Strong ownership and the ability to see issues through to closure without escalating them.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Copilot or other AI-related certifications.
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (Entra ID).
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102), or equivalent Intune expertise.
* Experience delivering AI-enabled self-service and automation in an enterprise workplace.
* Experience working across M365, endpoint, and identity services.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.
  
  
As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.
  
  
We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
WisdomAI builds AI-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
  
  
We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
  
  
**About Wisdom AI**
Wisdom AI is the generative AI data analyst for the enterprise. We help organizations turn their data warehouses into conversational interfaces. Our users expect high-precision answers from our AI, and our Technical Support team ensures that the infrastructure, data connections, and prompt logic supporting those answers are flawless.
  
  
**The Role**
As a
**Technical Support Engineer**
, you are the first responder for our most important customers. You won’t just be answering "how-to" questions; you will be debugging complex data schemas, investigating API integrations, and translating customer business logic into technical configurations.
  
  
You will live in
**Slack**
and
**Pylon**
, providing real-time, white-glove support that feels like an extension of the customer’s own team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Slack-First Support: Manage real-time customer interactions via dedicated Slack channels using Pylon. You will be responsible for triaging issues, maintaining fast response times, and ensuring no "ping" goes unanswered.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Deep-dive into the Wisdom AI platform to resolve issues related to:

+ Data Connectivity: Troubleshooting Snowflake/BigQuery permissions and connection strings.
+ Advanced Data Modeling: Helping customers refine their "Context Modeling" and domain-specific knowledge.
+ API & Integrations: Assisting with GraphQL API implementation and Slack integration setups.

* Case Management: Use Pylon to track bugs, enhancement requests, and documentation gaps. You will own the lifecycle of a ticket from initial Slack message to engineering resolution.
* Live Consultations: Hop on video calls with customers to walk through complex "How-To" scenarios, such as creating custom metrics or configuring Row Level Access Control (RLAC).
* Voice of the Customer: Aggregate common friction points and missing features to provide structured feedback to our Product and Engineering teams.
* Documentation: Contribute to the Wisdom AI Docs by turning common support resolutions into self-service guides.

**Technical Requirements**
**Stack focus:**
SQL, APIs, AI/LLMs, Pylon
  
  

* Data & SQL: Strong ability to write and read SQL. You must be able to look at a query generated by Wisdom AI and understand why it might be returning a specific result based on the customer’s schema.
* The Wisdom Stack: Proficiency in (or ability to quickly learn) the technical pillars defined in our documentation:

+ Building and managing Knowledge/Context Models.
+ Setting up Evaluations Sets and Runs to test AI accuracy.
+ Managing Workspaces, Organizations, and User Permissions.
+ Working with Deep Analysis functionality and visualization properties.

* API Familiarity: Comfortable using tools like Postman or cURL to test GraphQL endpoints.
* Tooling: Experience with modern support stacks—specifically Pylon for Slack-based support—is a significant advantage.

**Qualifications**

* The "Support Engineer" DNA: You are naturally curious and won't stop until you understand the root cause of a problem.
* Communication: You can explain a complex RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) concept to a non-technical business user without losing them.
* Agility: You thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where the product evolves weekly.
* Empathy: You understand that when a data tool isn't working, it impacts a customer's ability to do their job. You handle high-pressure situations with a calm, helpful demeanor.

**Why Join Wisdom AI?**

* Direct Impact: You are the face of the company to our customers and the eyes and ears for our engineers.
* Growth: You will gain deep expertise in the "Modern Data Stack" and the emerging field of Enterprise AI.
* Culture: Join a team of high-performers who value clear communication, technical excellence, and winning together.

**Our CRAFT**
CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
  
  
**C — Customer trust.**
Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
  
  
**R — Relentless on outcomes.**
We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
  
  
**A — Authenticity.**
We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
  
  
**F — First principles, grounded in reality.**
We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real-world results decide.
  
  
**T — Transparency.**
We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
  
  
**Equal opportunity employer**
WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.
