title: Production Support Engineer (L2, Customer-Facing)
description:
**Position Type**
Full time
  
  
**Type Of Hire**
Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
  
  
**Production Support Engineer (L2, Customer-Facing)**
Sits within a newly acquired startup building an AI-enabled, autonomous banking platform for Tier-1 financial institutions within the banking group. The Production Support Engineer diagnoses, troubleshoots, and resolves complex production and customer issues across modern banking platform environments. This is a level 2 role~ the engineer takes tickets directly from Tier-1 banks, with no first-line team in front, reproduces issues and hands them to the owning engineering team with clear evidence, and keeps the customer informed throughout. The role is hands-on and customer-facing, requiring strong investigation skills, clear communication, and the ability to connect application behavior, Kubernetes infrastructure, logs, metrics, and customer impact. The role offers an advancement path into platform engineering for those who want to grow in that direction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Troubleshooting & Incident Resolution**

* Investigate and resolve complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and platform layers
* Analyze logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to identify root causes and correlate symptoms across systems
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes and container issues, including pods, services, deployments, networking, and resources
* Reproduce issues and hand them over to the owning engineering team with logs, traces, timestamps, and steps to reproduce

**Customer-Facing Support**

* Engage directly with enterprise banking customers to understand, investigate, and resolve technical issues, including issues caused by changes on the customer's side, such as firewall or network changes, without assigning blame
* Acknowledge new issues quickly and give customers regular updates while an investigation is open, even when there is no news
* Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical customer stakeholders

**Observability & AI-Assisted Operations**

* Use tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or similar to investigate behavior
* Work with the platform's AI-driven SRE capabilities — incident insights, auto-remediation, and AI-based root cause analysis — validating findings and acting on them
* Improve runbooks, dashboards, alerts, and support processes based on recurring issues and lessons learned

**Platform Support**

* Support Kubernetes-based banking platform environments across multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), hybrid, and customer-hosted deployments
* Assist with deployment-related troubleshooting when required; deployment ownership is a plus, not a core requirement
* In quieter periods, contribute to projects alongside the platform engineering team

**Required Experience & Capabilities**
**Technical Expertise**

* 7 to 12 years of Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience across production or customer-facing technical environments — the single most important capability for this role
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes~ what pods and services are, how traffic reaches the cluster and moves between pods, and how storage works; hands-on troubleshooting with kubectl. Building or running clusters is not required
* Solid Linux troubleshooting, including processes, memory, disk space, and inodes. The platform does not run on Windows
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, APIs, services, and distributed system behavior. Networking is one of the most common causes of issues on the platform
* Basic understanding of PostgreSQL or another relational database, such as replication, primary/replica, and active-passive setups. Deep database administration is not required
* Ability to read, interpret, and correlate logs, metrics, traces, and alerts; comfortable using Grafana dashboards, running metric queries, and following traces. The engineer uses these tools and does not need to have built them

**Customer-Facing Experience (Mandatory)**

* At least one proven customer-facing technical role is required
* Experience working directly with customers during investigations, escalations, or production support scenarios

**Operating Style**

* Strong ownership mindset and bias toward resolution
* Practical, hands-on problem solver who enjoys investigation and troubleshooting
* Works as a peer within a small team
* AI-native~ integrates LLMs and AI tooling into daily investigation and support work

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS, banking platforms, fintech systems, or regulated infrastructure
* Familiarity with cloud or hybrid environments such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or on-prem enterprise deployments
* Exposure to deployment workflows, Helm, Terraform, Flux, ArgoCD, Kafka, or distributed databases
* Awareness of Kubernetes networking plugins (CNI), for example Cilium

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**
The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, working directly with customers, and bringing structure and clarity to complex technical situations. They are hands-on, calm under pressure, and comfortable moving between logs, metrics, customer context, and engineering discussions to get to root cause. This is not an SRE, DevOps, architecture, or platform engineering role, and the engineer does not build or own the infrastructure — engineers looking to architect and build systems will find a better fit in our Platform Engineer openings. For those who want to grow into platform engineering, this role offers a path there, typically over one to two years.
  
  
**IMPACT & SCOPE**

* Direct impact on customer trust, production reliability, and operational continuity for Tier-1 banking institutions
* High visibility across customer, support, engineering, platform, and product teams

**WHY JOIN**

* This role offers the opportunity to support a next-generation banking platform used by some of the world's largest financial institutions. It combines the technical complexity of Kubernetes-based infrastructure, the urgency of production support, and the customer impact of enterprise banking
* Work alongside the platform engineering team on projects, not only on tickets
* Gain hands-on exposure to multi-cloud Kubernetes and an AI-driven SRE agent that diagnoses and remediates incidents
* A clear path into platform engineering for those who want to grow in that direction

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: IT Administrator
description:
**Location:**

Bengaluru

**Experience:**

1-2 years

**About LH2 AI Labs**

LH2 AI Labs builds post-training infrastructure for frontier AI models. Our mission is to bring data that has never been used for training (the code, conversations, documents and workflows inside real institutions) into frontier AI pipelines, safely and with the trust of the people who own it. We work across verticals such as coding, computer use, agentic workflows, medical and audio, alongside a network of vetted domain experts. We’re a small team in Bengaluru, founded by second-time founders.

**About the role:**

Companies trust us with their internal code and data, and that trust starts with the basics: who has access, which devices touch company data, and how fast access is removed when someone leaves. You’ll be one of our first IT hires, and you’ll run identity, devices and SaaS for everyone at LH2, including employees, contractors and our expert network. We want someone who automates rather than clicks, and who sees a well-run laptop fleet as a security control.

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage identity for everyone at LH2: SSO, MFA, groups and roles, so access follows each person from joining to leaving.
* Enroll and manage every device that touches company data. That covers device management (MDM), disk encryption, patching, and device health checks before access is granted.
* Automate onboarding and offboarding so access is ready on day one and fully revoked within an hour of someone leaving.
* Keep an up-to-date inventory of the SaaS tools we use and who can reach what in each.
* Configure email and collaboration tools against phishing, spoofing (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and accidental oversharing.
* Set up access for contractors, vetted experts and vendors on devices we don’t own, without exposing anything else.
* Run regular access reviews and keep records an auditor would accept.
* Be the first point of contact for IT support across the team.

**You may be a good fit if you:**

* Have 1-2 years of experience in IT administration, IT engineering or a similar role.
* Have hands-on experience with an identity provider (Google Workspace, Okta, Microsoft Entra ID or similar) and an MDM tool (Jamf, Kandji, Intune or similar).
* Can script repetitive tasks in Python, Bash, PowerShell or a similar language.
* Understand the basics of networking, SSO protocols (SAML, OIDC) and endpoint security.
* Are organised and careful with documentation, and treat “how do we know it worked?” as part of the job.
* Communicate clearly with non-technical teammates.

**Nice to have**

* Experience setting up IT at a startup.
* Exposure to zero-trust or device-aware access tools.
* Familiarity with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 controls for IT.

**Representative projects**

* Make offboarding a single action: one change in the identity provider removes access from every SaaS tool, repo and device within the hour, and produces a record proving it.
* Put every laptop that touches customer data under management, and block access from any device that isn’t.
* Build a complete SaaS and access inventory, and help make “nobody gets access they don’t need” true.

**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword. It's a way of life. We're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce's own business running. We operate Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau, the data and analytics foundation for how Salesforce sells, serves, and makes decisions. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams.
  
  

* Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do.
* Make it stable. Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings.
* Run it well. Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent.
* Make it easy to get help. One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents.
* Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering.

**What it's like to join at this level:**
You'll be a trusted operator on a team that is rebuilding how it works. You already know how to run production; here you'll take the hardest recurring problems, own them to root cause, and turn what you learn into runbooks, monitors, and automation the whole team uses. You'll manage escalations and support processes with guidance from senior leads, and you'll help the analysts around you get better.
  
  
**Who thrives here:**
You're curious, you want to know why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You can explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people, and you leave every system a little better documented and a little more automated than you found it.
  
  
What Are We Looking For?
  
  
As a Senior Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you'll independently own production support and administration for Salesforce's enterprise data and analytics platforms, with a strong grasp of native platform functionality and best practices. You'll help the team respond faster and resolve issues sooner, and you'll keep an eye on how satisfied our customers and partners are. You'll manage escalations across teams and time zones, act as a frontline responder who swarms incidents and knows when to pull in reliability engineers, own root-cause analysis through to resolution, and design monitoring that gives early warning. You'll shape lightweight support processes and reference material, and mentor analysts. You are an individual contributor and a go-to expert for your platform area.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Escalation Management & Incident Response
  
  

* Own escalations on cases, intake, and investigations across teams and time zones: set priority, route to the right engineering, SRE, or vendor owner, drive them to closure, and keep stakeholders informed.
* Run follow-the-sun handoffs so escalations keep moving between Mexico City, Dublin, and Hyderabad without losing context.
* Track escalation trends (volume, repeat causes, time to engage, time to resolve), and bring them to leads and platform engineering to drive fixes.
* Be the escalation point for Tier-2 analysts on complex cases and investigations.
* Be a frontline responder in incidents: connect first, assess impact, and use judgment on when to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs). Manage the case, intake, and stakeholder communication workstream alongside Incident Command. SREs own incident resolution.
* Meet individual and team lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART), and case satisfaction (CSAT) targets while keeping backlog health. You are measured against the same targets as the team.
* Help L7 refine the intake and investigation lifecycle SLAs: mentor Systems Analysts on hitting them, and raise challenges where targets, routing, or processes make them hard to meet.
* Spot patterns in SLA misses and satisfaction feedback, and bring recommended fixes to the L7 and the team.

Problem Management & RCA Ownership
  
  

* Own root-cause analysis and resolution for application bugs and recurring failures, and close RCAs with verified fixes.
* Troubleshoot complex declarative and low-code issues, and recommend code-level fixes to engineering partners.
* Prioritize technical debt against the backlog to improve stability, and recommend fixes.

Reliability & Observability
  
  

* Design and implement proactive monitors, alerts, and automations for platform health.
* Contribute to design reviews and operating-model improvements (for example Operational Readiness practices).
* Use automation and AI to reduce manual work and move the team toward self-healing operations.

Platform Administration & Enhancement
  
  

* Deliver complex declarative solutions (Flows, validation rules, permission models) and manage enhancement projects from inception through support transition.
* Own complex access and role-hierarchy design, bulk data loads and migrations, and sandbox management.
* Reliably handle standard administration so the team can focus on higher-value work.

Process Engineering, SOPs & Support Reference Manuals
  
  

* Own process engineering for your platform area: templates, process design, capture, and lifecycle (create, review, update, retire) of lightweight SOPs and Support Reference Manuals (SRMs). This is process design, not technical writing.
* Request SRM inputs from Platform Engineering and create or manage them as needed, so support teams have the reference material they need before launch.
* Keep SOPs and SRMs current and findable, and use them to reduce repeat escalations.
* Write knowledge articles and business process maps that let Tier-1/Tier-2 teams resolve issues without escalation.
* Act as SME and point of contact for development and product partners.

Security, SOX & Compliance
  
  

* Maintain compliance with security policies and change controls.
* Support technology compliance activities, audit reporting, and SOX controls, and help close findings.
* Follow the SDLC (Agile) and change, deployment, incident, and problem management processes.

Collaboration & Growth
  
  

* Partner effectively with vendors, engineers, and business teams across time zones.
* Mentor Systems Analysts and new joiners, and share knowledge through documentation and team forums.
* Try new tools and practices, and bring ideas that improve how the team works.

Flexibility
  
  

* On-call and travel as required, subject to local regulations. Other related duties as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, business, or equivalent experience.
* 0-3 years of hands-on platform or systems support, administration, or implementation experience in an enterprise IT environment.
* Strong knowledge of Salesforce native functionality and best practices.
* Demonstrated ability to manage escalations across teams and time zones, respond as a frontline responder in incidents (including knowing when to pull in reliability engineers), and own RCAs through resolution.
* Experience with declarative tools (Flow, validation rules), data loading, and troubleshooting complex data and configuration issues.
* Working knowledge of Service Management practices (incident, problem, change) and the SDLC.
* Ability to design lightweight processes, SOPs, and reference manuals that others can run.
* Strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to work independently in a distributed, global team.
* Certifications (achieved): Salesforce Administrator (ADM-201), Advanced Administrator (ADM-211), and Platform App Builder. Platform Developer I achieved or actively pursuing.

**Preferred**

* Certifications: Data 360, Tableau, or other specialist or consultant certifications.
* Hands-on experience with Data 360, Agentforce, CRM Analytics, or Tableau.
* Experience building monitors, alerts, or automation (observability tooling, Flow, scripting).
* Intermediate coding (Apex, Python, SQL).
* Experience in SOX-controlled environments.
* Experience mentoring or informally leading peers.

title: Staff Technical Enablement Consultant
description:

The Staff Technical Enablement Consultant serves as the technical bridge between product architecture, instructional design, and field readiness, partnering deeply across Professional Services, Technical Success Managers, and Customer Support. **What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience building/operating lab infrastructure and automation (e.g., environment provisioning, tenant resets, repeatable lab reliability) in partnership with Lab Infra/DevOps
* Experience with AI-assisted curriculum workflows (creating “AI-ready” canonical source content, validating AI-generated learning modules, governance to prevent drift/hallucinations)

title: AM-Client IT FIX Onboarding Protocol - Exchange listed derivatives
description:
Job Title: Client IT FIX Onboarding
  
  
Department: ISPL, GM IT
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
The Global Markets business of BNP Paribas helps its corporate and institutional clients leverage capital markets across the globe for their financing, risk management and investment needs. This encompasses a wide range of financial products ranging from Foreign exchange to complex Equity Derivatives that are traded in financial markets across the globe 24/7. IT systems are integral to the business and are a key part of the value proposition to clients. These IT systems range from industry standard products for standard process automation to internally developed, often, market leading IT applications. The IT teams owning these IT systems are made up of functions that include Technical and Application production support, Business Analysis & Project Management, Development & Maintenance and Quality Control. BNP Paribas India Solutions is an equal partner in these IT functions along with colleagues in other locations including Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Singapore & Hong Kong. This partnership ranges from sharing the IT workload, executing global strategy to owning global applications offshore. The technology and engineering landscape is wide, encompassing almost all techniques and platforms. It continues to evolve and transform with the market with the business continuing to invest in it.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
Join BNP Paribas’ Derivatives FIX Connectivity team – the frontline IT group that on‑boards clients to electronic trading via the FIX protocol across all futures, options and spread products. You will lead end‑to‑end onboarding, from requirement gathering to go‑live certification, and provide Level‑2 production support for our global trading platform. Not limited to trading flow but allocation, clearing, EFRP and dropcopies flows as well.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* - The person will prepare, supervise, coordinate and implement client connectivity with clients or vendor teams.
* - The role requires to build strong relationship with client's IT and infrastructure teams and to liaise closely with various BNPP teams, on IT (infrastructure/production anc development) and business side (Client Service and Sales teams).
* - The objective of the team is to minimize the delay between the time a client is notified by our
* sales to be commercially ready to do business with BNPP and the time the client has been technically provided with the ability to execute orders through BNP platform.
* - The FIX onboarding team is expected to be an extended team, in this case, this role is expected to independently manage the onboarding responsibilities for one of the regions.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* - Liaise with sales‑trading, vendors, clients and internal tech teams to capture requirements and design FIX solutions.
* - Develop, test and implement Java‑based FIX flow changes, client‑specific rules, and new product configurations.
* - Manage the full certification cycle for new clients and for additional offerings.
* - Deliver Level‑2 support, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate hand‑over with the Level‑1 FIX support team.
* - Contribute expertise on FIX‑related inquiries, network connectivity, and TCP/IP/VPN aspects.
* - Implement AI changes to support current workflow.
* - Design the target setup ensuring the functionality is available in BNP platform.
* - For new requirements, coordinate with Dev team to ensure correct implementation of new feature.
* - Participate in calls with clients to arbitrate issues related to onboarding.

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  
Functional
  
  

* - Strong knowledge of Derivative (Futures/Options/Spreads) Execution products lifecycle.
* - Should have good understanding of trade life cycle and different flows – Low Touch and High touch.
* - Deep knowledge of the FIX protocol is mandatory, FIX certification, and testing procedures.
* - Familiarity with AI‑driven implementation tools.
* - Strong UNIX/Linux skills; Java scripting experience preferred.
* - Project‑management capability in a distributed, multi‑stakeholder environment.
* - Excellent communication, analytical and problem‑solving abilities.
* - Strong knowledge on any OMS/EMSX.
* - Strong knowledge of market specific behavior and complexities EMEA/US/APAC markets.
* - Knowledge of networking (firewalls, VPN), databases, and version‑control/release management systems.

**Additional Requirements**

* Flexible to work in any region according to the regional requirements.
* SDLC and Process
* Sound knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) activities.
* - Capability for documentation of Requirement/Functional specifications.
* - Ability to create test scenarios and test cases.
* - Ability to review and ensure completeness of test scenarios.

**Specific Qualifications**

* - 6-10 years of experience along with Bachelor's Degree - in management, finance, science, economics, related field or equivalent experience.
* - Proven experience as a FIX onboarding engineer with a solid track record of client electronic‑trading implementations.

**Technical Skills**
Skills Referential (Required knowledge, skills and abilities)
  
  

* - Claude or AI knowledge will be good.
* - Java Script (good to have), Programming or scripting proficiency.
* - FIX Protocol (Mandatory)
* - Network

Behavioural Skills
  
  

* - Ability to collaborate / Teamwork
* - Attention to detail / rigor
* - Decision Making
* - Communication skills – oral & written

Transversal Skills
  
  

* - Analytical Ability
* - Ability to manage a project
* - Ability to develop and adapt a process
* - Ability to anticipate business / AI evolution
* - Ability to develop and leverage networks

Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
Experience Level
  
  

* - Minimum 6-10 Years of experience in FIX protocol client onboarding.
* - Minimum 6-10 years of experience in electronic and algo trading.
* - Engineering, computer‑science or equivalent academic background.

Location: Bengaluru
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. title: Staff Technical Enablement Consultant
description:

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. **Role**
We are looking for a Staff Technical Enablement Consultant to join our team. This is a Hybrid role in Bangalore, reporting to the Manager, CS Enablement in the CS Enablement department. The Staff Technical Enablement Consultant serves as the technical bridge between product architecture, instructional design, and field readiness, partnering deeply across Professional Services, Technical Success Managers, and Customer Support. This position accelerates time-to-autonomy by reproducing real customer architectures and edge-case issues in lab environments, converting that specialized work into scalable enablement assets and targeted technical coaching.

* Produce authoritative, structured technical source collateral for AI-assisted content generation and perform strict quality assurance to ensure technical accuracy and prevent content drift
* Deliver targeted, high-impact enablement interventions such as topic bootcamps, weekly office hours, and ad-hoc architecture whiteboard deep dives focused on complex topics and new releases

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable building the path as you walk it, viewing a dynamic environment as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You are a dedicated problem-solver who seeks out challenges and is energized by finding solutions, knowing that solving the hardest problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a continuous learner with a true growth mindset who actively seeks feedback to develop yourself into a better partner and a stronger teammate.
* You are a pragmatic builder obsessed with creating, iterating, and shipping, willing to roll up your sleeves to balance technical excellence with rapid value delivery.
* You champion simplicity and are highly skilled at distilling complex problems, user needs, and technical concepts into clear, actionable plans and precise communication.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

* Strong foundation in enterprise networking/security concepts and the ability to whiteboard and explain end-to-end flows (e.g., packet flow, policy processing order, hybrid connectivity, IdP/SCIM concepts)
* Demonstrated cross-functional partnering skills (PS, TSMs, Support, Enablement/LXD, Lab Infra/DevOps) and ability to intake/prioritize requests based on impact and urgency
* Strong communication and facilitation skills across modalities (written self-paced content + live clinics/office hours), with a bias toward improving field autonomy

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience building/operating lab infrastructure and automation (e.g., environment provisioning, tenant resets, repeatable lab reliability) in partnership with Lab Infra/DevOps
* Experience with AI-assisted curriculum workflows (creating “AI-ready” canonical source content, validating AI-generated learning modules, governance to prevent drift/hallucinations)
* Track record of keeping enablement content current in fast-release SaaS environments (e.g., bi-weekly/monthly releases), and/or relevant industry certifications/upskilling momentum

In this high-impact role, you will redefine the cloud-native storage experience by bridging deep technical expertise with direct customer engagement. You will serve as a technical expert across all deployment phases, partnering closely with customer engineers, account teams, and core R&D to solve complex cloud-native architecture challenges.

* Outstanding cross-functional communication and technical consultation skills, with a track record of effectively managing customer escalations and translating technical challenges into actionable engineering solutions.

We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

title: IT Service Desk Technician
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and customer-focused IT Service Desk Technician to join our team. This position will be responsible for providing remote technical support and assistance to end-users across the organization. They will play a crucial role in resolving IT-related issues remotely, ensuring the smooth operation of systems, and delivering exceptional customer service. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a remote support environment.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Provide remote technical support and assistance to end-users, addressing basic software and account related issues like password troubleshooting, bitlocker recovery, and o365 tools.
* Respond to incoming support requests via various channels (phone, email, chat), ensuring timely and accurate resolution that align with SLAs and KPIs.
* Troubleshoot and diagnose technical issues reported by end-users, utilizing remote tools and diagnostic techniques.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to appropriate support teams or senior analysts for further investigation and resolution.
* Follow standard operating procedures to assist with IT account provisioning and deprovisioning. Maintain thorough and accurate records of support interactions, actions taken, and resolutions provided.
* Provide clear and concise instructions to end-users regarding system usage, troubleshooting steps, and preventive measures.
* Contribute to the knowledge base by creating and updating support articles, guides, and FAQs.
* Stay updated with the organization's IT policies, procedures, and technologies to ensure accurate and effective support delivery.

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in an IT Service Desk or Technical Support role, preferably in a remote support environment.
* Strong knowledge of IT fundamentals, including hardware, operating systems (MAC, Windows 10, 11), networking, and productivity software such as PDF software, Office 365.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting common desktop, laptop, and mobile device issues.
* Familiarity with remote support tools and technologies.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to communicate technical information effectively to non-technical users.
* Customer-centric approach with a passion for delivering exceptional customer service.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to multi-task and quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with IT Service Management practices (eg. Incident/problem/change management, etc.) using enterprise ticketing systems and tools.
* Willingness to work in different shifts to provide 24/7 support, if required.

**Qualification**
-----------------

* *Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).*

**About ATS**
-------------

ATS is an industry-leading automation solutions provider to many of the world’s most successful companies. ATS uses its extensive knowledge base and global capabilities in custom automation, repeat automation, automation products and value-added services, including pre-automation and after-sales services, to address the sophisticated manufacturing automation systems and service needs of multinational customers in markets such as life sciences, food & beverage, transportation, consumer products, and energy. Founded in 1978, ATS employs over 6,000 people at more than 50 manufacturing facilities and over 75 offices in North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, South Asia, and China. The Company’s shares are traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the symbol ATS.

description:

-------------

You will work closely with functional teams to deliver high-quality ABAP developments, integrations, forms, and enhancements while ensuring optimal system performance and alignment with business requirements. You will also contribute to S/4HANA transformation initiatives using modern ABAP technologies.

  

### **What will you do:**

* Design, develop, and maintain custom SAP ABAP applications including reports, ALV reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms.
* Develop and support technical objects using BAPI, RFC, BDC, IDoc, BADI, User Exits, and Enhancement Framework.
* Build and maintain interfaces for seamless integration between SAP and external systems.
* Develop and enhance SmartForms, Adobe Forms, and SAP Scripts based on business requirements.
* Create and maintain Data Dictionary objects including tables, views, domains, data elements, and indexes.
* Perform complex debugging, root cause analysis, and defect resolution for custom and standard SAP applications.
* Optimize application performance using SQL tuning, runtime analysis, and ABAP performance best practices.
* Develop and support modern ABAP solutions using CDS Views, OData Services, and S/4HANA technologies.
* Collaborate with functional consultants across FI, MM, SD, HR, and other SAP modules to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Manage transport requests, technical documentation, code reviews, and deployment activities throughout the development lifecycle.
Support testing activities, production issue resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

### **Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Experience:**

* Strong hands-on experience in SAP ABAP development across multiple SAP modules.
* Expertise in Reports, ALV Reports, Interfaces, Enhancements, SmartForms, Adobe Forms, and SAP Scripts.
* Experience with BDC, BAPI, RFC, IDoc, BADI, User Exits, and Enhancement Framework development.
* Strong knowledge of SAP Data Dictionary objects including Tables, Views, Domains, Data Elements, and Indexes.
* Proficiency in ABAP debugging, performance tuning, SQL optimization, and runtime analysis.
* Experience integrating SAP with external systems through IDocs, RFCs, and BAPIs.
* Hands-on experience with SAP transport management and technical documentation.
* Strong understanding of SAP development lifecycle, testing, and production support processes.
* Ability to work closely with functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.  

  

### **Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise:**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA development and modernization projects.
* Hands-on expertise in CDS Views, OData Services, and SAP Fiori application development.
* Exposure to ABAP on HANA concepts and performance optimization techniques.
* Experience working on large-scale SAP implementations, upgrades, or AMS support engagements.
* Knowledge of SAP Workflow, Web Services, and integration technologies.
* Familiarity with SAP BTP development and extension capabilities.
* Experience with code quality reviews, technical governance, and development best practices.
* SAP ABAP and/or SAP S/4HANA Technical certifications are preferred.
Strong communication skills and ability to work within global delivery teams.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

The role supports a remote and operationally important location, requiring strong independence, responsiveness, and coordination with Digital Operations as well as Infrastructure & Operations teams.
  
  
The position serves as the primary local IT support presence and works closely with global IT teams to resolve incidents, fulfill service requests, maintain device readiness, and support day to day business operations. This is an individual contributor role requiring strong technical troubleshooting, sound judgement and a customer focused approach.
  
  
**The Role**
***As a Deskside Support Technician I with Worley,***
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  
**End User Support**

* Provide in person support for desktops, laptops, monitors, peripherals, printers and mobile devices.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, device and access related issues for local users.
* Support new hire onboarding, workstation setup, user moves, and day to day break/fix activities.
* Deliver timely user updates and ensure support activities are properly documented and managed through our approved ITSM processes.

**Workplace Technology & Site Support**

* Support conference room and collaboration technology, including basic meeting room troubleshooting and readiness checks.

**Device Lifecycle & Logistics**

**Operational Support & Continuous Improvement**

* Demonstrate commitment to health, safety and compliance requirements applicable to the office or site environment.
* Follow company processes for security, asset management, access, and technology handling.
* Complete all required site or office inductions and work in accordance with local HSE expectations.

**Physical Demand/Work Environment**
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to speak or listen. The employee frequently is required to walk and sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform all required Job Description tasks in a safe manner. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Work is usually done in an office setting and sometimes at a client facility or job site.
  
  
This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents.
  
  
**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Experience in deskside, desktop, field, or end user support within a business environment.
* Strong hands on troubleshooting skills across Windows endpoints, standard business applications, peripherals and user access issues.
* Experience providing in person support to end users, including onboarding, break/fix, and workplace technology support.
* Familiarity with IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow.
* Ability to work independently with limited supervision and manage multiple priorities.
* Strong communication skills and a customer focused approach to support delivery.
* Experience supporting conference room, meeting room, or collaboration technologies.
* Experience supporting mobile devices, including iOS and Android.
* Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination.
* Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: L2/L3 Application Support Engineer - Power BI
description:
Job Location: Cebu City, Chennai, Pune, Taguig City, Taguig City
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 13423
  
  
Posting Start Date: 11/6/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
  
  

* Position purpose

Provide second- and third-level support for the Power BI service and Power BI Report Builder estate, covering operational, fleet, procurement, compliance, payroll and customer-facing reporting. The engineer keeps reports and semantic models available and current, resolves refresh, gateway and data issues, administers workspaces and security, and delivers report enhancements through change control.
  
  

* Key accountabilities

Incident management and service restoration
  
  

* Own assigned ServiceNow incidents through resolution: refresh failures, gateway and credential failures, expired certificates, broken data sources and report errors.
* Distinguish user navigation issues from data and model defects, and publish shift-left knowledge articles for common issues such as filters, bookmarks and access so the Service Desk can resolve them.
* Trace data defects to source (data warehouse, ADF pipelines, SharePoint lists, other sources) and coordinate fixes with the owning engineer.

Monitoring and operational health
  
  

* Monitor scheduled refreshes, gateway health and capacity daily. Act on failures before business use.
* Maintain the gateway, credential and certificate expiry register, and renew before expiry.
* Make sure datasets, gateways and data sources are owned by service accounts, not named individuals.

Administration and service requests
  
  

* Administer workspaces, apps, deployment pipelines, Premium/Fabric capacity settings, row-level security and sharing within delegated authority.
* Fulfil authorised report access requests, preferring AD/Entra group-based and self-service models with an audit trail.
* Support reports embedded in portals and intranet pages, including customer-facing reporting.

Change, release and enhancement
  
  

* Design, build, test and deploy minor enhancements to reports, semantic models (DAX, Power Query) and paginated reports through change control.
* Support business-requested measures and visuals while keeping metric definitions agreed with business owners.
* Take delivered reporting from projects into BAU with documentation and ownership transfer.

Problem management and knowledge
  
  

* Raise problem records for recurring refresh and data issues, and drive permanent fixes.
* Maintain the report catalogue (owner, source, refresh, RLS model), metric definitions, runbooks and knowledge articles. Keep PBIX and RDL source under version control.
* Participate in knowledge transfer from the incumbent provider, demonstrate independent handling of common support scenarios, and transfer knowledge to new team members.

Security and compliance
  
  

* Use privileged and production access only through the approved access process (e.g. CyberArk), on a least-privilege basis and for authorised tasks.
* Never record passwords, tokens or other secrets in tickets, email or documents. Store and hand over credentials only through the approved vault.
* Handle customer, employee and payroll personal information in line with the Privacy Act and Cleanaway data classification, including compliant incident records and escalation of potential data breaches.
* Maintain segregation of duties: perform data corrections, approvals and production changes only with documented business or change approval, and keep an audit trail.
* Role boundaries

L2/L3 accountability
  
  

* Own Power BI incidents, refresh and gateway operations, workspace and security administration, and minor report and model enhancements.
* Retain ServiceNow ownership while upstream data engineers fix source issues.

Outside delegated authority
  
  

* Upstream data pipeline and data warehouse fixes, owned by the data warehouse and ADF/Databricks engineers.
* Business ownership of metric definitions, KPI targets and report audience decisions.
* Tenant-wide Power BI/Fabric governance and licensing decisions owned by the platform owner.
* Skills and experience

**Essential**

* Demonstrated enterprise production support and development experience with the Power BI service: datasets and semantic models, DAX, Power Query, on-premises data gateways, scheduled refresh and row-level security.
* Power BI Report Builder (paginated reports) and SQL skills against SQL Server and SSAS sources.
* Workspace, app and capacity administration and access management with Entra ID groups.
* ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change and request practice using ServiceNow or equivalent.
* Clear communication with business report owners and executives.

Desirable
  
  

* SSRS and SSAS (tabular) experience. Microsoft Fabric.
* Embedding Power BI in SharePoint or external portals. Power Platform awareness.
* Fleet, procurement or compliance reporting domain experience.
* PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer), ITIL 4 Foundation.
* Key relationships

**Business report owners (operations, fleet, procurement, finance, safety):**
Requirements, metric definitions, access approval and validation
  
  
**Data warehouse and ADF/Databricks engineers:**
Upstream data issues and model dependencies
  
  
**SharePoint & Power Platform engineers:**
Embedded reports and SharePoint list data sources
  
  
**Service Desk / L1:**
Intake, initial triage, shift-left knowledge articles and incident escalation
  
  
**Technical Platform Owner / Principal Analyst:**
Platform priorities, risks, technical governance and acceptance
  
  
**Change and release management:**
CAB approval, controlled releases and production validation
  
  
**Infrastructure, DBA and Cyber Security teams:**
Servers, databases, privileged access, certificates and security approvals
  
  

* Performance measures
* Incident response and resolution against agreed service levels and business-critical processing windows.
* Completion and effectiveness of proactive monitoring, exception detection and recovery.
* Service request timeliness and first-time-right fulfilment.
* Changes delivered successfully through change control, without unplanned outage or rollback.
* Reduction in repeat incidents through problem records, root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
* Accuracy and currency of runbooks, knowledge articles, ServiceNow resolution notes and operational documentation.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and timely communication during incidents and changes.
* Refresh success rate. No outages caused by expired gateway credentials or certificates.
* Share of simple report issues resolved at L1 through shift-left knowledge articles.
* Transition readiness (by 21 December 2026)

Independence criteria Fujitsu must demonstrate before taking over from the incumbent provider. Remove this section after transition acceptance.
  
  

* Resolve at least two refresh, gateway or credential failures unaided.
* Deliver at least one report or model enhancement end to end through change control before the Christmas change freeze.
* Ownership of datasets, gateways and data sources transferred from incumbent named accounts. Gateway, credential and certificate expiry register handed over.
* Report catalogue and a knowledge article for each request type in place. Two monthly reporting cycles delivered on time.
* Incident SLAs met for four consecutive weeks.
* Working arrangements and cross-cover

Provide coverage of Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT) through agreed shift patterns, including the Australian morning window. Participate in a rostered on-call arrangement outside business hours, including weekends, for incidents and business-critical processing windows (e.g. morning operational reporting and month-end), and in planned after-hours changes and maintenance. All operational activities must follow approved procedures, access controls, Cleanaway change governance and delegated authority.
  
  
**Cross-cover:**
Primary cover is provided by the data warehouse engineer, who must be able to handle refresh, gateway and access tasks from runbooks. The Power BI engineer provides secondary cover for SSRS reporting. Power BI support has historically depended on a single engineer, so a trained backup is mandatory.
  
  
Relocation Supported: No
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Staff Cloud Services Engineer
description:
**Job Title – Staff Cloud Service Engineer III (Microsoft 365 Email Security & SMTP)**
**Role Overview**

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Email Security & Microsoft 365 Messaging Engineer to own engineering, operation and continuous improvement of enterprise email platform, mail flow and email security services across a global estate. This is a hands-on technical role for a professional who can take ownership of complex incidents and engineering work, not an entry-level or developmental position.

  
  

The successful candidate will manage, evolve, support Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Purview, Cisco secure email gateways, SMTP relay services Public DNS configuration and hygiene adhering to industry standards. They will work with security, identity, network and application teams, and with suppliers, to keep email secure, deliverable, compliant and reliable.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

  
* Manage the configuration of Cisco secure email gateways, including inbound and outbound routing, policies, quarantine and encryption.
  
  
* Design, manage and troubleshoot Exchange Online services, including transport rules, connectors, accepted and remote domains, mailbox and distribution group settings, and migrations.
  
  
* Design, configure and optimize Microsoft Defender for Office 365 policies, including anti-spam, anti-phishing with impersonation protection, anti-malware, Safe Links, Safe Attachments and pre-set security policies.
  
  
* Own email authentication for all company domains: SPF, DKIM, DMARC
  
  
* Design and support SMTP relay and application email services
  
  
* Onboard and govern applications, devices (such as multifunction printers and scanners) and SaaS platforms that send email on behalf of company domains, making sure they are authenticated, approved and documented.
  
  
* Investigate and remediate phishing, business email compromise, spoofing and malware campaigns with the Security Operations team, using Threat Explorer, message trace, Advanced Hunting and automated investigation and response.
  
  
* Monitor mail flow health, deliverability, queue and reputation issues, using Exchange Admin Centre, Defender portal, message trace, Microsoft 365 Service Health and gateway reporting.
  
  
* Support Microsoft Purview controls that apply to email: data loss prevention, sensitivity labels, message encryption, retention, eDiscovery and journaling.
  
  
* Use ServiceNow and Jira to manage incidents, requests, problems, changes and project activities in line with operational processes.
  
  
* Create and maintain designs, runbooks, mail flow diagrams, standards, domain and sender inventories, and knowledge articles.
  
  
* Provide clear technical guidance and knowledge transfer to service desk teams, application owners and other engineers.
  

  

**Role Scope & Technical Ownership**

  
  

This is an experienced engineering role responsible for independently handling complex work, making sound operational decisions and contributing to the technical direction of messaging and email security. It includes broad technical ownership across:

  

  
* SMTP relay services for applications, devices and third-party platforms.
  
  
* Exchange Online, and mail flow architecture, including routing through secure email gateways.
  
  
* Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and the wider email threat protection stack.
  
  
* Domain and sender governance: SPF, DKIM, DMARC enforcement and the inventory of approved senders.
  
  
* Email-related identity and access controls, including Conditional Access, modern authentication and the removal of legacy protocols.
  
  
* Email data protection and compliance with Microsoft Purview.
  
  
* Technical leadership during email incidents, including deciding when to block, quarantine, reroute, roll back a change, escalate or engage a specialist.
  
  
* Global service delivery, Incident, Change and Problem Management, root-cause analysis and preventative actions.
  
  
* Automation with PowerShell (Exchange Online, Microsoft Graph), Power Automate and Logic Apps to improve operations and reporting.
  
  
* Mentoring less-experienced engineers and service desk teams.
  

  

**Skills & Experience**
**Exchange Online & Messaging**

  

  
* Hands-on professional experience engineering and supporting Exchange Online in a large enterprise.
  
  
* Strong knowledge of mail flow: connectors, transport rules, accepted domains, centralized mail transport, and routing through third-party gateways.
  
  
* Experience with mailbox types, shared and resource mailboxes, distribution and Microsoft 365 groups, permissions and migrations.
  
  
* Confident use of message trace, Exchange Admin Centre, Microsoft 365 Service Health and Microsoft support escalation.
  

  

**Email Security**

  

  
* Practical experience configuring and tuning Microsoft Defender for Office 365
  
  
* Experience administering secure email gateway
  
  
* Detailed understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, MTA-STS and TLS, and experience moving domains to DMARC enforcement.
  
  
* Experience investigating phishing, spoofing and business email compromise with Security Operations teams.
  
  
* Working knowledge of email encryption, data loss prevention and sensitivity labels in Microsoft Purview.
  

  

**SMTP & Application Email**

  

  
* Deep understanding of SMTP: the protocol, headers, response codes, TLS negotiation, MX and DNS records, and bounce (NDR) analysis.
  
  
* Experience designing and supporting SMTP relay for applications and devices, including authenticated submission, connector-based relay and third-party relay services.
  
  
* Experience planning and delivering the retirement of Basic Authentication and legacy SMTP AUTH.
  
  
* Ability to diagnose deliverability problems blocklists, IP and domain reputation, throttling, and recipient-side rejections.
  

  

**Identity, Automation & Operations**

  

  
* Working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, modern authentication and licensing as they apply to messaging.
  
  
* Strong PowerShell skills (Exchange Online module, Microsoft Graph); experience with Power Automate or Logic Apps is desirable.
  
  
* Working understanding of DNS, firewalls, proxies and TLS certificates.
  
  
* Strong systematic troubleshooting: restore service first, then complete root-cause analysis.
  
  
* Experience managing incidents and changes through ServiceNow or a comparable IT service management platform.
  

  

**Communication & Customer Support**

  

  
* Ability to explain technical issues clearly to the audience and give concise, actionable updates.
  
  
* Comfortable working under time pressure, for example during an active phishing campaign, while keeping sound judgement.
  
  
* Professional written and spoken English suitable for global engineering, security and business teams.
  

  

**Personal Attributes**

  

  
* Accountable: owns technical issues from first diagnosis through restoration, escalation and closure.
  
  
* Security-minded: balances protection against deliverability and user experience, and document why each decision was made.
  
  
* Calm, methodical and decisive during live incidents such as phishing campaigns or mail flow outages.
  
  
* Curious and committed to keeping up with changes in Microsoft 365, email standards and the threat landscape.
  
  
* Confident making recommendations, and comfortable admitting knowledge gaps and bringing in specialists.
  
  
* Collaborative and non-territorial, working well with security, identity, network and application teams.
  
  
* Organized and detail-oriented, with a commitment to documentation, standards, change control and knowledge transfer.
  
  
* Respectful and constructively challenging, able to push back on risky sender or relay requests without undermining colleagues.
  
  
* Comfortable working independently while staying connected to a globally distributed team.
  

  

**Desired Overall Candidate Profile**

  
  

The ideal candidate is a strong messaging engineer who understands email end to end from SMTP and DNS on the wire, through Exchange Online and the security stack, to the people and applications that depend on it. They are neither only an Exchange administrator nor only a security analyst.

  
  

They do not need expert knowledge of every product. More important is the breadth to understand how mail flow, security controls, identity and DNS interact, to isolate the likely fault quickly, and to engage the right specialists when needed.

  
  

Hands-on Exchange Online and email security experience, strong SMTP troubleshooting, calm decision-making, clear communication and the ability to work at an experienced engineering level within a collaborative global team are essential.

  
  

**Desirable Qualifications & Vendor Experience**

  

  
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Messaging Administrator Associate, or equivalent experience.
  
  
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) or Information Protection Administrator Associate (SC-400).
  
  
* Vendor training or certification from Proofpoint, Mimecast, Egress or a similar email security provider.
  
  
* Experience with DMARC reporting platforms.
  
  
* Experience in a large enterprise with many domains, business units or acquired companies.
  
  
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions or divestments: domain migration, coexistence and mail routing during transition.
  
  
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management knowledge.
  

  

**Who we are:**

  
  

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

title: AV Design & Collaboration Engineer
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Genesys is looking for a motivated AV Engineer to design, deliver and look after audio visual and collaboration technology across our EMEA and APAC offices. You will work on office builds and refurbishments, meeting rooms, event spaces, audio visual broadcast, desk and room booking, desktop technology and digital signage, and you will support our internal All Hands events.
* These projects change how our colleagues work. Getting the technology right improves productivity, drives office adoption and makes hybrid working work well. You will be our level four (L4) AV escalation point. Our Global Service Desk (L1 to L2) and our on-site End User Services desk-side teams (L2 to L3) handle day-to-day support, and you step in for the complex, recurring and design-related issues. Part of the role is site-based at our key location, working alongside the on-site team.
* You will also look after our Zoom and Microsoft Teams platforms, and you will use automation and AI to move our AV estate from reactive support to proactive, self-monitoring operations. You do not need to be an expert in all of this on day one. We want someone with strong AV foundations who is eager to build these skills with us.

**What You Will Do**
**Design and delivery**

* Attend design workshops to capture requirements, and shape designs for office technology deployments. Act as technical lead on small and medium projects and a key contributor on larger ones.
* Prepare bills of materials, obtain supplier quotes, and work with Project Managers and Facilities to keep budgets, timelines and expectations on track. Track changes and variations against the agreed scope and cost.
* Produce system descriptions, block wiring diagrams, rack elevations, cable schedules and as-built drawings using AutoCAD, working from architectural drawings and specifications.
* Carry out site surveys to make sure designs work in practice.
* Support projects through build, installation, configuration and commissioning of audio, video and control systems, and keep commissioning documentation, AV/IT schedules and site notes accurate.
* Research and recommend technology options, and stay current through trade publications, vendor roadmaps and training.
* Align with our US counterpart so design standards are consistent globally.

**Escalation, support enablement and events**

* Act as the L4 escalation point for AV and videoconferencing. Take complex faults from the Global Service Desk and the desk-side teams, find the root cause, arrange repairs, and escalate to manufacturers and chase to resolution, remotely and on site.
* Spot recurring issues and fix them at source through problem management, design changes, standards or automation, so fewer faults reach L4.
* Enable L1 to L3: write runbooks, knowledge articles and troubleshooting guides, and train the Service Desk and desk-side teams, so they can resolve more AV issues first time.
* Manage AV refreshes across EMEA and APAC sites.
* Support and run internal All Hands events, including planning with IT, Facilities and Events teams.
* Train end users so systems are used well, and share knowledge with colleagues across IT.

**Zoom and Microsoft Teams: administration and integrations**

* Changes to these tools reach every colleague, so we make them thoughtfully, not reactively. You will take responsibility for day-to-day administration of both consoles and deliver integrations, with guidance from senior colleagues on larger changes. You will:
* Gather user needs through conversations, feedback and support trends, so new features and integrations solve real problems.
* Partner with Legal, Security and Privacy teams to understand what a feature can and should not do before it is switched on, including recording, transcription, data retention and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Plan releases carefully, with testing, pilot groups, phased rollouts and a clear rollback approach, and build a communication plan for each change.
* Monitor usage, quality and support tickets after release, and adapt settings, guidance and integrations based on what you find.
* Write clear documentation: admin runbooks, configuration standards, user guides and release notes.
* Follow Zoom and Microsoft roadmaps and assess what is worth adopting, and what to hold back on.

**Automation, data and proactive support**

* We want to find problems before our colleagues do. You will:
* Automate repeatable work using APIs, scripts and integrations (for example PowerShell, Python, Microsoft Graph and the Zoom and Teams APIs) to reduce manual effort and human error.
* Use device and platform management tools, such as Teams Rooms Pro Management and Zoom device management, along with call quality and usage data, to monitor room health and spot trends. Connect alerts to our ticketing so faults are logged automatically and routed to the right team, with the diagnostic detail they need.
* Help define simple health measures for our rooms, such as availability, time to resolve, and the share of faults we catch before a user reports them.
* Keep scripts, configurations and standards under version control, with review and testing, so nothing depends on one person.
* Work with Security, IT and Network teams on least-privilege access, safe handling of credentials and keys, and firmware and patch management.

**Working with AI**

* We expect a practical, AI-first mindset. AI is part of how we design, build, support and document, and it is a growing part of the platforms we run. That means:

**How We Work Day To Day**

* Using approved AI tools to speed up documentation, troubleshooting, research, reporting, bills of materials and cable schedules, and always checking the output carefully before it is used. You are accountable for the result, not the tool.
* Using AI coding assistants to write, explain and improve scripts and integrations. You review and test everything the AI produces, understand what it does before it runs, and manage it in version control like any other code.
* Using AI to turn what we learn from escalations into clear, searchable guidance, so the Service Desk and desk-side teams can resolve more AV issues without escalating.
* Looking for chances to automate: if you do something repeatedly, you ask whether a script, an integration or an AI-assisted workflow could do it.
* Following our responsible AI rules: no confidential, personal or customer data in unapproved tools, and no secrets or credentials in prompts or code.

**AI in our platforms and rooms**

* Assess AI-enabled features in Zoom, Microsoft Teams and room devices, such as meeting summaries and agents, intelligent cameras and framing, room analytics and automated monitoring, and recommend where they fit and where they do not.
* Work with Legal, Security and Privacy on what these features capture and store, including consent, retention, transparency and the regulatory position in each region (for example the EU AI Act and data protection law, and works council requirements where they apply).
* Pilot new AI capabilities with small groups first, measure the result, and share what works and what does not.
* Help colleagues and the wider team build good, responsible AI habits.

**The mindset**

* We want someone curious and creative who naturally looks for ways to move the AV team forward. Bring ideas, test them sensibly, be honest about what did not work, and share what you learn. Good judgement about when to trust automation, and when to check it, matters more than any single tool.

**What We Are Looking For**

* You do not need to tick every box. Typical experience includes:
* Around 4 to 5 years in AV system design, integration or enterprise AV support.
* A good grasp of project phases from concept through design development, construction and commissioning, and working knowledge of architectural drawings and specifications.
* Hands-on experience with some of: Zoom Rooms, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Surface Hub, Crestron, Polycom, Evoko, Lenovo ThinkSmart Manager, Scala and VuWall, or similar.
* Training or certification in at least one DSP platform (Biamp, QSC, ClearOne or similar) and one control system (Crestron, Extron, AMX or similar).
* A solid grounding in AV-over-IP and networking: TCP/IP, VLANs, QoS, PoE, and how audio and video traffic behaves on the network.
* Some experience scripting or automating tasks (PowerShell, Python or similar), or a clear track record of teaching yourself new tools. We will help you build from there.
* Experience, or real interest, in using AI tools to work faster and better, with good judgement about checking the output.
* Good cost awareness and the ability to work within agreed budgets.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with experience handling escalated faults and working with service desk and on-site support teams.
* Clear, concise communication and a professional, courteous approach with colleagues and suppliers.
* Good time management, self-motivation and attention to detail.

**Helpful But Not Required**

* CTS, Zoom, Microsoft Teams or similar certifications.
* Experience with ServiceNow or Jira, or with monitoring and dashboard tools.
* Experience with Git, REST APIs or building small integrations.
* Event, webinar or live-streaming production experience.

**Growth**

* This role is designed to grow towards senior AV design and platform responsibilities. We will support you with training and certification, time to experiment, and exposure to larger projects, as you build your design, automation and AI skills.
* Travel as required.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
