title: Jira Administrator
description:
**Jira Administrator**

**Chennai, India**

An established and rapidly growing global technology business is looking for an experienced Jira Administrator to take ownership of its Jira Cloud environment.

The organisation operates within the Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) and cybersecurity space, supporting customers across more than 100 countries. Its technology portfolio spans multiple operating systems and devices, with continued expansion into areas including Extended Detection and Response (XDR), Identity and Access Management (IdP), and Digital Employee Experience (DEX).

With a strong focus on product development and continuous innovation, the business releases more than 100 new features each year.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Jira Administrator to play a key role in improving internal systems, supporting technical teams and ensuring the Jira environment continues to evolve alongside the business.

**The Role**

You will take responsibility for the administration, configuration and ongoing development of the company's Jira Cloud platform. Working closely with Engineering, Product and Project Management teams, you'll ensure the platform effectively supports business processes, project delivery and operational requirements.

A key part of the position will involve ongoing optimisation following a recent migration, identifying opportunities to improve existing configurations, resolve issues and enhance the overall user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of the day-to-day administration, maintenance and support of the Jira environment.
* Configure and customise Jira Cloud to meet business and operational requirements, including:
* Workflows and workflow schemes.
* Custom fields, permission schemes and issue types.
* Automation rules and notification schemes.
* Boards, dashboards, filters and project templates.
* Work alongside Engineering, Product and Project Management stakeholders to understand their requirements and implement appropriate Jira solutions.
* Manage post-migration improvements, configuration changes and technical troubleshooting.
* Support integrations between Jira, Confluence and relevant third-party marketplace applications.
* Oversee user management, access permissions, roles and platform governance, ensuring best practices are maintained.
* Review Jira data, reporting and existing configurations, carrying out regular housekeeping and optimisation activities.
* Ensure the platform operates in line with relevant security requirements, compliance controls and internal processes.
* Provide guidance, training and supporting documentation to help internal teams get the most from Jira.

**Skills & Experience Required**

* At least 4 years' hands-on experience working as a Jira Administrator.
* Strong practical knowledge of Jira Cloud, including administration, configuration, customisation and automation.
* Previous experience supporting Agile and DevOps environments, with a good understanding of Scrum and Kanban methodologies.
* Experience providing post-migration Jira support, including troubleshooting and platform enhancements.
* Familiarity with integrations involving Confluence, Bitbucket and similar development or collaboration tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the confidence to identify and implement improvements.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across different technical and business teams.
* Able to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver solutions within a fast-paced working environment.

title: Analyst 4 - Billing Operations & Solutions
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Access Control Analyst supports enterprise access provisioning across billing, customer care, and operational platforms to help ensure employees and business partners have accurate, timely, and appropriate system access. The role supports access requests, provisioning workflows, approvals, exception management, operational controls, and compliance requirements while partnering across business and technology teams to deliver consistent and reliable access experience. As a lead professional-professional 4, this role operates with a high degree of independence in a complex, high-volume environment and exercises judgment in matters of significance. The role provides subject-matter expertise, leads projects and improvement initiatives, and identifies opportunities to strengthen controls, improve automation, reduce provisioning fallout, and enhance the access experience.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Supports enterprise control-access provisioning for billing, customer care, commerce, PII, and other operational platforms.
* Analyzes complex access requests, business requirements, approval standards, and system dependencies to determine the appropriate provisioning action.
* Supports joiner, mover, and leaver processes by validating that system access aligns with an employee’s job status, job code, organizational assignment, and approved access configuration.
* Reviews automated provisioning outcomes and investigates records that require manual processing or exception handling.
* Analyzes job-code, location, division, and business information to support accurate provisioning within the appropriate system environment.
* Validates access assignments against approved role-based, job-code-based, or standards.
* Review access requests for completeness and confirm that required manager, business, security, or secondary approvals are in place before provisioning.
* Investigate provisioning fallout, incomplete requests, access discrepancies, and other exceptions; determine contributing conditions and coordinates resolution with the appropriate partners.
* Identifies recurring provisioning exceptions and recommends configuration, process, documentation, training, or automation improvements.
* Applies established access-control requirements and approval standards when reviewing and fulfilling control-access requests.
* Supports access-review, audit, control-testing, and compliance activities by providing complete, accurate, and timely documentation or evidence.
* Helps ensure that sensitive and PII-related access is provisioned only after required approvals and validations have been completed.
* Identifies potential control gaps, processing risks, and inconsistent access conditions and escalates concerns through the appropriate channels.
* Maintains accurate records of access requests, approvals, provisioning decisions, exceptions, and remediation activities.
* Monitors request volumes, case activity, aging, service-level performance, and other operational measures across supported tools and work queues.
* Analyzes missed service levels, processing trends, and recurring issues to identify contributing factors and recommend corrective actions.
* Develops and maintains operational reporting that provides visibility into workload, performance, exceptions, and emerging risks.
* Uses Excel and other reporting or analytical tools to reconcile data, identify trends, validate results, and support operational and leadership decisions.
* Documents business rules, access requirements, provisioning logic, operational procedures, and exception-handling requirements.
* Translates business and control requirements into actionable workflow requirements, provisioning configurations, and process improvements.
* Evaluates the potential impact of access-policy, job-code, system, workflow, or configuration changes on related processes and supported users.
* Supports testing and business validation for access-management enhancements, system changes, and automated provisioning improvements.
* Creates clearly defined success measures for new or revised processes and establishes plans to monitor performance and results.
* Serves as a liaison among business partners, system owners, security teams, technology teams, audit partners, and access-management teams.
* Communicates access requirements, request status, exceptions, risks, and resolution plans clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Facilitates cross-functional alignment on access standards, operating procedures, escalation paths, service expectations, and process improvements.
* Leads assigned projects or workstreams with limited guidance and provided directions to other team members as needed.
* Exercises independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Maintains regular, consistent, and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights, weekends, variable schedules, and overtime as business needs require.
* Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting identity and access management, control-access provisioning, system administration, business operations, or a comparable operational function.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex requests, business rules, approval requirements, operational procedures, and system dependencies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate exceptions, identify contributing factors, and recommend sustainable solutions.
* Proficiency with Excel and experience using data to perform reconciliations, identify trends, measure performance, and support decisions.
* Experience managing work against established service levels, operating procedures, approval standards, and internal controls.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to maintain accuracy while working in a high-volume operational environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex requirements to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across business, security, technology, audit, and operational teams.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and independently resolve complex operational issues.
* Experience documenting business requirements, process flows, decision logic, operating procedures, or control requirements.
* Experience supporting CSG/ACSR or comparable billing and customer-management platforms.
* Familiarity with Einstein360, XOE, Celestial, NOW, CRM, or related customer care and operational tools.
* Experience working with enterprise access-request or provisioning platforms, including MyComcastAccess or Tech Spot.
* Familiarity with automated provisioning, role-based access, job-code configurations, and joiner, mover, and leaver processes.
* Experience investigating provisioning fallout, manual exceptions, or access discrepancies.
* Experience supporting audit requests, access reviews, sensitive-data access, or PII-related controls.
* Experience monitoring operational metrics, service-level performance, request volumes, case aging, or exception trends.
* Experience identifying automation opportunities and improving provisioning workflows, business rules, or operating procedures.
* Experience leading projects or cross-functional process-improvement initiatives.

**Employees at all levels are expected to**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience - think and act in ways that put our customers first.
* Know your stuff - be enthusiastic learners, users, and advocates of our game-changing technology, products, and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team - make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System, a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company - by joining huddles, making callbacks, and helping elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Respect and promote inclusion - do what’s right for each other, our customers, investors, and our communities.

**Comcast Competencies: Professional Level**

* Alignment & Quality Execution: Priorities aligned to goals, be accountable, use data to make decisions, and optimize processes and resources
* Win as One: Embrace change & adapt, communicate openly, keep safety top of mind, be respectful/inclusive/curious, and exhibit a companywide sales culture
* Customer First Mindset: Put customers at the center of our decisions, execute first time right, understand customer needs, and turn insights into actions
* Advance with Tech: Embrace AI tools for innovation/automation, apply critical thinking, and use analytical judgment to think differently, fail fast

**Disclaimer:**
This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.
  
  
Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

Bachelor's Degree

title: L2/L3 Application Support Engineer - Informatica IDMC & OMS
description:
Job Location: Cebu City, Chennai, Pune, Taguig City, Taguig City
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 13430
  
  
Posting Start Date: 11/6/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
  
  

* Position purpose

Provide second- and third-level support for the Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) integration platform and the OMS operational data store. These underpin municipal and commercial collection services, resident-facing booking portals and council integrations. The engineer owns incidents end to end, monitors daily integration processing, reconciles job and work-order data across ERP, fleet, OMS and council systems, and delivers minor changes and council onboardings through Cleanaway change control.
  
  

* Key accountabilities

Incident management and service restoration
  
  

* Own assigned ServiceNow incidents from acceptance through resolution, including impact assessment, stakeholder updates and accurate resolution notes.
* Diagnose and resolve failed taskflows and mappings, Secure Agent and connection failures, SFTP and API errors, file and payload format errors, and authentication failures.
* Restore resident-facing portals and dependent services during outages, including database blocking, log growth and hosting VM issues, coordinating with Infrastructure and DBA teams.
* Reprocess or resend council, ERP and partner files and messages using documented, authorised procedures.
* Lead or support major incident response, service restoration and post-incident review for integration outages.

Monitoring and operational health
  
  

* Perform daily monitoring of IDMC jobs, the Application Integration console, infrastructure alerts (e.g. PRTG) and exception mailboxes. Triage, action and record exceptions.
* Follow up daily operational exception reports, such as jobs completed without mandatory driver data or vehicles not assigned, so that invoicing and council reporting stay accurate.
* Validate integrations after monthly ERP (JDE) and IDMC patching and after platform upgrades, including impact analysis before upgrades.

Integration operations and data reconciliation
  
  

* Investigate missing, delayed, duplicated or inconsistent records across JDE, fleet and job-dispatch systems (e.g. Verizon Connect, Echo), OMS and council systems.
* Reconcile work-order and job status across systems after outages or sync gaps. Close or correct records under business approval and confirm closure status to councils.
* Investigate data flows from HR, safety and compliance systems into downstream staging and reporting, and correct staging data on authorised request.
* Produce scheduled and ad hoc extracts and operational KPI reports (e.g. monthly integration performance and booking extracts) on time.

Service requests and configuration
  
  

* Fulfil authorised OMS configuration and data requests: service frequency codes, booking limits and entitlements, portal calendars and seasonal opening, exception-report maintenance and status resends.
* Run calendar-driven operations such as annual entitlement resets, month-end finance file loads and monthly credential rotations for messaging services.
* Manage user and service access within IDMC and OMS in line with security approvals and audit requirements.

Platform administration
  
  

* Administer the IDMC org, Secure Agent hosts, connections and runtime environments, including authentication modernisation and licence and subscription coordination with Informatica.

Change, release and enhancement
  
  

* Design, build, test and deploy minor changes and enhancements to IDMC assets and OMS objects, including new council onboardings and integration changes (SFTP, REST/SOAP, OAuth).
* Prepare change records, test evidence, deployment and rollback plans for CAB. Execute production deployments and cutover tasks.
* Take delivered project components (e.g. fleet-system migration and HR-system replacement integrations) into BAU through hypercare and documented handover.

Problem management and knowledge
  
  

* Raise and progress problem records for recurring failures such as portal outages, sync gaps and high-volume manual corrections, and propose permanent fixes or automation.
* Maintain runbooks, interface documentation, a business-rules register, knowledge articles and the credential and certificate expiry register.
* Maintain the contact and escalation matrix for councils, ERP and fleet vendors, Informatica support and internal business teams.
* Participate in knowledge transfer from the incumbent provider, demonstrate independent handling of common support scenarios, and transfer knowledge to new team members.

Security and compliance
  
  

* Use privileged and production access only through the approved access process (e.g. CyberArk), on a least-privilege basis and for authorised tasks.
* Never record passwords, tokens or other secrets in tickets, email or documents. Store and hand over credentials only through the approved vault.
* Handle customer, employee and payroll personal information in line with the Privacy Act and Cleanaway data classification, including compliant incident records and escalation of potential data breaches.
* Maintain segregation of duties: perform data corrections, approvals and production changes only with documented business or change approval, and keep an audit trail.
* Role boundaries

L2/L3 accountability
  
  

* Own operational investigation, incident coordination, monitoring, documented recovery, reconciliation and minor change delivery for IDMC and OMS.
* Retain ServiceNow ownership and stakeholder communication when a vendor, Infrastructure or DBA team performs specialist remediation.

Outside delegated authority
  
  

* Solution architecture and major redesign, such as OMS or Informatica replacement and new digital-channel platforms. The engineer contributes but does not lead.
* Business decisions on council contracts, entitlement rules, service pricing, master-data ownership or approval of data corrections.
* Server, operating system, database backup and patching operations owned by Infrastructure and DBA teams.
* Skills and experience

**Essential**

* Demonstrated enterprise production support and development experience with Informatica IDMC/IICS: taskflows, mappings, Secure Agent, connections and Application Integration.
* Strong SQL Server and T-SQL skills for diagnosis, reconciliation and data correction in an operational data store.
* Experience with file and API integrations: SFTP, REST/SOAP, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0 and API testing tools (e.g. Postman, SoapUI).
* ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change and request practice using ServiceNow or equivalent.
* Clear written and verbal communication with business operations, councils, vendors and IT teams, including during time-critical incidents.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience with ERP (JD Edwards) and fleet telematics or job-dispatch integrations.
* Waste, municipal services, logistics or field operations domain experience.
* Azure Application Insights, infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g. PRTG) and Windows server troubleshooting.
* Informatica Cloud Data Integration certification, ITIL 4 Foundation, AZ-900.
* Band expectations

**Senior / Lead:**
Technical escalation point for the platform. Leads major incident recovery, council onboarding design and change, platform administration and upgrades, problem management and vendor escalation. Reviews and approves runbooks.
  
  
**Mid:**
Daily monitoring, exception follow-up, service requests and OMS configuration, reconciliation under runbook, standard reprocessing, and changes under senior review.
  
  

* Key relationships

**OMS business support and operational teams:**
Issue validation, business impact, data-correction approval and recovery confirmation
  
  
**Councils and partner organisations:**
Council integrations, file and API contracts, firewall and connectivity testing
  
  
**ERP, fleet and SaaS vendors (e.g. DXC for JDE, Verizon Connect, Informatica):**
Vendor escalation, platform cases and coordinated fixes
  
  
**Service Desk / L1:**
Intake, initial triage, shift-left knowledge articles and incident escalation
  
  
**Technical Platform Owner / Principal Analyst:**
Platform priorities, risks, technical governance and acceptance
  
  
**Change and release management:**
CAB approval, controlled releases and production validation
  
  
**Infrastructure, DBA and Cyber Security teams:**
Servers, databases, privileged access, certificates and security approvals
  
  

* Performance measures
* Incident response and resolution against agreed service levels and business-critical processing windows.
* Completion and effectiveness of proactive monitoring, exception detection and recovery.
* Service request timeliness and first-time-right fulfilment.
* Changes delivered successfully through change control, without unplanned outage or rollback.
* Reduction in repeat incidents through problem records, root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
* Accuracy and currency of runbooks, knowledge articles, ServiceNow resolution notes and operational documentation.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and timely communication during incidents and changes.
* Timeliness of calendar-driven operations: month-end, monthly reports and annual entitlement resets.
* Transition readiness (by 21 December 2026)

Independence criteria Fujitsu must demonstrate before taking over from the incumbent provider. Remove this section after transition acceptance.
  
  

* Restore at least one real or simulated portal outage and at least two integration failures without incumbent assistance.
* Deliver at least one council integration change end to end through change control before the Christmas change freeze.
* Reconciliation runbook signed off by the OMS business support team.
* Daily monitoring checklists written. Alert and exception distribution lists repointed to Fujitsu groups.
* A knowledge article for each service request type, with at least 90% first-time-right fulfilment.
* Two monthly reporting cycles delivered on time. Problem records with RCA drafted for recurring failures.
* Incident SLAs met for four consecutive weeks.
* Working arrangements and cross-cover

Provide coverage of Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT) through agreed shift patterns, including the Australian morning window. Participate in a rostered on-call arrangement outside business hours, including weekends, for incidents and business-critical processing windows (e.g. portal outages, council file deadlines, month-end and annual entitlement resets), and in planned after-hours changes and maintenance. All operational activities must follow approved procedures, access controls, Cleanaway change governance and delegated authority.
  
  
**Cross-cover:**
Senior and mid engineers provide mutual primary and secondary cover across all IDMC and OMS services. Secondary cover with Azure Integration Services for shared Application Insights diagnosis and integration triage.
  
  
Relocation Supported: No
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Applications Support Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
The Applications Support Analyst (C10) is an intermediate-level individual contributor responsible for managing production and continuity of business (COB) deployments, release execution, day-to-day technical support, and operational maintenance across enterprise application suites. Applies standard technical and operational procedures to execute automated and manual releases (via tools such as Harness and uDeploy/IBM UrbanCode Deploy), validate Change Tasks (CTASKs), and troubleshoot production issues in a timely manner. Works collaboratively within a 24x7 operational support model, executing routine health checks, participating in Release on Demand (ROD) cycles, conducting incident triage, and escalating complex issues appropriately. Strong release management fundamentals, analytical capabilities, and communication skills are required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Release Management & CTASK Execution: Executes and owns production and COB release implementations against scheduled Change Tasks (CTASKs), ensuring strict adherence to enterprise Change Management governance, approval gates, and deployment windows.
* Deployment Automation & Tooling: Drives both Release on Demand (ROD) and planned/manual deployments utilizing continuous delivery and orchestration tools such as Harness, uDeploy (IBM UrbanCode Deploy), Bitbucket/Git, and associated CI/CD pipeline frameworks.
* Environment & Post-Deployment Validation: Coordinates and executes comprehensive pre-deployment health verifications, rollback procedures when necessary, and post-implementation checkouts across Production (PROD) and Continuity of Business (COB) disaster recovery environments.
* Operational Shift Support: Operates as a technical support practitioner within a 24x7 rotational shift environment, ensuring continuous system availability and structured shift handovers.
* Incident & Problem Resolution: Triages, investigates, and troubleshoots incoming application incidents and user queries, adhering to established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and escalating severe issues promptly.
* Monitoring & Health Checks: Executes start-of-day checks, intra-day health monitoring, and system checkout procedures to proactively identify performance degradations, data discrepancies, or infrastructure failures.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Serves as a primary liaison between business users, Release Management, Application Development (AD), and Infrastructure teams during deployment windows and incident resolution.
* Runbook & SOP Maintenance: Maintains, updates, and executes standard operating procedures (SOPs), deployment runbooks, and batch schedule configurations to ensure consistent operational execution.
* Problem Management & RCA: Participates in root cause analysis (RCA) investigations following production incidents or release failures to identify preventative controls and improve deployment reliability.
* Continuous Improvement: Identifies opportunities to streamline release workflows, eliminate manual deployment steps, and automate repetitive operational tasks.
* Risk & Control Compliance: Appropriately assesses risk when business decisions and operational actions are taken, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct, and business practices, and transparently escalating, managing, and reporting control and operational risk issues.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: 4–6 years of relevant experience in Application Support, Production Support, or Environment/Release Operations within financial services or enterprise technology domains.
* Release & Deployment Expertise: Proven hands-on experience executing CTASKs, managing release cycles (scheduled and Release on Demand / ROD), and deploying artifacts across PROD and COB/DR environments.
* Deployment & CI/CD Tools: Working proficiency with enterprise deployment and orchestration tools such as Harness, uDeploy (IBM UrbanCode Deploy), Jenkins, Tekton, Git/Bitbucket, and Artifactory.
* Change & Incident Management: Solid understanding of ITIL frameworks, specifically Change Management (ServiceNow CTASK lifecycle, standard/normal/emergency changes), Incident Management, and Problem Management.
* Monitoring & Observability: Hands-on experience with real-time monitoring and observability tools such as ITRS Geneos, Splunk, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, or equivalent enterprise monitoring platforms.
* Technical Competencies: Strong foundational knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems, shell scripting, SQL/relational database queries, and enterprise job scheduling tools (e.g., Autosys, Control-M).
* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to provide structured deployment updates and incident summaries to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Shift & On-Call Flexibility: Willingness and flexibility to work in a 24x7 rotational shift pattern, including scheduled weekend/overnight release windows and COB testing exercises.

**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

title: Production Support Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
Citi's Securities Services division is seeking a Senior Production Support Analyst to join the Data & Client Platforms (DCP) Production Support team — a globally distributed, 24×6 function supporting business-critical and client-facing data and reporting platforms across Investor & Issuer Services.
  
  
This is a senior operational role that sits at the intersection of data platform operations, client service delivery, and technology transformation. The DCP PS team supports an expanding portfolio of platforms serving some of the world's largest institutional investors, across multiple geographies and business lines within Investor & Issuer Services.
  
  
The team is actively investing in engineering capability, automation, and AI-assisted operations — making this an opportunity for candidates who want to grow beyond traditional incident management into a forward-looking, engineering-oriented production support function.
  
  
**What You Will Be Working On**
The DCP platform underpins Citi's data distribution, client reporting, and operational data services across Securities Services. You will be supporting a portfolio of proprietary and industry-standard platforms spanning:
  
  

* Client data and reporting platforms — real-time and end-of-day data delivery, client reporting, and operational oversight tools
* Data lake and cloud-native platforms — next-generation cloud data infrastructure built on modern technologies including Snowflake, Apache Kafka, Couchbase, Amazon S3, and DataBricks
* Client-facing digital experience — platforms delivering data, reporting, and instructions to institutional clients via Citi's digital channels
* Entitlements and data access management — infrastructure governing client and user access to data services

The platform is undergoing significant transformation — including migration of applications to modernised digital platforms, consolidation of data services across business lines, and adoption of cloud-native data lake architectures. You will be directly involved in supporting this evolution.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Operations**

* Provide L2 production support across the DCP application portfolio — incident triage, investigation, escalation, and resolution — operating within a global follow-the-sun support model
* Perform start-of-day checks, continuous platform monitoring, and structured regional handovers to ensure seamless 24×6 coverage
* Manage and resolve user and client-reported incidents via ServiceNow, maintaining SLA adherence and clear communication throughout the incident lifecycle

**Client Service & Communication**

* Act as the internal operational point of contact for client-impacting incidents — providing timely, accurate, and professional communication to client-facing teams including Client Services, Technology Relationship Managers, and Operations
* Proactively identify and escalate data quality and service availability issues — contributing to a detect-first operating model that reduces client-reported incidents
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of a centralised service level inventory — ensuring Citi's commitments to institutional clients are tracked, governed, and met

**Platform Stability & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and drive resolution of recurring incident patterns through structured problem management — reducing manual toil and preventing reoccurrence
* Develop and maintain technical runbooks, support documentation, and operational procedures across the platform portfolio
* Contribute to automation and observability initiatives — using tools including Grafana, ITRS, and GCO — to reduce manual effort and improve platform monitoring coverage
* Participate in change management activities including release preparation, deployment support, post-implementation review, and production risk assessments

**Engineering & AI Enablement**

* Actively engage with and adopt AI-assisted tooling for incident troubleshooting, automated investigation, and resiliency gap detection — aligned to Citi's firm-wide AI-driven production management strategy
* Contribute to operational readiness for new platform migrations and onboarding — ensuring production support capability keeps pace with technology evolution
* Partner with development and platform engineering teams to influence upstream design decisions that improve production operability and resilience

**Transformation & Programme Delivery**

* Participate in continuous improvement workstream items spanning automation efficiency, monitoring uplift, resiliency, and application onboarding
* Support DCP's expansion as the central data services hub across Investor & Issuer Services
* Contribute to business continuity planning, contingency testing, and resiliency exercises across the platform portfolio

title: L2/L3 Application Support Engineer - Azure Data Factory & Databricks
description:
Job Location: Cebu City, Chennai, Pune, Taguig City, Taguig City
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 13421
  
  
Posting Start Date: 11/6/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  

* Position purpose

Provide second- and third-level support for Cleanaway's Azure batch data integration platform. This covers Azure Data Factory pipelines, Azure Databricks notebooks, self-hosted integration runtimes, pipeline Function Apps and supporting Azure services. Together these move HR, identity, procurement, finance, fuel and operational data between enterprise systems. The engineer resolves pipeline incidents, monitors scheduled processing, administers the platform and delivers enhancements, including completing remaining SSIS-to-ADF migrations through change control.
  
  

* Key accountabilities

Incident management and service restoration
  
  

* Own assigned ServiceNow incidents through resolution: pipeline and notebook failures, missing or duplicate data, authentication and API failures, and integration-runtime outages.
* Diagnose failures using ADF monitoring, Databricks job runs, Spark logs and source and target data. Rerun, backfill or deduplicate under documented procedures.
* Prioritise feeds with downstream business impact, such as identity lifecycle (joiner/leaver), procurement and accounts payable, finance claims and executive reporting.

Monitoring and operational health
  
  

* Monitor scheduled ADF triggers, Databricks jobs and integration runtime health daily. Action alerts and failures before business deadlines.
* Disable and re-enable dependent pipelines around planned source-system outages (e.g. ERP maintenance windows) and validate catch-up processing.
* Build and tune Azure Monitor alerts so that failures are detected proactively rather than reported by users.

Integration and data support
  
  

* Investigate data issues across connected systems such as JDE, Coupa, Fieldglass, Dayforce, Preceda, PageUp, identity governance (SailPoint), fuel card providers and the data warehouse.
* Validate source and target data before attributing faults. Coordinate with SaaS vendors and internal application teams on API and file contract changes.
* Fulfil authorised data adjustment and file reprocessing requests with audit evidence.

Platform administration
  
  

* Administer linked services, Key Vault secrets, managed identities and service principals, integration runtime servers and DSNs within delegated Azure RBAC.
* Maintain Azure DevOps repositories and CI/CD pipelines (ARM, DACPAC), environment promotion and branching for the platform.
* Maintain the credential, secret and certificate expiry register, and rotate credentials before expiry.

Change, release and enhancement
  
  

* Design, build, test and deploy enhancements to pipelines, notebooks (PySpark/SQL) and Function Apps through Azure DevOps and Cleanaway change control.
* Complete remaining SSIS-to-ADF migrations as planned enhancements, working with the data warehouse engineer: parallel running, reconciliation and decommissioning.
* Take delivered project integrations into BAU through hypercare and documented handover, and manage the integration backlog with owner and status for each item.

Problem management and knowledge
  
  

* Raise problem records for recurring pipeline failures and dual-running risks, and drive permanent fixes.
* Maintain interface definition documents, runbooks, pipeline inventories and knowledge articles in the agreed repository.
* Participate in knowledge transfer from the incumbent provider, demonstrate independent handling of common support scenarios, and transfer knowledge to new team members.

Security and compliance
  
  

* Use privileged and production access only through the approved access process (e.g. CyberArk), on a least-privilege basis and for authorised tasks.
* Never record passwords, tokens or other secrets in tickets, email or documents. Store and hand over credentials only through the approved vault.
* Handle customer, employee and payroll personal information in line with the Privacy Act and Cleanaway data classification, including compliant incident records and escalation of potential data breaches.
* Maintain segregation of duties: perform data corrections, approvals and production changes only with documented business or change approval, and keep an audit trail.
* Role boundaries

L2/L3 accountability
  
  

* Own monitoring, incident resolution, platform administration and enhancement delivery for ADF, Databricks and associated batch integration components.
* Own Function Apps and Logic Apps that run as steps within batch pipelines. Event-driven and API-based Logic Apps and Function Apps belong to the Azure Integration Services engineer.
* Retain ServiceNow ownership while vendors or application teams remediate source or target system faults.

Outside delegated authority
  
  

* Azure landing-zone, network and subscription architecture, and platform design decisions owned by Cloud and Architecture teams.
* Business decisions on data ownership, mapping rules and corrections in source systems.
* Leadership of new integration programmes. The engineer contributes delivery effort under change control.
* Skills and experience

**Essential**

* Demonstrated enterprise production support and development experience with Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks (PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake).
* Self-hosted integration runtimes, linked services, Key Vault, managed identities and Azure RBAC.
* Azure DevOps CI/CD for data platforms (ARM templates, DACPAC, YAML pipelines).
* Strong SQL skills and experience with REST API and file-based integrations with SaaS platforms.
* ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change and request practice using ServiceNow or equivalent.

Desirable
  
  

* SSIS knowledge for migration and legacy analysis. Azure Function Apps and Logic Apps.
* HR, identity governance, procurement or ERP (JD Edwards) integration experience.
* Microsoft Fabric exposure.
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate, DP-700 (or the retired DP-203), AZ-104, AZ-400, ITIL 4 Foundation.
* Key relationships

**HR, identity, procurement and finance system owners:**
Feed validation, business impact and data-correction approval
  
  
**SaaS and data vendors (e.g. Coupa, Fieldglass, fuel card providers):**
API and file contract changes, authentication and vendor escalation
  
  
**Data warehouse, Power BI and Azure Integration engineers:**
Shared dependencies, migration and cross-platform triage
  
  
**Service Desk / L1:**
Intake, initial triage, shift-left knowledge articles and incident escalation
  
  
**Technical Platform Owner / Principal Analyst:**
Platform priorities, risks, technical governance and acceptance
  
  
**Change and release management:**
CAB approval, controlled releases and production validation
  
  
**Infrastructure, DBA and Cyber Security teams:**
Servers, databases, privileged access, certificates and security approvals
  
  

* Performance measures
* Incident response and resolution against agreed service levels and business-critical processing windows.
* Completion and effectiveness of proactive monitoring, exception detection and recovery.
* Service request timeliness and first-time-right fulfilment.
* Changes delivered successfully through change control, without unplanned outage or rollback.
* Reduction in repeat incidents through problem records, root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
* Accuracy and currency of runbooks, knowledge articles, ServiceNow resolution notes and operational documentation.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and timely communication during incidents and changes.
* Migration backlog progressed with recorded owner, status and decommissioning of retired SSIS packages.
* Transition readiness (by 21 December 2026)

Independence criteria Fujitsu must demonstrate before taking over from the incumbent provider. Remove this section after transition acceptance.
  
  

* Daily ADF and Databricks monitoring run without incumbent assistance. Alert recipients repointed to Fujitsu groups.
* Resolve at least two pipeline failures unaided, including a rerun or backfill.
* Deliver at least one pipeline or notebook enhancement end to end through Azure DevOps and change control before the Christmas change freeze.
* Integration runtimes, linked services, secrets and DevOps access under Fujitsu control. Credential and certificate expiry register handed over.
* Integration backlog (remaining SSIS migrations, stalled changes) held with owner and status, and the migration completion decision recorded.
* Incident SLAs met for four consecutive weeks.
* Working arrangements and cross-cover

Provide coverage of Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT) through agreed shift patterns, including the Australian morning window. Participate in a rostered on-call arrangement outside business hours, including weekends, for incidents and business-critical processing windows (e.g. identity, procurement and finance feed deadlines and ERP outage windows), and in planned after-hours changes and maintenance. All operational activities must follow approved procedures, access controls, Cleanaway change governance and delegated authority.
  
  
**Cross-cover:**
Mutual cover with the data warehouse engineer (SSIS migration, data warehouse loads and pipelines feeding the data warehouse).
  
  
Relocation Supported: No
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

description:
**Company Overview**

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. **Job Overview**
----------------

Role Summary

The L2 SAN & Storage Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day operations, provisioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting of enterprise shared storage devices, fabric networks, and backup technologies. This role provides Level 2 escalation support to ensure the demanding up-time, responsiveness, and performance of production storage and backup environments. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with Dell PowerMax, Dell Unity, and Data Domain, combined with deep knowledge of iSCSI protocols, VMware host environments, and solid ITSM practices.

Technical & Process Profile Summary

Storage Technologies: Dell PowerMax, Dell Unity (File & Block)

Backup Technologies: Dell Data Domain, Veeam, Oracle RMAN

Protocols & Networking: iSCSI, Fibre Channel (FC)

Host & Virtualization: VMware vSphere (ESXi), Windows Server, RHEL/OEL

Monitoring Tools: SolarWinds, Splunk (Log analysis & dashboard tracking)

Ticketing & Operations: JIRA (Incident, Change, Service Requests), ITSM Framework

Shift Timings: 24x7 Operations (Rotational Shifts)

Key Responsibilities

Storage Administration: Perform day-to-day provisioning and allocation of storage, including creating Storage Groups, Aggregates, Volumes, LUNs (Thin/Thick), and managing Storage Virtual Machines (SVM) across Dell PowerMax and Dell Unity platforms.

Host Connectivity & Virtualization: Configure, map, and troubleshoot host-side storage connectivity within a highly virtualized VMware ESXi environment, including cluster configurations, multi-pathing (PSP/NMP), and datastore management.

Protocol Management: Implement, manage, and troubleshoot storage connectivity using iSCSI (software/hardware initiators, network binding, CHAP authentication) and Fibre Channel fabric protocols.

Enterprise Monitoring: Proactively monitor storage array health, replication status, and fabric alerts using SolarWinds. Leverage Splunk to track alerts, analyze system logs, and review dashboards to investigate storage performance anomalies.

ITSM & Queue Management: Own the operational queue within JIRA, acting as the L2 technical owner for Incident Management, Service Requests, and Problem Management. Ensure all operational activities strictly follow organizational ITSM frameworks.

Backup & Recovery Operations: Administer and monitor enterprise backups utilizing Dell Data Domain and Veeam. Triage backup failures for business-critical volumes and databases (SQL/Oracle via RMAN).

Lifecycle & Maintenance: Coordinate with hardware vendors (e.g., Dell) for physical component replacements (disks, controllers, SFPs) and assist L3/Architecture teams with storage microcode/firmware upgrades and data migrations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent practical combination of education and experience.

Experience: 5-7 years of dedicated experience in enterprise SAN/NAS storage and backup infrastructure support.

Storage Expertise: Proven hands-on administration experience with Dell PowerMax and Dell Unity storage arrays.

Network & Protocols: Direct hands-on experience configuring iSCSI storage networks alongside traditional Fibre Channel switching.

Virtualization Exposure: Operational knowledge of VMware vSphere environments, focusing on how ESXi hosts interact with shared enterprise storage.

Tools & Processes: Practical experience tracking work via JIRA and a strong foundational understanding of ITSM methodologies (Incident, Change, and Problem workflows).

Monitoring Skills: Experience using SolarWinds for infrastructure health monitoring and Splunk for analyzing technical logs.

Collaborate with client, network, server, database, and application teams to resolve storage and connectivity issues.

Participate in change management, patching, upgrades, and maintenance windows.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and documentation skills.

title: Scientific Support Specialist – Endotoxin Detection Systems & Microbiology
description:
**Scientific Support Specialist – Endotoxin Detection Systems & Microbiology**  
**Location:** Hyderabad, India  
  
This is an office‑first role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and team alignment, enabling us to deliver our best work. You will work primarily in the office, with the flexibility to work remotely for 40% of your time (two days per week).

The actual location of this job is in Hyderabad, India. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.  
  
**Intro Summary of the Role**  
The Scientific Support Specialist provides expert scientific and technical support for Lonza's endotoxin testing portfolio, including reagents, consumables, software solutions, and instrumentation such as the **Nebula® Multimode Reader** and **PyroTec™ PRO Automated Endotoxin Testing System**. The role serves as a subject matter expert (SME) in microbiology, bacterial endotoxins, and endotoxin testing methodologies, supporting customers, sales teams, field service engineers, product management, quality, and R&D.

The incumbent is responsible for resolving complex scientific inquiries, troubleshooting product performance issues, supporting method development and validation activities, conducting customer training, and ensuring the successful implementation of endotoxin testing solutions in regulated environments.  
  
**What you will get:**

  

* An agile career with the opportunity to drive global HR transformation and continuous improvement initiatives
* An inclusive and ethical workplace where you collaborate with senior stakeholders across a global organization.
* The chance to shape the future of HR through automation, digital solutions, and innovation
* Meaningful work that enhances employee experience, operational excellence, and delivers lasting business impact
* Access to global benefits via https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

**What you will do:**  
  
**Scientific and Technical Support**

* Provide advanced scientific support for endotoxin testing products, reagents, consumables, and instrumentation.
* Support customers utilizing:
  + Kinetic Chromogenic LAL assays
  + Gel Clot assays
  + Turbidimetric assays
  + Recombinant Factor C (where applicable)
  + Endotoxin testing software and data management solutions
* Troubleshoot complex assay performance, contamination, inhibition/enhancement, and validation issues.
* Interpret customer-generated data and recommend scientifically sound corrective actions.
* Support product investigations, complaint handling, and root cause analyses.

**Instrument and Software Expertise**

* Act as scientific expert for the **Nebula® Reader** and **PyroTec™ PRO System**.
* Support installation qualification (IQ), operational qualification (OQ), and performance qualification (PQ) activities.
* Assist customers with:
  + Instrument configuration
  + Method setup
  + Software workflows
  + Data analysis
  + Regulatory compliance requirements
* Collaborate with Field Service Engineers on instrument-related investigations.

**Microbiology Expertise**

* Provide expert guidance on:
  + Gram-negative bacteria and endotoxin biology
  + Lipopolysaccharides (LPS)
  + Sources of endotoxin contamination
  + Water systems and environmental monitoring
  + Pharmaceutical microbiology
  + Bioprocess contamination control
  + Sterility assurance concepts
* Support microbiological risk assessments and contamination investigations.

**Regulatory and Compliance Support**

* Maintain knowledge of applicable regulations and guidance including:
  + USP <85>
  + EP 2.6.14
  + JP bacterial endotoxin testing requirements
  + FDA guidance documents
  + GMP requirements
  + Annex 1 contamination control principles
* Support customer audits and scientific documentation requests.
* Assist with method suitability and validation studies.

**Customer Training and Education**

* Deliver scientific training programs to customers and internal teams.
* Develop application notes, troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and technical presentations.
* Support workshops, webinars, and scientific conferences.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with:
  + Sales
  + Marketing
  + Product Management
  + R&D
  + Quality Assurance
  + Regulatory Affairs
  + Field Service teams

Provide customer insights and market feedback to drive product improvements  
  
**What we are looking for:**

**Required Knowledge**

**Microbiology Knowledge (Expert Level: Specialist II)**

  

* Expert in Gram-negative bacterial physiology and LPS structure and function.
* Understand bacterial endotoxins and pyrogens in depth.
* Experienced in microbial contamination control and environmental monitoring.
* Knowledgeable in WFI systems, cleanroom microbiology, and aseptic manufacturing.
* Apply pharmaceutical microbiology and sterility assurance principles.
* Familiar with bacterial growth, metabolism, and biofilms.
* Aware of cell culture contamination risks and bioprocess microbiology.
* Skilled in bioburden testing and microbial identification techniques.

**Endotoxin Testing Knowledge (Expert Level: Specialist III)**

* Strong command of LAL assay principles and mechanisms.
* Understand endotoxin chemistry and biology.
* Perform method suitability and inhibition/enhancement testing.
* Evaluate standard curves and interpret assay data.
* Troubleshoot assays and calculate endotoxin limits.
* Support product validation and method transfer activities.
* Advanced knowledge of alternative pyrogen testing, recombinant technologies, and automation platforms.
* Able to apply statistical evaluation to assay performance.

**Instrumentation Knowledge (Expert Level)**

* Operate and troubleshoot the Nebula® Multimode Reader.
* Manage PyroTec™ PRO System workflow and automation.
* Handle software configuration and data management.
* Understand IQ/OQ/PQ qualification protocols and laboratory automation principles.
* Advanced knowledge of optical detection technologies, robotic liquid handling, and LIMS.
* Follow data integrity principles in all work.

**Preferred**

* PhD in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field.

**About Lonza**

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together.
  
  
Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

title: AV and Microsoft Teams Rooms Support Engineer
description:
Location: Powai, Mumbai (Work from Office)

Experience: 3–6 years

Employment: Full-time employment with Bay of Bangalore IT Services Pvt Ltd

Recruitment Partner: Vallaham

Working Week: Five days, with planned event coverage

Joining: Immediate to 30 days preferred

**Hiring and Employment Arrangement**

Vallaham is the recruitment partner for this position and will manage candidate sourcing, screening and interview coordination. The successful candidate will be employed by Bay of Bangalore IT Services Pvt Ltd.

The offer letter, payroll, statutory benefits, employment terms and HR records will be managed by Bay of Bangalore IT Services Pvt Ltd.

**Role Overview**

Bay of Bangalore is seeking a technically proficient and customer-focused L2 AV and Collaboration Support Engineer to support enterprise meeting-room technology and collaboration systems at its Powai, Mumbai, workplace.

The role involves maintaining the operational readiness of Microsoft Teams Rooms, Zoom Rooms and associated Audio-Visual (AV) systems; troubleshooting technical incidents; supporting executive meetings, town halls and hybrid events; and coordinating with specialist vendors for complex issues, hardware repairs and system-level escalations.

The ideal candidate will combine hands-on technical expertise with structured troubleshooting, clear communication, professional stakeholder management and strong incident ownership. The candidate should be capable of working independently, diagnosing faults systematically and ensuring a reliable meeting experience for business users.

Expertise in every AV manufacturer or platform is not expected. However, practical experience with enterprise collaboration systems and the ability to troubleshoot across multiple technology layers are essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AV and Collaboration Technology Support**

* Perform daily room health checks and provide L2 operational support for conference rooms, boardrooms, town halls and other collaboration spaces.
* Configure, operate and troubleshoot Microsoft Teams Rooms and Zoom Rooms in a live enterprise environment.
* Support enterprise AV equipment and peripherals from manufacturers such as Logitech, Poly, Crestron, Extron, Neat, DTEN, Shure, Biamp and QSC.
* Diagnose and resolve issues involving displays, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels, cabling, USB/HDMI connectivity, content sharing and conferencing peripherals.
* Trace AV signal flow and isolate faults across compute devices, conferencing applications, audio/video equipment, network connectivity and peripheral interfaces.
* Conduct room readiness checks before scheduled meetings and ensure that critical collaboration spaces remain operational.

**2. Technical Troubleshooting and Incident Resolution**

* Apply a structured troubleshooting methodology to identify the root cause of AV and collaboration incidents.
* Differentiate between hardware, software, configuration, connectivity and network-related issues before implementing corrective action.
* Perform basic network diagnostics relevant to AV endpoints, including IP addressing, DHCP, DNS reachability, VLAN awareness and switch port identification.
* Resolve incidents independently within the scope of L2 support and escalate complex programming, infrastructure or hardware issues with detailed diagnostic findings.
* Document symptoms, troubleshooting steps, root causes, workarounds and resolutions to support knowledge sharing and prevent recurrence.
* Identify recurring faults and recommend preventive measures to improve system reliability and reduce downtime.

**3. Executive Meetings and Live Event Support**

* Provide planned technical support for executive meetings, boardroom sessions, town halls, webinars and hybrid events.
* Conduct pre-event testing, technical rehearsals and dry runs to validate audio, video, presentation sharing and conferencing functionality.
* Monitor live sessions, respond promptly to technical issues and minimise disruption to business-critical meetings.
* Coordinate with meeting organisers, presenters, event teams and relevant technical stakeholders to confirm requirements and ensure operational readiness.
* Maintain composure and communicate clearly when resolving issues under time pressure, particularly during senior leadership meetings and live events.
* Support event-specific requirements such as microphone management, camera positioning, audio mixing and digital signage, where applicable.

**4. Communication and Stakeholder Management**

* Communicate professionally with business users, meeting organisers, senior stakeholders and external service providers.
* Ask relevant diagnostic questions, understand the impact of incidents and explain technical issues in clear, non-technical language.
* Provide timely updates on incident status, expected resolution, workarounds and escalation requirements.
* Manage user expectations appropriately while maintaining a calm, service-oriented approach during high-pressure situations.
* Provide simple operating instructions and guidance to users on meeting-room equipment and collaboration platforms.
* Coordinate effectively with internal IT teams, network teams, AV integrators, OEMs and specialist vendors to resolve incidents.

**5. Service Management and Operational Governance**

* Log, categorise, prioritise, track and close incidents and service requests using an IT service management or ticketing platform.
* Take ownership of assigned incidents and service requests, ensuring timely follow-ups and compliance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain accurate records of room configurations, equipment inventories, spare devices, maintenance activities and vendor service actions.
* Perform preventive maintenance and coordinate approved firmware updates, system checks and routine equipment servicing.
* Support room upgrades and new deployments through site surveys, equipment testing, punch-list closure, acceptance checks and handover documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors for warranty claims, equipment replacement, repairs and specialist technical support.

**Essential Skills and Qualifications**

* 3–6 years of hands-on experience in enterprise AV support, video conferencing operations, meeting-room technology or AV systems integration.
* Practical experience supporting Microsoft Teams Rooms or Zoom Rooms in a live business environment.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across audio, video, display, camera, microphone, touch panel, USB/HDMI and conferencing systems.
* Ability to understand AV signal flow and systematically isolate faults across hardware, software, peripherals and network connectivity.
* Hands-on experience with at least two enterprise AV ecosystems or equipment platforms, such as Logitech, Poly, Crestron, Extron, Neat, DTEN, Shure, Biamp or QSC.
* Working knowledge of networking concepts relevant to AV systems, including IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs and switch ports.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems, incident management, SLA-based support and technical documentation.
* Strong spoken and written English, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly and communicate professionally with senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ownership, analytical thinking, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise incidents based on urgency and business impact.
* Ability to work independently onsite while collaborating effectively with remote IT teams, event organisers and external vendors.
* Willingness to work from the Powai, Mumbai, office and provide planned early-morning or late-evening event coverage when scheduled.

title: Senior Engineer, Digital Collaboration & Messaging (SharePoint)
description:
**Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint)**
The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (SharePoint) is a senior technical practitioner responsible specifically for the engineering, administration, governance, reliability, migration, and continuous improvement of the firm’s enterprise SharePoint Online environment. This role serves as the technical subject matter expert for SharePoint within the Messaging and Productivity Platforms function. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift.
  
  
**Key Job Responsibilities Include**
The engineer will own the technical administration and engineering of SharePoint Online and play a significant role in SharePoint migrations, tenant consolidations, mergers and acquisitions, content remediation, lifecycle management, governance, and automation.
  
  
**SharePoint Online Administration & Engineering**

* Engineer, administer, and continuously improve the enterprise SharePoint Online environment.
* Maintain tenant-level SharePoint configurations and administrative controls.
* Establish and maintain standards for site architecture, provisioning, permissions, ownership, sharing, and lifecycle management.
* Manage and monitor SharePoint storage, site collections, access, configuration, and platform health.
* Develop scalable technical solutions for SharePoint administration and management.
* Evaluate SharePoint Online product changes and assess their potential impact on the enterprise environment.
* Plan, test, and implement SharePoint platform changes in a controlled and supportable manner.
* Identify and remediate stale, abandoned, redundant, orphaned, or improperly configured SharePoint sites.
* Develop automation using PowerShell, PnP PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, APIs, and other appropriate technologies.
* Reduce manual SharePoint administration through repeatable engineering and automation.

**SharePoint Migration Engineering;**

* Plan and execute enterprise SharePoint Online migrations.
* Support SharePoint migrations associated with mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, tenant consolidations, and organizational transformation.
* Perform technical discovery and assessment of source SharePoint environments.
* Analyze sites, content, permissions, metadata, links, customizations, dependencies, and other migration considerations.
* Determine migration readiness and identify technical risks, remediation requirements, and dependencies.
* Develop migration strategies, technical migration plans, sequencing, migration waves, validation procedures, and rollback approaches.
* Configure and operate enterprise SharePoint migration technologies.
* Develop scripts and automation to improve migration discovery, preparation, execution, validation, and reporting.
* Troubleshoot complex migration failures and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
* Perform pre- and post-migration validation of content, permissions, metadata, links, access, and functionality.
* Identify obsolete, redundant, unsupported, or unnecessary content and determine appropriate remediation rather than automatically carrying technical debt into the destination environment.
* Develop repeatable migration processes and standards that can be reused for future migration initiatives.
* Transition migrated environments into established SharePoint governance and lifecycle-management processes.

**SharePoint Governance & Lifecycle Management**

* Establish and maintain enterprise SharePoint governance standards.
* Define and maintain standards for site provisioning, ownership, permissions, external sharing, and lifecycle.
* Establish processes for identifying and managing inactive, abandoned, and orphaned sites.
* Support site expiration, archival, retention, and decommissioning processes.
* Maintain appropriate controls for external and guest sharing.
* Partner with Information Security on SharePoint security and data-protection requirements.
* Partner with Identity & Access Management on SharePoint authentication, access, guest identity, and related access-management requirements.
* Improve visibility into SharePoint ownership, usage, storage, health, and lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to reduce SharePoint technical debt and platform sprawl.

**Advanced SharePoint Troubleshooting**

* Serve as an advanced engineering escalation point for complex SharePoint Online issues.
* Troubleshoot complex permissions, authentication, access, sharing, configuration, content, and migration problems.
* Investigate issues that cannot be effectively resolved through established frontline or second-level support processes.
* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions where possible.
* Identify patterns across escalated incidents that indicate broader platform or governance problems.
* Engage Microsoft and SharePoint technology vendors when vendor-level escalation is required.
* Document solutions and transfer repeatable troubleshooting knowledge to appropriate support teams.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience administering and engineering enterprise SharePoint environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with SharePoint Online in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Strong experience with enterprise SharePoint administration, configuration, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing large-scale SharePoint migrations.
* Experience with SharePoint Online tenant-to-tenant migrations or similar complex enterprise migration initiatives.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint architecture, sites, permissions, sharing, metadata, storage, and content structures.
* Experience performing technical discovery and migration-readiness assessments.
* Experience identifying migration dependencies, risks, technical debt, and remediation requirements.
* Experience validating content, permissions, metadata, links, access, and functionality following migrations.
* Strong PowerShell and PnP PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
* Experience using Microsoft Graph, APIs, or other automation technologies for SharePoint administration.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint security, permissions, guest access, and external sharing.
* Experience troubleshooting complex SharePoint Online platform and migration issues.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex technical problems.
* Experience working with enterprise security, compliance, retention, and data-governance requirements.
* Experience working within enterprise Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to independently drive complex technical work across multiple technical and business teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise SharePoint migration platforms such as ShareGate or equivalent technologies.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or tenant consolidations involving SharePoint.
* Experience migrating SharePoint Server or other legacy SharePoint environments to SharePoint Online.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview capabilities relevant to SharePoint, including retention, information protection, and eDiscovery.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, guest access, and external identity capabilities as they relate to SharePoint.
* Experience with SharePoint site lifecycle automation and enterprise governance tooling.
* Experience with Microsoft Graph and API-based SharePoint automation.
* Relevant Microsoft 365 or SharePoint certifications.
* Experience working within a global enterprise and with managed service providers.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.
