title: IT Systems Administrator
description:
**IT & Systems Administrator**

**About the Role**

We are looking for an **IT & Systems** **Administrator** who can manage our complete technology infrastructure, hardware environment, cloud hosting, and critical business applications. This role goes beyond routine IT support; it involves taking complete ownership of the company's technical operations, ensuring seamless reliability across our local networks, Wi-Fi, and cloud platforms (AWS), and guaranteeing maximum uptime for our ERP and Tally servers. Because our operations are dynamic and spread out, this role requires a hands-on approach and the readiness to work across our Factory, Warehouse, and Head Office (HO) to ensure uninterrupted business continuity as the organisation grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

● Manage all internal hardware systems, including the provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of PCs, laptops, and VoIP phone systems.

● Maintain an accurate and up-to-date hardware and software list, ensuring proper asset management, licensing compliance, and lifecycle tracking.

● Take full ownership of network administration, managing the local area network (LAN), Wi-Fi infrastructure, routers, switches, and enterprise firewalls to ensure maximum security and seamless connectivity.

● Administer the company's G Suite (Google Workspace) environment, including user account creation, access management, and security settings.

● Formulate, implement, and enforce standard IT policies, best practices, and internal security controls across the organization.

● Deal directly with IT vendors, service providers, and ISPs for procurement, contract negotiation, and resolving third-party service issues.

● Manage, update, and troubleshoot all operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) across the organization.

● Oversee the hosting, deployment, and optimization of the company website and central ERP system on AWS (or similar cloud infrastructure).

● Manage and maintain on-premise or cloud-based Tally servers to ensure the finance and accounting operations run smoothly without data bottlenecks.

● Proactively monitor and manage the uptime, health, and performance of the ERP system to guarantee high availability for daily operations.

● Manage endpoint security, VPNs, user access, and credentials to protect corporate data and prevent unauthorized access.

● Design, implement, and maintain regular data backups and disaster recovery protocols for both on-premise hardware and cloud environments.

● Work closely with internal teams across all locations to resolve technical support queries, onboarding issues, and system access bottlenecks promptly.

**What We Value**

We value people who are self-motivated, energetic, analytical, humble, patient, and eager to learn. You should be comfortable taking initiative, stepping into unfamiliar areas, and figuring things out when there is no ready-made solution. We look for someone who takes ownership, stays committed to getting the work done, and is willing to go the extra mile while continuously learning and growing with the role.

**What We’re Looking For**

● 4–6 years of hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, cloud management, or a related field.

● Flexibility and readiness to work on-site across our Factory, Warehouse, and Head Office (HO) environments as required.

● Expert-level practical knowledge of managing cloud hosting environments, specifically AWS (EC2, RDS, etc.) or equivalent platforms.

● Strong practical knowledge of network configuration, Wi-Fi management, LAN setups, and enterprise firewall administration.

● Experience in ERP technical administration, Tally server maintenance, and proactive uptime management.

● Proven experience in G Suite administration, hardware/software inventory management, and IT policy formulation.

● Strong negotiation and communication skills with a track record of effectively dealing with IT vendors and service providers.

● Practical experience managing mixed-OS environments (Windows/macOS/Linux) and daily IT hardware troubleshooting.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Experience:

* IT administration: 4 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
Nuventure Connect is a global technology services company that is ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified and GDPR compliant, demonstrating a strong focus on security and data protection. The company leverages deep technology expertise to solve complex business problems and support clients across the entire product value chain. With strengths in engineering, design, and digitalisation, Nuventure Connect delivers next-generation solutions, including intuitive software, end-to-end IoT systems, cloud infrastructure management, and managed hosting support. Using agile methodologies, the company efficiently transforms unique ideas into scalable solutions for organizations of all sizes. Nuventure Connect is also a trusted partner for industrial CAD services and comprehensive industrial solutions.

About the Role

* As a Technical Analyst, you will help maintain reliable service during the Monday through Friday day shift. You will manage support tickets, respond to monitoring alerts, provide live phone support, and coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer issues.
* This role suits a technical support professional with system administrator-level experience who can balance ticket, alert, and phone workloads, follow established support processes, and triage issues effectively during the day shift.

Key Responsibilities

Ticket and Incident Management

•  Manage support tickets, ensuring timely response and resolution within defined service level agreement (SLA) guidelines.

•  Monitor alerting and monitoring systems, such as Zabbix, GrokStream, and SIEM, and respond to infrastructure, system, and service notifications.

•  Triage alerts in real time to reduce duplication, noise, and unnecessary escalations.

•  Follow established incident, problem, and change processes to ensure consistent service delivery.

•  Maintain clear and accurate ticket documentation aligned with ITIL‑based service management practices.

•  Provide clear ticket handoffs at the end of each shift, including status, severity, and next steps.

Phone Support and Customer Interaction

•  Provide live inbound phone support during the Monday through Friday day shift.

•  Balance phone responsibilities with active ticket and alert workloads.

•  Assist with phone coverage during peak periods to avoid relying on a single team member for inbound calls.

•  Escalate complex or high-severity issues appropriately while maintaining ownership through resolution or handoff.

System Administration and Collaboration

•  Perform system administrator-level support tasks, including user administration, service troubleshooting, and system health checks.

•  Support Level One (L1) team members with escalated or more technically involved issues.

•  Coordinate escalations to Engineering, Networking, Backup, or Remote Hands teams, documenting work performed and required follow-up.

•  Participate in incident response activities during service‑impacting events.

•  Collaborate with team members to identify recurring issues, root causes, and opportunities for service improvement.

Required Skills and Experience

•  Experience in technical support, IT support, or system administration. MSP or NOC experience is preferred.

•  System administrator-level experience with Windows Server; Active Directory users, groups, and basic GPOs; and core networking concepts, including DNS, DHCP, and connectivity troubleshooting.

•  Experience administering and supporting Microsoft Azure environments, including virtual machines, networking components, and identity and access management (Azure AD).

•  Working knowledge of ITIL‑based service management practices, including incident, request, problem, and change management.

•  Experience with virtualized environments such as VMware, Hyper-V, or Proxmox.

•  Familiarity with backup and recovery tools, including Veeam, Zerto, and AS400-based backup environments.

•  Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort with phone‑based customer support.

•  Ability to manage multiple tasks, follow defined processes, and document work clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

•  ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent practical experience.

•  Basic familiarity with Linux systems, MySQL, or web services (Apache/IIS).

•  Exposure to PowerShell or similar scripting tools.

•  Prior experience balancing customer phone support, tickets, and monitoring alerts during daytime operations.

•  Additional platform, automation, or certification experience is beneficial but not required.

Why This Role Matters

This role provides consistent weekday daytime coverage for support tickets, monitoring alerts, and live phone support. By coordinating timely responses and clear handoffs, the Technical Analyst helps maintain reliable service and reduce operational risk.

title: FAAS MS - Service Management Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Senior – Incident & Access Management (IFMS)**
**Profile Summary:**
Senior Analyst – Incident & Access Management (IFMS) will support IFMS business service continuity through incident coordination and timely, approved access provisioning for Business Operations users. The role monitors tickets and SLAs, drives resolver follow-ups, publishes service reports and identifies Continual Service Improvement (CSI) opportunities across supported engagements.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilities:**
As an Incident Management Analyst, support IFMS Business Operations through the following activities:
  
  

* Incident monitoring: Review MSO queues daily; validate business impact, priority and assignment, and track ageing, backlog and SLA risks.
* Resolution coordination: Follow up with business and technology resolver teams, escalate delays, communicate progress and confirm closure; support major incident coordination and post-incident actions.
* Access fulfilment: Handle Business Operations access requests; validate approvals and provision, modify or revoke application access within delegated permissions, following approved role profiles, least privilege and segregation-of-duties controls.
* Service reporting: Publish daily ticket updates and periodic reports on demand, SLA attainment, backlog, access fulfilment, risks and outstanding actions.
* Operational controls: Maintain accurate MSO records, access approval evidence, SOPs and handovers; support access reviews and track service reviews to closure.
* CSI: Identify recurring incidents and process bottlenecks; recommend knowledge articles, self-service and automation, and track improvement outcomes.

**Desired Skills:**

* Working knowledge of incident, request, access and SLA management; ITIL Foundation preferred.
* Understanding of role-based access, approval workflows, least privilege and segregation of duties.
* Proficiency in Excel, ITSM reporting and trend analysis; Power BI familiarity preferred.
* Clear stakeholder communication, customer focus and effective business/technology team coordination.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize business impact and maintain accurate records and timely follow-ups.

**Essential Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT or a related discipline preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Typically, 5–8 years in service delivery/support, including 3+ years in incident coordination, ticket governance, SLA monitoring or reporting.
* Hands-on ITSM tool experience; familiarity with MSO and finance managed services environments is an advantage.
* Experience in approved user access provisioning, operational reporting and service improvement tracking.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Workstation Engineer
description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At
**Worldwide Clinical Trials**
, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.
  
  
With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
**SUMMARY:**
The Workstation Engineer is responsible for the design, lifecycle management, security, standardization, and continuous improvement of Worldwide's end-user computing environment. This role ensures that employee devices, operating systems, endpoint management platforms, and productivity tools remain secure, reliable, compliant, and aligned with business needs.
  
  
The Workstation Engineer evaluates emerging technologies, maintains endpoint technology roadmaps, manages hardware and software standards, validates compatibility, administers endpoint management solutions, and supports the deployment of secure workstation technologies across a global enterprise environment. The role works closely with Security, Infrastructure, Service Desk, Procurement, and business stakeholders to deliver a modern digital workplace experience. Industry best practices emphasize endpoint lifecycle management, modern device management, cloud-managed endpoints, automation, and Zero Trust security principles.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Tasks may include but are not limited to
  
  
Endpoint Strategy & Roadmap
  
  

* Own and maintain the global workstation hardware roadmap.
* Define and manage approved standards for laptops, desktops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals, and mobile computing devices.
* Develop lifecycle and refresh strategies for end-user hardware.
* Recommend future-state endpoint solutions aligned with business, security, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with Procurement and vendors to evaluate new hardware platforms and technologies.

Technology Evaluation & Innovation
  
  

* Research, evaluate, and assess new endpoint technologies, operating systems, management tools, and productivity solutions.
* Conduct proofs of concept (POCs) and pilot programs for emerging technologies.
* Evaluate compatibility, supportability, security risks, and operational impact of new solutions.
* Provide recommendations based on technical, business, security, and user experience considerations.

Hardware & Software Compatibility Testing
  
  

* Design, coordinate, and execute testing activities for workstation hardware, operating systems, drivers, applications, and peripherals.
* Validate compatibility between business applications and supported endpoint platforms.
* Develop testing standards, procedures, and acceptance criteria.
* Document findings and support enterprise-wide deployment decisions.

Endpoint Engineering & Administration
  
  

* Engineer, deploy, and maintain Windows and macOS workstation environments.
* Manage endpoint configuration standards and images.
* Configure and support endpoint management platforms such as Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Jamf, and related technologies.
* Develop automation and self-service solutions to improve endpoint management and user experience.
* Create and maintain endpoint configuration, compliance, and security policies.

Patch & Vulnerability Management
  
  

* Test, validate, and deploy operating system, driver, firmware, and application updates.
* Assess software patches for potential business impact prior to enterprise deployment.
* Develop deployment schedules and rollout strategies.
* Monitor patch compliance and remediation activities.
* Partner with Cybersecurity teams to address endpoint vulnerabilities and reduce risk exposure.

Security & Compliance
  
  

* Support Zero Trust and endpoint security initiatives.
* Ensure workstation configurations comply with organizational security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Security teams to implement endpoint protection, encryption, device compliance, and conditional access controls.
* Participate in security reviews, audits, and compliance assessments.

Operational Support
  
  

* Serve as Tier 3 escalation support for complex workstation-related incidents and problems.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Engage vendors and manufacturers to resolve product defects and technical issues.
* Support major incidents impacting endpoint services.

Documentation & Process Improvement
  
  

* Develop and maintain technical standards, procedures, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
* Maintain endpoint architecture documentation and hardware standards catalogs.
* Continuously improve workstation deployment, support, and lifecycle processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.

Project Participation
  
  

* Lead or participate in endpoint modernization initiatives.
* Support workstation-related workstreams for mergers, acquisitions, office openings, and technology refresh projects.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Networking, Cybersecurity, and Service Desk teams to deliver endpoint solutions.

**Other Skills And Abilities**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Technology evaluation and decision-making.
* Project and change management.
* Process improvement mindset.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to balance security, usability, and operational requirements.
* Vendor management and stakeholder engagement.
* Documentation and knowledge management.
* Customer-focused approach.
* Ability to work independently in a global environment.
* Success Measures
* The Workstation Engineer will be measured on:
* Endpoint compliance and security posture.
* Hardware roadmap effectiveness and lifecycle management.
* Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation performance.
* Device reliability and user experience metrics.
* Reduction in endpoint-related incidents.
* Successful delivery of endpoint modernization initiatives.
* Automation and operational efficiency improvements.
* Quality of documentation and technical standards.

**Requirements**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, workstation engineering, desktop engineering, or end-user computing.
* Experience managing enterprise-scale Windows workstation environments.
* Experience with endpoint lifecycle management and hardware standardization.
* Experience testing and validating hardware and software compatibility.
* Experience managing software deployment and patch management processes.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Windows 10/11 administration and engineering.
* Microsoft Intune and Endpoint Manager.
* Windows Autopilot.
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
* Microsoft 365 platform.
* PowerShell scripting and automation.
* Endpoint security technologies.
* Software packaging and deployment.
* Hardware lifecycle and asset management.
* Driver and firmware management.
* Device compliance and configuration management.
* Remote support and endpoint troubleshooting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting macOS environments.
* Experience with Jamf Pro.
* Experience with Azure Virtual Desktop or other virtual desktop technologies.
* Experience with Tanium or similar endpoint management platforms.
* Experience with Digital Experience Monitoring (DEX/DEM) tools.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate.
* Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator (or successor certification).
* Experience operating within a regulated environment such as healthcare, clinical research, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industries.

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

description:
**Job Title:**

SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator

**Department:**

SAP Solutions & Delivery

**Experience:**

3+ years of experience(Preferred)

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Functional Expertise:**

SAP FICO preferred, with exposure to SAP S/4HANA and SAP integrations

**Reporting To:**

Delivery Head / Management

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator**

with strong SAP functional knowledge, business analysis capabilities, and project delivery experience.

The role will act as a bridge between customers, business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, and technical developers, ensuring that business requirements are clearly understood, translated into appropriate solution designs, and delivered within agreed timelines.

The primary objective is to
**strengthen functional ownership and delivery coordination**

, allowing the existing SAP development team to focus on technical implementation while ensuring business alignment, solution quality, and predictable project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Business Requirements & Functional Analysis

* Engage with customers and stakeholders to understand business processes and requirements.
* Conduct requirement-gathering workshops and functional discussions.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and development-ready requirements.
* Identify functional gaps, dependencies, and integration requirements.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), and process flows.

2. SAP Solution Design & Functional Leadership

* Evaluate business requirements and recommend suitable SAP solutions.
* Provide functional guidance to SAP ABAP developers and integration teams.
* Review proposed solutions for functional accuracy and business alignment.
* Support SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and third-party integration requirements.
* Coordinate solution design reviews and technical feasibility discussions.
* Ensure consistency with SAP best practices and customer expectations.

3. Project Planning & Delivery Coordination

* Develop project plans, milestones, delivery schedules, and resource requirements.
* Coordinate tasks across functional, development, QA, and deployment teams.
* Track project progress, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular project reviews and communicate status to management.
* Identify potential delivery delays and initiate corrective actions.
* Support multiple concurrent SAP projects and customer engagements.

4. Stakeholder & Customer Management

* Serve as the primary functional and delivery coordination point for assigned projects.
* Facilitate communication between customers, internal teams, and management.
* Manage requirement clarifications, change requests, and scope discussions.
* Coordinate customer demonstrations, reviews, and solution walkthroughs.
* Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and timely resolution of open items.

5. Testing, Deployment & Delivery Assurance

* Define functional acceptance criteria and support test scenario preparation.
* Coordinate SIT, UAT, defect resolution, and customer sign-off.
* Verify that delivered functionality meets agreed requirements.
* Support deployment planning, go-live readiness, and post-production stabilization.
* Maintain functional documentation, project records, and delivery handover materials.

Required Skills & Qualifications

**SAP Functional Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of SAP business processes and functional modules.
* SAP FICO expertise preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC.
* Familiarity with SAP ABAP development concepts, BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs, APIs, and integration scenarios.
* Ability to review functional specifications and communicate effectively with developers.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Proven experience coordinating SAP implementation, enhancement, support, or integration projects.
* Strong requirement-gathering and functional documentation skills.
* Experience in project planning, task tracking, risk management, and delivery reporting.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Experience working directly with customers and cross-functional technical teams.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and delivery commitments.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and decision-making capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3+ years of relevant SAP functional and delivery experience.
* At least 2 years of SAP project coordination or functional leadership experience.
* SAP certification in FICO or S/4HANA is an advantage.
* Exposure to SAP integrations with external enterprise applications, financial systems, and reconciliation platforms.

**Expected Deliverables**

The successful candidate will be responsible for :

* Clearly documented and validated customer requirements.
* Functional specifications ready for technical development.
* Approved solution designs with defined scope and acceptance criteria.
* Structured project plans, milestones, and delivery trackers.
* Regular project status reports with risks, blockers, and action items.
* Coordinated SIT, UAT, customer sign-offs, and deployments.
* Improved predictability, quality, and timeliness of SAP project delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Requirement completeness and accuracy.
* Functional specification quality and development readiness.
* On-time achievement of project milestones.
* Reduction in requirement-related rework.
* Stakeholder communication and issue-resolution effectiveness.
* UAT acceptance and successful delivery sign-offs.
* Overall customer satisfaction and delivery efficiency.

Role Positioning

**This is a functional leadership and delivery coordination role, not a hands-on ABAP development position.**

The candidate must possess sufficient SAP functional and technical understanding to guide development teams, resolve requirement ambiguities, coordinate stakeholders, and take ownership of delivery commitments.

**Our Goal:**

Establish a strong functional and delivery ownership layer between customers and our SAP development team, enabling developers to concentrate on technical execution while improving solution alignment, project governance, and delivery reliability.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced
**ServiceNow Functional Consultant**
to support a SAP-led enterprise transformation programme. The consultant will be responsible for functional design, platform configuration, custom application workflows, SAP integration requirements, testing, UAT, training and go-live support.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role requiring strong ServiceNow functional expertise and a good understanding of SAP logistics processes.

Key Responsibilities

* Gather business requirements and conduct fit-gap analysis.
* Review and prepare Functional Design Documents (FDDs), process flows and user stories.
* Configure ServiceNow tables, forms, UI policies, workflows, notifications, SLAs and service catalog items.
* Design and support custom applications and complex approval workflows.
* Work with developers to translate business requirements into functional and technical solutions.
* Define functional integration requirements between ServiceNow and SAP modules (MM, SD, FI and PS).
* Coordinate with SAP, MuleSoft and ServiceNow development teams for integration requirements.
* Prepare and execute SIT test scenarios, test cases and defect tracking.
* Support UAT, client interactions and issue resolution.
* Prepare training materials and conduct end-user training.
* Support cutover, deployment, go-live and post-go-live hypercare.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5–8 years of experience in ServiceNow Functional Consulting.
* At least 2–3 full lifecycle ServiceNow implementations.
* Strong hands-on experience in ServiceNow configuration.
* Experience with custom applications and complex workflows beyond standard ITSM.
* Good understanding of SAP logistics processes (MM, SD, FI and PS).
* Experience in SAP–ServiceNow integration requirements.
* Strong knowledge of Flow Designer, Approval Engine, Service Catalog, Service Portal, UI Policies, Data Policies and Reporting.
* Experience in FDD documentation, SIT, UAT and defect management.
* Experience in client coordination, training, cutover and go-live support.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Good to Have

* SAP S/4HANA implementation exposure.
* Knowledge of IntegrationHub, REST APIs and MuleSoft.
* ServiceNow CSA / CIS certifications.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or HP ALM.

**Job Description: Product Specialist – Kerala**

**Product Line: Digital Radiography (DR) Systems, X-Ray & C-Arm Imaging Systems**

The Product Specialist will be responsible for supporting sales, clinical applications, product demonstrations, customer training, and technical product positioning for Digital Radiography (DR), X-Ray, and C-Arm systems across Kerala. * Contrast Resolution
* Spatial Resolution
* Noise Assessment
* Dose Optimization
* Image Processing
* Clinical Image Acceptability

**Technical Support & Market Intelligence**

* Develop strong technical understanding of company products and competing technologies.
* Gather market intelligence regarding competitor products, features, and customer feedback.
* Collaborate with service engineers for troubleshooting and product enhancement.
* Support launch and promotion of new products and software upgrades.

**Required Qualifications**

* Radiology Technology (Paramedical Radiography)
* BSc Medical Imaging Technology
* Biomedical Engineering
* Experienced healthcare as applicable

**Required Skills & Competencies**

**Technical Skills**

* Knowledge of Digital Radiography (DR), X-Ray, and C-Arm imaging systems.
* Understanding of radiographic positioning and imaging protocols.
* Ability to assess and discuss image quality with healthcare professionals.
* Basic knowledge of:
* DICOM
* PACS
* RIS/HIS Integration
* Radiation Safety Principles

**Communication Skills**

* Strong presentation and demonstration skills.
* Ability to train clinical users and conduct workshops.
* Excellent customer handling and relationship management skills.
* Ability to provide remote support via phone, video conference, and online sessions.

**Functional Skills**

* Problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Team collaboration with Sales, Service, and Product Management teams.
* Ability to work independently and manage territory responsibilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively within Kerala and neighbouring regions.

**Language Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* Malayalam
* English

Knowledge of additional South Indian languages will be considered a significant advantage.

* Tamil
* Kannada
* Telugu

**Preferred Experience**

* 3-6 years of experience in Medical Imaging Applications, Product Specialist, Clinical Application Engineer or Service Engineer aspiring to move in Product Roll.

* Digital Radiography Systems
* Mobile X-Ray Systems
* Fixed X-Ray Systems
* C-Arm Systems

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Nuventure Connect is a global technology services company that is ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified, and fully GDPR compliant. The organization applies deep engineering and digital expertise to solve complex business challenges across the entire product value chain. Nuventure Connect delivers next-generation solutions, including intuitive software products, end-to-end IoT implementations, cloud infrastructure management, and managed hosting support. The company also provides industrial CAD services and scalable industrial solutions, supporting organizations of all sizes through agile methodologies. As a trusted technology partner, Nuventure Connect focuses on innovation, reliability, and long-term client success.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Systems Engineer**
with strong expertise in
**IBM Power Systems, IBM i (AS/400), AIX, storage, backup, and high availability solutions**
. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing enterprise infrastructure, troubleshooting complex issues, ensuring system availability, and supporting disaster recovery operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot IBM i (AS/400), AIX, and IBM Power Systems environments.
* Manage IBM PowerVM virtualization, HMC, VIOS, LPARs, NPIV, vSCSI, and Live Partition Mobility.
* Administer high availability solutions, including PowerHA, MIMIX, and SAN replication.
* Manage enterprise storage infrastructure, including IBM FlashSystem, Dell EMC, NetApp, and SAN switches.
* Perform OS patching, upgrades, performance tuning, security hardening, and capacity planning.
* Administer backup and recovery solutions, including IBM BRMS, mksysb, savevg, and tape libraries.
* Support disaster recovery planning, testing, and restoration activities.
* Troubleshoot critical infrastructure incidents and provide L3 technical support.
* Automate administrative tasks using Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible.
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure procedures.

**Mandatory Skills & Qualifications**

* **Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience with IBM Power Systems environments.**
* **Strong expertise in IBM i (AS/400) and AIX administration.**
* **Hands-on experience with IBM PowerVM, HMC, VIOS, and LPAR management.**
* **Experience with PowerHA, MIMIX, and high availability/replication solutions**
  .
* Strong knowledge of enterprise SAN storage, Fibre Channel, and storage replication.
* Experience with IBM BRMS, enterprise backup, and disaster recovery.
* Proficiency in AIX LVM, JFS2, system performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Experience handling enterprise infrastructure incidents and production support.
* Strong communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* IBM FlashSystem, SAN Volume Controller, Dell EMC, and NetApp storage.
* Brocade or Cisco MDS SAN switches.
* Ansible, KornShell, Bash, Perl, or Python scripting.
* Db2 for i administration and performance monitoring.
* ServiceNow, Jira, and ITIL processes.
* Experience with SOX, PCI-DSS, and infrastructure security compliance.
* **Ideal Candidate:**
  A senior IBM Power Systems professional with 10+ years of experience in IBM i, AIX, virtualization, high availability, enterprise storage, backup, and disaster recovery, capable of independently managing complex production infrastructure.

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Unix Conglomerate Private Limited is a strategic partner for commercial real estate, specializing in Integrated Smart Facility Management Services. The company offers a single-point-of-contact solution for both Hard and Soft services, ensuring operational excellence, compliance, safety, and efficiency across client sites. Hard Facilities Management covers mechanical and electrical systems, public health infrastructure, structural maintenance, and life safety protocols. Soft Facilities Management focuses on hygiene, cleanliness, landscaping, pest control, and comprehensive security to deliver a productive workplace experience. By consolidating services, leveraging smart automation and analytics, and managing maintenance contracts directly, Unix Conglomerate helps clients standardize operations, reduce costs, and streamline vendor and staffing complexities.

**Role Description**
The Operations Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Bengaluru, responsible for overseeing day-to-day facility management operations across client locations. This position manages Hard and Soft facilities services, ensuring adherence to safety, compliance, and performance standards. The Operations Manager coordinates vendor and AMC management, supervises service delivery teams, and implements standardized processes to maintain quality and efficiency. The role includes monitoring operational KPIs, using technology and analytics for decision-making, optimizing costs, and supporting lean staffing models. The Operations Manager also collaborates with clients to understand requirements, address service issues, and drive continuous improvement in facility operations.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in operations management, preferably in facility management, real estate, or related service industries.
* Strong skills in vendor management, AMC oversight, and contract administration.
* Ability to manage Hard services such as mechanical, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and building maintenance.
* Ability to oversee Soft services including cleaning, landscaping, waste management, pest control, and security operations.
* Competence in using digital tools, automation platforms, and analytics for reporting and performance tracking.
* Excellent organizational, planning, and multitasking capabilities with attention to detail.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
* Proven problem-solving abilities and experience in process improvement and cost optimization.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Business Administration, or a related field; relevant certifications in facilities or operations management are an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru and travel to client locations as required.

title: Regional Event Manager, APAC
description:
The
**Regional Event Manager, APAC**
owns the overall standardization, quality, operational governance, and continuous improvement of event and onsite delivery across all Stripe offices in the APAC region. Acting as the regional SPOC, subject matter expert, coach, and community lead, this role establishes regional parity with AMER and EMEA event operations.
  
  
The position ensures that all in-office events and team onsites—from routine gatherings to high-visibility, executive, and cross-functional programs—are delivered consistently according to global policy, service principles, and performance SLAs.
  
  
Additionally, this role provides operational continuity and front-of-house/administrative support for the Bengaluru office team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Regional Event Quality Control & Governance
* Daily Ticket & Tracker Audits: Conduct daily (not weekly) system audits of incoming event tickets in Summit (Stripe’s event intake system) and ensure site trackers are up to date across all APAC locations.
* SLA Enforcement: Drive strict adherence to regional SLAs:

+ Initial Acknowledgment: 1 business day for standard requests; immediate triage for same-week/same-day escalations.
+ Substantive Follow-Up: 1 business day (<3 weeks out), 2 business days (3–8 weeks out), or 1 week (>8 weeks out).
+ Escalation Path: Maintain a strict 48-hour SLA for unresolved risks or policy triggers.

* Playbook & SOP Ownership: Own and maintain regional event SOPs, training materials, and intake workflows. Ensure standard operating procedures are easily executable by any local DRI.
* High-Profile Program & Multi-Site Delivery
* Program Execution Lead: Directly lead and coordinate delivery for high-visibility, high-touch, and complex events across APAC, including Convergence, Executive Visits, Board/VIP Events, EBC Visits, SKO, and Summer Parties.
* Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as the regional nexus between cross-functional partner teams:

+ AV / IT: Tag and align AV DRIs via Summit/Jira for specialty spaces (EPS, EDU, All-Hands), recordings, and hybrid setups.
+ Corporate Security: Ensure guest lists are submitted via Jira 1+ week prior for external events, enforce alcohol/bartender rules (e.g., third-party licensed bartenders for 50+ external attendees with alcohol), and manage access control.
+ EHS (Environmental Health & Safety): Review medium/high safety risk triggers (open flames, space alterations, heavy equipment, over-capacity) and collaborate with EHS DRIs.
+ Food & Catering: Coordinate catering pilots, vendor logistics, and budget tracking.

* Risk Mitigation & Decision Making: Evaluate request feasibility against the 5-Question Review Framework (Policy, Relevance, Operational Feasibility, Dependencies, Governance) and process LT/OG/CEO exception approvals when required.
* Community Leadership, DRI Coaching & Global Alignment
* DRI Coaching: Provide continuous 1:1 coaching, onboarding, and operational guidance for the 6 local Event DRIs (Workplace/Facility Coordinators) across APAC sites.
* Regional Community: Facilitate bi-weekly APAC Event DRI alignment calls to share best practices, address common friction points, and review systemic issues.
* Global Peer Sync: Participate in monthly synchronization calls with AMER and EMEA Event Managers to drive global parity, tool consistency, and playbook evolution.
* Metrics, Budget & Strategic Initiatives
* Reporting & Benchmarking: Maintain the regional KPI dashboard and synthesize monthly metrics for MBRs. Benchmark cost-per-event-type across APAC sites.
* Budget Tracking: Track event execution spend against site-level budgets, flag overruns early, and enforce T&E policies.
* Strategic Rollouts: Lead regional implementation of core programs, including the Trailhead office event directory, Kai skills rollout, site catering pilot expansions, and Site Support Profile definitions.
* Site Onboarding: Own the end-to-end event operational setup for new Stripe APAC office openings.
* Local Bengaluru Operations Support
* Site Event Delivery: Provide hands-on coordination and execution support for Bengaluru office events
* Operational Continuity & Coverage: Serve as secondary line of coverage for Bengaluru site team absences and leave (Workplace Manager, Receptionist,).
* Administrative Support: Manage vendor relations, purchase order (PO) processing, front-of-house operations, and general administrative tasking.

Position Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Ticket Audit & SLA Compliance: 1 business day for ticket review/acknowledgement; 100% compliance with 48-hour escalation resolution.
* Data Integrity: 100% compliance of Summit system ticket updates, active Slack communications, and regional event tracker alignment.
* Escalation SLA: 48-hour maximum turnaround for regional approval/decline workflows.
* Partner Alignment: Early, accurate tagging of AV, Security, Food, and EHS cross-functional DRIs prior to setting ticket status to "Scheduled".
* DRI Capability & Adoption: 100% DRI participation in bi-weekly syncs and high baseline scores on quarterly playbook compliance reviews.

title: Operations Lead- Commerce Vertical
description:
**About Scapia**

Scapia is one of India's fastest-growing consumer technology platforms, bringing together fintech, travel, and commerce. Powered by our credit card, travel platform, and rewards ecosystem, we help members turn everyday spending into rewarding travel and shopping experiences.

**About Scapia Store**

Scapia Store is our members' destination for an active lifestyle, bringing together handpicked brands across sneakers, sports shoes, athleisure, and more. Curated for workdays, weekends, and the next getaway, with exceptional value through Scapia Coins on every purchase.

We're building India's most loved active lifestyle shopping destination, combining great brands, compelling value, and delightful customer experiences. We're early in this journey, already working with 100+ brands, with ambitions to grow manifold in the coming years.

We're a team of passionate builders who thrive on ownership, move fast, challenge each other, and put customer delight at the centre of everything we do.

**The Role: Operations Lead**

We're looking for a
**hands-on, entrepreneurial Operations Lead to build and scale end-to-end marketplace operations for Scapia Store.**

You'll own the entire operational lifecycle from inventory and order management to fulfilment, logistics, returns, and seller and customer experience. Your goal is to build a reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient operations engine that delivers exceptional experiences for customers and sellers.

This is a
**build-and-operate role**
, where you'll design processes, manage daily execution, solve complex operational problems, and build capabilities that scale with the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Supply Chain & Fulfilment**

* Design and optimise fulfilment networks across seller warehouses, third-party warehouses, and logistics partners.
* Own inventory management, order routing, picking, packing, dispatch, and delivery processes.
* Drive improvements in fulfilment speed, reliability, and cost efficiency.

**2. Order Management & Customer Experience**

* Own end-to-end order execution and build a strong operational control tower.
* Monitor order health, seller SLAs, delivery breaches, cancellations, and exceptions.
* Proactively resolve operational bottlenecks and improve customer experience.

**3. Seller Operations**

* Build scalable seller operating processes covering inventory readiness, order fulfilment, dispatch, and returns.
* Define and manage seller SLAs, performance scorecards, and operational standards.
* Drive seller performance and deliver a seamless seller experience.

**4. Logistics, Returns & Partner Management**

* Own first-mile, last-mile, and reverse logistics operations.
* Manage third-party logistics, warehousing, and order management partners, including selection, negotiations, and performance.
* Optimise returns, quality checks, claims, and liquidation processes.
* Own fulfilment costs, partner rate cards, and operational unit economics.

**5. Operational Excellence & Scale**

* Build dashboards and operating reviews to track SLAs, breaches, fulfilment performance, and costs.
* Drive root-cause analysis, process improvements, and automation to eliminate recurring issues.
* Partner with product, engineering, business, and customer experience teams to build scalable operational systems.

**What You'll Need**

* **10+ years of experience**
  in marketplace operations, e-commerce operations, supply chain, or fulfilment, preferably in a fast-growing consumer technology company.
* Strong understanding of the e-commerce order lifecycle, seller operations, warehousing, logistics, and returns.
* Experience managing third-party partners, sellers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Proven ability to both
  **build operational processes from scratch and manage day-to-day execution**
  .
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to dive deep into data, identify root causes, and drive improvements.
* Ability to balance customer experience, operational performance, and cost efficiency.
* High ownership, attention to detail, bias for action, and comfort with ambiguity in a 0-to-1 environment.

**Why Join Us?**

You'll have the opportunity to build the operational backbone of a fast-growing commerce business, with significant ownership and the freedom to shape how we scale.

If you love building from scratch, solving tough operational challenges, and delivering exceptional customer experiences,
**we'd love to hear from you.**

**Role Directly Reports To**
Senior Chief Manager – Logistic & Customer Service.
  
  
**Positions Reporting Into This Role**

* Executive – Regional Logistics
* CFA / Warehouse Operations Team (functional coordination and supervision)
* Essential Qualifications
* Graduate in any discipline with a full-time MBA / PGDM in Supply Chain Management, Logistics or Operations Management preferred.
* Additional certification in Logistics, Warehouse Management or Supply Chain Management will be an advantage.
* Essential Skills & Experience
* 5-8 years of overall experience in Supply Chain, Logistics and Distribution, with at least 5 years in a regional logistics management role.
* Experience preferably in FMCG, Consumer Products or Pharmaceutical industries.
* Strong experience in managing multiple CFAs, warehouses, hubs and regional transportation networks.
* Hands-on experience in secondary transportation management, freight negotiations and cost optimization.
* Experience in managing E-commerce, Modern Trade, CSD and Quick Commerce distribution operations.
* Working knowledge of SAP / SAP HANA, preferably SAP SD and MM modules.
* Experience in WMS implementation, warehouse automation and process improvement will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, financial and problem-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, communication and leadership skills.
* Ability to manage large operational teams, 3PL partners and multiple regional locations.
* Key Roles & Responsibilities
* Regional Distribution Planning & Inventory Management
* Ensure effective distribution planning in coordination with Supply Chain Planning, Procurement, Manufacturing Units and Sales Teams.
* Monitor Plan Vs Dispatch adherence and ensure timely stock availability at all regional CFAs.
* Maintain optimum inventory levels at CFA/SKU level in line with sales forecasts and business requirements.
* Plan direct dispatches and optimize volumetric movements wherever commercially viable.
* Coordinate stock allocation against E-commerce, Quick Commerce, Modern Trade and CSD orders / POs.
* Ensure timely stock connect for New Product Development (NPD) and product launches.
* Drive exception management, including inter-CFA transfers, non-moving inventory, excess and slow-moving stock.
* Ensure optimum inventory utilization and adherence to FEFO/FIFO guidelines.
* Monitor stock availability, ageing and inventory accuracy across all regional locations.
* Secondary Logistics Management
* Manage the regional transportation infrastructure covering CFA-to-customer movements.
* Ensure optimum vehicle utilization, route planning and transporter allocation.
* Drive freight cost optimization through effective transporter negotiations, rate benchmarking and route rationalization.
* Ensure adherence to approved freight budgets and regional AOP targets.
* Monitor transit time, vehicle placement, dispatch planning and delivery performance.
* Optimize transportation modes based on product mix, volume, distance and customer requirements.
* Ensure timely transporter invoice verification, processing and payment coordination.
* Manage delayed consignments, transit damages, permits, documentation and other logistics exceptions.
* Coordinate with Corporate Insurance / Finance teams for transit insurance and claims settlement.
* Drive continuous improvement in logistics productivity and cost per case / cost as a percentage of sales.
* CFA & Warehouse Operations Management
* Ensure efficient management and operational governance of all regional CFAs, hubs and warehouses.
* Monitor warehouse space utilization, storage capacity, manpower productivity and material handling efficiency.
* Ensure inventory record accuracy, physical verification and timely reconciliation of stock discrepancies.
* Monitor FEFO/FIFO compliance, batch management and expiry / damage stock segregation.
* Ensure timely processing of saleable returns, damages, expiries, credit notes and stock adjustments.
* Drive warehouse hygiene, safety, statutory compliance and audit readiness.
* Monitor CFA Scorecard performance and implement corrective action plans for underperforming locations.
* Ensure timely uploading of Proof of Delivery (POD), Goods Receipt Notes (GRN) and other operational documents.
* Identify capacity constraints and initiate warehouse expansion, relocation or temporary space arrangements.
* Ensure effective CFA contract management, SLA adherence and periodic performance reviews.
* Customer Service & Distribution Excellence
* Ensure achievement of regional OTIF, targets across MT, CSD, E-commerce, Quick Commerce and GT channels.
* Monitor order fulfilment, billing and delivery turnaround time.
* Drive timely resolution of customer complaints, delivery issues, POD pendency and appointment-related delays.
* Coordinate with Sales and Distribution teams to improve serviceability and customer experience.
* Monitor invoice-wise delivery performance and proactively resolve last-mile challenges.
* Ensure continuous tracking of service-level performance through regular MIS and review mechanisms.
* E-commerce & Quick Commerce Fulfilment
* Manage operational fulfilment requirements for E-commerce and Quick Commerce channels.
* Ensure effective stock connect and order fulfilment for D2C, Seller Flex, Vendor Flex and other fulfilment models.
* Coordinate with Amazon, Flipkart and other platform partners for timely dispatches and deliveries.
* Ensure adherence to customer appointment schedules, order SLAs and fulfilment requirements.
* Optimize direct dispatches and volumetric movements for E-commerce locations.
* Monitor order pendency, cancellation, fulfilment efficiency and delivery performance.
* Financial Management & Cost Optimization
* Ensure regional logistics and distribution expenditure remains within approved AOP budgets.
* Monitor distribution cost as a percentage of sales and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Drive freight rationalization, vehicle utilization improvement, warehouse productivity and operational efficiencies.
* Monitor EBITDA contribution through logistics cost control and process optimization.
* Ensure proper verification of transporter, CFA and 3PL invoices before processing.
* Identify and eliminate avoidable costs arising from detention, underutilization, excess storage and operational inefficiencies.
* Process Compliance, Governance & Operational Excellence
* Ensure compliance with internal SOPs, statutory requirements, CFA agreements and operational policies.
* Drive monthly CSRM activities and half-yearly NDC collection as per the prescribed timelines.
* Ensure timely completion of internal, statutory and third-party audits.
* Drive closure of audit observations and corrective / preventive actions.
* Monitor documentation, POD, GRN, claims and credit note issuance within agreed TAT.
* Ensure operational support for Embellishment Operations, Pirakart, Piraflex and other business initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement, standardization and process digitization across regional operations.
* WMS Implementation & Digital Transformation
* Lead WMS implementation across identified regional hubs / warehouses.
* Ensure timely project execution, master data readiness, process mapping and system integration.
* Coordinate with IT, WMS vendors and operational teams for successful rollout.
* Ensure user training, change management and operational stabilization after go-live.
* Improve warehouse productivity through system-driven picking, put-away, inventory tracking and dispatch processes.
* Monitor system performance and ensure timely resolution of critical operational issues.
* Team Management & Stakeholder Coordination
* Lead, guide and develop the regional logistics and distribution team.
* Establish clear performance objectives and review individual and team KPIs.
* Drive accountability, operational discipline and cross-functional collaboration.
* Conduct periodic performance reviews with CFAs, transporters and service providers.
* Build a strong operational review mechanism through daily MIS, monthly performance reviews and action tracking.
* Develop a culture of customer focus, cost consciousness, ownership and continuous improvement.

title: Service Delivery Manager- Lead Managed Services Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help transform technology platforms, driving innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Lead Managed Services Engineer II
  
  
As a Lead Manager Services Engineer II at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of enterprise-scale software solutions, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will collaborate to understand functional requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end-to-end project delivery, including estimation and planning, to ensure successful outcomes.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Own end-to-end delivery of managed infrastructure services across on-premises, network, and cloud environments while meeting contractual service-level agreements, key performance indicators, customer satisfaction targets, and compliance requirements.
* Lead client governance forums, major incident and escalation management, root-cause analysis, and preventive actions; ensure adherence to Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL)-aligned service-management processes.
* Coordinate delivery across compute, storage, network, cloud, database, middleware, end-user, security operations, and service desk teams; maintain ownership models and escalation paths with client teams and third-party vendors.
* Lead and develop multi-location delivery teams, including team leads, shift managers, and specialists; manage capacity planning, staffing, skill development, attrition, and succession.
* Drive automation-first transformation through monitoring, event correlation, intelligent triage, provisioning, patching, runbook automation, artificial intelligence for information technology operations (AIOps), and self-healing capabilities; measure impact on mean time to resolution, ticket volume, manual effort, and incident recurrence.
* Manage delivery risks, scope, change requests, and delivery financial performance; support account transitions, sales and proposal activities, renewals, extensions, and growth opportunities.

At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing, and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai (preferred)
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
Rotational Shifts
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 12–18 years of experience delivering information technology infrastructure services, including managing managed-services engagements.
* Experience managing on-premises data center, network, and cloud environments using Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience meeting contractual service-level agreement, customer-satisfaction, and compliance targets in managed-services environments, including client governance and escalation management.
* Experience leading infrastructure delivery teams of 100+ professionals across technology towers, including people managers.
* Experience using ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, release, capacity, availability, and configuration management processes; ServiceNow; and observability or monitoring platforms.
* Experience delivering automation, AIOps, or self-healing initiatives with documented measures of mean time to resolution, ticket volume, manual effort, or incident recurrence.
* Experience leading service-delivery transformation, operating-model changes, account turnarounds, or account transitions, including change control and delivery financial management.

Preferred:
  
  

* ITIL 4 Foundation or higher, Project Management Professional, or PRINCE2 certification.
* AWS, Microsoft Azure, or GCP certification or cloud architecture experience.
* Experience using ServiceNow, Dynatrace, Datadog, Splunk, or Moogsoft for service management, observability, or AIOps.
* Experience using Terraform, Ansible, or Python for infrastructure automation.
* Experience applying generative artificial intelligence or agentic artificial intelligence to infrastructure operations.
* Experience in global delivery models, multi-vendor environments, account transitions, or large-deal onboarding.

title: Manager, Managed Services
description:
**Why project44?**

 

 

At project44, we believe in better. 

 

We challenge the status quo because we know a better supply chain isn't just possible—it's essential. Better for our customers. Better for their business. Better for the world. 

 

With our
**Decision Intelligence Platform, Movement,**

we're redefining how global supply chains operate. By transforming fragmented logistics data into real-time, AI-powered insights, we empower companies to connect instantly, see clearly, act decisively, and automate intelligently. Our Supply Chain AI enhances visibility, drives smarter execution, and unlocks next-gen applications that keep businesses moving forward. 

 

Headquartered in Chicago, IL with a 2nd HQ in Bengaluru, India we are powered by a diverse global team that is tackling the toughest logistics challenges with innovation, urgency, and purpose. 

 

**AI at project44**

 

 

We expect every project44 team member, regardless of role or function, to actively leverage AI in their day-to-day work. Whether you're building product, serving customers, managing people, or running operations, AI is a tool you're expected to use with intent, curiosity, and judgment. We don't expect everyone to be a data scientist. We do expect everyone to be an intelligent user of AI: able to identify where it adds value, direct it effectively, evaluate outputs critically, and govern it responsibly. We invest in our team's AI fluency because we believe it's a competitive advantage for every person at project44, not just our engineers. 

 

If you're driven to solve meaningful problems, leverage AI to scale rapidly, drive impact daily, and be part of a high-performance team – we should talk.

 

 

**Role Overview**

 

As a
**Manager,**
**Managed Service**

, you will play a highly visible role partnering with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure world class delivery across a diverse portfolio. You will drive customer value through data analysis, operational excellence and proactive project management. This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving and requires the ability to influence stakeholders, manage multiple complex accounts and translate insights into long-term solutions.

 

As the Manager, Managed Services, you will lead a team of Managed Service Consultants and own the delivery of a diverse portfolio of

enterprise

and strategic customers. You will partner with business leaders, customers and carriers to ensure

strong outcomes in

adoption

, data

quality

and service performance

, and you will set the operational standards, analytics practices and people development that make the team successful. This role blends strategic leadership with hands-on problem solving. You will influence senior stakeholders, coach your team through complex accounts and turn data insights into scalable, long-term solutions. This role reports to VP,

Customer experience, manages a team of 5+ consultants and covers global region. Location: Bengaluru

 

**What You Will Work On**

* Hire

  , onboard, lead, coach and develop a team of Managed Service Consultants, setting clear goals, giving regular feedback and building a strong, high-performing culture.

* Own the health of the team’s customer portfolio, including delivery timelines, milestones, end-to-end project plans and risk management across global regions and multiple project44 products.

* Serve as an executive point of contact for key customers and carriers and escalate and resolve complex issues.

* Set the strategy for carrier initiatives, from planning through adoption, and review data-driven insights and best-practice recommendations presented by the team.

* Drive a culture of deep-dive data analysis, ensuring the team identifies patterns, uncovers root causes and delivers improvements that increase data quality and availability, using visualization tools and internal data platforms to triage errors and speed up issue resolution.

* Define and monitor team KPIs, review progress across accounts, and publish regular reports to leadership that highlight risks and business impact.

* Hold customers, carriers and internal teams accountable for actions that improve operational outcomes.

* Partner with Product, Support, Carrier Operations, Engineering and Sales to drive customer value, and represent the voice of the customer and carrier in cross-functional forums.

* Develop and maintain SOPs, playbooks and process improvements that raise quality, consistency and efficiency across the Managed Services practice, and identify process gaps and share scalable solutions across the organization.

* Allocate and balance workload across the team, and manage capacity, prioritization and competing demands.

* Maintain a deep understanding of carrier integration methods across modes, and guide the team’s technical decision-making.

What You Need

 

* 8+ years of experience in data analysis, operations, consulting or account management, including at least two years leading or managing a team.

* Experience in SaaS, software or logistics is preferred.

* Proven ability to manage a complex portfolio of enterprise customers and to lead multiple projects with competing priorities.

* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and executive audiences.

* Solid understanding of source data, data formats (such as EDI, API and file-based feeds) and data behaviour.

* Proficiency in Excel and SQL, and familiarity with visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Kibana or Observe.

* Experience with APIs or basic coding concepts is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor and develop talent, and to manage performance.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels and a customer-focused, problem-solving mindset.

* Exceptional organizational skills and a track record of process improvement.
* Fluency in English and Spanish. Additional languages are a plus.

**In-office Commitment:**

Our office is where ideas spark, connections thrive, and innovation comes alive. The expectation is to be on-site,
**in office five days a week**

as this offers the chance to immerse yourself in the energy of the office and collaborate with your co-workers. Together, we’re building something extraordinary—learn, grow, and thrive in our fast-paced, transformative environment.

 

**Diversity & Inclusion:**

 

At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a truly world-class product and experience, we are also intentionally building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

 

We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the actions of our leadership, global teams and individual team members. We are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.

 

project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!

 

For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, please email


recruiting@project44.com

. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

 

**More about project44:**

 

Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest, most important global industries does business. As transportation and logistics continue to evolve and customer expectations around delivery become more demanding, industry technology must rise to the occasion. In just a few short years, we have created a digital infrastructure that eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual processes. Our Advanced Visibility Platform is used by the world’s leading brands to track shipments, collaborate with supply chain partners, drive operational efficiencies, and create outstanding customer experiences.

title: Outlet Manager / Outlet Assistant Manager
description:

* Team Leadership: Supervise, train, and motivate staff to deliver exceptional guest experiences and maintain high performance.
* Guest Experience Management: Ensure personalized service, handle guest feedback, and resolve issues promptly to enhance satisfaction.
* Inventory & Cost Control: Monitor stock levels, manage ordering, and control costs to optimize profitability.
* Sales & Revenue Support: Drive upselling initiatives, monitor sales performance, and support revenue targets.
* Compliance & Hygiene: Ensure adherence to health, safety, and hygiene regulations across all outlet areas.
* Coordination & Communication: Collaborate with kitchen, housekeeping, and other departments for seamless service delivery.
* Food Safety Regulations: Ensuring that all food safety standards are met.

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**

* Proven experience as an Outlet Manager or similar role in a high-end restaurant or hotel, or 2-3 years as an Assistant Manager.
* Assistant Manager: The ideal candidate should possess at least 1 year of experience as an Assistant Outlet Manager.
* High school diploma or equivalent; hospitality training is a plus
* Excellent communication, grooming, and interpersonal skills
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage
* Friendly, professional, and guest-focused
* Able to work flexible shifts

**About Us**

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
  
  
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. title: Technology Operational Reporting & Insights Lead Grade Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As an Operational Reporting & Insights Lead - Manager, you will focus on utilizing advanced analytical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will leverage skills in data manipulation, visualization, and statistical modeling to support clients in solving complex business problems. As a Manager, you will enhance your leadership style, motivating and developing your team to deliver quality results. You will be responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to meet client expectations. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will take ownership of projects, validating their successful planning, budgeting, execution, and completion. You will work with team leadership to establish collective ownership of quality, timelines, and deliverables. By embracing technology and innovation, you will enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same. This position offers an opportunity to develop skills outside your comfort zone and mentor others, contributing to the success of our firm.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support the development and delivery of technology operational reporting, dashboards, insights, and governance materials across Tech Hub
* Build and refine operational reporting processes to improve accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and decision support
* Develop proof of concepts and automation solutions to streamline reporting, reduce manual effort, and improve operational effectiveness
* Use AI-enabled tools and approaches to improve data analysis, reporting quality, process efficiency, and insight generation
* Apply financial acumen to incorporate relevant financial metrics into operational performance reporting and management insights
* Support continuous improvement initiatives that simplify ways of working, reduce waste, and strengthen operational disciplines
* Support preparation of high-quality presentations, papers, and reporting packs for governance forums, Technology Leadership, and other stakeholders
* Partner with Finance, Technology teams, and business stakeholders to translate operational and financial data into clear insights and recommendations
* Ensure reporting outputs, automation artefacts, and performance insights are accurate, timely, well-controlled, and aligned to leadership expectations

What You Must Have
  
  

* Any Graduate
* At least 8-14 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Experience in technology operational reporting, performance reporting, business operations, or governance support within a technology environment
* Ability to build, manage, and continuously improve reporting processes, dashboards, metrics, and insight packs
* Experience developing proof of concepts, automation opportunities, and process improvements that reduce manual effort and improve reporting quality
* Ability to utilise AI-enabled tools to support analysis, reporting, automation, process improvement, and insight generation
* Financial acumen, including the ability to incorporate financial metrics into operational performance reporting and management insights
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate operational and financial data into clear insights and recommendations
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work with Technology teams, Finance, governance stakeholders, and business partners
* Ability to prepare clear, high-quality reporting packs, presentations, and governance materials for management and leadership audiences
* High attention to detail, quality, accuracy, and consistency in reporting, analysis, and stakeholder communications
* An experienced technical expert who uses your specialised skills to provide advice, influence others, and help by directly contributing to solutions.
* Ability to solve complex work problems leveraging overarching guardrails, experience and strong judgement.
