title: Manager, Service Excellence
description:
**Job Summary**
Reporting to the Director of Service Excellence, the Service Excellence Manager will help improve how People Services & Solutions (PSS) delivers services to colleagues, while also leading the transition of People processes into PSS.
  
  
The role will focus primarily on service excellence, including service quality, operational performance, governance, continuous improvement and colleague experience. It will also play an important role in managing process transitions into PSS and ensuring new services are ready for successful delivery.
  
  
You will work with People leaders, Centres of Excellence (CoEs), PSS teams and project teams across regions. You will use data, feedback and service insights to improve performance, strengthen service delivery and help teams adopt new processes and ways of working.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Improve Service Quality and Colleague Experience
  
  
You will help strengthen service delivery across PSS by using service measures, colleague feedback and operational data to understand performance and focus improvement efforts.
  
  
You will support a consistent approach to service quality across teams and locations. This includes reviewing service performance, understanding trends and helping teams make practical changes that improve quality, efficiency and colleague experience.
  
  
You will also help develop service measures and dashboards that give teams clear information to support day-to-day decisions and monitor progress.
  
  
Strengthen Operational Performance
  
  
You will help PSS teams build strong and sustainable service practices through regular performance reviews, clear measures and effective operational controls.
  
  
Working with service delivery teams and leaders, you will help strengthen quality, capability and operational rigor. You will use service reviews and data to highlight areas that need attention and work with teams to address them.
  
  
You will support risk assessments and help ensure appropriate controls are in place to protect service quality and continuity.
  
  
Build Service Capability
  
  
You will help PSS teams develop the skills and knowledge needed to provide a positive and consistent colleague experience.
  
  
This will include coaching, sharing practical guidance and supporting learning activities that strengthen service behaviours, problem-solving and continuous improvement.
  
  
You will encourage teams to learn from feedback, share what works and recognise improvements that make a significant difference to colleagues.
  
  
Lead People Process Transitions
  
  
You will plan and manage the transition of People processes into PSS, from initial planning through knowledge transfer, implementation and stabilisation.
  
  
You will work with the teams involved to agree scope, responsibilities, timelines and readiness requirements. You will track progress, manage risks and help resolve issues that could affect the transition.
  
  
You will make sure essential materials are ready for use, including Desktop Procedures (DTPs), process maps, SLAs/OLAs and training materials. You will also help PSS teams build the knowledge and confidence needed to take ownership of new services.
  
  
Support People Through Change
  
  
You will help colleagues prepare for changes to processes, systems and ways of working. This includes understanding the impact of change, supporting communications and training, and checking that teams are ready before services move into PSS.
  
  
You will bring together different perspectives and encourage open discussion. Communication, training and transition activities should consider the different needs of colleagues across teams and locations.
  
  
Turn Data into Action
  
  
You will use service measures, quality reviews, colleague feedback and operational data to understand patterns and service trends.
  
  
You will turn these insights into practical recommendations that help teams improve service quality, simplify processes and strengthen colleague experience.
  
  
What You’ll Bring
  
  
You will bring experience in service excellence, service delivery, People Operations, HR operations, process improvement, transitions or a related area.
  
  
You will be comfortable working with data, understanding service performance and turning findings into practical improvements. You will be able to organise complex work, communicate clearly and build positive working relationships across teams, levels and regions.
  
  
Experience with service quality, operational governance, organisational change, process mapping or continuous improvement would be useful. Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Voice of the Customer, Workday, ServiceNow or process mapping tools would also be helpful, but you do not need experience in all of these areas.
  
  
You should be comfortable using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  
  
We recognise that relevant skills can be gained through different roles, industries and career paths.
**You do not need to meet every desirable criterion to apply.**
**Career Stage:**
Manager
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.
  
  
Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.

description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
YOUR IMPACT
  
  
As
**Sr. Manager, People Services - India & Global Services Team**
, you will lead People Services delivery for India while also overseeing a centralized Global Services Team responsible for consistent, high-quality HR lifecycle transactions at scale.
  
  
You will play a critical leadership role in creating a connected employee and manager experience, simplifying and standardizing HR operations, strengthening data quality and controls, and accelerating automation and AI-enabled service delivery.
  
  
Working closely with HR Shared Services, Payroll, Centres of Excellence, Technology, Automation & AI, and regional People Services teams, you will help build a scalable, efficient and future-ready People Services organization.

* Lead the Global Services Team, delivering standardized HR transactions across multiple countries through common processes, service measures and operating standards.

* Ensure India HR operations meet applicable statutory, regulatory, policy, audit, data privacy and record-retention requirements.

* Forecast demand and manage capacity, peaks, service risks, cross-training and workload across teams and time zones.
* Maintain strong SOPs, playbooks, work instructions and control frameworks across the operation.
* Partner with People Services leaders across the Americas, EMEA and APJ to clarify global and regional ownership and continuously improve service delivery.

* Lead operational transitions and migration waves while protecting employee experience and service continuity. [JD - Sr. M...m v1.1.pdf]

* Strong understanding of employee lifecycle transactions, service management, capacity planning, operational controls and quality assurance.
* Experience using operational data and service metrics to improve SLA performance, cycle time, quality, productivity and customer experience.

* Strong understanding of controls, segregation of duties, data privacy, audit requirements and compliance in a multi-country environment.
* Working knowledge of India HR statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to work across HR, Payroll, Technology, COEs and geographically distributed teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Operations or a related discipline.
* Lean/Six Sigma, PMP/PRINCE2, change management or HR technology certification is desirable.

**How You'll Make a Difference**
Success in this role will mean:
  
  

* Consistently strong SLA, cycle-time and first-time-right performance.
* Improved employee and manager experience with fewer hand-offs and escalations.
* High levels of HR data accuracy and audit readiness.
* Reduced manual processing through standardization, automation and AI.
* Effective management of demand, capacity, backlog and service risk.
* Successful global process migrations without disruption to service.
* Strong team engagement, cross-skilling and leadership capability.
* A measurable shift toward simpler, scalable and globally consistent People Services.

title: Cluster Manager – Retailer Business Expansion & C&F Operations
description:
Company Description

OLTOWNS is building India's largest organized retail ecosystem for Tier-2, Tier-3, and rural markets through supermarkets, retailer commerce, quick commerce, technology, and AI-powered retail solutions.

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Cluster Manager – Retailer Business Expansion & C&F Operations**
to lead our distribution network expansion across Karnataka. The candidate will be responsible for identifying and onboarding C&F partners, developing the retailer network, driving market penetration, and building a scalable distribution ecosystem.

Role Description

The Cluster Manager will be responsible for expanding OLTOWNS' retailer business across assigned clusters in Karnataka by establishing a strong C&F (Carrying & Forwarding) partner network and onboarding retail stores.

The role involves identifying potential business partners, negotiating commercial agreements, building distribution infrastructure, acquiring retailers, driving sales, and ensuring sustainable business growth across assigned territories.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in FMCG distribution, general trade, channel sales, and distributor network expansion.

Key Responsibilities
  
1. C&F Network Development

* Identify, evaluate, and onboard C&F partners across assigned territories.
* Develop a strong C&F network to support OLTOWNS' distribution expansion.
* Identify suitable C&F infrastructure based on storage capacity, location, and operational capabilities.
* Negotiate commercial terms, agreements, margins, and operational SLAs with C&F partners.
* Build and maintain long-term relationships with C&F operators and distribution partners.
* Ensure smooth coordination between C&F partners, warehouses, and retailers.

2. Retailer Network Expansion

* Drive retailer acquisition and expansion across Tier-2, Tier-3, and rural markets.
* Identify and onboard Kirana stores, independent retailers, and general trade outlets.
* Develop territory-wise retailer acquisition and expansion strategies.
* Build a strong network of active retailers through OLTOWNS' retailer commerce platform.
* Drive retailer activation, repeat ordering, and monthly business growth.
* Ensure achievement of retailer onboarding and revenue targets.

3. Sales & Business Development

* Develop and execute cluster-wise business expansion plans.
* Drive primary and secondary sales across assigned territories.
* Identify new market opportunities and potential business locations.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue, sales, and retailer acquisition targets.
* Develop strong relationships with FMCG distributors, wholesalers, manufacturers, and retail partners.
* Monitor competitor activities, market pricing, and distribution opportunities.

4. Distribution & Operations Management

* Ensure efficient order processing, inventory availability, and timely deliveries.
* Monitor stock movement, fill rates, order fulfilment, and distributor performance.
* Coordinate with procurement, warehouse, logistics, finance, and technology teams.
* Ensure efficient working capital and credit management across the distribution network.
* Monitor C&F and retailer-level operational performance.
* Implement standard operating procedures across the assigned cluster.

5. Team Management & Reporting

* Build and manage a team of Business Development Executives and Field Sales Representatives.
* Set territory-wise targets and monitor team performance.
* Conduct regular market visits and review retailer acquisition activities.
* Prepare monthly business performance and expansion reports.
* Track KPIs including active retailers, new retailer onboarding, sales volume, revenue, C&F coverage, and repeat orders.

Eligibility

* Minimum
  **5 years of experience**
  in FMCG distribution, general trade, channel sales, or retail business development.
* Proven experience in appointing and managing C&F agents, distributors, or stockists.
* Strong experience in retailer acquisition and distribution network expansion.
* Experience managing multiple territories or clusters.
* Good understanding of FMCG distribution models, general trade, and supply chain operations.
* Proven track record of achieving sales and business expansion targets.
* Strong commercial negotiation, relationship management, and leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across Karnataka.

Preferred Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management preferred.
* Prior experience with leading FMCG companies, distributors, or organized retail businesses.
* Experience with companies such as HUL, ITC, Reliance Retail, D-Mart, Metro Cash & Carry, JioMart, Udaan, or similar FMCG and distribution organizations.
* Experience in building distribution networks in Tier-2, Tier-3, and rural markets.
* Knowledge of ERP, distribution management systems, and CRM platforms.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and business reporting.

What We Offer

* Salary up to
  **₹2,00,000 per month**
  , based on experience and capability.
* Opportunity to lead large-scale distribution and retailer network expansion.
* Leadership role in a fast-growing retail and technology ecosystem.
* Opportunity to build and scale a distribution network across Karnataka.
* Dynamic and entrepreneurial work environment.

title: Business Manager
description:
**Company Description**
First Adviser | Your Loan Partner is one of the youngest and fastest-growing corporate channel partners in India, working with leading banks and financial institutions across the country. Founded in 2017–2018 by experienced ex-bankers, the company focuses on retail loans for emerging and deeper geographical markets. It offers a wide range of unsecured and secured loan products, including personal, business, professional, home, mortgage, SME, and vehicle loans. First Adviser operates through a multifaceted sourcing model that includes telemarketing teams, field staff, business development managers, corporate partnerships, and an expanding agency network, supported by a strong second-layer team of ex-bankers for localized business development. The company leverages AI-powered lending solutions, automated platforms, and digital payment integration to deliver transparent, ethical, and customer-centric experiences while empowering individuals and businesses across India.
  
**Role Description**
The Business Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Bengaluru. The Business Manager will oversee day-to-day branch and business operations, including managing loan sourcing activities, monitoring sales performance, and ensuring compliance with partner bank and financial institution guidelines. This role will involve coordinating with telemarketing teams, field staff, business development managers, and agency partners to drive loan volumes and maintain high service standards. The Business Manager will analyze portfolio performance, track key metrics, and implement strategies to improve productivity, customer satisfaction, and profitability. Responsibilities also include stakeholder management, local market development, risk awareness, and alignment with the company’s ethics-driven approach to transparency and data security.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong business operations and team management skills, including experience in supervising sales or branch staff and coordinating cross-functional activities.
* Proficiency in retail lending and financial products, with familiarity in personal, business, home, mortgage, SME, and vehicle loans.
* Ability to develop and execute local business development strategies, manage corporate tie-ups, and nurture agency and channel partner networks.
* Solid analytical and reporting skills, including comfort with dashboards, portfolio analysis, performance tracking, and basic financial metrics.
* Understanding of compliance, risk management, and data security practices in banking or NBFC environments.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills to work with internal teams, partners, and customers in a diverse, fast-paced setting.
* Comfort with technology-driven processes, including digital platforms, CRM tools, and automated lending or payment systems.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field; MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in banking, NBFCs, or financial services, ideally in retail lending or channel partner management, is strongly preferred.

Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**
, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end mid-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
  
  
Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To manage mid-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
Hub Operations Management
  
  
  

* Lead day-to-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.

Mid Mile Network Operations
  
  
  

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time-definite shipments across the network.

Network Coordination & Exception Management
  
  
  

* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.

Workforce & Shift Leadership
  
  
  

* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.

Fleet, Capacity & Resource Management
  
  
  

* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.

**Service Quality & Operational Excellence**

* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.

Safety, Security & Compliance
  
  
  

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.

Stakeholder Management & Operational Communication
  
  
  

* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.

People Leadership & Capability Development
  
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on-the-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
**Education**
:
  
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**
:
  
  
  

* Senior Executive – Hub Operations (Grade N): 3–5 years of experience in hub operations, mid-mile logistics, transportation or express distribution.
* Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 - 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.
* Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network.
* Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management.
* Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high-volume, time-sensitive logistics environments.

**Skills & Capabilities:**
**Technical Competencies:**

title: DGM-IOA Delivery
description:
**Job Summary**
This hybrid role for DGM IOA Delivery focuses on overseeing end to end Procure to Pay and Operational Procurement delivery for a global enterprise while ensuring seamless process execution compliance and service excellence. The role requires ten to fourteen years of experience driving complex procurement operations and stakeholder outcomes with beneficial exposure to cards and payments and a strong orientation toward optimization risk control and business value creation in a day shift env
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive end to end delivery of Procure to Pay and Operational Procurement services to ensure timely and accurate processing of requisitions purchase orders and invoices across multiple business units in alignment with agreed service levels and quality standards.
* Oversee daily operational workflows across procurement cycles to reduce bottlenecks improve throughput and maintain high levels of process adherence while ensuring hybrid work model coordination between onsite and remote team members.
* Manage procurement related issue resolution by analyzing root causes collaborating with cross functional partners and implementing corrective actions that minimize recurrence and protect business continuity.
* Coordinate closely with finance sourcing and operations teams to ensure that Procure to Pay processes support working capital objectives supplier relationships and compliance with internal controls and external regulations.
* Optimize use of procurement and payment platforms by monitoring performance metrics identifying gaps and defining enhancement requests that improve automation data quality and user experience.
* Guide operational procurement activities such as catalog management spot buys and tactical sourcing to drive cost efficiency policy compliance and timely fulfillment of business needs.
* Monitor key performance indicators for procurement operations tracking cycle times accuracy exceptions and user satisfaction to provide structured reporting and actionable insights for senior stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures for Procure to Pay processes ensuring that documentation reflects current practices controls and technology while supporting efficient onboarding and cross training.
* Collaborate with risk and compliance partners to strengthen controls around approvals segregation of duties and supplier data management thereby reducing operational and financial risk exposure.
* Support transformation initiatives by assessing current procurement workflows proposing process redesign options and coordinating implementation activities that align with broader enterprise digital and automation roadmaps.
* Engage with business stakeholders to capture demand forecast procurement requirements and service feedback enabling continuous improvement and alignment of operational procurement services with evolving business strategies.
* Ensure data integrity and audit readiness across procurement transactions by enforcing validation checks maintaining accurate master data and responding effectively to internal and external audit requests.
* Drive knowledge sharing and capability building within the operations team by organizing training sessions reviewing complex procurement scenarios and promoting best practices across regions and functions.

**Qualifications**

* Possess solid experience of at least ten years in Procure to Pay operations handling requisition processing purchase order management invoice handling and vendor collaboration in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrate strong expertise in operational procurement including catalog management tactical sourcing and spot buying with a focus on cost efficiency policy compliance and cycle time improvement.
* Apply practical understanding of cards and payments domain to procurement transactions and payment flows where relevant contributing to safer smoother and more innovative financial operations.
* Utilize advanced skills with enterprise resource planning systems and procurement platforms to navigate transactions generate reports support automation and improve user experience across hybrid teams.
* Exhibit thorough knowledge of procurement compliance frameworks internal controls and risk mitigation methods enabling reliable audit support and reduction of operational incidents.
* Communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders across business finance and technology teams using clear concise and inclusive language to drive alignment and timely decision making.
* Maintain high levels of adaptability and problem solving capability to manage changing business volumes complex cases and new initiatives while preserving service stability during hybrid work arrangements.

title: Senior Treasury Staff Manager - Treasury Infrastructure

title: AGM - Engineering Hospitality

title: Head - Business Administration, UK GCC
description:
**Job Description**
The Head of Business Administration – GCC will work closely with the UK Leadership Team and the UK-based Business Solutions function to lead and develop the GCC Business Solutions team. The role is accountable for ensuring the team is appropriately resourced, operates effectively, and delivers high-quality support across a portfolio of administrative, project support, and graphic services.
  
  
Working in close collaboration with Senior Leadership Team members, Team Leaders and People Managers across both the UK and GCC, the role will drive operational excellence through consistent delivery standards, continuous improvement, and process simplification.
  
  
As the team continues to grow, the successful candidate will provide strong leadership and line management, with responsibility for resource planning, recruitment, capability development, and performance management. A strong working knowledge of Microsoft and Adobe tools is essential to support the team’s delivery requirements.
  
  
The role requires a proactive and self-directed individual with strong problem-solving capability, able to manage multiple priorities and identify effective solutions where required. Excellent communication skills are critical, enabling clear and concise engagement with stakeholders and effective direction to GCC-based team members on task and project delivery.
  
  
Attention to detail, the ability to work at pace, and a collaborative approach are essential. The role will continue to evolve, requiring ongoing flexibility and a willingness to self learn new systems, tools, and processes quickly and effectively.
  
  
A key focus of the role is to embed a “one team” culture across all teams and geographies, aligning purpose, ways of working, values, and behaviours.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Working in partnership with the UK Business Solutions Leadership team, the role is responsible for:
  
  
**Business and organisational insight**

* Developing a strong understanding of WSP UK and the wider organisation to enable effective alignment of services to business needs, projects, and teams.

**Operational leadership and resource management**

* Leading the day-to-day operations of the GCC Business Solutions team, ensuring effective resource planning, allocation and prioritisation to meet service demand.

**Team leadership and capability development**

* Providing leadership and line management to a multi-disciplinary team including PA services, Business and Project Support, Travel and Fleet, and Graphic Design. Accountable for recruitment, performance management and ongoing capability development.

**Performance management and reporting**

* Driving performance through robust reporting on utilisation, service delivery and team outputs. Identifying trends, risks and improvement opportunities to inform decision-making.

**Continuous improvement and innovation**

* Leading the identification and adoption of new technologies, tools and processes including automation, to enhance team efficiency, simplify delivery and improve service quality. Maintain exceptional design skills and understanding to accelerate team capability.

**Service delivery and quality oversight**

* Ensuring the consistent delivery of high-quality outputs across administrative, project support and graphic design and digital services, often within tight deadlines.

**Meet brand and design standards**

* Adhere corporate branding standards across all outputs. Provide guidance and mentorship to improve design quality and consistency across deliverables.

**Collaboration and knowledge sharing**

* Supporting the development of the wider UK Business Solutions function through knowledge sharing, training and best practice development.

**GCC team integration and support**

* Providing clear guidance and support to India-based team members to ensure effective delivery and alignment with UK requirements.

**Team engagement and communication**

* Leading team communication through briefings, team meetings and forums, encouraging contribution, feedback and continuous improvement.

**Clients and stakeholders**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders, contributing to overall service quality and client satisfaction.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing across internal and external forums to elevate the teams visibility.

**People**

* Lead inclusively by clearly articulating vision, setting expectations, defining responsibilities, and delegating effectively, while providing constructive feedback to support individual and team development.
* Contributes to building an inclusive and engaged function, with a focus on retention, talent attraction, and creating opportunities for career development and progression.
* Drive improvements in employee engagement (including Peakon outcomes) by implementing and tracking meaningful actions that enhance team experience.
* Provide visible leadership through regular communication, motivation and coaching, alongside effective performance management, including Personal Development Reviews and ongoing development conversations.
* Manage personnel matters in partnership with HR, ensuring appropriate handling of employee relations, recruitment, and organizational requirements.
* Support and lead recruitment activity in collaboration with the Senior Leadership Team, ensuring alignment to current and future capability needs.
* Foster a culture of trust and openness through the appropriate and confidential handling of sensitive information and employee-related matters.
* Manage conflict effectively and professionally, maintaining a positive and collaborative team environment.
* Work effectively across geographies and disciplines, embracing diverse perspectives and ensuring inclusive ways of working.

**Business Focus**

* Proactively promotes and influences a strong culture of health, safety and wellbeing across the team and wider function.
* Support the UK Business Solutions team in shaping and delivering clear, consistent communication strategies.
* Engage regularly with Directors, key stakeholders and teams to represent Business Solutions, strengthening visibility, building relationships and gathering feedback to inform future direction and decision-making.
* Act as a role model, championing standards and mentoring others to support individual and team development. Explore ways to add value and improve personal and team performance.

**Qualifications**

verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
  
  

* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

description:
Join us as a Trade & Transaction Reporting ManagerVP, Regulatory Reporting Assurance
  
  

* In this critical role, you’ll be supporting with trade and transaction reporting and the execution of a variety of processes
* You’ll contribute to leading and supporting key global change initiatives across the business and make sure regulatory requirement changes are met
* Take on a new career challenge and hone your analytic skills in a fastpaced, forward-thinking team
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Trade & Transaction Reporting Manager, you’ll be supporting with submissions to regulators for trade and transaction reporting and making sure that control framework is adhered to and remains compliant with our regulatory requirements. We’ll also look to you to build and manage a team providing guidance, acting as a subject matter expert with regard to various regulatory trade and transaction reporting, data validation and data controls for certain asset class.

We’re looking for someone who has a good understanding of relevant asset classes rates, credit, equity, FX and futures markets including vanilla and structured trading businesses. This will ideally have been gained from working in a middle office or operations environment. We’ll also expect you to have knowledge of regulatory reporting requirements and a moderate understanding of risk and control frameworks, including process documentation, control documentation and supervisory frameworks.

* Experience in global regulations like MIFID, MIFIR and working on Regulatory Reporting and assurance

* Experience of people management, with the ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders
* The ability to work within governance to creatively solve business challenges
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel
* The ability to maintain a focus on control and a keen attention to detail

title: Officer - Continuous Improvement
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Supply
  
  
Our supply chain is the backbone of our business. It's how we get our trusted products to people all over the world, safely and efficiently. And it's our talented and passionate teams that make this happen. If you're looking for a career in supply chain, there's no better place to be than Reckitt. We offer a variety of exciting opportunities in all areas of the supply chain, from planning and procurement to manufacturing and logistics. You could join our Global Supply Planning team to develop and implement our global supply strategy, or work with our Procurement Centre of Excellence team to negotiate and manage our supplier relationships. Our Manufacturing Excellence team help us improve the efficiency, quality and safety of our manufacturing operations, and our Logistics Excellence team develop new and innovative ways to distribute our products to customers.
  
  
**About The Role**
Seeking a leadership opportunity where you can mould the future of manufacturing? As a Coordinator at Reckitt, you'll be in the driver's seat, nurturing a team of dedicated factory employees. Your role is pivotal – you'll elevate your team's skill set, ensure the smooth running of our supply operations, and leave a lasting impact on our manufacturing process. We're inviting you to be a cornerstone of our continuous drive for excellence, where your influence will go beyond operations to truly shape our success.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Oversee the daily operations of our manufacturing teams to meet our ambitious production goals.
* Recruit and cultivate a high-functioning team, providing mentorship and identifying areas for development.
* Ensure our operations are efficient and adhere to health and safety standards for both products and personnel.
* Conduct training needs analysis and implement strategies to bridge skill gaps.
* Manage the production budget, making sure resources are used efficiently.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Substantial experience in manufacturing, well-versed in 5S, TPM, and root cause analysis. - A strong track record of leadership and team management. - Comprehensive knowledge of manufacturing processes and experience leading factory employees. - Solution-oriented approach to complex challenges, with a focus on process improvement. - Business acumen, paired with expertise in supply chain management and production optimisation.

The skills for success
  
  
Supply Chain Management, Business Partnership, Collaboration and partnership building, Relationship Management, Business Acumen, Productivity management, Improve business processes, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Supply Chain Planning, Logistics Management.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

**Reporting To: Head – Process Excellence**

**Location: Hosur**

**Role purpose:**

Drive process improvement, standardization, productivity and operational excellence across the plant by developing robust processes, managing improvement projects, strengthening documentation and implementing digital solutions.

**Key responsibilities:**

**1. Process excellence & lean**

• Understand and apply Lean principles by adapting Lean tools, systems and practices to the company's High-Variety, Low-Volume (HVLV) manufacturing environment.

• Identify and eliminate process losses to improve productivity, flow, lead time, quality, cost and resource utilization.

• Drive Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives across the plant.

**2. SOP, work instructions & process documentation**

• Develop and standardize SOPs, Work Instructions and process flows across the complete plant value chain: Order Taking > JO Release > Production Scheduling > RM Issuance > Production > Stock Audit > QC > Packing > Dispatch.

• Define process ownership, checkpoints, documentation requirements and standard formats.

• Ensure SOPs and Work Instructions reflect the actual and improved process.

• Maintain document revision and change control.

• Prepare and maintain the SOP/WI review schedule.

**3. Documentation audit & improvement**

• Establish a mechanism to audit process documentation for completeness, accuracy, timeliness and traceability.

• Identify documentation gaps and coordinate corrective actions with process owners.

• Continuously improve, simplify and standardize documentation.

• Identify opportunities for digitalization of documentation and process records.

• Prepare and maintain the documentation audit schedule.

**4. PEx project planning & execution**

• Maintain a Process Excellence project pipeline covering ongoing, planned and future projects.

• Prioritize projects based on business impact, urgency and feasibility.

• Define project scope, milestones, timelines, owners and expected benefits.

• Track ongoing projects and ensure timely execution and closure.

• Monitor project benefits and ensure sustainability of improvements.

**5. Productivity & process improvement**

• Conduct time studies, process studies, line balancing and capacity analysis.

• Identify bottlenecks and improve manpower and machine utilization.

• Drive improvements in cycle time, throughput, yield, WIP and lead time.

• Support productivity improvement and capacity expansion initiatives.

**6. Data & performance management**

• Analyze operational data to identify improvement opportunities.

• Develop and maintain PEx dashboards and performance metrics.

• Track productivity, OEE, yield, rejection, rework, WIP, lead time and cost.

• Convert data-driven insights into improvement projects.

**7. Digitalization**

• Identify opportunities to digitize manual processes, documentation and data capture.

• Develop digital workflows, dashboards and tracking systems to improve visibility, accuracy and process control.

• Reduce manual data entry and duplicate documentation.

• Work with IT and process owners to implement and sustain digital solutions.

**8. Automation**

• Identify opportunities for process automation, semi-automation and machine/process improvements.

• Support feasibility studies, trials and implementation of automation projects.

• Evaluate automation opportunities based on productivity, quality, cost and ROI.

**9. New process / product support**

• Support NPD and new process implementation through process mapping, capacity study, manpower planning, cycle-time definition and SOP creation.

• Ensure new processes are standardized before implementation.

**Key skills:**

• Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement

• Industrial Engineering

• Process Mapping & Standardization

• Time & Motion Study

• Capacity & Productivity Analysis

• Project Management

• Root Cause Analysis

• Data Analysis

• SOP & Work Instruction Development

• Documentation Management

• Digitalization (Mandatory)

• Automation (Optional)

• Change Management (Optional)

**Key KPIs:**

• Productivity Improvement

• Cost Savings

• Cycle-Time Reduction

• Lead-Time Reduction

• Yield Improvement

• OEE Improvement

• WIP Reduction

• PEx Project Completion

• Project Benefits Realized

• SOP/WI Completion & Compliance

• Documentation Audit Score

• Documentation Improvement / Digitalization Initiatives

**Qualification & experience:**

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical / industrial / production engineering or equivalent.

• 3–8 years of experience in Process Excellence, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Excellence or Operations.

• Strong manufacturing shop-floor exposure.

• Experience in Lean, Kaizen, process improvement and project execution.

• Experience in High-Variety, Low-Volume manufacturing will be an advantage.

**Core expectation:**

The role is expected to understand the existing operating system, identify gaps, adapt Lean and Process Excellence practices to the company's HVLV environment, standardize improved processes, strengthen documentation, drive digitalization and maintain a continuous pipeline of improvement projects.

title: Care Services Manager
description:
**Job Description**
As a Care Services Manager, you will oversee the operational delivery of Care Services for assigned customers, ensuring contractual commitments, service quality targets, and customer expectations are consistently achieved. You will manage service performance, team workload, escalations, and operational efficiency while maintaining strong customer relationships and driving continuous improvement.
  
  
Working closely with customers, Care delivery teams, program managers, and other stakeholders, you will ensure effective case management, service governance, transition activities, and successful delivery of support services throughout the customer lifecycle.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Manage the delivery of Care Services, including case handling, emergency support, and software upgrade services.
* Monitor and drive operational performance, service quality, team efficiency, and workload management.
* Ensure adherence to Care processes, service governance requirements, customer SLAs, and operational KPIs.
* Lead service reviews, KPI tracking, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Manage customer escalations and act as the primary point of contact for Care-related operational matters.
* Support customer satisfaction initiatives, including EBCS, OES, OPVi, and related improvement actions.
* Collaborate with Care Program Managers to ensure service data, installed base information, and contract records are accurate and maintained.
* Support customer-facing activities by providing operational guidance, escalation management, and process expertise.
* Contribute to or lead the successful transition of services from project delivery into operational Care support.
* Lead small projects and coordinate resource allocation to meet customer and business objectives.

**Key Skills And Experience**

* Experience in service delivery, customer support, or telecommunications operations management.
* Strong understanding of Care Services, incident management, escalation management, and operational support processes.
* Experience managing service performance through KPIs, SLAs, governance reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
* Strong customer relationship and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to analyze complex operational issues and implement effective corrective actions.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing operational priorities.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to lead small teams, manage workloads, and drive performance improvements.

Nice to have:
  
  

* Experience within telecommunications managed services or network operations environments.
* Knowledge of software upgrade management, technical support services, and service transition processes.
* Familiarity with customer satisfaction frameworks such as EBCS, OES, and OPVi.
* Experience with operational reporting, cost tracking, and service governance processes.

Additional information:

Learn more about life at Nokia .

title: Data Center Physical Security Lead
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.
  
  
**Vultr Cares**

* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription

**Join Vultr**
Vultr is seeking an experienced
**Data Center Physical Security Lead**
person who will play a key role in protecting our
**data centers and critical infrastructure**
. As a Security Lead, you will oversee site-level physical security operations, lead security personnel and vendors, manage access control and surveillance systems, drive risk assessments and incident response, and ensure compliance with security standards. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen our security posture, support critical infrastructure projects, and maintain a safe, secure, and operationally ready environment. If you are passionate about security leadership, risk management, and protecting mission-critical infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The
**Data Center Physical Security Lead**
is responsible for the overall physical security program and day-to-day security operations at assigned Vultr data center and critical infrastructure facilities. This role serves as the primary on-site security point of contact, protecting people, facilities, technology infrastructure, proprietary equipment, and other critical assets.
  
  
The
**Data Center Physical Security Lead**
combines hands-on security operations with program leadership, ensuring that security standards, policies, processes, technology, compliance requirements, and vendor performance are effectively implemented and maintained at the site.
  
  
This position will work closely with the Physical Security PMO, Data Center Operations, Facilities, IT, EHS, HR, Legal, Procurement, customers, colocation providers, security vendors, and other stakeholders. The role is expected to identify risks, drive corrective actions, support security projects, and ensure the site remains operationally ready and aligned with Vultr's physical security standards.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on security professional who can operate effectively in a critical infrastructure environment while also thinking strategically about risk, program maturity, technology, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Physical Security Operations**

* Lead day-to-day physical security operations for assigned data center and critical infrastructure facilities.
* Serve as the primary on-site physical security point of contact for employees, contractors, customers, vendors, and facility partners.
* Enforce physical security policies, standards, procedures, post orders, and site-specific requirements.
* Oversee access control, visitor management, badge issuance, patrols, security monitoring, and protection of critical areas.
* Maintain effective controls to prevent unauthorized access, tailgating, piggybacking, and other physical security violations.
* Ensure security coverage and operational readiness during normal operations, maintenance activities, construction, and special events.
* Conduct routine security walkthroughs, inspections, and physical security assessments.
* Maintain accurate security documentation, logs, records, and shift handovers.

**Security Team & Guard Force Leadership**

* Lead and oversee contract security personnel and/or on-site security resources.
* Establish clear expectations for performance, professionalism, customer service, documentation, and adherence to security procedures.
* Partner with security vendors to ensure staffing, training, post orders, and service levels meet Vultr requirements.
* Monitor guard-force performance and address deficiencies through documented corrective actions.
* Support onboarding, training, drills, tabletop exercises, and ongoing security awareness activities.
* Ensure security personnel are prepared to respond appropriately to incidents and emergencies without unnecessary use of force.

**Security Systems & Technology**

* Oversee the operational effectiveness of electronic physical security systems, including:

+ Electronic Access Control (EAC)
+ CCTV/Video Management Systems (VMS)
+ Intrusion detection
+ Alarm monitoring
+ Biometric and multifactor access systems
+ Intercom and related security technologies

* Review access, video, and alarm activity to identify anomalies, policy violations, and security trends.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance, testing, troubleshooting, and repair of security systems with integrators, vendors, facilities, and internal technical teams.
* Identify system deficiencies and recommend improvements to security technology, barriers, lighting, perimeter controls, and other protective measures.
* Support implementation and operational acceptance of new security technologies and site security systems.

**Risk Management & Physical Security Assessments**

* Conduct regular physical security risk assessments, vulnerability reviews, and site walkthroughs.
* Identify security gaps and develop practical corrective and preventive actions.
* Track security findings through closure and verify that remediation is effective.
* Apply layered security and defense-in-depth principles to site protection.
* Evaluate changes to site operations, construction, equipment, occupancy, or customer requirements for potential physical security impacts.
* Escalate significant risks and unresolved security issues to the Physical Security PMO Lead and appropriate stakeholders.

**Incident Management & Emergency Response**

* Serve as the primary security escalation point for physical security incidents at the assigned site.
* Lead or support response to security incidents, unauthorized access attempts, suspicious activity, security system failures, alarms, facility emergencies, and physical security breaches.
* Act as security incident commander when required and coordinate with internal stakeholders, emergency services, law enforcement, and facility management.
* Support emergency response, evacuation, lockdown, shelter-in-place, business continuity, and crisis management procedures.
* Conduct or support incident investigations and produce clear, timely, and accurate incident reports.
* Identify root causes and track corrective actions resulting from security incidents.
* Participate in emergency drills, tabletop exercises, and incident-response testing.

**Compliance, Audits & Security Documentation**

* Maintain site compliance with applicable physical security requirements, customer obligations, contractual requirements, and industry frameworks.
* Support compliance requirements associated with SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST controls, NIST 800-88, MSA requirements, and other applicable standards.
* Prepare and maintain documentation and evidence required for internal, customer, and third-party audits.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and recertification of physical access rights.
* Maintain accurate records related to badges, visitors, incidents, security inspections, system testing, corrective actions, and security personnel.
* Identify audit findings and coordinate remediation through closure.

**Vendor & Colocation Management**

* Manage day-to-day relationships with contract security providers, security technology integrators, and other physical security vendors.
* Establish and monitor vendor performance against contractual requirements, SLAs, KPIs, and Vultr security standards.
* Partner with colocation and facility providers to ensure building, perimeter, and shared security controls adequately protect Vultr assets and operations.
* Participate in vendor performance reviews, issue resolution, and corrective action planning.
* Escalate vendor or facility security deficiencies when appropriate.

**Security Projects & PMO Support**

* Partner closely with the Physical Security PMO Lead on security projects, site deployments, upgrades, and program initiatives.
* Provide site-level operational requirements and subject-matter expertise for physical security projects.
* Support project planning, implementation, testing, commissioning, and operational handoff of security systems and infrastructure.
* Review project designs, security drawings, technology deployments, and proposed security solutions for operational suitability.
* Identify site-specific security risks or requirements that may not be captured in standard security designs.
* Participate in project meetings with internal teams, customers, contractors, integrators, and facility partners.
* Track site security actions, dependencies, risks, and deliverables through completion.
* Help ensure new or modified facilities meet Vultr physical security standards before operational handoff.

**Asset, Shipment & Media Security**

* Support secure receipt, verification, staging, and handling of inbound technology equipment and critical components.
* Verify shipments against applicable manifests, bills of materials, or documentation.
* Maintain appropriate records within asset tracking or IT asset management systems.
* Ensure equipment and sensitive materials are appropriately secured while awaiting deployment.
* Maintain knowledge of and enforce applicable media storage, handling, and destruction procedures.
* Coordinate with appropriate teams regarding secure media destruction and documentation.

**Reporting & Metrics**

* Provide regular security status updates to the Physical Security PMO Lead and relevant site stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain site security metrics, including incidents, vulnerabilities, corrective actions, system availability, access reviews, audit findings, and vendor performance.
* Produce clear and concise incident reports, risk assessments, security summaries, and management reports.
* Identify trends and recommend actions that improve the effectiveness and maturity of the site security program.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in physical security, corporate security, critical infrastructure security, data center security, law enforcement, military security, or a related field.
* At least 2 years of experience in a lead, supervisory, or program ownership role.
* Experience operating in a data center, critical infrastructure, technology, or high-compliance environment.
* Hands-on experience with electronic access control, video surveillance, alarm systems, and other physical security technologies.
* Working knowledge of physical security risk assessment, vulnerability management, and defense-in-depth principles.
* Demonstrated experience managing contract security personnel and security vendors.
* Strong incident response, investigation, documentation, and report-writing skills.
* Experience supporting audits and compliance programs.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, operations personnel, executives, vendors, customers, and first responders.
* Ability to work independently and make sound operational decisions within established security policies and procedures.
* Ability to pass required background checks and obtain applicable site access or clearances.
* Willingness to work flexible hours and participate in after-hours security escalations when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Emergency Management, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Professional certifications such as CPP, PSP, PCI, CPO, or equivalent.
* Experience securing hyperscale, colocation, cloud, data center, or other critical infrastructure environments.
* Experience with security platforms such as Lenel, Genetec, Software House, Avigilon, Milestone, or similar systems.
* Experience with security program metrics, KPIs, and reporting.
* Experience with project management or participation in security technology/infrastructure projects.
* Knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, NIST, and other security/compliance frameworks.
* Training in First Aid/CPR/AED, de-escalation, incident command, ICS/NIMS, or emergency management.

**Inclusion & Privacy**
We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
  
  
We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
  
  
Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: WHS Manager
description:
**Description**
Overview:
  
  
The Site WHS Manager will be responsible for partnering with a site operations team in a Fulfillment Center to execute company WHS policies and ensure compliance to all applicable local and regional regulations. By leveraging lean principles and kaizens, this individual will lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce conditional and ergonomic risk in our processes to ensure a safe and healthful working environment for our Associates. The Site WHS Manager must demonstrate the ability to build trust and confidence with the Operations Team and influence change through providing comprehensive risk assessments and safety data analysis.
  
  
The Site WHS Manager must be an effective communicator and send clear, concise and consistent messages, both verbally and in writing. This individual must instruct and train Operations Leaders in company safety policies and assist the operations site teams in incorporating our safety standards at their site. The Site WHS Manger will be required to identify best practices and incorporate these best practices into our standards to continuously improve company safety policies. The Site WHS Manager will be required to possess excellent safety program and relevant safety, environmental and ergonomic knowledge and demonstrates this expertise when working with Operations.
  
  
The Site WHS Manager will be responsible to lead a safety team members: Safety Specialist, Safety Coordinators, Onsite first aid Associates. This individual must create and execute leadership development plans for their Safety Associates on their team. They must communicate safety team expectations and give frequent and appropriate feedback to their safety teams and ensure they are executing to the core competencies of an Amazon safety professional.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Possess a thorough understanding of local/regional regulations and company policy.
  
  
Provide guidance and oversight to ensure compliance to all applicable Amazon Safety Policies.
  
  
Measure sites’ performance against published requirements in safety policies. For all deficiencies, identify a plan for the site to implement and fix all identified deficiencies.
  
  
Deliver on-time and quality projects to Operations.
  
  
Analyze safety metrics and review incident weekly and monthly incident trends to discover trends to justify the allocation of appropriate resources to areas where the safety risk is highest.
  
  
Perform frequent site safety audits to identify all non-compliance equipment and/or processes at the site. Implement solutions to eliminate exposure to these risks and prevent injury at other FCs.
  
  
Audit record keeping practices and Austin entries to ensure compliance to global safety standards and local regulations.
  
  
Audit the workplace organization and Associate behaviors to ensure that training, auditing and scoring methods are accurate and consistent.
  
  
Manage and mentor Safety Associates in your assigned FC/DRRC.
  
  
Spend time at the sort centers and seek input from Safety teams, Associates and leaders on safety program improvement opportunities. Ensure open communication on status of progress and resolution against these suggestions.
  
  
Ensure site leadership and Associates are trained and knowledgeable of their responsibilities under each policy. Audit the quality, delivery (including qualifications of the trainer), and effectiveness of all required safety training.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of increasing responsibilities in WHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications and the use of pivot tables and the development of charts and graphics
* Bachelor's degree

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing lean principles and process improvement in an operational environment
* Master's degree in Health and Safety or a related field
