title: Finance Shared Services Manager
description:
**Mott MacDonald**
is a global engineering, management, and development consultancy committed to delivering impactful work that shapes the future.
  
  
We are a team of over 20,000 experts working across the world in more than 50 countries.
  
  
We are proud to be part of an ever-changing global industry, delivering transformative work that’s defining our future. It’s our people who power that performance. As an employee-owned business, we invest in creating a space for everyone to feel safe and valued and empowered with the right tools and support.
  
  
Whether you want to pursue excellence in your specialism or broaden your experience with flexible roles across our business, you’ll be connected to a community of global experts championing you to be your best. Join us and shape your story with Mott MacDonald, where everyone has the opportunity to be
**brilliant**
.
  
  
**Role Overview**
This is an opportunity to shape the next chapter of Finance Shared Services at Mott MacDonald.
  
  
Leading around 125 colleagues in India, while building strong operational alignment with a further 25 colleagues in Thailand, you’ll bring together people, process and technology to create a high-performing, resilient and increasingly strategic finance capability.
  
  
Your mandate goes beyond running today’s operation. You’ll help evolve shared services from its strong foundations in transactional finance, reporting and reconciliations into a broader, world-class finance capability. You’ll simplify and standardize how we work, strengthen controls, unlock automation, and create opportunities for people to broaden their skills and careers.
  
  
Reporting to Group Management Accountant, the role holder will lead the ambition to build a shared services organisation recognized not just for operational excellence, but for the quality of its people, customer experience and contribution to Mott MacDonald’s wider business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Alignment with Group Finance Strategy**

* Ensure the direction, priorities and activities of the shared services operation are fully aligned with the Group Finance strategy.
* Translate Group Finance objectives into practical operating plans, team priorities, and measurable performance outcomes.
* Ensure investment in people, systems, process improvement, and automation supports the future requirements of Group Finance.
* Provide clear feedback to Group Finance leadership on operational risks, capacity requirements, and opportunities to improve service delivery.
* Ensure the India and Thailand teams understand how their work contributes to wider Group Finance objectives and business performance.

**Transformation**

* Deliver a multi-year FSS transformation roadmap aligned with Group Finance strategy and global accounting requirements.
* Assess the current operating model, define the target operating model, and govern prioritised initiatives, benefits, risks and dependencies while maintaining service continuity and embedding continuous improvement.
* Own the FSS digital roadmap in partnership with Group Finance and digital teams, simplifying and standardising processes before prioritising workflow, ERP, RPA, analytics and appropriate AI solutions.
* Track benefits realisation, improve master-data quality, and provide clear dashboards and performance metrics, with defined ownership and effective controls for automated processes.

**Process Standardisation and Efficiency**

* Establish standardised end-to-end processes, controls, procedures and service expectations across FSS.
* Minimise unnecessary local and regional variation, ensuring that exceptions are justified, documented and appropriately governed.
* Simplify processes by removing duplication, avoidable hand-offs, rework and manual activity before applying technology solutions.
* Use operational data and performance insights to identify capacity constraints, inefficiencies and improvement opportunities, delivering measurable gains in productivity, quality, cost-effectiveness and turnaround times.
* Ensure that efficiency improvements do not compromise service quality, financial control or employee wellbeing.
* Benchmark FSS performance against leading shared services organisations and use the findings to support progress towards world-class performance.

**FSS Organisation and Capability**

* Design a scalable FSS organisation structure with clear accountabilities, appropriate spans of control and a strong leadership layer, supported by effective workforce and capacity planning.
* Partner with HR on role architecture, recruitment, retention and succession, establishing the workforce framework and investment priorities needed to build sustainable capability.

**Staff Development and Rotation**

* Establish structured development plans and career pathways that build technical, operational, digital, continuous-improvement and leadership capability.
* Use planned rotations and cross-training across processes, teams and, where practical, locations to broaden experience, strengthen succession and reduce reliance on individuals.
* Develop multi-skilled teams that can provide effective cover during absences, peak periods and workload changes, ensuring that rotations are purposeful, supported and aligned with business and development needs.
* Identify high-potential colleagues and provide targeted development, mentoring and exposure to improvement initiatives and broader finance roles.
* Measure the effectiveness of development and rotation through improvements in capability, engagement, service quality and succession coverage.

**India and Thailand Collaboration**

* Build one connected shared services community across India and Thailand, aligned with common Group Finance objectives.
* Apply common processes, controls, technology, documentation, performance measures and service standards across both locations.
* Establish regular mechanisms for sharing knowledge, operational insight and proven practices, including joint improvement initiatives and communities of practice.
* Balance workloads and deploy capacity across both locations to provide agreed reciprocal cover and improve resilience, efficiency and service outcomes.
* Recognise collective achievements and reinforce shared accountability for overall service performance.

**Key Outcomes and Measures of Success**

* Operational performance: shorter month-end close and end-to-end cycle times, stronger SLA performance, higher productivity, lower cost-to-serve and faster turnaround times.
* Quality and control: reduced rework, exceptions, manual intervention and control failures; timely remediation; improved master-data quality; and increased adoption of standard processes and controls.
* Transformation: delivery of agreed roadmap milestones and measurable benefits from automation, transitions and the target operating model.
* Customer: higher satisfaction, more consistent service, and effective reciprocal cover and workload sharing between India and Thailand.
* People: improved retention and engagement, broader skills coverage, greater career mobility and stronger succession coverage for critical leadership and technical roles.
* Strategic progress: clear alignment with Group Finance priorities and demonstrable progress towards a resilient, scalable and world-class shared services operating model.

**Experience Requirements**

* Overall 15+ years of experience with significant India-based leadership experience in a large, multi-process FSS, GBS or finance operations environment, supported by strong end-to-end accounting knowledge and a track record of leading substantial cross-country transformation.
* Proven delivery of target operating models, effective governance, process standardisation, technology-enabled improvement, stronger controls and measurable benefits, together with senior stakeholder management, organisation design, workforce planning and change leadership.

**Competencies And Skills**

* Driven individual, able to roll out programmes effectively.
* Chartered Accountant with experience of setting up or running back-office services.
* Develops strong working relationships with stakeholders.
* Champions automation, clean data, and continuous improvement.
* Drives cadence, escalations, and disciplined follow-through.
* Advanced analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Effective communication with clear and concise explanation, reasoning and persuasion, focused on outcomes.

Highly effective working with little supervision; able to delegate while retaining ownership and accountability
  
  
**Your benefits**
**and rewards**
Our benefits vary by country and are subject to eligibility and local policy:
  

* Rewards and bonuses: we are owned by our people (no external investors) and through our employee ownership model success is shared through annual bonus opportunities and longer-term participation as your career grows (subject to local plan, eligibility and business performance)
* Medical insurance and life insurance as per local plan (standard and enhanced coverage may vary by country and policy).
* Annual leave in line with local policy (competitive within the market).
* Maternity leave above and beyond local provisions and paternity leave provisions where applicable
* Professional membership/ institution subscription support
* Learning and career development through project variety, technical networks and structured development opportunities.
* An inclusive culture: we’re committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, and creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

Location(s):
  
  
Ahmedabad, GJ, IN Bengaluru, KA, IN
  
  
Contract Type: Permanent
  
  
Work Pattern: Full Time
  
  
Market: Various

.

* Build credibility with stakeholders through strong analytical thinking and dependable execution.
* Develop scalable analytical solutions rather than repeatedly solving the same problem manually.

title: P&F Lead
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead planning and forecasting activities for India, partnering with commercial teams, in-market finance and shared services. You will translate business plans into clear financial forecasts, challenge assumptions and deliver concise recommendations. We value practical problem solving, collaboration and continuous improvement. This role offers strong learning, visible impact and the chance to help GSK unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: - Lead end-to-end planning, budgeting and monthly forecasting cycles for India commercial and operational spend. - Consolidate forecast inputs, validate data and deliver clear variance commentary with actionable insight. - Build and maintain financial models and planning system master data to ensure accuracy and auditability. - Partner with commercial teams and project owners to run scenario analysis and support decision making. - Design and deliver automation and process improvements using analytics and reporting tools to reduce manual effort. - Prepare executive-level reports and present concise recommendations to finance leaders and business partners. Why You? Work arrangement: This role is hybrid. You will be expected to work from the office regularly as agreed with your manager and have flexibility to work remotely on other days. Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related field. - Minimum 3 years of experience in financial planning and analysis, forecasting or controlling. - Hands-on experience with budgeting, forecasting and month-end processes. - Strong Excel skills and practical experience with ERP or planning systems such as SAP or equivalent. - Clear written and verbal communication skills in English for multinational stakeholders. - Experience working in a matrix organisation and managing competing priorities. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: - Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Tableau or similar planning and reporting tools. - Background in commercial, market finance or project-based finance within healthcare or related industries. - Experience delivering automation, data integration or process improvement projects. - Familiarity with accounting controls, reconciliations and month-end close processes. - Experience presenting to senior leaders and influencing decisions with concise recommendations. - Progress towards or completion of a professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, CA or equivalent). How to Apply If this role matches your skills and ambitions, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your CV and a short note explaining why you are interested and how you would contribute. We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
**Skills**
Business Forecasting, Business Reporting Tools, Critical Thinking, Data Analytics, Data Visualization, Digital Fluency, Financial Controlling, Financial Reporting and Analysis, Influencing Without Authority, Stakeholder Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Senior Business Planning & Performance Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
The Senior Business Planning & Performance Analyst owns forecasting, performance reporting and commercial-analysis processes for the India business across a broad portfolio of brands.
  
  
Acting as a key business partner to the commercial team, the role connects market knowledge, product performance, inventory and forward-looking planning. You will translate data into clear insights, identify risks and opportunities, and recommend actions to improve sales, inventory productivity and overall business performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business Performance & Reporting**

* Lead the analysis of key commercial performance indicators across sell-in, sell-out, inventory, availability and assortment performance.
* Develop and continuously improve dashboards and KPIs used to steer the business.
* Identify opportunities and risks and translate them into actionable recommendations.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis to support management decision-making.

**Demand Planning & Forecast**

* Own the creation and maintenance of SKU-level finished-goods forecasts.
* Consolidate, analyze and propose launch orders and monitor launch performance.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, identify gaps, risks and opportunities, and recommend corrective actions.
* Support Budget, Best Estimate and other business-planning cycles.

**Assortment & Product Performance**

* Prepare product-rating analysis and assortment recommendations using sales performance, sell-through, stock position, newness performance and trends.
* Maintain SKU classifications and product priorities.
* Monitor collection availability, stock exposure and newness requirements and recommend actions where needed.
* Provide allocation and newness-dispatch recommendations based on performance, range plans and inventory data.

**Markdown Analytics & Monitoring**

* Prepare markdown proposals using stock, sell-out, margin and ageing analysis.
* Monitor markdown performance and exposure versus approved limits, flagging deviations and recommending action.

**Business Partnering**

* Partner with local and regional teams, connecting performance, forecast, inventory and commercial opportunities into clear recommendations.
* Lead regular analytical reviews with Sales, connecting performance against targets, forecasts, open orders, stock availability and inventory risks.
* Recommend actions required to support commercial targets and improve inventory productivity.
* Challenge assumptions and encourage fact-based decision-making across the commercial organization.
* Build strong cross-functional relationships with Sales, Brands, Marketing, Controlling, GILP, Customer Operations, Logistics, and regional and global teams.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Improve and standardize planning, reporting and analytical processes.
* Strengthen data quality and reduce manual work through better tools and automation.
* Share best practices and contribute to regional or global improvement initiatives.

**What You Bring**

* Degree in Analytics, Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Economics or a related field.
* At least 5 years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, Planning, Merchandising, Demand Planning or Sales Analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into clear business recommendations.
* Advanced Excel skills; SAP, BI, Power BI and Databricks knowledge is preferred.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Proactive, structured and comfortable working in an international environment.
* Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.

title: Assistant Vice President Finance
description:
**Location**

Delhi / Bangalore (Hybrid)

**About the Company**

Elucidata is a data-centric AI company on a mission to make life sciences AI-ready. Headquartered in San Francisco with a 120+ member team across the US and India, we're building the future of data-centric AI for drug discovery. Our flagship AI-agentic platform, Polly, helps research teams wrangle, harmonize, and analyze massive volumes of biomedical data- accelerating discoveries and making precision medicine a reality.

Recognized by Fast Company as the “Most Innovative Biotech Company of 2024,” Elucidata partners with 25+ leading organizations, including Pfizer, Novo Nordisk, Google DeepMind, Alnylam Therapeutics, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Research Institute. We are backed by top investors including Eight Roads, F-Prime, IvyCap, and Hyperplane.

With over 200 data products and AI solutions co-developed by 100+ domain experts, we've helped our partners achieve 4X faster R&D milestones and contribute to 16 therapies advancing toward FDA approval. At Elucidata, you'll work at the intersection of AI, biology, and impact - solving real-world challenges that accelerate the journey from data to discovery.

**About the Role**

Elucidata is looking for an AVP- Finance to own the company's financial strategy, capital planning and finance operations as it scales across the US and India. You will be a core member of the leadership team and the founders' primary partner on growth, fundraising and unit economics. This is a hands-on role in a lean organization. You will report to the Co-Founder and work directly with the board and investors.

**What You'll Own**

* Partner with the CEO and founders on growth strategy, pricing, capital allocation and strategic planning, providing financial insight and analysis.
* Lead fundraising and investor relations, including the financial model, data room, diligence and negotiations.
* AOP (Annual Operating Plan) ownership: target setting, department budgets, board approval and monthly budget-vs-actual reviews
* Prepare and present monthly, quarterly and annual financial reports for the board, investors and founders, and handle ad-hoc reporting requests.
* Build and maintain financial models to support business planning, scenario analysis and hiring decisions.
* Analyze financial performance and key metrics (ARR, gross margin, burn, net revenue retention) and recommend ways to improve efficiency and profitability.
* Fund/capital allocation across functions, projects and the US and India entities, including intercompany funding.
* Treasury investment policy for surplus cash, cap table/ESOP management, and cross-border tax compliance (transfer pricing, FEMA/RBI, GST, US tax)
* Partner with HR and functional leaders to align workforce planning, headcount and compensation budgets with business objectives, while monitoring employee costs, resource utilisation and productivity to drive financial efficiency.



**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA); MBA in Finance would be an added advantage.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in finance, including leadership experience in a start-up, scale-up or mid-sized organization.
* 4+ years of experience with US GAAP and accounting-system knowledge with close oversight experience.
* Deep understanding of revenue accounting and accounts receivable management for professional services and project based revenue models.
* Experience in modern US startup financial systems such as Bill.com (AR/AP), HRIS (Justworks, Rippling, Gusto), various Bank Portals)
* Demonstrated experience and enthusiasm with leveraging AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude within financial workflows, modeling, and automation
* Strong expertise in corporate finance, treasury, taxation, financial reporting and regulatory compliance.
* Proven experience in financial planning & analysis (FP&A), financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow management.
* Experience managing relationships with Boards, investors, lenders and senior leadership teams.
* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to drive strategic business decisions through financial insights.
* Exposure to fundraising, investor due diligence and financial operations in a technology-driven organization would be preferred.

**Why Join Elucidata?**

* Shape the future of biomedical data ecosystems at the frontier of science and healthcare.
* Direct visibility with the founders and leadership team.
* A high-impact role - the accounts you grow and the team you build translate directly into Elucidata's growth and customer success.
* Work with global leaders and contribute to data-driven drug discovery.

*We are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and an affirmative-action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, caste, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.*

**Benefits of Working With Us**

* Competitive compensation including ESOPs
* Unlimited vacation and holiday time off
* Hybrid work environment (3 days in office per week)
* The opportunity to be part of a dynamic team in a growing company

**Elucidata at First Glance**

title: Finance Manager
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD101588
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a strategic, process-oriented Finance Manager to lead the standardization and centralization of financial forecasting, reporting, and spend management processes across Autodesk’s Corporate and Product Finance organization and adjacent divisions.
  
  
This role will report to the Finance Director and operate with a high degree of independence, serving as a connective leader between Finance Business Partners (FBPs), Senior Financial Analysts (SFAs), Corporate FP&A, and cross-divisional stakeholders.
  
  
This position will own the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of scalable FP&A processes to drive efficiency, consistency, and insight quality. The Finance Manager will elevate how forecasting, reporting, headcount management, and close activities are executed, ensuring that best practices are standardized while maintaining flexibility to meet business needs.
  
  
This role requires strong financial acumen, operational rigor, stakeholder leadership, and the ability to influence across multiple divisions in a large, publicly traded software company such as Autodesk.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Strategic Process Leadership & Standardization
  
  

* Design and implement standardized forecasting, reporting, and spend management frameworks across multiple divisions.
* Centralize key FP&A processes to drive efficiency, consistency, and scalability while maintaining alignment with divisional business needs.
* Partner closely with the Finance Director and FBPs to define best practices and operating cadences.
* Develop governance structures, documentation, and process controls to ensure clarity and repeatability.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and enhance data reliability.

Systems & Tools Optimization
  
  

* Partner with stakeholders to optimize the use of SAP, Adaptive Insights, and related systems.
* Establish standardized templates, models, and reporting dashboards to improve transparency and comparability across teams.
* Identify automation opportunities and partner with systems teams to implement enhancements.

Headcount & Fixed Cost Governance
  
  

* Create consistent methodologies and practices for headcount tracking and reporting processes across divisions.
* Standardize collaboration between FBPs and HR to improve workforce planning accuracy.
* Coordinate with Corporate FP&A on reporting needs to ensure that FBP and SFA practices support Corporate FP&A requirements.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence
  
  

* Operate as a thought partner to FBPs across divisions, balancing local flexibility with enterprise-scale efficiency.
* Influence stakeholders without direct authority to adopt standardized practices.
* Provide guidance, mentorship, and informal leadership to Senior Financial Analysts.
* Lead special projects, including operating model redesign, tool implementation, and process transformation initiatives.

Scope & Impact
  
  

* Broad, cross-divisional scope.
* High degree of autonomy and decision-making authority.
* Accountability for improving finance team productivity and effectiveness.
* Direct impact on the quality, consistency, and scalability of financial planning processes.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* BA/BS degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field (MBA or CPA is a plus).
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive finance experience, including FP&A and process improvement.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional initiatives or driving operational standardization.
* Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial systems, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with SAP, Adaptive Insights, and Anaplan preferred.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
* Excellent communication, planning, and organizational skills.
* Willingness to travel occasionally, as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA, CPA, CMA, or an equivalent professional finance qualification.
* Experience in Corporate FP&A, finance transformation, or centralized financial planning operations within a large, publicly traded technology or SaaS organization.
* Advanced proficiency in SAP, Workday Adaptive Planning, Anaplan, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Power Query, SQL, or financial reporting automation tools.
* Proven track record of standardizing forecasting, management reporting, headcount planning, and expense management processes across multiple business units.
* Strong understanding of financial governance, internal controls, process documentation, and scalable FP&A operating models.

title: Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**
As a
**Property Accounting Analyst**
, you will manage day-to-day activities across lease accounting, project accounting, fixed assets, and balance sheet reconciliations. You will work with lease agreements, validate rent calculations, manage project setups and maintenance, review project costs and capitalization, prepare journal entries, and support month-end close and financial reporting activities. You will also analyze account balances, investigate variances, identify accounting risks, and collaborate with business partners to resolve issues.
  
  
The role offers opportunities to take ownership of process transitions, gain deeper end-to-end business understanding, and contribute to process simplification, automation, and stronger financial controls.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* General Ledger Accounting & Reconciliations
* Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
* Perform journal entries, expense accruals, account analysis, and month-end close activities.
* Investigate accounting discrepancies, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and drive timely resolution.
* Lease & Property Accounting
* Review and interpret lease agreements to identify key financial and accounting obligations.
* Perform Sales-Based Rent calculations, CPI-based rent adjustments, and Commercial Rent Tax calculations.
* Maintain accurate lease records and coordinate with business partners to resolve accounting issues.
* Project Accounting & Fixed Assets
* Perform project setup and maintenance, ensuring appropriate accounting classification and tracking.
* Review Assets Under Construction (AUC), validate capitalization eligibility, and monitor project completion.
* Maintain Fixed Asset (FA) ledgers and ensure alignment with General Ledger balances.

**4**
.
**Process Transition & Knowledge Management**

* Actively participate in end-to-end accounting process transitions, including knowledge transfer, process documentation, and stabilization.
* Demonstrate the ability to quickly learn and independently manage newly transitioned activities, ensuring accuracy, controls, and business continuity.
* Support the development of SOPs and control frameworks to ensure seamless transition and sustainable operations

**5**
.
**Financial Controls & Process Improvement**

* Analyze account balances, transaction trends, and ageing to identify potential accounting risks.
* Identify opportunities for process simplification, standardization, and automation.
* Support internal and external audits through accurate documentation

**Key Skills & Competencies**
**Accounting & Technical Skills:**

* Working knowledge or experience in Property Management Accounting, Lease Accounting, and Fixed Asset Accounting. Understanding of US GAAP and financial reporting principles.
* Process Transition & Knowledge Management: Experience in accounting process transitions, including knowledge transfer, process documentation, control assessment, process stabilization, and independently managing transitioned activities while ensuring business continuity.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with ERP/accounting systems. SAP and reconciliation tools such as Cadency/Blackline would be an advantage.

**Professional & Interpersonal Skills:**
Analytical & Problem-Solving | Ownership & Accountability | Learning Agility | Collaboration | Adaptability
  
  
**Qualifications**

* CA / CA Inter / CPA / CWA / CMA / ACCA / MBA (Finance) / M.Com / B.Com / M. Fin or equivalent.
* 4–8 years of post-qualification experience
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Property Accounting workflows, including upstream and downstream process dependencies, transaction flows, and their impact on financial reporting and controls.
* Relevant experience in Record-to-Report (R2R), General Ledger, Property Accounting, Lease Accounting, or Fixed Assets.
* Prior relevant experience in Retail accounting and US GAAP/Accounting standards

title: Regulatory Capital Reporting & Analysis - Associate
description:
**Job Description**
As a Regulatory Capital Reporting & Analysis Associate on the U.S. Regulatory Capital and Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) Reporting team within Firmwide Regulatory Reporting & Analysis (FRRA), you will oversee the production and integrity of regulatory reports for Capital and Risk-Weighted Assets under Basel III Standardized and Advanced Approaches. You will analyze risk-based capital results across external filings, review variance analyses, and ensure adherence to established procedures and SOX controls while engaging directly with senior leadership and regulators. You will also contribute to CCAR stress testing, monitor evolving regulatory requirements including Basel III Endgame, and drive process improvements across the reporting lifecycle.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end integrity of capital and RWA reporting, filings, and data oversight, covering analysis, production, and validation.
* Review quarterly “actuals” for FFIEC 101/102, FR Y‑9C (HC‑R), and Call Report (RC‑R), plus FR Y‑14A stress test forecasts.
* Ensure RWA and related balances comply with regulatory instructions within a robust control and procedural framework.
* Assist in the presentation of quarterly regulatory capital results to the Treasurer, Firmwide Controller, and regulators (FRB, OCC, FDIC), with variance analysis by product/report.
* Review and analyze Standardized and Advanced RWA, SLR, and capital results for JPMorganChase and its Lead Bank for CCAR and Risk Appetite stress tests.
* Address internal and external regulatory inquiries.
* Monitor industry, accounting changes, and regulator changes (e.g. Basel end-game) to maintain accurate filings and assess reporting impacts.
* Lead process improvements and manage quarterly and CCAR post‑mortem actions.
* Execute internal controls for quarter‑end close and CCAR/Risk Appetite reporting.
* Run cross‑report error reviews and revision decision forums to determine regulatory reporting impacts; communicate instruction changes promptly to stakeholders.
* Partner with LOBs, Capital Management/Policy/Controllers to ensure compliance, and lead the Basel III Endgame external reporting workstream across stakeholders post‑announcement.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
* 4 years of experience in financial services or a related industry
* Firmwide regulatory reporting experience with deep Basel capital expertise
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; able to partner effectively with managers and stakeholders at all levels
* Strong control mindset with experience establishing or enhancing internal controls
* Solid knowledge of regulatory reporting standards and requirements
* Strong analytical skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.
  
  
Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

title: Associate Director - Finance & Accounting
description:

We are Series C funded, having raised ~$50M from global Tier 1 investors including Tiger Global, Z47, Greenoaks, and Dharana Capital

**About the Role**

We are seeking an ambitious, hands-on, and strategically-minded Associate Director, Finance & Accounting to own the entire financial function of the company. You will be the custodian of our financial health, driving everything from daily operational accounting to strategic financial planning and FinOps optimization. This is a high-impact role requiring strong technical accounting knowledge, a detail-oriented mindset, and a proactive approach to business growth and efficiency.

**Experience:**
5-6 years of progressive experience in Finance, Accounting, and Operations, ideally within a fast-paced startup environment. CA/CPA/MBA (Finance) preferred.

**1. Core Financial Accounting & Reporting**

* **Bookkeeping Ownership:**
  Fully manage and oversee all accounting operations using Zoho Books (or similar cloud accounting software).
* **Timely Accounting:**
  Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant recording of all revenue, expenses, assets, and liabilities.
* **Financial Reporting:**
  Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow statements for internal and external stakeholders.

**2. FinOps, Treasury & Expense Control**

* **FinOps & Operational Problem Solving:**
  Spearhead FinOps initiatives focused on optimizing and automating operational financial workflows, including streamlining the lifecycle of vendor payments, customer refunds, financial reconciliation processes, etc.
* **Treasury Management:**
  Manage working capital, monitor cash flow, and optimize bank relationships and internal treasury processes.
* **Expense Controller:**
  Implement and enforce robust internal controls and policies to manage and optimise operating expenses.

* **Revenue Assurance:**
  Assume full responsibility for the company's revenue cycle, ensuring all revenue is correctly recognized, collected efficiently, and accounted for with zero leakage.

  Work closely with business teams to identify and validate new opportunities for revenue generation or pricing structure optimization.

**4. Investor Relations & Strategic Contribution**

* **Investor Reporting:**
  Manage and prepare all financial and operational metrics/dashboards required for investor updates, board meetings, and due diligence.

* **Budgeting & Forecasting:**
  Lead the annual budgeting process and continuous financial forecasting to guide the business towards its financial targets.

**What You Bring**

* **Technical Expertise:**
  Deep understanding of accounting principles (Ind AS/IFRS/GAAP) and practical experience with Zoho Books or a similar ERP/accounting system.
* **FinOps Mindset:**
  Proven ability to marry finance with operations, using data and process to solve real-world business problems.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Strong ability to analyze complex financial data, model scenarios, and translate numbers into clear business insights and actions.
* **Communication:**
  Excellent communication skills, capable of confidently presenting financial data to the leadership team and external investors.

title: Senior Energy Market Consultant - Power
description:

ICF is seeking a talented consultant to support our growing team and client base in the area of power markets advisory consulting. Professionals with 5 years of experience in US power market analysis/forecasting/economics are ideal candidates for the role.
  
  
As a Senior Energy Consultant, you will be responsible for leading a team of analysts to develop and defend power price forecasts, power plant proformas and financial projections using grid software models (e.g. PROMOD, PSLF, TARA etc.), issuing detailed market reports, growing our business with new and existing clients, mentoring and developing junior staff, and contributing to ICF’s thought leadership and competitive positioning in the market.
  
  
In this practice area, ICF’s typical client base includes owners and developers of power plants, banks and investors, and occasionally government entities and other stakeholders. We advise on asset transactions, support siting and financing of new power plants, and provide expert testimony in litigation cases among other work. Great managers at ICF are both analytically sharp and great communicators and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative work environment.
  
  
ICF’s practice covers all major market areas in the US, including ERCOT, PJM, ISO-NE, NYISO, MISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, and SERC, with specialized teams serving each region.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead a dedicated team of analysts to perform detailed energy market modelling and long-term forecasting efforts for market prices, plant/grid operations, and plant economics
* Manage multiple projects with overlapping timelines while ensuring excellent quality, consistency, and client support
* Review and provide direct feedback to the team on quantitative modeling approaches and results
* Communicate effectively with a diverse client base as a subject-matter expert in US wholesale power markets
* Grow ICF’s business by leading interactions with potential clients and developing proposals
* Mentor and develop junior staff as well as collaborate with ICF senior management on key business decisions

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative-focused field. Candidates majoring in other fields must clearly demonstrate equivalent quantitative aptitude
* 5+ years of work experience in North American electric power sector, including market analysis, Power Flow studies and forecasting
* Experience with a minimum of one of the following: ERCOT, PJM, ISONE, NYISO, MISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, and SERC
* Deep familiarity with market modeling approaches and tools (e.g. PROMOD, PSLF, etc.)
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong capabilities in Microsoft Office
* Experience independently conducting and supervising technical analysis

**Preferred Skills**

* Master’s degree in any of the aforementioned fields or closely related areas
* Consulting background preferred. However, other experience with financial analysis, asset valuation, or power plant development is a plus

**Job Description ::**

Job Title: Strategy, M&A & Integration Manager

Location: Bangalore

Team: Corporate Strategy

**About the Role**

We are looking for a high-performing Strategy, M&A and Integration Manager based in Bangalore to help drive the company’s strategic direction and inorganic growth agenda across APAC and global markets. In this role, you will play a key part in running strategy processes, evaluating M&A and partnership opportunities, and, once deals close, leading the integration of acquired businesses and making sure the expected value is delivered. You will work closely with senior leadership and studio teams to shape our gaming portfolio from deal origination through to realised synergies.

**Key Responsibilities ::**

M&A and Strategy

* Support and help drive end-to-end M&A processes, including target screening, valuation, due diligence coordination, and transaction execution
* Contribute to and co-run structured strategy processes and reviews (e.g., annual strategy cycle, portfolio reviews, market deep-dives), ensuring clear frameworks and actionable outputs
* Build robust financial models, investment cases, and strategic analyses to inform acquisitions, investments, and growth initiatives
* Monitor industry trends and competitive dynamics across gaming and digital entertainment, with particular focus on APAC markets

Post-Merger Integration and Value Delivery

* Drive post-merger integration from signing through Day 1 and beyond, owning the integration plan, governance, timelines, and milestones
* Define, validate, and track the synergy case (revenue, cost, and capability synergies) and ensure identified synergies are delivered against agreed targets and timelines
* Set up and run the Integration Management Office (IMO), including workstream leads, cadence, risk and issue tracking, and escalation paths
* Coordinate integration workstreams across Finance, HR, Technology, Legal, Product, Marketing, and Live Operations, resolving cross-functional dependencies and keeping stakeholders aligned
* Support cultural integration and retention of key talent, particularly studio leadership and creative teams, while preserving the entrepreneurial strengths of acquired studios
* Track post-deal performance against the original investment case, report progress to executive leadership, and feed lessons learned back into future deal evaluation
* Develop and continuously improve the company’s integration playbook, templates, and best practices

Stakeholder Management

* Partner with studio leadership and functional teams across regions to assess strategic priorities and expansion opportunities
* Prepare high-quality materials and insights for executive leadership and board discussions, including regular integration and synergy updates

title: Lead Expert
description:
**Our team**

We are part of the Market RISQ Department (
**RMA**
), and are at the center of Société Générale’s business. The Risk Department aims to contribute to the development of business lines and their profitability through a challenging risk culture. Working within the Risk Department is intellectually stimulating, and current economic activities guide our analysis daily. As a key business partner, our department is close to all the Group’s business lines. Joining us would mean integrating a network of proven excellence at the very center of the bank’s activities, opening access to new and exciting development opportunities.

**Mission**

Within the Market RISQ department, The
**CRF**
(Counterparty Risk Framework) team is in charge of

* the regulatory and models for counterparty risks (EEPE) for the entire trading portfolio.
* the standard methodologies for capital requirements and for economic models to monitor counterparty credit risk (EE, PFE, Country Risk, etc.).
* designing the stress test methodologies, to meet the regulatory requirements for internal monitoring purposes.

In addition, the CRF team plays a key role within RISQ/RMA and for the SG Group given the current regulatory context and topics and their strategic impact on SOCIETE GENERALE Group.

The
**Bangalore CRF**
team is specially handling the following topics:

* Computation of the Counterparty credit risk profile (EE, PFE and Country Risk).
* Calibration of the diffusion volatilities, mean and other parameters for CCR model.
* Back testing of CCR Models.
* Ongoing monitoring tasks on counterparty credit risk metrics

**Role**

As
**Lead Expert**
**in Bangalore CRF Ponderation team**
, your main missions will be to:

**Counterparty Credit risk metrics computation**

* Compute CCR metrics such as EE (Expected Exposure), PFE (Potential Future Exposure) and Country Risk for various Exotic Derivatives
* Compute LTV (Loan to Value) for various financial assets like Bonds, Funds and Structured Products.
* Document and provide commentary on the figures.
* Respond to Risk Managers or Front-Officers requests and queries.

**Counterparty Risk Analysis**

* Perform financial product and payoff analysis across multiple asset classes, including Equities, Rates, Foreign Exchange, Credit and commodities.
* Analyze the risk characteristics and exposure profiles of derivative instruments.
* Document analytical findings and communicate conclusions to business stakeholders.
* Support Sales and Risk teams by providing quantitative analyses and explanations.

**Reporting & Controls**

* Prepare and deliver recurring and ad-hoc reports related to asset and payoff analysis.
* Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of risk reports.
* Support operational controls and quality assurance activities around risk production processes.

**Continuous improvement**

* Support potential system information upgrades or business evolution
* Maintain scripts, methodology and operational documentation.

**Requirements**

**Background**

* Background in a quantitative role within risk management, market risk, counterparty risk, valuations, or financial product analysis within a financial institution is preferred.
* Knowledge of financial markets and derivative products across multiple asset classes

**Technical**

* Understanding of CCR concepts such as EE, PFE, EEPE, Wrong Way Risk and Country Risk.
* Understanding of CCR risk mitigants such as netting, collateral, and MPoR.
* Knowledge of derivative products and payoff structures.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Knowledge of VBA and Python.

**Soft skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a global environment.
* Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement orientation.

title: Payments F&S Specialist
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are building an elite team to drive financial insight and strategy at Stripe. The Finance & Strategy team brings understanding and predictability to Stripe’s financials, and we work together with our key business partners to accelerate long term growth for Stripe.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with F&S and Business Leaders to drive the long-term success of Stripe
* Work cross functionally to identify important strategy questions and answer them with data
* Build financial forecasts and targets, track performance, and understand deviations from actuals to drive strategy and operational rigor
* Gain deep knowledge and understanding of Stripe's business performance across geographies and user segments
* Define metrics and leading indicators of business performance and partner with the Analytics team to develop tools and dashboards to make these metrics widely accessible across Stripe

Who you are
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 7–14 years of experience in a relevant analytical or finance role
* Intermediate (at a minimum) or advanced knowledge of SQL or Python is required - you must be well versed working with extremely large and complex datasets + extracting insights
* Experience with financial analysis, financial forecasting, BvA (variance analysis), and other financial concepts
* Experience working on ambiguous problems and driving solutions/projects independently
* Ability to automate and use AI to streamline recurring tasks/analyses, in order to free up time to work on more strategic and higher impact work
* Experience building dashboards and data visualization tools from scratch
* A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners and department leads. You are seen as a trusted and objective advisor
* An enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality
* A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision
* Experience working in a global capacity (this team will work will all regions)

**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in a strategic finance function at a high-growth tech company, preferably in the payments/fintech space
  
  
In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Treasury Analyst
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
What You Can Expect
  
  
**Job Summary**
Provide Treasury support to Global Treasury and EMEA controllers across cash flow forecasting, daily cash positioning, liquidity reporting, bank account administration, foreign exchange exposure analysis, intercompany netting, and treasury operations. Use SAP, Power BI, and related data tools to deliver accurate reporting, investigate variances, and improve processes. Collaborate with EMEA stakeholders and work hours aligned to EMEA business hours.
  
  
**Work Mode:**
2 WFH,3 days WFO
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
How You'll Create Impact
  
  
**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**

* Cash flow forecasting: collect information from EMEA entities, maintain forecasts in the TIP tool, reconcile forecast cash flows to bank account balances and SAP data where applicable, investigate variances, and prepare reporting for Global Treasury.
* Support EMEA bank account administration, including account opening and closure, signatory and access updates, KYC documentation, and maintenance of appropriate segregation of duties and supporting records.
* Prepare and validate daily cash position and liquidity reports; investigate discrepancies, follow up on exceptions, and escalate material items to Treasury Manager.
* Monitor EMEA liquidity and support daily cash disposition in accordance with Treasury instructions and established controls.
* Coordinate responses to bank KYC requests for EMEA entities and track timely completion of bank account signatory and access updates.
* Collect and validate monthly foreign exchange exposure data and forecasts for EMEA entities operating in multiple currencies; support hedging analysis and review actual foreign exchange results against forecast.
* Support alignment on intercompany financing strategy for EMEA entities
* Provide operational support for FX and related Treasury transactions, including transaction processing, settlement follow-up, documentation, and control checks in accordance with assigned responsibilities.
* Review monthly intercompany netting positions for EMEA entities and contribute to regional and global liquidity analysis.
* Support issuance, renewal tracking, and reporting of bank guarantees.
* Participate in Treasury projects to standardize, automate, and improve processes; develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, use SAP, Excel, and Power Query to improve data quality and reporting. Exposure to Snowflake and data-querying tools is an advantage

This job description is not exhaustive; responsibilities may change and may include other duties consistent with the role.
  
  
What Makes You Stand Out
  
  
**Expected Areas Of Competence (i.e., Knowledge, Skills And Abilities)**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Additional EMEA language skills are an advantage, depending on the countries and stakeholders supported.
* Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize work, maintain accuracy, and adapt to changing priorities; able to collaborate across countries and work hours aligned to EMEA business hours.
* Demonstrates analytical judgment, initiative, accountability, a strong control mindset, and a continuous-improvement orientation.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills and practical SAP experience. Hands-on Power BI experience building or maintaining reports and dashboards. Power Query experience preferred; Snowflake experience and data-querying skills are advantageous. Strong quantitative, data-validation, and financial-analysis skills.

Your Background
  
  
**Education/Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent education and experience.
* 3+ years of Treasury experience, or 5+ years of accounting or finance experience.
* Experience supporting a multinational, multi-entity, or multi-currency environment is preferred.

Physical Requirements
  
  
Travel Expectations
  
  

* Up to 5%

EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

title: Director – Strategy and Operations, Chalhoub Capability Hub
description:
**INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT**

Chalhoub Group’s Capability Hub is our technology and innovation hub set up with the vision to unite exceptional talent to build technology and capabilities that elevate luxury experiences and define the future of luxury retail.

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

**What you'll be doing**

The Director - Strategy and Operations, Chalhoub Capability Hub will lead the integrated delivery and governance of the Chalhoub Capability Hub programme, ensuring multiple workstreams move together against a clear roadmap, milestones and outcomes , Working closely with the Capability Hub leadership, global Technology & Data leadership and functional workstream leads, the role will bring structure, pace and transparency to programme execution — proactively managing dependencies, risks and decisions while ensuring stakeholders remain aligned throughout the build and transition.

The role will also establish the governance, reporting and operating disciplines required to support the Hub as it scales.

* Integrated Program Delivery: Lead the end-to-end program plan, bringing together People, Finance, Real Estate, Legal, Technology Readiness and other workstreams to ensure coordinated execution against agreed milestones.
* Program Planning & Dependencies: Own the integrated program roadmap, identifying critical dependencies, sequencing activities and ensuring delivery plans remain realistic and aligned with wider Technology & Data transformation milestones.
* Proactive Risk & Escalation Management: Transition governance from passive administrative tracking to active risk mitigation. Architect an operating rhythm that preemptively identifies blockers, facilitates cross-stream alignment, and enables rapid, informed executive decisions.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Navigate a complex global matrix, bringing together senior stakeholders across functions and geographies to resolve competing priorities and maintain alignment on program outcomes.
* Champion the Standard: Design and maintain robust operating standards and deliverable acceptance criteria across all program tracks. You will ensure that site readiness, talent onboarding, and infrastructure provisioning consistently meet the exact requirements of the business.
* Process Optimization: Apply continuous improvement methodologies to identify and resolve organizational friction, optimize program throughput and ensure target timelines are successfully met.
* Strategic Translation: Translate complex operational realities, site logistics, and crossworkstream progress into clear, commercial narratives for global executive leadership.
* Automated Executive Insights: Design and implement self-serve dashboards and reporting cadences that provide the C-suite and Steering Committee with transparent visibility into the program’s velocity, budget utilization, and overall health.
* Board-Ready Deliverables: Produce high-fidelity artifacts (financial impact models, governance logs, Board decks) that are polished and ready for executive consumption and strategic decision-making.

**What you’ll need to succeed**

* 15+ years' experience leading complex enterprise programmes, transformation initiatives, PMOs or capability-centre programmes.
* Demonstrated experience delivering large-scale, cross-functional programmes involving multiple functions, geographies and senior stakeholders.
* Experience establishing or scaling a GCC, capability centre, technology hub or comparable enterprise operation strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of Technology & Data organisations and the dependencies involved in building technology capabilities, without necessarily being a technical delivery leader.
* Strong commercial and analytical capability, including programme financials, workforce plans, dashboards and performance measures.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and drive decisions in a matrix environment.
* Exceptional programme discipline with the ability to move between strategic executive conversations and detailed delivery execution.
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to synthesise complex information into clear recommendations and decisions.

**What we can offer you**

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

**Using GenAI in Your Application Process**

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

**We Invite All Applicants to Apply**

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

title: Area Operations Manager - NBM
description:
**Job Title**

Area Operations Manager

  

**Function**

Operations

  

**Reports To**

Branch Operations Head

  

**Location**

Area / Cluster of Non-Metro Locations

  

**Travel Required**

**25%****50%** **þ****75%**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

At **Blue Dart**, we go beyond delivering shipments—we deliver trust, precision, and excellence. As India’s most reliable express logistics provider, we empower commerce by reaching over 56,000+ locations across India and connecting to 220+ countries through our global DHL network. Backed by the strength of DHL Group, we bring together international standards with deep local expertise. Our dedicated Boeing freighter fleet, 12,000+ vehicles, and best-in-class service ensure time-definite delivery that businesses and customers count on every day.

We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work®** and recognized as part of the DHL Group’s Top Employer certification across multiple regions. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal—it’s a fundamental part of who we are. We are committed to creating a workplace where people feel valued, empowered, and proud to belong.

If you're looking to join a purpose-led, people-first organization that shapes India’s supply chain with integrity and care—**Blue Dart is where you belong**.

**Position Overview:**

The Area Operations Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end operational performance of a defined cluster of non-metro locations within the Branch geography.

The role oversees multiple Service Centres, Business Development Offices (BDOs), RSP / partner-supported locations and customer-facing counters, ensuring consistent service delivery, workforce productivity, operating discipline and customer experience across the Area.

Acts as the operational link between the Branch Operations Head and location-level Operations teams, translating Branch priorities into effective local execution while ensuring timely pickup, processing, dispatch and delivery of shipments.

The role is accountable for service quality, productivity, manpower deployment, local operating cost, infrastructure readiness, partner performance, safety and compliance across assigned locations.

**Job Purpose:**

To lead and manage a high-performing cluster of non-metro Operations locations by ensuring reliable service delivery, effective workforce and resource utilization, cost discipline, customer satisfaction and consistent operational standards across Service Centres, BDOs, PUDs and partner-supported locations.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Area Operations Leadership**

* Own operational performance across all assigned locations within the Area.

* Translate Branch operational priorities into location-level execution plans.

* Ensure consistent adherence to Blue Dart operating standards and service commitments.

* Conduct structured daily, weekly and monthly reviews with location Operations teams.

* Identify underperforming locations and drive focused corrective actions.

* Ensure operational readiness across locations for daily volumes, peak periods and business growth.

* Act as the first level of leadership escalation for operational issues across the Area.
  

**Service Centre & PUD Operations**

* Oversee pickup and delivery performance across Service Centres and PUD locations.

* Monitor First Attempt Delivery, NDR, ageing, pickup adherence and route productivity.

* Ensure adequate manpower and resource deployment across locations.

* Drive adherence to operational cut-offs and shipment-processing requirements.

* Review location-level productivity and initiate corrective actions where required.

* Ensure smooth coordination between Service Centres, PUDs and downstream network nodes.

* Drive standardisation of operating practices across locations.
  

**Non-Metro / BDO & Partner Operations**

* Govern operations across BDOs, RSPs and other partner-supported locations within the Area.

* Monitor partner / outsourced workforce performance and service adherence.

* Ensure adequate operating capability in lower-volume and remote locations.

* Drive corrective action for recurring partner service or productivity gaps.

* Ensure outsourced locations comply with Blue Dart operational and customer-service standards.

* Escalate structural vendor or operating-model issues to the Branch Operations Head / Regional RSP-BDO Manager as appropriate.

* Maintain service continuity in remote and difficult-to-operate markets.
  

**Shipment Flow & Network Connectivity**

* Ensure timely inbound and outbound shipment movement across Area locations.

* Monitor adherence to dispatch, pickup and network cut-offs.

* Coordinate with Branch, Hub, CPU and Network teams on recurring connectivity issues.

* Identify shipment accumulation, missed connections and ageing risks.

* Drive timely resolution of operational exceptions.

* Support contingency planning during route disruptions, capacity shortages or peak volumes.

* Ensure timely handover of shipments to upstream and downstream network locations.
  

**Service Quality & Customer Experience**

* Drive achievement of defined service-quality targets across the Area.

* Review customer complaints and recurring operational service failures.

* Ensure timely root-cause analysis and corrective action.

* Monitor service trends by location and identify high-risk operating pockets.

* Partner with Customer Service / Commercial teams on significant customer issues.

* Ensure customer-facing counters maintain required service and process standards.

* Reduce repeat service failures through preventive action.
  

**People & Workforce Management**

* Lead and guide Service Centre In-charges, Assistant Managers / Operations Managers and local Operations teams.

* Ensure appropriate staffing across FTE, outsourced and partner-supported locations.

* Monitor attendance, productivity, attrition and replacement requirements.

* Coach and develop location Operations leaders.

* Build adequate bench strength for critical roles.

* Support workforce planning for peak and seasonal requirements.

* Drive accountability, discipline and engagement across the Area.
  

**Cost & Productivity Management**

* Monitor operating costs across assigned locations.

* Track cost per shipment, manpower productivity, route productivity and resource utilization.

* Identify high-cost / low-productivity locations and initiate corrective actions.

* Ensure adherence to approved operating budgets and cost controls.

* Support optimisation of routes, manpower and local operating resources.

* Track OCPM / OCPK and other relevant cost-efficiency metrics where applicable.

* Deliver cost improvement without compromising service quality.
  

**Infrastructure & Capacity Management**

* Assess adequacy of Service Centre, BDO and PUD capacity against shipment volumes.

* Identify local infrastructure constraints affecting service or productivity.

* Provide inputs for facility expansion, relocation or capacity enhancement.

* Ensure operating equipment and facilities remain fit for purpose.

* Coordinate with Branch / Engineering teams on infrastructure requirements.

* Ensure peak-volume readiness across assigned locations.
  

**Compliance, Safety & Operational Governance**

* Ensure adherence to SOPs, safety, security and statutory requirements.

* Conduct periodic location visits, floor reviews and compliance checks.

* Maintain readiness for operational and internal audits.

* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and process gaps.

* Monitor shipment security and handling standards.

* Ensure appropriate controls over cash, documentation and Blue Dart assets where applicable.

* Promote a strong culture of safety and operational discipline.
  

**Continuous Improvement & Digital Adoption**

* Identify recurring operational bottlenecks across Area locations.

* Drive structured root-cause analysis and improvement actions.

* Promote adoption of Blue Dart systems, digital tools and dashboards.

* Standardise proven practices across Service Centres and BDOs.

* Track benefits from local productivity and service-improvement initiatives.

* Support implementation of regional / Branch improvement programs.

* Encourage data-led operating reviews and fact-based decision-making.
  

**Stakeholder & Governance**

* Work closely with the Branch Operations Head and location Operations teams.

* Coordinate with PUD, Hub, CPU, RSP / BDO and regional functional teams as required.

* Partner with HR on manpower and people issues.

* Work with Customer Service and Commercial teams on service concerns.

* Coordinate with Security, IT, Engineering and Finance as required.

* Provide accurate visibility of Area performance, risks and corrective actions.

* Represent the Area in Branch-level Operations reviews.
  

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or related discipline; MBA / PG desirable.

* **Experience**: **6–9 years** of relevant experience in express logistics, courier, eCommerce logistics, 3PL, distribution or multi-location Operations.

* Experience managing multiple Service Centres / BDOs / non-metro Operations locations preferred.

* Strong exposure to First Mile and Last Mile Operations.

* Understanding of pickup, delivery, shipment processing, network cut-offs and service-quality management.

* Experience managing direct and outsourced workforce.

* Exposure to partner / franchise / RSP operating models desirable.

* Experience in manpower productivity, route performance and local operating cost management.

* Strong understanding of customer service, operational compliance and safety requirements.

* Demonstrated ability to manage teams across geographically dispersed locations.

* Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Courier, eCommerce Logistics, 3PL, Distribution, Transportation and Supply Chain Operations.
  

**Skills & Capabilities:**
