title: Team Leader
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
The Sanctions Review team performs sanctions screening in the FircoSoft system for payment entities, settlements, and trade transactions across Asia, EMEA, and the US at the enterprise level.
  
  
Payments created manually through GBS, FPS, or STP, along with trade transactions, are routed through FircoSoft and RLSU filtering channels for sanctions review.
  
  
**Job Description\***
The Sanctions Review team reviews all transactions in coordination with GES and completes assessments in the FircoSoft application. The team also investigates requests from the Global Economic Sanctions team for additional transaction information.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Review the Global Economic Sanctions hits on Fircosoft for Asia Branches (Except India), EMEA Branches (Except Greece) and US
* Investigate the transactions coming in to the queue for additional information required by GES (Global
* Economic Sanctions)
* Monitor the group mailbox
* Investigate the transactions which are rejected for any possible OFAC Sanctions reasons
* Be a subject matter expert and train the new joiners in the team
* Review the Global Economic Sanctions hits on Fircosoft for printed checks (DPS files)
* Escalate the close hits / potential hits to GES or Local Compliance
* Process the transactions from the OFAC queues within the currency cut offs
* Review and Monitor Sanctions Queues across profiles
* Review and Monitor all currency cut offs across branches
* Report any escalations immediately and ensure timely resolution
* Prepare/Review EOD reports across branches and ensure appropriate monitoring of the same
* Prepare monthly process dashboards as per schedule
* Report, monitor and escalate any cut off miss / OTD error and ensure timely resolution & control
* In case of any error on releasing the transaction, take all measures to inform GES proactively
* In case of any error on releasing the transaction, seek help from the branch / Operation teams to recall the funds such that the funds do not reach the beneficiary / beneficiary bank
* Identify and address knowledge gaps in the process across profiles
* Assist and adhere to any audit schedules applicable
* Comply with the CTQ (Critical to Quality)
* Must be fully conversant with Windows based IT systems, eg, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Access

**Requirements\***

* Education\* - Graduate (B.Com)
* Certifications If Any
* Experience Range\* 5-8 years of experience
* Mandatory skills\* Experience in Sanctions Review process, Strong Payments knowledge (Swift) and good communication skills.
* Desired skills\* Strong ability to conduct detailed research, with preferred exposure to the FircoSoft application

**Work Timings\***

* Staggered Night Shifts - 5:30 PM to 5:30 AM (Any 9 Hours shift on rotation basis).

**Job Location\* -**
Chennai

title: Product Implementation Manager
description:
**What’s The Role**
The Product Implementation Manager (PIM) within the Capability Hub acts as the operational backbone of the Global Product Management organization, serving as a central hub for portfolio governance, compliance, implementation, and strategic portfolio support. The role supports the execution of Global Product Management priorities across lubricant portfolios, including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, and Greases, depending on business requirements and job grade.
  
  
The position focuses on data-driven portfolio management, knowledge management, compliance coordination, analytics, and digital enablement to ensure consistency, scalability, and governance across regions while driving execution against defined KPIs and SLAs. By coordinating cross-functional, cross-regional, and system-related activities, Product Implementation Managers enable Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs to focus on portfolio strategy, innovation, customer engagement, and long-term business growth.
  
  
In addition, PIMs provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to regional FPIMs and RAPMs, ensuring effective integration between global strategy and regional execution. At more senior levels, the role also provides guidance and support to the wider PIM community, drives capability development, and contributes to portfolio optimization, digital transformation, and strategic planning initiatives across the Global Product Management organization.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Portfolio Management & Product Lifecycle Support**

* Manage the deployment, maintenance, and governance of regional and global product portfolios across business systems, including full GPC data ownership.
* Support and maintain Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes, ensuring portfolio data accuracy, integrity, and governance compliance.
* Provide implementation support for product launches, portfolio changes, and withdrawal of obsolete products.
* Support a range of lubricant portfolios including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, Greases, and other assigned portfolios based on business priorities.

**Data Governance, Analytics & Portfolio Optimization**

* Ensure accurate and consistent portfolio data management across multiple systems and regions.
* Develop, maintain, and analyse KPI and SLA dashboards to support portfolio performance monitoring and decision-making.
* Drive analytics and insights to support formulation cost optimization, portfolio rationalization, and business performance improvement.
* Provide structured analysis and recommendations to support regional and global portfolio planning activities.

**Strategic Portfolio Support**

* Support Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs in developing and executing 5+ year portfolio strategies and roadmap plans.
* Provide implementation, risk, feasibility, and execution perspectives to support strategic portfolio decisions.
* Contribute to portfolio optimization initiatives through data-driven insights and business recommendations.

**Compliance, Quality & Governance**

* Coordinate and maintain compliance documentation, including SDS, product registrations, certifications, approvals, waivers, and governance records.
* Manage and maintain digital PPAP records and quality-related portfolio documentation.
* Ensure adherence to internal governance, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain central repositories for formulations, approvals, compliance records, and portfolio documentation.

**PPAP, Licensing & Project Support**

* Support and/or coordinate PPAP activities for automotive-related products, including readiness assessments, documentation, quality assurance requirements, and implementation activities.
* Own or support product licensing activities, including documentation management, approvals, renewals, and implementation support.
* Provide support for Joint Venture (JV), portfolio implementation, and special project activities where applicable.
* Coordinate with manufacturing sites, quality teams, FPIMs, RAPMs, and other stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and compliance.

**Digital Enablement & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as a key user, trainer, and subject matter resource for portfolio management and digital tools.
* Collaborate with digital and system development teams to identify and implement tool enhancements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across portfolio management processes, systems, governance practices, and workflows.
* Support capability-building and digital adoption initiatives across regional and global teams.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Execution Support**

* Provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to FPIMs, RAPMs, and regional stakeholders.
* Coordinate cross-functional activities involving Product Management, Technology, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, and Procurement teams.
* Support additive transitions, supplier escalations, and portfolio-related implementation activities in collaboration with GAAMs and other stakeholders.
* Organize governance forums, stakeholder reviews, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities to drive alignment and best-practice adoption.

**Leadership & Capability Building (Senior PIM Levels)**

* Act as a senior PIM for complex or high-value portfolios, providing guidance, coaching, and support to less experienced PIMs.
* Lead strategic initiatives focused on portfolio transformation, governance excellence, and digital enablement.
* Support long-term capability development across the PIM community.
* Influence portfolio management, governance, and implementation decisions through thought leadership, analytics, and subject matter expertise.
* Champion best practices and drive consistency across regions, functions, and portfolio teams.

**What You Bring**

* A background in physical or chemical product testing, product development, or a formal qualification in technical sciences, engineering, chemistry, mathematics, or a related discipline would be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of lubricant product specifications, formulations, manufacturing processes, and product quality requirements.
* Familiarity with blending operations, supply chain processes, and product lifecycle management concepts.
* Understanding of analytical test methods, quality procedures, and Quality Assurance standards and processes.
* Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in data handling, reporting, data governance, and performance analysis.
* Ability to handle, collate, manipulate, and interpret large volumes of data accurately and with strong attention to detail.
* Experience in developing insights and recommendations through data analysis to support operational and portfolio decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across global, regional, and cross-functional teams.
* Experience working with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders, including suppliers, customers, technical teams, and business partners.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Demonstrated continuous improvement mindset with experience in process optimization, workflow improvement, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to quickly learn new concepts, analyze situations, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience with digital systems and tools, including Microsoft Office applications and data visualization/reporting platforms.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed global environment.
* High level of accuracy, ownership, and attention to detail when managing product, portfolio, and compliance-related data.
* English language proficiency at a minimum C1 level.

**What We Offer**
You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.
  
  

* Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
* Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
* Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
* Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
* Achieve your balance in a values-led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
* Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
* Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and
* international teams.
* Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

**After you submit your application, you will receive an email providing a link to an online assessment that is a mandatory part of the process. The email will come from HireVue - please check your spam/junk mailbox if you do not see the email. Once completed, your application will be reviewed to determine next steps. Thank you for your interest in Shell.**

▪️ Rotas and rostering: Prepare and circulate monthly duty rotas for DMOs, RMOs and residents (ER, ICU, NICU, wards) and on-call rotas for consultants. Manage swaps, leave cover and last-minute gaps.

▪️ Communication: Relay circulars, policies and decisions to doctors, and coordinate with nursing, lab, pharmacy and billing to resolve issues.

✅ A graduate degree. An MBA or MHA in Hospital/Healthcare Administration is preferred.

✅ 3–5 years in hospital administration, with at least 2 years handling doctors or medical staff coordination.

✅ Working knowledge of NABH standards.

✅ Strong MS Excel skills and comfort with HIS/EMR systems.

✅ Fluency in English and Tamil.

✅ The tact to work with senior consultants, calm under pressure, and discretion with confidential information.

title: Manager - Billing Operations & Solutions
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.  
**Job Summary**

The Manager, Service Enablement, is a first-line people leader responsible for analysts across four individual-contributor levels, from developing analysts through lead professionals. The team supports operational capabilities that may include customer-facing billing messages and communications, enterprise access provisioning, and related business-system services. The role translates business priorities into clear team objectives, assigns and reviews work based on complexity and risk, develops talent, and ensures services are accurate, timely, compliant, controlled, scalable, and reliable. This manager combines people leadership with functional knowledge of billing operations, business systems, access controls, customer communications, operational controls, validation, and issue resolution. The role creates an environment in which employees can grow their career path while maintaining clear accountability for delivery, quality, customer and employee experience, security, compliance, and operational performance.

**Job Description**

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop teammates spanning levels; set clear expectations and tailor assignments, guidance, and development plans to employee experience and role scope.
* Translate organizational priorities into team goals, work plans, capacity decisions, performance measures, and day-to-day execution across assigned service-enablement functions.
* Assign and balance work based on complexity, customer or employee impact, security and compliance risk, urgency, development opportunity, and available capacity.
* Oversee operational services that may include billing statement and communication support, enterprise access provisioning, approvals, exception management, business-system enablement, and related controls.
* Review and approve requirements, business rules, workflow designs, validation approaches, release-readiness recommendations, provisioning standards, and operational documentation for significant changes.
* Ensure the team delivers accurate, timely, compliant, controlled, scalable, and reliable outcomes across supported communications, systems, access requests, configurations, and work queues.

* Establish quality expectations, access and operational control points, success measures, service levels, escalation paths, and go/no-go criteria appropriate to the risk of the work.
* Guide analysis of customer and employee scenarios, system logic, billing and access data, approval requirements, job-code and role-based configurations, integrations, production results, and recurring exceptions.
* Oversee joiner, mover, and leaver support, sensitive or PII-related access, provisioning fallout, access discrepancies, communication defects, data-quality concerns, and control gaps within the team's assigned scope.
* Confirm required approvals, validations, documentation, and audit evidence are complete, and that corrective and preventive actions are implemented and sustained.
* Use reporting, reconciliation, trend analysis, service-level results, risk indicators, and operational metrics to monitor performance, prioritize improvements, and communicate outcomes.
* Build team capability in Excel, SQL, requirements, proofreading, reconciliation, root-cause analysis, access-control practices, operational controls, and executive-ready communication.
* Conduct regular performance and development discussions, recognize strong results, address performance concerns, and support career progression.
* Partner across business, technology, security, development, legal, compliance, audit, operations, system-owner, and vendor teams to align decisions, dependencies, standards, timing, and accountability.
* Represent Service Enablement in planning, prioritization, governance, access-review, audit, incident-response, release-readiness, and continuous-improvement forums.
* Promote consistent standards, reusable documentation, automation, knowledge sharing, and first time-right execution.
* Maintain regular attendance and work nights, weekends, variable schedules, or overtime as business needs require.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Guide analysis of customer and employee scenarios, system logic, billing and access data, approval requirements, job-code and role-based configurations, integrations, production results, and recurring exceptions.
* Oversee joiner, mover, and leaver support, sensitive or PII-related access, provisioning fallout, access discrepancies, communication defects, data-quality concerns, and control gaps within the team's assigned scope.
* Confirm required approvals, validations, documentation, and audit evidence are complete, and that corrective and preventive actions are implemented and sustained.

* Conduct regular performance and development discussions, recognize strong results, address performance concerns, and support career progression.
* Partner across business, technology, security, development, legal, compliance, audit, operations, system-owner, and vendor teams to align decisions, dependencies, standards, timing, and accountability.
* Represent Service Enablement in planning, prioritization, governance, access-review, audit, incident-response, release-readiness, and continuous-improvement forums.
* Promote consistent standards, reusable documentation, automation, knowledge sharing, and first time-right execution.
* Maintain regular attendance and work nights, weekends, variable schedules, or overtime as business needs require.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Progressive experience in billing operations, customer communications, identity and access management, access provisioning, business systems, application operations, business analysis, or a comparable function, including experience leading projects or guiding others.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and develop employees with different levels of experience, independence, and technical depth.
* Strong knowledge of requirements, business rules, process and workflow design, validation, release readiness, service delivery, operational controls, and issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of access requests, approval standards, role-based or job-code-based provisioning, joiner-mover-leaver processes, exception handling, and access-review or audit support.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, proofreading, and attention-to-detail skills, including the ability to evaluate customer, employee, business, security, financial, regulatory, operational, and technical impacts.
* Proficiency with Excel and practical SQL or data-analysis experience for research, reconciliation, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, reporting, and validation.
* Experience with customer-facing content, sensitive-data access, quality control, compliance, data integrity, risk management, and operational controls.
* Ability to prioritize work, manage capacity and service levels, make sound decisions, and maintain accountability in a complex, high-volume environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to align business, technology, security, audit, compliance, operational, and vendor partners.
* Experience with billing, customer-management, communication, or access-management platforms is preferred, including tools comparable to BriteBill, CSG/ACSR, MyComcastAccess, or Tech Spot.
* Experience improving processes, strengthening controls, identifying automation opportunities, reducing exceptions or fallout, and building team capability.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience - think and act in ways that put our customers first.
* Know your stuff - be enthusiastic learners, users, and advocates of our game-changing technology, products, and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team - make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System, a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company - by joining huddles, making callbacks, and helping elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Respect and promote inclusion - do what's right for each other, our customers, investors, and our communities.

**Comcast Competencies: Manager Level**

* Alignment & Quality Execution: Set and align measurable goals, transparently hold team and self-accountable to outcomes, promote data-driven decision making and foster a culture of efficiency and fiscal responsibility to enable investments in growth
* Win as One: Embrace change and challenge status quo, drive productive debate and collaboration, keep team safety top of mind, be respectful, inclusive, and curious and exhibit a companywide sales culture
* Customer First Mindset: Put customers at the center of our decisions, support first time right, simplify the customer experience and turn customer insights into action
* Advance with Tech: Accelerate the use of AI, create space to experiment and fail fast and re-evaluate existing policies and processes to enable AI/automation

**Disclaimer:** This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Comcast provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Comcast provides best-in-class Benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality - to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

**Education**

Bachelor's Degree

While possessing the stated degree is preferred, Comcast also may consider applicants who hold some combination of coursework and experience, or who have extensive related professional experience.

**Relevant Work Experience**

5-7 Years

title: Area Manager-Branch Banking Operations
description:
* POSITION DESCRIPTION

JOB TITLE : Area Manager-Branch Banking Operations
  
  
GRADE : AVP-I
  
  
DEPARTMENT : Operations
  
  
LOCATION : RO
  
  
SUB-DEPARTMENT : TYPE OF POSITION : Full-time
  
  
REPORTS TO : Regional Manager-Branch Banking Operations
  
  
REPORTING INTO
  
  

* ROLE PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE

The purpose of this role is to provide the regional oversight for all operational activities that are required for successful banking business at the branch level, as outlined by the business and operational leadership team.
  
  
This role is accountable for all regulatory filing related to operations at the branch level and to maintain efficient operations that will enable delivery of business goals.
  
  
This role is also responsible to –
  
  

* implements and monitors branch operations strategy for the region
* maintain 100% regulatory and process compliance at branches for the region
* monitor branches operations team’s performance as per the defined checklist and defined frequency.
* provide guidance for process improvement and communicate updates on new processes/system.
* SIZE OF THE ROLE

**FINANCIAL SIZE**
**NON-FINANCIAL SIZE**

* Maintain approved budget for the unit.
* Vendors management
* Coordination with respective Regional Ops unit.
* Monitoring 20-25 Branches and supporting them for all operational and service related issues.
* KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

**Business**

* Prepare a regional operational strategy, under the guidance of the Regional Operations Manager and National Manager – Branch Operations.
* Implement strategy in their respective Branch Banking/Rural Banking Regions, monitor the same at defined periodicity and publish the complete report to senior management.
* Review all the policies and guidelines based on regional operational insights, identify any policy change required for the department, assess the impact and present a solution to supervisor for fix and implementation.
* Monitor the branches with respect to process adherence, perform surprise checks and identify the gaps.
* Prepare periodic reports and correct fixes based on branch visits
* Drive adherence to the branch operational score card, train the branches on the same and ensure the branches are above the required benchmark
* Identify branches under operational benchmark and recommend solutions to respective supervisors
* Collaborate with Branch managers / RSMs / AMs to ensure implementation of all operational checks, implement all policies/processes shared by central team.
* Implement approved operations policies and processes;
* Monitor key operational aspects such as Branch Cash Retention Limits and conduct cost analysis of account with high cash deposits.
* Work with RSMs / AMs to resolve critical issues and process improvements based on Audit Reports and Compliance feedback
* Monitor timely submission of data and documentation related to various operational and related business activities such as account opening.

**Customer- Branch Banking/Rural Banking**

* Analyze Service Index scores at the regions periodically and identify the related process bottlenecks
* Recommend solutions to key operational issues that result in delay of agreed customer TATs
* Monitor the account opening TATs, percentage of pending forms across branches
* Train branch operations’ team on operational efficiency and courteous customer service
* Monitory and analyze ATM usage data and ensure ATM uptime and cash availability.
* Resolve escalations pertaining to ATM downtime; cash reconciliation and customer grievances
* Identify patters and review existing process to suggest changes to enhance customer experience at Branch
* Monitor adherence to TAT for all branches transaction, grievance redressal and customer queries

**Internal Process- Branch Banking/Rural Banking**

* Oversee management of Branch GL accounts in the system;
* Ensure proper document tracking is done for all physical documents processed from the Branches.
* Ensure adherence to timelines for branch level risk and compliance reporting across all branches in respective region.
* Process level Gaps/Issues/Audit findings – Accountable for the timely follow-up and closure of issues raised in Audit and design action plan for minimizing similar lapses
* Closely work with Regional Operations Manager to ensure delivery within SLA
* Liaison with regional heads for resolving escalations and thus ensure seamless branch operations
* Perform the monthly operational & compliance review of all branches which are rated Unsatisfactory and Needs Improvement.
* Monitor responses and adherence by branches on internal compliance monitoring tool and drive 100% adherence
* Monitor end of day reconciliation for branches for the region and correct discrepancies
* Monitor branch compliance to KYC and AML guidelines and timely reporting of respective region.
* Identify patterns of process non-adherence at branches and ensure closure and adherence with suitable training and coaching.
* Responsible for timely follow-up and closure of issues raised during branch audits and design action plans to minimize repetitive incidents

**Learning & Performance**

title: Sr. Manager - RIS Operations
description:
**What You'll Do**
The Senior Manager will provide strategic and operational leadership across
**GRCTS, Investment Operations, and Document Services**
, with accountability for service delivery, quality, regulatory compliance, operational risk, workforce capability, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role will lead multiple operational teams and people leaders, ensuring strong execution against SLA, quality, productivity, and risk objectives while building a scalable operating model through cross-skilling, automation, technology enablement, and talent development.
  
  
The three verticals already have strong opportunities for cross-training because their skill requirements are broadly similar while their volume peaks occur at different times, making workforce flexibility an important part of the role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Multi-Vertical Operational Leadership
* Own end-to-end delivery across GRCTS, Investment Operations, and Document Services, ensuring achievement of SLA, quality, productivity, backlog, and customer commitments.
* Establish consistent operating rhythms, dashboards, performance reviews, capacity management, and governance across the portfolio.
* Anticipate seasonal and demand fluctuations and dynamically move capacity across teams through cross-training and workforce planning.
* Maintain operational readiness and business continuity across high-volume and time-sensitive workflows.

The portfolio currently manages meaningful seasonal and operational complexity. For example, GRCTS processed
**35.5K transactions with 100% SLA and zero backlog**
in September, while Investment Operations processed
**3,596 requests**
and Document Services maintained
**100% on-time delivery and zero backlog**

* Risk, Quality & Controls
* Establish and maintain a strong risk and control environment across all three verticals.
* Drive preventive quality management, root-cause analysis, calibration, quality assurance and first-time-right performance.
* Partner with Compliance, Risk, Quality and US business teams to ensure regulatory and operational requirements are consistently met.
* Ensure audit readiness and timely closure of identified control gaps.
* Strengthen governance through standardized quality frameworks and appropriate QC/QA mechanisms.

This aligns with existing initiatives including GRCTS QA governance, Document Services QC and quality-framework implementation, and Investment Operations communication controls
  
  

* Workforce & Capacity Management
* Develop capacity and staffing strategies aligned to volume forecasts, seasonality, complexity and productivity expectations.
* Create a flexible workforce model through structured cross-training across the three verticals.
* Optimize utilization, minimize idle capacity and proactively manage peak-volume requirements.
* Establish succession plans and leadership pipelines for critical roles.

Cross-skilling is already a major portfolio strategy, including GRCTS cross-training across Plan Design, IDE, Allocation and Compliance Testing activities
  
  

* Transformation, Automation & Operational Excellence
* Build and own a multi-year transformation roadmap across the portfolio.
* Identify automation, AI and workflow opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround time and strengthen controls.
* Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to prioritize and deliver automation opportunities.
* Drive Lean/process-improvement initiatives focused on simplification, standardization, productivity and customer experience.
* Establish measurable benefits realization for transformation initiatives.

Current portfolio examples provide strong anchors for this accountability, including automation enablement within GRCTS and Investment Operations' variance-review automation, which reduced manual effort by approximately
**10–15 minutes per case**
.
  
  

* Performance & Data-Driven Management
* Establish clear productivity, efficiency, quality and service benchmarks across all processes.
* Develop dashboards and management information that provide early visibility into performance and operational risk.
* Use data to identify trends, capacity constraints, quality deterioration and improvement opportunities.
* Drive structured corrective actions where performance falls below expectations.

Investment Operations has already been progressing efficiency and quality baselining and time-and-motion measurement.
  
  

* Stakeholder & Business Partnership
* Act as the senior India operations partner for US/home-office stakeholders across the portfolio.
* Build trusted relationships through transparent communication, effective governance and proactive issue management.
* Translate business strategy and customer expectations into executable operational plans.
* Lead escalations and ensure appropriate communication, root-cause assessment and sustainable corrective actions.
* Partner across Technology, Risk, Compliance, L&D, Quality and other RIS functions.
* People & Leadership Development
* Lead and develop Managers, Associate Managers and frontline leaders across the portfolio.
* Build succession depth for critical leadership and specialist roles.
* Establish clear accountability, coaching and performance-management disciplines.
* Develop domain expertise through structured learning, certifications, cross-skilling and role-based development.
* Build an inclusive, collaborative and high-accountability culture.

**Who You Are**

* Typically 15+ years of operations experience, with 5+ years in a middle management role.
* Significant experience managing multi location and multi vertical operational functions, preferably within Retirement Services, Financial Services, Banking, Asset Management, Investment Operations, Recordkeeping or similar regulated operations.
* Demonstrated experience managing managers and sizable operational teams.
* Strong exposure to US stakeholders and global delivery models preferred.
* Graduate/Post Graduation is preferred

title: Global AML Center (GAC) Operations & CAO – Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.
  
  
As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.
  
  
Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As Vice President you will:
  
  
***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards
* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance
* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model
* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking
* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability
* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls
* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance
* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds
* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value
* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda
* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning
* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy
* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials
* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time
* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through
* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning
* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure
* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements
* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed
* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight
* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability
* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required
* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization
* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential
* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls
* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans
* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment
* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models
* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers
* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively
* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning
* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials

• Drive root-cause analysis for missed deliverables, billing errors, delayed invoices, and collection issues; implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence.

• Ensure robust controls, process documentation, audit readiness, and compliance with client policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Support process transitions, migrations, client onboarding, and stabilization, ensuring knowledge transfer and operational readiness.

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant professional qualification is an added advantage.

• Demonstrated experience managing a team of 6–8 associates and SMEs, including work allocation, coaching, performance management, and delivery oversight.

• Experience working directly with stakeholders and clients across the US, Europe, and APAC time zones.

• Strong understanding of AR operations, billing controls, collections, dispute resolution, ageing analysis, and service delivery metrics.

• Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and experience using ERP systems such as SAP for billing and AR-related activities.

**Preferred Skills**

• Oversee customer invoicing, billing validations, dispute management, cash application/receipt follow-up, and collections activities, as applicable to the process scope.

• Exposure to insurance billing requirements, broker/client invoicing, and the operational practices of the Lloyd’s and London Market.

• Knowledge of process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma, and exposure to workflow automation and finance transformation initiatives.

title: Senior Manager, Data Center Facilities Development
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Manager, Data Center Facility Development leads the planning, governance, and execution of data center construction and development projects in India. The role is accountable for programme, cost, risk, quality, safety, contractor performance, commissioning readiness, and handover across new builds, expansions, retrofits, and other critical infrastructure workstreams.
  
  
Working closely with internal partners and external providers, the role aligns construction delivery with design, network, operations, commissioning, real estate, and business requirements. The Senior Manager also directly manages and develops project and construction professionals, establishes consistent delivery practices, and drives timely resolution of issues that could affect project milestones or operational readiness.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Project & Program Delivery Leadership

Lead end-to-end delivery of assigned construction projects, including new builds, expansions, retrofits, and customer-driven delivery.
  
  
Own integrated delivery plans, milestones, readiness gates, and recovery actions to meet business commitments such as Early Access, RFS, energisation, network readiness, and customer turn-up.
  
  
Provide timely, fact-based project reporting and escalate material risks, decisions, and constraints to regional leadership.
  
  

* Project Governance & Controls

Implement disciplined project controls across schedule, cost, risk, dependencies, change control, QA/QC, commissioning readiness, and handover.
  
  
Maintain accurate forecasts, critical-path plans, risk registers, issue logs, and action trackers; intervene early to remove constraints and protect delivery milestones.
  
  
Partner with PMO, Contracts, QS, and Procurement on commercial discipline, change management, claims exposure, and contractor performance.
  
  

* Cross-Functional & Partner Management

Coordinate closely with Design, Network, Commissioning, Operations, Real Estate/Facilities Development, and external delivery partners to ensure plans and readiness criteria are aligned.
  
  
Act as a senior day-to-day point of contact for contractors, consultants, colocation partners, customers, and internal stakeholders during delivery.
  
  
Build productive working relationships across diverse technical and non-technical stakeholder groups, resolving issues with clarity and pace.
  
  

* Safety, Quality & Operational Readiness

Champion a safety-first culture and ensure delivery activities comply with applicable site, company, and local regulatory requirements.
  
  
Drive quality assurance, inspections, defect management, system completion, commissioning readiness, and handover activities.
  
  
Ensure construction handover is complete, orderly, and suitable for transition into commissioning and operations.
  
  

* People Leadership & Capability Building

Directly manage, coach, and develop Construction Managers, Project Managers, and/or project controls personnel, setting clear expectations and supporting performance growth.
  
  
Plan team capacity and resource allocation to meet the local delivery pipeline and changing business priorities.
  
  
Embed consistent delivery practices, templates, reporting rhythms, and lessons learned across the team.
  
  
Success Measures (KPIs)
  
  
Delivery performance: milestone attainment, schedule trend stability, critical-path reliability, and approved-budget performance.
  
  
Safety: incident performance, audit outcomes, and demonstrable safety leadership.
  
  
Quality & readiness: defect closure, commissioning-readiness gates, and handover-pack completeness.
  
  
Governance: accurate forecasting, on-time reporting, effective escalation, and timely decision resolution.
  
  
People leadership: team capability growth, resource readiness, engagement, and consistent adoption of delivery practices.
  
  
**Required Experience & Qualifications**
8-10 years of construction, project delivery, or program delivery experience, ideally in mission-critical environments such as data centers, critical infrastructure, industrial, pharma, aviation, utilities, or similarly complex developments.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing people, including setting objectives, coaching performance, developing capability, and allocating team resources.
  
  
Proven experience delivering multiple construction projects or workstreams from design coordination through construction, commissioning, and operational handover.
  
  
Strong understanding of project controls, scheduling, cost management, construction risk, change control, and contractor management.
  
  
Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences.
  
  
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and to travel domestically as business needs require.
  
  
**Preferred**
Experience delivering data center, critical-facility, or other mission-critical construction programs.
  
  
Knowledge of commissioning frameworks, readiness gating, and operational handover requirements.
  
  
Experience working with colocation, partner-delivery, or integrated network/customer dependencies.
  
  
Relevant degree or professional qualification in construction management, engineering, project management, quantity surveying, or a related field.
  
  
Key Skills & Competencies
  
  
Hands-on construction delivery leadership with a strong execution focus.
  
  
People management, coaching, performance leadership, and team capacity planning.
  
  
Program governance, schedule discipline, and project-controls capability; familiarity with P6 and/or MS Project is beneficial.
  
  
Strong risk, dependency, escalation, and issue-resolution management.
  
  
Clear written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and cross-cultural collaboration.
  
  
Safety and quality leadership, with a continuous-improvement mindset.

title: Senior Manager - RTR
description:
**Job Purpose:**
The Senior Manager - Record to Report (R2R) Tower Lead will provide strategic and operational leadership for the Record-to-Report function , supporting multiple businesses, countries, and legal entities. The role is responsible for delivering a scalable, high-performing, and control-focused R2R organization covering General Ledger, Period-End Close, Balance Sheet Reconciliations, Fixed Assets, Intercompany Accounting, Financial Reporting support, controls, and audit support

**JobResponsibilities / KRAs:**

**1. R2R Tower Leadership & Service Delivery**

* Provide end-to-end leadership for the R2R tower, establishing clear accountability, governance, service standards, KPIs and escalation mechanisms across supported businesses and entities.
* Ensure effective delivery across General Ledger, Financial Close, Balance Sheet Reconciliations, Fixed Assets, Intercompany and related accounting activities.
* Partner with the Head of Finance Shared Services and global Finance leadership to strengthen service delivery, financial controllership and the future-state operating model.

**2. Financial Close, Accounting & Reporting**

* Lead governance over monthly, quarterly and annual close, ensuring accurate, complete and timely financial accounting and reporting.
* Oversee General Ledger activities including journals, accruals, allocations, reconciliations and period-end accounting, with appropriate review of significant or unusual matters.
* Improve
  **close speed, predictability and quality**
  through standardization, automation, effective issue resolution and adherence to accounting policies.

**3. Balance Sheet, Fixed Assets & Intercompany Governance**

* Own balance-sheet reconciliation governance, with risk-based review of material accounts and timely resolution of aged, unsupported or unreconciled balances.
* Provide oversight of Fixed Asset and Intercompany accounting, reconciliation and related financial controls.
* Identify recurring accounting issues and drive sustainable root-cause resolution while ensuring material financial risks are appropriately escalated.

**4. Financial Governance & Business Partnership**

* Maintain strong financial governance across R2R, ensuring adherence to accounting policies, internal controls, statutory requirements and applicable audit requirements.
* Partner with Legal Entity Controllers, Business Finance, FP&A, Tax, Treasury and Corporate/Regional Controllership to ensure accurate financial information, clear accountability and effective resolution of cross-functional matters.
* Provide accounting insights to support business decision-making and proactively identify, escalate and drive remediation of financial reporting, audit and control risks.

**5. Global Process Standardization & Process Governance**

* Partner with Global Process Owners to standardize R2R processes, controls, RACI, service expectations and ways of working across businesses and entities.
* Maintain effective governance over
  **SOPs, Desk Procedures and end-to-end process flows**
  , ensuring processes, controls, systems and handoffs are appropriately documented.
* Challenge unnecessary process variations and strengthen knowledge management to improve consistency, scalability and reduce key-person dependency.

**6. Transition & Service Migration**

* Lead R2R transitions into the India GCC, establishing governance across scope, timelines, knowledge transfer, controls, documentation, risks and dependencies.
* Ensure business continuity and accounting/control readiness throughout migration, followed by effective stabilization and hyper care.
* Establish repeatable transition practices and apply lessons learned to improve future Finance migrations.

**7. Transformation, Technology & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the R2R transformation roadmap, driving process simplification, standardization, automation and elimination of non-value-added activities.
* Partner with Technology and Finance teams on ERP initiatives and leverage workflow, analytics, automation and appropriate AI capabilities to strengthen quality, productivity and controls.
* Promote exception-based management and ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in process effectiveness and scalability.

**8. Team Leadership & People Management**

* Lead and develop a large RTR organization comprising Team Leads, Managers, and individual contributors.
* Manage teams across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Build succession plans and talent pipelines for key positions.
* Drive employee engagement, performance management, coaching, and capability development.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer centricity.

**9. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as primary finance operations partner for Controllers, CFO organizations, Business Finance teams, and Country Finance leaders.

title: Procurement Manager – Data Center Cooling & Critical Infrastructure
description:
**Job Role :**

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Experience:**
5–10 Years

**Industry:**
AI Infrastructure / Data Centers / Liquid Cooling / Critical Infrastructure

**Company:**
Stealth AI Infrastructure Startup

About the Company

We are a stealth-mode technology company building next-generation infrastructure for
**AI Data Centers and high-density computing environments**
.

Our engineering and manufacturing teams are developing advanced
**liquid cooling and thermal-management systems**
designed for the rapidly increasing power densities of modern AI infrastructure.

We are looking for a
**Procurement Manager**
who can build and manage a high-performance procurement ecosystem for critical cooling infrastructure, working closely with engineering, manufacturing, quality, project management and suppliers.

**About the Role**

As Procurement Manager, you will own the procurement lifecycle for our
**Data Center Cooling and Liquid Cooling systems**
— from supplier identification and technical-commercial evaluation through negotiation, purchase orders, expediting, quality coordination and delivery.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on procurement experience in
**Data Centers, Critical Infrastructure, HVAC, Precision Cooling, Liquid Cooling, MEP, Industrial Equipment or similar environments**
.

You should understand that procurement for mission-critical infrastructure is not simply about achieving the lowest price — it requires balancing
**cost, quality, technical specifications, reliability, lead time and supply-chain risk**
.

**Key Responsibilities :**

Strategic Procurement

* Develop and execute procurement strategies for data center cooling and critical infrastructure components.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard qualified domestic and international suppliers.
* Develop a reliable supplier ecosystem for critical and long-lead components.
* Build alternate suppliers and dual-source strategies for critical components.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, warranties, lead times and commercial conditions.
* Drive cost optimization without compromising technical specifications or reliability.

**Data Center Cooling Procurement**

Manage procurement across components such as:

* Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs)
* Heat exchangers
* Pumps and pump skids
* Valves and actuators
* Manifolds and distribution assemblies
* Stainless steel / copper / specialized piping
* Hoses, connectors and fittings
* Sensors and instrumentation
* Flow meters and control components
* Cooling towers / chillers / dry coolers
* CRAH / CRAC-related equipment
* Liquid cooling skids
* Filtration and water-treatment systems
* Electrical and control panels
* Industrial fabrication and machined components
* Sheet metal and structural assemblies
* Seals, gaskets and other critical consumables

**Supplier Management**

* Develop and maintain a qualified supplier database.
* Conduct supplier evaluation based on capability, capacity, quality, cost and delivery performance.
* Manage supplier negotiations and commercial agreements.
* Establish supplier SLAs and performance metrics.
* Conduct periodic supplier performance reviews.
* Work with suppliers to improve quality, lead times and cost.
* Develop local manufacturing and fabrication partners where appropriate.

**Engineering & Technical Coordination**

* Work closely with Design Engineering, Thermal Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality teams.
* Understand engineering BOMs, technical specifications, drawings and material requirements.
* Participate in technical-commercial evaluations of suppliers.
* Coordinate prototype and first-article procurement.
* Support engineering teams in identifying alternate materials, components and suppliers.
* Ensure procurement decisions remain aligned with approved engineering specifications.

**Purchase & Delivery Management**

* Raise and manage purchase orders and procurement schedules.
* Track material requirements against project timelines.
* Drive supplier expediting for critical and long-lead items.
* Monitor manufacturing progress and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate with Quality for inspection and acceptance.
* Ensure timely delivery to manufacturing sites and project locations.
* Maintain procurement trackers, supplier schedules and delivery dashboards.

**Cost & Commercial Management**

* Prepare cost comparisons and should-cost analyses.
* Negotiate annual and project-based pricing.
* Identify opportunities for volume discounts and strategic sourcing.
* Track procurement savings and cost avoidance.
* Manage payment terms, credit periods and commercial risks.
* Support budgeting and cost estimation for new cooling systems and projects.

**Quality & Compliance**

* Work with Quality teams to establish supplier qualification processes.
* Ensure suppliers meet required technical and quality standards.
* Coordinate supplier audits where required.
* Support incoming inspection, NCR resolution and corrective actions.
* Ensure traceability and documentation for critical components.

**What We're Looking For**

Must-Have Experience

* **5–10 years of procurement / strategic sourcing experience.**
* Experience in
  **Data Centers, Data Center Cooling, HVAC, Precision Cooling, Liquid Cooling, MEP, Critical Infrastructure or Industrial Equipment**
  .
* Experience procuring engineered / mission-critical equipment and components.
* Strong supplier development and negotiation experience.
* Experience working with engineering drawings, BOMs and technical specifications.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing and supply-chain processes.
* Experience managing multiple suppliers and projects simultaneously.

Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL") is a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited. ABFL offers end-to-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers - Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid & Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. description:
**Job Purpose**
The purpose of this job is to execute sales operations through the Direct channel (builders, connectors, brokers, references, etc.) in line with branch plan and objectives, leading and supporting the Sales Officer team in achieving targets and managing client relationships. This role coordinates with Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure compliant and efficient sales operations, and portfolio health. It also drives and executes cross-selling across ABHFL and ABFSG products/ solutions as per branch level objectives and client requirements.
  
  
**Job Context & Major Challenges**
Job Context & Challenges:Part of the Aditya Birla Financial Service Group (ABFSG), Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL) is registered with the National Housing Bank as a housing finance company under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987. The company offers a complete range of housing finance solutions such as home loans, home improvement and home construction loans, balance transfer and top-up loans, loans against property and construction finance. The company acquired its license on 9th July 2014 and has aggressive growth plans.
  
  
ABHFL operates in the Rs. 11.4 trillion Indian Housing Finance market, which has grown at a steady rate of 17% CAGR over the last 3 years while reporting good asset quality despite challenges in the operating environment. While the industry is dominated by five large groups, there has been an emergence of newer entrants in niche segments like affordable housing and self-employed borrowers, given the high potential in these segments. Despite increased focus by banks, HFCs have been able to maintain their share in the mortgage market and has remained stable at ~37% as on December 2015.
  
  
The ABHFL Sales organization works broadly with 3 customer segments – retail (individual) customers, institutional customers (for retail and institutional loan consumers) and builders (for both retail tie-ups and construction finance), with a major share of the business coming from retail customers. Client segments can also be divided into Salaried and Self employed, with both of these having very different preferences and needs.
  
  
Job Context
  
  
**Key Aspects**
Providing housing finance (to buyers), Loan against Property, Commercial Property Purchase, Lease Rental Discounting and Construction Finance (to builders) solutions, ABHFL caters to a diverse range of customer segments through its various service offerings. Additionally, being predominantly retail driven, the business is characterized by high volume of loan transactions and customer relationships. As a result, ABHFL business performance is strongly impacted by people, process and organizational efficiencies, alongside core business drivers such as product/ solution quality, channel and customer relationship management and risk management.
  
  
While unit of sizing up the business is its loan book size, profitability and minimized delinquency are also key business objectives.
  
  
Higher cost of funding impacts profitability as well as competitiveness of loan rates that can be offered to clients
  
  
For retail customers, identifying and acting on relevant needs for target demographics/ customer segments/ etc., in an efficient manner ensuring process, statutory and regulatory compliance at all times, are key for building business performance and sustainability.
  
  
For institutional/ builder customers, understanding and addressing complex business requirements via proactive relationship management and customized solution fitment, while ensuring compliance at all times, are important to gain competitive advantage in this segment.
  
  
The Sales Manager (Direct) – ABHFL is responsible for achieving sales targets through direct channels, as agreed with the AH (Sales) – ABHFL, in terms of targeted book size, growth & customer service objectives.
  
  
Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include commercial acumen, team management and communication, product-market awareness, and execution skills.
  
  
Education & experience required to fulfil this profile are a graduate with minimum 5 - 7 yrs of total sales experience in the Banking/ NBFC space, of which at least recent 2 - 3 yrs experience should be in HFC sales.
  
  
**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)**
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
KRA1 Sales Planning & Management Work with AH (Sales) - ABHFL and plan sales operations for achieving targets, considering competitive forces and local trends, and cascade the same to the team
  
  
Scan the local market and competitive offerings on a periodic basis, guiding team members on possible opportunities and challenges
  
  
Proactively track target achievement and intervene with sales efforts (personal references, prospecting, etc.) to ensure the same
  
  
Communicate sales targets and provide team members clarity on business goals, role expectations, product characteristics and USPs to enhance effectiveness of sales efforts
  
  
Deploy schemes to drive sales and enhance profitability, ensuring dual focus on sales expansion and cost optimization
  
  
Provide data for and compile periodic MIS reports for disbursements, profitability, NPAs, market expansion, etc. and communicate to AH (Sales) - ABHFL as well as to team members
  
  
KRA2 Customer Acquisition/ Engagement Identify local business growth opportunities, guide customer acquisition efforts, intervening where required for relationship management/ origination
  
  
Work closely with team members, hand-holding critical/ complex transactions to ensure favourable closure with customer satisfaction
  
  
Intervene where required to manage customer complaints/ grievances effectively, and escalate to AH (Sales) - ABHFL as necessary to secure customer relationship
  
  
KRA3 Operational Effectiveness Monitor and ensure efficient business processes/ operations across the Customer Lifecycle (Sourcing, Approval, Servicing, Collections)
  
  
Work with team for adequate focus on different distribution channels, interfacing with senior stakeholders as required for smooth operations
  
  
Drive process efficiencies and faster TATs through interfacing with stakeholders across processes and functions (Risk, Operations, Sales Governance)
  
  
Drive the implementation of improved processes and best practices in order to enhance operational effectiveness, productivity and overall business impact
  
  
KRA4 Cross-Selling across ABFSG products Drive team efforts as per Cross-Selling strategy agreed with AH (Sales) - ABHFL
  
  
Drive alignment to the adopted Cross-Selling strategy by supporting team members with requisite communications, training, guidance, and interfacing with clients where required
  
  
KRA5 Team and Internal Stakeholder Management Guide and develop team members for enhanced customer acquisition and engagement efforts, and hand-hold as required
  
  
Nominate teams for relevant technical and behavioral trainings/ seminars and work on self development initiatives
  
  
Coordinate with internal stakeholders for smooth operations and alignment towards achievement of targets
  
  
KRA6 Portfolio & Risk Management Work with the Risk, Operations and Sales Governance teams to ensure adherence to risk management and control mechanisms
  
  
Drive compliant Sales Operations and sound risk management by training and guiding the team proactively on early alert practices to reduce NPA risks
  
  
Compile and ensure systematic, accurate MIS on NPAs and credit trends, providing inputs on factors impacting portfolio quality
