title: Global AML Center (GAC) Operations & CAO – Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.

As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.

**Why this role is important to us**

The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.

Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.

**What you will be responsible for**

As Vice President you will:

***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders

* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards

* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance

* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model

* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking

* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability

* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls

* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance

* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds

* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value

* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda

* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning

* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy

* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials

* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time

* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through

* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning

* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure

* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements

* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed

* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight

* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability

* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required

* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization

* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential

* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working
  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role:

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls

* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans

* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment

* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models

* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers

* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them

* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions

* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively

* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning

* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials

* A collaborative leadership style that balances empowerment with accountability

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in AML/KYC, financial crime or operations within a large global financial institution

* Demonstrated experience leading strategic transformation and technology change programs, from business case to adoption

* Significant senior people leadership experience, including leading leaders

* Experience in business management role, including budget, headcount and governance ownership, is strongly preferred

* Bachelor’s degree required

* Strong knowledge of global AML/KYC regulatory requirements

* Experience with KYC workflow platforms (e.g., Fenergo/FenX), automation tools or AI solutions is an advantage

* Change or project management credentials (e.g., PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile) are an advantage

* Professional certifications such as CAMS or ICA are an advantage

* Proven ability to present to and work effectively with an executive audience

* Excellent verbal and written English and advanced MS Office skills
  

  

**About State Street**
======================

  

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

  
  

We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

  
  

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

**Position Overview:**
The SFC Hub Manager is accountable for end-to-end operational performance of an individual Surface Hub, ensuring timely, accurate and cost-efficient movement of shipments across inbound, processing, sorting, staging and outbound linehaul operations.
  
  
The role owns day-to-day Surface Hub execution including shipment processing, throughput, turnaround time, manpower deployment, dock and yard operations, vehicle loading and unloading, cut-off adherence, shipment quality, safety and infrastructure readiness.
  
  
Leads hub operational teams across shifts and ensures seamless connectivity between upstream pickup / CPU operations and downstream Surface, Air and Last Mile networks.
  
  
The role works closely with the Regional SFC Hub Manager and Regional SFC Network & Fleet Manager to ensure timely vehicle placement, dispatch readiness, load consolidation, route connectivity and operational recovery during delays or capacity disruptions.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To manage a safe, reliable and high-performing Surface Hub by ensuring timely shipment processing, accurate sorting, efficient linehaul connectivity, optimum manpower and infrastructure utilization, and adherence to network cut-offs, while continuously improving throughput, productivity, service quality and cost efficiency.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Surface Hub Operational Leadership**

* Own day-to-day operational performance of the SFC Hub across all shifts.
* Translate regional network plans, shipment volumes and linehaul schedules into daily hub operating plans.
* Ensure smooth execution of inbound receipt, unloading, sorting, processing, staging, loading and outbound dispatch.
* Maintain operational readiness for scheduled and ad-hoc linehaul movements.
* Ensure seamless handover between the SFC Hub, CPU, PUD, Air and Last Mile operations.
* Proactively escalate capacity, manpower, vehicle or infrastructure risks to the Regional SFC Hub Manager.

**Inbound & Outbound Operations**

* Ensure timely unloading, processing and clearance of inbound vehicles.
* Manage accurate sorting and staging of shipments for destination-wise dispatch.
* Ensure outbound loads are processed, built and released within network cut-offs.
* Monitor dock utilization, loading sequence and dispatch readiness.
* Prevent avoidable detention, congestion and shipment accumulation.
* Ensure smooth handover to linehaul vehicles and downstream hubs.
* Drive adherence to loading, sealing, documentation and dispatch-control requirements.

**Throughput & Turnaround Time Management**

* Own hub throughput and processing TAT across all shifts.
* Monitor hourly shipment flow and proactively address bottlenecks.
* Ensure effective load balancing across shifts, docks, processing areas and teams.
* Reduce backlog and ensure timely processing of ageing or exception shipments.
* Improve vehicle turnaround time and dock productivity.
* Drive consistent throughput during peak and seasonal periods.

**Linehaul & Network Connectivity**

* Ensure adherence to scheduled linehaul departures and network cut-offs.
* Coordinate with the Regional SFC Network & Fleet Manager on vehicle placement, capacity and route requirements.
* Monitor inbound vehicle arrival and outbound dispatch performance.
* Minimize missed connections and avoidable linehaul delays.
* Support contingency planning during vehicle shortages, road disruptions, network delays or sudden volume spikes.
* Ensure optimal synchronization between the hub and upstream/downstream network locations.

**People Leadership & Workforce Management**

* Lead supervisors, executives, operational staff and outsourced workforce across the SFC Hub.
* Plan shift-wise manpower based on shipment volume and operational workload.
* Ensure efficient manpower deployment across unloading, sorting, processing, loading and support activities.
* Drive attendance, productivity, discipline and accountability across shifts.
* Build team capability through coaching, training and on-the-job development.
* Maintain adequate contingency manpower for peak periods and operational disruptions.
* Promote a high-performance, safety-focused and improvement-oriented culture.

**Shipment Quality & Operational Accuracy**

* Ensure accurate sorting, scanning, routing and handling of shipments.
* Monitor missorts, misroutes, damages, losses and processing exceptions.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring quality defects.
* Ensure physical-to-system reconciliation and scan compliance.
* Reduce rework, handling errors and avoidable shipment movement.
* Maintain shipment security and chain-of-custody discipline.

**Capacity & Infrastructure Management**

* Monitor hub capacity against current and projected shipment volumes.
* Ensure docks, processing areas, material-handling equipment and workstations are operationally ready.
* Coordinate with Engineering / Facilities teams for equipment breakdowns and preventive maintenance.
* Support layout improvements and workflow redesign to improve movement efficiency.
* Identify emerging capacity constraints and recommend infrastructure enhancement.
* Ensure adequate peak-period storage, staging and processing readiness.

**Productivity & Cost Management**

* Drive shipments-per-man-hour productivity across hub operations.
* Improve dock, manpower and infrastructure utilization.
* Optimize shift deployment, overtime, consumables and support resources.
* Reduce vehicle detention, idle time, excess handling and rework.
* Monitor cost per shipment and identify efficiency opportunities.
* Track operational cost and productivity trends and implement corrective actions.
* Deliver cost improvement without compromising service or safety.

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to Blue Dart operational SOPs, EHS standards and security requirements.
* Maintain safe loading, unloading and material-handling practices.
* Ensure compliance with vehicle, dock and facility safety requirements.
* Conduct regular floor, dock and process audits.
* Drive timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Maintain housekeeping, workplace safety and equipment-operating discipline.
* Coordinate with Security on shipment loss, damage or operational-risk incidents.

**Continuous Improvement & Technology**

* Identify recurring bottlenecks and operational failure points.
* Drive root-cause analysis and structured continuous-improvement initiatives.
* Support implementation of scanning, automation and digital operating tools.
* Use operational data to improve throughput, TAT, productivity and service quality.
* Pilot and implement improved operating practices.
* Measure benefits from productivity, process and technology improvements.
* Share successful practices with the Regional SFC Hub Manager for wider replication.

**Stakeholder & Governance**

* Work closely with the Regional SFC Hub Manager and Regional SFC Network & Fleet Manager.
* Coordinate with CPU, PUD, Air Operations, Last Mile, Engineering, Security, IT, Finance and HR.
* Participate in regional Surface Hub performance reviews.
* Provide accurate daily / weekly operational reporting and risk visibility.
* Escalate network-impacting issues in a timely manner.
* Act as the location SME for Surface Hub operations.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration or related discipline preferred; MBA / PG desirable.
* Experience: 8–11 years of relevant experience in express logistics, Surface Transportation, hub / sort-centre operations, middle-mile logistics, 3PL, eCommerce logistics or high-throughput distribution operations.
* Strong hands-on experience managing inbound, sorting, processing, outbound and linehaul-connected hub operations.
* Proven experience managing medium-to-large operational teams across multiple shifts.
* Strong understanding of network cut-offs, hub throughput, vehicle turnaround and shipment connectivity.
* Experience in manpower planning, productivity improvement and cost optimization.
* Experience handling peak-volume operations and operational contingency planning.
* Exposure to dock operations, material handling, scanning systems and operational technology preferred.
* Strong understanding of safety, process compliance and shipment-quality controls.
* Preferred Industries: Express Logistics, Courier, 3PL, eCommerce Logistics, Surface Transportation, Distribution and Supply Chain Operations.

**Position Overview:**
The Area Operations Manager is responsible for managing the end-to-end operational performance of a defined cluster of non-metro locations within the Branch geography.
  
  
The role oversees multiple Service Centres, Business Development Offices (BDOs), RSP / partner-supported locations and customer-facing counters, ensuring consistent service delivery, workforce productivity, operating discipline and customer experience across the Area.
  
  
Acts as the operational link between the Branch Operations Head and location-level Operations teams, translating Branch priorities into effective local execution while ensuring timely pickup, processing, dispatch and delivery of shipments.
  
  
The role is accountable for service quality, productivity, manpower deployment, local operating cost, infrastructure readiness, partner performance, safety and compliance across assigned locations.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To lead and manage a high-performing cluster of non-metro Operations locations by ensuring reliable service delivery, effective workforce and resource utilization, cost discipline, customer satisfaction and consistent operational standards across Service Centres, BDOs, PUDs and partner-supported locations.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Area Operations Leadership**

* Own operational performance across all assigned locations within the Area.
* Translate Branch operational priorities into location-level execution plans.
* Ensure consistent adherence to Blue Dart operating standards and service commitments.
* Conduct structured daily, weekly and monthly reviews with location Operations teams.
* Identify underperforming locations and drive focused corrective actions.
* Ensure operational readiness across locations for daily volumes, peak periods and business growth.
* Act as the first level of leadership escalation for operational issues across the Area.

**Service Centre & PUD Operations**

* Oversee pickup and delivery performance across Service Centres and PUD locations.
* Monitor First Attempt Delivery, NDR, ageing, pickup adherence and route productivity.
* Ensure adequate manpower and resource deployment across locations.
* Drive adherence to operational cut-offs and shipment-processing requirements.
* Review location-level productivity and initiate corrective actions where required.
* Ensure smooth coordination between Service Centres, PUDs and downstream network nodes.
* Drive standardisation of operating practices across locations.

**Non-Metro / BDO & Partner Operations**

* Govern operations across BDOs, RSPs and other partner-supported locations within the Area.
* Monitor partner / outsourced workforce performance and service adherence.
* Ensure adequate operating capability in lower-volume and remote locations.
* Drive corrective action for recurring partner service or productivity gaps.
* Ensure outsourced locations comply with Blue Dart operational and customer-service standards.
* Escalate structural vendor or operating-model issues to the Branch Operations Head / Regional RSP-BDO Manager as appropriate.
* Maintain service continuity in remote and difficult-to-operate markets.

**Shipment Flow & Network Connectivity**

* Ensure timely inbound and outbound shipment movement across Area locations.
* Monitor adherence to dispatch, pickup and network cut-offs.
* Coordinate with Branch, Hub, CPU and Network teams on recurring connectivity issues.
* Identify shipment accumulation, missed connections and ageing risks.
* Drive timely resolution of operational exceptions.
* Support contingency planning during route disruptions, capacity shortages or peak volumes.
* Ensure timely handover of shipments to upstream and downstream network locations.

**Service Quality & Customer Experience**

* Drive achievement of defined service-quality targets across the Area.
* Review customer complaints and recurring operational service failures.
* Ensure timely root-cause analysis and corrective action.
* Monitor service trends by location and identify high-risk operating pockets.
* Partner with Customer Service / Commercial teams on significant customer issues.
* Ensure customer-facing counters maintain required service and process standards.
* Reduce repeat service failures through preventive action.

description:

**We are hiring: Distribution Center Operations Lead – India**

* Knowledge of SAP, warehouse management systems and Power BI, with advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Strong communication, analytical and collaboration skills, with excellent English proficiency.

title: Customer Manager
description:
**WHO YOU ARE**

We’re on the lookout for an enthusiastic and customer-focused Customer Manager who lives and breathes home furnishing. This is your chance to lead an energetic team, introduce IKEA to new customers, drive success in a new market, and create a meaningful and locally relevant shopping experience.
  
  
• Minimum 5 years of leadership experience with a proven track record in developing and leading high-performing teams.
  
• Experience in driving customer satisfaction and delivering business results in a customer-focused environment.
  
• Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict management skills, with the ability to lead through change and complexity.
  
• Good understanding of IKEA business, values, and ways of working, with experience in a fast-paced, multichannel retail environment.
  
• Good knowledge of P&L, budget management, cost control, and resource optimization.
  
• Good knowledge of Food, Hospitality, Retail Operations, or Customer Service management.
  
• Proven ability to create and deliver an excellent customer experience, utilizing customer insights and feedback to drive continuous improvement.
  
• Good understanding of talent management, including recruitment, succession planning, coaching, and development.
  
• Experience in leading organizational change and implementing improvement initiatives.
  
• Good knowledge of legal compliance requirements, contracts, and vendor/third-party management.
  
• Understanding of health, safety, security, and food safety requirements, with the ability to act as a key contact for authorities and external stakeholders.
  
• Knowledge of food operations, food quality standards, and food business performance management.
  
• Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across functions.
  
• Passion for people, food, and creating positive customer experiences that strengthen business performance and customer loyalty.
  
• Good analytical and communication skills

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

To lead the Customer Relations and IKEA Food functions by driving commercial growth, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction across all channels. The role is accountable for maximizing sales, profitability, and business performance in line with local, national, and global frameworks, while ensuring a safe, high-quality, and rewarding customer experience. Through customer insights, feedback, and emerging consumer trends, the role continuously improves customer journey, strengthens customer loyalty, and develops recommendations that support sustainable business growth and operational effectiveness. The role also ensures compliance with food safety, health, safety, and security requirements for customers and co-workers.
  
  
• Drive a customer-focused culture throughout the complete market and secure an overall inspiring shopping experience where it is always for customers easy to shop.
  
• Influence the unit management team with customer insights that will allow it to base business decisions on customer expectations.
  
• Responsible for identifying and removing hindrances to secure an easy buying experience, a positive shopping experience and easy payment and after-sales fulfilment.
  
• Support commercial initiatives and priorities before, during and after the shopping experience.
  
• Establish and maintain service agreements with internal stakeholders (including customer support) and external partners to protect operational standards and help safeguard the IKEA culture.
  
• Plan and determine which departmental resources and investments are required to achieve operational excellence in balance with customer expectations.
  
• Secure and monitor the department is working according to internal, global and national rules and policies, IKEA best practise and in accordance with local legislation. Collect and synthetize consumer, customer, brand and internal data to contribute with recommendations and decisions to improve and to develop customer service.
  
• Provide relevant consumer and customer insights to the store team to initiate and support problem solving and find solutions to improve customer shopping experience.
  
• Responsible for the development of excellence in the customer experience including all services and HCS / Pulse CX.
  
• Champion the delivery of a seamless, convenient and rewarding end to end shopping experience to maximize conversion and selling more across all channels
  
• Actively cooperate with all key stakeholders within commercial and beyond to secure integration, common focus and to maximize impact for our customers.
  
• Responsible for customer experience in the store, seamless and convenient check-out and IKEA Food business (Swedish bite)
  
• Contributes to the implementation of global and national food safety compliance standards to secure a safe environment for customers and co-workers.
  
• Ensure that retail foundations and sales steering tools, food safety and Swedishness are in place to optimize commerciality
  
• Contribute to the creation and implementation of the IKEA Retail Food business plan and food action plans
  
• Ensure the customer focus and relevant business plans relate and create the local action plan accordingly that is operationally implemented and fulfilled.
  
• Lead, coach, develop the full team promoting individual growth and competence and secure a high performing team and a strong collaboration across the store.
  
• Ensure the building of business competence by supporting managers, leaders and team members in setting and working on relevant goals and agreed development plans.
  
• Identify and develop the talents in the unit and within the department to secure succession planning.
  
• Establish and maintain service agreements with internal stakeholders, across the market, with SO, RCMP and external partners to develop efficient operational processes and promote IKEA culture and values.
  
• Secure and monitor the department is working according to internal, global and national rules and policies, IKEA best practice and in accordance with local legislation.

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM**

To drive sales growth and sustained long-term profitability, by providing an outstanding shopping experience and establishing and retaining a life-long relationship with existing and new customers. This is achieved by working in partnership with our customers and other functions to:
  
  
• Secure an easy buying process from home to home
  
• Understand and match customers’ needs and expectations now and in the future.
  
• Secure always strong customer focus as priority.
  
The aim is to motivate our customers to shop with us more frequently because they trust us to make their shopping experiences successful and their visits worthwhile. Being the voice of the customers in the store and secure that all store team members understand the importance of our customer centric approach. Every customer counts.
  
  
Let’s create the future of home furnishing together! ❤
  
  
WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
  
At IKEA we value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are committed to providing coworkers with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We encourage individualism and invite you to come join our team and be yourself with us! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristic protected by law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

title: Clinical Trial Manager
description:
Medpace is the leading CRO for Biotech companies and is continuing to add Clinical Trial Managers of different experience levels to join our Clinical Trial Management Group in Navi Mumbai, India Office. Clinical Trial Managers with expertise in Cardiovascular, Renal, Metabolic or Gastrointestinal related are welcome to continue to work in their area of expertise or to expand to a new therapeutic area.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage and provide accountability for day-to-day operations of the project, as defined by the contract and according to ICH/GCP and all other applicable laws, rules, and regulations;
* Serve as primary Sponsor contact for operational project-specific issues and study deliverables;
* Maintain in depth knowledge of protocol, therapeutic area, and indication;
* Provide cross-functional oversight of internal project team members and deliverables, which includes ensuring all necessary project-specific training is provided;
* Review and provide input for study protocol, edit check specifications, data analysis plan, and final study report, when applicable;
* Develop operational project plans;
* Manage risk assessment and execution;
* Responsible for management of study vendor; and

* Bachelor’s degree in a health or life science-related field; Advanced degree in a health or life science-related field preferred;
* At least 2 years of clinical trial management experience in Asia Pacific region ideally in a CRO environment;
* Experience in Cardiovascular, Renal, Metabolic or Gastrointestinal related studies required;
* Excellent communication skills including good written and spoken English; and
* Flexible, accountable and comfortable in working in a global environment.

**Medpace Overview**
Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development

title: Head Supply Chain Management - Mumbai
description:
The Position

  

Are you passionate about building an efficient, customer-focused supply chain that keeps products moving seamlessly from forecast to delivery? In this role, you'll take ownership of the end-to-end supply chain, ensuring our products reach customers and stockists on time, in the right quality, and at the right cost.

  

You will lead demand forecasting, supply planning, warehousing, distribution, logistics, customer service, and partner management while driving continuous improvement across the supply chain network. Beyond operational excellence, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of our supply chain by leading strategic initiatives, digital transformation efforts, and regional optimization programs that support business growth.

  

Duties & Responsibilities

  

  
* Champion a strong Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) culture and ensure alignment across the business.
  
* Partner with stakeholders to balance opportunities, risks, financial targets, and supply requirements.
  
* Continuously identify and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, service levels, and cost effectiveness.
  
* Monitor forecasting accuracy and challenge assumptions to improve supply reliability and business performance.
  
* Establish and track key supply chain KPIs to drive operational excellence.
  
* Manage operational costs and ensure delivery against budget commitments.
  
* Build strong relationships with stockists, distributors, logistics partners, trade stakeholders, and internal teams.
  
* Ensure successful product launches through effective cross-functional collaboration.
  
* Support key commercial initiatives such as pricing changes, lifecycle management, and portfolio optimization.
  
* Drive local improvement projects including packaging enhancements, logistics optimization, order consolidation, security measures, and digitalization initiatives.
  
* Ensure all operations comply with quality, safety, security, regulatory, legal, and financial requirements.
  
* Oversee third-party logistics and distribution partners, ensuring high performance, compliance, and exceptional customer service.
  
* Lead corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to maintain operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
* Develop and mentor a high-performing supply chain team, helping individuals grow while supporting business success.
  
* Drive future-focused supply chain initiatives, including network optimization, track-and-trace solutions, automation, and process simplification.
  
* Navigate complex stakeholder environments and influence across functions and external partners.
  
* Balance customer service, inventory, operational costs, and supply reliability.
  
* Build strong relationships while effectively managing a diverse distribution network.
  
* Drive operational improvements without disrupting business continuity.
  
* Lead through change and adapt quickly to evolving market, regulatory, and business requirements.
  
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
  

  

**About our Future Employee**

  

  
* Education : Post graduate in management or PG in SC with a basic degree in commerce, arts, science, engineering etc.
  
* Assertive Communication,Strong India distribution knowledge and ability to manage the traders & union, Being both strategic & operational, Ability to lead a team covering all functions from forecasting till delivery of material to stocksist and their on.
  
* Should have been in a leadership role for over 10 years with an over all experience of 15 to 20 years+ primarily in MNC Pharmaceutical Organization.
  
* Have through working knowledge around regulatory, GWP, GxP, Quality, Safety, Compliance, Cost impacts etc., around Pharmaceutical product supply & distribution in the India context
  
* Knowledge & strategical management of trade and their union
  
* Complete understanding of Sc operations across various activities such as forecasting, supplies, s&op process, inventory management, Imports and export regulations, customs interaction management etc.
  
* Ability to manage team of 5-6 members / network of cfas etc.
  
* Position will be based at Mumbai
  
  

  

READY TO APPLY?

  

Click the “Apply On Company website” button. Create an account or sign in and continue to register your profile, upload your resume, and apply in the company site.

  
**Our Company**
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com.
  
  
**Why Boehringer Ingelheim?**

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

The Clinical Trial Manager interprets data on project issues and makes good business decisions with support from experienced team members or line manager. Works to ensure that all clinical deliverables meet the customer's time/quality/cost expectations. Maintains profitability by ensuring clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the clinical team. The position involves working on projects of low to moderate complexity and as part of a team of CTMs.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Manage all clinical operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of low to moderate complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. In accordance to project specific requirements, may assume Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities on small and/or less complex projects.
* Develop clinical tools (e.g. Monitoring Plan, Monitoring Guidelines) in conjunction with the Data Quality Plan. Contribute to the development of the Master Action Plan (MAP) for providing clinical related documents. Ensure timely set up, organization, content and quality of the relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design and development of CRFs, CRF guidelines, patient informed consent templates and other protocol specific documents as required. Collaborate with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand-off meetings.
* Collaborate with the clinical team and other departments as needed to meet deliverables of the project. Regularly communicate with the team and lead team meetings to ensure that timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Responsible for the implementation and training of standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Responsible for the timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department.
* Ensure achievement of the final clinical deliverable within the contractual time period specified by preparing and monitoring clinical activity timelines and metrics, providing status updates to the project manager, regularly reviewing projects using tracking and management tools, implementing recovery actions, reviewing monitoring visit reports, and managing CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitor or co-monitors clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. In smaller regions, may routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials.
* May communicate with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, case report form completion and other study-related issues.
* May coordinate all start-up activities and ensures that timely ethics committee and regulatory submissions (if appropriate) are addressed. Ensure that essential document quality meets the expectation of Regulatory Compliance Review. Review and follows up on all questions raised by the ethics committees.
* May provide input into preparation of forecast estimates for clinical activities. Responsible for clinical resource management, assignment, delegation of clinical responsibilities and identification of additional resource requirements.

**Education & Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
* 2+ Years of Experience in CTM role for more than 1 Year
* Hands on experience in Onsite Monitoring and managing clinical trials
* Must be from Mumbai or near by Location
* Should have Hands on experience in ICF, DCGI, Import/Export, EC/IRB related Submission
* Should have Hands on experience in Negotiating with Site Contracts, Scheduling and leading meeting with DCGI or any Regulatory Authorities

In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:
  
  

* Good leadership skills, effective at mentoring and training, and capable of motivating and integrating teams
* Good planning and organizational skills to enable effective prioritization of workload
* Solid interpersonal and problem solving skills to enable working in a multicultural matrix organization
* Capable of working effectively in a changing environment with complex/ambiguous situations
* Familiarity with the practices, processes, and requirements of clinical monitoring
* Good judgment and decision making skills
* Effective oral and written communication skills, including English language proficiency
* Capable of evaluating workload against project budget and adjusting resources accordingly
* Sound financial acument and knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and fiscal management
* Strong attention to detail
* Solid understanding of relevant regulations e.g. ICH/GCP, FDA guidelines, etc.
* Good computer skills to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word, etc.

Working Conditions and Environment:

title: Audit Manager - Retail
description:
**Audit Manager - Retail**

* **The Opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're building the world's most admired tattoo company.

With 16+ premium studios, a team of 160+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become a global lifestyle brand, we believe great businesses are built by great leaders.

We're not looking for managers who simply maintain operations.

We're looking for leaders who build businesses, develop people, obsess over customer experience, and think like owners.

If you thrive in high-performance environments, love solving complex business challenges, and enjoy leading teams to extraordinary results, we'd love to meet you.

As a Cluster Manager, you will be the CEO of your region.

* **The Mandate**

You will own quality across the entire studio network end to end — compliance with how a studio is meant to run, the customer experience it delivers, the physical readiness of the floor, and the integrity of every rupee that passes through it. You'll design the audit system itself — what gets checked, how often, through what method — and build and run the team that executes it. You'll report to the Director of Operations AT, with the standing to raise what you find directly and have it acted on.

* **What you'll be doing**

Checking every studio against its own standard — how it opens, how it closes, the process it's supposed to run — through visits that are sometimes announced and sometimes not, in person and on camera, so what you see is what's actually happening, not what's being reported.

Following through on what you find. A gap logged and forgotten is worse than no audit at all — you'll drive every finding to a real fix, and when the same issue shows up in more than one studio, you'll catch that it's not five separate problems but one system that needs to change.

Defining what a great customer experience looks like in an Aliens studio, and checking every visit against it — real visits and unannounced ones — so the standard is more than a document nobody's held to.

Owning the physical readiness of every studio — hygiene, safety, the equipment a session actually depends on — and catching what's broken before a customer does.

Protecting the integrity of what happens at the till. Every rupee collected reaches the business, every invoice gets raised, every number in the system can be trusted — and when it can't, you're the one who catches it and escalates it.

Building the entire audit system from nothing — the calendar, the criteria, the dashboards that make every studio's status visible without anyone needing to ask — designed to keep running whether or not you're the one checking that day.

Hiring and growing the team that makes all of this real at network scale — holding the bar on every seat, and coaching the kind of discipline that makes an audit actually mean something.

* **What we're looking for**

You've done this before — run quality or audit work across multiple locations.

You know that a standard which only holds where someone's watching isn't a standard at all.

Your eye for detail borders on the obsessive. You catch what other people walk past — the small drift that becomes the big failure six months later.

You think in systems, not incidents. You don't just find problems; you build the process that catches the next hundred before they happen.

You are exacting with numbers, especially where money and trust intersect. When a finding is inconvenient for someone — a studio manager, a high performer, someone senior — you report what you found, not what's comfortable.

Most people who are good at meticulous, detailed inspection work are not naturally the kind of person who can also design a system and build a team. This role needs both — the person who'll walk a studio floor at 7am checking a washroom, and the person who'll sit down and design the dashboard that makes a hundred studios' worth of that visible at once.

Bachelor's degree, with a track record in quality assurance, audit or operations across a multi-location retail, hospitality or service business. That's the baseline — what we're actually hiring is the judgment that comes from having done this at scale before.

* **What success looks like**

every studio in the network is audited on a published cadence, with nothing left unaccounted for. The compliance status of any studio is answerable in a moment, without needing to call and check. Cash and billing integrity is verified everywhere, and the leaks that used to go unnoticed get caught before they become losses.

The audit system runs as a system — not as you personally visiting every studio, but as a team you've built and trained, working to a standard you designed and can walk away from without it slipping.

* **Practical details**

Education: Bachelor's degree, any discipline

Preferred Industry - Retail Only

A quality or process-audit certification — Six Sigma, ISO auditing or equivalent - This is optional, However this is an added advantage

* Train and mentor junior staff on best practices for survey programming and coding, including improving efficiency in translating spec documents to final survey designs, effectively testing routing and randomization for accuracy, and using JavaScript and other custom web design languages to create custom layouts and presentations to meet client needs
* Serve as a senior voice for internal communication, stepping in to resolve project issues between team members and operational staff, provide leadership on kickoffs for complex or sustained engagements, and serve as an advisor on sales or internal kick-off calls where demonstrated programming experience is needed

**What we Offer:**

* Competitive compensation
* Employee medical coverage

* Entrepreneurial environment, autonomy, and fast decisions

Guidepoint powers end-to-end research workflows for the world’s best research teams.

title: Head – Mining & Metals
description:
**Job Description**
The Head of Department – Mining & Metals, Australian GCC is a senior business leadership role responsible for leading, growing and developing WSP’s GCC Mining & Metals organisation as an integrated delivery partner to the Australian business. Working with Australian and GCC leadership, the role will establish the leadership capability, operating systems, governance and culture required for a sustainable, scalable and high-performing organisation.
  
  
The role is accountable for the performance and development of an organisation of approximately 70 professionals, with significant growth ambitions. The priority is to build strong leaders, clear accountabilities and embedded business and delivery systems so the organisation operates proactively and consistently without reliance on individual intervention.
  
  
This is a business leadership and operating-model role requiring strong leadership presence, commercial judgement and credibility in an engineering or project-delivery environment. Australian Mining & Metals experience is strongly preferred, although candidates from comparable sectors or markets will be considered where they can establish credibility quickly.
  
  
The Head of Department will strengthen integration through connected relationships at multiple levels and a culture of trust, transparency, constructive challenge and shared accountability. People will be expected to identify risks early, exercise judgement and retain ownership through to resolution, supporting predictable delivery, sustainable growth and career development across both regions.
  
  
**Scope of Work – Mining & Metals**
The GCC Mining & Metals team supports the Australian business across the full project lifecycle, including:
  
  

* Studies and early project phases
* Design and engineering delivery
* Project execution and delivery support
* Operations, sustaining capital and brownfield work

The Head of Department is not expected to provide technical delivery, but is accountable for ensuring the leadership, capability and systems are in place to support high-quality outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Leadership, Governance & Operating Model**

* Provide visible senior leadership with accountability for the organisation’s growth, performance, culture and development.
* Build an effective leader-of-leaders structure with clear responsibilities, decision rights and performance expectations.
* Translate Australian Mining & Metals strategy and business plans into executable GCC priorities and operating requirements.
* Establish and continuously improve the systems, governance and operational disciplines required for consistent and sustainable performance.
* Empower decisions at the appropriate level and build accountability for matters through to resolution, reducing reactive intervention and upward escalation.
* Provide evidence-based advice and constructive challenge to Australian and GCC leadership on strategy, growth, capability and integration.

**Delivery, Quality, Health & Safety**

* Establish a strong culture of health, safety and wellbeing, with clear leadership and individual accountability.
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery within agreed scope, schedule and requirements, aligned with Australian technical governance and client expectations.
* Embed fit-for-purpose planning, assurance, review, reporting and lessons-learned systems that improve delivery confidence and reduce rework.
* Ensure delivery risks, capability constraints and resource limitations are identified early, communicated transparently and addressed appropriately.
* Work with Australian leaders, technical authorities and project managers to clarify requirements, maintain effective interfaces and drive sustained improvement.

**Australian Interface, Integration & Collaboration**

* Strengthen the “One Team – Two Locations” model through trusted relationships between Australian and GCC leaders, disciplines, project teams and support functions.
* Set clear expectations for communication, planning, decision-making and escalation, including early dialogue on scope, priorities, constraints and risk.
* Promote early GCC involvement in workforce and project planning to improve predictability, quality and integration.
* Build multi-level relationships, shared ownership and clear interfaces that reduce reliance on individual points of contact.
* Address structural, behavioural or cultural barriers to collaboration and represent the organisation in relevant leadership forums.

**People, Culture & Capability**

* Create a safe, inclusive and high-performing environment that supports wellbeing, engagement, retention and sustainable growth.
* Build psychological safety, ownership and initiative so people ask questions, provide honest advice, challenge respectfully and bring considered recommendations.
* Build leadership depth through clear accountabilities, coaching, succession planning and practical development pathways.
* Lead workforce planning and recruitment against agreed growth, capability and business plans.
* Empower leaders to manage day-to-day people, performance and delivery matters within clear governance boundaries.
* Build cross-cultural leadership capability and meaningful career opportunities across Australian and GCC teams.

**Business Planning & Resource Stewardship**

* Develop and deliver the GCC Mining & Metals business plan, workforce plan and budget in partnership with Australian leadership.
* Manage headcount, capability, deployment and utilisation to align capacity with demand while protecting quality, wellbeing and sustainable delivery.
* Provide transparent information on performance, capacity, financials and risk to support timely business decisions.
* Support project planning, resource commitments and proposals, ensuring commitments are achievable and commercially sound.
* Promote a value-based approach to GCC growth that improves client outcomes, competitiveness, profitability and reinvestment in people across both regions.

**Key Interfaces & Stakeholders**
Australian Mining & Metals leadership, discipline leaders and project teams; GCC discipline and team leaders; other WSP regions, sectors and GCC leaders; and Talent, HR and Operations teams.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Experience, Skills & Profile Required**

* Senior leadership experience in a complex professional services, engineering or project-delivery environment, including leading leaders and scaling teams.
* Demonstrated success establishing or evolving operating models, governance and delivery systems during growth or transformation.
* Proven ability to lead across regions and cultures and build credibility with Australian or comparable international teams.
* Strong leadership presence and stakeholder skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge constructively and drive behavioural change.
* Experience building leadership depth, accountability and succession rather than relying on direct control.
* Commercial acumen and understanding of workforce planning, utilisation, delivery economics and risk.
* High cultural and emotional intelligence, sound judgement and clear communication.
* Mining & Metals experience is strongly preferred but not mandatory where relevant sector leadership and credibility can be demonstrated.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical leadership experience.
* Postgraduate leadership, management or business qualifications and professional accreditation are advantageous but not mandatory.
* Extensive senior leadership experience, judgement and credibility are more important than specific academic or technical qualifications.

**What Success Looks Like (12–24 Months)**

* Australian and GCC leaders routinely undertake joint workforce, project and delivery planning, with clear interfaces, direct multi-level relationships and shared accountability for outcomes.
* A capable leader-of-leaders structure is established, with clear accountability and decisions made at the appropriate level.
* Business, workforce and delivery systems are documented, implemented and routinely used by leaders to plan, manage performance, identify risks and make decisions.
* Delivery performance, risks, capacity and resource constraints are predictable and transparent.
* Workforce growth and career opportunities align with business demand, capability requirements and agreed plans across both regions.
* Health, safety, wellbeing, quality and team sustainability are evident in leadership decisions and everyday practices.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

* Develop and implement plant security policies, procedures, and SOPs.
* Ensure protection of employees, visitors, assets, materials, products, and infrastructure.

title: Campaign Operations Manager - Asia Pacific (1-year contract)
description:
:

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

**About the role**

We are looking for a highly organised, detail-oriented and proactive Campaign Operations Manager – Asia Pacific to join our regional marketing organisation at SAS.

In this role, you will play an important part in enabling marketing execution across Asia Pacific, supporting campaign operations, financial governance, internal communications, agency management and strategic marketing programs.

Working closely with regional and global marketing teams, finance, procurement, business operations and external agency partners, you will help ensure that marketing initiatives are executed efficiently, processes are optimised and resources are managed effectively.

This is an exciting opportunity for an early-career marketing professional who enjoys bringing structure to complexity, thrives in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, and is keen to explore how data, technology and generative AI can transform the way marketing teams operate.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Campaign Operations & Execution**
--------------------------------------

* Support the end-to-end operational execution of regional marketing campaigns and initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities, timelines and established processes.
* Coordinate campaign planning, setup, tracking and reporting across marketing platforms, maintaining accurate and reliable campaign data.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, marketing operations teams and external agencies to ensure effective campaign delivery and operational excellence.
* Support purchase requisition processes, including vendor onboarding, cost-centre allocation, approvals and coordination with procurement, legal and finance.
* Maintain campaign documentation, operational trackers and shared resources to ensure visibility, consistency and compliance.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, automate repetitive tasks and improve campaign execution efficiency.

**2. Budget, Procurement & Agency Management**
----------------------------------------------

* Support regional marketing budget management, including spend tracking, purchase requisitions, financial reconciliation, forecasting and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date budget trackers and financial records to support informed decision-making and quarterly planning.
* Coordinate with finance, procurement and regional marketing stakeholders to ensure timely processing of purchase requisitions and adherence to financial governance requirements.
* Work closely with external agencies and vendors to coordinate operational deliverables, track progress and ensure adherence to agreed timelines and processes.
* Support supplier onboarding, invoice coordination, documentation and ongoing agency operations.
* Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of budget management and procurement processes across markets.

**3. Internal Communications & Stakeholder Engagement**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Support the planning and execution of regional and global internal communications initiatives that strengthen alignment, engagement and collaboration across the marketing organisation.
* Coordinate internal events, including leadership town halls, team meetings, employee engagement sessions and regional planning forums.
* Develop, edit and coordinate content for internal newsletters, presentations, announcements and other communication channels.
* Collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure communications are clear, accurate, visually engaging and delivered on time.
* Maintain internal communication platforms and shared repositories, ensuring information is accessible, organised and current.
* Support the preparation of leadership presentations, operational updates and business communications as required.

**4. Regional Programs, Events & Operational Excellence**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Support the planning, coordination and execution of regional marketing programs, executive engagements and flagship events, working alongside internal teams and external agency partners.
* Coordinate event logistics, project timelines, stakeholders, vendors and supporting materials to ensure seamless delivery.
* Research relevant industry conferences, business forums, awards and thought leadership opportunities to strengthen the organisation’s market presence and executive visibility.
* Contribute to regional and global marketing operations initiatives focused on process standardisation, efficiency and operational excellence.
* Explore opportunities to leverage digital tools, automation and generative AI to streamline workflows, improve reporting accuracy and increase team productivity.
* Assist with tracking operational performance, identifying gaps and recommending practical improvements to processes and ways of working.

**Qualifications & Experience**
===============================

**Education**
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business, Marketing, Finance, Communications or a related discipline.

**Experience**
--------------

* 1–2 years of relevant experience preferred, ideally in marketing, campaign operations, business operations, marketing communications, project coordination or a related function.
* Exposure to a business-to-business (B2B) marketing environment, technology organisation or multinational company would be advantageous.
* Previous experience coordinating with external agencies, vendors or cross-functional stakeholders would be beneficial.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**
=================================

**Marketing & Business Acumen**
-------------------------------

* Foundational understanding of marketing concepts, including content marketing, digital campaigns, social media, email marketing and B2B marketing strategies.
* Interest in understanding how marketing operations contribute to business outcomes, campaign performance and overall marketing effectiveness.
* Familiarity with marketing technology platforms and campaign management processes would be advantageous.

**Analytical & Operational Skills**
-----------------------------------

* Strong numerical aptitude, analytical thinking and exceptional attention to detail.
* Good organisational, project coordination and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Ability to work with budgets, spreadsheets, operational data and reporting tools with a high degree of accuracy.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; familiarity with collaboration and workflow management platforms is an advantage.
* Good creative problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to identify inefficiencies and propose practical solutions.

**Communication & Collaboration**
---------------------------------

* Strong written, verbal and visual communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences.
* Confidence in collaborating with stakeholders across functions, seniority levels, cultures and geographies, including senior leaders and external agency partners.
* Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative and contribute effectively within a team.
* Strong interpersonal skills, professionalism and a service-oriented approach to stakeholder engagement.

**Technology, AI & Learning Agility**
-------------------------------------

* Curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies, marketing platforms and digital tools.
* Interest in leveraging generative AI, automation and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiencies and streamline marketing workflows.
* Ability to adapt quickly to new processes and systems, with an openness to experimentation and continuous learning.
* Awareness of the importance of data accuracy, confidentiality and responsible technology use.

**Ways of Working**
-------------------

* Self-motivated, resourceful and accountable, with a strong sense of ownership and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
* Comfortable operating in a dynamic, multicultural and matrixed global organisation.
* Able to balance competing priorities, respond to changing business needs and maintain attention to detail under tight deadlines.
* Flexible to collaborate across global time zones, including occasional meetings during US business hours.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

In this role, success means helping build a marketing organisation that operates with greater clarity, efficiency and consistency. You will contribute by:

* Ensuring campaign operations, budget tracking and procurement workflows are accurate, timely and well coordinated.
* Enabling effective collaboration between marketing teams, finance, procurement, global operations and external agencies.
* Delivering clear, engaging and professionally executed internal communications and marketing programs.
* Identifying opportunities to improve existing processes through data, automation and emerging technologies.
* Building trusted relationships and developing the skills needed to take on greater responsibilities within a global marketing organisation.

**Why Join Us?**
================

At SAS, you will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of marketing, business operations, data and AI, gaining exposure to diverse markets, experienced leaders and cross-functional initiatives across Asia Pacific and beyond.

We value curiosity, collaboration, accountability and the willingness to challenge conventional ways of working. If you are someone who enjoys solving problems, learning continuously and making things work better, this role offers the opportunity to develop your career while making a meaningful contribution to a regional and global team.

**You are welcome here.**

At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

SFC Hub Manager (Operations)

Operations

SFC Hub / Operating Location

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**

At **Blue Dart**, we go beyond delivering shipments—we deliver trust, precision, and excellence. As India’s most reliable express logistics provider, we empower commerce by reaching over 56,000+ locations across India and connecting to 220+ countries through our global DHL network. Backed by the strength of DHL Group, we bring together international standards with deep local expertise. Our dedicated Boeing freighter fleet, 12,000+ vehicles, and best-in-class service ensure time-definite delivery that businesses and customers count on every day.

We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work®** and recognized as part of the DHL Group’s Top Employer certification across multiple regions. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal—it’s a fundamental part of who we are. We are committed to creating a workplace where people feel valued, empowered, and proud to belong.

If you're looking to join a purpose-led, people-first organization that shapes India’s supply chain with integrity and care—**Blue Dart is where you belong**.

**Position Overview:**

The SFC Hub Manager is accountable for end-to-end operational performance of an individual Surface Hub, ensuring timely, accurate and cost-efficient movement of shipments across inbound, processing, sorting, staging and outbound linehaul operations.

The role owns day-to-day Surface Hub execution including shipment processing, throughput, turnaround time, manpower deployment, dock and yard operations, vehicle loading and unloading, cut-off adherence, shipment quality, safety and infrastructure readiness.

Leads hub operational teams across shifts and ensures seamless connectivity between upstream pickup / CPU operations and downstream Surface, Air and Last Mile networks.

The role works closely with the Regional SFC Hub Manager and Regional SFC Network & Fleet Manager to ensure timely vehicle placement, dispatch readiness, load consolidation, route connectivity and operational recovery during delays or capacity disruptions.

**Job Purpose:**

To manage a safe, reliable and high-performing Surface Hub by ensuring timely shipment processing, accurate sorting, efficient linehaul connectivity, optimum manpower and infrastructure utilization, and adherence to network cut-offs, while continuously improving throughput, productivity, service quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Surface Hub Operational Leadership**

* Own day-to-day operational performance of the SFC Hub across all shifts.

* Translate regional network plans, shipment volumes and linehaul schedules into daily hub operating plans.

* Ensure smooth execution of inbound receipt, unloading, sorting, processing, staging, loading and outbound dispatch.

* Maintain operational readiness for scheduled and ad-hoc linehaul movements.

* Ensure seamless handover between the SFC Hub, CPU, PUD, Air and Last Mile operations.

* Proactively escalate capacity, manpower, vehicle or infrastructure risks to the Regional SFC Hub Manager.
  

**Inbound & Outbound Operations**

* Ensure timely unloading, processing and clearance of inbound vehicles.

* Manage accurate sorting and staging of shipments for destination-wise dispatch.

* Ensure outbound loads are processed, built and released within network cut-offs.

* Monitor dock utilization, loading sequence and dispatch readiness.

* Prevent avoidable detention, congestion and shipment accumulation.

* Ensure smooth handover to linehaul vehicles and downstream hubs.

* Drive adherence to loading, sealing, documentation and dispatch-control requirements.
  

**Throughput & Turnaround Time Management**

* Own hub throughput and processing TAT across all shifts.

* Monitor hourly shipment flow and proactively address bottlenecks.

* Ensure effective load balancing across shifts, docks, processing areas and teams.

* Reduce backlog and ensure timely processing of ageing or exception shipments.

* Improve vehicle turnaround time and dock productivity.

* Drive consistent throughput during peak and seasonal periods.
  

**Linehaul & Network Connectivity**

* Ensure adherence to scheduled linehaul departures and network cut-offs.

* Coordinate with the Regional SFC Network & Fleet Manager on vehicle placement, capacity and route requirements.

* Monitor inbound vehicle arrival and outbound dispatch performance.

* Minimize missed connections and avoidable linehaul delays.

* Support contingency planning during vehicle shortages, road disruptions, network delays or sudden volume spikes.

* Ensure optimal synchronization between the hub and upstream/downstream network locations.
  

**People Leadership & Workforce Management**

* Lead supervisors, executives, operational staff and outsourced workforce across the SFC Hub.

* Plan shift-wise manpower based on shipment volume and operational workload.

* Ensure efficient manpower deployment across unloading, sorting, processing, loading and support activities.

* Drive attendance, productivity, discipline and accountability across shifts.

* Build team capability through coaching, training and on-the-job development.

* Maintain adequate contingency manpower for peak periods and operational disruptions.

* Promote a high-performance, safety-focused and improvement-oriented culture.
  

**Shipment Quality & Operational Accuracy**

* Ensure accurate sorting, scanning, routing and handling of shipments.

* Monitor missorts, misroutes, damages, losses and processing exceptions.

* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective action for recurring quality defects.

* Ensure physical-to-system reconciliation and scan compliance.

* Reduce rework, handling errors and avoidable shipment movement.

* Maintain shipment security and chain-of-custody discipline.
  

**Capacity & Infrastructure Management**

* Monitor hub capacity against current and projected shipment volumes.

* Ensure docks, processing areas, material-handling equipment and workstations are operationally ready.

* Coordinate with Engineering / Facilities teams for equipment breakdowns and preventive maintenance.

* Support layout improvements and workflow redesign to improve movement efficiency.

* Identify emerging capacity constraints and recommend infrastructure enhancement.

* Ensure adequate peak-period storage, staging and processing readiness.
  

**Productivity & Cost Management**

* Drive shipments-per-man-hour productivity across hub operations.

* Improve dock, manpower and infrastructure utilization.

* Optimize shift deployment, overtime, consumables and support resources.

* Reduce vehicle detention, idle time, excess handling and rework.

* Monitor cost per shipment and identify efficiency opportunities.

* Track operational cost and productivity trends and implement corrective actions.

* Deliver cost improvement without compromising service or safety.
  

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure strict adherence to Blue Dart operational SOPs, EHS standards and security requirements.

* Maintain safe loading, unloading and material-handling practices.

* Ensure compliance with vehicle, dock and facility safety requirements.

* Conduct regular floor, dock and process audits.

* Drive timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
