title: Quick-Commerce Lead
description:
Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
- Own the complete PO lifecycle, from PO generation and system acceptance to slot booking, appointment scheduling, delivery, and closure at platform warehouses/dark stores.
- Track and improve OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery, fill rates, and service levels across platforms.
- Convert POs into fulfillment orders based on real-time Stock on Hand (SOH).
- Track POs from generation through fulfillment and POD (Proof of Delivery) upload.
- Monitor open and pending POs and proactively resolve fulfillment issues.
- Identify and reduce RTO (Return to Origin) caused by dock rejections, missed appointments, vehicle refusals, or other operational issues.
- Coordinate with primary and secondary 3PL logistics partners for vehicle placement, route planning, and SLA adherence.
- Monitor transit times, freight efficiency, vehicle placement, and hub-level bottlenecks.
- Ensure zero-miss appointments through proactive coordination with logistics and platform teams.
- Manage 3PL relationships, SLAs, and vehicle placement compliance for FTL and PTL shipments.
- Ensure compliance with: E-Way Bills, GST invoices, Batch/MRP requirements, and Platform-specific barcode and labelling guidelines
- Maintain accurate and complete POD documentation, including physical records and digital acknowledgements, to support claim resolution and financial recovery.
- Own end-to-end RTV (Return to Vendor) processing for damaged, near-expiry, customer-returned, or overstocked inventory.
- Maintain real-time dashboards covering key quick-commerce operational metrics.
- Track and analyse: Platform-wise and region-wise serviceability, Fill rates, Category-level performance, DOH (Days of Inventory), Inventory ageing, Fast-moving and slow-moving SKUs, Near-expiry inventory, Open POs and pending PODs, RTO trends and reasons, RTV volumes and trends
- Generate actionable operational insights for Sales, Category Management, Supply Chain, and Operations leadership.
- Identify recurring operational gaps and recommend corrective actions.
- Manage end-to-end reconciliation and closure of Debit Notes (DN) and Credit Notes (CN).
- Validate claims related to: Shortages, Transit damage, Price differences/variances, Promotional deductions
- Track open DN/CN claims and drive timely recovery within defined TATs.
- Reconcile GRN vs. PO vs. Invoice and identify discrepancies.
- Coordinate with relevant internal and platform teams to resolve reconciliation issues and ensure timely payment processing.
- Minimize working-capital lock-up arising from unresolved operational discrepancies.
- The role will own end-to-end operational execution across platforms such as Swiggy Instamart, Blinkit, Zepto, and BigBasket.
- The channel is in a testing phase, rolling out region by region.
- Works from the warehouse.
- Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm, single shift.
- Reports to the Warehouse Manager, Director of Audit and Training, and potentially the Co-founder.
Requirements
  
  
  
Ideal Candidate
  
  

* Strong Quick-Commerce Operations Lead Profile with hands-on brand-side execution across q-commerce platforms
* Mandatory (Experience 1): Must have 4+ years in B2B, Quick-Commerce, E-commerce, Supply Chain, Logistics or Fulfilment Operations, and be able to lead the q-commerce function independently as the first dedicated hire (no existing internal q-commerce expertise to lean on)
* Mandatory (Experience 2): Must have hands-on experience managing operations from the brand side (not the platform side) on Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, BigBasket or similar q-commerce platforms
* Mandatory (Experience 3): Must have owned the full PO lifecycle (PO generation, system acceptance, SOH-based fulfilment, slot booking, appointment scheduling, delivery, POD upload, closure) and improved OTIF, fill rates and service levels
* Mandatory (Experience 4): Must have coordinated 3PL logistics (vehicle placement, route planning, SLA adherence, FTL/PTL) and handled RTO reduction and end-to-end RTV processing
* Mandatory (Experience 5): Must have managed platform compliance (E-Way Bills, GST invoices, batch/MRP, barcode/labelling) and POD documentation for claim resolution
* Mandatory (Experience 6): Must have run MIS and dashboards (serviceability, fill rates, DOH, inventory ageing, fast/slow SKUs, near-expiry, open POs, RTO/RTV trends) and turned them into actionable insights for Sales, Category, Supply Chain and Operations leadership
* Mandatory (Experience 7): Must have managed financial closures and claim settlements (Debit/Credit Notes, shortages, transit damage, price variances, promo deductions), reconciled GRN vs PO vs Invoice, and minimised working-capital lock-up from unresolved claims
* Mandatory (Tech skill 1): Must have strong hands-on experience with OMS/WMS and ERP systems (Unicommerce, Ginesys or similar), plus strong MS Excel and Google Sheets
* Mandatory (Skill 1): Must have strong ownership, coordination and stakeholder management, attention to detail and data accuracy, and comfort in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
* Mandatory (Note 1): Warehouse-based role in Pune; Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 7 PM Shift
* Preferred (Company): Brands performing very well on q-commerce platforms

Experience: 4–7 years · Work from office · 6 days a week · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits
  
  
- Probation period of 3 months.

This is not simply an opportunity to manage a transition plan. It is a chance to help build a greenfield GBS organisation, shape new ways of working, and create the operational foundations for an independent global ice cream company.
  
  
As a Transition Manager, you will lead complex, end-to-end process transitions across functions such as Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement and Supplier Operations. You will own the integrated transition journey from solution identification and knowledge transfer through readiness, go-live, Hypercare and sustainable handover to Operations.
  
  
You will work at the centre of business, GBS, technology, functional and service-provider teams, connecting multiple workstreams into one executable transition plan. You will drive governance, manage risks and dependencies, challenge readiness where required, and help leadership make informed phase-gate and Go/No-Go decisions.
  
  
This role is for someone who can bring structure to complexity, influence senior stakeholders and translate transformation ambition into successful operational delivery.
  
  
**What You Will Bring**

* At least 8 years of professional experience, including a minimum of 4 years leading end-to-end transitions
* Experience managing transitions within GBS, SSC, BPO or GCC environments
* Strong project governance, risk management and stakeholder-management capability
* Experience working alongside transformation programmes, ERP implementations, carve-outs or demergers
* The confidence to challenge, escalate and protect successful transition outcomes

If you want to do more than inherit an established model, and instead help create one that will define how GBS operates for years to come, this is your opportunity.
  
  
**Join us and help create the GBS legacy behind some of the world’s most loved ice cream brands.**
**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

* Experience working with US Stakeholders and US Suppliers is a must.

* Experience within Financial Service or Banking Industry, Manufacturing
* Hands-on experience with executive leadership report-outs.
* Experience in Facilities and Securities Sourcing commodities.
* Demonstrated project management skills
* Must have proven strong facilitation skills and experience delivering presentations
* Must have proven quantitative and analytical skill set
* Experience providing outstanding oral and written communication skills at all levels of the organization
* High enthusiasm and desire to work in fast paced, ever changing environment
* Proven ability to manage complex initiatives across multiple teams/platforms
* Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities with little supervision
* Strong PC proficiency (Microsoft Suite including: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook) or comparable software application

title: Senior IAM Architect & PingFederate Operations Lead role
description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone.

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who share the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest banks in the world.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced for
**Senior IAM Architect & PingFederate Operations Lead role**
to own the architecture, engineering and global production operations of enterprise Identity and Access Management platforms.

The role requires deep
**hands-on expertise in PingFederate and Microsoft Entra ID**
, complemented by experience with
**SailPoint and CyberArk**
. The successful candidate will combine enterprise IAM architecture with
**24x7 global service ownership**
, personally leading complex implementations, integrations and production troubleshooting while providing technical leadership to globally distributed teams.

**This is a hands-on technical leadership role. Candidates with primarily managerial, advisory or high-level architecture experience without recent practical implementation experience will not qualify.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**IAM Architecture & Engineering**

* Own enterprise IAM architecture, engineering, implementation and technical standards across
  **PingFederate, Microsoft Entra ID and integrated identity platforms**
  .
* Design and implement enterprise
  **SSO, federation and authentication**
  using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC and related standards.
* Architect highly available, multi-region IAM environments with appropriate
  **resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity**
  .
* Drive Zero Trust, phishing-resistant MFA, passwordless authentication and least-privilege principles.
* Establish secure reference architectures, engineering standards, automation and operational runbooks.

**PingFederate & Microsoft Entra ID**

* Hands-on design, configuration and administration of
  **PingFederate**
  , including adapters, authentication policies, connections, token management, certificates, clustering, upgrades and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on architecture and administration of
  **Microsoft Entra ID**
  , including Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, Identity Protection, enterprise applications, app registrations, Entra Connect/Cloud Sync and B2B.
* Design and troubleshoot
  **PingFederate-Entra ID integrations**
  , complex authentication flows, federation, token, certificate and synchronization issues.
* Use
  **Microsoft Graph API, PowerShell and automation**
  to improve IAM engineering and operations.

**Global IAM Operations**

* Own
  **24x7 IAM production operations**
  across multiple regions, ensuring availability, resilience, service continuity and SLA/SLO performance.
* Lead globally distributed IAM engineering and operations teams using a
  **follow-the-sun L1/L2/L3 support model**
  .
* Personally lead critical incident troubleshooting, escalation, RCA, problem management and corrective actions.
* Oversee monitoring, capacity, patching, upgrades, certificate/key rotation, change management and production releases.
* Drive operational automation, continuous improvement and service reliability.

**Identity Governance & Privileged Access**

* Support and integrate
  **SailPoint IdentityIQ / Identity Security Cloud**
  for identity lifecycle, JML, provisioning, access certification, RBAC and SoD.
* Work with
  **CyberArk**
  capabilities including Vault, PSM, CPM and Privilege Cloud to strengthen privileged identity and secrets management.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical direction and mentoring to IAM engineering teams globally.
* Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, audit and compliance teams.
* Communicate architecture decisions, operational performance and risks to senior stakeholders.
* Ensure IAM platforms meet applicable security, regulatory and audit requirements.

**Required Experience**

* **10-15 years**
  of IT experience with
  **7+ years in IAM**
  .
* **5+ years hands-on PingFederate**
  experience.
* **5+ years hands-on Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD**
  experience.
* Deep knowledge of
  **SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SSO and federation**
  .
* Proven experience integrating
  **PingFederate and Microsoft Entra ID**
  .
* Experience architecting and operating
  **highly available, enterprise-scale IAM platforms**
  .
* Demonstrated ownership of
  **24x7 global IAM operations**
  , including critical incident management, RCA, SLA/SLO management, DR and operational resilience.
* Strong hands-on technical troubleshooting, engineering leadership and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Preferred:**

Hands-on
**SailPoint IIQ/ISC and CyberArk**
experience; PingAccess, PingDirectory or PingID; AD FS migration; FIDO2/passwordless authentication; Terraform/IaC and CI/CD; Splunk or Microsoft Sentinel; and relevant
**CISSP, Microsoft SC-300, Ping Identity, SailPoint or CyberArk certifications**
.

**Company Overview:**

Mizuho Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, Mizuho Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

Mizuho Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

Mizuho Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices.

Mizuho Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

title: Assistant F&B Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Your Role in the Story**
As the F&B Manager you lead the full spectrum of our food and beverage, from bars and restaurants to in-room dining and outlets. You tailor group standards to the local context and make sure every experience feels memorable and true to our brand.
  
  
You lead a dynamic team and build a culture of service, collaboration and continuous improvement. It’s a hands-on leadership role for someone who knows F&B and hotel operations deeply, loves developing talent and is at their best on the floor.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all F&B operations across restaurants, bars, in-room dining, events, and banqueting, ensuring a consistent and memorable guest experience.
* Inspire, develop, and lead a high-performing team, building a culture of professionalism, collaboration, accountability, and genuine hospitality.
* Lead and align all Floor Managers, ensuring unity across outlets and driving operational excellence through one-team leadership.
* Drive departmental performance, balancing exceptional guest experiences with strong commercial results.
* Partner closely with the Executive Chef and Bar Manager to create exceptional food and beverage experiences that reflect brand and destination.
* Lead recruitment, onboarding, training, and talent development, hiring individuals with the right attitude, personality, and potential; in alignment with the P&C team.
* Create development opportunities for the team and build succession plans for future leaders.
* Be present on the floor, leading by example during service, peak periods, VIP visits, and key guest moments.
* Ensure the team has strong product knowledge and can confidently recommend food, wine, cocktails, and experiences.
* Drive guest satisfaction by anticipating needs, resolving concerns, and creating memorable dining experiences.
* Take ownership of guest feedback and service recovery, turning challenges into opportunities to build loyalty and trust.
* Work closely with Revenue, Reservations, Sales, Marketing, and Operations teams to maximise covers, revenue, and guest engagement.
* Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of all events, banquets, private dining experiences, and special activations.
* Work collaboratively with Sales and Events teams to ensure flawless event delivery and commercial success.
* Oversee workforce planning and labour productivity across all outlets.
* Prepare and manage team schedules and rosters, ensuring the right staffing levels are in place at all times.
* Monitor and control overtime costs through effective scheduling, productivity management, and operational planning.
* Manage departmental budgets, payroll, purchasing, inventory, and profitability while maintaining quality standards.
* Monitor guest feedback, market trends, and business performance, implementing improvements where needed.
* Create and support events, activations, and seasonal experiences that enhance the hotel's identity and guest experience.
* Ensure compliance with hygiene, HACCP, health & safety, licensing requirements, and company standards across all F&B operations.
* Build strong relationships with suppliers and local partners, supporting quality, sustainability, and cost efficiency.
* Champion local products, responsible sourcing, and sustainable operating practices.
* Oversee in-room dining standards and operations, ensuring efficient, professional, and personalized service.
* Work collaboratively with all hotel departments to ensure a seamless guest journey.
* Act as a brand ambassador, maintaining strong relationships with guests, VIPs, and returning customers.
* Stay informed on industry trends and continuously seek opportunities to elevate the guest, team, and business experience.

**Qualifications**
**Who We’re Looking For**

* Minimum 3-5 years' experience in a F&B leadership role within a luxury hotel, resort, lifestyle hospitality brand, beach club, or premium restaurant environment; with great references.
* Proven experience managing multiple outlets, including restaurants, bars, in-room dining, events, and banqueting operations.
* Strong track record of leading, developing, and retaining high-performing teams in fast-paced, high-volume environments.
* Experience in recruitment, workforce planning, scheduling, and labor cost management.
* Solid understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cost control, payroll, inventory management, and commercial performance.
* Hands-on experience driving guest satisfaction, service recovery, and operational excellence.
* Experience collaborating with Culinary, Revenue, Sales, Marketing, and Rooms teams to achieve business objectives.
* Experience in luxury lifestyle, boutique, or destination-led hospitality concepts is a strong advantage.
* Warm, welcomed, inspiring and guest oriented profile.

title: Senior Energy Market Consultant - Power
description:
**Description**
ICF is seeking a talented consultant to support our growing team and client base in the area of power markets advisory consulting. Professionals with 5 years of experience in US power market analysis/forecasting/economics are ideal candidates for the role.
  
  
As a Senior Energy Consultant, you will be responsible for leading a team of analysts to develop and defend power price forecasts, power plant proformas and financial projections using grid software models (e.g. PROMOD, PSLF, TARA etc.), issuing detailed market reports, growing our business with new and existing clients, mentoring and developing junior staff, and contributing to ICF’s thought leadership and competitive positioning in the market.
  
  
In this practice area, ICF’s typical client base includes owners and developers of power plants, banks and investors, and occasionally government entities and other stakeholders. We advise on asset transactions, support siting and financing of new power plants, and provide expert testimony in litigation cases among other work. Great managers at ICF are both analytically sharp and great communicators and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative work environment.
  
  
ICF’s practice covers all major market areas in the US, including ERCOT, PJM, ISO-NE, NYISO, MISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, and SERC, with specialized teams serving each region.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead a dedicated team of analysts to perform detailed energy market modelling and long-term forecasting efforts for market prices, plant/grid operations, and plant economics
* Manage multiple projects with overlapping timelines while ensuring excellent quality, consistency, and client support
* Review and provide direct feedback to the team on quantitative modeling approaches and results
* Communicate effectively with a diverse client base as a subject-matter expert in US wholesale power markets
* Grow ICF’s business by leading interactions with potential clients and developing proposals
* Mentor and develop junior staff as well as collaborate with ICF senior management on key business decisions

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, or a related quantitative-focused field. Candidates majoring in other fields must clearly demonstrate equivalent quantitative aptitude
* 5+ years of work experience in North American electric power sector, including market analysis, Power Flow studies and forecasting
* Experience with a minimum of one of the following: ERCOT, PJM, ISONE, NYISO, MISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, and SERC
* Deep familiarity with market modeling approaches and tools (e.g. PROMOD, PSLF, etc.)
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong capabilities in Microsoft Office
* Experience independently conducting and supervising technical analysis

**Preferred Skills:**

* Master’s degree in any of the aforementioned fields or closely related areas
* Consulting background preferred. However, other experience with financial analysis, asset valuation, or power plant development is a plus

**Organizational Context**
**Key Aspects:**
As the lending arm of Aditya Birla Financial Services Group (ABFSG), Aditya Birla Finance Limited (ABFL) offers specialized lending and financing solutions in the areas.
  
  
Being one of the most preferred asset classes in the lending space today lends this business the immense challenge of competing with all FIs / banks in a highly price sensitive target segment.
  
  

* of Capital Markets, Corporate/ Trade Finance, Commercial Real Estate and Mortgages. Currently ranked within the top 25 NBFCs of India, ABFL has made significant progress and the Company’s balance sheet at INR 15,000 Cr plus exceeds that of several mid-sized Banks and NBFCs
* Having focused traditionally on secured lending verticals and built a strong balance sheet on the same, ABFL has ventured into Unsecured Business segment in order to effectively capitalize on its financial base with carefully managed exposures in this higher yield segment
* The Unsecured Business segment products line caters to funding short term and medium term working capital needs of small businesses (BIL) and individuals (PIL), via a suite of customized short and long tenured products, without any security/ collateral.
* Risk function is engaged in evaluating the creditworthiness of both business and personal loan applications by considering quantitative & qualitative factors like the client credibility, size of the client business, earnings of an individual, capital adequacy, liquidity and management quality

**Job Context**
**Key Aspects:**

* To ensure smooth and institutionalized flow of the BIL & PIL proposals at all the branches across their region
* To manage is responsible for analyzing the credit proposal with the required due diligence and to ensure that all information required to take a credit decision is captured in the proposal.
* To maintain stipulated TAT in credit appraisal process and co-ordinate with sales team for faster decisions to improvise TATs of the overall sanction process.
* To manage a team of Credit Analysts who will carry out the due-diligence, analysis and recommend credit proposals for approval.

**Key Challenges**

* To ensure timely availability of accurate data and information for exhaustive credit appraisals as each proposal has its respective structuring complexities as per the customer, product & regulatory requirements.
* To ensure efficient TATs in highly competitive & dynamic market conditions
* To ensure credit risk and customer risk are mitigated at all times
* To facilitate seamless cross functional coordination for timely approval of credit proposals.
* To ensure sticky accounts as well as pending documents are monitored and regularized on a regular basis
* To ensure self and team are constantly updated on economic/ industry/ sectoral knowledge and trends

****Enabling Skill Sets & Qualifications****

* Critical skill required to meet this role are a strong analytical acumen, evaluation skills, detail orientation and decision making skills, initiative & target orientation, market intelligence, team management

The education & experience required to meet this profile is Chartered Accountant or MBA with minimum 4-7yrs of experience in credit and risk functions of Banks/NBFCs.
  
  

* Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4- 7 key result areas)

**Key Result Areas**
Supporting Actions
  
  
**Accountability**
Supporting Actions
  
  
Credit Underwriting Management
  
  

* Oversee the credit proposals evaluation and ensure that the client creditworthiness, business strength, market credibility, Financial statements, Income Tax returns, cash flow statements, repayment track record, average bank balance & adherence to other internal credit norms are followed
* Ensure direct and thorough investigation is undertaken to obtain relevant credit information through personal interaction with customer.
* Approve/ decision credit proposals at the local/ regional level and recommend for further approval/ decision to Zonal / National / Credit Committee levels for certain proposals
* Ensure timely submission of Credit Appraisal Memo to the Zonal Credit Manager for all proposals highlighting the key risks associated with the borrower to enable a prudent credit lending decisions
* Ensure no loss of revenue by issuing proper sanction letter and capturing the right deviation while assessing a case
* Ensure document execution from RMs & the handover of complete documentation to Operations team for disbursement of loans.
* Undertake detailed external research and market feedback on the loan proposal and evaluate the proposal in accordance

Documentation & MIS
  
  

* To maintain thorough documentation process for effective tracking of proposal documents and TAT monitoring
* To ensure compliance with robust documentation mechanism
* To oversee the preparation of MIS & trend charts on portfolio progress/variances/defaults for all the loans during their credit life cycle and derive insights at a regional level for relevant action
* To oversee the preparation of regular MIS for areas under risk management and give regional level presentations to various Zonal/ Corporate stakeholders

Process Management
  
  

* Ensure end to end processes are understood and followed by the regional team as per the SOPs at the local assessment level
* Monitor loans by tracking various covenants and sanction condition put in the proposals at the time of approvals
* Ensure data is captured in the requisite systems by the team to ensure proper MIS generation for business decisions
* Monitor the overdue position for the region and take appropriate steps to support the recovery process through the team.
* Handle customer escalations and complaints during and post disbursements in certain cases
* Drive continuous improvement in credit approval process to meet the dynamic business needs and institute mechanisms to mitigate risk associated with the products and customer satisfaction.

Team Management
  
  

* Manage, guide and develop a team of credit analysts to ensure that TAT, Process and Credit Quality are adhered to.
* Implement training modules as required for Local Credit Process team, Sales team on product, processes, legal and technical aspects

description:
* POSITION DESCRIPTION

JOB TITLE : Area Credit Manager-Working Capital
  
  
GRADE : AVP-I
  
  
DEPARTMENT : Credit
  
  
LOCATION : RO
  
  
SUB-DEPARTMENT : Credit Working Capital
  
  
TYPE OF POSITION : Permanent
  
  
REPORTS TO : Regional Credit Manager-Working Capital
  
  
REPORTING INTO
  
  
Credit Manager-Working Capital
  
  

* ROLE PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE

* WORKING CAPITAL vertical is a growing business for Ujjivan. The Area Credit Manager will be an important position that will drive the Portfolio growth for the particular Area which involves multiple Branches.
* Underwriting of Working Capital - Fund Based & Non-Fund Based customers for Facility amount up to 10 Cr
* Implement robust credit underwriting policies and processes for large ticket size WORKING CAPITAL loans in the Area and ensure that the processes/policies are effectively managed on the field
* Conduct income appraisal and working capital gap of WORKING CAPITAL borrowers. In depth understanding and analysis of P & L Account and Balance Sheet including cash flows of self-employed borrowers.
* Ratio analysis of financials and loans for lending to self-employed customers.
* Responsible for underwriting and building quality secured portfolio.
* Engage with Risk committee to monitor credit risk and ensure Risk is managed proactively, involve in IDM (Inter Departmental Meeting), Risk Committee meetings, Audit closure meeting
* Work closely with Business and Collections team to manage collections in different buckets at the field
* Manage cost and productivity of team and vendors.
* SIZE OF THE ROLE

FINANCIAL SIZE
  
  
NON-FINANCIAL SIZE
  
  

* Portfolio size of 100 Cr
* 20-25 vendors (legal, technical etc.)
* Multiple Fund Based and Non Fund based offerings
* 20-30 files per month
* Coordination with CAD and Operations for case disbursement
* KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

**Business/ Financials**

* Underwriting target customer and understanding their working capital requirement
* Evaluate and assess whether collateral security is adequate.
* Implement Credit policies and processes for WORKING CAPITAL in field
* Implement new policies, amendments and technology changes through proper communication / training
* Participate in collection of dues from customers to maintain low delinquency/Bounce Rate
* Review and suggest policy and process changes based on the field understanding / feedback from the field team
* Ensure the portfolio quality in excellent category through induction of good quality customers in WORKING CAPITAL
* Effectively monitor external risk by keeping a tab on macro level inputs, field issues and customer dynamics
* Identify, highlight and address emerging risks proactively along with the risk and compliance departments
* Conduct Periodic review of Portfolio Quality and Collection to take necessary actions.
* Conduct periodic reviews with Credit Managers for driving desirable credit performance
* Be updated about the competition in the field and update the management on regular basis
* Monitor credit staff expenses across and ensure the same within the budget

**Customer (Both Internal & External)**

* Supervising the team in the given region for building of a performing portfolio.
* Work with Area Business Managers and Regional Business Managers for onboarding good customers, building quality portfolio, effective implementation of Credit Policies and team management
* Engage with vendors, FCU and other agencies to ensure productivity and cost control.
* Engage with Product Management Team for necessary changes in products as per the observations from the field
* Engage with Recruitment Manager for timely recruitment and induction of new employees
* Engage branch supervisors to understand the customer and field staff requirements while framing the policies and processes
* Ensure that credit responds to Customer’s and branch staff queries and issues timely.
* Engage with HR to ensure all staffing and training requirements are met in a timely manner
* Ensure the key MIS’s and reports are effectively delivered to management for managing business, portfolio, team and risk in the field

**Internal Process**

* Full adherence to all Regulatory Norms, Internal Policy & Process with respect to Credit & Collections
* Deliver High TAT applications are addressed immediately.
* Provide timely compliances to internal and external audit reports
* Present major findings to Risk Committee on High-Risk branches, IDM Issues and on monthly basis in coordination with Audit and Vigilance
* Implement accountability to address policy/process violations
* Timely escalation of critical cases to Credit Head and obtain appropriate deviation approvals
* Monitor timely & accurate submission of daily, weekly & monthly reports
* Monitor health of portfolio

**Innovation & Learning**

* Engage with HR to execute all training programs on Credit Policies and Processes
* Ensure structured induction plan for new joinees, lateral hires and internally promoted candidates
* Responsible for on time hiring of the right people for the assigned hubs
* Ensure goal-setting, midyear review and annual appraisal process happens within specified timelines for self and reportees
* Monitor performance of direct and skip level eportees against defined goals/metrics and take corrective action wherever required
* Ensure staff attrition is below defined limits at regional level
* Pursue Relevant Courses to the team and for the self and Groom team members for cross learning and provide growth opportunities
* Visit Field regularly with Subordinates to keep abreast of area related issues, underwriting performances, Performance of Competitors, and any staff related issues which may pose a risk to portfolio
* Monitor performance of staff against defined goals/metrics and take corrective action wherever required; undertake disciplinary and attendance monitoring of the team.
* MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

Educational
  
  
**Qualifications**

* CA or MBA in Finance from a reputed college or B.Com, M.Com with relevant experience

**Experience**

* Preferred experience of 5-10 years or more in Credit Secured Loan products in working capital limits and term loans.
* Experience in Team Handling and Credit Risk Management

Certifications
  
  

* Relevant certifications shall be an added advantage

Functional Skills
  
  

* Knowledge of Underwriting of loans (Credit, product & process)
* Knowledge of Documentation and Regulatory requirements
* Knowledge of financial analysis, working capital gap & cash flow determination
* Adequate Computer Knowledge
* Evaluate and assess collateral security/collateral documentation adequate for the lending
* Ability to speak and read regional language(s)- is desirable. Ability to communicate in English (Read-speak-write) is required. Has good verbal fluency and uses simple, clear and purposeful language

Behavioral Skills
  
  

* Accuracy, precision and attention to detail
* Pro-activeness and initiative taking
* Training skills and Co-ordination skills
* Interpersonal, Communication and Presentation skills
* Ownership, Leadership and team handling
* Problem Solving, conflict management skills
* Good personal discipline and planning
* Ability to form good working relationships with other functions
* Decision Making skills
* Performance oriented

Competencies Required
  
  

* Good Computer Knowledge
* Competent to handle MIS systems and Lending Software

title: Senior Analyst- BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Senior Analyst (SA) with the ValueScience® Center (VSC), Client-Focused track, you will provide hands-on corporate finance and valuation expertise to consulting teams – developing Total Shareholder Return (TSR) and financial diagnostics, building from scratch and stress-testing 3-statement financial models, and running scenario and sensitivity modelling to support client decision-making. You will translate your analysis into clear client insights, and guide case teams on core CFS concepts, acting as a thought partner in brainstorming and problem-solving discussions.
  
  
You will work as part of a growing global team across Singapore, India, North America, Europe and Middle East, deployed on case and proposal work for more than 55% of your time. Regular travel to client sites should be expected during staffing assignments, as you work onsite – alongside consulting team members, as well as client stakeholders directly – to understand requirements and help design and deliver solutions.
  
  
Beyond casework, you are also comfortable with GenAI and agentic ways of working – for example, building skills using Claude Code to accelerate analysis and modelling, and contributing to reusable tools and client assets.
  
  
The Profile
  
  
We are looking for someone who combines technical rigor with genuine curiosity about the “so what” – someone who does not just execute a model correctly, but pushes to understand what it means for the client's decision, and says so clearly.
  
  
You are comfortable being in the room with clients early – not just supporting from behind the scenes, but building the confidence to walk stakeholders through your own analysis, take questions, and hold your own when challenged on the numbers.
  
  
You manage your own workload with minimal hand-holding: you flag issues before they become problems, keep people informed without being asked, and know when to escalate versus when to solve it yourself.
  
  
You are a natural collaborator – someone who explains the “why” behind an approach rather than just the “how,” and contributes to a positive, supportive team environment.
  
  
And you bring care to how you communicate: written work that is clear and nearly client-ready the first time, and a manner in meetings that is confident without needing to dominate the room.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  
**Required**

* 2+ years of experience in Financial Modelling & Valuation / Corporate Finance, preferably with In-House Corporate Development / Corporate Finance teams, Big 4 Advisory firms / Consulting firms and Private Equity and Venture Capital firms, candidates with consulting experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Management, Accountancy, or a related field, with demonstrated high academic achievement
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including building historical and forward-looking 3-statement financial models from scratch – integrating the Income Statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow – and running multiple business scenarios
* Strong command of accounting and valuation fundamentals — including standard methodologies such as DCF and trading comparables — with the ability to interpret financial statements, annual reports, and investor presentations and translate them into a clear view on company performance and value drivers
* Fluency in English

Technical Toolkit
  
  

* Experience with financial databases such as S&P Capital IQ, Refinitiv Workspace, and Bloomberg
* AI fluency: comfortable going beyond basic chat to write clear, structured prompts, build reusable prompt workflows, and use agentic tools (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate analysis, modelling, and reusable client assets

**Preferred, Not Required**

* Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst (CAIA) qualification

Who You'll Work With
  
  
**About BCG Vantage**
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
  
  
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
  
  
*Client Focus (Embedded Expertise) –*
Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets.
  
  
*Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions) –*
Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients.
  
  
*Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights) –*
Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project's needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data.
  
  
**About CFS**
Strategy and value creation are part of BCG's DNA. Through the experience curve, growth-share matrix, and digital deconstruction, BCG has been at the forefront of strategic innovation. Our corporate finance and strategy consulting team helps clients drive growth, attract investors, and deliver value for stakeholders.
  
  
BCG's Corporate Finance & Strategy (CFS) Practice Area helps CEOs and leaders win the “next game” – transforming strategic insight into ambitious, actionable agendas for value creation. The practice spans three businesses: Strategy, Corporate Finance (ValueScience® Center and CFO Excellence) and Transactions & Integrations.
  
  
**About VSC**
When you optimize value creation, you maximize not only growth, but also strategy. BCG's ValueScience® Center applies cutting-edge analytics to provide the insights that spark and propel competitive advantage.
  
  
These insights help shape and improve decision making and corporate strategy. By understanding how different plans and actions impact value creation, companies can zero in on the right choices, in everything from acquisitions to business models. BCG's ValueScience® Center is the “analytical engine” behind our value creation consulting work. Together with clients, we develop and unleash advanced analytics to reveal the best path forward. By delivering rapid and targeted value creation analysis, we help companies deliver results.
  
  
BCG's ValueScience® Center helps clients optimize future value creation through effective capital allocation and financial policies.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
How You Work
  
  

* Effective written and verbal communication
* Comfortable engaging directly with clients, including presenting your own work in client meetings
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment
* Manages multiple parallel tasks independently, with limited guidance
* Builds interpersonal credibility with stakeholders, both internal and external
* Collaborative team player who exercises discretion when needed

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
  
  
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

title: Investment Analyst
description:
We are looking for a driven and analytical Investment Analyst to join our AIF Investment Team. The individual will be responsible for identifying potential investment opportunities, analysing companies, evaluating financial performance, conducting due diligence and supporting investment decisions for funds raised under our Alternative Investment Fund (AIF).
  
  
The role requires a strong understanding of financial statements, business models, company valuations, industry research and investment analysis.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with the fund management team to assess investment opportunities, prepare investment recommendations and monitor portfolio performance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Investment Research & Opportunity Identification
* Identify and evaluate potential investment opportunities across relevant sectors and industries.
* Conduct detailed research on companies, their business models, market positioning and growth potential.
* Analyse industry trends, competitive landscapes and emerging business opportunities.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of potential investment opportunities.
* Financial Analysis & Valuation
* Analyse company financial statements, including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow Statements.
* Evaluate revenue growth, profitability, EBITDA, margins, debt levels and cash flows.
* Prepare financial models, projections and valuation analyses.
* Conduct company valuations using appropriate methodologies such as DCF, comparable company analysis and precedent transactions.
* Assess investment potential, expected returns and downside risks.
* Investment Evaluation & Recommendations
* Prepare detailed investment notes and presentations for the Investment Committee.
* Present the investment thesis, valuation, expected returns, key risks and exit opportunities.
* Support the fund management team in evaluating investment proposals.
* Assist in investment structuring and transaction execution.
* Track investment opportunities from initial evaluation through investment closure.
* Portfolio Monitoring & Management
* Monitor the financial and operational performance of portfolio companies.
* Track actual performance against projected financials and investment assumptions.
* Prepare periodic portfolio performance reports.
* Identify potential risks and recommend corrective actions.
* Evaluate potential exit opportunities and investment realisation strategies.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* CA / CFA / MBA (Finance) / PGDM (Finance) or equivalent qualification.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in investment analysis, private equity, venture capital, investment banking, equity research, AIF or transaction advisory.
* Strong financial modelling and valuation skills.
* Excellent understanding of financial statements and company analysis.
* Knowledge of investment evaluation, due diligence and risk assessment.
* Strong analytical, research and presentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to interpret complex financial information and convert it into actionable investment insights.

**Preferred Experience**
Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:
  
  

* Alternative Investment Funds (AIF).
* Private Equity / Venture Capital.
* Investment Banking.
* Equity Research.
* Corporate Finance.
* Transaction Advisory / Financial Due Diligence.
* Unlisted and pre-IPO company analysis.

title: Executive | Asset Valuations and Data Management
description:
We have an exciting opportunity to join our Asset Valuations and Data Management (AVDM) within Macquarie Asset Management. Our team maintains the quality, accuracy, and integrity of valuation and reference data across our investment operations. We play a critical role in ensuring reliable data management processes that support informed decision-making and effective funds management.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. **What role will you play?**

Additionally, you will be responsible for conducting timely research and clearance of reconciliation discrepancies. You will be preparing daily control reports, monitoring reconciliation discrepancies, ensuring regular follow-ups and escalations, and clearing Nostro items. * Experience in security master/static data maintenance, portfolio setup, valuation validation, reconciliation processes, and data quality controls across multiple asset classes.
* Strong Microsoft Office proficiency with advanced Excel skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues, solve problems, and identify process improvement opportunities.
* Strong documentation, communication, and collaboration skills, with flexibility to support global teams and work across different time zones.

title: AVP Mgr-RRS GCC
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 8+ yrs in credit/financial analysis and team leadership
* Extensive working knowledge of applicable methodologies with ability to perform holistic analysis to support ratings and research with limited guidance for many advanced/bespoke tasks
* Proficient in technical and operational aspects of deliverables, with strong organizational and multitasking skills to manage multiple projects independently.
* Comfortably and professionally interact with various senior stakeholders on a wide range of topics
* Experienced in mentoring and managing diverse teams with a dependable and collaborative approach
* Fluent in English with excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal abilities
* Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly advanced Microsoft Excel skills

Interest in exploring AI systems and a willingness to develop awareness of responsible AI practices, including risk management and ethical use.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Finance, Economics, or Business or qualified CA
* CFA/ FRM preferred

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage managers, people and projects supporting data, ratings, research, analytical outreach and apply technical knowledge to guide junior team members and lead process improvements.
* Oversee all aspects of data intake, normalization, and processing with a focus on quality and consistency
* Ensure timely, high-quality execution of complex BAU tasks (data, research, analytics, methodology, credit estimates)

Learn more at axaxl.com

That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.

* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements

* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
**Total Rewards**
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
**Sustainability**
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.

Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.

At Aspire, the Finance team plays a strategic and pivotal role in Aspire's continued expansion. Our comprehensive Finance function encompasses six key verticals: Financial Controlling, Treasury, Finance Analytics, Strategic Finance & Planning, Credit Risk, and Finance Strategy & Operations. From conducting in-depth strategic data analysis to spearheading Finance transformation initiatives with our Aspire software, you'll directly contribute to critical business decisions in a dynamic market. This is an exciting chance to be part of a team that values strategic thinking, innovation, and robust controls in a hyper-growth environment.

**About the role**

* Support the management of all Singapore companies’ accounts, ledgers, and reporting systems ensuring compliance with local standards, policies in IFRS and regulatory requirements
* Support the month end close process for all Singapore companies and enable accurate and efficient financial results and reporting within tight deadlines
* Build and grow cross-functional relationships to collaboratively work together to resolve month end issues, build new financial process relating to launch of new products and solve process efficiencies
* Evaluate and continually improve accounting procedures, processes and systems to ensure standardized close process and efficient operations across the Group
* Work with Singapore auditors and participate in the preparation of all the workpapers for the audit on a timely basis including all memos for any relevant areas
* Build and evolve upon our existing internal controls, financial systems and processes to ensure accuracy of financial reporting, integrity of corporate data, finance governance compliance and the safeguarding of assets
* Work closely with the Tax team to review local tax filings and returns (e.g., withholding tax, VAT, annual tax returns)

**About you**

**Minimum qualifications:**

* A minimum of 3-5 years of relevant experience
* Strong academic pedigree with formal education in Accounting or Finance and demonstrated technical accounting expertise.
* Preferably with experience working in one of the Big 4 firms
* Experience in Financial Services, Fintech and Credit businesses is a strong plus
* Strong proficiency in all aspects of corporate accounting and all pertinent GAAP, rules and regulations
* Strong leadership, team building and interpersonal skills
* Self-motivated and result oriented
* Proven team player, hands on and ability to work independently while managing multiple projects/assignments
* Has a strong grasp of artificial intelligence concepts and the ability to apply AI tools and frameworks to solve real world problems at Aspire

title: Head of Finance Indian Subcontinent
description:
Job Title
  
  
Head of Finance Indian Subcontinent
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job title:**
**Head of Finance Indian Subcontinent**
**Location**
: Gurgaon, Bharti Worldmark
  
  
**Your Role**
The Head of Finance Indian Subcontinent is a critical role as India is a key growth market that requires strong finance leadership from both a finance business partner perspective, as well as a license to operate / compliance perspective.
  
  
The main remit of the role is to drive sustainable business value and robust financial governance across the zone. The job incumbent will act as a strategic Finance Business Partner to the Zone Leader and Leadership team, translating business, market regulatory, and operational developments into clear financial insights, disciplined decision-making, and executable performance actions.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Leads the strategic financial direction of the zone, ensuring that financial strategies are aligned with the overall corporate vision and driving the long-term growth and profitability of the organization.
* Serves as a key member of the zone leadership team, providing expert financial guidance and strategic insights to influence critical business decisions, shape corporate strategy, and achieve financial objectives.
* Drives the strategic and operational financial planning process for the zone, including AOP support to the business, rolling forecasts, scenario planning, and performance / business reviews.
* Drives revenue growth, margin expansion, cost productivity and profitable market share development across businesses, customer segments, and sales channels.
* Supports key commercial decisions on pricing, tender strategy, sales channels, customer lifetime value, strategic deals, partnerships, financing solutions, and investment allocation.
* Ensures a strong and efficient internal control environment and high quality of financial statements across the zone.
* Drives month-end close discipline, reporting quality, standardization, automation and simplification across finance processes.
* Drives working capital discipline across receivables, inventory, order book quality, revenue recognition, and cash acceleration initiatives.
* Leads cross-functional teams in the development of financial models and business cases for high-impact projects, ensuring that all assumptions are rigorously tested and that recommendations are aligned with the company’s long-term strategic priorities.
* Ensures the organization’s financial practices adhere to the highest standards of integrity, compliance, and corporate governance, working closely with audit, compliance, and legal teams to manage financial risks and address regulatory requirements.
* Leads finance transformation and organizational improvements, including digital finance, analytics and process simplification.
* Builds and maintains strong relationships with key stakeholders, including senior executives, board members, and external partners, ensuring that financial perspectives are integrated into all major business decisions and that the finance function is viewed as a strategic partner.
* Develops a high-performing zone finance organization, with clear accountabilities, succession planning and capability building.
* Mentors and develops finance managers and specialists within the organization, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous learning, and ensuring that the finance team is equipped to support the company’s growth and innovation objectives at the highest levels.

**You're The Right Fit If**

* Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting or a related discipline. A professional finance qualification would be a plus.
* Deep understanding of medtech / health systems / health technology.
* 8+ years of broad-based finance leadership experience, including operational, commercial, and strategic finance roles in a complex matrix organization.
* Strong experience across FP&A, business partnering, accounting, internal control, statutory reporting, tax, treasury, audit, and commercial finance domains.
* Experience in regional, zonal or global business partnering roles.
* Experience having built engaged teams, and developed talents and succession plans.
* Demonstrated growth and transformation mindset.
* Able to influence across a complex matrix.

**About Philips**
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help improve the lives of others.
  
  

* Learn more about our business.
* Discover our rich and exciting history.
* Learn more about our purpose.
* Learn more about our culture.

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here.

title: Finance Manager, GCC
description:
*Do you want to join a global leader in renewable energy infrastructure? If so, CIP Fund Solutions (CIP FS) is looking for a Finance Manager to join our office in Gurugram, India.*
**Team**
As a Finance Manager, you will be part of the GCC Finance team in CIP FS. The team is responsible for delivering high-quality financial reporting, financial controls, accounting, treasury, budgeting, forecasting and compliance support for CIP’s global operations.
  
  
This team partners closely with regional finance teams, business stakeholders, auditors, and tax advisors to ensure robust financial governance, internal controls and operational excellence.
  
  
**Role**
As our new Finance Manager, you will play a key role in CIP’s audit, consolidation and reporting processes, and you will bring technical accounting expertise to the group. You will be responsible for coordinating audits, running consolidation in OneStream, and delivering accurate internal and external reporting.
  
  
You will also support the group on technical accounting matters when structures and entities are reorganised, and manage the TopCos, including distribution models. Working closely with finance teams and business stakeholders across geographies, you will provide insights that support decision-making, strengthen financial governance and support continuous process improvement.
  
  
**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Coordinate and support external audits and ensure timely delivery of audit documentation.
* Act as a key contact for auditors and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Perform and own the consolidation process, including intercompany eliminations and reconciliations in OneStream.
* Ensure accurate and timely month-end, quarter-end and year-end consolidation.
* Provide technical accounting analysis and guidance when entities, assets or funds are moved within the group.
* Own and support distribution models, ensuring accuracy, transparency and proper documentation.
* Own the accounting manual for the group.
* Partner with relevant stakeholders to ensure compliance and consistent processes.

**You**
We are looking for a motivated Finance Manager with a minimum of 10 years of experience in a similar finance role. You have experience in consolidation, financial reporting, technical accounting and statutory audit.
  
  
Moreover, you have solid experience in year-end close activities and in coordinating audits and internal and external reporting.
  
  
**We look for the following in a candidate:**

* Hands-on experience with consolidation tools such as OneStream (or similar, e.g. Hyperion, Tagetik) and ERP platforms such as Microsoft Business Central, SAP, Oracle. Experience with OneStream and Business Central is an advantage
* Comprehensive knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), including IFRS and their use in consolidation, technical accounting, and financial statement preparation
* Prior experience in managing finance activities for multiple geographies including but not limited to gaap-to-gaap differences
* Experience with accounting for group restructurings and complex transactions is an advantage
* High attention to detail and accuracy
* Well-developed organisational and time management skills
* Ability to manage strict deadlines
* Strong communication skills, including fluent English
* Advanced interpersonal skills, supported by experience working with stakeholders in cross-functional and external settings.

**The process**
Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
  
  
As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
  
  
---
  
  
**CIP Fund Solutions’ commitment to diversity and inclusion**
CIP Fund Solutions is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
  
  
A diverse workforce allows CIP Fund Solutions to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, or ethnicity.
  
  
**CIP Fund Solutions**
CIP FS’ purpose is to enable CIP’s ambition to scale rapidly over the coming strategy-period - supporting our colleagues with professional and efficient financial, legal, tax and business operations through the cycle from fund formation and capital raising, to deploying investments into construction of large-scale greenfield renewable energy assets, as well as M&A.
  
  
For more information, please visit CIP Fund Solutions.
