title: Head of Compliance APAC
description:
**Grow with us**
Our Exciting Opportunity!
  
  
This is strategically important role. The Head of Compliance for Market Area APAC carries a broad mandate, reflecting Ericsson's commitment to a holistic, forward-looking approach to integrity, compliance and risk management across the business.
  
  
The role encompasses the full spectrum of ethics and compliance risk: anti-bribery and corruption, antitrust and competition, anti-money laundering, human rights, anti-fraud, anti-terrorism, reputational risk, and beyond. The role holder will proactively identify emerging threats, regulatory developments, and business environment changes that could impact the organisation, and work with the business to own and respond where needed. This role will play a key part in enabling business leaders to own and manage risk as a driver of sustainable success.
  
  
As Head of Compliance APAC, you will lead a team of compliance professionals in a dynamic and exciting region. You will serve a diverse set of business and organizational units across the region, partnering with business stakeholders to embed Ericsson's Ethics and Compliance program, enable genuine business ownership of risk, and drive accountability for compliance and sound risk management throughout the organization.
  
  
Ericsson's Compliance Office, under the leadership of the Chief Compliance Officer, has responsibility for all components of Ericsson's Ethics and Compliance Program. The program covers compliance with our Code of Business Ethics and spans the broad range of subject matters within your remit — including anti-fraud, anti-bribery and corruption, anti-terrorism, antitrust and competition, anti-money laundering, human rights, sanctions and export controls, and the identification and management of emerging and reputational risks.
  
  
You will report to the Chief Compliance Officer and have a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Head of Legal APAC, sitting on both the Compliance Office Leadership Team and the Market Area Legal Leadership Team. This dual positioning ensures you are closely connected to both the global compliance agenda and the strategic priorities of the Market Area, enabling you to translate group-wide standards into locally relevant, business-enabling actions. You will collaborate closely within Legal Affairs & Compliance (GFLA) and other assurance colleagues on matters such as training and communication initiatives, risk assessments, third-party due diligence and monitoring, investigations and implementing remediation where needed. You will prepare insights, analyses and report to stakeholders about the effectiveness of the ethics, integrity and compliance program and the state of risk across the Market Area.
  
  
In this exciting role, you will lead and ensure the development of a diverse team of Compliance professionals, setting expectations, managing performance, and fostering a culture where every team member is empowered to enable the business to succeed — with integrity. You will guide them in partnering with business stakeholders to make sound judgments, implement the compliance program, and support effective, business-owned risk management throughout the Market Area.
  
  
The role can be located in Delhi, Singapore, Yokohama, Beijing, Seoul, Manila.
  
  
**In this role you will be expected to:**

* Lead and manage all aspects of the Market Area's Ethics and Compliance program, ensuring it enables the business to operate successfully within a robust framework of controls and ethical standards.
* Act as a solution-oriented trusted advisor, actively supporting business stakeholders in proactively identifying, owning and managing compliance and broader risk matters — providing expert advice, practical problem-solving, and clear paths forward.
* Drive a robust culture of ethics, integrity and compliance and a sense of shared responsibility, empowering business leaders to take ownership of risk as a foundation for sustainable success.
* Champion Business Success: Be a trusted advisor to the business, providing strategic and tactical solutions that drive things forward in the right way. You'll understand the complexities of our business but always strive for simplicity in your approach.
* Lead with Integrity: Act with integrity and do the right thing, always. You'll be a role model for your business partners, demonstrating sound judgment and a commitment to protecting company value and reputation.
* Lead and Develop Your People: You will build expert capability across the Compliance team. As a senior leader within GFLA, you will play a key role supporting the development of skills capability and effectiveness of your team and wider GFLA colleagues, including through sharing knowledge, best-practice, actively contributing to learning initiatives the function, alongside fostering an inclusive team environment where diverse talent thrives.
* Working in partnership with the APAC Head of Legal, you will lead horizon scanning and emerging risk identification across the Market Area, encompassing areas such as anti-bribery and corruption, antitrust and competition, anti-money laundering, human rights, reputational risk, and other areas of regulatory and business concern — ensuring risks are identified early and escalated appropriately.
* Lead the Market Area's Ethics and Compliance-related governance activities, managing relevant committees and boards such as the Market Area Remediation Committee and the Business Partner Review Board, while contributing to the activities of the Group Business Risk Committee.
* Oversee, together with colleagues in Compliance and other group functions, the engagement, due diligence, and ongoing monitoring of third parties.
* Lead training and awareness initiatives, with the support of other Compliance colleagues, to equip stakeholders across the Market Area with the knowledge and confidence to manage compliance and risk topics in their day-to-day work.
* Assess and manage actual or potential conflicts of interest, expenditure risks (including gifts, entertainment, and hospitality), and engagements with public officials.
* Lead remediation resulting from investigations or other consequence management processes across the Market Area, whether relating to personnel, third parties, or process matters — driving accountability and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with colleagues across legal, internal audit, and other assurance functions to assist in holistic risk identification and mitigation across the Market Area, reinforcing business ownership of risk.
* Provide input into improvements to Compliance Office programs and initiatives, bringing Market Area insights that strengthen global frameworks.
* Gather and analyze ethics, compliance and risk-related data to continuously enhance the implementation of the program in the Market Area, ensuring any gaps in risk management practices are swiftly identified, communicated to business owners, and addressed.
* Identify opportunities for the use of Artificial Intelligence in the compliance and risk program and promote its responsible use.

**To be successful in this role, you should have:**

* Strong ethics, compliance and risk management credentials, including at least 10 years of experience in an ethics & compliance or related risk leadership role in a multinational organization, with demonstrable breadth across multiple compliance disciplines (e.g., anti-bribery and corruption, antitrust, anti-money laundering, human rights, reputational risk).
* A legal degree is strongly preferred.
* Experience operating in the region, including in high-risk markets.
* A proven track record of successfully partnering and collaborating with senior business, commercial, and functional leaders to identify, own, and manage risks — with a focus on enabling the business to succeed through sound risk management.
* Experience in a matrixed organization and collaborating with different stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.
* An ability to simplify complex topics and communicate expectations and articulate risks clearly and concisely to stakeholders at all levels.
* An ability to take ownership of complex problems and projects and drive those to successful completion.
* Experience in managing and developing a large and diverse team, with members spread across several locations.
* Impeccable judgement, maturity, and discretion, including a demonstrated ability to engage in difficult conversations and constructive dialogue with senior stakeholders to address complex and sensitive issues.
* A positive attitude and strong interpersonal and influencing skills, with the credibility and presence to influence business leaders and foster a culture of business-owned risk and integrity.
* Working proficiency in languages relevant to the Market Area preferred.
* Ability to work across time zones.
* Ability to travel internationally

**Job Description – Senior Associate | Fractional General Counsel (FGC)**

**Practice Area: Fractional General Counsel | Corporate & Commercial Advisory | Technology & Software Law**

**About the Role**

**Bridge Counsels is looking for a dynamic, commercially oriented Senior Associate to join its Fractional General Counsel (FGC) practice.**

**The role involves providing end-to-end legal advisory and ongoing legal support to startups, technology companies, growing businesses, and domestic and international clients.**

**The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in corporate and commercial laws, with particular emphasis on software licensing, SaaS agreements, technology contracts, and cross-border commercial transactions.**

**The position requires a combination of technical legal expertise, business understanding, independent client management, and the ability to function as an extended in-house legal counsel for multiple clients.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Fractional General Counsel & Client Management**

**\* Independently manage assigned FGC client relationships and act as their primary legal point of contact.**

**\* Provide ongoing legal advice on corporate, commercial, contractual, operational, and regulatory matters.**

**\* Work closely with founders, management teams, CXOs, and international stakeholders.**

**\* Identify legal risks proactively and provide practical, business-oriented solutions.**

**\* Manage multiple client portfolios, deliverables, and timelines.**

**2. Corporate & Commercial Advisory**

**\* Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, including MSAs, service agreements, vendor agreements, NDAs, consultancy agreements, and strategic partnership agreements.**

**\* Advise on corporate governance, shareholder arrangements, investment documentation, and routine corporate matters.**

**\* Support domestic and cross-border commercial transactions.**

**\* Coordinate with external counsel, company secretaries, and other professional advisers where necessary.**

**3. Software, Technology & Digital Business Advisory**

**\* Draft and negotiate SaaS agreements, software licensing agreements, EULAs, technology services agreements, and software development agreements.**

**\* Advise on intellectual property ownership, licensing structures, technology procurement, and contractual risk allocation.**

**\* Review privacy policies, data processing agreements, and platform terms of use.**

**\* Support advisory matters involving data protection, cybersecurity, AI governance, and emerging technology regulations.**

**4. International Client Engagement**

**\* Independently coordinate with foreign clients and international legal and business teams.**

**\* Advise on India-related legal and commercial matters and coordinate cross-border legal requirements.**

**\* Participate in client calls, contract negotiations, management discussions, and legal strategy meetings.**

**\* Ensure timely, clear, and professional communication with stakeholders across jurisdictions.**

**Candidate Profile**

**\* LL.B. from a recognised university with approximately 5–8 years of relevant post-qualification experience.**

**\* Strong background in corporate and commercial contracts, preferably from a law firm or in-house legal team.**

**\* Demonstrable experience in technology contracts, SaaS, software licensing, and IT-related commercial arrangements.**

**\* Prior experience independently managing corporate clients and advising business stakeholders.**

**\* Strong drafting, contract negotiation, legal research, and analytical skills.**

**\* Understanding of Indian corporate and commercial laws, with familiarity with data protection and technology-related regulations.**

**\* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly in dealing with international clients.**

**\* Ability to manage multiple assignments independently, exercise commercial judgment, and take ownership of client deliverables.**

**Preferred Attributes**

**\* Exposure to startups, SaaS companies, technology businesses, or multinational clients.**

**\* Experience operating as in-house counsel, external general counsel, or within a retainer-based advisory practice.**

**\* Familiarity with AI governance, cybersecurity, data privacy, and technology-sector compliance.**

**\* Commercially pragmatic, solution-oriented, and comfortable working directly with senior management.**

**What Makes This Role Different?**

**This is not a conventional documentation-focused associate position.**

**The Senior Associate will function as a strategic legal partner to businesses, combining corporate and commercial advisory with technology-sector expertise and ongoing client relationship management.**

**The role offers exposure to varied businesses, complex commercial transactions, international stakeholders, and the evolving Fractional General Counsel model.**

title: General Manager-Legal
description:
Role Overview The GM Legal will lead and manage all litigation and dispute resolution matters for the renewable energy business, including solar, wind, hybrid, storage, transmission, and related infrastructure. The role requires deep understanding of sector‑specific regulatory frameworks, commercial disputes, land‑related litigation, EPC and O&M issues, and government interface. --
  
  
Key Responsibilities 1. Litigation Strategy & Management - Manage and oversee all litigation across civil, commercial, regulatory, arbitration, criminal, environmental, labour, and land acquisition matters. - Develop and implement litigation strategy aligned with business goals and project timelines. - Provide risk analysis and strategic inputs for high‑value disputes and contingencies. - Ensure effective case lifecycle management including tracking, reporting, and closure.
  
  

* Renewable SectorSpecific Dispute Handling - Handle disputes related to: - EPC/O&M contractors - Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) - Open access, transmission, and grid‑connectivity issues - Land acquisition, ROW, and local authority challenges - DISCOMs and state nodal agencies - SLDC / RLDC / CERC / SERC regulatory litigation - Support negotiations for tariff issues, curtailment, scheduling, penalties, liquidated damages, and performance claims.
* Regulatory & Government Interface - Draft and review replies for regulatory bodies: CERC, SERCs, MNRE, SECI, revenue authorities, forest/environment departments, and state land authorities. - Handle show‑cause notices, compliance matters, and appeals before tribunals. - Represent the organisation in government hearings, regulatory proceedings, and compliance audits.
* External Counsel & Advisor Management - Identify, empanel, and manage external advocates and law firms across multiple states. - Review pleadings, statements, notices, and legal opinions prepared by counsel. - Ensure high‑quality representation and cost optimisation. ### 5. Contractual & Documentation Support - Review litigation‑sensitive clauses in EPC contracts, PPAs, land agreements, vendor contracts, and financing documents. - Ensure documentation, evidence, and internal approvals for litigation are timely and accurate. - Oversee drafting of replies, complaints, petitions, affidavits, and arbitration submissions.
* Internal Advisory & Stakeholder Coordination - Collaborate closely with Projects, EPC, Finance, Land, Regulatory, and Operations teams. - Conduct internal investigations, fact‑finding exercises, and legal audits. - Provide preventive legal advisory to reduce disputes.
* Governance, Risk & Compliance - Build SOPs for dispute resolution and legal risk mitigation. - Conduct training on litigation risk, regulatory compliance, and contract safeguards. - Monitor legal budgets, case outcomes, timelines, and recurring risk patterns. ---

Qualifications & Experience - LL.B / LL.M from a reputed law school. - 10-15+ years of experience in litigation, preferably in energy, infrastructure, EPC, or utilities. - Strong exposure to regulatory bodies like CERC, SERCs, APTEL, and state authorities. - Experience handling arbitration, high‑stake commercial disputes, and land‑related matters. - Prior leadership experience in managing multi‑state litigation portfolios.
  
  
Key Skills & Competencies - Deep knowledge of the Electricity Act, renewable energy regulations, transmission codes, land laws, and contract laws. - Strong analytical, drafting, and negotiation skills. - Ability to handle high‑pressure, time‑sensitive regulatory matters. - Excellent stakeholder and cross‑functional coordination abilities. - High integrity, strong business acumen, and leadership maturity.

title: Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Governance
description:
Position Summary

The incumbent resource will be responsible for managing strategic sourcing activities with a primary focus on
**Professional Services, Audit-related Spend, Banking Tools, Consultancy Services, and Technical Manpower Requirements.**
The role will also act as the custodian of Procurement Governance, ensuring adherence to SCM policies, procurement processes, regulatory requirements, internal controls, and audit standards across the organization.

The incumbent will drive procurement excellence through effective vendor management, sourcing optimization, contract governance, compliance monitoring, spend analytics, stakeholder engagement, and continuous process improvements while ensuring cost efficiency, quality service delivery, and risk mitigation.

Educational Qualification

Essential

* Engineering Degree / B.Tech / BBA/ MBA from a recognized institute.

Preferred

* Specialization in Supply Chain Management & Governance.
* Professional certifications in Procurement, Supply Chain, Contract Management, or Vendor Risk Management will be an added advantage.

Experience

* Overall experience at least 10-15 years.
* Minimum 8 years of strong and relevant experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Governance, and Compliance Management.
* Proven experience in handling procurement of:
* Professional Services
* Consulting Services
* Audit Services
* Banking Tools and Technology Services
* Technical Manpower / Resource Augmentation
* Prior exposure to Procurement Audits, Vendor Governance, Contract Management, and Regulatory Compliance will be highly preferred.

Key Purpose of the Role

The primary purpose of the role is to:

* Lead sourcing activities related to
  **Professional Services, Audit engagements, Banking Tools, Consulting Assignments, and Technical Manpower requirements.**
* Ensure timely execution of procurement activities through robust sourcing strategies, RFP management, negotiation, and vendor selection.
* Drive end-to-end procurement governance and compliance in alignment with organizational policies, procedures, and regulatory expectations.
* Strengthen procurement controls through vendor due diligence, contract governance, audit readiness, risk assessments, spend analytics, and stakeholder awareness.
* Support business teams with efficient procurement solutions while maintaining transparency, compliance, and cost effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

A. Strategic Sourcing & Procurement Operations

* Understand business requirements and formulate sourcing strategies to meet procurement objectives.
* Manage end-to-end sourcing lifecycle including:
* Requirement gathering
* Vendor identification
* RFP/RFQ preparation
* Bid evaluation
* Commercial negotiations
* Vendor finalization
* Purchase Order issuance
* Contract execution
* Ensuring timely payment issuance to partner
* Drive procurement of professional services, consulting assignments, audit services, banking tools, and technical manpower.
* Complete procurement activities within defined timelines while ensuring optimum cost, quality, and service standards.
* Conduct market intelligence and benchmarking exercises for better commercial outcomes.
* Support business stakeholders in selecting the most suitable sourcing model and procurement route.

B. Procurement Governance & Compliance

* Act as the governance lead for procurement activities across the organization.
* Ensure compliance with Procurement Policies, SCM Procedures, Delegation of Authority (DOA), Contracting Guidelines, and Regulatory Requirements.
* Monitor procurement transactions and identify process deviations or control gaps.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with organizational standards and audit requirements.
* Drive procurement governance initiatives and periodic compliance reviews.
* Establish robust controls to ensure transparency, accountability, and risk mitigation.

C. Vendor Due Diligence & Risk Management

* Execute vendor onboarding and due diligence processes in accordance with organizational guidelines.
* Conduct proactive and periodic screening of new and existing vendors including:
* Blacklist Verification
* Regulatory Screening
* ROC Struck-off Verification
* IBA Defaulter/Negative List Checks
* Other compliance-related assessments
* Identify non-compliant vendors and coordinate corrective actions.
* Assess vendor risk and provide recommendations to stakeholders.
* Maintain documentation supporting vendor approval and compliance requirements.

D. Contract Management & Repository Governance

* Review vendor agreements and ensure adherence to contracting guidelines.
* Maintain centralized contract repository and agreement tracker.
* Monitor contract validity, renewal dates, amendments, and obligations.
* Highlight contracts nearing expiry and initiate renewal actions proactively.
* Identify engagements operating without valid contracts and escalate to stakeholders.
* Analyze contractual risks and recommend mitigation measures.
* Ensure execution of agreements before commencement of services wherever applicable.

E. Audit Management & Internal Controls

* Act as the primary coordinator for procurement-related internal and external audits.
* Maintain audit readiness through robust documentation and process controls.
* Prepare procurement spend analysis, compliance reports, and risk assessments for audit reviews.
* Address audit observations and ensure timely closure of action items.
* Conduct periodic gap assessments to identify control weaknesses and improvement opportunities.
* Review procurement-related audit findings and implement corrective and preventive actions.

F. Stakeholder Management

* Partner with business functions to understand procurement requirements and operational challenges.
* Collaborate with Legal, Finance, Compliance, Risk, Information Security, and Business Teams for seamless procurement execution.
* Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external vendors.
* Resolve procurement-related issues in a timely and professional manner.
* Drive stakeholder satisfaction through proactive engagement and service orientation.

G. Vendor Management & Performance Evaluation

* Maintain effective communication with vendors to ensure quality and timely delivery of services.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed service levels and contractual commitments.
* Conduct Annual Vendor Performance Reviews.
* Identify underperforming vendors and recommend corrective actions or alternate sourcing options.
* Support vendor development and supplier relationship management initiatives.

H. Spend Analytics & Management Reporting

* Analyze procurement spend patterns, trends, savings opportunities, and compliance metrics.
* Develop and publish Monthly Procurement MIS and Management Reports.
* Present procurement insights and governance updates to senior management.
* Conduct spend and risk analysis to identify opportunities for optimization.
* Track procurement KPIs and develop performance dashboards.

I. Awareness, Communication & Process Excellence

* Drive procurement process awareness across the organization.
* Publish Monthly Procurement Governance Communications to internal stakeholders.
* Issue periodic communications to vendors regarding:
* Invoice submission processes
* Payment procedures
* Procurement compliance requirements
* Vendor obligations
* Promote procurement best practices and policy adherence.
* Facilitate training and awareness sessions for stakeholders.

J. Continuous Improvement & Policy Enhancement

* Periodically review procurement processes, policies, SOPs, and governance frameworks.
* Identify opportunities for automation, digitization, simplification, and process efficiency.
* Recommend policy enhancements based on audit findings, business requirements, and industry best practices.
* Prepare business cases and proposals for management approvals.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance procurement effectiveness and governance maturity.

The Senior Manager - Student Experience will be responsible for driving student experience, residential quality, student engagement, student support coordination, feedback management, grievance resolution, and continuous improvement across the student housing environment.
  
  
The role will serve as an important link between students, Wardens, Student Housing Operations, University stakeholders, support teams, and service partners, ensuring that student concerns are identified proactively, addressed professionally, and converted into measurable service improvements.
  
  
The position requires strong experience in student engagement, customer experience, residential operations, quality management, community management, service excellence, or institutional/student affairs.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Key Responsibilities
* Student Experience & Quality

Own and drive the overall student experience and quality agenda across student residences.
  
  
Establish and monitor quality standards for student housing services.
  
  
Conduct regular student interactions, floor visits, feedback sessions, and quality audits.
  
  
Identify recurring student concerns and develop corrective and preventive action plans.
  
  
Monitor service quality across Housekeeping, Security, Maintenance, Food Services, and other residential services.
  
  
Ensure student-facing services are delivered consistently across all residential blocks.
  
  
Develop and implement initiatives to improve student satisfaction, participation, and engagement.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Student Feedback & Grievance Management

Establish a structured mechanism for collecting and analysing student feedback.
  
  
Monitor student complaints, grievances, and escalations through designated systems.
  
  
Analyse complaints to identify root causes, recurring trends, and systemic gaps.
  
  
Coordinate with respective departments to ensure timely resolution.
  
  
Track escalated and sensitive cases until closure.
  
  
Prepare regular Student Experience / Quality Dashboards for senior management.
  
  
Ensure student concerns are handled with confidentiality, professionalism, and responsiveness.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Student Engagement

Build strong and constructive relationships with students.
  
  
Conduct regular student forums, listening sessions, and engagement activities.
  
  
Work closely with Student Council and student representatives.
  
  
Create mechanisms through which students can safely provide feedback and suggestions.
  
  
Develop initiatives that promote a positive, inclusive, and respectful residential community.
  
  
Proactively identify emerging student concerns before they become major grievances.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Quality Audits & Compliance

Conduct periodic quality audits of student residences.
  
  
Develop checklists and measurable quality parameters for residential services.
  
  
Monitor compliance with Student Housing SOPs and University policies.
  
  
Conduct surprise inspections and student experience audits.
  
  
Identify gaps and coordinate corrective actions with relevant functional teams.
  
  
Track closure of audit observations within agreed timelines.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Data, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

Analyse student complaints, feedback, satisfaction scores, and service-performance data.
  
  
Identify trends by hostel/block, service category, and time period.
  
  
Develop actionable recommendations based on data.
  
  
Establish service-quality KPIs and track performance.
  
  
Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on student feedback and operational data.
  
  
Present key insights, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Cross-Functional Coordination

**Work Closely With**
Student Housing Operations
  
  
University Wardens
  
  
Student Support Teams
  
  
Security
  
  
Housekeeping
  
  
Engineering / Technical Services
  
  
University Medical Centre
  
  
University Departments
  
  
Ensure effective coordination for student-related issues requiring multi-functional intervention.
  
  
Coordinate referrals and follow-ups with appropriate support functions whenever specialised intervention is required. The role itself does not provide counselling or therapeutic services.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Critical Incident & Sensitive Case Management

Support the Student Housing leadership team in handling sensitive and high-priority student cases.
  
  
Ensure timely identification, documentation, and escalation of cases involving student safety, conduct, or support concerns.
  
  
Coordinate with authorised University stakeholders and designated support teams for appropriate intervention.
  
  
Ensure proper documentation and follow-up.
  
  
Maintain strict confidentiality of sensitive student information.
  
  
Ensure all actions follow University policies and established protocols.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Key Performance Indicators

Student Satisfaction / Experience Score
  
  
Reduction in recurring student complaints
  
  
Complaint resolution and closure timelines
  
  
Quality audit compliance
  
  
Student engagement levels
  
  
Feedback participation rate
  
  
Effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions
  
  
Student support referral coordination effectiveness
  
  
Reduction in repeat grievances
  
  
Quality of student communication and engagement
  
  
Timeliness and accuracy of management reporting
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Qualification & Experience

**Educational Qualification**
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education, Student Affairs, Hospitality, Business Administration, Operations Management, Public Administration, Social Sciences, or a related discipline.
  
  
Additional qualifications or certifications in Customer Experience, Service Quality, Student Affairs Administration, Community Management, or Hospitality Operations will be advantageous.
  
  

* Professional Experience

8-12 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:
  
  
University / Higher Education
  
  
Student Affairs / Student Services
  
  
Student Housing / Residential Operations
  
  
Student Experience & Engagement
  
  
Customer Experience / Service Quality
  
  
Hospitality
  
  
Institutional Quality Management
  
  
Large residential or campus operations
  
  
Experience managing student-facing teams and working with multiple stakeholders will be preferred.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Core Competencies

Student-centric approach
  
  
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  
  
Student support coordination and student experience awareness
  
  
Quality management
  
  
Grievance management
  
  
Conflict resolution
  
  
Data analysis and problem-solving
  
  
Stakeholder management
  
  
Professional judgment and stakeholder sensitivity
  
  
Confidentiality and discretion
  
  
Strong ownership and accountability
  
  
Ability to handle sensitive situations calmly
  
  
Strong written and verbal communication
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a highly professional student-experience leader with the ability to balance student needs, service quality, residential community expectations, and institutional requirements.
  
  
The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and the ability to build trust with students while maintaining appropriate professional boundaries.
  
  
Experience in a large university, student housing, residential campus, hospitality, community-living, or customer-experience environment will be highly desirable.
  
  
The individual should be capable of moving beyond reactive complaint handling and building a proactive student-experience framework based on data, student feedback, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**
**Key Attributes**
**Student First | Integrity | Confidentiality | Quality Orientation | Ownership | Collaboration | Service Excellence | Data-Driven Decision Making | Continuous Improvement**

title: Sr. Consulting Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
Sr Consulting Manager role in a global organization focused on guiding property and casualty insurance clients through complex business and technology transformation. The role requires 12 to 15 years of consulting experience deep insurance domain expertise and the ability to deliver measurable value in a hybrid work model during day shifts without travel requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead complex consulting engagements for property and casualty insurance clients by defining clear transformation objectives and driving measurable business outcomes that align with client and company goals.
* Oversee end to end delivery of strategic initiatives in underwriting claims and policy administration by coordinating multidisciplinary teams to ensure timelines quality standards and budget expectations are consistently met.
* Provide expert guidance on modernizing insurance operations including process reengineering and digitization to improve efficiency reduce operational risk and enhance customer satisfaction for client organizations.
* Drive development of data informed strategies for pricing risk selection and portfolio management by collaborating with analytics teams to translate insights into practical actions that improve combined ratios.
* Facilitate structured workshops with client stakeholders to identify pain points and opportunities in property and casualty value chains and translate findings into prioritized roadmaps and actionable implementation plans.
* Manage engagement governance by establishing clear communication cadences detailed status reporting and risk mitigation plans that provide transparency and build trust with client sponsors and internal leadership.
* Guide solution design for core insurance platforms rating engines and claims solutions by aligning functional requirements with industry best practices and regulatory expectations to ensure robust and compliant outcomes.
* Coordinate hybrid project teams across client and company locations by setting expectations promoting inclusive collaboration and ensuring efficient use of virtual and onsite interactions during day shift operations.
* Develop compelling business cases that quantify expected benefits from transformation initiatives including cost savings revenue growth and customer experience improvements to support informed decision making by client executives.
* Mentor consulting team members by offering structured feedback on deliverables and consulting approaches helping them develop strong domain knowledge and professional skills that strengthen overall team capability.
* Ensure consistent adherence to industry regulations data privacy standards and company risk policies within all consulting recommendations and implementation activities to protect client and company interests.
* Collaborate with sales and account teams to shape new consulting opportunities by contributing domain insights solution concepts and delivery estimates that improve win probability and long term client relationships.
* Measure engagement success through defined key performance indicators capturing operational and financial impacts then use findings to refine methodologies and drive continuous improvement in consulting offerings.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate extensive experience of 12 to 15 years in consulting roles with sustained responsibility for complex initiatives in property and casualty insurance environments.
* Show deep practical knowledge across core property and casualty functions including underwriting claims policy lifecycle billing and reinsurance with proven experience in process and operating model enhancements.
* Apply strong skills in business analysis requirements definition and documentation to translate client needs into structured solution designs and implementation roadmaps.
* Exhibit proficiency in guiding adoption of modern insurance platforms and digital tools such as workflow engines portals and rating systems while maintaining focus on user experience and operational resilience.
* Use advanced communication and stakeholder management capabilities to engage executives subject matter experts and project teams ensuring clarity alignment and proactive issue resolution.
* Demonstrate solid understanding of regulatory frameworks and compliance expectations relevant to property and casualty insurance and incorporate these considerations into all consulting recommendations.
* Display familiarity with common project management methods and consulting frameworks enabling effective planning risk management and status reporting in a hybrid work environment with no travel.

title: AVP, Sourcing Manager (L10)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Sourcing Manager (L10)**
**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The AVP Sourcing will execute and carry out the sourcing process, ensure supplier compliance during on-boarding and engagement for renewal time periods, review contractual agreements of assigned suppliers, including developing certain sourcing category strategies for Global hubs (US and Philippines). In this role, you will manage and mitigate supplier as well as business risks and work closely with the Business leaders and Sourcing Leaders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Regularly meet with business owners across Synchrony lines of businesses (LOBs) and/or Sourcing Leaders to provide guidance and direction to functional teams, with strong process responsibility to develop comprehensive plan to execute while meeting business needs (i.e., examine scope, cost, availability of products/services and market conditions to complete projects).
* Expertise on Global Supply markets (US and Philippines) in terms of supplier/products/services and local compliance requirement for suppliers.
* Drive sourcing initiatives with focus on driving productivity, cost saving benefits and identifying rationalization opportunities.
* Leverage professional expertise with Legal and business owners to review and modify contractual terms & conditions.
* Oversight of supplier compliance with regulatory and reputational requirements throughout all stages of the sourcing process.
* Conduct and assist RFIs/RFPs, market research and identification, qualification and competitive analysis of required products and services.

description:
**Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses**

**Brainware University seeks an analytical and resourceful professional to lead a team of bright young AI researchers to work on problems relating to admissions, placements, HR, cost control, programme performance and institutional growth.**

**The role**

You will translate management concerns into clearly formulated problems, identify the questions that matter, investigate available evidence and recommend practical solutions.

The work will rely primarily on secondary research, supplemented by available university data discussions with relevant colleagues and market research.

Information will sometimes be incomplete. You must be able to make reasonable assumptions, explain their basis and assess how they affect your conclusions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Structure problems into specific questions, research tasks and measurable outcomes.
* Research comparable institutions, industry practices, market trends and relevant benchmarks.
* Develop realistic estimates and financial or operational models using clearly stated assumptions.
* Assess alternative solutions in terms of cost, feasibility, likely benefit and implementation requirements.
* Present concise recommendations explaining what should be done, why, by whom and how results should be measured.
* Refine recommendations as new evidence becomes available.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and practical judgement.
* Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
* Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets and incomplete information.
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply.
* Ability to work independently and question assumptions constructively.
* Responsible use of AI research tools, including verification of sources and calculations.

**Candidates may come from consulting, business analysis, economics, finance, operations, market research or related backgrounds. Experience in higher education would be preferred. Demonstrated problem-solving ability will carry more weight than a particular degree or designation.**

The expected output is a workable recommendation supported by evidence, transparent assumptions and an implementation plan.

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical case exercise and discuss their reasoning, assumptions and recommendations.

**Locations : Both Salt Lake and Barasat**

Remuneration: Commensurate with capability and experience.

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a brief example of a problem you have analysed, explaining your approach, recommendation and outcome, to ds.cho@brainwareuniversity.ac.in.

title: Pod Lead, Delivery Architect
description:
**What Amphare is**

Amphare Technologies builds governed, AI-native software delivery. The method is atomikd: scope is decomposed into machine-checkable units, each with a contract and an evidence grade, scheduled in waves and shipped inside a release envelope. The kernel is AmphSE: it sits above the coding agents and enforces the gates. The instrument is CodeSentinel: it reads the code and grades the evidence. The map is RepoGraph: the code graph every atom is planned against. The proof is a services pod that delivers real client software with all three and feeds what it learns back into the product.

The hybrid is deliberate. Service work funds the product and tests it against reality. The product makes the service faster, and lets us show a client exactly what was built, how it was verified, and by whom. Showing the client that is the business.

**Why this role exists**

Someone has to hold the whole project: the client's actual problem, the architecture that answers it, the estimate the business signed, the waves that get it built, and the evidence that proves it shipped. In a traditional firm that is a project manager, an architect, a scrum master and a BA, plus a steering committee. Here it is you, with three strong colleagues and a kernel that enforces the gates you set. You are the person a client trusts because you can draw the system on one page and defend every box. You are the person the pod trusts because when the critical path is blocked, you open the editor.

**What you own**

* The engagement. One at a time for the first pod. From sales handover to acceptance: scope, commercial envelope (what the fixed price can absorb), risk, client relationship, and the decision to say no when the evidence says no. Pricing new work and signing contracts stay with the founder.
* Solution shape. Architecture, stack choice for the client's constraints (we are stack-agnostic by principle), integration boundaries, non-functional requirements, and the trade-offs written down where the client can read them. You are accountable for the user experience too; specialist design is engaged per engagement from outside the pod.
* The Epic Map and the estimate. Decomposition to the level where effort can be measured and compared with what we actually spent. Your estimates are checked against outcomes every wave. Wave scheduling and the release envelope. What ships, in what order, with what dependencies, under what gate. Short, written, evidence-first.
* Pod governance. The gates agents and humans pass through, the evidence grades we accept, the retros that change the method. "AI proposes, humans approve" is a rule you enforce, including on yourself.
* The pod itself. Growing the three people beside you, and writing down how this pod works so the next pod can copy it.

**Who we are looking for**

* You have shipped production software as an engineer and later run delivery for teams larger than this pod, and you know what that cost.
* You have personally fixed a bad estimate, in front of a client, with numbers rather than apologies.
* You can draw a system on one page and answer "why not the obvious alternative" for every component.
* You have read code an agent wrote for you closely enough to send it back. More than once.
* You have written requirements, test plans and release notes yourself because nobody else was going to, and they were good.
* You can name a ceremony you removed from a team and what you replaced it with.
* You are commercially literate: blended rates, margin, fixed-price risk, what a change request costs.

*Signals this is not your role*

* You manage through status meetings and feel exposed without a PMO.
* You last committed code three or more years ago and are comfortable with that.
* You believe "architect" means not touching the keyboard.
* You see AI coding tools as a productivity add-on for juniors.
* You cannot do your best work until scope is frozen.
* You prefer to be told the method rather than to improve it.

title: Area Manager, Retail
description:
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2024, Sika’s around 33,000 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11.76 billion.

**Job Description**

An inspired self-starter and able to drive sales growth. Ultimately, a top-notch sales executive should be able to build rapport with customers and close sales Promoting new products and any special deals. Advising customers about delivery schedules and after-sales service. Recording orders and sending details to the sales office. Giving feedback on sales trends.

**Key Responsibilities**

* To fulfil and achieve distribution and sales objectives for key brands in the on-trade channel by successful implementation of sales strategies and plans
* To ensure full compliance of sales, price management, promotion and merchandising

Distribution

* To ensure distribution objectives for specific SKUs are achieved as per sales plan
* Focus on driving sales in Hardware, Paints, Cement & Sanitary channels
* To ensure a high standard of presence and merchandising for key products in the trade
* To ensure target price levels for both trade and consumers are implemented

Promotions

* Identify target outlets, negotiate and implement promotional activities at the highest possible standard
* Feedback and evaluation of results for sales and marketing management’s review

Control

* To recommend appropriate level of credit and duration to trade accounts as per standard policies and procedures
* To ensure collection through pro-active evaluation and management of receivables in order to achieve collection target as set by sales management

Trade Relationships

* Develop and maintain amiable win-win relationship with the Distributors, Sub Distributors, PoS
* Manage and improve performance of assigned trade accounts

Sales Management

* To achieve the following core KPIs
  + **Monthly sales target volume**
  + **Increase point of sales ( PoS )**
* Provide timely and accurate information for the updating of Salesforce.com
* Evaluate outlet date, call targets and trade information on regular basis to drive improvement on sales efficiency

**Additional Information**

We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

title: Stores - Lead Shipping and Receiving Associate
description:
**Position Summary**
The main job function is to ensure the effective functioning of Production Stores operations by managing the receipt, storage, binning, issuance, and inventory control of raw materials and parts. The role supports production requirements through accurate material availability, ERP transactions, inventory management, and effective coordination with internal departments.
  
  
**Work You’ll Do**

* Responsible for receipt of raw materials, storage, binning supervision, issuance of materials to assembly lines, periodic cycle counting of raw materials, and dispatch of materials to job-work vendors.
* Coordinate with interdepartmental teams for proper storage of inward materials and plan storage locations for new and existing parts to avoid material spillage. Create new storage locations in the ERP system as required.
* Responsible for issuing raw materials as per the production plan and carrying out advance kitting based on the Bill of Materials (BOM). Support identification and retrieval of parts when they are not available at designated locations.
* Supervise and effectively manage a team of approximately 10–15 casual workers engaged in stores and material-handling activities.
* Manage a large inventory consisting of more than 20,000 parts/SKUs in an open-store raw material warehouse environment.
* Responsible for periodic physical audits, cycle counts, and inventory verification of raw materials.
* Ensure Goods Receipt Note (GRN) processing for inward materials in the ERP system, including physical quantity verification and maintenance of required documentation as per organizational policies.
* Ensure minimum material wastage, damage, or spillage through proper handling and storage practices.
* Responsible for data preparation, MIS reporting, documentation, and accurate data entry in the ERP system.
* Use ERP store/inventory modules effectively for day-to-day stores operations and maintain inventory-related data and reports using Microsoft Excel.

**Team**
This role will be a part of the Operations – Stores Team.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
Diploma / Graduate in a relevant discipline.
  
  
Relevant experience in Stores, Warehouse, Material Management, or Inventory Management within a manufacturing environment.
  
  
Experience in handling large inventories with 20,000+ parts/SKUs.
  
  
Working knowledge of ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in Production Stores or Raw Material Stores within an engineering/manufacturing organization.
  
  
Good knowledge of material receipt, GRN, BOM-based kitting, inventory control, cycle counting, physical audits, and warehouse operations.
  
  
Strong supervisory and interdepartmental coordination skills.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. With expertise in plastics spanning nearly 60 years, Milacron holds longstanding relationships with more than 27,000 customers around the world. The original equipment provider of plastics manufacturing solutions is the largest US-owned and globally served of its kind. Headquartered in Batavia, OH, Milacron’s global footprint is also serviced through regional facilities in Asia, Europe, and South America.
  
  
**Eeo**
The policy of Milacron is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. We are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offer opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@milacron.com. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: General Manager- Techno Commercial
description:
****About Business:****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The TCD Site Executive (OPEX) is responsible for overseeing the procurement and inventory management of OPEX items required for operational activities across all mining sites. The role ensures the timely and cost-effective acquisition of goods and services, maintaining optimal inventory levels to support continuous site operations.
  
  
****JOB RESPONSIBILITIES****
**Category In-charge (CAPEX) - NR**
****Strategic Procurement And Supplier Management:****
Coordinate procurement activities across sites, ensuring strategic planning and alignment with operational needs.
  
  
Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers to procure quality OPEX items, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to quality standards.
  
  
Manage supplier relationships to negotiate favorable terms and ensure continuous improvement in vendor performance.
  
  
Lead process improvement initiatives in purchasing, contract management, supplier selection, and sourcing to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
  
  
**Inventory Management:**
Monitor and manage inventory levels to ensure availability of OPEX items, minimizing excess stock and obsolescence.
  
  
Conduct regular inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies to maintain accurate records.
  
  
Determine optimal reorder points and quantities to prevent stockouts and ensure uninterrupted site operations.
  
  
Generate and analyze inventory reports to identify trends, forecast needs, and inform procurement decisions.
  
  
Review inventory levels periodically and take necessary actions to maintain optimal stock at all sites.
  
  
**Financial And Budget Management:**
Conduct cost analysis of procurement activities to identify savings opportunities and drive cost reduction initiatives.
  
  
Ensure procurement activities are within budgetary constraints and provide regular updates to management on budget status.
  
  
Manage buying processes efficiently, including RFPs, proposal evaluations, negotiations, vendor selection, and contract awards.
  
  
Prepare and issue purchase orders for required OPEX items, ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures.
  
  
**Operational Coordination And Reporting:**
Coordinate with site managers and operational teams to understand OPEX requirements and ensure timely delivery of needed items.
  
  
Address and resolve procurement or inventory issues to ensure smooth operational activities.
  
  
Manage urgent procurement requests to support unplanned operational needs and minimize downtime.
  
  
Attend to internal/external audit queries, provide data, and take corrective actions for observations received.
  
  
Review commercial/stores SOPs annually, make necessary changes, and update the revision.
  
  
Review Pending PRs status with team members and take necessary corrective actions, providing performance feedback.
  
  
Attend review meetings conducted by TCD Leads/site head/corporate and prepare necessary data and presentations on OPEX-related procurements and inventory.
  
  
Release all e-NFA documents after checking the support documents and follow up for timely approval.
  
  
Check and release New Vendor code, VC unblock, and GRN error in MDG portal.
  
  
Review reports on inventory stock at all sites and follow up with contractors for monthly consumption reports.
  
  
**Compliance And Quality Assurance:**
Ensure compliance with quality, legal, financial, and safety terms in OPEX purchase and service contracts.
  
  
Monitor material/service providers’ performance and take necessary action to bridge gaps and ensure timely renewal of contracts.
  
  
Manage all commercial processes and data as per IMS standards, update data, attend audits, and address observations.
  
  
**Technology Integration:**
Deploy digital tools for real-time monitoring and optimization of operational expenditures on site, enhancing cost efficiency and project outcomes.
  
  
Implement advanced digital solutions for managing site operations and resource allocation, ensuring effective and efficient use of operational resources.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Sites Projects team
  
  
Marketing department
  
  
Finance & Accounts team
  
  
Quality Assurance Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Vendors
  
  
Suppliers
  
  
External agencies
  
  
Auditors
  
  
****RESPONSIBILITIES****
Strategic Sourcing:
  
  

* Plan and forecast Capex procurement needs based on the projects in pipeline and organization's strategic objectives.
* Formulate contractual terms and conditions for major EPC contracts to secure favorable terms.
* Negotiate with vendors for long-term contract terms to ensure beneficial agreements.
* Select the bidding process, prepare vendor selection approaches, and vendor evaluation criteria to streamline the procurement process.
* Review RFI and RFP documents, identify potential bidders, and organize pre-bid meetings to facilitate a competitive bidding process.
* Conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations and fact-based negotiations/e-auctions to select the best vendors.
* Review Notes for Approval (NFA) for selected bidders and obtain required approvals to ensure compliance with company policies.
* Leverage extensive experience in mining and material handling procurement, including handling mining and EPC contractors, explosives, CHPP, and project monitoring to develop and implement procurement strategies.

**Core Procurement Activities:**

* Understand the Techno-Commercial strategy and plan for the Business Unit (BU) to implement strategic initiatives for all categories (Group-wide/BU specific) as per plan.
* Oversee the review of approved PRs from user departments to ensure correctness and completeness of PRs.
* Coordinate with leads in identifying the type and method of procurement based on material/service type, urgency, stock availability, rate contracts, value, and delivery timeline to optimize procurement efficiency.

**Contract Management:**

* Oversee the preparation of contract documents as per protocols and standard templates to ensure consistency and compliance.
* Set up approved contract records within the ERP system to maintain accurate and accessible records.
* Maintain contract documents for future reference and compliance to ensure traceability and accountability.
* Collate Advance Bank Guarantee/Contract Performance Bank Guarantee (ABG/CPBG)/Customs related documents from vendors to secure financial assurances.
* Prepare, review, and issue rate contracts based on approved NFAs to secure long-term pricing agreements.
* Prepare master outline agreements in ERP systems based on rate contracts to streamline procurement processes.
* Prepare PO/SO for procurement under valid rate contracts to facilitate timely procurement.

**Supplier Management:**

* Oversee the identification of vendor evaluation criteria in consultation with quality, engineering, and project management departments to ensure rigorous vendor selection.
* Ensure completeness of forms submitted by vendors and update the approved vendor list to maintain an accurate and up-to-date vendor database.
* Coordinate with new vendors for evaluation documents and with quality/engineering/user teams for assessments if required to ensure comprehensive vendor evaluations.
* Prepare vendor segmentation matrices and performance evaluation criteria to categorize and assess vendor performance effectively.
* Oversee the evaluation process for CapEx and services vendors, ensuring thorough review of vendor scorecards.
* Plan improvement actions for vendors with unsatisfactory performance to enhance vendor performance.
* Manage all cluster CAPEX commercial activities and site TC functions as per Delegation of Authority (DoA) to ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

**Data Management And Risk Management:**

* Collate and analyze data related to large scale procurement activities (e.g., commodity analysis, supplier debugging) to derive actionable insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and value through data analysis to drive continuous improvement.
* Identify procurement risks for assigned categories using master lists, supply market analysis, long-term procurement plans, annual procurement plans, and project risk registers to mitigate risks.

**People Management:**

* Work towards achieving set goals and participate in performance reviews to stay aligned with team objectives.
* Communicate personal development needs and actively engage in creating and following Individual Development Plans (IDP) for professional growth.
* Develop skills in current and future functional focus areas as per the capability matrix and IDP guidelines to contribute to team versatility.

**Technology Integration:**

* Utilize digital solutions for comprehensive tracking and analysis of capital expenditure projects, ensuring accurate forecasting and budgeting.
* Implement digital tools for project management and reporting, improving transparency and efficiency in Capex initiatives.
* Contribute to action planning and implementation based on data analytics to enhance CAPEX procurement strategies.

****QUALIFICATIONS****
**Work Experience (Range of years):**
**Work Experience (Range Of Years):**
More than 12 years of experience in supply chain management, procurement.

**Who are we?**

Trelleborg Industrial Solutions (TIS) is a global leader in innovative polymer-based solutions for key industries and critical infrastructure. We are one of three Business Areas within the Trelleborg Group, with a total of about 6 200 employees around the world.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and driven finance professional to manage end-to-end Record-to-Report (R2R) activities within general ledger accounting. This role involves handling journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, fixed assets, intercompany accounting, and month-end/year-end close processes while ensuring compliance with organizational standards and Indian statutory requirements (Companies Act, GST, Income Tax, and Cost Audit).

The role also requires supporting financial reporting, audits, and strengthening internal controls across the R2R function.

**Key Responsibilities**
**General Ledger & Month-End Close**

* Prepare and post journal entries for accruals, prepayments, provisions, allocations, and adjustments in line with the close calendar
* Perform balance sheet reconciliations and ensure timely resolution of reconciling items
* Conduct trial balance reviews and variance analysis (actual vs budget/forecast)
* Support month-end and year-end close processes

**Fixed Assets & Intercompany**

* Maintain fixed asset registers; handle asset additions, disposals, transfers, and depreciation as per Companies Act and Income Tax
* Process and reconcile intercompany transactions and ensure timely confirmations and eliminations

**Financial Reporting & Consolidation**

* Prepare management reporting packs for assigned areas
* Support preparation of statutory financial statements and schedules under Companies Act, 2013
* Assist in BPC/consolidation system data uploads for reporting

**Statutory Compliance & Tax Support**

* Maintain schedules and reconciliations for GST/VAT filings and audits
* Support cost audit requirements including product/process-wise cost statements
* Assist in advance tax computation, deferred tax workings, and other income tax schedules
* Contribute to segment-wise and product-wise disclosures

**Controls & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with SOX and internal control requirements
* Maintain audit documentation for internal, statutory, and cost audits
* Act as a point of contact for auditors on R2R matters
* Identify and escalate control gaps or unusual transactions

**About You**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or CA/CMA (Inter)
* 5+ years of experience in finance operations or shared services

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of general ledger accounting and reconciliations
* Experience in fixed assets accounting and depreciation
* Understanding of intercompany accounting and consolidation
* Good knowledge of Indian statutory requirements (GST, Income Tax, Companies Act, Cost Audit)
* Proficiency in ERP systems (D365/SAP preferred) and MS Excel
* Exposure to BPC or similar consolidation tools is an advantage

**Core Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with variance analysis capability
* Attention to detail and focus on accuracy
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English
* Ability to work in a structured, deadline-driven environment

title: Senior Marketplace Analyst
description:
**About Stonehill Solutions**

Stonehill Solutions is a technology solutions company dedicated to building reliable, scalable, and intelligent digital systems that help businesses operate more efficiently, adapt faster, and grow with confidence.

Established on the trusted foundation Stonehill Solutions carries forward a legacy of excellence while building its own identity as a specialized technology and business solutions provider. We focus on delivering innovative, practical, and future-ready solutions that streamline operations, enhance productivity, and support sustainable business growth.

**Position overview**

We are looking for a Senior Marketplace Analyst to strengthen the forecasting, diagnostic and reporting systems behind our marketplace decisions. Working directly with the Director, Marketplace, Operations & Customer Experience, you will turn complex operating data into clear recommendations that improve capacity planning, service reliability and city performance.

This is a hands-on analytical role for someone who can move beyond reporting to explain what changed, why it has changed and what business should do next. You will work closely with Supply, Ground Operations, Customer Service, Product, Technology, Finance and Growth.

Ride-hailing experience is strongly preferred. We will also consider candidates from delivery, quick-commerce, last-mile logistics or other marketplaces where supply-demand balancing, field execution and real-time service levels are central to the business.

**Key responsibilities**

**Demand, supply and capacity planning**

* Build rolling demand and supply forecasts by city, product, day and hour.
* Translate demand forecasts, chauffeur churn and productivity into recruitment, activation and capacity requirements.
* Track forecast accuracy and improve models as seasonality, new products, events and city behavior change.
* Model the marketplace impact of B2B commitments, port work, scheduled services, promotions and Saudi launch requirements.

**Marketplace performance analysis**

* Monitor fulfilment, request-to-accept time, accept-to-arrival time, cancellations, unserved demand, active chauffeurs, online hours, utilisation, productivity and Customer Service performance.
* Diagnose performance by city, daypart, zone, service type, chauffeur cohort and customer segment.
* Identify anomalies, quantify the customer and commercial impact, and distinguish symptoms from root causes.
* Build clear action-oriented analyses for the Director and functional heads, including owners, expected impact and follow-up measurement.

**Operating reviews and decision support**

* Own the analytical preparation for daily controls, weekly business reviews and monthly operating reviews.
* Maintain one trusted set of marketplace definitions and challenge inconsistent or unreliable metrics.
* Automate recurring reports and alerts so time is spent on diagnosis and action rather than manual data preparation.
* Support scenario planning for city launches service-level trade-offs, supply incentives and operational investments.

**Cross-functional problem-solving**

* Work with Supply, Ground Operations and Customer Service to convert analysis into operating changes and measurable service recovery.
* Partner with Product and Technology on data quality, marketplace tooling and product changes affecting operational performance.
* Collaborate with Finance and Growth where marketplace decisions affect unit economics, pricing, promotions or capacity investment.

**Candidate profile**

* Four to seven years of experience in marketplace analytics, strategy and operations, business operations or operational planning.
* Ride-hailing experience is strongly preferred. Adjacent marketplace experience is acceptable when the operating model includes live supply-demand balancing and field execution.
* Advanced SQL and strong Excel or Google Sheets skills are mandatory.
* Strong working knowledge of Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, Looker or a comparable business-intelligence platform.
* Demonstrated experience building forecasts, capacity plans, cohort analyses and operational performance diagnostics.
* Ability to communicate complex analysis as a short, defensible recommendation for senior operators.
* Strong attention to definitions, data quality and detail, without losing sight of the commercial and customer outcome.
* Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where the question may initially be unclear and the data may be imperfect.
* Python or statistical modelling experience is useful but not required.

description:
