* ROLE PURPOSE & OBJECTIVE

* Officer-Credit Agriculture Banking is responsible for underwriting secured variant under Rural Banking i.e. KPC and related variants of KPC. The role mainly co-ordinates with sales team and also with external vendors such as legal & technical to sanction the secured agri loans. This profile visits the customer residence place and business / activity place to assess the financial parameters, and then appraises the loan applications as per credit approval grid, deviation matrix and bureau matrix
* SIZE OF THE ROLE

FINANCIAL SIZE
  
  
NON-FINANCIAL SIZE
  
  

* 10-15 Crores of asset portfolio to be managed with a span of minimum 3 loan officers per credit officer
* Atleast 10 vendors / consultants including all fintech partners, technical vendors and BCs associated/ to be associated with Rural banking
* KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

**Business**

* Underwrite Kisan Prgati Card, Kisan Suvidha Loans and any other new products rolled out under Rural Banking in the field through thorough assessment and personal discussion with borrower and / or co-borrower
* Sanction or recommend secured loans with proper justification as per product features, credit policy and based on approval rights
* Conduct farm lands, business place, office, and residence verification of the applicants based on the product and purpose of the loan
* Assess repayment capacity, character and cash flow of the applicant.
* Conduct reference checks with customers /suppliers / vendors / dealers.
* Ensure collection of relevant and proper documents. Ensure adherence to internal and regulatory policies / compliances like KYC etc.
* Understand the nature of collateral security, ensure the collateral offered is free from all the encumbrances, having clear title and marketability, the charge creation of the bank on the property should be exclusive first charge.
* Obtain Legal opinion and valuation reports on the collateral offered as security, should clearly advise type of mortgage to be created on the security in the sanction
* Decision whether to approve or reject the files appraised by the sales / distribution team through thorough verification of the documents and assessment by the appraiser of the loan.
* Capture proper reasons of rejections and communicate the same to branch team in case of rejections
* Escalate deviations for necessary approval as per the deviation matrix. Observe for triggers in documents and escalate documents with issues to FCU team.
* Decision on loan applications as per credit approval grid, deviation matrix and bureau matrix
* Responsible for portfolio quality of the loans underwritten
* Review/renew the accounts before expiry of the limit through coordinating with Distribution team
* Ensure weekly and monthly productivity with respect to personal discussions, quality check of applications, sample visits and checks etc.
* Monitoring rejections from field, guide the branch staff to control the same and ensure higher number of Straight through applications from branches.
* Report/ Escalate critical issues at field for necessary action as per penalty matrix and ensure compliance of Audit issues.
* Conduct Loan Utilization Checks for the recent disbursement cases as per policy.
* Ensure to participate and drive the successful implementation of technology based projects at backend and field
* Engage in collections for recovery, follow up for Incremental overdues and non-starters
* Ensures success and growth of these products by adhering to defined policy and process for loan approval

**Customer**

* Ensures customer satisfaction by processing of loan applications within the TAT defined
* Understand customers’ need & repayment capacity & make appropriate loan decisions and recommend right product and loan amount to right customer
* Ensure that credit responds to branch & customers queries and issues timely, thereby ensuring good service to customers through efficient processing of applications
* Co-ordinate with Legal and technical vendors for quick response on the property documents
* Coordinate with FCU team or agency for their reports
* Ensure customers documents are kept safe till they are handed over to concerned authority
* Coordinate with Operations for loan booking, safe keeping of the customer document etc.
* Undertake visits in other financial institutions for timely resolution of issues relating customer or staffs of other institution
* Engage with customer for any feedback on the products, policy and process

**Internal process**

* Ensure credit policies and processes are followed effectively by sourcing staffs
* Ensure adherence to all regulatory norms with respect to KYC & Documentation, Customer Selection and Sanctioning of loans
* Decision on loan applications as per credit approval grid, deviation matrix and bureau matrix
* Ensure legal opinions are clearly understood and necessary action taken based on the legal opinion
* Ensure completeness of post disbursement documents, follow up for if gaps any
* Review branch working areas, negative areas, no-go areas and negative customer list
* Ensure that the Issue/ deviations / policy/ process violation are escalated appropriately to the concerned department and supervisors for implementation of penalty matrix.
* Attend audit closure meetings to understand identified issues & take necessary corrective measures.
* Maintain and update activity trackers – Personal discussions, Quality check of files shadow visits, sample checks, trainings, LUCs, escalations, deviations, branch errors
* To do quality check of documents that are executed post sanction and then recommend for sanction.

**Learning & Performance**

* Maintain up to date knowledge of all the products and the geography
* Keep updated about the regulatory norms for agri products
* Keep updated about the property document related policies and processes
* New products being introduced and new systems being adopted to be learnt quickly and to be adopted
* Keep updated with SLBC / DLC meetings & annual reports for information on investment on different types of crops for KCC / Agri limits. Keep abreast with ongoing farming operations in the field & market
* Networking with other Banks to have a deeper understanding of the Industry and its perspectives
* Undertake business sub sector study and underwrite cases at field
* Ensure necessary feedback is given to supervisors on regular basis about the credit policies, processes and systems for effective and efficient underwriting
* Improve the probing skills to identify any issues in the field and report critical findings / observations for necessary action
* Imparting training to branch team on KCC, Agri composite loans, other agri secured product’s credit policies, processes and systems, conduct regular trainings on changes / refreshers.
* Ensuring visits in branches of other clusters to ensure understanding and learning through experience
* MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

Educational
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Graduation or Post Graduation Preferably in Agriculture, Agri Business Management, Rural Management, Finance etc.

Experience(Years and Core Experience Type)
  
  

* 2-4 years of experience preferably in field credit or sales of any financial products preferably agricultural or secured products

Certifications
  
  

* NA

Functional Skills
  
  

* Knowledge of credit underwriting in secured loans, agricultural loans
* Business analysis skills and document verification skills
* Proficient in reading / understanding financial statements and legal opinions
* KYC norms/guidelines for high ticket size secured and agri loans
* Knowledge of land and property documents
* Knowledge of hypothecation and mortgage process

Behavioral Skills
  
  

* Good decision making and judgement ability
* Time Management - Ability to prioritize the work based on the importance / urgency
* Flexible enough to support the business needs
* Customer relations management
* Performance oriented approach with high productivity
* Good interpersonal skills
* Willingness to travel & relocation as per business requirements and career opportunities

Competencies
  
  

* Communication skills - fluent in the local language and basic English
* Strong Analytical and Interpretation skill.
* Good interrogation and investigation skills
* High degree of accuracy and attention to detail
* Strong Interpersonal skills & ability to manage relationships with internal & external stakeholders

Loan Officers, Distribution team, Credit supervisory staff, Collection team, Branch Manager, Vigilance Officer and Auditors etc.

Apply today!

title: Cluster Manager for Salons
description:
**Company Description**
Naturals Salon & Spa, launched in 2000, is one of the world’s fastest-growing salon chains, with over 800 salons across India and an ambitious target of 3,000 salons by 2029. The brand pioneered the concept of unisex salons in India and has become widely recognized for accessible, high-quality hair, beauty, and wellness services. Naturals serves a diverse clientele through its portfolio of sub-brands, including Naturals Unisex Salon, Naturals Signature Salon, and Naturals W, a women-focused concept. With a mission to create 1,000 successful women entrepreneurs and 50,000 job opportunities by 2029, Naturals offers strong growth prospects for professionals in the beauty and salon management industry. The brand’s partnership with Bollywood actor Kareena Kapoor as ambassador reflects its focus on style, confidence, and continuous expansion.
  
**Role Description**
The Cluster Manager for Salons is a full-time, on-site role based in Coimbatore, responsible for overseeing the performance and operations of multiple Naturals salons within the assigned cluster. This role includes monitoring daily salon activities, ensuring consistent service quality, implementing brand standards, and driving revenue and profitability across locations. The Cluster Manager will guide salon managers on staff scheduling, inventory management, and adherence to hygiene and safety protocols, while supporting training and development of beauty and hair care professionals. They will handle customer escalations, foster strong client relationships, and collaborate with leadership to execute local marketing initiatives and promotional campaigns. The role also involves hiring and onboarding key salon staff, analyzing performance data, and recommending improvements to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Foundational knowledge in cosmetology and hair.
* Strong communication and customer service skills to manage client interactions, resolve concerns, and coordinate with salon managers and staff.
* Experience in hiring, staffing, and basic HR practices to build and retain high-performing salon teams.
* Background in salon, spa, retail, or hospitality operations, with proven ability to manage multiple outlets or a multi-location portfolio.
* Skills in people management, leadership, and performance coaching, with the ability to motivate teams and maintain high service standards.
* Ability to analyze sales, customer feedback, and operational metrics, and take data-driven decisions to improve cluster performance.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the capacity to travel between salons within the Coimbatore cluster as needed.
* Diploma or certification in cosmetology, beauty therapy, or salon management is preferred; a degree in business, hospitality, or related fields is an added advantage.

title: Head - Central Planning
description:
**Job Title: Head of Central Planning**

**Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu**

**Experience: 10–15 years of experience in garment manufacturing**

**JOB PURPOSE**

Lead the centralised manufacturing planning function across all manufacturing units,

ensuring optimum capacity utilisation, effective order allocation, balanced factory

loading, material readiness, production execution and on-time delivery.

**CENTRAL PLANNING & STRATEGY**

* Develop and manage the overall central planning strategy across

manufacturing units.

* Establish standard planning processes, systems, formats and review

mechanisms.

* Consolidate business requirements and convert them into realistic

manufacturing plans.

* Develop monthly, quarterly and annual manufacturing plans aligned with

business projections.

* Drive proactive rather than reactive planning across the organisation.

**CAPACITY PLANNING & FACTORY LOADING**

* Develop factory-wise and line-wise capacity plans based on SMV, efficiency,

working days, product complexity and available resources.

* Allocate orders to factories based on capability, capacity and delivery

requirements.

* Ensure optimum and balanced utilisation of manufacturing capacity.
* Identify capacity gaps, excess capacity and future capacity requirements.
* Recommend capacity redistribution, additional shifts, outsourcing or capacity

expansion where required.

**ORDER & PRODUCTION PLANNING**

* Manage end-to-end order planning from order confirmation to production

completion.

* Prepare production plans aligned with committed delivery dates.
* Monitor planned vs. actual production, WIP, efficiency and order

completion.

* Prioritise critical orders and develop recovery plans for delayed orders.
* Ensure production plans are realistic, achievable and continuously updated.

**RAW MATERIAL & MATERIAL READINESS**

* Coordinate with Sourcing - Fabric, Sewing Trims and Packing Trims teams

to ensure material readiness.

* Monitor material availability against planned production requirements.
* Identify material shortages or delays that may impact production.
* Ensure production plans are aligned with actual material availability.
* Establish early-warning mechanisms for critical material risks.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION**

* Work closely with:
* Merchandising
* Sourcing - RM
* Production
* Industrial Engineering
* Quality
* Factory Heads
* Commercial & Logistics

Ensure business commitments, material availability, factory capacity and production

plans remain aligned.

**INDUSTRIAL ENGINEERING & EFFICIENCY**

* Work with IE teams to validate SMV, efficiency and capacity assumptions.
* Monitor planned vs. actual efficiency.
* Identify productivity gaps affecting capacity.
* Support line balancing, bottleneck reduction and capacity improvement.
* Incorporate product complexity and learning curves into planning.

**DELIVERY & RISK MANAGEMENT**

* Establish an early-warning system for delivery risks.
* Identify bottlenecks, capacity constraints and production delays in advance.
* Drive corrective and recovery actions with relevant teams.
* Monitor critical orders through regular review mechanisms.
* Develop contingency plans for capacity, material and production disruptions.

**MIS, SYSTEMS & ANALYTICS**

* Develop central planning dashboards and management MIS.
* Ensure accurate visibility of orders, capacity, production, WIP, material

readiness and delivery status.

* Drive ERP-based planning and data accuracy.
* Utilise Advanced Excel / Power BI for planning analysis and decision-making.
* Establish meaningful planning KPIs and performance dashboards.

**TEAM LEADERSHIP**

* Lead and develop the Central Planning / PPC team.
* Define clear KRAs, KPIs and accountability.
* Build planning capability through training and process improvement.
* Promote data-driven decision-making and strong planning discipline.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Capacity Utilisation
* Factory Loading Accuracy
* Production Plan Adherence
* On-Time Production
* On-Time Shipment
* Planning Accuracy
* Material Readiness
* WIP Control
* Production Efficiency
* Order Ageing
* Bottleneck Resolution
* Reduction in Last-Minute / Emergency Planning

**QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor degree in Textile, Apparel, Production, Industrial Engineering

or related discipline.

* 10–15 years of experience in garment manufacturing with strong exposure

to Central Planning / PPC.

* Experience in multi-factory planning and capacity management is

preferred.

* Strong knowledge of garment manufacturing, SMV, efficiency, capacity

planning and production systems.

* Strong analytical, leadership, communication and stakeholder-management

skills.

* Proficiency in ERP, Advanced Excel and Power BI/MIS preferred.
* Experience in sportswear / activewear manufacturing will be an added

advantage.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

The ideal candidate should be a strong strategic and execution-oriented manufacturing planner who can connect business demand with manufacturing capacity and ensure the right order is planned at the right factory, with the right material and capacity, at the right time. The role requires strong ownership, analytical thinking, decision-making, cross- functional coordination and execution discipline to build a scalable and proactive central planning function.

title: Head of Industrialization
description:
**Designation: Head of Industrialization**

**Department: Industrialization**

**Location: Tirupur, Tamil Nadu**

**Job Purpose**

The Head – Industrialization will lead the Industrialization function and drive

standardization, cost optimization, productivity improvement, and technical

excellence across garment manufacturing operations. The role will establish robust

manufacturing standards from product development through bulk production,

ensuring accurate SMV, costing, consumption, CPM, technical feasibility, and SOP

implementation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. SMV – Method & Time Study**

* Lead method study, time study, operation breakdown, and SMV setting

for new and existing styles.

* Establish accurate and achievable SMVs based on standardized methods,

machines, and operator performance.

* Identify productivity improvement opportunities through method engineering,

line balancing and process optimization.

* Periodically review SMVs against actual production performance and update

standards where required.

**2. Product Costing**

* Drive accurate product costing covering fabric, trims, sewing, processing,

overheads, efficiency, rejection, and other manufacturing parameters.

* Validate costing assumptions with actual manufacturing data and ensure cost

competitiveness.

* Support Merchandising, Sourcing, and Manufacturing teams during product

development and order finalization.

* Identify cost-reduction opportunities without compromising quality or product

specifications.

**3. CPM – Cost Per Minute**

* Establish and maintain standardized CPM benchmarks across products,

operations, and manufacturing units.

* Analyze actual versus standard CPM and identify key cost and efficiency

gaps.

* Work closely with IE and Production teams to improve operational efficiency

and manufacturing cost performance.

**4. Consumption**

* Drive accurate fabric and garment consumption standards during product

development and pre-production.

* Validate consumption through marker efficiency, fabric width, shrinkage,

construction, and wastage parameters.

* Monitor actual versus standard consumption and initiate corrective actions for

deviations.

**5. Technical Support**

* Provide technical support for new product development, proto/sample,

pre-production, and bulk production.

* Evaluate manufacturing feasibility, construction, operation sequence, machine

requirements, and process risks.

* Resolve technical issues in coordination with Design, Merchandising, Quality,

Production, and Sourcing teams.

**6. SOP & amp; Documentation**

* Develop and maintain standardized SOPs, work instructions, technical standards, and process documentation.
* Ensure effective implementation of industrialization standards across factories.
* Establish systems for periodic review, audit, and continuous improvement of technical standards.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong expertise in Industrial Engineering, garment manufacturing, SMV, costing, CPM, and consumption.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills.
* Strong understanding of garment construction, manufacturing processes, and production systems.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive standardization across multiple manufacturing units.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Experience & amp; Qualification**

* 10–15+ years of relevant experience in garment manufacturing / Industrial Engineering / Industrialization.
* Degree/Diploma in Textile Technology, Apparel Technology, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
* Strong proficiency in Excel, ERP systems, and industrial engineering tools.

LATTIX INFRATECH LLP is an engineering and construction company specializing in high-quality steel structures and infrastructure solutions for industrial and commercial projects. The company delivers end-to-end project execution, including design, fabrication, construction, roofing, consulting, and project management, with a focus on precision, efficiency, and reliability. The Site Supervisor role is a full-time, on-site position based in Trichur, responsible for overseeing daily construction activities and ensuring work is executed according to design specifications, safety standards, and project timelines. title: Senior Production Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

**Position:** Senior Production Manager – CNC/VMC/VTL/HMC Manufacturing Unit  
**Job Title:** Production Manager  
**Industry:** Manufacturing / Precision Engineering / Machining  
**Department:** Production & Operations  
**Experience:** 10–15 Years (Preferred)  
**Qualification:** Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering  
**Location:** Arasur, Coimbatore  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Production Manager to take complete ownership of the manufacturing unit's operations, production planning, execution, and overall performance.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the entire production process, including CNC, VMC, VTL, and HMC machining operations, manpower management, machine utilization, quality control coordination, production planning, and timely delivery.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise in machining operations, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to independently manage and drive the manufacturing unit towards operational excellence, productivity, quality, and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Complete Production & Operations Management**

* Take complete responsibility and ownership of the manufacturing unit's production operations.
* Manage end-to-end manufacturing processes involving CNC, VMC, VTL, and HMC machines.
* Ensure smooth and uninterrupted production activities across all shifts.
* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly production targets.
* Monitor production output, machine efficiency, and overall operational performance.
* Take independent decisions to improve production efficiency and resolve operational challenges.

**2. Production Planning & Execution**

* Develop and implement production plans based on customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Ensure optimal utilization of machines, manpower, materials, and resources.
* Monitor job progress from raw material stage to finished goods.
* Coordinate with planning, purchase, stores, quality, and dispatch departments.
* Ensure timely completion of production schedules and customer commitments.

**3. CNC / VMC / VTL / HMC Machining Management**

* Possess strong knowledge of CNC turning, VMC, VTL, and HMC machining operations.
* Monitor machining processes, cycle times, tool usage, and productivity.
* Ensure efficient machine loading and allocation of jobs.
* Coordinate with programming, setting, and operator teams.
* Identify and implement process improvements to reduce cycle time and machining costs.
* Troubleshoot production-related technical issues and machining bottlenecks.

**4. Manpower & Team Management**

* Lead and manage production supervisors, engineers, CNC programmers, setters, and machine operators.
* Allocate manpower according to production requirements.
* Monitor employee performance, discipline, and productivity.
* Conduct regular production review meetings.
* Train and develop production teams to improve technical capabilities.
* Ensure effective shift management and workforce utilization.

**5. Quality & Process Control**

* Ensure adherence to quality standards and customer specifications.
* Coordinate with the Quality Department to minimize rejection, rework, and scrap.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions for production-related quality issues.
* Ensure process standardization and compliance with manufacturing procedures.
* Maintain consistency in product quality and dimensional accuracy.

**6. Machine Maintenance & Utilization**

* Coordinate with the maintenance team for preventive and breakdown maintenance.
* Minimize machine downtime and ensure maximum machine availability.
* Monitor machine performance and identify recurring breakdown issues.
* Ensure proper maintenance of machines, tools, fixtures, and equipment.
* Improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

**7. Cost Control & Productivity Improvement**

* Control production costs, material wastage, tooling expenses, and overtime.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Improve productivity through efficient process planning and resource utilization.
* Monitor rejection rates, cycle time, and manufacturing costs.

**8. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to industrial safety standards and workplace practices.
* Maintain a safe and organized manufacturing environment.
* Ensure proper usage of PPE and compliance with safety procedures.
* Implement 5S and housekeeping practices across the production unit.

**9. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.
* Track production achievement against planned targets.
* Monitor machine utilization, downtime, rejection, and productivity.
* Report operational performance, challenges, and improvement plans to management.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong technical knowledge of CNC, VMC, VTL, and HMC machining.
* Excellent production planning and execution capabilities.
* Proven experience in independently managing a manufacturing unit.
* Strong leadership and manpower management skills.
* Good knowledge of machining processes, tooling, fixtures, and cycle time optimization.
* Ability to handle production bottlenecks and operational challenges.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and OEE.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple production activities simultaneously.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of production targets.
* On-time delivery performance.
* Machine utilization and OEE.
* Reduction in rejection and scrap rates.
* Reduction in machine downtime.
* Improvement in productivity and cycle time.
* Manpower efficiency.
* Production cost control.
* Customer quality and delivery performance.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on and result-oriented Production Manager with the capability to independently take charge of the entire manufacturing unit.

The candidate must be capable of managing production from planning to final dispatch, leading the production team, optimizing machine utilization, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring timely delivery while controlling operational costs.

The role requires complete ownership and accountability for the overall production and operational performance of the manufacturing unit.

Job Type: Permanent

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

description:
**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

Zamorins Solutions is a growing software company founded in 2014 in Des Moines, Iowa, with a strong delivery center in Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala. We began as a web development firm and have expanded into mobile development, business analysis, digital marketing, and our own SaaS products serving clients across North America and beyond. day-to-day operations for
our Kochi office, and HR management for our team.

**:**

  monitor daily attendance, punctuality, leave, and work-from-office compliance; maintain accurate records and share regular attendance reports with leadership.
* **HR management:**

  own the full employee lifecycle: workforce planning, recruitment, interviews, onboarding, and exit processes.
* **HR policies and compliance:**

  create, update, and enforce HR policies, the employee handbook, and leave rules; ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, PF, ESI, and gratuity requirements.
* **Performance and payroll:**

  run goal setting, appraisals, and performance improvement plans; maintain employee records and prepare accurate monthly payroll inputs.
* **Employee relations:**

  handle employee concerns and grievances fairly and promptly; drive engagement, training, and retention initiatives.
* **Security and compliance:**

  enforce data security, access control, and backup policies; support risk management and compliance practices across systems and client data.
* **Team leadership:**

  lead, mentor, and motivate developers and technical staff; build a culture of ownership, learning, and continuous improvement.
* **Reporting and metrics:**

  track performance KPIs for systems, projects, and people; prepare clear weekly reports for the CEO.



**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven experience in a senior technology, IT operations, or engineering leadership role, preferably in a software or digital services company.
* Strong, hands-on database expertise: SQL, schema design, performance tuning, and administration of production databases.
* Practical AI experience: has built or shipped AI-powered features or automations using LLM APIs, RAG, vector databases, or machine learning tools.
* Solid knowledge of IT service management, cloud infrastructure, and modern development practices (Git, CI/CD, APIs).
* Strong HR management experience: hiring, onboarding, attendance and leave management, performance appraisals, payroll coordination, and employee relations.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory requirements (PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops and Establishments Act).
* Data Science skills: data analysis, Python or R, data visualization, and applying machine learning to business problems.
* Strong project management and analytical skills; able to read data, diagnose issues, and make sound decisions quickly.
* Familiarity with security, compliance, and risk management practices in IT environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to work clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and international teams. Fluency in Malayalam is preferred.
* PMP, ITIL, cloud, or AI certifications are a plus.
* **A positive, growth-oriented mindset:**

  you thrive in a fast-moving environment, bring solutions rather than excuses, and take ownership as if the business were your own.



**WHY JOIN ZAMORINS**

* Work on real SaaS products and client solutions used across North America.
* Lead AI adoption in a company that is actively investing in it.
* Direct partnership with the CEO and a clear path to grow with the business.
* A collaborative environment focused on continuous learning and innovation.

title: Manager- MEP
description:
Being the go-to MEP/CIVIL person
  
  
Are you considered to be the go-to person for all MEP/CIVIL matters? That’s what you’ll be in this role. You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients’ MEP/CIVIL requirements. The design manager in MEP/CIVIL will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP/CIVIL-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP/CIVIL-related installation, site inspection and contractor management.
  
  
Making visions come true
  
  
You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there.
  
  
While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project.
  
  
Building strong teams and business reputation
  
  
One of your priorities will be to produce high-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities.
  
  
Keeping risks at bay
  
  
How do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP/CIVIL field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health & safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
An MEP/CIVIL pro
  
  
You have a degree in MEP/CIVIL engineering-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.
  
  
Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP/CIVIL-related management—including the development of MEP/CIVIL project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk.
  
  
A business savvy leader who can walk the talk
  
  
You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements.
  
  
You’ll back up your business know-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders.
  
  
A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills
  
  
Are you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results-oriented leader with good problem-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!

title: GDS Microsoft Partner Program Specialist - Assistant Director
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Title: GDS Microsoft Partner Program Specialist**
**The opportunity**
The Microsoft Partner Program Specialist will support the governance, operational management, value realization and continuous improvement of EY’s Microsoft alliance partner program ecosystem from Argentina. Hands-on Microsoft Partner Center knowledge is the defining capability for this role and will be the primary criterion used to screen, interview and evaluate candidates. The role will work closely with Microsoft Alliance Leadership, Operations, Finance, Go-to-Market (GTM), Service Lines, Business Development and Microsoft-facing stakeholders to translate partner program priorities into structured processes, accurate reporting, actionable insights and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
This role is focused on strengthening how EY manages and optimizes Microsoft partner program activities, including benefits, incentives, eligibility, utilization, compliance, documentation and governance. The individual will help establish operating rhythms, maintain program trackers, support decision forums, monitor key performance indicators and provide portfolio-level visibility that improves transparency, accountability and leadership decision-making.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a dependable connector across alliance, finance, operations and business stakeholders, ensuring partner program activities are executed consistently and aligned to broader Microsoft alliance objectives. The role will support process standardization, issue tracking, stakeholder follow-through and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance program effectiveness and the overall stakeholder experience.
  
  
Leveraging automation, analytics and AI-enabled productivity tools, the role will help modernize partner program management by improving reporting quality, increasing operational efficiency, strengthening benefit realization and generating practical insights that support planning, governance and business growth. Through disciplined execution and strong attention to detail, the role will contribute to maximizing the value of EY’s Microsoft partnership.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Partner Program Management function for the Microsoft Alliance by coordinating program benefits, incentives, eligibility, investments, marketplace/co-sell priorities and related alliance growth activities.
* Maintain operating models, governance routines, KPI trackers, executive review inputs, escalation logs and control mechanisms for Microsoft partner programs.
* Own and administer Microsoft Partner Center as the role’s primary operational responsibility, including account and organization profiles, program enrollments, agreements, user access and role-based permissions, location and tenant associations, incentives and benefits workspaces, referrals/co-sell, marketplace-related configurations, access troubleshooting and supporting audit trails, in coordination with authorized administrators and control owners.
* Translate Microsoft alliance priorities into structured execution plans, program trackers, eligibility logs, utilization summaries, partner updates, portfolio views and compliance-ready documentation.
* Monitor program performance across funding utilization, benefits realization, investment governance, incentive tracking, specialization readiness, risk indicators and leadership reporting.
* Prepare executive-ready dashboards, business updates, decision materials, portfolio summaries and governance inputs that support leadership reviews and prioritization discussions.
* Coordinate with stakeholders across EY Microsoft Alliance, Finance, Operations, GTM, Service Lines, Business Development, Markets and Microsoft-facing teams to align priorities and drive timely follow-through.
* Support governance forums, working sessions and leadership reviews by maintaining decision logs, action trackers, RAID logs, issue registers and follow-up mechanisms.
* Identify dependencies, policy constraints, partner requirements, execution risks and commercial implications; recommend practical mitigation steps and escalate issues where required.
* Support revenue-enabling motions by improving program-backed enablement, partner value realization, investment return, pipeline visibility and alliance operating effectiveness.
* Standardize repeatable processes across regions and teams while adapting execution support to local stakeholder needs and global Microsoft Alliance requirements.
* Partner with reporting and analytics teams to develop Power BI dashboards, structured scorecards, trend analysis and actionable insights for leadership reviews.
* Use Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, workflow automation and AI-enabled productivity tools responsibly to streamline reporting, summarize updates, identify risks and improve decision quality.
* Ensure program documentation, controls and reporting outputs align with EY policies, Microsoft program requirements, audit expectations, data privacy standards and quality guidelines.
* Contribute to team capability by creating reusable templates, improving documentation, sharing best practices and promoting insight-led continuous improvement.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong experience in alliance operations, partner programs, ecosystem support, strategic PMO, commercial operations, business reporting, transformation support or governance operations.
* Good understanding of Microsoft partner ecosystem themes, including incentives, Solution Partner designations, specializations, marketplace, co-sell, cloud, Data and AI, security, business applications and program investment frameworks.
* Microsoft Partner Center administration is the mandatory core requirement and primary evaluation criterion for this role. Candidates must demonstrate current, hands-on capability across account settings, organization and legal profiles, program enrollment and agreement status, Microsoft Entra ID-linked user provisioning, role-based permissions and workspace access, identifiers and tenant/location associations, incentives and benefits, referrals/co-sell, marketplace workflows, activity logs, compliance controls and access troubleshooting. Candidates without demonstrable hands-on Microsoft Partner Center experience should not progress beyond initial screening.
* Ability to support operating models, KPI frameworks, governance routines, executive reporting packs, portfolio views and decision materials for senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and follow-through skills in a matrixed, cross-geo environment.
* Analytical and financial acumen, with comfort interpreting utilization, investment, program performance, pipeline influence and business impact data.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, high-impact requests and sensitive business information with maturity, accuracy and ownership.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint and Power BI; familiarity with Power Platform, Fabric and reporting automation is preferred.
* Ability to apply AI-enabled tools responsibly for status reporting, executive summaries, insight generation, automation, content acceleration and productivity improvement while following EY guidelines.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation discipline, process mindset and commitment to continuous improvement.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Mandatory gateway requirement: demonstrable, hands-on Microsoft Partner Center administration experience in a complex partner organization. This capability is non-negotiable and will carry the highest weighting in candidate shortlisting, technical assessment and final selection.
* University graduate or postgraduate qualification; specialization in Business Administration, Finance, Technology, Engineering, Economics, Management or a related field would be preferred.
* 12+ years of experience in alliance operations, partner operations, PMO, program governance, commercial operations, reporting, business transformation or ecosystem support.
* Prior experience supporting Microsoft, technology alliances, partner programs, professional services organizations or global matrix environments would be preferred.
* Evidence of Microsoft Partner Center proficiency through specific examples of maintaining account and program configurations, coordinating user access and role assignments, monitoring enrollments and agreements, resolving access or configuration issues, and supporting incentives, benefits, referrals/co-sell, marketplace and compliance activities. Evaluation should prioritize the candidate’s depth of ownership, recency of experience, scale and complexity of the environment, problem-solving approach and understanding of controls.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional workstreams, maintaining governance routines, managing trackers and preparing stakeholder-ready reporting outputs.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Microsoft credentials or training relevant to Partner Center, Cloud Partner Program operations, Security, Azure, Modern Work or Business Applications; Project/Program Management, Agile, Strategy, Portfolio Management, Business Analysis or Business Transformation certification would be an additional advantage.
* Hands-on exposure to Microsoft partner programs, marketplace/co-sell motions, investments, incentives, benefits realization, specialization readiness or partner-led governance models.
* Experience creating executive-ready dashboards, program scorecards, leadership review packs, portfolio summaries and decision support materials.
* Exposure to automation, workflow optimization, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot or AI-enabled productivity tools in an enterprise environment.

**Technologies and Tools**

* Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools, including Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Word and PowerPoint, for stakeholder coordination, documentation and executive-ready communication.
* Microsoft Excel and Power BI for trackers, budget monitoring, KPI reporting, dashboarding, performance analysis and leadership updates.
* Microsoft Planner, Project, Lists or equivalent work management tools for milestone tracking, action logs, RAID management, approval workflows and dependency tracking.
* Microsoft Partner Center administration across account settings, organization and legal profiles, program enrollments, agreements, user management, Microsoft Entra ID-linked role and workspace permissions, identifiers, tenants and locations, incentives and benefits, referrals/co-sell, marketplace and AppSource, activity logs, access troubleshooting and compliance evidence.
* Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, workflow automation and collaboration tools to improve program operations, data capture, feedback collection and reporting efficiency.
* Microsoft Copilot or other EY-approved AI-enabled tools for research, meeting summarization, stakeholder updates, content drafting, insight generation and productivity improvement, in line with EY guidelines.
* Location: India – Kochi, Trivandrum or Bengaluru preferred
* Working Hours: Aligned to Americas and Global Microsoft Alliance stakeholder coverage, especially for US ET or CT work timings; flexibility may be required for global leadership forums and cross-time-zone collaboration.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
**JD: Project Manager - Petrochemical Construction (Kochi, Kerala)**

***EPC Company (Petrochemical Laboratory Infrastructure Project)***

**Parameter Overview:**

* **Position:**

  Resident Construction Manager (RCM) / Project Manager
* **Project Site Location:**
  Refinery campus, Ernakulam District,
  **Kochi, Kerala**
* **Industry Experience:**

  Projects in Petrochemical, Chemical, Oil & Gas, Pharma, or Industrial
* **Discipline:**
  B.E. / B.Tech (Civil/Mechanical/Architecture)
* **Reporting To:**

  Project Director
* **Experience:**
  15+ years (minimum), including the last 5-6 years as PM/RMC
* **Employment Type:**

  Full-Time Employee (FTE)
* **Deployment & Schedule:**
  Onsite, 6 days/week
* **Joining:**

  Immediate need
* **Notice Period:**
  30 days preferred (maximum 45 days)
* **Compensation & Benefits:**



  ₹20 - 25 LPA + Benefits

**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

GoodHiresOnly is recruiting on behalf of our client, a growing Turnkey Engineering Laboratory Solutions (TELS) company. The organisation delivers end-to-end laboratory facilities, from consulting, design and engineering through build, commissioning and facility management, for pharmaceutical, energy, petrochemical, research and industrial customers. It operates as a dedicated business division with its own P&L and a specialised team, backed by an established parent group with a strong track record in laboratory infrastructure.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

The
**Resident Construction Manager**
will be deployed on site to lead day-to-day execution and end-to-end turnkey delivery of a new Polypropylene (PP) Application Laboratory inside a large, operating petrochemical refinery campus (600+ acres). The laboratory is an extension of an existing facility and will test and certify samples from a new PP plant, for a marquee public-sector energy major.

You will own the project at site, from mobilisation through civil and MEP works, laboratory furniture, fume hoods, exhaust, gas distribution, electrical and ELV systems, and instrument installation, testing, commissioning, training and handover. You will lead a team of 5-6 discipline leads and coordinate about 10 specialist sub-contractors, and you will report formally to the Project Management Consultant (PMC) appointed by the end customer. Because the refinery runs 24x7x365, safety, statutory compliance and permit protocols are paramount. The construction period is about 14-15 months, within an overall engagement of 18-24 months.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Site Leadership & Accountability:**
  Lead and own day-to-day site activities and act as the single point of accountability for all project deliverables from mobilisation to handover.
* **Turnkey Execution:**
  Drive execution across civil, architecture, interiors, MEP, lab furniture, fume hoods, exhaust systems, gas distribution system (GDS), electrical (transformer, panels, UPS, batteries), ELV (access control, CCTV) and analytical instruments through commissioning, training and sign-off.
* **Safety & Statutory Compliance:**
  Enforce strict adherence to refinery safety rules, permit-to-work systems, statutory requirements and quality standards while working inside a live, operating plant.
* **PMC Interface & Reporting:**
  Serve as the primary site interface with the PMC. Submit all formal correspondence, progress reports, extension-of-time requests, invoices, delay matrices and incident reports through accurate project documentation.
* **Integrity in Progress Reporting:**
  Report actual progress factually and consistently across every forum. Records must withstand review by the PMC and the end customer, and transparency is non-negotiable.
* **Planning & Schedule Control:**
  Validate the planner's baseline schedule, lead/lag logic and recovery plans (MS Project) before submission. Proactively identify bottlenecks, delays and interface gaps, and drive recovery plans.
* **Sub-contractor Management:**
  Manage operational delivery of about 10 discipline sub-contractors and vendors, chair progress reviews and resolve site-level issues, with commercial support from headquarters.
* **Team Leadership:**
  Lead and mentor the Civil, Mechanical, Quality and Safety leads and the supporting site engineers, supervisors, document controller and safety officer.
* **Headquarters Coordination:**
  Work closely with the Project Director and the head office team, who visit site regularly, and provide timely MIS and status updates.
* **Project Governance:**
  Maintain complete documentation, risk registers, action trackers and weekly reports within agreed timelines.

**PROJECT ENVIRONMENT**

* **Live Refinery Campus:**
  Execution inside a large, continuously operating petrochemical refinery with strict safety protocols and statutory controls.
* **Turnkey Laboratory Scope:**
  A high-precision laboratory fit-out with integrated civil, MEP, gas, electrical, ELV and instrumentation packages.
* **Multi-Party Matrix:**
  Coordination across the end customer, the PMC, internal discipline leads, about 10 specialist sub-contractors and instrument vendors.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* **Professional Experience:**
  15+ years in construction or project management, including the last 5-6 years as a Project Manager. Experience is verifiable through degree certificates and experience/relieving letters.
* **Project Scale:**
  Has managed projects of ₹50-60 Crore or more.
* **Industry Exposure:**
  Hands-on project delivery inside Petrochemical, Chemical, Oil & Gas, Pharma or Fertilizer plants, ideally in live-plant conditions. General factory, commercial office or civil infrastructure experience alone will not be sufficient.
* **Planning Skills:**
  Strong working knowledge of MS Project to validate baselines and delay analysis. Primavera P6 is a plus.
* **Leadership:**
  Proven record of leading multi-disciplinary site teams and sub-contractors, with ownership and willingness to extend hours when site conditions demand it.
* **Communication & Contract Management:**
  Strong documentation, reporting and formal correspondence skills, with an understanding of contractual processes.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Education:**
  B.E. / B.Tech in Civil or Mechanical Engineering. Architecture qualification will also be considered.
* **Certifications:**
  PMP preferred. Safety certifications (NEBOSH / IOSH) are not mandatory.
* **Domain & Location:**
  Prior exposure to refinery campus projects or laboratory/MEP turnkey projects. Fluency in Malayalam and familiarity with Kerala are an added advantage. Candidates from Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Puducherry and neighbouring regions are welcome.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)**

* **Project Delivery:**
  Delivery in line with agreed schedule, scope, budget and quality benchmarks.
* **Safety:**
  Zero Lost Time Injuries (LTI) and full compliance with refinery safety and permit systems.
* **Reporting Integrity:**
  Accurate, consistent, on-time progress reports and documentation, with zero variance between reported and actual progress.
* **Stakeholder Satisfaction:**
  Strong PMC and customer satisfaction through transparent communication and prompt issue resolution.
* **Team Effectiveness:**
  Strong team morale, discipline and low attrition on site.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PACKAGE**

**A) Salary & Incentive Structure**

* **Base Salary:**
  ₹20 - 25 LPA (depending on experience and capability)
* **Project Bonus:**
  Milestone-based, performance-linked project bonus.
* **ESOP:**
  Eligibility for ESOPs as per company policy.

**B) Insurance & Protection**

* **Group Medical Insurance:**
  ₹4.0 Lakhs family floater coverage (Self, Spouse, Children, Parents).
* **Term Life Insurance:**
  Coverage equivalent to 5x CTC.
* **Accidental Insurance:**
  Comprehensive personal accident cover.
* **Statutory Benefits:**
  PF and Gratuity as per statutory standards.

**C) Deployment & Career Growth**

* **Onsite Support:**
  Accommodation (one-bedroom) and transport for single-status outstation candidates. Candidates relocating with family are not provided accommodation. Laptop and group mobile with internet connectivity provided for site use.
* **Interview Travel:**
  Travel for the in-person final round is reimbursed by the company.
* **Career Growth:**
  Full ownership of a marquee refinery-campus project. High performers may be considered for future projects within the group.

**SELECTION PROCESS**

* **Round 1:**
  Virtual interview.
* **Round 2:**
  In-person final round at the corporate office in Bengaluru.
* **Verification:**
  Credentials and experience are validated against documentary evidence before deployment.

**CONFIDENTIALITY & APPLICATION NOTE**

This job description outlines the general scope and key expectations of the position and is not an exhaustive list of all duties. Candidates should be comfortable with 6-day/week onsite deployment inside a live refinery campus. For additional information or confidential inquiries, please contact:
**Faisal Siddiqui, Founder, GoodHiresOnly | Email: faisal@goodhiresonly.com**

title: IT & CRM OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:

**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 2–3 Years  
**Qualification:** Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in IT, Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related field.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an experienced and result-oriented IT & CRM Operations Manager to oversee CRM software operations, manage technical support activities, and ensure the smooth functioning of the company's IT infrastructure and digital systems.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, hands-on experience in CRM management, and the ability to independently handle technical issues related to laptops, Android devices, software applications, and digital platforms.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONS

* Oversee daily CRM software operations, data management, and system updates.
* Manage CRM configurations, user access, and operational troubleshooting.
* Supervise technical support activities related to laptops, desktops, and Android devices.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
* Ensure proper installation, configuration, and maintenance of software applications.
* Monitor system performance and ensure smooth IT operations.

* Opportunity to lead and manage IT & CRM operations.
* Career advancement opportunities.
* Exposure to digital systems and technology management.

Interested and qualified candidates are requested to submit their updated resumes through Indeed.

**Take ownership of our IT and CRM operations and grow with our organization!**

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Vyttila, Kochi, Kerala

title: Service Optimization Specialist
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* We are seeking a dynamic and future-ready Invoice & Cost Control professional to lead financial governance, transport cost control, analytics, and digital transformation activities within Service Operations & Technology (SO&T).
* This role goes beyond traditional invoice processing—it combines financial control, data analytics, digitalization, process optimization and cost intelligence to enable accurate, efficient, compliant, and data-driven transport operations.
* As a key member of the Service Operations & Technology (SO&T) team, you will play a critical role in end-to-end logistics invoice validation, payment governance, transport cost control, GST compliance, financial reporting, supplier reconciliation, and analytics. You will leverage digital tools and data-driven insights to identify cost leakage, improve process performance, strengthen controls, and support sustainable business growth.

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Financial Control & Governance**

* Ensure compliance with Internal Control (IC) processes for Logistics Service Provider (LSP) invoice processing and payment.
* Ensure LSPs submit invoices on time, accurately, and in compliance with statutory and tax requirements.
* Validate invoices using the 3-Way Matching Principle and ensure appropriate financial controls are maintained.
* Ensure all mandatory supporting documents are uploaded and maintained in SAP before invoice processing.
* Record, monitor, analyze, and resolve invoice disputes by coordinating timely escalations with LSPs and relevant stakeholders.
* Reconcile outstanding supplier statements of accounts within agreed timelines and obtain No Due Certificates (NDC) from LSPs.
* Ensure compliance with GST regulations through GST reconciliation, exception analysis, and timely resolution of discrepancies.

**Cost Management & Business Performance**

* Collaborate with Transport Controllers and Business Control teams to ensure accurate monthly provisions, accruals, freight costs, and transport volumes.
* Analyze transportation costs, premium freight, rush shipments, accessorial charges, and other cost deviations to identify cost leakage and improvement opportunities.
* Perform variance analysis, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, and cost-driver analysis to support business decision-making.

**Data Analytics & Digital Transformation**

* Act as a data-driven finance and cost-control partner, using analytical methods to identify trends, anomalies, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and management reports using digital reporting platforms.
* Combine financial, invoice, transport, supplier, and operational data to provide end-to-end cost and performance insights.
* Participate in digital transformation projects from process assessment and requirements definition through implementation, testing, adoption, and benefits realization.

**Strategic Projects & Cost Improvement**
The role will take ownership of strategic and time-bound projects based on business priorities, with a strong focus on cost optimization, analytics, and financial improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead freight cost analysis and benchmarking across Group companies and operating companies to identify cost drivers, performance gaps, and opportunities for cost optimization
* Analyze dealer pricing versus actual/average transportation costs to identify price variances, under-recovery, negative margins, and potential financial losses, and recommend actions to improve cost recovery and avoid recurring losses.
* Group Company Price Analysis for Common Parts, Analyze pricing of common parts across Group Companies to identify significant price variations and cost drivers.
* Track project progress, financial impact, and benefits realization, ensuring agreed actions are implemented and improvements are sustained.

**Critical Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of financial controls, invoice validation, accounting processes, logistics operations, and transport cost management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to interpret large and complex datasets.
* Ability to perform variance analysis, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, forecasting, and cost-driver analysis.
* Strong understanding of data visualization, KPI management, and management reporting.
* Digital mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for automation, AI, analytics, and process digitalization.
* Strong knowledge of GST compliance, statutory requirements, monthly closing, accruals, and audit support.
* Ability to translate data and analytical outputs into business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Ability to lead and influence digital and process transformation initiatives in a changing environment.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to balance speed, accuracy, compliance, and business value.

**Digital & Data Skills**

* ERP systems
* Power BI/Microsoft 365
* Data visualization and dashboard development
* Data extraction, transformation, and analysis
* Automated reporting and workflow solutions
* Understanding of RPA and intelligent automation
* Exposure to process mining and digital process optimization
* Basic understanding of data governance and data quality principles

**Qualifications**
University degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or Business Management.
  
  

* 3- 5 years of relevant experience in finance operations, logistics finance, transport accounting, invoice processing, or shared services.
* Experience with ERP systems such as SAP (Finance/Logistics modules)
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (especially Excel), Power BI, QlikView/Qlik Sense, and other data visualization tools.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Trucks Technology & Industrial Division**
hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
  
  
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Treasury Analyst
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

**What You Can Expect**
-----------------------

**Job Summary**

Provide Treasury support to Global Treasury and EMEA controllers across cash flow forecasting, daily cash positioning, liquidity reporting, bank account administration, foreign exchange exposure analysis, intercompany netting, and treasury operations. Use SAP, Power BI, and related data tools to deliver accurate reporting, investigate variances, and improve processes. Collaborate with EMEA stakeholders and work hours aligned to EMEA business hours.

**Work Mode:** 2 WFH,3 days WFO  
**Location:** Bangalore

**How You'll Create Impact**
----------------------------

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Cash flow forecasting: collect information from EMEA entities, maintain forecasts in the TIP tool, reconcile forecast cash flows to bank account balances and SAP data where applicable, investigate variances, and prepare reporting for Global Treasury.
* Support EMEA bank account administration, including account opening and closure, signatory and access updates, KYC documentation, and maintenance of appropriate segregation of duties and supporting records.
* Prepare and validate daily cash position and liquidity reports; investigate discrepancies, follow up on exceptions, and escalate material items to Treasury Manager.
* Monitor EMEA liquidity and support daily cash disposition in accordance with Treasury instructions and established controls.
* Coordinate responses to bank KYC requests for EMEA entities and track timely completion of bank account signatory and access updates.
* Collect and validate monthly foreign exchange exposure data and forecasts for EMEA entities operating in multiple currencies; support hedging analysis and review actual foreign exchange results against forecast.
* Support alignment on intercompany financing strategy for EMEA entities
* Provide operational support for FX and related Treasury transactions, including transaction processing, settlement follow-up, documentation, and control checks in accordance with assigned responsibilities.
* Review monthly intercompany netting positions for EMEA entities and contribute to regional and global liquidity analysis.
* Support issuance, renewal tracking, and reporting of bank guarantees.
* Participate in Treasury projects to standardize, automate, and improve processes; develop and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards, use SAP, Excel, and Power Query to improve data quality and reporting. Exposure to Snowflake and data-querying tools is an advantage

This job description is not exhaustive; responsibilities may change and may include other duties consistent with the role.

**What Makes You Stand Out**
----------------------------

**Expected Areas of Competence (i.e., knowledge, skills and abilities)**

description:
**Job Description**

n

**Experience:**

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in income tax, audit, financial statement analysis, financial due diligence, credit appraisal, loan underwriting, banking or assessment of individual/business financial capacity.
* Experience in a Chartered Accountant or tax consultancy firm will be preferred.

**Educational Qualification:**

* CA Inter / Semi-qualified Chartered Accountant.
* Qualified CAs may also be considered.
* Candidates with M. Com, B. Com or MBA (Finance) may be considered if they have demonstrated practical experience in income-tax analysis, financial statement review, financial due diligence, credit appraisal or assessment of financial capacity.

**Soft Skills:**

* Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical ability.
* Sound professional judgement, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* High standards of integrity and confidentiality.
* Strong questioning, interviewing and investigative skills.
* Ability to communicate with parents/guardians in a professional, respectful and empathetic manner.
* Ability to remain objective while dealing with emotionally sensitive cases.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Effective time management, critical thinking, collaboration and teamwork.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong working knowledge of ITRs, tax computations, AIS, Form 26AS, Form 16 and salary-related documents.
* Ability to analyse individual, self-employed and business income.
* Ability to understand and analyse Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss Accounts, turnover, profitability, cash flows, assets and liabilities.
* Working knowledge of proprietorships, partnerships and common business structures.
* Understanding of presumptive taxation and its implications while assessing financial capacity.
* Ability to reconcile and cross-verify information across tax records, bank statements and financial statements.
* Ability to distinguish between taxable income, accounting profit and actual cash availability.
* Advanced Excel and strong data analysis skills; proficiency in MS Office and relevant reporting/data visualization tools

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

1. Financial Assistance Assessment and Case Evaluation

* Review Financial Assistance applications and supporting documents to assess the financial background and paying capacity of the applicant's family.
* Conduct detailed and professional interactions with parents/guardians to understand the family's financial circumstances and obtain clarification, wherever required.
* Examine and analyse ITRs, tax computations, AIS, Form 26AS, Form 16, salary records, bank statements, Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss Accounts, capital accounts and other relevant financial records.
* Assess cases relating to salaried individuals, self-employed professionals, proprietorships, partnership firms, businesses and other sources of family income.
* Analyse cases involving presumptive taxation and understand the limitations of relying solely on reported taxable income for assessing actual financial capacity.
* Cross-verify information across documents to identify inconsistencies, gaps or areas requiring further clarification.
* Evaluate actual ability to pay considering income, business performance, assets, liabilities, financial obligations and other relevant factors.
* Prepare a well-reasoned initial assessment and recommendation for the Financial Assistance Committee.

2. Financial Analysis and Due Diligence

* Perform detailed financial analysis of complex and high-value financial assistance cases.
* Analyse the relationship between declared income, turnover, profitability, cash flows, assets, liabilities and the family's overall financial position.
* Review business financial statements to understand the underlying financial capacity of business-owning parents/guardians.
* Distinguish between accounting profit, taxable income and actual cash availability.
* Analyse capital withdrawals, loans, debt servicing obligations and working capital requirements.
* Maintain appropriate documentation supporting the assessment and recommendation made in each case.

3. Financial Assistance Process Management

* Review applications and supporting documents within defined timelines.
* Conduct interviews with applicants and parents/guardians in a professional and sensitive manner.
* Compile findings and present initial recommendations to the Financial Assistance Committee.
* Manage cases with conditional offers, additional assistance requests and requests from previous batches.
* Ensure accurate data capture in round-wise sheets, schedule meetings and support case allocation.
* Communicate final financial assistance decisions through the designated process after necessary approvals and fee enablement.
* Maintain complete and confidential records of applications, financial documents, assessments and decisions.

4. Scholarships

* Work closely with the Scholarship Committee to review, recommend and process applications for Merit and Merit-cum-Means Scholarships.
* Assess the financial eligibility of applicants under need-based or merit-cum-means scholarship categories.
* Review supporting financial documents and ensure that recommendations are supported by appropriate analysis.
* Maintain accurate scholarship-related data and documentation.

5. Analysis, Modelling and Reporting

* Conduct comparative analysis of current and previous year Financial Assistance data.
* Analyse trends relating to applications, approvals, average assistance, family income profiles and budget utilization.
* Prepare timely reports, dashboards and forecasts to support alignment with approved budgets.
* Develop and improve financial assessment models and frameworks.
* Develop objective methods and tools for evaluating financial need while recognizing the need for professional judgement in individual cases.

6. Providing Professional Service to the Organization

* Participate actively in team meetings, contribute to problem-solving and process improvement.
* Build and sustain strong working relationships with key stakeholders.
* Communicate information, share knowledge and provide insights to the team.
* Ensure reports and presentations are accurate, relevant and easy to understand.
* Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

7. Better Appreciation of Financial Assistance Processes and Decision Making

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of financial assistance principles and financial concepts relevant to determining aid.
* Combine technical financial analysis with professional judgement and sensitivity while dealing with students and parents.
* Ensure that financial assessments are fair, objective, evidence-based and based on a holistic review rather than reliance on a single document or reported taxable income.
* Continuously improve methods and tools used to assess financial need and paying capacity.

The roles and responsibilities outlined above are not meant to be an exhaustive list of tasks.

The need for flexibility is required, and the job holder is expected to carry out any other related duties that are within the employee’s skills and abilities whenever reasonably instructed.

Interested candidates please mail your CV to careers@krea.edu.in

The subject line for the email should be
Candidate Name \_Application for Senior Executive – Financial Assistance

Please fill the application form attached herewith (mandatory) – Click here for the application.

Krea University is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from individuals of all backgrounds. Remuneration will be competitive with Indian nonprofit pay scales and will depend upon the candidate’s experience levels and the overall organization’s salary structure.

**Note: Only Shortlisted candidates will be contacted**

description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences.
