This role supports the Revenue Analytics and Operations team in protecting billing accuracy, revenue integrity, and the customer experience. The role leads the investigation and resolution of complex customer account, order, and billing-related issues; performs advanced analysis to identify systemic trends, root causes, and business impacts; and ensures corrective actions align with established company policies and controls. Responsibilities also include ensuring effective audit documentation, identifying opportunities for efficiency, and developing recommendations to strengthen policies, processes, procedures, reporting, and controls. Works independently on complex assignments and serves as a key contributor and subject-matter resource in a critical operating environment.

* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Strong SQL Server knowledge or comparable experience using data-query tools to investigate issues and support advanced analysis.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Knowledge of CSG and/or Amdocs, or related experience working with customer billing systems.
* Strong knowledge of billing cycles, account adjustments, charge structures, billing discrepancies, and related operational processes.

**Employees at All Levels Are Expected To**

title: Principal Specialist, Project Controls
description:
**Title:**
Principal Specialist, Project Controls
  
  
**Job Title**
Principal Specialist Project Control
  
  
**Division and/or Project Hook**
KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) provides holistic and value-added solutions across the entire asset life cycle. These include world-class licensed process technologies, differentiated advisory services, deep technical domain expertise, energy transition solutions, high-end design capabilities, and smart solutions to optimize planned and operating assets.
  
  
**Summary Section**
The Project Controls Engineer is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining integrated project control systems to ensure effective planning, scheduling, cost management, progress monitoring, and performance reporting throughout the project lifecycle. The role supports the successful delivery of projects by providing accurate forecasting, timely analysis, and decision-support information to project management.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Develop, implement, and maintain project planning, scheduling, and cost control procedures in accordance with project and organizational requirements.
* Prepare, develop, and maintain integrated project schedules using appropriate planning tools, ensuring alignment with project scope, milestones, and contractual requirements.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedules and budgets, identify variances, analyze trends, and recommend corrective actions to achieve project objectives.
* Establish and maintain project cost control systems, including budgeting, cost forecasting, commitment tracking, earned value analysis, and cost reporting.
* Prepare and update project baseline schedules, recovery schedules, and look-ahead plans to support project execution and management decision-making.
* Liaise with engineering, procurement, construction, planning, estimating, contracts, finance, and accounting functions to ensure accurate integration of schedule and cost information.
* Measure project performance through key performance indicators (KPIs), productivity analysis, earned value management (EVM), and schedule performance metrics.
* Prepare periodic progress reports, cost reports, schedule updates, cash flow forecasts, management dashboards, and master plan roll-ups for project stakeholders.
* Evaluate the impact of scope changes, variations, delays, and risks on project schedule and cost, and provide recommendations for mitigation and recovery.
* Provide commercial input and technical reviews for tenders, proposals, budgets, and project execution strategies.
* Support project risk management by identifying schedule and cost risks, conducting quantitative and qualitative analyses, and assisting in the development of mitigation plans.
* Ensure project control information systems, reporting procedures, document control interfaces, and data integrity comply with project-specific and corporate requirements.
* Participate in project reviews, management meetings, and performance assessments by providing timely and accurate planning and cost control information.

Chennai, initially remote

Full-time, dedicated position

Group Financial Controller

**We are building an internal finance team to support a growing international portfolio. This position owns the preparation of reliable entity accounts and the delivery of assigned tax and statutory compliance work, under the Group Financial Controller’s review.**

* Prepare monthly accounts for an allocated portfolio of companies.

* Strong reconciliation skills and experience managing several companies simultaneously.
* Practical experience with Xero or comparable software and advanced spreadsheet skills.

title: Associate Manager - SEC Reporting
description:
**Associate Manager – SEC Reporting – CFO Advisory**

As CohnReznick grows, so do our career opportunities. As one of the world’s top professional services firms, and in support of our global workforce strategy, we’re growing our operations in India! We create rewarding careers in advisory, assurance, and tax with team members who value innovation and collaboration in everything they do!

CohnReznick helps organizations optimize performance, manage risk, and maximize value through CohnReznick LLP (assurance services) and CohnReznick Advisory LLC (advisory and tax services). Together, the firm provides leaders with deep industry knowledge and relationships, solutions to address clients’ unique business goals and risks, and insight on how emerging market forces can drive opportunity. With offices worldwide, the firm serves organizations around the world as an independent member of Nexia.

We currently have an exciting career opportunity for an
**Associate**
**Manager**
to join the
**CFO**
team in our
**Advisory**
practice -
**Chennai**
office.

CohnReznick is a hybrid firm and most of our professionals are located within a commutable distance to one of our offices. This position is considered remote which means it does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a CohnReznick office location. However, as a remote employee, you may be required to be present at a CohnReznick office with scheduled notice for client work, team meetings, or training.

**YOUR TEAM.**

This position will support our CFO team. This role involves preparing and reviewing SEC filings including
**S-1, S-3, S-4, 8-K, 10-Q, and 10-K**
and supporting
**financial statement uplift and presentation**
under US GAAP and SEC requirements.

**WHY COHNREZNICK?**

At CohnReznick, we’re united by a common mission to create opportunity, value, and trust for our clients, our people, and our communities. Whether it’s working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your “why” at the firm.

We believe it’s important to balance work with everyday life – and make time for enjoyment and fun. We invest in a robust Total Rewards package that includes everything from generous PTO, a flexible work environment, expanded parental leave, extensive learning & development, and even paid time off for employees to volunteer.

**YOUR ROLE.**

***Responsibilities include but not limited to:***

* Prepare and review SEC filings including
  **S-1, S-3, S-4, 8-K, 10-Q, and 10-K**
* Support
  **financial statement uplift and presentation**
  under US GAAP and SEC requirements
* Assist clients with
  **Business Combinations (ASC 805)**
  ,
  **Financial Instruments (ASC 480/815)**
  ,
  **Share based payments (ASC 718)**
  ,
  **Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)**
  ,
  **Leases (ASC 842)**
  and related reporting requirements
* Support IPO readiness and public company reporting initiatives
* Prepare and review financial statements, disclosures, and footnotes
* Collaborate with client finance teams, auditors, and legal stakeholders to ensure filing compliance

**YOUR EXPERIENCE.**

***The successful candidate will have:***

* 5+ years of experience in
  **SEC Reporting, Financial Reporting, or CFO Advisory**
* **Qualifications:**
  CA/CPA (preferred), B. Com, M. Com, or MBA.
* **Preferred Experience:**
  Candidates from Public Accounting Firms (Big 4 or mid-market advisory firms) with experience in CFO Advisory, Accounting Advisory, SEC Reporting, and Technical Accounting functions.
* Strong experience with
  **SEC filings (S-1, S-3, S-4, 8-K, 10-Q, 10-K)**
* Sound knowledge of
  **US GAAP, Regulation S-X, and Financial Statement Presentation**
* Experience supporting publicly traded companies, IPOs, or SEC registrants
* Accuracy and attention to detail
* Must be able to handle multiple priorities and effectively meet critical deadlines
* Ability to interact with senior executives and management
* Ability to solve problems by gathering information, discussing options and making recommendations
* Ability to work flexible hours and travel as required, in support of the business
* Significant knowledge of accounting and finance processes and functions
* Strong understanding of financial statement preparation and analysis

In addition, please take a moment to review our
**Universal Job Standards.**

Studies have shown that we are less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. At CohnReznick, we are dedicated to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or one of our other roles.

* Integrate CRM with billing, product and CS tools via APIs and webhooks

* Proactive, solution-oriented approach to complex business challenges

title: EPM Tech Lead(One Stream)
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
  
  
**EPM TECH LEAD (ONESTREAM)**
**The Role:**
The Role EPM Tech Lead is responsible for the implementation of financial planning, reporting, consolidation, closing and other process solutions using Onestream software for the stakeholders in finance department. The candidate will lead Onestream solutions through the full cycle of an implementation including requirements, design, testing, development, testing, training, documentation, and support.
  
  
**Your Contribution:**
Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. These are the behaviors you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:
  
  

* Lead the stabilization and performance optimization of the OneStream platform, addressing system bottlenecks and improving user experience, especially for Excel-based reporting
* Drive large-scale transition of reporting and planning processes from Essbase to OneStream, ensuring data accuracy, reconciliation, and business continuity
* Work closely with Finance stakeholders (FP&A, Accounting, Regional Finance teams) to gather, define, and deliver scalable and sustainable solutions
* Evaluate standard functionality and recommend enhancements to improve financial processes and system efficiency
* Participate in all phases of software development including planning, analysis, design, development, testing, integration, documentation, and training
* Develop and optimize Cube Views, Quick Views, XF reports, business rules, and workflows
* Lead and coordinate testing efforts including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing
* Build and enhance integrations with upstream and downstream systems
* Support expansion of data models to incorporate additional dimensions as required and enable future reporting and planning capabilities
* Strengthen governance by implementing SOX-compliant controls and best practices across development and deployment processes
* Collaborate with architects, business analysts, and external partners to define and deliver solutions
* Mentor junior team members and provide technical leadership across the OneStream platform
* Support ongoing user enablement, report conversion, and adoption as part of enterprise-wide rollout

**Key Qualifications:**
For consideration, you must bring the following
**minimum**
skills and behaviors to our team:
  
  

* Minimum of 6–9 years of overall relevant experience with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience in full lifecycle OneStream implementations
* Strong experience in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise-scale EPM solutions
* Strong functional knowledge of financial planning, reporting, consolidation, and close processes
* Proven expertise in Cube Views, Quick Views, XF reporting, business rules, workflows, system security, and configurations
* Strong experience in performance tuning, troubleshooting, and optimizing reporting applications
* Experience working with business stakeholders to define and deliver requirements
* Experience in integrating OneStream with other enterprise systems using REST APIs or other methods
* Proficiency in .NET/C# and SQL for developing technical solutions
* Experience with data integration, data transformations, and reconciliation across systems
* Strong understanding of SOX and ITGC controls in financial systems
* Ability to independently manage deliverables and contribute to complex projects
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools

In addition,
**preferable**
skills and behaviors include:
  
  

* OneStream Certified Professional (OCP) certification
* Experience with reporting tools such as Tableau and OBIEE
* Familiarity with Oracle ERP and Snowflake data warehouse
* Experience in large-scale EPM transformation or system migration programs
* Exposure to performance optimization and post-go-live stabilization initiatives

**Education:**
BS/MS in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related technical field or equivalent industry expertise.

title: Vice President, WRB GRU
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business**

* (WRB GRU) Wealth Solutions and Retail Banking Global Reconciliation function across markets, products and account types
* COE (Centre of excellence) for WRB Reconciliations that enables optimal end to end delivery of financial controls leveraging on global TLM system, core TP system with specialist accounting talent

* Aspire Project for WRB – Ie., Transitioning General Ledger from PSGL to SAP S4 HANA for WRB systems

**Strategy**

* Drive the reconciliation strategy for the (WRB) Wealth Solutions and Retail Banking Global Reconciliation function across markets, products and account types
* Deliver the overall strategy for the global processes, controls and technology solutions within the function
* Drive the alignment of GRU services with the relevant operational and technology change deliverables including leveraging innovative solutions to increase quality of services
* As a control stakeholder to the underlying operations, act in a directing and influencing capacity with the stakeholders regarding the recon strategy to secure ongoing support for the business process and technology changes required to deliver high standard of reconciliation controls
* Continuously appraise internal and industry strategies and approaches to ensure best practices and innovative solutions are being utilized
* Support Product, Operations and other Value centres on a day-to-day basis in areas of process changes, improvements and new product launches
* Play an active role in developing the business requirements on system enhances and follows through till delivery of requirements.
* Lead re-engineering initiatives along with other value centres like Operations, Service and Distribution for identification of cost-saves, process improvement opportunities & customer service enhancement.

**Processes**

* Manage account reconciliation activities covering;
* Internal/ GL account (suspense and sundry) reconciliations,
* Trade/Stock and Position reconciliations,
* Credit Card, ATM, retail branch banking reconciliations
* Perform error free reconciliation as per procedures (DOI) / Reconciliation Policy using reports from various transaction processing and recon applications.
* Handle customer queries and correspondence (both internal and external) and maintain effective working relationships with all departments, country and internal stakeholders including technology teams.
* Ensure effective follow ups and escalations, both internal and external, in resolving outstanding reconciliation items, process and system issues, as per agreed SLA / reconciliation matrix, DOIs. Ability to differentiate escalations to various senior levels depending on the nature and impact of an issue/open reconciliation break with clear articulation of the requirement and attention from them is a must.
* Actively look for opportunities to standardize processes / automate / eliminate nonvalue added activities and implement them for process improvements.
* Liaise extensively with a wide set of senior stakeholders, get required support to resolve long outstanding reconciliation open items and get buy-in to implement process / system changes
* Continuously improve team productivity to the standards prescribed
* Consistent review on process cycle times and ensure effective and efficient service delivery.
* Work to reduce System Downtime in collaboration with technology teams
* Create sufficient back-ups for each process to eliminate key staff risk at any point of time.
* Lead inward migration of newer activities and ensure relevant documentations are completed within the timelines
* Manage budgeting for the unit and have detailed knowledge of the unit financials - effectively control spends and deliver on cost targets
* Ensure high engagement levels in the teams with minimal attrition.
* Provide training to teams and ensure they have thorough understanding of the underlying product, recon process and its impact before handling a new process
* Implement robust training and development plan for each staff keeping succession planning for various roles into consideration.
* Understand the end-to-end impact of any new change/enhancement initiative, train teams and ensure the change is incorporated in a seamless way with no service impact
* Closely hand hold teams and train them to perform thorough User Acceptance Tests (UAT) in consultation with tech teams and co-ordinate with them to ensure timely completion of testing and comprehensively highlight all issues
* Perform end-to-end analysis of reconciliation processes and controls and propose solutions for addressing gaps, from a reconciliation perspective.
* Perform root-cause analysis of reconciliation errors and issues with clearly articulated mitigation plans.
* Follow up on risks with both internal teams and external stakeholders for timely closure without becoming overdue and promptly update actions to risk teams ahead of target timelines
* Liaise extensively with the product and technology teams to understand the product nuances and associated regulations to recommend required reconciliation controls and processes

**People and Talent**

* SDAF approvals and Amendments for TLM Account Opening and Closure basis Country Ops approvals and confirmation.
* Ability to lead the team effectively through remote working
* Guide the team on Recon and Recon COE

**Governance**

* WRB GRU risk reporting related governance at country / regional and Group RC levels
* Periodic review of hubbed and non-hubbed WRB reconciliations for adherence to GPI (including exception management ie., dispensations from adherence to GPI)
* Continuous recon and accounting process review to assure that the controls are fit for purpose and act as mitigation against internal frauds

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* GPO WRB SnT / COO, Client Servicing & Transacting, WRB
* COO, Wealth Soln, Affluent Bnkg & Enablement
* Global Head, WM Investment Operations
* Global Head – R2R GSF Finance
* Global Head – WRB Internal Fraud
* Financial Transaction processing team leads (WRB – COB, SnT, Branches and business in particular)
* Finance operation leads
* Technology data Lead (Aspire)
* Workstream team members across TP systems (eBBS, RLS, CCMS, Card400, Marcis and other CPBB TP systems)
* Workstream team members across Programme (Data, Tools, Core Finance, Local Regulatory, Treasury) – (Aspire and SOX)
* Product Controllers and Business CFO’s
* Treasury leads
* Information Technology (Recon tool ‘TLM – Transaction Lifecycle Management‘ change management as WRB business owner and continuous improvement)

**Skills And Experience**

* Financial Accounting
* Financial Reconciliations
* Sarbanes and Oxley Act (UK SOX)

**Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant or Equivalent

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

**What We Offer**

we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

title: Associate Procurement Professional
description:
****Career Area:****
Procurement
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Role Definition:****
Processes requisitions and provides support for purchasing, supply chain, sourcing, cost, price analyses and contract/purchase order generation.
  
  
****Responsibilities:****

* Developing improvement plans to support buyers & professionals related to Response Time, Lean Targets Quality, Cost, Logistics, Development, and Management (QCLDM) to enable optimal and efficient operations.
* Performing analysis and maintenance of assigned processes that produce output excellence, builds expertise for the assign process area, and contributing to continuous improvement efforts.
* Supporting customers and customer proposal efforts with pricing information and supplier selection.
* Performing analytical and administrative tasks in support of purchasing strategic initiatives.

**Degree Requirement:**
Preferred to have a Bachelor’s Degree from Tier 1 University or college
  
  
**Skill Descriptors**
Data-driven Decision Making: Knowledge of the data-driven decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to gather and analyze data to make organizational decisions that align with strategic business objectives and goals.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Applies an assigned technique for data-driven thinking in a Decision-Making process.
* Discerns between "signal" and "noise" when interpreting data.
* Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
* Participates in the process of choosing KPIs and metrics to influence decisions.
* Utilizes the basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Names specific tools or techniques that can be used to support the analytical thinking process.
* Describes specific software applications or products used for business analytics.
* Gives examples of how analytical thinking has been used to resolve problems.
* Helps others research and learn more about business analytics tools and applications.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
* Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
* Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
* Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides input for Gantt or PERT charts or their equivalent to track project progress and status.
* Under guidance, plans and estimates simple projects.
* Assists in detailed project plans including cost, schedule, and resource requirements.
* Obtains information from stakeholders during the planning stage of a project.
* Produces standard project status reports.

Procurement: Knowledge of buying and procurement; ability to work with organizational strategies and practices, and use tools for buying goods, supplies, equipment and services needed to conduct business.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Identifies the major steps and critical paths in a purchasing cycle.
* Explains the basic concepts and responsibilities of institutional purchasing.
* Describes the major types of materials, products or services purchased by the organization.
* Identifies the basic tools used for maintaining procurement information and records.

Knowledge of a Specific Procurement System: Knowledge of the features, functions and operations of a specific procurement system; ability to develop and use tools, techniques, and practices for a specific procurement application.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Uses the system to process routine purchase orders and payments.
* Communicates with professionals to understand various procedures for a specific procurement system within the organization.
* Troubleshoots common applications or data problems for a specific procurement system.

**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
  
  
Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

title: Analyst 2 - Billing Operations & Solutions
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.  
**Job Summary**

The Message Experience Analyst manages moderately complex customer-facing billing statements and communication requirements for Residential and Small to Medium Business experiences. The role translates business needs into documented requirements, conducts research and validation, resolves routine issues, and applies established controls to support accurate, timely, compliant, and reliable billing communications. As a developing professional 2, this role works with increasing independence to manage standard and moderately complex exceptions. The role analyzes recurring issues, contributes to process and documentation improvements, and uses operational data to support accurate, timely, and compliant delivery.

**Job Description**

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Create, maintain, implement, and validate billing statement content, customer communications, and related configurations for assigned work.
* Analyze moderately complex business requirements, customer scenarios, system logic, dependencies, and implementation impacts.
* Translate business, legal, regulatory, and customer needs into clear specifications and business rules.
* Research statement content, billing data, bill codes, discount codes, configurations, and production results to determine current functionality and needed changes.
* Use SQL, Excel, and other approved tools to reconcile data, identify trends, investigate exceptions, and validate system behavior.
* Perform production validation for approved communication changes.
* Resolve defects, partner with technology and development teams, and verify that corrections meet documented requirements.

title: GBS Financial Planning & Analyst (FP&A)
description:
*We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,500 employees operate a network of 2,500 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.*

**Job Description**

The GBS Financial Planning & Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day execution of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, cost allocation and intercompany recharge activities for the GBS India center.

The role is highly operational and requires a hands-on approach to financial data preparation, cost monitoring, reporting and reconciliations. It ensures accurate and timely financial information, transparent cost allocations and reliable recharging of GBS costs to the benefiting businesses, functions and affiliates.

As GBS India is an emerging center, currently employing approximately 100 people and expected to grow to 200–300 employees over the next two years, the position will play an important role in establishing practical, efficient and scalable financial processes to support this expansion.

Working closely with the GBS Finance Manager, operational teams, HR, Accounting and Global GBS Controlling, the role contributes to financial discipline, cost transparency and continuous improvement.

1. **Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting**
   * Prepare and maintain annual budget and periodic forecasts, including personnel costs, operating expenses, investments and headcount plans.
   * Collect and consolidate financial inputs from operational teams and HR, ensuring alignment with the center's growth plans.
   * Monitor actual performance against budget and forecast, identifying and explaining significant deviations.
2. **Financial Reporting & Cost Monitoring**
   * Prepare monthly financial reports and analyses covering costs, headcount, budget variances and key performance indicators.
   * Monitor personnel expenses, indirect costs and operating expenditures, ensuring accuracy, completeness and consistency with approved plans.
   * Provide financial analyses and supporting information to the GBS Finance Manager and operational management.
3. **Cost Allocation & Intercompany Recharges**
   * Prepare monthly cost allocations and intercompany recharge calculations, including personnel costs, indirect expenses, accruals and invoicing instructions.
   * Maintain accurate allocation keys and records of employees, cost centers and benefiting affiliates, reflecting changes in headcount and service scope.
   * Reconcile recharges with accounting records, resolve discrepancies and respond to queries from affiliates and internal stakeholders.
4. **Financial Operations & Accounting Support**
   * Support monthly financial closing activities, including the preparation of accruals, reconciliations and cost analyses.
   * Coordinate with the Accounting team to ensure accurate expense recording, cost classification and intercompany transactions.
   * Maintain reliable financial records and supporting documentation for reporting, internal controls and audits.
5. **Process Improvement & Center Expansion**
   * Develop and maintain practical financial models, reporting templates and tracking tools to support day-to-day operations.
   * Simplify, standardize and progressively automate financial processes to support the center's expansion.
   * Provide hands-on financial support for recruitment plans, service transitions, cost assessments and other ad hoc activities.

**Qualifications**

* Education & Experience
  + University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field.
  + Approximately 3–5 years of experience in financial controlling, FP&A, management reporting or accounting-related activities.
  + Practical experience in budgeting, forecasting, cost monitoring and financial reconciliations.
  + Experience with intercompany recharges, cost allocation methodologies or shared services environments is an advantage.
  + Experience working in a growing organization or establishing financial processes is desirable.
* Technical Skills
  + Strong Excel capabilities, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, data consolidation and financial modelling.
  + Good understanding of financial planning, budgeting, cost accounting and management reporting.
  + Ability to work with detailed financial and operational datasets, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
  + Experience with ERP systems, preferably Oracle.
  + Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting tools is an advantage.
  + Good understanding of basic accounting principles, accruals and reconciliations.
* Behavioural Competencies
  + Highly hands-on, operational and detail-oriented, with a willingness to work directly with financial data and calculations.
  + Strong analytical skills, with a practical and problem-solving mindset.
  + Self-motivated, proactive and comfortable working in a developing organizational environment.
  + Flexible and adaptable, with the ability to handle a broad range of financial tasks and changing priorities.
  + Well-organized, reliable and capable of meeting recurring monthly deadlines.
  + Good communication and collaboration skills across functions and countries.
  + Willingness to take ownership of tasks and continuously improve existing processes.
* Languages
  + Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

title: GBS Finance Manager
description:
*We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 100,000 employees operate a network of 2,500 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.*

**Job Description**

Lead the financial management and governance of the GBS India site, covering planning, reporting, accounting, compliance, cash management, cost allocation and intercompany recharges. Partner with site and global leaders to improve transparency, cost efficiency and operational performance.

**Key responsibilities**

Financial planning and performance

* Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and long-term planning, incorporating workforce, inflation and investment assumptions.
* Monitor actual performance against budget, forecast and business cases, including headcount and salary costs.
* Provide variance analysis, dashboards and actionable recommendations to improve cost, productivity and service performance.
* Challenge assumptions and identify financial risks and opportunities.

Cost allocation and business partnering

* Manage indirect cost allocation and accurate, timely intercompany recharges in line with transfer pricing and internal policies.
* Partner with site leadership, operational teams, Global Process Owners and Global Finance to support decisions and strengthen financial discipline.
* Prepare financial models, scenarios and profitability assessments for operational and strategic decisions.

Projects and transformation

* Build business cases, ROI analyses and financial impact assessments for transitions, scope changes, automation, office projects and CAPEX investments.
* Track project costs and benefits, supporting initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability and standardization.

Accounting, tax and compliance

* Oversee legal entity financial statements, month-end close, accounting records and accruals in line with local and group requirements.
* Coordinate statutory reporting, tax filings, audits and compliance with internal controls, corporate governance and foreign exchange regulations.
* Maintain financial policies, procedures and controls, working closely with Tax, Treasury, HR and Procurement.

Cash, risk and governance

* Monitor liquidity and ensure timely payment of payroll, taxes and facilities costs, as well as collection of intercompany balances.
* Manage financial risks, including fraud, segregation of duties, foreign exchange exposure, insurance and other financial instruments.
* Act as a supplementary legal representative within the legal entity bylaws and approval matrix.

Continuous improvement

* Improve controlling, reporting, data quality and automation, including ERP and reporting tools.
* Support benchmarking, cost optimization and strategic finance projects across GBS locations.
* Contribute to a performance-driven, service-oriented culture and provide support across GBS Finance when required.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or a related field. CPA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent is an advantage.
* 7–10 years of experience in finance, controlling, audit or business partnering, preferably within GBS, shared services or a multinational environment.
* Proven experience in legal entity reporting, statutory audits and financial compliance.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, internal controls and financial modelling.
* Experience with intercompany accounting, cost allocation and recharge models is preferred.
* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, with experience using ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Workday. Power BI is an advantage.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

**Additional Information**

**Why SGS?**

* Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
* SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
* Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
* Benefits platform.

**Join Us:**
At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

* Experience in EPM Data Management / Data Exchange.
* Experience with data integrations tools (ODI, OIC), SQL and relational databases.
* Experience in EPM Automate / EPM REST APIs.
* Experience in implementing Transfer Pricing solutions in EPM is a plus.
* Experience in implementing Legal Entity Forecasting solutions in EPM is a plus.
* Experience with the recently released ESG Reporting EPM module is a plus.
* Experience with the recently released Predictive Cash Forecasting EPM module is a plus.
* Proactive and innovative approach, constantly looking for chances to enhance processes and supporting management in their implementation.
* Motivated to learn new technologies and expand your functional and technical expertise to other Oracle EPM Cloud products.

As an Services Support Associate II on the Audit Project Management Network (PMN) team, you’ll help Audit engagement teams make informed

You’ll bring careful attention to detail and the ability to learn, retain, and consistently apply complex processes and requirements.
  
  
**About Our Team**
This team provides indispensable support to Audit Public Engagement teams throughout the client engagement lifecycle, working closely with project managers and engagement managers to coordinate schedules, manage resources, and track key activities. By integrating staffing, WIP, hours, rates, billing, revenue, expenses, budgets, forecasts, and compliance data, the team provides actionable insight into engagement performance, helps identify and resolve variances, and supports timely follow-up on independence, documentation, milestones, and review items. Through collaboration, accuracy, and attention to detail, PMN helps large & complex Audit public engagement teams maintain financial and operational control while supporting successful client outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:**

* Analyze weekly WIP, budgets, forecasts, staffing, rates, and revenue to surface trends, explain variances, and support engagement decisions
* Reconcile time, resources, and billing data across internal platforms; investigate differences in hours, utilization, coding, rates, invoices, and payments
* Monitor engagement performance against budgets and forecasts, flag potential overruns, and identify billing and resource-planning opportunities
* Build dashboards and publish leadership reports such as LTD, WIP, EMD, and recovery analysis with concise summaries of key metrics and audit review notes
* Maintain accurate engagement records, including fees, expenses, receivables, payables, WBS structures, work plans, charge codes, and supporting documentation
* Coordinate engagement updates and follow-ups across staffing, milestones, timekeeper reviews, entity and independence records, SRM requests, DCIPP, Omnia, and Deloitte Connect
* Multi-tasking various activities maintaining quality, efficiently managing time and prioritizing tasks
* Perform additional tasks as required

**Work location & shift timings**

* Hyderabad office
* Hybrid model (work from Deloitte office minimum of two to three days in a week)
* 2 pm to 11 pm IST (may vary based on business requirement)
* Flexible to support overtime during busy season

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Graduate or Master’s Degree in Commerce/Finance (B.Com/BBA/M.Com/MBA)
* 1 to 3 years work experience in Banking, Financial services or similar industry
* Advanced Excel skills including data extraction, analysis, validation, and reporting
* Basic working knowledge in MS-Word and MS-PowerPoint
* Good verbal and written communication skills

**Required Professional Skills**

* Strong attention to detail
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior leaders at all levels
* Proactive and highly organized with an exceptional ability to multi-task
* Ability to manage documentation, tracking issues and summarizing status, and support project planning
* Experience in financial analysis, reconciliation, invoice or billing analysis, forecasting, and/or variance analysis
* Experience using AI tools in day-to-day work
* Ability to respond to requests in a timely manner
* Demonstrate enthusiasm for continuous learning relevant to the role

**Preferred Skills:**

* Working knowledge in building macros in Excel
* Basic Tableau and/or Power BI working experience
* Bilingualism (English and French) would be an asset

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

* Investigate and resolve questions from internal customers about contract terms, data updates, system changes, and billing adjustments, and escalate complex or unusual cases

description:

**Position Overview**
We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Senior Accounts Receivable Professional**
to take ownership of accounts receivable operations, oversee collections, drive process efficiencies, and ensure the accuracy of financial records.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have 8 to 10 years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, collections, and financial reconciliations, preferably in a global or SaaS-based organization.
  
  
This role requires strong analytical capabilities, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to independently manage complex AR activities while ensuring timely collections and maintaining healthy cash flow.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Accounts Receivable Management: Oversee end-to-end accounts receivable operations, including invoicing, payment processing, collections, reconciliations, and account maintenance.
* Collections & Follow-ups: Drive collection strategies and proactively follow up with customers to ensure timely payments and minimize overdue receivables.
* Customer Account Management: Manage customer queries, resolve billing disputes, and address payment discrepancies in coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
* Reconciliation & Reporting: Perform regular account reconciliations, investigate irregularities, and ensure the accuracy of AR ledgers and financial records.
* Aging Analysis: Monitor accounts receivable aging reports, identify high-risk and overdue accounts, and take appropriate actions to improve collections.
* Cash Flow Management: Support cash flow forecasting by providing accurate collection projections and regular updates on outstanding receivables.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline AR processes, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen internal controls.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to resolve outstanding payment issues.
* Audit & Compliance: Ensure compliance with financial policies, accounting standards, and internal audit requirements.
* Management Reporting: Prepare and present periodic AR reports, collection dashboards, outstanding balances, and key performance metrics to management.
* Team Guidance: Provide guidance and support to junior team members, review operational activities, and ensure adherence to established processes.

**Requirements & Skills**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in Accounts Receivable, Billing, Collections, and Financial Operations.
* Strong experience in managing end-to-end AR operations, including invoicing, collections, cash application, and reconciliations.
* Proven experience handling large customer portfolios, overdue accounts, and complex collection scenarios.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls, and AR processes.
* Experience in preparing and analyzing AR aging reports, collection forecasts, and financial dashboards.
* Hands-on experience with ERP/accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar platforms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical skills with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to independently manage priorities, meet deadlines, and drive process improvements.
* Experience working with global customers or in a SaaS/product-based organization will be an added advantage.

title: GBS Financial Planning & Analyst (FP&A)
description:
**Company Description**

*We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for sustainability, quality and integrity. Our 99,500 employees operate a network of 2,500 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.*

 **Job Description**

The GBS Financial Planning & Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day execution of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, cost allocation and intercompany recharge activities for the GBS India center.

The role is highly operational and requires a hands-on approach to financial data preparation, cost monitoring, reporting and reconciliations. It ensures accurate and timely financial information, transparent cost allocations and reliable recharging of GBS costs to the benefiting businesses, functions and affiliates.

As GBS India is an emerging center, currently employing approximately 100 people and expected to grow to 200–300 employees over the next two years, the position will play an important role in establishing practical, efficient and scalable financial processes to support this expansion.

Working closely with the GBS Finance Manager, operational teams, HR, Accounting and Global GBS Controlling, the role contributes to financial discipline, cost transparency and continuous improvement.

* **Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting**
  + Prepare and maintain annual budget and periodic forecasts, including personnel costs, operating expenses, investments and headcount plans.
  + Collect and consolidate financial inputs from operational teams and HR, ensuring alignment with the center's growth plans.
  + Monitor actual performance against budget and forecast, identifying and explaining significant deviations.
* **Financial Reporting & Cost Monitoring**
  + Prepare monthly financial reports and analyses covering costs, headcount, budget variances and key performance indicators.
  + Monitor personnel expenses, indirect costs and operating expenditures, ensuring accuracy, completeness and consistency with approved plans.
  + Provide financial analyses and supporting information to the GBS Finance Manager and operational management.
* **Cost Allocation & Intercompany Recharges**
  + Prepare monthly cost allocations and intercompany recharge calculations, including personnel costs, indirect expenses, accruals and invoicing instructions.
  + Maintain accurate allocation keys and records of employees, cost centers and benefiting affiliates, reflecting changes in headcount and service scope.
  + Reconcile recharges with accounting records, resolve discrepancies and respond to queries from affiliates and internal stakeholders.
* **Financial Operations & Accounting Support**
  + Support monthly financial closing activities, including the preparation of accruals, reconciliations and cost analyses.
  + Coordinate with the Accounting team to ensure accurate expense recording, cost classification and intercompany transactions.
  + Maintain reliable financial records and supporting documentation for reporting, internal controls and audits.
* **Process Improvement & Center Expansion**
  + Develop and maintain practical financial models, reporting templates and tracking tools to support day-to-day operations.
  + Simplify, standardize and progressively automate financial processes to support the center's expansion.
  + Provide hands-on financial support for recruitment plans, service transitions, cost assessments and other ad hoc activities.

 **Qualifications**  

* Education & Experience
  + University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field.
  + Approximately 3–5 years of experience in financial controlling, FP&A, management reporting or accounting-related activities.
  + Practical experience in budgeting, forecasting, cost monitoring and financial reconciliations.
  + Experience with intercompany recharges, cost allocation methodologies or shared services environments is an advantage.
  + Experience working in a growing organization or establishing financial processes is desirable.
* Technical Skills
  + Strong Excel capabilities, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, data consolidation and financial modelling.
  + Good understanding of financial planning, budgeting, cost accounting and management reporting.
  + Ability to work with detailed financial and operational datasets, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
  + Experience with ERP systems, preferably Oracle.
  + Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting tools is an advantage.

title: Senior Equity Research Analyst
description:
**About Us**

**iRage**
is one of India's leading high-frequency trading firms. We build and own everything in-house, from ultra-low-latency execution to our entire trading infrastructure. Our systems deliver some of the lowest latencies in the market, with order-send speeds under 100 nanoseconds - but the harder problem we've solved is keeping that latency low at scale. We run thousands of independent portfolios in parallel, carrying overnight positions across thousands of instruments, with tooling that coordinates state and information across hundreds of servers spanning multiple data centres in real time.

The stack is ours end to end: custom FPGA pipelines - including PHY and MAC layers we built on hardware firmware in-house - and a C++ codebase we control from market-data ingestion through order entry and risk. We run experiments over days just to shave off a single clock cycle.

But great technology alone doesn't move markets. Our quant and tech teams work side by side, and the results speak for themselves: millions of trades a day. To put that in perspective, we handle the equivalent of several Big Billion Days in a single day, every day, at lightning speed. iRage is where deep technical expertise meets real market impact, in one of the world's fastest-growing trading ecosystems.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Own the research product and its quant edge**

* Define the desk's coverage universe, research calendar and house style, anchored in your own sector expertise.
* Apply iRage's strengths to your fundamental work, with the quant team assisting with: market microstructure, flows, derivatives positioning, factor and statistical models, and alternative data.
* Work with iRage's quant researchers and data engineers to turn signals (earnings-surprise models, F&O open interest, delivery and block-deal data, index rebalancing, event studies) into publishable, client-ready ideas.
* Publish initiations, earnings updates, thematic and quant-screen reports, plus short daily or weekly notes.

* Translate quant outputs into a clear investment story a fundamental PM will act on.
* Gather client feedback and shape the product around what clients pay for.

* Train analysts in fundamental research, and encourage them to build data and quant skills alongside iRage's quant team.

description:
**Nomura Overview:**

Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com.

Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations.

At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies & programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.

**Divisional Overview:**

The Risk Management Division encompasses the firm's comprehensive risk framework responsible for determining and managing the overall risk appetite for the firm. The division is responsible for effectively managing the firm's risk-return profile, which ensures the efficient deployment of the firm's capital. It is one of the firm's core competencies and is independent of the trading areas and operational area.

The Risk Department at Nomura is broadly organised according to the main risk classes Market Risk, Credit Risk, New Business and Operational Risk. The Risk Department provides senior management with an independent view of the principal risks taken by individual business units.

**Business Unit Overview:**

Credit Risk Management (CRM) is an independent risk oversight function, reporting to the Global Chief Risk Officer (CRO). Its mandate is to manage the risk of loss arising from an obligor or counterparty’s default, insolvency or administrative proceeding, which results in the obligor’s failure to meet its contractual obligations in accordance with agreed terms.

The process for managing credit risk at Nomura includes:

* Evaluation of likelihood that a counterparty defaults on its payments and obligations;
* Assignment of internal ratings to all active counterparties;
* Approval of extensions of credit and establishment of credit limits;
* Measurement, monitoring and management of Nomura’s current and potential future credit exposures;
* Setting credit terms in legal documentation, including margin terms; and
* Use of appropriate credit risk mitigants, including netting, collateral and hedging

CRM Powai

CRM Powai is an integral part of the CRM function globally, responsible for credit risk analysis of a diverse portfolio of counterparties across sectors and regions. The team is engaged in assigning credit ratings, carrying out sector and peer reviews, recommending and monitoring credit limits, suggesting credit terms for legal agreements, tracking early warning indicators, and various other portfolio management activities, as well as participating in global projects. The team comprises of Credit Risk Analysts, Financing Risk Analysts, Portfolio and country risk Analysts to list a few.

**Position Specifications:**

As a credit Analyst, you will be responsible for managing portfolio of EMEA/AEJ based Hedge Funds and Private Equity Funds. In this role you will be responsible for managing all aspects of the portfolio, including Ratings, Limits and exposure monitoring, monitoring early warning indicators, stress testing etc. In addition, you will support the build out of specialized data analytics and portfolio tools and actively participate in the risk monitoring of the portfolio. The position requires you to frequently interact with Clients, Traders, Operations, Legal and other teams in Risk Management, and where necessary escalate credit concerns to senior management.

**Corporate Title :**
Associate

**Functional Title :**
Associate

**Experience :**
4 – 6 years

**Qualification :**
Chartered Accountant (Rank holder or 1st Attempt pass) or PGDM/MBA from top-tier Colleges. Additional qualification like CFA/FRM is preferable

**Role & Responsibilities:**

Credit Officer’s responsibility for a portfolio of Counterparties within the global Hedge Fund team, primarily includes coverage for Hedge Funds (HF) and Private Equity Fund (PE).

Daily responsibilities include:

* Undertake Due Diligence (DD) calls with clients. Collect credit information necessary for conducting detailed credit analysis.
* Conduct in-depth credit research and credit analysis and write high quality Credit Memos, to assign internal credit rating, appetite and margin tiers for clients.
* Prescribe credit terms and covenants for legal documents.
* Analyze and support trade approvals by liaising with the Financing Risk team and obtain Independent Amount (IA) or Initial Margin numbers for such trades.

* Investigate credit limit breaches by speaking to Sales, Operations and Credit Risk Analytics team, determine the cause and escalate as per Credit Policies.
* Design automated reports and implement process workflows for the Hedge Funds team to assist in the monitoring of this specialized portfolio, including highlighting hedge fund clients with elevated levels of risks based on client information (risk/ performance), market indicators, early warning indicators and credit exposure.
* Build data processes and implement models in Python/ Alteryx to minimize manual effort and enable analysts to effectively and efficiently manage their portfolios.
* Monitor the portfolio by reviewing and updating NAV and Performance data for Hedge Funds on a monthly basis. Follow up with HF Managers and flag any clients with deteriorating NAV/Performance metrics
* Contribute to the firm’s Risk Change agenda and participate in regulatory and audit assessments.

Participating in global projects and initiatives for example: the development of scorecards, preparing

credit updates for senior management, suggesting system and process improvements via automation, participating in Global Sector Forums etc.

**Requirements:**

**Mandatory**

Professional degree holders such as CAs (Rank holder or 1st Attempt pass), MBAs from reputed institutes or CFA. Other post graduate degrees will be acceptable, if accompanied by relevant CRM experience

4-6 years’ prior experience in CRM or Rating assignments, working in any sector. Prior experience in the Hedge Fund Analysis will be an added advantage

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially report writing skills and the ability to independently lead global calls

Strong analytical ability, with an eye for detail and the ability to identify emerging risks

The ability to be a ‘self-starter’, have proactive approach to resolving issues and the willingness to learn

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint is a must, any additional technical knowledge will be an added advantage

**Desired**

Prior experience in managing a Hedge Funds portfolio

Experience in appetite setting, limit setting and monitoring, setting legal documentation terms

Strong coding skills in Python, SQL, VBA, Alteryx, Power BI

Good understanding of products traded by Investment Banks, legal agreements etc.

title: Quantitative Investment Strategies, Manager, Institutional Equity Division
description:
**Quantitative Investment Strategies, Senior Associate, Institutional Equity Division**
The Quantitative Investment Strategies business at Morgan Stanley sits within the Institutional Securities Group with a cross-asset mandate and is a global multi-function team consisting of dedicated Research, Structuring, Strats, and Trading. The mandate of the group is to design quantitative systematic strategies that can be offered to the firm’s clients to access in a variety of formats.
  
  
This is a challenging role and offering exposure to an interesting, dynamic product group and work environment to build your career in.
  
  
From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast-changing markets.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity-linked and equity-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
  
  
Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales & Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, strats to risk management.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Work on new equity and multi-asset index development - back testing, coding, tweaking codes etc.
* Development of processes to improve index support, e.g. scripts to aid debugging, index code refactoring and standardization
* Index oversight - Daily monitoring of the complex indices & resolving calculation issues (data problems, calendar errors, common code errors etc.)
* Overseeing Index rebalance processes for client directed strategies
* Making modifications in existing live indices e.g. new cost structures, universe changes, minor methodology adjustments
* Index Description drafting for minor adjustments, Repeat Index Launch Form completion
* Carrying out performance attribution of systematic strategies
* Production of periodic standard performance reporting for client distribution
* Development and production of position, stress, composition reports for clients
* Bespoke scenario/sensitivity analysis for clients

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Degree with a quantitative discipline (BE, BTech, MS in Maths/Statistics/Financial Engineering) from Tier 1 or 2 institutes
* 2-4 year of prior exposure to Index/Quants Research and equities/multi asset indices analytics is important.
* Computer Skills: strong programming skills such as Python (mandatory), R and Java.
* Must be able to flexibly respond to changes in priorities, be able to communicate results to a less-technical audience, work well in a team and be comfortable in a front office environment.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills/Ability to express ideas via writing. Prior track record in writing marketing material/trade ideas for wider distribution will be advantageous.
* Proactiveness / Initiative taking & Teamwork are the skills desired
* Option Greeks and their behavior over time
* Derivative products like Swaps, Swaptions, Spread Options, Cap/Floors, range accruals, Digitals etc.
* General behavior of Equity Derivatives markets – Flow and Structured Products

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. We are looking for an experienced
**Assistant Vice President (AVP) based in India**

1. M&A Transaction Execution

* Work closely with senior bankers, analysts, associates, and other transaction team members.

2. Financial Analysis & Valuation

* Analyze financial statements, operating metrics, revenue growth, EBITDA, and business performance.
* Develop financial models and valuation analyses for technology services and software businesses.
* Conduct market research, industry analysis, and benchmarking of comparable companies.
* Evaluate business performance, growth opportunities, and transaction considerations.

3. US Team Support

* Work as an extension of the US Investment Banking team, supporting ongoing M&A mandates and deal execution.
* Collaborate with US-based Managing Directors, Directors, Vice Presidents, and other deal team members.
* Manage multiple transaction workstreams while maintaining high-quality deliverables and turnaround times.
* Participate in deal discussions, internal reviews, and client-related preparation.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination across US and LATAM teams.

4. Business Development & Deal Origination

* Support senior bankers in identifying potential acquisition targets, buyers, and strategic opportunities.
* Conduct buyer research and develop targeted lists of strategic and financial investors.
* Assist in preparing pitchbooks, industry presentations, and marketing materials.
* Track industry developments, M&A activity, and relevant market trends.
* Support the development of new client relationships and transaction opportunities.

5. Team Leadership & Quality Control

* Review and oversee work prepared by Analysts and Associates.
* Provide guidance on financial analysis, valuation, and transaction materials.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and quality of deliverables.
* Manage priorities across multiple projects and support effective team execution.
* Contribute to the development of transaction processes and internal best practices.

Required Qualifications

* 7–12 years of experience in Investment Banking, M&A, Corporate Finance, or Transaction Advisory.
* Experience working on technology-focused M&A transactions, preferably within Technology Services, IT Services, Software, SaaS, Consulting, or Business Services.
* Strong experience in financial modeling, valuation, transaction execution, and investment banking presentations.
* Experience supporting US-based clients, deal teams, or cross-border M&A transactions preferred.
* Proven ability to manage multiple transactions and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
* Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience reviewing and mentoring junior team members.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience working with US Investment Banking teams or US-based clients.
* Exposure to sell-side M&A processes and transaction marketing.
* Experience preparing CIMs, buyer presentations, financial models, and valuation materials.
* Knowledge of the US technology services and software M&A market.
* Fluency in English; Spanish or Portuguese proficiency is an advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is an experienced investment banking professional based in LATAM who can independently manage transaction workstreams, support US senior bankers, and deliver high-quality financial analysis and deal materials.

The candidate should have strong execution capabilities, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, cross-border investment banking environment.

**This is an opportunity to work closely with the US Investment Banking team while contributing to global technology M&A transactions from Latin America.**
