title: Financial Reporting Professional - Mumbai
description:
**Job Description**

**BDO India Services Private Limited: Financial Reporting Role**

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It’s a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting Manager to take ownership of the financial reporting and month-end close process across group entities. This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, audit management capabilities, and a strong focus on internal controls and financial governance. The role will work closely with Service Lines, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Compliance, and senior leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Reporting & Month-End Close**

* Own and drive the monthly financial reporting and close process across group entities.
* Ensure timely and accurate closure of monthly books within defined timelines.
* Review trial balances, general ledger accounts, and supporting schedules.
* Review and ensure accurate accounting of provisions, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortization, and other month-end entries.
* Perform detailed variance analysis of actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, and highlight key business drivers to management.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data across entities.

**Financial Statements & Accounting Compliance**

* Prepare and review annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS / Local GAAP.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions and financial reporting matters.
* Provide accurate financial information, schedules, and supporting documentation for regulatory and statutory filings.
* Partner with the Compliance and Secretarial teams to ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting.

**Statutory & Internal Audit Management**

* Lead and manage statutory audits across group entities.
* Coordinate and support internal audits, including preparation of audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents, and deliverables.
* Act as the key point of contact between auditors and internal stakeholders.
* Manage audit timelines and ensure timely closure of audit observations and queries.
* Proactively identify and resolve audit issues with minimal escalation.

**Internal Financial Controls & Governance**

* Execute and monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCR/IFC) within the reporting function.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and testing of key financial controls.
* Identify control gaps and drive timely remediation.
* Strengthen financial governance and control frameworks across entities.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.

**Lease Accounting & Fixed Assets**

* Manage lease accounting, including maintenance of lease trackers and periodic accounting entries.
* Ensure appropriate accounting and reporting under Ind AS 116, where applicable.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, and reconciliation.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of fixed asset registers and related schedules.

**Balance Sheet & Month-End Governance**

* Ensure all balance sheet schedules are prepared, reviewed, and reconciled on a monthly basis.
* Maintain strong controls over provisions and expense recognition.
* Ensure appropriate cut-off procedures and completeness of expense recognition.
* Investigate and resolve long-outstanding reconciling items and unusual balances.
* Drive high standards of accuracy and financial discipline across the reporting process.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate closely with Service Lines, FP&A, AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, and other cross-functional teams.
* Provide management with relevant financial information, analysis, and insights.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve accounting, reporting, and close-related issues.
* Build strong working relationships with senior stakeholders and external auditors.

**Process Improvement & Systems**

* Identify opportunities to improve and standardize financial reporting and close processes.
* Drive standardization of reconciliations, reporting schedules, and management reporting formats.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen controls and improve process efficiency.
* Support enhanced utilization and optimization of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.
* Drive process improvements, automation, and reporting efficiencies wherever relevant.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory.
* Experience in financial reporting, accounting, controllership, or related finance functions.
* Strong hands-on experience in:
* Financial reporting and financial statements
* Month-end and year-end close
* Statutory and internal audits
* Balance sheet reconciliations
* Internal financial controls
* Technical accounting
* Experience managing reporting across multiple entities will be preferred.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, Big 4, or similar environments will be an advantage.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.

You will provide clients with the in-depth analysis, insight and perspective they require, contributing to our outlooks and analytics services. You will play a key role in building the business through development of propositions, products and services. * Support the improvement of continuously evolving analysis of the global fertilizer markets for subscription reports: outlooks and analytics services.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of the core models to support the forecasting of supply, demand, capacity, imports and exports, price, production costs and margin analysis in the fertilizer.
* Lead components of delivery, under guidance from managers, providing input to the subscription analysis reports produced by Argus Media Analytics.
* Liaise with wider Argus staff to ensure current knowledge of Argus products and maintain current knowledge of major drivers and trends across commodity markets.
* Work with experts and analysts across our global offices to extract maximum value out of data collected and to deliver integrated analysis.
* Support the development and commercialization of new data-driven products.

**Skills And Experience**

* Graduate / Master’s degree from a top tier university with minimum 2-3 years of experience in fertilizers sector; exposure to nitrogen sector shall be an added advantage.
* Highly numerate with experience analysing comprehensive datasets quickly and meticulously with excellent attention to detail and accuracy focus.
* Intellectually curious and able to demonstrate structured problem solving and analytical skills.
* Exceptional communication and relationship building skills.
* Strong IT skills including advanced Excel and PowerPoint; awareness of other statistical and programming languages such as R is an advantage.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks to deadline and to meet targets.
* Flexible in approach, highly motivated and willing to contribute to the growth of Argus’ Analytics Services.

**What’s In It For You**

* Competitive salary
* Hybrid Working Policy (3 days in Mumbai office/ 2 days WFH once fully inducted
* Group healthcare scheme
* 18 days annual leave
* 8 days of casual leave
* Extensive internal and external training

Argus is the leading independent provider of market intelligence to the global energy and commodity markets. We offer essential price assessments, news, analytics, consulting services, data science tools and industry conferences to illuminate complex and opaque commodity markets.
  
  
Headquartered in London with 1,500 staff, Argus is an independent media organisation with 32 offices in the world’s principal commodity trading hubs.
  
  
Companies, trading firms and governments in 160 countries around the world trust Argus data to make decisions, analyse situations, manage risk, facilitate trading and for long-term planning. Argus prices are used as trusted benchmarks around the world for pricing transportation, commodities and energy.
  
  
Founded in 1970, Argus remains a privately held UK-registered company owned by employee shareholders and global growth equity firm General Atlantic.

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.

Our Company

title: Sr Program Controls Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
Are you ready to help us make the future?
  
  
Project Control Specialist’s primary function is to assist project managers in scheduling and cost controls and do regular projects audits to proactively identify and communicate the risks and opportunities during the project life cycle. The Project Control Specialist support project managers to maximize their facetime with the customers, keep them informed of the potential risks, opportunities like change orders, estimate at completion, and other issues. Project Control Specialist also tracks the project issues and corrective actions He/ She ensures all customer projects follow standard methodology and ensure all projects are maintained in our financial and project execution systems. He/ She ensures that the Program / Project Management processes are implemented effectively. He / She will support business and program management leaders to ensure data integrity by enforcing compliance to management operating system and processes. The Project Control Specialist will also lead a team of Project Controls Analysts
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Principal Responsibilities
  
  
The Project Controls Organization’s (PCO) primary function is to ensure all customer projects follow standard methodology and ensure all projects are setup, reviewed and maintained to the Honeywell HBS standards in financial and project execution systems. PCO ensures data integrity by enforcing compliance to project management methodology, and project accounting requirements.
  
  
The Project Control Specialist will be responsible for complying to the systems, tools, and processes for effective PCO function for the assigned geography and LOB. The Project Control Specialist will ensure program / project management processes are implemented effectively. He/ She will ensure standardize project analysis tools and reports are used for a portfolio of large, medium and small projects.
  
  
**Other Expectations From This Role**

* Deploy standard systems and processes for the project reviews and bring in consistency to ensure common project control processes are followed for all projects
* Leverage existing tools and systems to optimize the Project Control Processes
* Candidate should have PMP or CAPM certificate issued by PMI,USA (Preferred)
* Implementation of the standard Project Controls tool sets and work processes on all projects assigned within regional Operations.
* Set-up of projects schedules, tracking, reporting, highlights deviations and proposes recovery plans.
* Set-up of project controls tools for Budget control and monitoring project Earned Value and productivity.
* Assist in Project timesheet coordination and management.
* Support the Project Managers in managing project review, control and reporting processes.
* Support Project Manager in planning, scheduling and cost control including monthly review and audit on Projects, setting up of Workbook, DCI and uploading to Project Review & Forecast Integrated System PPM Cora.
* Perform monthly reviews, projects gating reviews (support affiliates) and audit on projects.
* Assist project manager to coordinate internal project reviews and preparation of monthly project reports.
* Assist the PM in tracking and monitoring project variation with respect to budget & schedule and change management.
* Ensure the Project Control policies and procedures are consistently applied on the projects.
* Work with Program Managers, Project Manager, Operation Managers and engineering manager to implement the work processes, data structures and technology for Project Controls.
* Partner with the project managers, project coordinators, project admins to ensure that there is seamless handover between various project, operations, finance, sales, and engineering teams
* Deploy standard process and tools and measure effectiveness
* Establish regular project reviews as per guidelines, and make sure that the ERP and Project Execution systems are effectively used and updated with the most current project status.
* Reporting the potential EACs, Change Order potentials, and exceptions to the business leaders and following up corrective actions

**Qualifications**
YOU MUST HAVE
  
  

* Sound understanding of various solutions HON provides to its customers
* Basic Commercial & Financial & Contracts know how
* Strong Project financials understanding – Cost Controls, POC, EAC, Budget, Forecasting, Contracts
* Finance Or Process Background with Project Ops exposure shall be a plus
* Coaching abilities / strong communication
* 7+ years of experience including team supervisory roles (optional).
* Cost risk analysis and Concept of Change Management
* Familiar with MS Office applications, SAP Applications or equivalent business systems , Expert in Primavera Project Planner and / or Microsoft projects
* Project Controls Analysis (data, indices, variances, trends, projects), Planning and Integrated scheduling (concepts and work processes
* Well versed with Data Analytics dashboards and tools viz. Power BI,Tableau

WE VALUE
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred with 7+ years of experience.
* Degree in Business, Science or Engineering, Finance or Accounting or related field
* Experience as Business Analyst
* Self-starter, eye for detailing
* Demonstrated leadership experience in coordinating and overseeing successful projects and entry-level employees
* Ability to consistently make timely decisions even in the face of complexity, balancing systematic analysis with decisiveness.
* Ability to convey subtle or complex messages clearly, as appropriate for the topic and audience
* Experience in financial data compilation, analysis and metrics management
* User experience of SAP system
* Experience in project operations & Project Management certification shall be a plus

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Business Strategist
description:
The Business Strategist is a key hire as IMC India builds out its Business Strategy function to support the office's rapid growth ambitions over the coming years. You will join a small, high-impact team working closely with IMC's India leadership and trading desk leads, and you will report to the Head of Business Strategy and Corporate Development for India. The working environment is collaborative and non-hierarchical, and you will manage a wide range of stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Core Responsibilities**
  
  

* Contribute to and shape definition of strategic priorities to help the India team achieve its growth ambitions over the next years.

+ Assess attractiveness of a new opportunities based on opportunity size, competition, and internal capabilities.
+ For example: make a business case for trading a new class of products, with cost and benefits analysis and an organizational, legal and compliance set-up.

* Drive real business impact by supporting the execution of the defined strategic priorities

+ Help translate the strategy into planning.
+ Support execution of specific strategic priorities.
+ For example: build annual plans that tie to the long-term strategy with trading, tech and support teams, or develop a joint roadmap for the various teams that trade cryptocurrencies, including taking care of the synergies between the teams.

* Support on specific (ad hoc) strategic problems and opportunities

+ Detect and solve ad hoc problems in a solution-oriented way by using analytical skills.
+ Help detect (operational) bottlenecks within the organization and apply your problem-solving skills to work towards solutions.
+ Run strategy off-sites for teams.
+ For example: hold workshop to improve efficiency of central trading processes.

* Gather external insights, asses their implications for IMC strategy and help decide on a response

+ Ongoing external engagement: play a pivotal role in corporate development projects relevant to the business (e.g. identify threats, opportunities and actions for IMC, leading acquisitions, establishing partnerships, etc.).
+ Develop a perspective on industry trends/developments as well as on the competitive landscape in the secretive field of trading.
+ For example: conduct global competitive analyses into the Indian and global equity markets, make a mapping of various players, revenues, FTEs, trading styles and strategies.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Experience at a top-tier consulting firm in strategy, preferably at the manager level or higher
* Outstanding problem solving and people skills
* Bachelor's degree in STEM from a Tier 1 University mandatory
* Master’s degree in Physics, Mathematics or Econometrics
* Ability to deal with organizational complexity and ambiguity
* Capable of dealing with a large scope of and senior stakeholders
* Likes to work in an innovative technology driven fast-paced environment, surrounded by highly educated, ambitious and collaborative colleagues

**About Us**
*IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: Fund Accountant
description:

* Handle fund accounting, general ledger, journal entries and trial balance.

* Process investment transactions, corporate actions, income and expenses.
* Calculate management fees, performance fees and fund expenses.

* Manage subscriptions, redemptions, P&L and trade reconciliation for Hedge Funds.

* Support annual audits and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Communicate with international clients, investment managers and offshore teams.

* Strong experience in Fund Accounting and Investment Accounting.
* Hands-on experience in Hedge Funds, Private Equity or Multi-Asset funds.
* Expertise in NAV Calculation and Reconciliation.
* Knowledge of General Ledger, Financial Reporting and P&L.
* Working knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP.
* Advanced MS Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP and Macros).
* Good understanding of financial instruments and investment operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to meet strict reporting deadlines and work with international teams.

* Experience with Investran, eFront, Allvue, Geneva, Paxus, Multifonds or similar fund accounting platforms.

* Exposure to Cayman, Luxembourg, Ireland or GIFT City fund structures.
* CA, CFA, CPA, ACCA or CMA qualification (preferred).

title: Specialist - Research
description:
As a part of the Business Intelligence Group (BIG) Asia - Strategic Research team in India Knowledge Services function of Marsh (India) Private Limited, the candidate will be aligned to the regional sales and client engagement vertical, supporting sales enablement projects and live client pitches for the sales team, partners, and risk advisors.
  
  
Dedicatedly working for Asia, the BIG team supports stakeholders with insights to achieve distinctive client outcomes. We track clients, prospects, industries, markets, competitors as well as emerging risks and develop research collateral critical to growth and sales strategy.
  
  
**What is in it for you?**

* Discover what is great about working at Marsh – from the opportunities that our size brings, to our commitment to our communities and understanding the benefits you will receive. We are four businesses with one PURPOSE: helping companies meet the challenges of our time
* As a global leader in insurance broking and risk management, we are devoted to finding diverse individuals who are committed to the success of our clients and our organisation. Joining us will provide a solid foundation for you to accelerate your career in the risk and insurance industry. You will join a team of talented professionals from across the globe, who are dedicated to helping clients manage some of the world's most challenging and complex risks. We can promise you extraordinary challenges, extraordinary colleagues, and the opportunity to make a difference
* Our rich history has created a client service culture that we believe is second to none. Our commitments to Diversity and Inclusion , Corporate Social Responsibility , and sustainability demonstrate our commitment to stand for what is right

**What will you focus on:**

* Client dialogue decks to support initial discussions with clients and prospects, encompassing business overview, financial analysis, strategic priorities and risk assessment
* Prospect identification of companies around industries, locations, business type, etc.
* Industry assessment highlighting deep insights into addressable market size, industry trends, challenges, outlook, external drivers, as well as key existing and emerging risks
* Competitor analysis that highlights client/ prospects, competitors’ strategic objectives, key investments/ activities undertaken, and how these factors connect to potential opportunities
* Insurance market analysis that provides a detailed analysis of specific market and product line

**We will count on you to:**

* Invest in understanding our business thoroughly
* Independently deliver high-impact research engagements ─ projects commissioned by regional leaders, strategy and sales communities within the firm
* High attention to detail in both research and creation of end products, with focus on producing insightful, synthetized, well written outputs/ reports
* Be extremely responsive in daily work and showcase research process excellence
* Maintain regular project manager interaction for constant flow of information on delivery status, expectations, process changes and new opportunities
* Develop strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders through high-quality project delivery, responsiveness, and agile and clear communication
* Contribute to process improvement of the team by making relevant recommendations and executing the process initiatives to enhance the efficiency and quality of overall delivery

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelors / Masters in Economics or Masters in Business Administration (MBA) / equivalent post-graduation certification from a reputed institute
* 2 to 4 years of experience in strategy advisory, research (quantitative and qualitative | secondary) experience, at a leading professional services / consulting firm / market intelligence / research firm
* Strong commitment to absorb and engage in feedback discussions and enhancing own knowledge and quality of end products
* Proven ability to present project updates to stakeholders, with strong project management expertise
* Exposure in building frameworks, drawing data driven insights and performing analysis aligned to the ‘Sales Strategy’, focusing on clients / prospects, markets, competitors, products and regulatory developments
* Good understanding of financial concepts, global marketplace, key trends, economic and geo-political developments, key business and financial risks
* Strong understanding of strategy frameworks (PESTEL, Porter’s 5 forces, BCG Matrix, SWOT, etc.) and their applications in bringing out innovative insights
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem solving, storyboarding and report writing skills, and excellent communication skills – verbal, writing, listening
* Advanced level of proficiency in MS Office - PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and SharePoint
* Extensive exposure of commercial databases such as S&P Cap IQ, Factiva, Global Data, A.M Best Insurance service etc.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Exposure to working in a global setting
* Experience in risk consulting or insurance/ re-insurance related research or advisory support in related verticals
* Knowledge/ exposure of global insurance markets, risk advisory, enterprise risk management or risk consulting space

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Deputy Manager - B&M (Category Management)
description:
The Deputy Manager – Buying & Merchandising (Category Management) will support the seasonal range planning, assortment building, category performance management and commercial execution for the Footwear category.
  
  
The role will be responsible for translating category and business requirements into effective assortments, tracking seasonal deliveries, monitoring sell-through and category performance, supporting End of Season Sale (EOSS) planning, and providing actionable insights at store, region, gender, style and size levels.
  
  
The position will work closely with Buying, Merchandising, Retail Operations, Marketing, Planning, Product Development and Store teams to ensure successful execution of the seasonal category strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Season Range Planning & Assortment
* Support the development of seasonal range plans and assortment architecture for the Footwear category.
* Assist in building the right assortment based on category objectives, consumer preferences, store potential, historical performance and business requirements.
* Support assortment decisions across gender, category, style, size, price point and store grades.
* Participate in seasonal product conferences and contribute to product and assortment discussions.
* Identify assortment gaps and opportunities based on sales trends, market insights and category performance.
* Seasonal Product & Delivery Management
* Take ownership of tracking seasonal product deliveries for the respective category.
* Monitor delivery timelines against the agreed seasonal calendar and highlight potential delays or gaps.
* Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders to ensure timely availability of products across channels and stores.
* Maintain and update seasonal product trackers and provide regular visibility on delivery status.
* Buying & Merchandise Planning
* Support the Buying Manager in developing seasonal buy plans aligned with category and business objectives.
* Prepare and maintain seasonal buy forms, catalogues and relevant merchandising documentation.
* Support merchandise planning to ensure the right product, quantity and assortment is available across stores and channels.
* Monitor inventory and sell-through trends and provide recommendations for corrective actions wherever required.
* Category Performance & Sell-Through Management
* Monitor and analyse category performance on a periodic basis across regions, stores and store grades.
* Conduct detailed analysis at category, gender, style and size levels to identify key performance drivers and gaps.
* Track sell-through and identify slow-moving, underperforming and high-performing products.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve category productivity and inventory efficiency.
* Monitor performance against agreed GM% and category deliverables and highlight deviations.
* End of Season Sale (EOSS)
* Support the Buying Manager in EOSS planning and execution for the Footwear category.
* Analyze inventory ageing, sell-through and product performance to support markdown and liquidation decisions.
* Track EOSS performance and provide periodic updates on sales, inventory and sell-through.
* Support identification of products requiring specific interventions to optimize inventory liquidation.
* Marketing & Seasonal Initiatives
* Support the development and execution of the seasonal marketing calendar and key marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate with Marketing and relevant stakeholders to ensure category priorities are incorporated into seasonal campaigns.
* Support the creation of merchandise display plans for new-season products during the season.
* Ensure merchandising initiatives are aligned with product launches and category priorities.
* Product Knowledge & Store Training
* Conduct product training sessions for store teams to enhance product knowledge and selling effectiveness.
* Build awareness of key product features, technologies, benefits and selling propositions among store staff.
* Work with Retail Operations and store teams to ensure effective communication of seasonal product launches and priorities.
* Product Development & Channel Support
* Support new product development initiatives for key channels and business partners.
* Provide category and market inputs based on consumer trends, store-level performance and sales insights.
* Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to identify product opportunities and assortment requirements for specific channels/partners.
* Business Analytics & Insights
* Perform periodic, in-depth analysis of category performance across:

+ Region
+ Store and store grade
+ Category
+ Gender
+ Style
+ Size
+ Sell-through
+ Inventory/productivity

* Identify trends, opportunities and risks and translate data into actionable business recommendations.
* Prepare and present category performance reports and insights to relevant stakeholders.
* Support data-driven decision-making for range, assortment, replenishment and EOSS planning.

**Key Stakeholder Interfaces**
**The Role Will Work Closely With**

* Buying & Merchandising
* Retail Operations
* Planning & Allocation
* Marketing
* Product Development
* Finance
* Supply Chain
* Store Teams
* Key Channel / Business Partners

**Role Specifications**
**Qualification**

* Graduate from FDDI preferred.
* Additional qualification in Fashion, Retail, Merchandising, Business Management or a related discipline will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in Buying & Merchandising / Category Management, preferably within the Footwear, Fashion, Sportswear or Lifestyle Retail industry.
* Experience in seasonal range planning, assortment building and category performance management will be preferred.

**Key Competencies**
**Functional Competencies**

* Season range planning and assortment building
* Category management
* Sell-through management
* Merchandise planning
* EOSS planning and execution
* Category and store-level performance analysis
* Style and size-level analysis
* Inventory and assortment productivity
* GM% management
* Product knowledge and merchandising
* Retail and consumer understanding

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and numerical ability
* Commercial acumen
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Strong communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work collaboratively across functions
* Ownership and accountability
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven retail environment
* Strong presentation and data interpretation skills

**Key Success Measures**
**Success In The Role Will Be Measured Through**

* Effectiveness of seasonal range and assortment planning
* Category sell-through and productivity
* Achievement of agreed GM% deliverables
* Timely tracking and availability of seasonal deliveries
* Effectiveness of EOSS planning and inventory liquidation
* Category performance across stores, regions, styles and sizes
* Quality of business insights and recommendations
* Effectiveness of product knowledge and store training initiatives
* Successful execution of seasonal and category priorities

**About Skechers**
Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: FP&A Manager – Revenue
description:
**Our Story:**

Founded in 2000 by Dilip Modi, Spice Money Limited is India’s leading rural fintech company, headquartered in Noida and operating as a subsidiary of DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited, a publicly listed entity. The company is driven by a strong mission to accelerate financial inclusion and empower the underserved “Bharat” through technology-enabled financial services.

With a network of 1.6+ million Adhikaris across India, the company enables last-mile access to essential services including AEPS cash withdrawal and deposits, domestic money transfer, bill payments, insurance, micro-ATM services, credit solutions, travel bookings, account opening, and UPI-led digital payments. Spice Money has consistently introduced industry-first innovations such as a zero-cost Adhikari platform, one of India’s largest assisted payments networks, a rural credit marketplace, and Spice Money UPI & Spice Pay wallet to accelerate digital adoption in smaller towns and villages.

Operating across 95%+ pincodes with a team of 1,000+ employees, Spice Money combines the agility of a high-growth fintech with the scale and impact of a nationwide distribution network—creating meaningful economic opportunities and driving the next phase of financial inclusion in India.

**Why This Role Matters:**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue forecasts and budgets in collaboration with Sales and Business Heads.

* Build and maintain revenue MIS, dashboards, and management reporting packs for leadership and board reviews.
* Partner with Sales and Product teams on pricing, discounting, and margin analysis to support commercial decisions.

* Drive automation and improvement of revenue reporting processes and data accuracy.
* Work closely with Sales, Business, and Accounting teams to ensure revenue recognition aligns with actuals.
* Present insights and recommendations to senior management on revenue trends and forecast accuracy.

* Chartered Accountant with 5–6 years of experience in FP&A, revenue/commercial finance, or business finance roles, preferably with exposure to a high-growth, transaction-heavy business (fintech, BFSI, e-commerce, or similar).
* Demonstrated experience in revenue forecasting, MIS reporting, and business partnering with Sales/Commercial teams.
* Prior experience presenting to senior leadership or working closely with a CFO's office is preferred.
* Advanced Excel (financial modeling) and strong PowerPoint skills; working knowledge of Power BI/Tableau for dashboards.
* Familiarity with an ERP (SAP/Oracle) and SQL is a plus for pulling and validating transactional revenue data.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability; comfortable working with large, granular datasets.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills to influence Sales and business leaders.
* High attention to detail with the ability to work to tight monthly/quarterly close timelines.

title: Chartered Accountant
description:
**Position: Assistant Manager – Accounts & Finance**

**Level: Mid-Level**

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

1. Consolidating and analyzing financial data, considering financial standing.

2. Providing creative alternatives and recommendations to reduce costs and improve financial performance.

3. Assembling and summarizing data to structure sophisticated reports on financial status and risks

4. Develop financial models, conduct benchmarking, and process analysis.

5. Reconcile transactions by comparing and correcting data.

6. Lead annual budgeting, quarterly forecasts, and long-term financial planning, performing scenario analysis to assist senior management in strategic decision-making.

7. Monitor financial performance by preparing monthly/weekly Management Information Systems (MIS) and dashboards, analyzing Profit & Loss (P&L) statements, and conducting variance analysis against budgets/forecasts.

8. Collaborate with business units (e.g., Credit, Collections, Operations) to track KPIs, provide financial insights, and recommend actions for improvement or cost reduction.

9. Conduct revenue and Non-Performing Assets (NPA) analysis, highlighting trends and identifying drivers.

10. Assist with cash flow management, liquidity monitoring, and investment analysis.

**Requirements and Skills:**

1. Proven working experience as a Finance Analyst

2. Proficient in spreadsheets, databases, MS Office, and financial software applications

3. Hands on experience with statistical analysis and statistical packages

4. Outstanding presentation, reporting and communication skills

5. Proven knowledge of financial forecasting and diagnosis, corporate finance, and information analysis

6. Well informed in current financial subjects, accounting, tax laws, and business environments

7. CA or equivalent degree in Finance, Economics.

title: Manager - FP&A
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**EY – GDS**
–
**Consulting – Finance**
As part of our EY - Finance Consulting Team, you will help clients develop their Performance Improvement initiatives and identify potential opportunities for performance improvements drive them. This includes techno-functional role conducting finance processes assessments, deep diving and analysing pain areas and coming up with solutions. The client base spans across industries and countries.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Manager with expertise in BPRA (Business Planning Reporting & Analytics), and BPRA Process Assessment assignments. Also, experience in, Financial Accounting and Reporting domain
**is an added advantage**
to join the global EY - Finance Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledge on Financial Planning and Budgeting Processes, Financial Consolidation, Cost Allocation and Controllership, EPM tools
* Focus on the design and implementation of operating models in BPRA
* Design, configuration and implementation of BPRA processes in EPM tools
* Lead forecasting and financial planning process (Budgeting and long-range financial plan) for the client/enterprise by analyzing the trends of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), especially relating to financial metrics such as sales, expenditures, profit margin etc.
* Transform the overarching company strategy into a long-range plan, annual budget, capital budgets and forecast
* Advice capital allocation plan, revenue plan, Opex/Capex plan, and key cost drivers to create / revise Income statement, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow Forecasts
* Model how BPRA teams use information from multiple sources to model new assumptions, run sensitivity analysis and test alternatives, leverages analytical models and systematic projections (using in market expectations and other macro-trends) to identify updates required
* Review and explain key drivers, managing risks and opportunities, and updated forecast with Regional and Local leads, consolidating submissions and revisions from BUs, adjustments made as needed
* Provide regular/ad hoc strategic support to executive leadership (onshore/client) and provide support on current and future outlook, target setting outcome etc.
* Identify improvement opportunities in BPRA domain
* Process re-design and optimisation (AS-IS & TO-BE) leveraging BPM tools
* Identification of KPIs for CXO reporting and dashboarding
* Perform vendor analysis and prepare relevant analysis reports for clients
* Configuration and know how on activity-based costing models
* Partner directly with onshore finance teams/clients to collaborate on metrics, goals and business reviews
* Perform cost Accounting & cost categorization (People & Non people cost)
* Standardisation and streamline close processes leveraging leading practices and technology
* CoA design/re-design as per management and statutory reporting needs
* Build Management Reporting in tools like Power BI / Tableau / Qlik Sense / OneStream / Jedox / Anaplan / Hyperion / Board EPM
* Good Knowledge on ledger and sub-ledger systems; technical know-how of SAP ERP / HANA, Oracle GL (good to have)
* Knowledge in finance functions – ‘Record to report’, processes involving account reconciliations, Journals, Transaction matching, Variance analysis, intercompany and Fixed assets accounting / management (Good to have process knowledge of Procure to Pay and Order to Cash)
* Working knowledge of GBS / SSC setup engagements
* Should have knowledge of activities in financial close of an organisation for month / Quarter / Annual close periods
* Translate business requirements to technical language and model (good to have)
* Managing/ supervising teams of people on project work
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure
* Open to travel (Domestic & International)

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, tasks and adapt to a changing environment
* Must be organized, focused, and driven to meet established deliverable deadlines
* Ability to lead client workshops and guide on BPRA vision and strategy
* Agile, Learnability and problem-solving approach
* Consulting experience is a must have
* Confident & professional communication style
* Proficiency in English (oral and written)
* Ability to clearly articulate messages to a variety of audiences
* Flexible and adaptable; able to work in ambiguous situations
* Able to work effectively at all levels in an organization
* Must be a team player and able to work collaboratively with and through others
* Strong analytical skills as well as excellent problem-solving skills for interpreting the IFRS standards

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, OR Master’s in business administration in Finance
* 10-15 years of work experience in BPRA projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Anaplan/Tagetik/Oracle PBCS and EPBCS/Power BI/Tableau/OneStream/Board and relevant EPM tools

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Finance Transformation
* GBS/SSC Setup
* Project management skills, IFRS Implementation / IFRS Reporting Experience
* Exposure to tools like ERP, EPM tools, Visio, ARIS, etc.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* Opportunities to work with EY Advisory practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from world’s top companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
**Company Description**
GHC Growth Lab is focused on strengthening the startup ecosystem by helping convert innovative ideas into viable and scalable business models. The organization operates as a specialized consultancy for startups, offering tailored advisory and mentoring services. Its team consists of experienced and skilled professionals who emphasize quality, timely delivery, and a high level of professionalism. GHC Growth Lab is committed to providing customized support that addresses the specific needs and challenges faced by early-stage ventures.
  
**Role Description**
The Investment Banking Intern role at GHC Growth Lab is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi. The intern will support deal execution and advisory projects by assisting with financial modeling, valuation analysis, and investment research on startups across sectors. Day-to-day responsibilities include gathering and analyzing financial and market data, preparing pitch books and investor presentations, and contributing to due diligence activities. The intern will collaborate with senior team members on transaction documentation, help maintain internal databases and reports, and participate in client meetings and internal discussions as needed.
  
**Qualifications**

title: SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator
description:
**Job Title:**

SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator

**Department:**

SAP Solutions & Delivery

**Experience:**

3+ years of experience(Preferred)

**Employment Type:**

Full-Time

**Functional Expertise:**

SAP FICO preferred, with exposure to SAP S/4HANA and SAP integrations

**Reporting To:**

Delivery Head / Management

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**SAP Solution Lead / Project Coordinator**

with strong SAP functional knowledge, business analysis capabilities, and project delivery experience.

The role will act as a bridge between customers, business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, and technical developers, ensuring that business requirements are clearly understood, translated into appropriate solution designs, and delivered within agreed timelines.

The primary objective is to
**strengthen functional ownership and delivery coordination**

, allowing the existing SAP development team to focus on technical implementation while ensuring business alignment, solution quality, and predictable project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Business Requirements & Functional Analysis

* Engage with customers and stakeholders to understand business processes and requirements.
* Conduct requirement-gathering workshops and functional discussions.
* Translate business requirements into functional specifications and development-ready requirements.
* Identify functional gaps, dependencies, and integration requirements.
* Prepare Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Specification Documents (FSD), and process flows.

2. SAP Solution Design & Functional Leadership

* Evaluate business requirements and recommend suitable SAP solutions.
* Provide functional guidance to SAP ABAP developers and integration teams.
* Review proposed solutions for functional accuracy and business alignment.
* Support SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and third-party integration requirements.
* Coordinate solution design reviews and technical feasibility discussions.
* Ensure consistency with SAP best practices and customer expectations.

3. Project Planning & Delivery Coordination

* Develop project plans, milestones, delivery schedules, and resource requirements.
* Coordinate tasks across functional, development, QA, and deployment teams.
* Track project progress, dependencies, risks, and deliverables.
* Conduct regular project reviews and communicate status to management.
* Identify potential delivery delays and initiate corrective actions.
* Support multiple concurrent SAP projects and customer engagements.

4. Stakeholder & Customer Management

* Serve as the primary functional and delivery coordination point for assigned projects.
* Facilitate communication between customers, internal teams, and management.
* Manage requirement clarifications, change requests, and scope discussions.
* Coordinate customer demonstrations, reviews, and solution walkthroughs.
* Ensure clear ownership, accountability, and timely resolution of open items.

5. Testing, Deployment & Delivery Assurance

* Define functional acceptance criteria and support test scenario preparation.
* Coordinate SIT, UAT, defect resolution, and customer sign-off.
* Verify that delivered functionality meets agreed requirements.
* Support deployment planning, go-live readiness, and post-production stabilization.
* Maintain functional documentation, project records, and delivery handover materials.

Required Skills & Qualifications

**SAP Functional Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of SAP business processes and functional modules.
* SAP FICO expertise preferred.
* Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC.
* Familiarity with SAP ABAP development concepts, BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs, APIs, and integration scenarios.
* Ability to review functional specifications and communicate effectively with developers.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Proven experience coordinating SAP implementation, enhancement, support, or integration projects.
* Strong requirement-gathering and functional documentation skills.
* Experience in project planning, task tracking, risk management, and delivery reporting.
* Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Experience working directly with customers and cross-functional technical teams.

**Communication & Leadership**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent stakeholder coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and delivery commitments.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and decision-making capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related discipline.
* 3+ years of relevant SAP functional and delivery experience.
* At least 2 years of SAP project coordination or functional leadership experience.
* SAP certification in FICO or S/4HANA is an advantage.
* Exposure to SAP integrations with external enterprise applications, financial systems, and reconciliation platforms.

**Expected Deliverables**

The successful candidate will be responsible for :

* Clearly documented and validated customer requirements.
* Functional specifications ready for technical development.
* Approved solution designs with defined scope and acceptance criteria.
* Structured project plans, milestones, and delivery trackers.
* Regular project status reports with risks, blockers, and action items.
* Coordinated SIT, UAT, customer sign-offs, and deployments.
* Improved predictability, quality, and timeliness of SAP project delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Requirement completeness and accuracy.
* Functional specification quality and development readiness.
* On-time achievement of project milestones.
* Reduction in requirement-related rework.
* Stakeholder communication and issue-resolution effectiveness.
* UAT acceptance and successful delivery sign-offs.
* Overall customer satisfaction and delivery efficiency.

Role Positioning

**This is a functional leadership and delivery coordination role, not a hands-on ABAP development position.**

The candidate must possess sufficient SAP functional and technical understanding to guide development teams, resolve requirement ambiguities, coordinate stakeholders, and take ownership of delivery commitments.

**Our Goal:**

Establish a strong functional and delivery ownership layer between customers and our SAP development team, enabling developers to concentrate on technical execution while improving solution alignment, project governance, and delivery reliability.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
Legal Counsel, Channels
  
  
Bangalore, India preferred (Hybrid in office 2 days a week) | Open to fully remote within India for the right candidate
  
  
**About Our Team**
The Rubrik Commercial Legal Team manages Rubrik's global commercial contracts and revenue-related legal matters. Within Commercial Legal, the Channels & Alliances legal team supports Rubrik's partner ecosystem: the distributors, resellers, managed service providers, global and regional system integrators, and alliance partners through which Rubrik sells its data security and cyber resilience products worldwide.
  
  
Rubrik goes to market primarily through a two-tier channel: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, the Distributor sells to a Reseller, and the Reseller sells to the end Customer. This role is the day-to-day legal partner for that business unit. You will be the first point of contact for the Channels organization on reseller and distributor agreements, amendments and partner program requests, keeping deals moving and partners compliant. You will join a small, collaborative team and work alongside a Channels Legal Counsel peer, reporting to the Director of Legal who leads Channels & Alliances, Marketplaces and Inbound Licensing.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for an attorney who already works in the channel world, enjoys negotiating with partners and wants to be a trusted advisor to a fast-moving sales organization.
  
  
Where You Can Make an Impact
  
  

* Own day-to-day channel contracting: Draft, review and negotiate reseller agreements, distributor agreements, amendments, adoption agreements for partner affiliates, resale enablement amendments and other documents partners need to resell Rubrik's SaaS and subscription products.
* Live in the two-tier channel model: Apply a deep working knowledge of Rubrik's go-to-market: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, who sells to a Reseller, who sells to the end Customer. Understand how order flow, pricing and discounts, deal registration, flow-down terms and end-user agreements work across each tier, and spot when a request breaks the model.
* Be the front door for the Channels organization: Manage the channel contract-request intake queue. Triage, prioritize and route incoming requests, resolve routine matters yourself and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation.
* Support the Partner Program: Advise Partner Programs and Partner Operations on partner program requests, program terms and conditions, tier and status changes, program exceptions, incentive and referral arrangements, and partner onboarding and offboarding.
* Advise channel leaders and account managers: Act as a trusted advisor to Channel Account Managers, Distribution leaders, Alliances and the Channels Global Partner Organization. Answer their questions with practical, business-ready guidance and help them close deals on standard terms.
* Negotiate directly with partners: Lead negotiations and calls with partner legal, procurement and business teams. Hold Rubrik's standard positions, use approved fallbacks and know when to escalate.
* Build and maintain templates and playbooks: Create and update channel agreement templates, amendment forms, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, FAQs and training so the ecosystem stays on standard terms and the business can self-serve.
* Drive deals to signature: Coordinate internal approvals, signature requests and e-signature execution, and work with Partner Operations and Deal Desk so executed agreements are recorded correctly in Salesforce and partners can transact.
* Apply a compliance and competition lens: Identify and escalate antitrust and competition law issues common to distribution (resale price maintenance, dual distribution, territorial and customer restrictions, exclusivity), as well as anti-corruption, sanctions and export, and public-sector procurement issues.
* Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Commercial Legal, Privacy, Security, Revenue, Tax, Deal Desk and Partner Operations to deliver consistent answers and keep channel terms aligned with Rubrik's customer-facing terms.
* Support a global channel: Work IST business hours while supporting partners and stakeholders worldwide, with a primary focus on APAC and EMEA and meaningful AMER coverage. Flex your hours during quarter-end and other peak periods to support AMER deals.
* Improve how we work: Spot repeat questions and bottlenecks, propose process and template fixes, and use technology (including AI tools) to speed up routine work.

Ideal Background
  
  

* Licensed attorney in India (LL.B. and enrolled with a State Bar Council) with 3 to 6 years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house experience at a technology or SaaS company.
* Currently working in a channel, partner or distribution contracting role. You negotiate reseller and distributor agreements today and understand two-tier distribution and how SaaS is resold through partners.
* Comfortable negotiating directly with partner legal and procurement teams and advising business stakeholders without a safety net.
* Working knowledge of partner programs, deal registration, subscription and SaaS commercial models, and how channel terms interact with end-customer terms.
* Awareness of competition and compliance issues in distribution relationships and of anti-bribery and anti-corruption rules that apply to selling through partners.
* Excellent English drafting and communication skills. You write clearly, explain risk in business terms and give a recommendation, not a menu.
* Organized and reliable in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You prioritize well, track your queue and close the loop.
* Independent, proactive and business-oriented, with sound judgment about what to decide and what to escalate.
* Experience with Salesforce, DocuSign or similar e-signature tools, and contract lifecycle management systems is a plus.
* Willingness to flex working hours periodically to support AMER-based deals and quarter-end activity.

Working Model
  
  
Our preferred candidate is based in Bangalore and works from the Rubrik office two days a week. We will consider remote candidates elsewhere in India for the right fit. You will work standard IST business hours and support a global partner base, with a primary emphasis on APAC and EMEA and regular AMER coverage. Periodic late-evening availability for AMER deals and quarter-end is expected, but not an everyday requirement.
  
  
Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation
  
  
Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.
  
  
Linkedin | X (formerly Twitter) | Instagram | Rubrik.com
  
  
Inclusion @ Rubrik
  
  
At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.
  
  
Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. description:

**About the Role:**

We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Global Legal Lawyer**
with
**10+ years of post-qualification legal experience**
to lead and support the company’s legal, regulatory, compliance, and commercial requirements across multiple international jurisdictions.

The ideal candidate will have strong practical knowledge of
**US, Europe & APAC regulatory frameworks**
, with experience advising technology-driven businesses operating across borders. Experience in
**AI, software, SaaS, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies**
will be highly valued.

The candidate should be comfortable working directly with senior management, business teams, investors, customers, partners, and external counsel across jurisdictions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Global Legal & Regulatory Advisory**

* Provide strategic legal advice on business operations across the United States, Singapore, and European jurisdictions.
* Monitor and interpret applicable international laws, regulations, and regulatory developments.
* Advise leadership on legal risks associated with global expansion, products, partnerships, and commercial activities.
* Coordinate with local and international external counsel where specialist or jurisdiction-specific advice is required.

**2. AI, Technology & Data Law:**

* Advise on legal and regulatory issues relating to AI, generative AI, QPIAI, machine learning, software, SaaS, and emerging technologies.
* Support compliance with applicable AI and technology regulations, including relevant U.S., Singaporean, and European frameworks.
* Advise on data protection, privacy, data transfers, data usage, cybersecurity, and data governance.
* Review legal implications of AI models, datasets, automated decision-making, intellectual property, and technology deployments.

**3. Commercial & Corporate Legal:**

* Draft, review, negotiate, and manage - Master Service Agreements (MSAs)SaaS and technology agreements, Licensing agreements, NDAs, Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), Vendor and procurement agreements Partnership and strategic alliance agreements, Employment and consulting agreements, Customer and enterprise contracts
* Support corporate transactions, investments, fundraising, restructuring, and international expansion.
* Establish and maintain appropriate legal policies, templates, playbooks, and contract processes.

**4. Privacy & Compliance:**

* Develop and oversee global privacy and compliance programs.
* Advise on requirements under relevant U.S. privacy laws, Singapore's PDPA, and European data protection frameworks including GDPR.
* Work with security, engineering, product, HR, and compliance teams to identify and mitigate regulatory risks.
* Support regulatory inquiries, audits, investigations, and compliance assessments.

**5. Intellectual Property**

Advise on protection, licensing, ownership, and commercialization of:

* Software
* AI/ML technologies
* Algorithms Data and datasets Trademarks Copyrights
* Patents and trade secrets

Develop strategies for protecting the company's intellectual property across jurisdictions.

**6. Risk Management & Governance**

* Identify and assess legal and regulatory risks associated with international operations.
* Develop practical risk-mitigation strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Support corporate governance, board matters, policies, and regulatory compliance.
* Maintain a strong legal-risk framework appropriate for a rapidly growing technology company.

**Required Qualifications**

* LLB, LLM, or equivalent recognized law degree.
* **10+ years of post-qualification legal experience, preferably with substantial in-house and/or technology-sector experience.**
* Qualified/admitted to practice in at least one major jurisdiction; qualification in the U.S., Singapore, UK, EU member state, or another recognized jurisdiction is desirable.
* Demonstrated experience working with cross-border legal and regulatory matters.
* Strong working knowledge of applicable laws and regulatory frameworks in the U.S., Singapore, and Europe.
* Strong understanding of technology, AI, privacy, data protection, intellectual property, and commercial law.
* Experience negotiating complex international commercial agreements.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with business, technical, compliance, and executive teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience advising AI, SaaS, fintech, cybersecurity, cloud, or other technology companies.
* Practical knowledge of GDPR, EU AI Act, Singapore PDPA, and major U.S. federal/state privacy and technology regulations.
* Experience with international data transfers and cross-border data governance.
* Experience managing external law firms across multiple jurisdictions.
* Experience supporting fundraising, M&A, strategic partnerships, or international corporate expansion.
* Prior experience working with regulators or handling regulatory investigations is advantageous.
* Experience establishing legal functions, compliance frameworks, and contract-management processes in a growing company.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic and commercial legal judgment
* International regulatory expertise
* Strong contract negotiation skills
* AI and technology-law knowledge
* Privacy and data-protection expertise
* Risk assessment and mitigation
* Excellent stakeholder management
* Ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical business guidance
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, global environment

The right candidate will act as a
**strategic legal partner to the business**
, enabling international growth while ensuring that products, operations, contracts, data practices, and AI-related activities are appropriately structured and compliant across relevant jurisdictions.

description:
**Innovate in Bengaluru**
This position is based at our on-site office in Bengaluru. Lowe's offers an ultramodern work environment, complete with cutting-edge technology, collaborative workspaces, an on-site gym and clinic, and other perks to enhance your work experience.
  
  
****About Lowe’s****
Lowe’s is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2024 sales of more than $83 billion, Lowe’s operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. For more information, visit Lowes.com
  
  
****About Lowe’s India****
Lowe’s India, the Global Capability Center of Lowe’s Companies Inc., is a hub for driving our technology, business, analytics, and shared services strategy. Based in Bengaluru with over 4,500 associates, it powers innovations across omnichannel retail, AI/ML enterprise architecture, supply chain, and customer experience. From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India
  
  
****About The Team****
Doing business legally and with integrity is at the heart of how we serve our customers, communities, and fellow associates. The Legal team works diligently to protect Lowe’s reputation and brand
  
  
****JOB SUMMARY****
The Legal Senior Compliance Analyst supports Lowe’s global Compliance & Ethics program with a focus on anti-corruption, business ethics and third-party due diligence.
  
  
The role conducts due diligence screening, analyzes compliance risks, supports business teams on the Code of Business Conduct & Ethics, and assists with compliance initiatives across India and global operations.
  
  
In office, full time role. Shift timings: 9 AM to 05 PM IST
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Execute enterprise-wide anti-corruption and third-party due diligence screening globally, including data compilation, screening, evaluation and analysis of due diligence reports.
* Identify, document and escalate due diligence red flags and potential compliance risks for appropriate review.
* Support execution of the global Compliance & Ethics program in India, primarily in anti-corruption and business ethics.
* Provide compliance guidance to business teams on Lowe’s Code of Business Conduct & Ethics and related requirements.
* Support compliance reviews, risk assessments, documentation, follow-up activities and periodic reporting.
* Review compliance-related contractual requirements and maintain accurate due diligence and approval records.
* Collaborate with Legal, Compliance and business stakeholders to ensure timely closure of compliance matters.
* Conduct and oversee preventative training on business ethics and anti-corruption.
* Track and monitor ethics and compliance trends globally and prepare summary reports for stakeholders.
* Own and maintain the compliance data repository, including due diligence, training, procedures and supporting documentation.
* Provide process guidance to junior team members and support continuous improvement of compliance controls.

****EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS****
Education Details
  
  
****Required****
Required Minimum Qualification: LL.B. or LL.M. graduate.
  
  
****Preferred****
Required Minimum Qualification: LL.B. or LL.M. graduate.
  
  
****Work Experience****
Experience Details
  
  
****Required****
4–6 years of relevant work experience in an MNC, law firm, legal/compliance function or similar corporate environment.
  
  
**Licenses and Certifications**
****Required****
Bar council enrollment
