title: Senior IP Laws Specialist
description:
The role will be responsible for validating and maintaining of IP Laws/rules, related IP Laws operations for operationalizing various products within Protect Delivery. This role should enable the “Law Engine” that powers our technology-enabled solutions – ensuring that jurisdictional rules, deadlines, fee structures and procedural logic are accurately formalized, validated, codified, maintained and embedded into our platforms.Working closely with the Head of IP laws, product teams, IP Operations, and external agents and authorities, this role contributes to the effective operations and delivery of IP Laws operations.
  
  
**About Protect**
We help Protect our customers’ ideas and innovations
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Job Overview**

* Conduct in-depth research into Laws, rules and renewal and fees for Patents, design, trademarks, plant variety rights across major global jurisdictions
* Creation of fresh IP Laws rules and renewal and fees for Patents, design, trademarks, plant variety rights across major global jurisdictions as per stakeholder requirements
* Research, analyse and validate IP Laws for accuracy before codifying into software
* Proactive research, monitoring IP office, law firm’s newsletter, internal and external resources for identifying timely law changes
* Contribute to process standardisation, efficiency, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Partner effectively with IP Operations teams, product team to ensure smooth end-to-end IP Laws operations and delivery.
* Regulatory insight across Protect by monitoring, interpreting and communicating changes to IP laws, rules, procedures and fees across all relevant jurisdictions.
* Maintain an authoritative, up-to-date knowledge base of jurisdictional requirements covering filing, prosecution, renewals, recordals and related IP procedures.
* Enable proactive compliance by translating evolving statutory and procedural requirements into clear, actionable guidance for service lines, regional teams and technology platforms.
* Provide early warning of legislative, treaty and procedural change (e.g. new IP offices, fee changes, deadline rule changes), assessing operational and client impact and coordinating response.
* Enable the legal “law engine” that powers our technology-enabled solutions, ensuring jurisdictional rules, deadlines, fee schedules and procedural logic are accurately codified and maintained.
* Partner with Technology, Product and Data, Analytics & Automation teams to embed legal rules and compliance logic into core fulfilment systems and client-facing platforms.
* Validate and govern the legal accuracy of automated laws, rules, calculations and workflows, providing sign-off and ongoing assurance as rules change.
* Define and maintain the framework for capturing, updating and version-controlling jurisdictional rules so that the law engine remains a single, trusted source of legal truth.
* Own the legal compliance framework for IP processes across Protect Delivery, ensuring enterprise processes meet applicable statutory and procedural obligations.
* Identify, assess and escalate legal and regulatory risks, working with Business IP Service Owners and Regional Service Leaders to implement mitigation and controls.
* Support governance and audit activities, ensuring procedures, controls and records meet professional, regulatory and client requirements.
* Advise on data protection, confidentiality, conflicts and professional conduct considerations relevant to the delivery of IP services.
* Maintain awareness of relevant treaties, conventions and regional frameworks (e.g. PCT, Madrid, Hague, EPC) and their operational implications.
* Ensure quality-assurance of legal and jurisdictional research in support of service lines, clients and solutions.
* Provide authoritative legal interpretation and advice on complex or non-standard IP procedural matters referred from regional teams or Business IP Service Owners.
* Develop standardised legal research methodologies, templates and knowledge assets to ensure consistency, accuracy and efficiency.
* Develop an internal database for storing all IP laws, rules, fees for all IP types across multiple jurisdictions
* Develop an internal hyperlink or page for easy access to other owners and stakeholders for accessing new law changes.
* Operate as an enabling capability within the IP Ops Hub, partnering with Business IP Service Owners (Filing, Renewals, Recordals, Translations) and Regional Service Leaders.
* Partner with Technology, Product and Innovation teams to align legal requirements with the technology roadmap and emerging solutions.
* Work with Training & Governance to embed legal and regulatory knowledge across regional operational teams.
* Collaborate with Finance, Payments and supply chain functions on fee accuracy, jurisdictional cost structures and official fee management.
* Engage with external counsel, IP offices, agents and professional bodies where required to validate or clarify jurisdictional requirements.
* Define and monitor KPIs for the IP Law function, including rule accuracy, research turnaround, compliance coverage and law-engine currency.
* Drive continuous improvement of legal research, rule maintenance and compliance processes, leveraging automation and analytics where appropriate.
* Capture and apply learnings from regulatory change, audits and incidents to strengthen processes and reduce risk.
* Contribute legal and compliance insight to enterprise-level reporting and governance forums.
* Foster a trusting and collaborative work environment that encourages professional growth and self-development.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning, integrity and professional excellence within the team.
* Lead by example, demonstrating the values and behaviours that reflect RWS’s commitment to quality, integrity and client excellence.
* Encourage open communication and psychological safety, ensuring team members feel empowered to raise ideas, concerns and feedback.

**Skills & Experience**

* A qualified IP professional or legally trained specialist with significant experience in IP law and procedure (a recognised IP/legal qualification is advantageous).
* Experience of 3-7 years in an IP legal, paralegal or regulatory role, ideally within the IP industry or a professional services environment.
* Deep working knowledge of IP filing, prosecution, renewals and recordals procedures across multiple jurisdictions, including key treaties and conventions (e.g. PCT, Madrid, Hague, EPC).
* Demonstrable experience interpreting and applying complex jurisdictional rules, deadlines and fee structures.
* Experience codifying or maintaining legal/procedural rules within technology platforms, rules engines or automated workflows is highly advantageous.
* Experience working with technology, product, data and operational teams to translate legal requirements into solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail capabilities, with a rigorous and accurate approach.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex legal matters clearly to non-legal stakeholders.
* Ability to prioritise and multi-task in a fast-paced environment, managing competing demands with confidence.

title: Contracts Administrator 3-Fin
description:
**Job Description**
The Contracts Administrator job is comprised of either a Deal Specialist or a Deal Manager role. Both work in a multi-cultural environment and cover multiple countries and/or lines of business. The work is fast-paced and seasonal in nature, corresponding with Oracle’s quarterly and annual fiscal cycles.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Deal Specialist creates, validates and processes contract documentation using Oracle's standard document templates, a set of contract options and in accordance with Oracle's policies and business approvals, in response to requests received from Sales. The Deal Specialist follows defined engagement guidelines to liaise with other Deal Management teams, Finance, Legal, and other groups across Oracle to ensure policy compliance and mitigate corporate risk. **About The Role**
The Data Governance Specialist executes a range of workstreams in delivering the design and implementation of BT Group's data governance strategy, advancing the organisation's thinking of data governance concepts and understanding of the benefits of data governance policies and procedures.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Maintain accurate information asset registers, including ownership, purpose, location, classification, processing activity, retention requirement and lifecycle status.
* Develop, maintain and operationalise retention and disposal schedules using legal, regulatory, contractual and business requirements.
* Apply and assure security classification, handling, access, storage, transfer, archival and disposal requirements across information assets.
* Support the establishment and ongoing maintenance of Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), ensuring processing purposes, personal-data categories, data subjects, recipients, transfers, retention periods and security measures are recorded.
* Perform data and information mapping to identify where information is created, stored, shared, transformed, archived and deleted.
* Work with Legal, Privacy, Security, Records Management and Data Owners to interpret obligations and document defensible control decisions.
* Configure, test or support lifecycle controls in Microsoft 365, Microsoft Purview, cloud platforms, repositories and business applications.
* Coordinate periodic reviews, exception management and remediation for assets with missing ownership, classification, retention rules or disposal evidence.
* Support legal holds, investigations, eDiscovery, data-subject rights, audits and regulatory requests by locating and preserving relevant information.
* Monitor control effectiveness and prepare evidence and reporting on register coverage, RoPA completeness, retention compliance, overdue disposal and exceptions.
* Identify opportunities to automate classification, retention labelling, disposition review, evidence capture and control monitoring.
* Provide guidance and training to information owners and custodians, and promote consistent lifecycle-management practices across BT.
* Support continuous improvement by tracking changes in legislation, regulation, standards, technology and business processes

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in information lifecycle management, records management, information governance, privacy operations, data governance or a related control discipline.
* Practical experience maintaining information asset registers, records inventories, retention schedules, file plans or disposal processes.
* Good understanding of UK GDPR principles and accountability requirements, including lawful processing, purpose limitation, data minimisation, storage limitation, security, individual rights and privacy by design.
* Experience establishing, maintaining or assuring Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) and supporting data or information mapping.
* Knowledge of records classification, security classification, retention, archival, legal hold, defensible disposal and evidence requirements.
* Working knowledge of relevant legislation and regulation, including UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025, the Freedom of Information Act 2000 and the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations 2003.
* Experience with information-governance or records tooling such as Microsoft Purview, Microsoft 365 retention and records management, OneTrust, BigID, ServiceNow GRC or equivalent.
* Ability to interpret policy and legal requirements and translate them into clear operational controls, procedures and records.
* Experience supporting assurance, audit, information requests, data-subject rights, investigations or regulatory evidence collection.
* Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder-management and communication skills across business, legal and technology teams.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**

* Knowledge of ISO 15489, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, DAMA-DMBOK or equivalent information-governance practices.
* Experience implementing lifecycle controls across cloud environments, particularly GCP, and across structured and unstructured information.
* Awareness of AI information-lifecycle risks, including provenance, permissions, retention, model or use-case inventories and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
* Experience with Power BI or equivalent reporting and dashboarding tools.
* A relevant degree or professional certification such as IGP, CIP, CIPP/E, CIPM, DAMA CDMP, Microsoft Purview or a recognised records-management qualification.

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
  
  
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
  
  
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

**Introduction**
The Analyst supports the team in managing

title: Liaison Officer
description:
**Liaison Officer**

**Loop by Zolo**

**Navigate authorities. Close approvals. Keep properties compliant and operational.**

**Why this role exists**

Running hospitality properties requires more than strong on-ground operations.

Each property must work within local regulatory requirements and regularly coordinate with government departments and external authorities for approvals, documentation, notices, inspections, and other statutory requirements.

For Loop's Bangalore portfolio, this requires someone who understands how to navigate these processes on the ground and can take matters from
**requirement to closure**
.

This role exists to ensure that:

* Government and authority-related requirements are handled proactively
* Required approvals and documentation are completed on time
* Notices and official communications receive timely action
* Regulatory matters do not remain unresolved or affect property operations
* Internal teams have clear visibility into pending requirements
* Relationships with relevant external authorities are managed professionally

**Your mandate is clear**

* Liaise with
  **BBMP, Police and other relevant government authorities**
* Coordinate approvals, submissions, inspections and follow-ups
* Manage notices and official communications received from authorities
* Maintain required statutory and compliance documentation
* Work with internal teams to collect and complete required information
* Track every regulatory requirement through to closure
* Escalate potential risks before they become operational problems

**This is not a documentation-only role. It is an on-ground liaison and execution role where success means getting requirements closed accurately, professionally and on time.**

**About Zolo and Loop by Zolo**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living by bringing together professionally managed homes, essential services, technology, and community into one seamless experience.

**Loop by Zolo**
brings together affordable stays, social experiences, and community-led travel for a new generation of travellers.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveller with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation — delivering experiences customers can rely on while building businesses that operate responsibly and sustainably.

**What you will be responsible for**

**1. Government & Authority Liaison**

* Coordinate with BBMP, Police and other relevant government departments and external authorities
* Represent Loop for routine regulatory and documentation-related matters
* Understand requirements raised by authorities and coordinate the necessary response
* Follow up consistently until matters are resolved
* Maintain professional working relationships with relevant external stakeholders
* Keep internal stakeholders informed about progress, requirements and potential risks

**2. Approvals, Licences & Regulatory Requirements**

* Coordinate submissions required for relevant approvals, permissions and regulatory requirements
* Understand documentation requirements and ensure complete submissions
* Track applications, approvals and renewals through closure
* Coordinate with properties and internal teams for supporting documents
* Maintain visibility into upcoming expiries, renewals and pending approvals
* Flag delays or risks requiring leadership intervention

**3. Notices & Official Communications**

* Receive and track notices or communications from government departments and authorities
* Understand the requirement and identify the appropriate internal stakeholders
* Coordinate information and documentation required for responses
* Ensure responses and follow-ups happen within required timelines
* Maintain records of notices, responses and final closure
* Escalate sensitive or high-risk matters to the appropriate team promptly

**4. Statutory & Compliance Documentation**

* Support the team with required statutory, legal and compliance-related documentation
* Maintain organised records of approvals, submissions, correspondence and supporting documents
* Ensure documents are complete, accurate and readily accessible when required
* Coordinate document collection across properties and internal functions
* Support inspections, audits or verification requirements where applicable

**5. Drive Closure Across Stakeholders**

* Work closely with Operations, Legal, Finance, Property teams and other relevant internal stakeholders
* Clearly communicate what information or action is required from each team
* Follow up until dependencies are completed
* Coordinate with external consultants or stakeholders wherever required
* Ensure matters do not remain pending because of gaps in internal coordination
* Maintain clear ownership and timelines for every open requirement

**6. Maintain Regulatory Trackers & Visibility**

* Maintain trackers for approvals, notices, submissions, renewals and pending matters
* Keep status and documentation updated regularly
* Highlight ageing or high-risk items requiring intervention
* Provide clear updates to leadership on open and closed matters
* Ensure no critical regulatory deadline is missed because of poor tracking or follow-through

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Government and authority-related matters are handled smoothly and professionally
* Approvals, submissions and renewals are completed within required timelines
* Notices receive timely and appropriate action
* Regulatory requirements have clear owners, timelines and status
* Documentation is complete, accurate and easily accessible
* Pending matters are actively followed through rather than repeatedly escalated
* Internal teams have clear visibility into regulatory requirements
* Potential compliance risks are identified early
* Strong working relationships are established with relevant authorities and external stakeholders

**The business spends less time chasing regulatory matters because there is clear ownership from requirement to closure.**

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You are comfortable working directly with government departments and external authorities
* You know how to navigate processes without losing patience or follow-through
* You are persistent and don't leave matters halfway
* You communicate confidently and professionally with different stakeholders
* You are comfortable spending significant time on the ground
* You maintain strong documentation and follow-up discipline
* You know when to resolve something independently and when to escalate
* You can manage multiple open requirements without losing track of deadlines
* You take ownership of closure rather than simply passing information between teams

**Experience we value**

* Prior experience in
  **Liaison / Government Relations / Regulatory Coordination / Property Compliance / Administrative Liaison**
  roles
* Experience coordinating with
  **BBMP, Police or other government/local authorities**
* Exposure to hospitality, hotels, hostels, real estate, property management, facility management or similar businesses will be valuable
* Experience handling official notices, approvals, submissions or statutory documentation
* Strong local knowledge of Bangalore and familiarity with relevant government processes will be an advantage
* Comfortable with regular local travel and on-ground coordination

**Existing authority relationships can help, but integrity, process understanding, persistence and the ability to drive matters to closure are more important.**

**The impact you will have**

Your work will directly help:

* Keep Loop properties operationally ready
* Reduce delays in approvals and regulatory requirements
* Ensure notices and authority matters are handled on time
* Reduce regulatory and documentation-related risks
* Give Operations teams greater confidence to focus on running properties
* Create stronger discipline around compliance and statutory requirements

You become the bridge between
**our properties, internal teams and the external authorities we need to work with.**

**Why join now**

Loop is building its presence in Bangalore, and as the portfolio grows, regulatory coordination becomes increasingly important.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a function that directly enables properties to operate smoothly.

You won't simply maintain documents or forward requests.

**You will navigate requirements, work with authorities, coordinate teams and take matters all the way to closure — helping build the regulatory foundation on which Loop can scale.**

title: Forensic Technology Lead
description:
**Job Description**

**About The Function**

Legal at Diageo is about more than managing risk, it’s about helping the business move forward in the right way.
  
  
Working across a global portfolio of brands, this team navigates complex legal and regulatory landscapes, from intellectual property and compliance to corporate activity and commercial partnerships. They work closely with teams across the business, offering clear, pragmatic advice that supports confident decision-making.
  
  
It’s a fast-moving, ever-evolving environment where no two challenges are the same. You’ll need sound judgement, curiosity and the ability to see the bigger picture, balancing risk with opportunity in a way that protects our business while enabling it to grow.
  
  
You’ll be part of a global community of lawyers who are not only experts in their field, but trusted partners to the business, shaping outcomes, influencing decisions and helping bring our brands to life responsibly.
  
  
**About The role**

This role is critical to ensuring Diageo’s investigations capability is fit for purpose in a digital world. The Forensic Technology Lead will develop the capabilities investigators need to quickly and effectively identify, access and review relevant documentation and communication.
  
  
The Forensic Technology lead will advise the business on how to harness developments in technology to save time and cost, and increase effectiveness of the investigation team, while preserving the integrity and confidentiality fundamental to the process.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Responsible for the effective adoption of digital forensic and eDiscovery capabilities in connection with internal investigations, including:
* developing efficient workflows and quality control processes,
* improving the use of existing tools and capabilities
* identifying new opportunities for the use of technology,
* liaising with third party providers
* ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory expectations for example in relation to privacy.
* Lead the development of data collection and analysis for investigations, identifying relevant stakeholders, designing appropriate oversight and approval, leveraging complimentary projects and capabilities elsewhere in Diageo, and building analysis toolkits to support a more effective, efficient and standardised investigations capability
* Develop proactive investigative and monitoring capabilities, working with other departments including Internal Audit and Global Business Services to ensure coordinated design of tools building on existing capabilities
* Provide practical advice on the application of technology to enable the delivery of individual investigation matters
* Support the transformation of the investigation team and the broader Business Integrity and Legal functions, including keeping stakeholders informed of relevant developments and best practice in the area.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical capability and the ability to communicate this analysis clearly to a diverse range of stakeholders
* Clarity in determining the key steps necessary to assess compliance with laws or policies and the ability to produce and present effective reports on complex investigations.
* Integrity, professionalism and empathy:
* the role requires strong ethical values, the ability to build trust by acting with integrity and sensitivity in dealing with delicate situations and potentially conflicting priorities.
* Influencing and Stakeholder Management
* Builds trusted relationships across the region and globally, communicates complex issues clearly, influencing outcomes through collaboration and credibility.

**Experience/skills required:**
  
  

* The candidate will be an investigations and forensic technology professional, with at least 10 years relevant experience.
* They will possess qualifications and practical experience in at least one of digital forensic collection and analysis, eDiscovery processing and hosting, or forensic data analytics and visualisation, and ideally more than one.

  
  
**Working with Us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
  
  
  
  
Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
  
  
We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
  
  
Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

title: Conga CLM Administrator – Legal Operations
description:
**About Pinnacle Group**

Pinnacle Group is a global workforce solutions and professional services organization dedicated to helping businesses operate more efficiently, manage complexity, and achieve their strategic objectives. Our success is built on operational excellence, innovative solutions, and strong partnerships across our global teams. We are committed to building an environment where talented professionals can take ownership, drive meaningful improvements, and make a measurable impact.

**Summary**

Pinnacle Group is seeking a highly organized, technology-driven
**Legal Operations Specialist**
to play a critical role in optimizing our legal department's operations and contract lifecycle management processes. This position will serve as a key administrator of our Conga Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform, supporting its implementation, configuration, user training, adoption, and ongoing administration, while overseeing contract intake, workflow coordination, approvals, and repository management while ensuring a seamless contracting experience for internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on Conga CLM expertise with strong process improvement capabilities, excellent attention to detail, and a proactive approach to solving operational challenges. This is an excellent opportunity for a legal operations professional who enjoys leveraging technology, training and supporting users, managing legal service request and improving workflows, and helping build a more scalable and efficient legal function.

**Job Description**

* **Own Conga CLM Administration:**
  Manage day-to-day operations of the Conga CLM platformsupport implementation, configuration, and ongoing administration of the CLM platform, manage day-to-day operations including contract intake, workflow routing, approval coordination, execution tracking, and repository management to ensure efficient and accurate contract processing.
* **Optimize Contract Lifecycle Workflows:**
  Monitor contract progression from initial request through execution, proactively identifying bottlenecks, resolving workflow issues, and coordinating with stakeholders to maintain timely processing. Identify opportunities to automate manual activities and improve workflow efficiency through Conga CLM and related tools.
* **Maintain Contract Repository Integrity:**
  Oversee the uploading, indexing, classification, organization, and maintenance of agreements and related documentation, ensuring accurate records, consistent metadata, and reliable document accessibility.
* **Manage Legal Service Requests and Ticketing Systems:**
  Administer the legal department's Freshservice ticketing platform, including request intake, categorization, assignment, prioritization, tracking, reporting and follow-up to support effective workload management and service delivery. Monitor pending requests, and support timely and efficient delivery of legal services.
* **Enhance Operational Visibility:**
  Maintain Smartsheet trackers and other reporting tools to provide visibility into contract activity, pending approvals, legal requests, workload distribution, and operational priorities.
* **Drive Process Improvement:**
  Evaluate existing legal operations processes, identify opportunities to eliminate manual tasks, streamline approval workflows, improve data accuracy, and increase overall departmental efficiency.
* **Support Legal Technology Initiatives:**
  Participate in the implementation, configuration support, testing, and adoption of new legal operations, contract management, vendor management, and workflow technologies. Work with internal stakeholders and relevant technology providers to resolve issues, implement improvements, and ensure systems remain aligned with the legal team’s operational requirements.
* **Partner Across Business Functions:**
  Collaborate with Legal, Sales, Delivery, Finance, and other internal teams to facilitate contract processing, clarify submission requirements, and resolve operational challenges.
* **Develop Documentation and Best Practices:**
  Create and maintain standard operating procedures, workflow documentation, process guides, and user resources to promote consistency, system adoption, and operational excellence. Provide ongoing user support to encourage adoption and improve operational efficiency
* **Support Strategic Legal Operations Projects:**
  Contribute to departmental initiatives focused on improving legal service delivery, strengthening operational controls, and building scalable processes that support organizational growth.

**Requirements**

* 3–8 years of experience in legal operations, contract lifecycle management, contract administration, or a related business operations function.
* **Required: Strong hands-on experience administering Conga CLM**
  , including contract intake, workflow management, approval routing, template and clause library management and contract repository administration.
* Demonstrated experience managing contract documentation, metadata, indexing, document uploads, and end-to-end contract processing workflows.
* Experience managing ticketing and service management platforms, preferably Freshservice or comparable ticketing and service management platforms. Experience using Smartsheet or similar workflow tracking tools to manage legal requests, contract activity, workload distribution, and operational metrics
* Demonstrated ability to develop training materials, conduct user training, support onboarding, troubleshoot user issues, and drive adoption of CLM platforms and standardized processes.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, troubleshoot operational issues, and maintain exceptional accuracy.
* Experience supporting legal operations, process improvement initiatives, workflow automation, system enhancements, or legal technology implementations and developing SOPs and process documentation.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across legal, business, and operational teams.
* A bachelor's degree in Legal Studies, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.

title: Senior Tax Associate - GMS
description:

Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.
  
  
To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.
  
  
**Job Summary**
In this position, your main duty will be to act as the first point of contact for inquiries related to Employment Tax. As you evolve into a Subject Matter Expert, you will work closely with clients, guiding them through complex employment tax issues. This role entails ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, identifying opportunities for tax savings and operational improvements, and ensuring that Employment Tax practices are in sync with the broader business strategy and primary objectives.
  
  
In this position, your main duty will be to act as the first point of contact for inquiries related to Global Mobility Services (GMS) focused on Cross border compliances. This includes expertise in tax compliance for employers and employees, social security implications, equity incentives (e.g., stock options/RSUs), and advisory services. You will collaborate with clients to address complex employment tax matters, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, minimizing tax exposure, and aligning employment tax practices with business objectives.
  
  
**Job Description**
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Understand and analyze residential status under Income Tax Act, FEMA, and tax treaties.
* Advise on tax and social security implications for employees and employers, including secondment arrangements and employer reporting obligations.
* Interpret and apply provisions of DTAAs to minimize tax liabilities.
* Handle complex tax returns, including foreign asset reporting.
* Analyze and advise on taxability of equity plans (e.g., stock options, RSUs).

description:

Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need.
  
  
**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

**Purpose And Scope**
Summarize the primary purpose of the position in 1-3 sentences. Intent is to capture the work this position does and is accountable for and why the role exists as a unique position. Not intended to be a summary of all duties.
  
  

* The AI Governance Specialist is a member of the AI Governance team within the DigitalX organization's Enterprise AI Enablement team, supporting all Astellas regions. Reporting to the AI Governance Lead, the role executes and operates the global AI Governance framework day to day, running intake and risk assessments, maintaining governance documentation and controls, and supporting delivery teams so that AI and Generative AI solutions are developed and used safely, ethically and in compliance with global regulations. title: Legal Counsel
description:
Legal Counsel, Channels
  
  
Bangalore, India preferred (Hybrid in office 2 days a week) | Open to fully remote within India for the right candidate
  
  
About Our Team
  
  
The Rubrik Commercial Legal Team manages Rubrik's global commercial contracts and revenue-related legal matters. Within Commercial Legal, the Channels & Alliances legal team supports Rubrik's partner ecosystem: the distributors, resellers, managed service providers, global and regional system integrators, and alliance partners through which Rubrik sells its data security and cyber resilience products worldwide.
  
  
Rubrik goes to market primarily through a two-tier channel: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, the Distributor sells to a Reseller, and the Reseller sells to the end Customer. This role is the day-to-day legal partner for that business unit. You will be the first point of contact for the Channels organization on reseller and distributor agreements, amendments and partner program requests, keeping deals moving and partners compliant. You will join a small, collaborative team and work alongside a Channels Legal Counsel peer, reporting to the Director of Legal who leads Channels & Alliances, Marketplaces and Inbound Licensing.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for an attorney who already works in the channel world, enjoys negotiating with partners and wants to be a trusted advisor to a fast-moving sales organization.
  
  
Where You Can Make an Impact

* Own day-to-day channel contracting: Draft, review and negotiate reseller agreements, distributor agreements, amendments, adoption agreements for partner affiliates, resale enablement amendments and other documents partners need to resell Rubrik's SaaS and subscription products.
* Live in the two-tier channel model: Apply a deep working knowledge of Rubrik's go-to-market: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, who sells to a Reseller, who sells to the end Customer. Understand how order flow, pricing and discounts, deal registration, flow-down terms and end-user agreements work across each tier, and spot when a request breaks the model.
* Be the front door for the Channels organization: Manage the channel contract-request intake queue. Triage, prioritize and route incoming requests, resolve routine matters yourself and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation.
* Support the Partner Program: Advise Partner Programs and Partner Operations on partner program requests, program terms and conditions, tier and status changes, program exceptions, incentive and referral arrangements, and partner onboarding and offboarding.
* Advise channel leaders and account managers: Act as a trusted advisor to Channel Account Managers, Distribution leaders, Alliances and the Channels Global Partner Organization. Answer their questions with practical, business-ready guidance and help them close deals on standard terms.
* Negotiate directly with partners: Lead negotiations and calls with partner legal, procurement and business teams. Hold Rubrik's standard positions, use approved fallbacks and know when to escalate.
* Build and maintain templates and playbooks: Create and update channel agreement templates, amendment forms, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, FAQs and training so the ecosystem stays on standard terms and the business can self-serve.
* Drive deals to signature: Coordinate internal approvals, signature requests and e-signature execution, and work with Partner Operations and Deal Desk so executed agreements are recorded correctly in Salesforce and partners can transact.
* Apply a compliance and competition lens: Identify and escalate antitrust and competition law issues common to distribution (resale price maintenance, dual distribution, territorial and customer restrictions, exclusivity), as well as anti-corruption, sanctions and export, and public-sector procurement issues.
* Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Commercial Legal, Privacy, Security, Revenue, Tax, Deal Desk and Partner Operations to deliver consistent answers and keep channel terms aligned with Rubrik's customer-facing terms.
* Support a global channel: Work IST business hours while supporting partners and stakeholders worldwide, with a primary focus on APAC and EMEA and meaningful AMER coverage. Flex your hours during quarter-end and other peak periods to support AMER deals.
* Improve how we work: Spot repeat questions and bottlenecks, propose process and template fixes, and use technology (including AI tools) to speed up routine work.

Ideal Background

* Licensed attorney in India (LL.B. and enrolled with a State Bar Council) with 3 to 6 years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house experience at a technology or SaaS company.
* Currently working in a channel, partner or distribution contracting role. You negotiate reseller and distributor agreements today and understand two-tier distribution and how SaaS is resold through partners.
* Comfortable negotiating directly with partner legal and procurement teams and advising business stakeholders without a safety net.
* Working knowledge of partner programs, deal registration, subscription and SaaS commercial models, and how channel terms interact with end-customer terms.
* Awareness of competition and compliance issues in distribution relationships and of anti-bribery and anti-corruption rules that apply to selling through partners.
* Excellent English drafting and communication skills. You write clearly, explain risk in business terms and give a recommendation, not a menu.
* Organized and reliable in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You prioritize well, track your queue and close the loop.
* Independent, proactive and business-oriented, with sound judgment about what to decide and what to escalate.
* Experience with Salesforce, DocuSign or similar e-signature tools, and contract lifecycle management systems is a plus.
* Willingness to flex working hours periodically to support AMER-based deals and quarter-end activity.

Working Model
  
  
Our preferred candidate is based in Bangalore and works from the Rubrik office two days a week. We will consider remote candidates elsewhere in India for the right fit. You will work standard IST business hours and support a global partner base, with a primary emphasis on APAC and EMEA and regular AMER coverage. Periodic late-evening availability for AMER deals and quarter-end is expected, but not an everyday requirement.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

  

**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**

* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

------------------------------------------------

title: General Manager-Legal
description:
**Role Overview** The GM Legal will lead and manage all litigation and dispute resolution matters for the renewable energy business, including solar, wind, hybrid, storage, transmission, and related infrastructure. The role requires deep understanding of sector‑specific regulatory frameworks, commercial disputes, land‑related litigation, EPC and O&M issues, and government interface. -

**Key Responsibilities****1. Litigation Strategy & Management** - Manage and oversee all litigation across civil, commercial, regulatory, arbitration, criminal, environmental, labour, and land acquisition matters. - Develop and implement litigation strategy aligned with business goals and project timelines. - Provide risk analysis and strategic inputs for high‑value disputes and contingencies. - Ensure effective case lifecycle management including tracking, reporting, and closure.

**2. Renewable SectorSpecific Dispute Handling** - Handle disputes related to: - EPC/O&M contractors - Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) - Open access, transmission, and grid‑connectivity issues - Land acquisition, ROW, and local authority challenges - DISCOMs and state nodal agencies - SLDC / RLDC / CERC / SERC regulatory litigation - Support negotiations for tariff issues, curtailment, scheduling, penalties, liquidated damages, and performance claims.

**3. Regulatory & Government Interface** - Draft and review replies for regulatory bodies: CERC, SERCs, MNRE, SECI, revenue authorities, forest/environment departments, and state land authorities. - Handle show‑cause notices, compliance matters, and appeals before tribunals. - Represent the organisation in government hearings, regulatory proceedings, and compliance audits.

**4. External Counsel & Advisor Management** - Identify, empanel, and manage external advocates and law firms across multiple states. - Review pleadings, statements, notices, and legal opinions prepared by counsel. - Ensure high‑quality representation and cost optimisation. ### **5. Contractual & Documentation Support** - Review litigation‑sensitive clauses in EPC contracts, PPAs, land agreements, vendor contracts, and financing documents. - Ensure documentation, evidence, and internal approvals for litigation are timely and accurate. - Oversee drafting of replies, complaints, petitions, affidavits, and arbitration submissions.

**6. Internal Advisory & Stakeholder Coordination** - Collaborate closely with Projects, EPC, Finance, Land, Regulatory, and Operations teams. - Conduct internal investigations, fact‑finding exercises, and legal audits. - Provide preventive legal advisory to reduce disputes.

**7. Governance, Risk & Compliance** - Build SOPs for dispute resolution and legal risk mitigation. - Conduct training on litigation risk, regulatory compliance, and contract safeguards. - Monitor legal budgets, case outcomes, timelines, and recurring risk patterns. -

**Qualifications & Experience** - LL.B / LL.M from a reputed law school. - 10-15+ years of experience in litigation, preferably in energy, infrastructure, EPC, or utilities. - Strong exposure to regulatory bodies like CERC, SERCs, APTEL, and state authorities. - Experience handling arbitration, high‑stake commercial disputes, and land‑related matters. - Prior leadership experience in managing multi‑state litigation portfolios.

**Key Skills & Competencies** - Deep knowledge of the Electricity Act, renewable energy regulations, transmission codes, land laws, and contract laws. - Strong analytical, drafting, and negotiation skills. - Ability to handle high‑pressure, time‑sensitive regulatory matters. - Excellent stakeholder and cross‑functional coordination abilities. - High integrity, strong business acumen, and leadership maturity.

title: Tender & Liaison Officer/Manager
description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Tender & Liaison Officer responsible for managing the complete tendering process, coordinating with government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), and private organizations, and ensuring timely submission of tenders. The candidate will also be responsible for maintaining effective liaison with relevant authorities and ensuring compliance with tender requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and monitor tender opportunities through GeM, CPPP, e-procurement portals, government websites and other platforms.
* Prepare, review and submit tenders, quotations, bids and proposals within specified deadlines.
* Coordinate with government departments, PSUs, procurement authorities and other agencies regarding tender-related matters.
* Handle online tender submission, bid opening, corrigendum updates and follow-ups.
* Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Accounts, Finance, Production and Legal for tender documentation.
* Follow up on submitted tenders, work orders, purchase orders and payment-related matters.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with government officials, consultants and procurement agencies.
* Track tender results and prepare regular MIS reports for management.
* Travel to Pan India as and when required -

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PG Diploma in Marketing or Business Administration preferred.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in tender management and government liaison.
* Good knowledge of GeM Portal, CPPP and various e-tendering platforms.
* Strong documentation, communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tenders and meet strict deadlines.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Number of tenders identified and submitted.
* Accuracy and timely submission of tender documents.
* Tender qualification and success ratio.
* Effective coordination and follow-up with authorities.
* Timely completion of tender-related documentation.
* Revenue generated through successful tender participation.

title: Sr. Golang Engineer AI-Era Software Development
description:
Job Summary 
 Position overview: We are seeking a Senior Golang Engineer to design, develop and operate scalable cloud-native systems while leveraging AI to improve delivery speed, quality and team productivity. You will bring strong expertise in Go, concurrent programming and distributed systems. You will work with Product, QA and DevOps stakeholders to translate business needs into reliable solutions, use AI to accelerate appropriate development activities, and take responsibility for verifying the quality and safety of the results. You will also help the team adopt effective AI-assisted workflows, maintain clear technical context and continuously improve how we deliver customer value. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Software design and development: Lead the design and development of scalable, performant and maintainable systems using Go, including concurrent and distributed applications. Design and manage RESTful APIs and microservices that integrate effectively with existing systems. Translate business and customer requirements into technical designs in collaboration with Product, QA, DevOps and other stakeholders. Define and address non-functional requirements, including security, scalability, performance, reliability and observability. Optimise SQL databases and queries for efficient data management and system performance. Identify technical risks early and develop practical mitigation plans. 
 
 AI-assisted delivery 
 Use approved AI tools to support research, design, implementation, testing, documentation and troubleshooting throughout the development lifecycle. Apply sound judgment when deciding which tasks to delegate to AI and what level of human review and verification is required. Review, test and improve AI-generated code, tests and documentation. Remain accountable for the correctness, security and maintainability of delivered work. Use generative AI to create prototypes, clarify uncertain requirements and validate ideas quickly with stakeholders. Maintain clear specifications, architecture decisions and project documentation so that both engineers and AI tools can understand the relevant context. Follow company policies for AI usage, data protection, confidentiality and access permissions. 
 
 Quality, operations and delivery 
 Build and maintain cloud-native applications on AWS using appropriate container and infrastructure technologies. Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, and manage version control workflows through GitHub. Collaborate with QA to identify testing gaps and improve automated testing, including the appropriate use of AI-assisted test generation. Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues in development and production environments. Lead production releases, coordinating with relevant teams and improving future releases through feedback and lessons learned. Balance delivery speed, release quality and technical debt while considering impacts on existing systems and business workflows. Identify delivery bottlenecks and improve team workflows, using measures such as lead time, quality and throughput where appropriate. 
 
 Leadership and collaboration 
 Mentor engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pair programming and knowledge sharing. Support team members in developing effective prompting, context-setting and AI-output review skills. Promote a culture of learning, experimentation, ownership and continuous improvement. Communicate technical decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Contribute to technology and tool selection based on business value, team needs and long-term maintainability. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Required qualifications 
 5+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years of Go development. Strong experience with Go concurrency, including goroutines, channels and concurrency control. Experience designing, troubleshooting and optimising scalable distributed systems. Experience with cloud-native technologies, particularly AWS, Docker and Kubernetes. Strong SQL skills, including database and query performance optimisation. Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools and version control using GitHub. Experience designing and managing RESTful APIs or microservices. Experience leading production releases and collaborating across engineering, Product, QA and operational teams. Ability to use AI-assisted development tools effectively and critically evaluate their outputs. Strong understanding of software testing, code review and engineering practices needed to deliver reliable, maintainable software. Ability to work through ambiguity, learn new technologies and make sound technical decisions. Strong communication, mentoring and cross-functional collaboration skills. 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience using AI to support prototyping, test automation, documentation or development workflow improvements. Experience coaching others in AI-assisted development or introducing AI tools and practices to a team. Experience integrating LLM APIs into application workflows, including prompt design and handling asynchronous or non-deterministic responses. Experience building services that interact with AI agents or developing AI-enabled product features. Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or the ELK Stack. Knowledge of security best practices for cloud-native environments. Familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ or other messaging technologies used in event-driven architectures. Experience with frontend development, such as React, or a willingness to work across relevant parts of the development lifecycle.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Agentic AI Engineer (Flutter / Next.js) Location: Hyderabad | Type: Full-time About the role Were looking for a self-driven Agentic AI Engineer who ships real products fast using Claude and strong prompt engineering . You’ll learn on your own, research what’s needed, and build, publish and deploy mobile apps, web apps and AI agents end to end: clean UI, backend, integrations and deployment, without waiting for someone to tell you what to do. Must-have Claude expertise (mandatory): you use Claude daily and know it well: Claude chat, Claude Code, the Claude API, and how to pick the right approach for each task. You know how it behaves, where it fails and how to get it back on track. Prompt engineering (mandatory): you write clear, structured prompts with context, examples and constraints. You break big tasks into steps, ask for a plan before code, and fix bad output. You can show us real prompts you’ve used. Good UI skills: you build clean, responsive, user-friendly screens. You care about layout, spacing, usability and how the product feels on mobile and web. Show us UIs you’ve built. Backend skills: you build APIs and server logic (Node.js or similar) with MongoDB . You handle authentication, data models, error handling and security basics. Integration skills: you connect third-party services and APIs: payment gateways, WhatsApp, maps, notifications, webhooks and LLM APIs. You can read API docs and get an integration working on your own. Self-learner and independent: when you hit something new (a tool, API, framework, error), you research it, learn it and solve it yourself. You take a task from idea to published, end to end. Shipped work: at least 1 app and 1 website deployed, built using AI tools Languages: JavaScript and Dart Frameworks: hands-on experience in Flutter , Next.js , or both Mobile: at least 1 app published to the Play Store or App Store. If not published, at least 1 app fully built (share the repo or APK/TestFlight) Agentic AI: experience building and publishing AI agents with LLM APIs, tool/function calling or MCP Communication (important): clear spoken and written English. You explain what you built, why, and what didn’t work, in plain words. You are honest about what you know and don’t know. You say “I’m not sure, let me check” instead of guessing, you take feedback well, and you work humbly with a small team. We are not looking for overconfident people who claim to know everything. Good to have REST API design and Node.js CI/CD (Codemagic, GitHub Actions, Vercel) WhatsApp or chatbot integrations MCP servers, Claude Skills or Claude Projects What you’ll do Build and ship Flutter apps and Next.js web apps with good UI Build backend APIs and connect them to MongoDB Integrate payments, WhatsApp, maps and other third-party services Research, build and publish AI agents on your own, from first idea to live Use Claude daily to move faster, and help the team prompt better Deploy to the Play Store, App Store and web Own features end to end, with no hand-holding Tell the team early when something is blocked or going wrong How to apply Send: Links to your deployed website and published app (or repo/APK if unpublished) A 2-minute video or short note on how you used Claude to build them One real prompt example: the prompt you wrote, what Claude returned, and how you improved it One integration you built: which service, what was hard, how you solved it One thing you taught yourself: a tool or topic you didn’t know, how you learned it and what you shipped with it One mistake: something that went wrong in a project and what you learned from it Your GitHub / portfolio Shortlisting (candidates without Claude and prompting skills will not pass): Short call to check communication and attitude Live Claude task (30-45 min): we give you a feature to build end to end that they haven’t built before, for example a screen with good UI, a small backend API on MongoDB, and one integration. Use Claude and any resources you like. We watch how you prompt, how you handle bad output, how you review code before accepting it, and whether you get it working without asking us for help. Screening questions for the call: “How do you start a prompt for a big feature?” (Strong: context, constraints, plan first, small steps) “Claude gave you wrong code. What do you do?” (Strong: share the error, narrow the scope, test it) “When do you use Claude Code vs chat vs the API?” “Walk me through an integration you built. What broke?” (Strong: specific details, real problems) “How do you design a MongoDB collection for an orders feature?” (Strong: thinks about fields, indexes, status flow) “Tell me about something you got wrong.” (Strong: owns it, explains the fix. Weak: blames the tool or others) “What don’t you know well yet?” (Strong: names real gaps. Weak: “nothing, I can do everything”) Spotting overconfidence: they claim to know everything, never say “I don’t know”, can’t name a mistake, or dismiss feedback. Good candidates are confident in what they’ve shipped but honest about their limits

Key Skills: Flutter,Node.js,Engineering,React.js,Ai Solutions,Tools,Nextjs,MongoDB

title: Staff Software Engineer, Mobile
description:
About Outreach Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. 
 About the Team On the Mobile team, the goal is to give sellers everything they need to work their pipeline when theyre away from their desk: their daily tasks, calls, email, SMS, meetings, deal insights and an AI assistant. We own Outreachs native iOS and Android apps end to end. That includes a voice dialer built on Twilio, CallKit and Androids Telecom framework, real-time messaging, conversation recordings, forecasting, and Ask Outreach, our AI assistant. Many of our customers are large enterprises that manage their devices with Microsoft Intune, so the bar on security, reliability and privacy is high. As our Staff Engineer, Mobile , youll be engaged in the technical lead for mobile across both platforms. Youll guide the design of our feature work, estimate and plan it with product and engineering leadership, and drive it from kickoff to the App Store and Google Play. Both apps have grown fast, so youll also set the technical direction: modern architecture, a predictable release process and quality you can measure, planned alongside the roadmap rather than instead of it. Youll help build a mobile engineering culture that the rest of Outreach can lean on. We have plenty of tough challenges which require creative minds like yours to help us solve! Your Daily Adventures Will Include Partnering with mobile product manager, designers and stakeholders to understand how sellers work on the go, and turning roadmap ideas into features that serve those teams on cross-cutting systems such as real-time calling, OIDC authentication, push notifications, feature flags and the GraphQL API, and building buy-in for technical choices Working on one of the most visible parts of Outreachs product, to both our customers and the rest of our organization Improving the team and company. description:
Job Summary 
 As a React Native Software Development Engineer , you ll be working in an agile team of industry leading engineers upon Tesco s customer facing mobile application. Working with Product Managers, you will be responsible for the future direction of the products that we build, solving problems and developing new features through quality, scalable, performant and maintainable technical solutions. The solutions that you will be responsible for will have a global reach, impacting millions of customers. You ll be a passionate, pragmatic React Native Software Development Engineer with an inquisitive mind who is motivated to make change for the better and most importantly put our customer first. You ll enjoy working as part of a team and be a keen problem solver. Comfortable with modern engineering practices and mobile development tooling and technologies you ll use innovation to improve the customer experience and efficiency of engineering teams. Let s {code} the together at {Tesco Technology}! 
 
 Responsibilities 
 You will be working on the Tesco UK mobile application to implement the capabilities to improve and personalize customer experience and ease of use in the store. In this team we use the latest technologies, working with a GraphQL backend (maintained by another team). This squad of 7 will have both Android and iOS developers and you will work closely with our other native development and platform teams to deliver a high-quality product. We love to work with smart people who have a strong sense of ownership and strong engineering mindset. You provide mobile perspective and context for technology choices. You re up to the challenge of device and mobile network limitations, device fragmentation, and other mobile development curve balls. You are motivated to tackle ambiguous situations with new technologies to rapidly produce prototypes. You outline paths from prototype to product. You are a technical leader for your team. You contribute to the professional development of colleagues, improving their technical knowledge and the engineering practices on your team. 
 
 What you will need 
 
 Qualifications and relevant experience 
 We are looking for people who have a passion for Technology. You will likely have made open-source contributions and have a GitHub account. You will demonstrate experience of different platforms and technologies. We expect to see some or all the following: Experience in architecting complex mobile applications Extensive experience working on commercial software development in React Native BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent Firm understanding of software development principles, capabilities, and limitations of mobile platforms Passion for mobile development. We would love to hear about apps you ve developed. Understanding and exposure to integrating GraphQL API endpoints Strong experience and understanding of industry standard mobile accessibility Experience in full development life cycle; design, coding, test, build, QA, deployment, and maintenance Exposure to the DevOps model Experience in Lean and Agile environments and understanding of principles behind methodologies such as: BDD, ATDD and TDD A strong team player with the ability to influence and lead stakeholders when necessary Demonstrable ability to self-manage, be proactive, take ownership, build relationships, and drive solutions through from inception to production
